title: Plano Plastic Surgery
address: 4100 W 15th St STE 106, Plano, TX 75093, United States

user_reviews.Name: Natalee Watson
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Haidenberg and his team are literally THE BEST or the best. I came to Plano Plastic Surgery to get my breasts redone. I had a Breast Lift + Breast Augmentation with an Implant Exchange. We went with the Motiva Round implants. I had surgery 12 days ago and my boobs are so perfect!

Dr. Haidenberg’s consultation was top tier. His bedside manner is so calm and kind. He actually listens and explains everything in detail. I felt so comfortable and confident in him and his expertise, I scheduled the surgery that day!

His team is amazing. The front desk is so welcoming and warm, his nurse is fantastic and we talked like we have been friends forever, the financial support gorgeous gal was so amazing too. The surgery team was so confident, sat down and went over everything from pain management, nausea management, and the anesthesiologist was awesome. He assured me he wouldn’t leave my side.

And biggest of all…. I have had ZERO pain. I haven’t needed narcotics other than the first two days.

Dr. Haidenberg, Thank you SOOO MUCH. You are a plastic surgery KING and I’m referring everyone to you. 20/10 recommend!! ❤️❤️❤️

If you’re looking for an amazing surgeon, please go see Dr. Haidenberg and his team. 🙏🏼🙌🏼💕

user_reviews.Name: Deanna Becker
user_reviews.Description: My experience has been phenomenal.   The staff is so kind, helpful and cheerful.   Doctor Haidenberg did a beautiful job with my tummy tuck. He has a lot of patience.  Thank you to the entire Plano Plastics staff.

user_reviews.Name: BC
user_reviews.Description: What an amazing experience! 5 stars is an understatement! Everything looks so natural and, after c sections and breast feeding, I finally feel like myself again. Thank you, Dr. H, Yaime, and the whole team!

user_reviews.Name: Marie C
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Haidenberg is amazing! I had a breast reduction with no lift and it turned out exactly as I had hoped. I went for consultations at three other places and they told me it could not be done without a lift. I'm very pleased with my results!

user_reviews.Name: Jacob Rosenblatt
user_reviews.Description: Consultation was thorough and honest. Expectations, risks and instructions were laid out clearly and all of my questions answered openly. Dr Haidenberg is charismatic , experienced and exercises excellent judgement. Billing was laid out completely and honored- with no surprises.  Aftercare: great . And most importantly the results were amazing and better than I expected!

user_reviews.Name: Gabi Silver
user_reviews.Description: My best friend and I came to Dr. Haidenberg wanting a subtle but natural change in the boob department. We both got our surgeries 6 weeks apart and the process was so easy for both of us. I did not want anything incredibly fake that screamed “hey I have fake boobs!” But something that looked bigger than what I had. He took my measurements and told me exactly what I needed for my body type as I am 4’11” and did not want to look top heavy. Dr. H. and his entire staff are so amazing and informative and they all truly care about you from start to finish. His top priority is safety and it truly shows. Dr. H. and his staff also have the best bedside manner and they held my hand the entire way. I also appreciated that they were always there to answer questions promptly through a text portal if I had any. I am so glad I chose Dr. H. to be my surgeon and recommend him 10000%:)

user_reviews.Name: nokaoimaui05
user_reviews.Description:
This is my third surgery/service With Dr. Haidenberg w/ Plano plastic Surgery. Each experience has been exceptional.The entire team provides current knowledge, sincere care and concern. Even when I ask loads of  questions. Having  had 3 separate
experiences / surgeries over the years, I can honestly recommend Dr Haidenberg. Besides his excellent  skills as a surgeon, a detail that stands out is his exceptional bedside manner w/ patients. He’s down to earth and authentic. It’s rare to interact so well w/ any doctor regardless of their specialty- Especially in the current medical climate.  Dr. Haidenberg and his team will not disappoint!

user_reviews.Name: S J
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough about how happy I am with my results! I had my lip injections done by Esther, PA-C, and I’m so obsessed! 🩷

My lips look so natural and she gave me exactly what I wanted. Just the perfect “my lips, but better” look. I have been to countless med spas all over DFW over the years, and I can confidently say she is truly one of the best I’ve seen. The quality at Plano Plastics Surgery is unbeatable. I highly recommend Esther for all your next injectable needs, whether you’re considering injectables for the first time or looking to step up your aesthetic needs. Esther was super sweet, thorough, and informative.

Office was spotless and had a private feel. The entire experience at Plano Plastics Surgery from check-in to check-out was smooth, thanks to the friendly and helpful office staff.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn Derrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenberg is The Best Surgeon!!! There isn’t enough room here to write about all of my positive experiences. The entire staff and Dr. H all seem like family now after my surgery. Incredible Experience. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janeth Urbina
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenburg and the staff were very kind and welcoming. They helped me feel comfortable throughout the process, even though surgery made me nervous.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julianna Sims
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenburg did a breast lift and augmentation for me. He was kind, professional and explained in great detail , the procedure. He was realistic with the outcome, not leading me to believe I would magically look perfect. But he taught me how to look at myself as uniquely beautiful only larger in size. It was a huge confidence boost for me. I am very thankful for his approach and care. The staff here were also amazing. They answered my many silly and repetitive questions with calm assurance and always made me feel comfortable and cared for. I am thankful I was finally able to have this procedure and am thoroughly satisfied with how I was treated and the outcome of my surgery. Thank you Dr. H and staff at Plano Plastic Surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonja Wagner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a tummy tuck last September 2024.  I had the best experience with this surgery.  Dr.  Haidenberg was very personable and knew the ins and outs of the surgery. He explained everything to me and my husband so we understood what would be happening. His office staff is top notch they made you feel like part of the family.  Today I had my six month checkup and the results are amazing. My tummy is completely flat, and I’m loving it. I recommend Dr. Haidenberg to anyone who is thinking about plastic surgery.
Sonja Wagner

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Neeley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am beyond thrilled with my procedure, Dr H and the entire office! I had my first breast augmentation over 23 years ago and was well over due. Dr H, his nurses and especially Carrie, his patient coordinator were amazing!!!! The outcome my recent surgery with Dr H was more than I expected! I never thought my breasts could look better than they did 20 years ago but here we are! I am extremely pleased and grateful for Dr H, his hard work and attention to detail. He made sure I was comfortable, listened and patiently answered all of my questions. I cannot say enough good things!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Who the hell is Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such an amazing experience from my initial consult to my final results.  The staff is very professional and kind.  Anything I needed or asked for was taken seriously and with high regard.  I can’t say enough about Dr. Haidenberg and Dr. Yaker - excellent surgeons and excellent care.  Thank you so very much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a surgery. It was scheduled fast, done professionaly, and the price was humane. Everybody was friendly and professional. My appointment was confirmed a day before by sending me a text - so convenient. I will definitely use this business for all my future needs. Thank you everyone who works here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trina Utt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenberg Is an artist. He repaired a breast implant rupture botched job by another doctor. I had waited years to have it done because of the bad experience.  I wish I’d seen Dr. Haidenberg earlier.  The doctor and his staff are amazing and he did such a wonderful job. I felt better the day after surgery. They have taken such a good care of me and I am so pleased.I would highly recommend Plano Plastic Surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irene Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The procedure was smooth and super quick. Thank GOD, I have been following all the recommendations and my recovery is being amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Klingler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough about my experience with Plano Plastic Surgery and Dr. Heidenberg.  I had lost a significant amount of weight and decided to have a tummy tuck and Liposuction. It's been less than two months and I am thrilled with the results. The team has been very attentive and informative as I heal. If you've thought a lot of cosmetic surgery go in an have a consultation. It's worth it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emilie Jansen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had the most incredible experience with Dr. Haidenberg! He listened and understood exactly what I was wanting- I couldn't be happier! His staff is top notch and so informative  - love everything here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella Argentine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had the greatest experience with Plano Plastic Surgery. Dr. H has been very reassuring with the process from start to finish. The entire staff is so positive and encouraging. This office feels like a safe space no matter what stage of surgery or treatment you’re in. Consultations to post op, I’ve had nothing but good experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jemmiah Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot recommend Plano Plastic Surgery and Dr. Haidenberg highly enough! From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcomed and at ease — they are friendly, professional, and incredibly courteous.

What truly set my experience apart was Dr. Haidenberg’s honesty and expertise. I initially came in with an idea of what I wanted, but Dr. Haidenberg was the only surgeon who told me “no” — and I’m so grateful he did. Instead of just giving me what I asked for, he offered a much better solution tailored to my goals and anatomy. The results are incredible — far beyond what I had imagined. I truly believe that if I had gone with another provider, I wouldn’t be nearly as happy with the outcome.

Another great perk: with your breast augmentation, you receive 50 free units of Botox or Juvederm, which was such a nice bonus! They also have licensed estheticians on site for skincare services, and the surgery suite is onsite, making everything so convenient and streamlined.

If you’re looking for a plastic surgeon who is both skilled and ethical, with a team that makes you feel supported every step of the way, I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Haidenberg and Plano Plastic Surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liz Lupton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Haidenberg is an incredible plastic surgeon and a genuinely kind person. I had a tummy tuck, lipo, and a breast lift, and I couldn’t be happier with my results—even after gaining a little weight!
His gentle, attentive nature made me feel confident and cared for throughout the process.
His staff is equally kind and helpful, making the experience smooth and enjoyable. Dr. Haidenberg is a true artist, and I highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Daum
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend! Dr. Haidenburg is an artist! So happy with my results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malina Suwannetr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a mini abdominoplasty in October 2022 with Dr. Haidenberg, and I couldn’t be happier with my results! From the very first consultation to my final follow-up, the entire process was seamless, professional, and truly personalized.

Dr. Haidenberg’s attention to detail and surgical expertise were evident every step of the way. He took the time to listen to my concerns, thoroughly explain the procedure, and set realistic expectations. His compassionate approach made me feel completely at ease, and his commitment to achieving natural, beautiful results exceeded my expectations.

The office staff was just as wonderful—friendly, supportive, and always available to answer any questions. Their level of care and professionalism made the experience even better - especially Vee and all his MA's!

Now, more than a year later, I am beyond thrilled with my results! The contouring and improvement in my midsection have given me a renewed sense of confidence, and my scar is minimal thanks to Dr. Haidenberg’s skillful technique.

If you're considering any cosmetic procedure, I highly recommend Plano Plastic Surgery and Dr. Haidenberg. Their expertise, kindness, and dedication to patient satisfaction truly set them apart!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edna Morataya
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I walked in, the staff was warm, professional, and attentive. The consultation with Dr. Haidenberg was thorough; he took the time to explain every detail of the procedure and answering all my questions patiently.
On the day of surgery, everything was well-organized, and I felt completely at ease knowing I was in skilled hands. The post-operative care was exceptional, with the staff checking in on me regularly and making sure my recovery was on track. I am thrilled with the results, my expectations were not only met but exceeded. The pricing was clear from the start, and I feel I received great value for the quality of care and results I achieved.

I highly recommend Dr. Haidenberg to anyone considering plastic surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Lassiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING! Not enough good things to say about Plano Plastic Surgery, it's staff and Dr.Haidenberg!!! The front desk staff won me over on the very first phone call, and have been nothing but an absolute dream ever since. They answer any and every question (no matter how big or small, at any time of the day) I felt very comfortable, valued and important with the whole staff. Dr.H made my dreams come true with my breast augmentation, the results are everything i've ever wanted and more. I love everything about this place and would recommend it to everyone!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenberg and his whole team greeted each part of the process with honesty and kindness, and I couldn’t speak more highly to the precision in his work. He is very knowledgeable and very skilled at his craft. I was very uncomfortable before I came in to his office for a consultation and afterward, I knew he was my doctor. He was warm and confident and his team was a variety of helpful and honest. I will always recommend anyone looking for cosmetic work to look to this practice because it has exceeded my expectations in every way. The outside of the office is unassuming but they spend their time and money where it counts - to benefiting your procedure. I cannot think of one thing I would change about my experience with Dr. Haidenberg. Very happy with my results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Solisa Phipps
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yaker did a phenomenal job on my explant and reconstruction! I’m so happy and confident in my new look!! Healed beautifully. I’m forever grateful for Plano Plastic and Dr. Yaker. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Onyinye Nweke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m almost a year post op and getting my reduction by DR. Haidenberg was one of the best decisions I’ve made. I’m so happy with my results and the after care received. He and his staff are very friendly, welcoming and you feel so calm with the process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vee H
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Haidenberg at Plano Plastic surgery is hands down the BEST Plastic Surgeon. He is truly exceptional and highly skilled in his craft. His talent and professionalism is unmatched. I recently had neck lipo done on a Thursday and was back to work on Monday! The consultation was very thorough and he really listened to my concerns. The OR Team and office staff were also amazing from my Pre-OP to my first Post Op visit. I am only 2 weeks out from surgery and already pleased with my results! I highly recommend Dr.Haidenberg as your Plastic Surgeon, you will not regret it!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drea Lucier
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a mommy make over about a week ago, and I have to say...I am extremely happy with my results. Everyone in this facility were very professional. They always treated me with the best manners. Dr. H was so caring and so gentle with everything he helped me with. He always made me feel very comfortable and made sure I got the best results. My nurses toke such great care of me afterwards and I was up and walking the next day. I am healing so good and I highly recommend them to everyone who ask about my work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Nugent
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Haidenberg is the best. I worked at a dermatology office and could get injections at a discount but I come to Plano Plastic Spa because of his expertise. The entire office is professional and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: brittany hargis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got my breasts done with Dr. Haidenberg, and not only do my breasts look amazing, he was so nice, professional and thorough with explaining everything. Could not have asked for a better experience here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Office Melanie Burman, LCSW
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am completely satisfied with the results of my procedure and the before and after care of the staff! Dr. H is wonderful! Edna and all the staff are very attentive and kind! The aftercare and follow up is better than any other plastic surgery office! I will continue with services from the spa!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy Argentine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience with Dr. Yaker, very grateful that he was my doctor.  I had my procedure in December 2021.  As a curvy woman, I felt he did a wonderful job on my mommy make over, I'm extremely pleased with the results. From the first consultation, through out the procedure and follow up visits, he made me feel safe and listened to.  His whole staff was so lovely, professional and patient. Thank you again!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Lovelace
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough about how thrilled I am with my surgery results! Dr. Haidenberg’s work and care are TOP NOTCH as well as that of his entire team! Part of my treatment plan included follow up visits and I looked forward to seeing Yaime and all the ladies in the front because they were so helpful and so friendly! I repeat TOP NOTCH!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Hanson
user_reviews_extended.Description: i recently got a breast reduction, and i cannot say enough good things about the entire experience! everyone in there was super helpful, the staff was super kind and friendly. i was nervous going into it, but dr.haidenberg did a fantastic job and was very sweet! will be back in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet Dewey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a couple of procedures done by Dr. Haidenberg at Plano Plastic Surgery and I want to say what a success it was. The staff are professional and so helpful. Dr. Heidenberg is very talented in surgery and gentle and caring in the office. I won’t ever go to anyone else. Great job Team!
Janet Dewey

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenberg was recommended to me from a friend. I was looking for a chest augmentation procedure, and they more than delivered. The whole staff was so kind and helpful, and they were so wonderful during the entire process. Not to mention, my chest looks the best it ever has, and I have more confidence in myself than ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laine A.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yaker and his entire office staff are phenomenal. I've had a breast lift/reduction and tummy tuck and I wouldn't go anywhere else. I'm so thrilled with my results and Dr. Yaker is so kind, takes his time and is very honest about what he thinks will look best. Edna, his nurse, is fantastic! She was with me every step of the way from my consult through my recovery. Believe me when I say you will be thrilled with your results with Dr. Yaker!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camila Boy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Haidenberg and his staff!! After my first consultation, I felt so comfortable, so understood, and I knew that Cosmetic Surgery Associates of Texas is where I would do my surgery. The reception staff is so lovely and welcoming, all of the nurses were incredible, and of course Dr. H is the best ever. Literally everyone I interacted with was so helpful and kind. A big shout out to Yeimi and Carrie who went above and beyond for me and made my experience that much better! I am beyond thrilled with my results and the delicate care Dr. Haidenberg and his staff took of me and my concerns/ wants. Forever grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: SIMPLY THE BEST! I highly recommend Dr. Haidenberg, I have had several procedures done elsewhere and I wish I would have found him sooner. His attention to detail, compassion toward his patients, and love for his line of work makes him the best! He did an amazing job helping me with issues from a prior breast augmentation surgery, the staff is just the cherry on top. The girls are amazing, everyone there is just so caring and eager to help. I love attending my post-op appointments, they all make me feel so welcomed. The Dr. takes his time explaining and analyzing any concerns or issues, you do not feel rushed, and he makes you feel so at ease. If you are looking for quality results and care Dr. Haidenberg is the one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabby Brule
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a great experience with Plano Plastic Surgery.  Dr. Yaker and his staff really walk you through the process and are there to answer all your questions. I felt very comfortable with Dr. Yaker right from the start and the office staff are so friendly and make you feel welcome.  Dr. Yaker took my medical history into account and used preventative measures to ensure a successful outcome. Couldn't believe there was barely any bruising after the procedure. I am about a month post-op and happy with the results so far!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ABIGAIL SKINNER
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenberg is an exceptional surgeon that is full of compassion, poise, and knowledge. His staff is truly amazing from the consultation to the check-ins. He is truly masterful in his work and understands what looks best on all different shapes and sizes of bodies...I am very happy and pleased with his work and how he and his staff treated me! Thank you Dr. Haidenberg for making me feel my best!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Pryor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had an excellent experience with my tummy talk. The staff is great. Doctor was great so far my results. I’m a week out from my first for my surgery. It all looks good. I have no complaints. Highly recommend Dr. Heidenburg.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carole Kalogirou
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a neck lift/face lift a couple of weeks ago and I am blown away how great it looks so soon. The staff from the receptionist to Dr. Haidenberg who performed the surgery and everyone in between were not only friendly and approachable, but very professional. The care I received after surgery was also top notch. I have had previous plastic surgery in my past and I can honestly say this was the best experience I have ever had. I highly recommend this team of professionals if you’re looking for awesome results and being taken care of like family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Arzate
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a wonderful experience. Dr. Yaker and Dr. Haidenberg’s staff are so knowledgeable. From the moment of arrival you are put at ease. Such a welcoming and relaxed environment is immediately reassuring. The procedure and recovery were thoroughly covered in the first visit. I felt very confident in Dr. Yaker before the surgery. He knew exactly what I needed and he is a truly a skilled artist! This surgery has not only improved my outer appearance, but has made me feel better about me inside.  I will always be grateful for the experience with he and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Haidenberg was phenomenal from start to finish. He was patient and compassionate about all of my questions. I am not yet fully healed so will continue to see results but I have already seen a change in so many aspects of my life from the breast reduction and tummy tuck. I am off all my headaches meds and the headaches and neck pain is gone! I love my body again and have my confidence back. I can’t wait to see the fully healed results! Can’t recommend him enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Haidenberg and staff have been so amazing with me through the whole process. All my questions are always fully answered and the work I have had which has been a tummy tuck and a neck lift have been unbelievable. I can't say enough good things for the work received and how I have been treated as a patient. I would  recommend this practice 10 times over!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ms. Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today, Im only 1 week post op but I have to begin with the exceptional, professional and friendly staff I started seeing the Summer of 2023. I researched Dr. Heidenberg's work, office and reviews. My first visit he was professional, honest and didn't try to upsale or take advantage of me to get a sell. I took my time with my desicion. Mrs. Hall explained all my options with no pressure. Yaime and other nurses informed me of everything, and left nothing for me to question. The day before my lipo the anesthesiologist made sure I had what I needed. The day of, everyone was on point, made me feel at ease and made me nice and comfy AND WARM. I was never afraid and thats not me! The plush blankets and heated operating table was enough to make me want to stay. I can already tell a difference through the normal swelling and Im excited to see my final results. My pain is minimal which is surprising because I have a zero pain tolerance. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jannelle Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I searched for a very long time and received multiple opinions with other plastic surgeons in Beverly Hills and Del Mar from some of the best surgeons who advised against a reverse tummy tuck and only taking minimal tissue out of my breast for a breast reduction. I’ve had large breasts my entire life and knew I wanted to go down to a B cup. I also had some loose skin on my upper abdomen from having three children and having lipo in that area. My belly button needed a lift but I did not want a full tummy tuck. I kept searching for the right doctor who was confident in his skillset who has experience in these specific procedures. I can’t express how grateful I am for Dr. Haidenberg. He really listened to what I wanted and he took his time making sure every measurement was correct. Every incision is absolutely perfect. My breasts look perfectly symmetrical, my results really exceeded my expectations and I have very high expectations. I also had an umbellical hernia repair and was told by multiple high profile surgeons I’d have a large scar and that was what I was trying to prevent by doing the reverse tummy tuck. I did not want belly button scars and others told me it is inevitable. Dr. Haidenberg addressed my umbilical  hernia from within while doing the reverse tummy tuck and left zero scars on the outside. He is absolutely brilliant and his skillset is unmatched. You can tell he really comes up with a game plan during your pre-op, he studies you meticulously and really prepares himself. I’m so happy I took a chance with him for both my breast reduction, my reverse tummy tuck, and hernia repair. I flew from California and would do it again in a heartbeat if I had to. I wish more of his patients would review him because there was really no reason for me to feel so nervous before the procedure. I really was in the best hands.  Just an incredible surgeon. For every perfectionist out there Dr. Haidenberg really is your guy.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Dr. Yaker in 2011, he was highly recommended by a few friends. I did not consult with any other surgeon as again, the trust of my friends were validating enough. I’m coming back years later to share that I would proceed with caution and make sure to ask plenty of questions during consult, and throughout the consideration- surgery process. I decided to have a breast augmentation, silicone under the muscle. After going through some health scares I decided to explant. While trying to validate the type of implant I had, I found out that Dr Yaker never registered my implants with the national Allergan database. Then upon explanting to my surprise they were actually above the muscle. I do not recall him ever telling me if he had to make a gametime decision just seems like important thing to cover with a patient. His staff was very kind and compassionate but knowing what I know now I find it disheartening that these things were missed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are shopping doctors, your search is over. I chose Dr. Yaker based on reviews, the samples of his work and his years of experience. I am almost two weeks post-surgery and really cannot say enough about him and his office. My BMI was 34, so clinically obese. Never one time did any doctor or nurse ever make me feel ashamed of my middle-aged body. Everyone was always encouraging and supportive, even trying to help me realize the curves and beauty of my pre-surgery body that has gifted me with two beautiful daughters. I got so much personal attention pre-surgery, including personal calls from the nurse and the anesthesiologist to explain the entire process and answer all my questions and concerns. Day of surgery was smooth and went exactly as explained. Dr. Yaker did a wonderful job with part 1 of my Mommy Makeover, which included a tummy tuck, breast lift and augmentation, and lipo of my inner thighs and knees. (Part 2 is still to come, which is lipo of flanks and hips.) My baby flab that just hung over my C-section scar is now gone and my stomach is flat! Dr. Yaker tightened my abdomen muscles which had separated during pregnancy and my breasts no longer look deflated from nursing. Even with the body swelling and stitches, I already feel more confident and beautiful. Aftercare has been very attentive and there is always someone available on-call. This is a gift I gave myself and I regret nothing! For those who have questions about the cost, a Mommy Makeover can be pricey because of the amount of work being done, but I felt the individual pricing of each separate procedure was very reasonable and fair. If you need help with financing, they have options. (Personally, I think Care Credit rates are ridiculous. If you have good credit, you should be able to get a much better rate on a simple personal loan at a credit union.) You deserve it! You wouldn't hesitate to finance a car for four years, then eventually have to finance another one, then another one. You are worth more than a car and the results are for the rest of your life! Go you!

title: North Texas Plastic Surgery
address: 5412 W Plano Pkwy #101, Plano, TX 75093, United States

user_reviews.Name: LaDesha Rush
user_reviews.Description:
From the very first consultation I knew this was the doctor for me. Dr. Bond was attentive and knowledgeable and set realistic expectations regarding the results that may be achieved. Whether it was the consultation, the pre-op appointment, or any meetings in between, I never felt rushed. He took his time and explained every step of the process clearly, answered all my questions, and made me feel comfortable and secure. On the day of the surgery, my iron level was lower than anticipated, but he promptly devised a backup plan. The surgery went smoothly, and the care I’ve received from him and his staff since then has been outstanding. I’m so elated with my results and can’t thank him enough. So far, my recovery is on the right track.
Please consider consulting with Dr. Bond; you won’t be disappointed.

user_reviews.Name: Kelley Ryder
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Mani is amazing! He listened to my wants & then set reasonable expectations for my results. He was patient and so kind! My results were 1000x better than I anticipated & I had minimal pain and almost no bruising. I had a breast lift & reduction and he did a scar revision on my back. He is truly an artist! The nursing staff could not be nicer or more supportive! Using the Klara app gives you easy access to the office, the nurses & even the surgeons. I never waited more than an hour for a response.  I would absolutely recommend Dr. Mani!!!

user_reviews.Name: Imogen Brown
user_reviews.Description: Kori was amazing! She was super friendly and explained everything very well. When she said it would be a small pinch, it really was a small pinch. She worked with me cost wise as I am a graduate student, she was very understanding. For my first ever cosmetic treatment, I was thankful to have such a wonderful cosmetic nurse! The front desk girls were lovely as well! Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Johanna W
user_reviews.Description: I am 55 years old and I’ve been dealing with all the issue that come with aging, I started noticing the hollowing around my eye’s and after doing some research decided PRF for under eye’s might be a good options prior to any sort of surgery. I researched for several months before choosing North Texas Plastic Surgery, they have a great reputation around the DFW area. I’ve been working with Kori out of the Plano office and she has been wonderful, looking forward to my next appointment and end results. Thanks Kori and staff

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Dunbar
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Kori. She made me feel comfortable from consultation through treatment, truly listened to my concerns, and recommended a plan tailored to give me the best outcome. Her expertise and care really show. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Zayra Carrera
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Bond completed blew me away. He delivered and did his thing!

Super knowledgeable, very open, full transparency and not to mention the awesome personality.

I needed one breast redone (not his doing the first time). He fixed all the issues I had and made it look perfect.

His way of stitching was impeccable which helped with the healing process and made scarring hardly visible!

Will be coming back for more.

Highly recommended.

user_reviews.Name: Kimberly Jacobs
user_reviews.Description: Brittney Anderson is an amazing N.P.! I have been a patient of her’s for years. She’s not only  the best botox and lip filler nurse ever she is warm, friendly, funny and it honestly feels like visiting with a friend when I come for my treatments. She has done my botox, lip filler and thread procedure and I always get the results I  was hoping for. I unfortunately had some bad experiences with cosmetic procedures in the past with other providers and Brittney talked me through everything, taking extra time to ease my anxiety. She literally helped me have a “glow up” after my divorce and helped me feel pretty again. I can’t say enough good things about her, her technique, her kindness, her professionalism, her passion for what she does.  I always recommend her to everyone and being a nurse myself I am really picky. Brittney is the best.💜💜💜

user_reviews.Name: Sylvia Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
I had the pleasure of meeting staff at the Plano location. The ladies at the front desk acknowledged and greeted me promptly. They were warm and welcoming with smiles on their faces. Ashley and Monica were awesome to work with and made everything simple even though it was a lot to discuss. The whole team seemed to work well together! They are knowledgeable, well organized, and made sure all of my questions were answered.
Dr. Bond was exceptional! He listened to what i had to say while also taking into consideration my health and safety. He was realistic when answering all of my questions and laying out a plan for staging my procedures. I have do doubt that I'll be in great hands with this team!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love going to Madison! I’ve had nothing but amazing experiences with her. She talks me through the entire process so I always understand what’s being done. The results are natural and elevated. I still look like myself, just more refreshed and confident!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Big shoutout to Kori!! The Plano NP she  is very sweet and very realistic. She'll tell you how it is and do her best to get you what you want!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mani is truly exceptional! From the very first consultation, I felt heard, informed, and completely at ease. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and artistic eye delivered results beyond my expectations. The care I received before, during, and after my procedure was outstanding. I couldn’t be happier with the outcome—natural, refined, and exactly what I hoped for. Highly recommend to anyone considering cosmetic surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: m z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing! Adrian has a talent with filler. The facility is spotless and staff is friendly and professional.
Thank you all!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Kori is such an exceptional injector! She truly knows how to balance your face and make everything she does look so beautiful and very natural. She also has such a fun personality and is enjoyable to spend an hour with! She is truly exceptional!

Katie my esthetician is outstanding as well. She advised me on the best options for treating redness and skin pigmentation on my face, and after doing a Halo I have had SUCH an improvement!! She is so sweet and easy to talk to also, the whole staff is wonderful! I highly recommend going to see them for your beauty needs, they are awesome!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Kori is THE BEST!
I trusted Kori's knowledge and recommendations for threads and neurotoxins our very first consult, because she has done and uses these things herself. Also, she was so  thorough in explaining the process of threads. When I went in for my appointment to get the barb threads, i had no questions. She had covered it all. And she was spot on. The procedure, post procedure and recovery time were exactly what she described. I felt so prepared thanks to her. Kori is an asset to NTPS . I am so fortunate to have met her and will be back  to see her for neuro toxin injections soon.
Thank you, Kori!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Cobos
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at North Texas Plastic Surgery was beyond amazing! The skin analysis given to me by Alyssa was incredibly thorough, giving me a deep understanding of my skin’s needs. Alyssa was knowledgeable, professional, and had some great recommendations. After my analysis, I received the best facial from Katie! She is so warm and welcoming and really took her time making sure all of my concerns were addressed. From start to finish, the treatment was pure relaxation, and my skin has never felt or looked better—so hydrated, smooth, and glowing! If you want top-notch skincare and real results, this is the place to go. I’m already looking forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description: They worked with me to try and get me scheduled right away. No wait and was seen right when I arrived. Madison listened to my concerns and suggested a few things to consider on my next visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kori is absolutely amazing and her work is perfection! She is very knowledgable, explains every step, answers all questions, and she is a great communicator. The receptionist was super sweet as well. I highly recommend North Texas Plastic Surgery for all aesthetic treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was wonderful and knowledgeable and made me feel very comfortable. Financing was a breeze and I was able to be scheduled right away. The procedure was smooth and Katie kept me informed at every step. It’s a bit early to report results but I honestly do believe I’m already starting to see positive changes. I’m looking forward to completing this treatment and future visits. Thanks all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Chandler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Kori was fantastic! She was extremely thorough and knowledgeable. She took the time to discuss my goals and ensure I felt comfortable before proceeding . I will definitely be going back to her for all my future Botox.
Dr. Obaid performed my Breast augmentation and I couldn’t be happier and I’m only 3 weeks post opp. Obaid and his staff kept me well informed throughout the whole process. From the consult to post opp.
Both procedures have boosted my confidence and left me feeling rejuvenated! If you’re considering either, I highly suggest these two skilled professionals!

The results are truly beyond my expectations—I’m amazed and couldn’t be happier! I highly recommend Kori and the entire team at North Texas Plastic Surgery for their exceptional care and expertise.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Mani did an horrible job on my friend’s rhinoplasty. The most disgusting thing is he didn’t even take accountability for it and the practice is trying to push down our reviews with “positive ones” just so people won’t see it.

My friend’s nose looks NOTHING like she asked for. Not even a little bit. It looks the exact same as she had it prior to the surgery, it’s just that the nose is way bigger and wider. Like how do you even manage to make a nose look that bad and on top of that, he didn’t even give her a nose she wanted, he gave her a nose that HE thought would look best on her.

Most important! She can’t even breathe properly! She had a deviated septum that he did NOT FIX. She’s been having an hard time breathing.

It looks like he mainly does breast augmentation and I see why. This surgeon should not be allowed to do any rhinoplasties or any surgery in that matter.

Do NOT go to Dr. Mani for any rhinoplasties bc he WILL mess it up tremendously!

I had such an incredible experience with Kori at North Texas Plastic Surgery Medspa. From the moment I walked in, she made me feel completely comfortable and confident in the process. She took the time to really listen to what I wanted, explained everything clearly, and made thoughtful recommendations that felt tailored specifically to me.

Kori is not only extremely knowledgeable, but also has a very gentle touch.  I truly appreciated how detail-oriented she was. She focused on achieving natural, balanced results rather than overdoing anything, which is exactly what I was hoping for.

The results exceeded my expectations. Everything looks refreshed and subtle, not obvious or overdone. I’ve already received so many compliments, and the best part is that I still look like myself, just better.

If you’re considering injections, I cannot recommend Kori enough. She’s professional, skilled, and genuinely cares about her clients. I will absolutely be going back to her for future treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bintou Camara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just wanted to come and put my experience out there. I feel like if people are considering a rhinoplasty, they should know this info and hopefully my experience can help you narrow down your options on which surgeon to go to.

I posted this review before but deleted it because I thought maybe I just needed to be more patient but I honestly just hate my nose the more the days go by. And the fact that if I were to do a revision, my nose would be swollen again for who knows how many months/years and I would have to pay more money. Nothing significant changed about my nose.

I decided to get a rhinoplasty by Dr. Mani. During consultation, I felt like we had a good understanding of what I wanted: narrow nose, slight swoop, dorsal hump gone, smaller tip, and most importantly narrow nostrils. Only one of these was achieved.

I’m about 10.5 weeks post op and I honestly can’t say I love my nose. When my cast came off, I kind of liked it because it looked narrow but still swollen. A few days later my nose started looking worse and I started seeing what was really done.

My nostrils look the exact same as before surgery. I did a side by side with my consultation photos and post-op photos and I see no change besides the hump being gone. The bridge looks the same, just wider. It does not look any thinner. Especially when I smile it looks super big and untouched.

The ONLY difference is my dorsal hump is gone so from the side there is a change I guess, but the tip is super pointy and I hate it.

I feel like Dr. Mani changed my nose the way he wanted and not the way I wanted. I haven’t been taking pictures of myself because my nose stands out more than before and it just looks weird. I’ve been really depressed and regretting this every day.

My nose doesn’t look close to the digital morph at all. I had high hopes and spent almost 11K just to look the same or worse.

After cast removal, no one mentioned taping even though I have thick skin. I had to ask Dr. Mani myself. Then nothing was followed up on until I pushed again. (Update: this was eventually addressed, but only after I brought it up.)

I also have visible scars from the open rhinoplasty incision, and a dark spot on my nose that is getting darker.

I paid 11K for a wide nose, wide nostrils, unrefined tip, wide bridge, scars, and a result that I feel is worse than before.

If you’re considering a nose job, please think twice before coming here. Dr. Mani was nice but I don’t feel like my concerns were fully reflected in my result. I truly regret getting my nose done here.

I was so happy I was able to have my consultation and procedure done just a week apart. Dr. Mani did an amazing job and I will recommend him to anyone! My confidence level is through the roof now! From the very first moment I walked into NTPS, I knew I was in the hands of someone truly special. The space itself radiates calm, professionalism, and genuine care — the kind of atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease. But what truly sets Ashleigh apart isn’t just the environment, it’s the extraordinary expertise, artistry, and heart that go into every treatment.

I’ve been to many aesthetic professionals before, but none have combined clinical precision with such a deep understanding of natural beauty the way Ashleigh does. Every appointment feels completely tailored to me — never rushed, always thoughtful. Before any treatment, she takes the time to explain everything with complete transparency, helping me understand not just what we’re doing, but why. That kind of communication builds enormous trust, and it’s one of the many reasons I keep coming back.
What I appreciate most is Ashleigh’s  commitment to natural, balanced results. There’s no “cookie-cutter” approach here; every facial, every step, is guided by a clear vision of harmony and proportion. After my treatments, I never feel “done” — I simply look fresher, more confident, and absolutely myself. Friends constantly comment on how rested and glowing I look, and I always tell them it’s thanks to Ash’s careful, artistic eye.

Beyond technique, she celebrates the progress as much as I do. There’s such a rare gift in being able to blend science, artistry, and empathy — and that’s exactly what makes her the best aesthetic practitioner in a league of her own.

Every visit feels like self-care on every level: professional, emotional, and personal. I leave feeling empowered, refreshed, and grateful to have found someone so talented and trustworthy in this industry.

3 cosas importantes para mi: que el lugar se vea limpio, que te atiendan bien y que te expliquen Cada paso del proceso… las 3 cosas las encontre aqui.
Gracias Anna por todo el seguimiento que me has ofrecido!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Brantzeg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
To start I would like to say thank you to Dr Carlson and his team and anyone that has communicated with me to help me through this journey. When I first spoke with Dr Carlson at my consultation I knew within the first 5 minutes that he was the Doctor for me. His calm demeanor, honest answers and genuine personality made me feel complete confident that he was the one and booked my procedure that day! He and his staff have been nothing short of amazing when I have a question(s) or concern(s). The communication through the Klara app is not only super professional but they don’t skip a beat and someone is always able to reply to me in the most timely manner. Even over the weekend! 
I am currently 8 weeks post op and am always  reassured when I feel there’s something wrong that everything is completely normal for where I am at and I take a deep breath and know know I have the best people looking after me. I had lipo 360, with tummy tuck, breast implant exchange with lift and believe me I have had my share of questions. My thanks and utmost appreciation for everyone at North Texas Plastic Surgery that has talked me through some of my concerns comes with the most sincerity. So grateful. 
It is my opinion that Dr Carlson has met and exceeded all of my expectations and if you are looking to consult with a plastic surgeon for anything you are looking to have done look no further than him. He IS the best!! 10/10 :)

title: Renaissance Plastic Surgery
address: 5880 Ashmill Dr STE 200, Plano, TX 75024, United States

user_reviews.Name: B
user_reviews.Description:
The entire team at Renaissance Plastic Surgery has been beyond amazing. Dr. Angobaldo Is seriously the best surgeon. I've had amazing results, and honestly couldn't recomend him enough. All the nurses were incredibly caring and supportive, especially Kaitlyn who has been texting  and answering all my questions throughout the entire process.
Kandice did such an incredible job taking care of me during my procedure and even went above and beyond on helping me find my stage 2 faja. Overall I'm so incredible thankful with my results and the staff here at Renaissance.

user_reviews.Name: Kalia Nicole
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. P is absolutely incredible and Nurse Kandice is my fave! The medical staff is lovely. My only negative experience was having to deal with Kaitlyn. She lacks the appropriate communication skills, accountability and patient consideration needed in this role, particularly less than 24 hours before any procedure where you should be calm. Never had any issues with the prior coordinators.

Update: Kaitlyn made an effort to rectify my previous experience, which I told her directly I appreciate and all is well. Everything went great. This is your place. 🩷

user_reviews.Name: Audrey Deleon
user_reviews.Description: I had such a wonderful experience with my SkinPen treatment by Wendy. She was incredibly welcoming and professional from the moment I walked in. I ended up arriving late due to a flat tire and she was so understanding and kind about the situation. She never made me feel rushed and still took the time to explain every step of the process, answering questions and made sure I was comfortable. On day two, Kaitlyn was very informative in answering my after care questions and making suggestions on products to use during the healing process. Their attention to detail and genuine care really stood out. I'm grateful for their patience and high-quality service.

user_reviews.Name: Jacqueline Lara
user_reviews.Description:
I want to start by saying Dr. A is truly one of a kind. He performed my tummy tuck five years ago and completely changed the way I saw myself. After having children, I never thought I could feel that confident again or look like I hadn't had any.
Because of that incredible experience, trusting him again for my brachioplasty and Lipo 360 was an easy choice. But this review is truly for Nurse Kandice. From the very first moment I met her at my pre-op appointment, something about her presence brought me peace. She answered every single one of my questions - even the anxious, repetitive ones - with so much patience, kindness, and understanding. She never rushed me, never made me feel silly, and never made me feel like just another patient.

On surgery day, when emotions are high and vulnerability is at its peak, Nurse Kandice was everything I didn't know I needed. She treated me with such gentleness, grace, and love, and most importantly, she made me feel completely safe. In those moments, she made the fear disappear. She made me feel seen, heard, and deeply cared for as if I was the only patient in the entire office.
People like her are rare, and healthcare desperately needs more souls like Kandice. I genuinely
look forward to seeing her beautiful face every time I walk into the office, because I know I'm in the hands of someone who truly cares. She made an experience that could have been terrifying feel comforting and human, and I will forever be grateful for her.

user_reviews.Name: Julie Williams
user_reviews.Description: Very professional staff. Nurse Kandice treated me first class. She explained everything in detail, so that I had a full understanding of what to expect. Dr. Plano also took his time with me and asked a million questions to make sure I understood the procedure and the outcome. I felt safe with their service. I recommend them 100% . Side note : He got me walking around thinking I'm fine !!

user_reviews.Name: Javi Romero
user_reviews.Description: Dr. A was awesome. Ive been fighting a receding hairline for years and luckily found someone who understands and actually helped me get back the confidence I lost when I started finding more hair in the drain than id ever hoped to see. Being In My 30s and having to worry about losing my hair wasn't in my bingo card, but Dr. Plano definitely took care of it. The front desk staff was awesome and the assistants helped me feel comfortable at all steps. Valentina called when I reached out and helped me get scheduled. When I was feeling anxious about the procedure Caitlyn walked me through the treatment post procedure and what to actually expect in a hair transplant procedure. Thank you everyone! Will be 10000% recommending to anyone who needs hair restoration or other cosmetic procedure in the future!

user_reviews.Name: Brenda Reyes
user_reviews.Description: Loving my results I had chin and arm lipo and cellulite release my butt area amazing 👏🏻👏🏻 by the way I’m just one week post. And the attention Kaitlyn and Wendy the best . Also my consolation was with dr.plano not an assistant one of the best part not all dr. Do , and my procedure was very safe .

user_reviews.Name: Tiffany
user_reviews.Description: The entire team at Renaissance Plastic Surgery has been beyond spectacular from consult to post op! Dr. Angobaldo is an amazing and skilled surgeon, and made sure to address all my questions/concerns so that I felt comfortable and confident about the procedure. Amazing results, I’m totally stunned (in a happy way!). All the nurses were incredibly caring and supportive, and the front desk staff are some of the sweetest people I’ve met! And Kaitlyn is awesome for answering all my questions before and after the procedure over text around the clock which makes me feel super supported! The entire team here has made me feel very well cared for and I couldn’t ask for more. Every patient deserves this level of care and professionalism that Renaissance Plastic Surgery provides! The facility is incredible as well — fully equipped surgical center so your consult, procedure, and any follow ups are all in one place! They also have great resources and post op products/services that may be needed for a variety of procedures. This has been such an amazing experience and I wouldn’t hesitate to come back for other procedures. Thank you all for the love and support! <3

Kandice was absolutely amazing!!!
I am so thankful to have had such an awesome team! Everything from the consult to follow up has been so easy. Dr Angobaldo gave the very best results. He was kind, patient and so appreciated. 10/10 would recommend to anyone seeking a great surgeon and support staff.

user_reviews_extended.Description: absolutely loveeee the nurses and Dr. Plano.. they take care really good care of you! 3 weeks post op and my scars are looking amazing can’t wait til I’m FULLY healed!! Blessed with their work here 😍❤️❤️

user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely happy with my choice of Dr. Plano. The entire staff is incredibly friendly and caring. Dr. Jeff Angobaldo is exceptionally patient and takes the time to thoroughly answer all your questions.

user_reviews_extended.Description: After loosing 130 pounds from VSG surgery in October of 2023, I spent a lot of time searching for a plastic surgery center and a surgical team that was knowledgeable and trustworthy. I found just that here at Renaissance. Dr. Plano and Kandice have been the biggest blessing. From the moment I walked in for my consultation to surgery day, and every moment since- they have ensured my wellbeing and comforbility. I highly recommend any one who is searching for a plastic surgeon to come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description: After searching for a surgeon, I felt right at home with Dr. A! Kaityln was a life line and made everything seem not so scary!! I got my excess skin removed (arms, legs and my stomach) and I’m beyond grateful for the staff & Dr!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr plano & his staff are so professional and nice. At 4 months post op I am completely happy with my results and glad I chose him and his team to get my mommy makeover.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my mommy makeover with brachioplasty January 2025. My only regret is that I wish I had done it sooner! I enjoyed every aspect of my care with Renaissance Plastic Surgery. My first visit with Dr. Angobaldo was informative and he made me feel comfortable. I appreciated the amount of time he spent answering questions and showing me options. The entire staff from the moment you walk in, during and after surgery were awesome. I love my results and would not hesitate to recommend Dr. A and his staff to anyone looking to achieve their goal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veen Muhsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so welcoming when I come in for facials! They remember me by name and Kaitlyn always responds to texts whenever you have questions! They always have great deals on amazing skin care and are so informative on the best skin treatments for your personal skin type and texture.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sylvilla Humphrey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Plano and his team. From the moment I walked into the office, I felt welcomed and at ease. Dr. Plano is not only highly knowledgeable and skilled in his field, but he also takes the time to listen and explain things clearly. He genuinely cares about his patients and goes above and beyond to ensure the best possible outcome.

Throughout my treatment, I always felt confident in his recommendations and appreciated how thorough and detail-oriented he was. The results exceeded my expectations, and I am truly grateful for his expertise and professionalism.

If you’re looking for a doctor who is compassionate, trustworthy, and truly exceptional at what he does, I highly recommend Dr. Plano. His work speaks for itself!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David
user_reviews_extended.Description: They have always taken care of me like family and were always understanding of my anxieties with both my body and the procedures. Kandice, Yellen, Dr. A and the rest of the staff were amazing! I will definitely be recommending Renaissance to others and returning again myself in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Ortuño
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent doctor, very professional and very kind. I was delighted to have my abdominoplasty, BBL, lower and upper back liposuction, abdominal toning, and arm liposuction. I loved the results. I recommend it. The nurses and the entire clinic staff were very kind and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Cammack
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After a long search of surgeons, I finally said yes to one. I went in for a back-lift, breast lift with argumentation. I cannot say enough wonderful things about the incredible nurses who cared for me throughout my surgical journey—especially Kandice and Lauren.

Kandice was by my side before and after surgery, and her warmth, compassion, and professionalism made such a difference during a vulnerable time. She has always been so caring, understanding, and attentive—even during my aftercare visits. Her positive attitude is infectious, and she consistently made me feel heard, supported, and truly cared for.

Lauren was with me in the recovery room and immediately made me feel safe and at ease. We connected so effortlessly, and her gentle spirit and kind heart were exactly what I needed in that moment. She has a beautiful, calming presence that brought me so much comfort during those first hours after surgery.

Both of these women went above and beyond in their care, and I’m incredibly grateful for the compassion and excellence they brought to my experience. They are true examples of what it means to be a nurse, and I feel lucky to have had them by my side.

Kaitlyn is absolutely amazing! She is very heart warming and response quickly. She has so much positivity and truly shows her love for her career. I absolutely love her.

I am fortunate to have found Dr. Plano and his team! He is amazing. He listens to your concerns and draws a plan that includes not only his skills but also your concerns. I am proud to include him throughout this journey. He is truly a gem in the medical field!

This place shows positivity is reflection of the person that leads them.  Dr. Plano truly is one of his kind.

I can not wait to begin the second phase of my journey with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Barrientos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had breast implant surgery and was initially very nervous about the anesthesia. However, the entire experience turned out to be fantastic! The medical team was incredibly professional and reassuring throughout the process. I’m so happy with the results and would definitely recommend this to anyone considering the procedure. Thank you to everyone who made me feel comfortable and confident.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Humen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is friendly and they make you feel
Welcome.  Dr. A fixed my original lift, implants and did lipo with a reverse tummy tuck.  I am happy with the results and would highly recommend him.  He is a skilled artist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chiara Contreras
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m thankful for Dr. Angobaldo and Nurse Kandice! They took such great care of me during my surgery and all my follow-up appointments. Dr. Angobaldo was super professional, explained everything clearly, and made me feel at ease the whole time.

And Nurse Kandice—she was truly amazing. So kind, patient, and always checking in to make sure I was doing okay. You can tell she really cares about her patients, and that made such a difference during recovery.

I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better team. Thank you both for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a brachioplasty and tummy tuck with fat transfer and I couldn’t be happier. Dr. Plano es amazing and does a great job. Paola does my massages at the office and is amazing and Kaitlyn always takes good care of me at each visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Xochitl Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Angobaldo is the best surgeon and I wanted to share my results because of how happy I am with him. I honestly recommend him, he did an amazing job on me. I am from California and I came to Texas to do my surgery and I would do it again if I had to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Irvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love love the staff and Dr. Angobaldo. His work is seriously amazing and my husband says he is his biggest fan lol. I’ve never been more confident in my life since my MMO. The staff and the surgeon are so warm and easy to talk to. Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Noel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough how THRILLED I am by my results. I recently had a breast reduction and side liposuction done by Dr. Angobaldo and I have been blessed with life changing results. He executed what I imagined perfectly cosmetically, and medically I feel like a new woman. My breast were so heavy and sagged which made me feel and look much heavier than what I am . Anyone who struggles with huge breast that cause shoulder/back pain coupled with insecurities will find a huge confidence boost and relief going to Dr. Plano. He is truly an artist and I would recommend anyone to go to him. His entire staff are amazing, very communicative and great bed side manner which has always been so important to me when making a decision on my surgeon. If you are considering him let’s this be the positive nudge you need to go to him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: jeanine cusick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a facelift and I couldn’t be happier. Results are amazing so far. It’s only 2 weeks but I’m not in pain and I’m so pleased. Dr. A is great and gave me the best advice. I’m so happy I spent the night. The overnight nurse was amazing and so is Kaitlyn every time I come in!

user_reviews_extended.Name: barbara perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a SkinPen treatment and I'm delighted with the results. From the first session, my skin felt brighter, more even, and with a much smoother texture. This has also helped me a lot with my acne scars. I want to especially thank Oriana for her excellent work and her warmth. She's the best. She explained the entire process to me in detail and made me feel very comfortable the whole time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Wimbley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Plano was amazing and laid back, great bedside manners and made me feel at ease about the process. Candace my nurse was also amazing and helped calm my nerves the morning of surgery. All of the staff was friendly and amazing. My results are amazing, had no problems at all. They answered all my questions even the questions I didn’t ask! 5 star hands down.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Matthews
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am more than happy with my results with Dr. Plano! I am 6weeks out and I feel great, fit better in shirts and have gotten so many compliments about how much younger I look since my breast reduction. I can’t wait to do more treatment when I can!

His team is also the nicest medical staff I have seen in a very long time!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a surgery performed by Dr. Plano about a month ago so far I love my results , he accommodated me every way possible leading up to surgery. She’s very knowledgeable and professional. Great bedside manner. All of the staff are great. The receptionist is great as well always polite when she answers the phone.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a hydrafacial with Oriana and loved the results. Her care was exceptional. She was very kind and answered all my questions about the treatment. I'm delighted. I will definitely return.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Nurse Kandice and Yelen  did a wonderful job taking care of me. She explained everything thoroughly making sure that I understood. She is so very patient and pleasant. I highly recommend Renaissance plastic surgery for your services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: maria barrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a fan of Dr Plano, after having 3 kids my body has not been the same. I followed Dr Plano for 2 years, seeing his before and after in social media. I have no regrets in choosing him and I am so happy with my body. I am so confident in my body. The staff is amazing. Diana has helped me through out this process with my post op care. I am forever grateful. I definitely recommend him for all your cosmetic procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: MiMi M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Renaissance plastic surgery. Dr Plano and all the Nurses were extremely helpful, and I must say I was extremely impressed with the level of care I received.  They make me feel comfortable and cared for throughout my process The teamwork between Dr. Plano and Nurses was evident, and their professionalism and expertise truly made a difference in my overall experience. I highly recommend this dynamic duo for anyone seeking top-notch medical care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Morton
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10 recommend!! My breasts were painful as both implants had ruptured & needed to be removed. Dr Angobaldo & his staff were kind, informative & supportive through then entire process. Dr Angobaldo replaced the implants w/a lift & now my breasts look & feel amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jemma Murray
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don’t typically leave reviews but I had to for Renaissance Plastic Surgery.
I had a consultation for a Mommy Makeover and from the point of scheduling the original consultation, throughout the actual surgery process was stellar. The front office staff is welcoming and sweet. Dr. A himself made me feel so comfortable during the consultation and gave me realistic expectations. He really listened to what I wanted my end result to be and told me what was needed to achieve that. When I scheduled the surgery, Kimberly was an absolute sweetheart and answered every question I had.
The actual surgery could not have gone better. The medical assistant, Wendy, who helped me with everything prior was so warm and welcoming and helped me feel extremely calm even though I was about to go “under the knife”.
I am now a little more than 2 weeks post op and my results are better than I could have ever imagined. I almost cry every time I see my new body and I’m still in the recovery process!
At every post op visit, my nurse Hannah has been the absolute best! She’s funny and so informative. Gives the best instructions and explains exactly what to do during recovery. The medical assistant, Wendy, is a DOLL!! She makes me feel so supported and listens so carefully to all my concerns and makes sure they are communicated to Hannah and Dr.A.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just had a consult 2 days ago for a lift and breast implant removal and honestly... what the hell was that? I can't stop thinking about it. This man walked in, yawned 3 times, looked at my breasts for maybe 3 seconds, and said "yep, seen those before." Then carried on that I absolutely need to REPLACE my implants (I asked for removal / did not want implants anymore) because it would just look so much nicer while making disgusted faces at me continuing to say I did not want new implants put in. I asked about maybe transferring some fat in if they really needed more volume -- he said "we don't really do that for the breast, we just slam fat into the butt for the 3-4 BBLs a week we do here." He then sat and showed me ~30 before and after photos on a tv screen. I asked if he could fix the old bb ring scar on my belly button and showed him, to which he said, "you look pregnant." I was SHOCKED but just casually said, "oh well it's still early, it will go down after a few more months." Then he said, "your stomach won't go back to normal on its own, you look pregnant". I gave birth just 3 MONTHS AGO - which I stated in my online form, told the woman on the phone, mentioned to the staff once I got there, AND told him when he walked in the room which I guess he was too tired to listen. Note - I am 5'5" and 130 lbs. I am just so stunned at how terrible I felt after that appointment. NOT THE DOCTOR FOR ME.

On a positive note, Ann - his main office manager, was absolutely amazing and warm.

I had requested to stay at a size D or DD with cleavage during my consultation and preop appointment although I ended up with a size DDD which was very noticeable since I am a tiny girl 4 feet 9 in. He stated that it could be fixed with a separate procedure! (Sigh). I was very hesitant but I decided to go ahead and get a second procedure for breast reduction. I went to a consultation which I asked about changing my implants (310 cc to a 200 or 250 cc) to bring me down to a full C. I showed him inspiration pics which he explained that changing the size wouldn’t make a difference since I had a lot of breast tissue so he would just remove breast tissue. I didn’t understand this much but I agreed since I was influenced by his surgeon recommendation. During preop I shared this information with his nurses and they advised me to be persistent on what I wanted because he tends to do what he believes would look good instead of listening to his patients desires. With this I made sure to repeat myself when stating I wanted to be a full C after the procedure. I had my second procedure with him on May 2023. During my follow up appointments I expressed that I felt my right breast was larger than my left . His MA kept insisting that it was swelling and to give it time. For the first 2-3 follow up appointment I didn’t see Dr Angobaldo only his MAs. During one of these appointments I let them know that I was having a fluid leak from one of my breast and they applied Manuka honey and gauze on it. At a later appointment I finally saw Dr A and he prescribed me antibiotics for this reason, this is when I finally got to express my concern over my breast size. (At this time I was 3 months PO). He suggested that he could perform a revision on both breast and offered to remove both implants. At this point I was very irritated and annoyed since I got this second procedure to fix the first one. In total the first procedure was $18,500 the, awake revision was $250 and this last procedure was a total of about $5,000 (breast reduction and lipo to axillary area and abdomen). These costs don’t include medications and aftercare needs! In my mind that was what I was thinking, I’ve already spent all this money and now he wants to put me through a third procedure with him. He was able to tell that I was upset and recommended that I think about it and bring it back up at my 6 month follow up. After this follow up, front office scheduled me for a 6 month follow up. Once it got closer to that date they have changed my appointment last minute twice. And they told me that a 3rd revision would be about $1,200. At this point I just took a loss and am not making any attempts to see him again.

P.S. my BB scar was never fixed I had to cover it up with a tattoo.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Glover
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATED 2022: I have had 2 separate surgery occasions with the folks at Renaissance Plastic Surgery and the experience difference between the two was night and day.

My first set of surgeries I felt like a valued patient. Everything was explained very well, follow up calls and information were abundant, the surgeries themselves went very well with super high quality work and after care/follow up appointments were great!

I was VERY excited to go back and finish up my skin removal surgeries with thereabout 2 years later. I wish I had shopped around more and went somewhere else.

My second set of series covered a reverse tummy tuck, inner thigh lift and removal of extra skin on my arms. Every single appointment I had I waited at least 30 minutes past the appointment time to even be shown to a room where I waited for an additional 15 to 30 minutes for someone to conduct the appointment. The surgeries were not explained as clearly as my first set had been. My initial surgery date had to be pushed back due to a miscommunication over pre-op procedures.

What really drove my desire to leave this review was the quality of work performed in the surgeries and the utter lack of acknowledgment or assistance to address the incomplete work after surgeries.

Once the procedures were completed each follow up appointment had the same wait times, only this time I was dealing with healing wounds and having to stay in very uncomfortable positions for long periods of time. Once the wounds were healed it was VERY clear that the reverse tummy tuck was not completed ( extra skin was still very much on my stomach) and my right arm now has a permanent crease in the bicep due to that surgery not being done correctly.

When I attempted to make appointments to follow up on revisions for these unfinished items I was given the run around for 6 weeks. Wait times, Dr not being at the appointment, correct revision information not getting passed to the correct departments for pricing and scheduling…eventually after a 5th appointment where I had to wait for over an hour after my appointment time for no one to assist me, I left the office. They have not followed up with me in over two months since this.

I am now left with unbalanced/gnarly scars, loose skin on my abdomen and I still have a crease in my upper right arm. It is worse than it was before I had surgery.

While they were once very helpful and had the time to really do quality work, I feel this office has decided to pursue quantity or quality and as result surgeries are rushed and aftercare or assistance fixing errors post surgery is non existent.

Please shop around and make sure you find an office that will treat you as a valued patient not just another body to make money off of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toni Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a 45 year old mother of 2 grown children and grandmother of 2 beautiful granddaughters.
