Still with no success I saw Dr. Paul Pin in Dallas..... After a total of 10 surgeries later I got sat at the same table with Dr. Jeff Angobaldo. I don't know about you but I believe everything happens for a reason and he was a godsend! I quickly scheduled a consult with Dr. Angobaldo (Dr. Plano). At my consult he explained to me that I didn't have any breast tissue and a few other complicated things and gave me a surgery plan. Like all the other doctors he assured me he could fix me. HE WAS RIGHT!!! He preformed total body liposuction and transferred the fat to my breasts and butt. I am 4 months out from surgery now and as you can see from my picture, he knows what he's doing. My husband & I are BOTH very happy with his work. He has given me the confidence back that I haven't seen in years!!!  He is the most talented surgeon and he knows what he's doing! His work is outstanding. I would HIGHLY recommend him to anyone I know. His office is beautiful and his staff is so sweet and friendly. Dr. Angobaldo and his staff go beyond to welcome you & take care of you in every way. If you want to see his phenomenal work then you should follow him on snapchat. His username is Dr. Plano. Thank you Dr. Angobaldo for your fantastic work... I have never been happier (and the hubby) :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I typically do not leave reviews  but I have to agree with other reviews of Dr Angobaldo. After procedure follow up is almost non-existent, and the general attitude after payment is very poor. I had my surgery which went mostly well-thankfully. I had to call multiple times to get in for a post evaluation with the doctor. I would assume that any prudent practice, especially one that involves surgery, would keep up their 'after procedure follow up' efforts as they did when getting you in. I guess not in this office. During my two week visit, I had an infection but when I went in, sutures were hurriedly removed in a dimly lit room, and some were left in, for which I had to take care of myself.  I had to request another round of antibiotics, and even then, no follow up on how that went.  After my 6 week appointment being postponed, I called the office to request a consultation with the doctor as I had questions/concerns, and had not consulted with him after the surgery. I was quickly told not to worry, that "he would pop in" when i came in for the visit. I insisted that I actually needed to meet with the doctor, as I had not met him after surgery. They reluctantly scheduled the appointment after being on hold for almost 15 minutes. On the appointment date, after waiting for an hour, the physician came in, appeared  very rushed and impatient, did not listen to half my concerns, and left in the middle of the consultation, leaving the door open while I was half dressed. Of course my faith in continuing with any follow up at this point was fully diminished. Once you pay for surgery, the attitude of the physician changes radically. Very little patience, does not listen to concerns, and God forbid you have a follow up issue, he turns very sour. Bedside manner leaves much to be desired. Very unimpressed with after care. Shows you where their sole interest is in you as a client.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Sloan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a Mom to Four Kiddos! My last babies were twins and to say that they sucked the life from my breast would be an understatement. I still had the tissue but no volume anymore and after having a C-section I had this flap of skin that just laid there. I went to several drs looking to hear the words, "You don't need a lift!" Dr A spent over an hour showing me before and after pictures of women who had lifts and those who didn't who were very similar to me. He didn't try to sell me ON EVERYTHING he could do for me. He listened to what I wanted and gave me his recommendation. I couldn't be more happy with my results. My breast are full again. My flap is gone without having to do a big tummy tuck. I'm very thankful I used him. I am seeing Renee now for my laser hair removal. Its worth every penny that I've spent! I love how laid back their office is yet still very professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description:
There are numerous surgeon options to pick from when making the decision to have cosmetic surgery and it can be overwhelming when deciding on the final choice. I heard from others that when you meet the right doctor you would KNOW it was the right one. I went on 3 consults and after my 3rd one I was set to move forward with that surgeon but I still didn’t feel 100% but then I found Dr. Angobaldo and set my 4th consult. As soon as I met with him I KNEW that I found my doctor!

Dr. A is warm, outgoing and compassionate. Too many doctors are in and out as fast as possible during a consult but Dr. A takes time to go over each and every point and it never felt rushed. He addresses every concern you have and goes above and beyond to make every patient and family member comfortable. He explains each step of your procedure, explains why everything is being done and he sets great expectations for after surgery. Anytime I was worried something did look/feel right after surgery he would check it out and reassure me that everything was great! I’ve never had a doctor that made each patient feel like such a priority.

Every great doctor surrounds themselves with a great team and that is certainly the case with everyone in Dr. A’s office. Everyone that makes up his staff is amazing but I would really like to give a special mention to a few: Renee, Dawnyel, Ebony, Kimberly, Jackie and Raquel. These ladies have gone above and beyond for me numerous times and this journey would not have been the same without them. They take care of every patient and they are so sweet!

Dr. A completed an arm lift, circumferential abdominoplasty and thigh lift 4 months ago (December 2015). These were done to remove excess skin from losing 170lbs 5 years ago after a bariatric procedure. It is so amazing to FINALLY see the results I have been working towards over the last couple years and I owe it ALL to Dr. A! He did amazing work! Because of my experience and results my mom turned around and had a couple procedures done. Now I am getting my ducks in a row for a breast lift with implants as well as removing a bit of the excess skin that still remains around my upper back in July. My grandmother is also coming in for some laser treatments! Slowly but surely my whole family will be seeing Dr. A!

I recommend Dr. A to anyone and everyone interested in any kind of cosmetic surgery but also for any of the other numerous services, benefits and special perks they offer. They are more than just a cosmetic surgery center and they are more than just a doctor office, they have become family! You truly can’t go wrong with picking Dr. A! I’ve never had a doctor that I said I loved but I can now, seriously I could go on forever. He is WONDERFUL!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Pinion
user_reviews_extended.Description: After researching several doctors in the DFW area I went to see Dr. Angobaldo in December for a breast lift with implant exchange, tummy tuck and lipo to the back. I have 3 children and pay a pretty decent price for a sitter during these appointments.  One woman said she'd check while the other receptionist seemed to mumble something snarky.  5 minutes later I was taken into the room and spoke to briefly and given a gown. 45 minutes pass. No communication, no PA. No doc. Nothing. So I get dressed and tell the lady at checkout I am leaving.
She shuffled papers and said "oh I'm so sorry". And that was it.
Had this been a one off, I would understand. But every follow up has been late between 45 minutes to an hour and 15 minutes past the time scheduled.
All my sutures weren't even removed at my 2nd appointment. My husband helped me because he works in an emergency room.
Disheartening because everyone is so nice when you are going for a consultation. Once they are paid, everyone's demeanor changes and you are a burden.
I almost went with another plastic surgeon and now I wish I would have honestly.
Please see several docs before choosing. If you want to feel valued and that your time and money is worth something, then go somewhere else.
Also adding, I paid for botox (that should have been free after my breast aug!) And I still have lines above one eye.  Which I don't know how except it was very rushed and not marked like my previous botox professional did.

I sent a photo to a friend (who referred me to him) to confirm that it seemed abnormal and I wasn’t crazy- she agreed. I also had never experience this reaction before and felt it seemed very unusual. After discomfort of falling asleep at 12am, and waking up at 5am, I took medication for the pain + emailed the staff to see someone as soon as they opened. Everything I read and photos similar to mine looked as though an artery had been punctured while doing the injection. I also left a voicemail for their office that morning. I received a call back at 9-9:30am letting me know the earliest I could come in and see the doctor was at 3:45pm. I sent photos to the office where they then showed the doctor and I was prescribed 2 medicines. They told me they wanted me to pick them up at the pharmacy and take them immediately. I didnt give them a pharmacy to call anything into, so I then had to tell them what the information WOULD be if they had called them in, along with asking what it was I would be taking as no one has told me anything about what type of medicine or why I was prescribed this. I was then told I could come in at 2:45, and then finally at 12:30. After rearranging my day, picking my child up from day care an hour early, and driving another 30 minutes to Plano I received reversal (dissolver) of the filler injection to relieve the pressure / blockage of hitting an artery. I received an apology and “call us tomorrow to let us know how it is.” I asked for a refund for the filler purchased, and was told that only 1/4 of the area filled was disolved and I would not receive a refund. The syringe was $680 - even 1/4 of that would be $170. I now also have to pay for the prescribed medications to take after the filler was injected in error. I have never written a review (good or bad) of any services / experiences I have had - but I felt like this was necessary to share with readers. I hope that other patients are able to seek guidance with this, or if they’ve experienced the same issues know that they are not alone. I don’t think any “rating on google”  can express my disappointment, frustration, and lack of professionalism I felt I received.

user_reviews.Name: Abbie Acklin-Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve had two surgeries with Dr. Ronald Friedman and have been extremely pleased with the care I’ve received. He originally performed my breast lift with implants, and several years later I returned to him when I began experiencing implant pocket issues. In January he performed a breast pocket reconstruction and replaced my implants.

Even though I’m only about two months post-op and still healing, my results already look beautiful and natural, and I feel very confident in the work he did. Dr. Friedman is incredibly skilled, thorough, and takes the time to truly care for his patients.

His staff deserves recognition as well, they are consistently warm, professional, and attentive, which made every visit a positive experience. From consultation through recovery, I always felt well taken care of.

I’m very grateful for Dr. Friedman and his team and would highly recommend him to anyone considering plastic surgery. If I ever needed anything like this again, I would absolutely return to Dr. Friedman without hesitation.

user_reviews.Name: Tracey Pak
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Dr. Ron Friedman for Botox and fillers. He is professional, knowledgeable, and takes a very natural, conservative approach. He listened carefully to what I wanted and explained everything clearly.

My results look refreshed and subtle, exactly what I was hoping for. Love the office staff!! Everyone in the office is very friendly and efficient. I highly recommend Dr. Friedman if you’re looking for an experienced plastic surgeon and a great team.

user_reviews.Name: Jordyn Garcia
user_reviews.Description:
My breast augmentation experience was exactly what I hoped for — and that's all thanks to Dr. Friedman and his team.

The clinic is beautiful, clean, and welcoming, and the staff were professional and kind from start to finish. Dr. Friedman communicated everything clearly, made me feel at ease, and demonstrated real expertise and care throughout the entire process.

Post-surgery support was top-notch. Follow-up appointments were attentive and reassuring, which made my recovery so much smoother. I never felt alone in the process.

Most importantly — I love my results! They are exactly what I envisioned. If you're considering this procedure, I highly recommend Dr. Friedman without hesitation. Five stars, no question! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

user_reviews.Name: Kaylee King
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Ronald Friedman was kind and attentive throughout my entire consultation and surgical process. He even remembered that my mom had been one of his patients years ago and took the time to send her a handwritten letter thanking her for trusting him with my care — which meant so much to our family.

He answered all of my questions thoroughly and always made me feel comfortable and supported every step of the way. My results match my goals perfectly, and I absolutely love them! At four months post-op, my incisions are barely visible, and anytime I had questions during recovery he responded quickly — even on a Sunday.

I truly could not recommend Dr. Friedman more to anyone considering breast augmentation.

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Pletan
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Friedman is THEE BEST surgeon in the United States when it comes to breasts. He is a true artist and is passionate about his work--so much so that he wrote an entire musical about breast implants! He takes the time to explain everything to you and answer all your questions. His staff are all amazing and caring. I can't recommend him enough.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

He made me feel comfortable and confident every step of the way. The staff is just as wonderful — so helpful, fun, and welcoming! Special thanks to Sparkle and Kimmy for making every visit such a great experience. If you’re considering any kind of aesthetic correction, Dr. Friedman is the perfect surgeon to go to! I’m extremely happy with results!

I have been seeing Dr. Friedman for about 8 years now, and every time I see him I am impressed by the time he takes, and his attention to detail. His office staff is also stellar, and they make sure the process is easy and enjoyable!  Thank all of you for what you do!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Felicia Waggoner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been researching what would become my third breast surgery, and if we include the scar revision, it’s my fourth procedure. I fully understood that with each procedure, the risks increase. I was referred to Dr. Friedman by another surgeon who praised him as the breast expert, and I can confidently say he lives up to that title. Dr. Friedman is incredibly thorough during consultations and in the operating room, always prioritizing my comfort and needs. After my initial reveal, I assured him my tears were of joy—something he has surely encountered before. I finally feel I have achieved the symmetry, fullness, and confidence I’ve been aiming for all these years. I can’t recommend Dr. Friedman and his team highly enough; choosing him was the best decision I could have made. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently underwent a bilateral earlobe repair with Dr. Ronald Friedman, and I couldn't be more pleased with the experience and results. From the initial consultation to the post-operative care, Dr. Friedman and his team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, skill, and compassion.

The entire staff at the West Plano Plastic Surgery Center was welcoming and attentive, making me feel comfortable and well-informed at every step. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Hightower
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is truly an artist.  I had two procedures six months apart.  Both went so well.  I had in my mind how I would look, but the results exceeded anything I could have ever imagined.  I am thrilled with the results.  More importantly is how Dr. Friedman was from my initial consultation and then throughout my surgery journey.  While he is very personable and funny, he takes my health care very seriously.  He is very detailed and thorough with the procedure process.  He was also honest about what he could do and did not over promise.   His staff is the best around.  They are very friendly, attentive, respond quickly, and knowledgeable.   It was worth the wait to get in to see him and I would do it all over again.  I wish I had not waited so long to make the appointment.  Thank you Dr. Friedman and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I consulted with Dr. Friedman to fix my droopy, aging earlobes. I did research on many providers, but kept coming back to his name. I am absolutely thrilled with the result! Everyone that I came into contact with from the office staff to the nurses were all professional, kind and sweet. Dr. Friedman was great, he explained everything to me thoroughly, took his time to understand what my expectations were, and totally exceeded those expectations. He is a great Dr. very knowledgeable, kind and caring. I loved the comradery between him and his staff. I am so happy I found the right group of professionals to fix a problem that had bothered me for years. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Watson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent Dr and wonderful staff! This is my second surgery with Dr. Friedman and his staff. Dr. Friedman has the patient’s best interest at heart- he genuinely cares about what is best for the patient and not just about making money. He advised me to wait on having a lift during my surgery and I ended up not needing one! He is very trustworthy. He is also an expert at his craft. He is also easy to talk to. His staff made me feel very comfortable as well! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynn Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is absolutely excellent in all ways. Very thorough explanations, friendly sense of humor, dedicated to skill and perfection. I originally saw him for ear lobe reduction surgery and re-piercing. So happy with my results! I've since seen him for botox with great results. He even treated a minor issue for me, and regardless of the scope, his commitment to excellence is stellar. I've bragged about him to all of my friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rebecca womack
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an amazing experience with Dr. Friedman & his staff.  Everyone was very professional & very good, I never has a bad experience at the office. Dr. Friedman and his office staff was very supportive and professional at all times.  The day of the surgery I was really nervous, and while the staff was prepping me for surgery, they made me feel really relaxed and i was out.  Their positive attitude helped me to feel better even in the roughest times after surgery… I would definitely recommend everyone to come visit Dr. Friedman and his staff :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am about 8 weeks post-op from a breast lift and reduction. I am thrilled with the results!! Dr. Friedman, Jin, Kimmy and the rest of his team are amazing. Dr. Friedman is very safe and has a great reputation among his peers. When I saw him and Jin at my post-op appointment, all I could do was hug them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen B.
user_reviews_extended.Description: After receiving Dr. Friedman’s name as a recommendation I set up a consultation and  made the decision to select him to perform my surgery, despite having several other plastic surgeons much closer to me. The staff there is the best of the best! They are so nice and caring and responsive even before I committed to selecting Dr. Friedman. He is a perfectionist and it’s really cool to tell people my surgeon is also a sculptor (and composer), so detail matters. I’m so happy I went here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaye Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
BOOK! Dr. Friedman is literally an artist, a perfectionist, and the BEST in his profession.
His staff are beautiful, nurturing angels. My breast augmentation was flawless from beginning to end! He will elevate your body to its highest potential while ensuring your safety first. IG/TikTok @iamkayedavis if you need more proof of his fantastic work. I recommend him to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorena Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Extremely Satisfied Patient! I absolutely love my results. The staff in the office and Dr. Friedman are all amazing! I know I made the best decision when going with him. From the moment you step in you are treated with a great deal of courtesy and help. Dr. Friedman is professional, knowledgeable, 100 % honest and thorough with the procedure and recovery, and a big plus is that he has a great sense of humor. I can only say the same about all of his staff as well. I am only 5 weeks post op now but will add some pictures later on. Highly recommend.

It has been nearly 3 years since my surgery and it was by far the best decision I have made for myself. My results were incredible. They have made a world of difference in my confidence and my appearance. I Love what I see in the mirror every day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ameenah A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly he's the best! I got non surgical rhinoplasty with Dr. Friedman in February of this year (2024). Every part of the experience was awesome. Office staff, nurses and Dr. Friedman himself were all amazing to meet and work with. I ended up getting filler to my chin as well to balance my features. The change was so natural looking but drastic enough to make a huge difference in my appearance and self esteem. I'll be making a follow up appointment soon enough but I'm still so thrilled with the results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Ayari
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience getting my first breast augmentation. The office staff was friendly and supportive along the way. Dr. Friedman was very knowledgeable and made me feel at ease. I would recommend for anyone looking for a positive experience and great results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Schnabel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are absolutely amazing! Dr. Friedman truly is an artist and loves a challenge when presented with one. He goes above and beyond with patient care and is truly an amazing surgeon. We would recommend Dr. Friedman to anyone!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: We came to Dr. Friedman to fix our 8 year old daughter's torn earlobe from an ear piercing. We couldn't be happier with our experience.  Everything was great from making the appointment (even getting in sooner when there was an opening) to the after care. The entire staff did a wonderful job making sure that our daughter was comfortable and understood what was going on so that she wasn't nervous.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tierra Givens
user_reviews_extended.Description: A great team! I have recommend so many people here. I cannot wait to return for bigger boobs. I got my breast augmentation back in 2020 I love them and so does everyone else. They made the process feel comfortable and I felt safe and secure to be in their hands. From the front door to Dr. Ronald Friedman my experience was top tier 5 plus 5 stars. I get lots of compliments on how natural my boobies appear and most people cannot tell that they are implants hahahaha. Next time I am getting the lift and going bigger! Hopefully sooner than later like this year 2025 <3 Thanks Dr. Ronald Friedman and Team,  hope all is well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manasa Kuncham
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the most professional clinics I have ever visited. Dr. Friedman is so knowledgeable, meticulous, and always makes sure I am fully informed. His staff and his nurses are also amazing and hard working. They are always prompt in returning phone calls and emails, answering any and all questions, and truly made the whole experience easy for me. Wouldn’t have asked for a better group of professionals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oj Spesh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman was recommended to me by my sister and I also looked him up and the reviews speak for themselves. I would 10/10 recommend him for body contouring. Dr Friedman and his whole team are amazing people .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Lampkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I live in Florida, but my friend told me about Dr. Friedman and how happy she was with her surgical results so I decided to travel to Texas to consult with this practice. I believe I made the best choice possible for my surgery.  Dr. Friedman is very conscientious, honest, caring and is truly an artist in the surgical realm and in real life.  I felt very comfortable in his hands.  He answered all of my questions and gave me an expert assessment of the expected results for my surgery.  He also has a great sense of humor to help keep things light.  His staff is also very friendly, helpful and courteous.  I am very pleased with the whole experience with this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can't say enough about Dr. Friedman and his entire staff.  From my first visit to the day of surgery, they patiently explained everything to me.  The morning of surgery I was, of course, a bit nervous but they all calmed my nerves and we were laughing while they were still professionally taking care of me.  It's been 2.5 months since my extended mini tummy tuck and I did not have a bit of complications.  Yes, the first couple of days were not comfortable but I was back to work in 10 days.  My scar is healing so well and I am amazed at how quickly it is getting lighter.  Dr. Friedman did a fantastic job and I am so please with the results to date.  Hey, I might even get something else nipped or tucked :) I trust them and highly recommend.

Update - this past May I returned to Dr. Friedman for a breast lift and augmentation and yet again, he and his staff were amazing.   Dr. Friedman is a perfectionist and I love that about him. Actually I was able to recommend one of my friends to him for implants and she looks amazing too.  All I can say is if you are considering  any type of plastic surgery, this is your Doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: claudia arismendi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have thought about having my surgery for several years, but really seriously considered it for about 10 months before I made an appointment with Dr. Friedman, who was recommended by a friend who had breast augmentation with Dr. Friedman over 10 years ago and still looks great. During my first visit to Dr. Friedman's office he seems very educated, professional and experienced. He gave me all the information I needed about the procedure and answered all my questions, concerns and fears thoroughly and confidently. No question is looked down upon.I was very comfortable with Dr. Friedman, he is very professional and has great personable skills. The office staff is also very personable, they made me feel welcomed from the beginning, especially Rose, She is always upbeat, smiling and willing to help and answer all questions. I am happy with the results. Dr. Friedman has great expertise and I am very glad I went with him. I have gone back to Dr. Friedman for a couple of non-surgical procedures and I love the results. I would definitely recommend Dr. Friedman to all my family and friends!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman and his team (which includes his wife) are absolutely amazing!  He made me feel comfortable every step of the way. Even when I felt self-conscious, Dr. Friedman helped me feel good about myself.  He is personable and has a great sense of humor. He also knows this is serious business and takes your vision and health seriously.
I would recommend him to anyone in need of a surgery that requires excellence in the doctor’s fine motor skills.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melinda Woods
user_reviews_extended.Description: Only if there was 6 stars... I absolutely love Dr. Friedman and his staff.  My husband and I went in for a consultation after doing some extensive research on numerous surgeons.  Being post op bariatric/weight loss and a child in my 40's I need a make over badly.  Dr. Friedman was honest and forthcoming.  He told me what I needed and what I didn't need.  He was genuine and sincere.  I had no hesitation scheduling my surgery and I know I am in perfect hands with this professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristian Angle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a breast reduction surgery 12/13/2022 and I would do this experience all over again. Dr. Friedman has one of the best and most supportive staff ever. I remember being nervous before my surgery and they were understanding and made me feel comfortable with the entire experience. I love how they remember things that you have shared about yourself. It made me feel like I was more of a friend than a patient.
Dr. Friedman is one of the best plastic surgeons and I am thankful that I found him. I can tell he takes his craft very seriously and is proud of the work that he does. He makes sure to pay attention to your desire results and will tell you the truth about the outcome. I am 1 month post op and have amazing results. Overall,  I strongly recommend him!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irma Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was professional and personable! They did so well answering all my questions and informing me about everything. I got a breast augmentation and got exactly what I was looking for! I’m so happy I went with Dr. Friedman! I felt so comfortable and in the right hands. If I ever decide to get other plastic surgeries I will definitely going back to him!!! I was referred by my aunt and will be referring future potential candidates. I recommend 100%.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Any operation comes with its share of risks and apprehension, but Dr. Friedman’s confidence, skill, and exceptional bedside manner immediately put me at ease. Kim, Luisa, and the entire team were incredibly supportive, kind and thorough throughout the process. The results far exceeded my expectations (gynecomastia surgery) and my recovery is going remarkably well, no doubt due to Dr. Friedman’s expertise. I would wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone, even those outside the DFW area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginger Alford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is amazing! He is extremely knowledgeable and did an amazing job! I had an ear lobe reconstructed and my breast implants replaced plus a lift. The recovery was painless and easy! I love the results and would highly recommend Dr. Friedman. His staff is very friendly, helpful and made me feel so comfortable! Thank you so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Osato Ayeni
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his team of nurses were absolutely amazing. They took the best care of me for my entire stay at their facility and my post Care. The facility was very clean and very well maintained. Dr. Friedman did an amazing job, I am so impressed with his work and how professional, kind and skilled he is. The Anesthesiologist he works with, Dr. Nnamani, did an amazing job with my pain management. She was very attentive and kind and continued to check in and follow up even after my surgery. I will recommend Dr. Friedman and his team over and over again. If you want excellent results, he should be your pick.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzy Harmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fabulous experience with Dr. Friedman and his staff. They all made me feel so comfortable. I had a cosmetic procedure done to improve lines and wrinkles in advance of my son's wedding. I loved how honest Dr. Friedman was with me and all the time he took to explain my options. I am so happy with the results of my procedure. If you have ever wanted to try fillers or botox but were afraid, Dr. Friedman is the doctor for you. He is an artist, fun to talk to, patient and so knowledgable, and will put you at ease. I love how I look like an improved version of myself and my new found confidence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Ratsavongsa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough great things about Dr. Friedman, his wife, and the entire staff! They are truly amazing and go above and beyond to ensure their patients feel comfortable and cared for. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at ease. Dr. Friedman’s expertise and genuine compassion made my experience so positive. Everyone there is awesome, and I couldn’t recommend them more highly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Mullen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is an artist!  My results have been phenomenal.   I am happier with my body now at 53 then I have ever been in my life.   My results were better than I could have ever imagined.  I have confidence again in the way I look.  Dr. Friedman is great to work with and excellent at explaining all the details of your procedure.   His office team is so caring and kind.  Jin, Sparkle, Kim and Luisa always greet you with a smile and kind words. I would not go anywhere else to have a procedure done because once you have the best experience why go anywhere else.  I highly recommend Dr. Friedman and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sheri lindauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not be happier! I had a ruptured implant and at 69, was dreading surgery after 2 previous breast surgeries.  Dr. Friedman was highly recommended by a friend and plastic surgeon in Dallas. He spent the time to listen to me, my wants and my fears. He under promised, but over delivered!  It's now just 2 weeks after surgery, I feel fabulous and love my new breasts, SO grateful for him and all the amazing staff that took such great care of me...Thank You!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Spencer Crews
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an awesome experience with Dr Friedman and his team. Before my procedure I was nervous and anxious about my operation. Once I met with Dr. Friedman and his staff I knew I was in great hands. My anxiety went away and I felt so comfortable in their hands. I would highly recommend him and his team for any procedure they offer. I am extremely happy with the results of my operation and I feel so much more confident than I ever have before when it comes to my body image. He explained everything clearly and walked me through the whole procedure answering any questions I had. Kimmy who assisted in the procedure was also fantastic at keeping me comfortable and assisting dr. Friedman. 5 stars all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is very knowledgeable, patient, friendly, honest and has a great sense of humor. Also it is a great clinic with wonderful staff including his wife Jin! Thank you Dr. Friedman , Jin and the rest of staff! I would highly recommend Dr. Friedman and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Misty King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and the entire team were amazing to work with. My procedure has changed my life in such a positive way. I no longer feel neck and back pain. I can not express enough how much I recommend Dr. Friedman for a breast reduction, his work is precise and the results are awesome!! Thank you to the entire team, I love my new me!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are the absolute best!!! He made sure I had realistic expectations and knew what to expect recovery wise. user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Sullivan

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Moore

If I ever have any other needs for cosmetic surgery, I’ll be calling Dr. Friedman again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stella Strange
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Medina

user_reviews_extended.Name: S Ford

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tori Ignagni

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helen Peroulas

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Klingenberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is amazing!  I interviewed five other surgeons before I chose Dr. Friedman and it was worth all my research. I had a breast reduction and it has been life changing.  I'm so thankful and love the results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Spencer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his team were incredible from start to finish. Easy to schedule, clean office, and everyone was thorough in reviewing & executing my treatment plan. Can't say enough positive things about him & his team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you Dr. Friedman & team for your professionalism and exceptional care during my self-improvement journey. I feel like I have a family for life with you all. I highly recommend this office to anyone that is looking for top quality service. I sincerely appreciate the team taking such great care of me!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Koski
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Friedman and his team! I went to see him for an upper eyelid blepharoplasty and I am thrilled with the results. user_reviews_extended.Name: MARIBEL CUEVAS
user_reviews_extended.Description: Since day one my consultation appointment was awesome!!!  I left so happy and excited and feeling so safe with Dr Friedman. The staff is amazing, so helpful  answering all my questions always smiling.  I had breast augmentation Dr Friedman explain everything to me made me feel so comfortable, Dr made sure my size was something I was looking for and natural looking I was so happy with my results I can’t even explain how awesome this office is!! This is how safe and comfortable Dr Friedman office will make you feel, I will totally recommend anyone to his office you will not regret it I PROMISE YOU.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly F
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman is the BEST! I’ve had two procedures done with him and couldn’t be happier with the results. Not only is Dr Friedman an excellent surgeon, but also a very concerned and caring person. He and his staff were there every step of the way to ensure that I loved my results and that I had a successful recovery. Many thanks to Dr Friedman and his incredible staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Cannon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Superb Doctor.  From the first consult he made me feel at ease.  I came to him for a revision of a botched surgery, and he advised me to the best course of action to achieve what I was looking for and made sure my expectations aligned with the probable outcome.  I was treated with respect, never made to feel self-conscious, never felt rushed and everyone in the office made sure I was comfortable at all times.  I really appreciate that Dr. Friedman does all of his own surgeries without anyone else assisting - and he takes his time to make sure he has it right. His surgery center is state-of-art and connected to a major hospital. Everything from my first consult to my last follow-up is documented with photos and meticulous notes - including the surgery.  Communication is superior.  After my procedure, Dr. Friedman was quick to return phone calls - even late at night - and follow-up appointments have gone smoothly.  Pain management was excellent.  I am very pleased with the outcome and would (and have!) recommended Dr. Friedman and his staff to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Shaw
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman has a high standard of care and his entire staff is very professional. I am in the medical field and am very particular when choosing providers, so I can attest that he is top notch!
Dr. Friedman is also incredibly attentive to detail and I appreciate how creative he is in his ability to provide various solutions to any issue at hand. I also appreciated his honesty when suggesting other doctors that could perform other techniques to resolve my issue as well. My results were nothing short of Amazing! Other than his corny jokes 😜,  have no worries,  you are in great hands with an artist/physician.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Daniel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been considering a breast reduction and lift for several years due to years of chronic neck and shoulder pain. I was hesitant in having such an invasive type of surgery but I did a lot of research on line and spoke to others about this type of procedure. I was recommended to Dr. Friedman by a friend and it turns out their recommendation was one of the best ones I've received yet.

Dr. Friedman not only was very professional in his appearance but even more professional in his knowledge and expertise with this type of procedure. He's quite comical in his dry humor that I really like and a really nice and courteous doctor but yet caring about you, not only as his patient but also as a person.

His staff was A+ in my book and I felt like they were all my friends every visit I made to the office. They were even nice to my scruffy husband. LOL!  Before the procedure and post procedure, they took good care of me and even post surgery and during my recovery where I had some minor issues Dr. Friedman and his staff were so concerned about every single thing that I was dealing with.

I will definitely consider Dr. Friedman as my go to surgeon for any future endeavors I decide are the right things for me. I also recommend Dr. Friedman to anyone who would like to make improvements of any kind.

Thank you all for being amazing everyday!!!

Grace Daniel

user_reviews_extended.Description: Our first interaction with Dr. Friedman's office was with his front office staff, followed by his surgical coordinator and finally with him and his team.  Every one of these was kind, patient and professional.  The surgical appointment to remove my beauty mark was on time, efficient and the results EXCEPTIONAL.  I highly recommend Dr. Friedman and his office for your cosmetic surgery needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lonnie Chapman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is truly an artist and not just with inanimate objects but with the human body as well. My wife had sagging breasts with enlarged areola's and had received injections of a gel several years ago that was starting to harden. Not only was Dr. Friedman able to remove the gel but he reconstructed her breasts of a young girl. We are both very pleased with the outcome of this procedure. My wife and I highly recommend Dr. Friedman, he and his staff are the best, very friendly, knowledgeable and truly one of the best in the business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victor Carrington
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Going into the thought process of plastic surgery was a task within itself. I researched as many surgeons in this area as I could and I decided on Dr. Friedman because he had amazing reviews, because he was in a hospital and because after I met him he made me feel at ease after explaining the process. Dr. Friedman told me how things were with my body and gave me options. He let me decide what I wanted after he laid out all the options and the potential outcomes for each.

The day of surgery was a breeze. After surgery he explained thoroughly what he did and why and I had explicit instructions for aftercare.  The staff from scheduling with Dana to being fitted for my garment the day of surgery was a seamless process. I enjoyed the professionalism this team provided even with my driver and his instructions on what to do after surgery. I could feel that Dr. Friedman took a gentle approach with my liposuction because I did not feel any pain from the instrument stabbing me as I have seen on shows of patients getting liposuction.

I would recommend anyone to go have a consultation with Dr. Friedman if you are considering plastic surgery. I am most pleased with my results and this is only the beginning phase of my healing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Jiang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is first rate, very professional, knowledgeable, respectful, understanding and friendly. He carefully listens and discusses any concerns we have, we are very satisfied with the outcome. His office is very clean, and everyone in the office is very pleasant to work with and friendly. Thank you, All!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eo Stark
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman is highly skilled and in my personal experience, he was very knowledgeable in his procedures and made sure that everything went smoothly in terms of post-surgery healing. He is
One of, if not the best, doctor I’ve ever had the opportunity of going to.
5/5 stars, would highly recommend to anyone in need of an amazing reconstruction/cosmetic plastic surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alianna Abraham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Friedman is truly the best surgeon/artist, yes artist..that’s how good his work is! Also, honorable mention to his very attentive and caring team! I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Carnemolla Comerford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman and his staff are top notch.   I'd give him 6 stars if I could.  I'm so glad I chose him after thoroughly researching & consulting with alternatives for my breast implant replacement.  I can't say enough about how very seriously he takes his work and his results.  He's really a perfectionist at heart and he certainly went beyond going 'the extra mile' in my surgery to ensure that my results were up to his very exacting standard.  I am SO very happy with my outcome, which is even more wonderful than I expected.  In addition to the excellent result, I'm very pleased with his care and concern as well as that of his staff.  They're warm, reassuring and extremely competent.  You'll know you're in good hands when you meet them.  You simply can't go wrong with choosing Dr. Friedman for your plastic surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keely Hanson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman and his staff are extremely personable and friendly. Dr Friedman is an incredibly smart and talented surgeon and I would recommend any of my loved ones to him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: 2125 Gloves
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Undergoing a breast lift and augmentation has been something I wanted to do for years and I conducted a lot of research and met with over a dozen doctors before making my selection.
And when the time came, I selected Dr. Friedman not just because of his expertise, experience and great reviews, but also because of his genuine care for me as a patient, his patience in answering questions and how him and his staff made me feel like I am in the best possible hands. That feeling you get when you know “it’s the one”!
The staff is incredible also. Available. Attentive. Considerate. The facility is great, and the fact that the office is located inside the hospital gave me personally peace of mind also.
Post surgery support has been great too. Always available and very accommodating.

As someone who does not like to go through any medical procedure, I now trust Dr. Friedman and his staff with no doubt. He is my choice and my recommendation to anyone who needs any cosmetic procedure done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Brinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ronald Friedman opened many possibilities for me with the reconstructive surgery he performed on my abdomen. I can wear clothes that I have never wore before. He changed my life for the better. He made an excellent job. My abdomen looks amazing now. Also, he is a very kind and comprehensive person, and the staff is super kind and attentive to details.  I would absolutely recommend him to anyone. I feel so pleased with the surgery. Thanks to Dr. Friedman, I don't feel embarrassed to show my abdomen to other people anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a breast aumentation done in January by Dr. Friedman and I am so happy that I chose him and his staff for my surgery. I did a lot of research before choosing Dr. Friedman and I felt very comfortable with his level of expertise and experience. During my surgery, I had a complication in which I bled much more than usual. Dr. Friedman was very persistent in how he handled my situation - he made absolutely sure that all bleeding had stopped before inserting the implants. I feel that many other surgeons would have either closed me up without putting in the implants or (even worse) inserted the implants without being absolutely positive that all bleeding had stopped. My surgery took about triple the time that it would normally take. Dr. Friedman and his staff stayed very late into the night (after 11 PM) to make sure I was doing OK. Even though I'm sure they were anxious to get home, they were very gracious in making sure I had the best care. I am very happy with my results and my recovery has been wonderful. I highly recommend Dr. Friedman and his wonderful team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danille Dillon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had an augmentation surgery with Dr. Friedman. The results are amazing!!! He and his staff truly care about their patients and provide lots of personalized service, even if you email or call late at night!!! If I had to have another cosmetic surgery, he'd be my first and only choice. Thanks, Dr. Friedman!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sealey Dawn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are absolute experts in their field! Dr. Friedman corrected what another surgeon had messed up (significantly) and I am very happy with my results! In my book he is an expert at both science AND art! I recommend him with absolutely no reservation. Additionally, his staff is top notch in every way! They are attentive, personal and genuinely care about the patient. If you want it done right the first time...go to Dr. Friedman!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are truly amazing!  Dr. Friedman is knowledgeable, kind and the best at what he does. I could not imagine trusting another doctor like I trust him. The office staff are caring and provide a professional but friendly atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Forman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very happy I chose to go with Dr. Friedman.  He is the doctor that you want in the operating room with you.  He is a perfectionist and takes great pride in his work. I also want to mention that the nurses and office staff are the best of the best and always made me feel welcome. You can tell they enjoy coming to work with Dr. Friedman each day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: keeton roddy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman came highly recommended to me (for breast augmentation)  by a dear friend.  After having my two children,  being unhappy,  and thinking about it for 6.5 yrs, I decided to book a consultation and just see how I felt.  So, I did and I booked surgery with him the same day as my consult.  For me, having surgery was not an easy decision, obviously because it took me 6.5 years to just book a consultation.  But, after meeting Dr. Friedman and all of the incredible people working with him I knew it was the right fit and the right time for me.  Does this mean I didn't have questions and concerns leading up to my surgery day? Nope, but that was ok too because the staff was there for me every step of the way.

I'm now 1 week post-op (breast lift and augmentation),  everything went great, and I can't thank Dr Friedman, Jin, and the entire staff enough for how well they took care of me!  Thanks to all of you, I had a wonderful and life changing experience!

I highly recommend Dr. Friedman!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly F
user_reviews_extended.Description: The absolute best! After my thorough consultation with Dr. Friedman for a tummy tuck and lipo, I immediately knew he was the surgeon I would choose. He was friendly, informative, and answered every question I asked without interrupting once. I scheduled my surgery that same afternoon. Dr. Friedman and his staff are exceptional and extremely professional. They made me feel welcome and provided excellent care. Jin is a sweetheart and will make you feel like you’re chatting with a friend. And as for my surgery… well the results are AMAZING! After losing 90 lbs, I wanted to be contoured and have all of my excess skin removed. I feel so much more confident in my body now, and Dr. Friedman exceeded all my expectations! I also had submental liposuction done, which I highly recommend. I now have a waist and a jawline, and I couldn’t be happier! I definitely intend on going to Dr. Friedman for the rest of my plastic surgeries. If you’re looking for a surgeon who has expertise and truly cares about his patients and their needs, look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Felder
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but positive things to say about Dr. Friedman and his staff.  I work in the healthcare industry, and felt very comfortable in his office.  The staff is very professional, proficient and patient. The consultation visit was VERY thorough and he spent a very long time explaining all of the details, and didn't downplay the intensity of the recovery. Immediately prior to my surgery, I was unexpectedly nervous, and he was very patient with me, taking the time to allow me to rest and relax.  He also has a great sense of humor, which I appreciate.  After surgery, he and his staff were very attentive to my needs, followed up closely, and answered all of my questions with a smile.  You really should look no further if you're trying to select a surgeon.  I'm very pleased with my experience and will return here in the future without hesitation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tanya Deneve
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is amazing! I had  to have my 29 year old implants replaced on 12/22/22.  My recovery was painless and my breast look fantastic.  The staff was great!! If you’re thinking about doing anything, go see Dr. Friedman. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Arteaga
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had 2 surgeries by Dr. Friedman and both of my experiences were amazing! His staff is always friendly and made me feel very comfortable on surgery day. They called to check on me the day after surgery which I appreciated very much! I highly recommend Dr. Friedman and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arun Sharma
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A visit to Dr Friedman office was a wonderful experience for me and for my wife, who was treated by Dr Friedman for the earlobe repair. My younger son was in the procedure room when Dr Friedman was performing the repair. While my wife earlobe was repaired perfectly to our satisfaction - my 9 year old got his dream profession :)
The staff was helpful and efficient. They kept reminding us a day before our scheduled visits which was helpful.
Overall a great experience and we would certainly recommend Dr Friedman for the plastic surgery needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Tuma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman is hands down the best plastic surgeon! He pays attention to every detail.  His office staff is the friendliest and most helpful of any doctor’s office that I have been to!  Extremely happy with the results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Booth
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman was great! He explained everything so well during the consultation and eased all of my nerves. He was professional, but threw in a few jokes to lighten the mood (loved this!). I feel like he was very honest about the pros and cons of both saline and silicone implants. His staff was extremely helpful and made sure that my expectations were realistic. The office seems to really care about the patients as individuals. Six months after my surgery, the woman at the front desk remembered me and even asked me how school was going!

My surgery was in the morning, and I was able to do some walking that evening. I'm extremely thankful that I didn't have to deal with stitches, drainage tubes, or compression bras immediately after surgery. I was afraid I would look unnatural after my BA, but they look completely real! I've gotten a lot of compliments on how they "fit" my body. Eight months later, I'm still VERY happy that I chose Dr. Friedman!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Vazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can not express how HAPPY I am the results of my Cosmetic surgery. From the time of my first consultation to my last post op appointment I felt so comfortable with Dr. Friedman. Him and his staff are truly THE BEST!!! His anesthesiologist was so kind and made the experience so much easier, despite it being my first time. I can not wait until I go back to him. Words can not express on how grateful I am and how satisfied I am with the whole process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aimee Thibodeaux
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman has performed surgery on two of my daughters and the results were outstanding.  From the first call to the post op care, I can't say enough about how confidant I was entrusting him (and his staff) with my children. I would not hesitate to recommend his practice, he is truly and artist and his staff is top notch!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would recommend Dr. Friedman to anyone who is looking for something small, all the way up to a large life changing change.  I came in to his office, nervous and very insecure with my current situation with my belly after having 3 children.  Dr. Friedman and his staff made me very comfortable from the minute I walked in the door, sat with my consultation, pre op appts and multiple post op appointments. Every time, I come in, I am always greeted with the biggest welcome, like I am family.  By far, the most thorough Doctor I have ever been around and I am 100% satisfied with my results.  Thank you Dr Friedman and team for being part of my journey!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christiane Gilbert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff were absolutely amazing. From the second I had my first consultation until the follow-ups, it was a wonderful experience. I had a breast reduction after years of back pain and suffering, and after my procedure, I felt like a new person. The experience was life changing and it looks better than I ever imagined. I didn't go into the surgery with the purpose of vanity or to have perfect breasts- I went because I was tired of working out with 3 sports bras and living with constant neck and back pain. But, now I look better than I did when I was a teenager, lol! Dr. Friedman is an artist and if I could give him (and his staff) 10 stars, I would!

user_reviews_extended.Name: E L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved my experience with Dr. Friedman - I had a breast augmentation earlier this year and feel fantastic about my body. The surgery went smoothly, and the staff (Loved Jen!) paid attention to my needs (at all hours) during the crucial first week of recovery. No infection, my scars are healing nicely, the BA is looking GREAT & balanced on my body -- I would highly recommend Dr. Friedman even solely on the basis that his bleeding rate, infection rate, capsular contracture rates, and revision rates are much lower (5-8x) than the national average. I did a lot of research beforehand into the portfolios and care instructions of plastic surgeons in the Dallas area before choosing Dr. Friedman as my plastic surgeon, and he has definitely brought his wealth of experience and expertise to the table. If you're looking for a surgeon to do your BA, I highly recommend Dr. Friedman. Thank you again, Dr. Friedman and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CARLA HARRIS
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman did an wonderful job , I have a deflated implant - his staff got me in the office quickly and Dr. Friedman seen me - got it replaced very quickly and I am very happy with the results.
They are all a wonderful team at his office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Makaylie Teafatiller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Coming to this practice is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. I’ve been wanting a breast reduction/lift since I was in the 6th grade. I’m now 27. I found Dr. Friedman through a google search after my husband and I moved back home to Texas when he separated from the Air Force.  The photos on his gallery were the best I’ve seen out of the plethora of galleries I had looked through online. Once you add on the amazing reviews to that I called the next day! Dr.Friedman and his staff are absolutely amazing. Always so kind and professional. They truly make you feel like you’re the only patient! The ladies in his staff are truly sensational! They always made me feel so comfortable and excited! Like I was chatting with friends! I’m so happy that I was finally able to do this for myself. It has been life altering for me. I feel so happy in my own skin. This doctor and his team have truly given me the confidence I’ve always been wanting.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Dodd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman quickly saw me when I had an injury and my breast implant ruptured. He got me taken care of quickly and explained everything with extensive information. Jin is wonderful too! I feel like the staff have become friends during this process! So thankful to have him as my surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devrry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr. Friedman by two friends. After the first consultation, I knew he was the right surgeon for me. He gave me honest suggestions regarding my procedure and made me feel comfortable and confident. I could not be happier with the results!  Dr. Friedman was voted the best surgeon in Dallas area and his work definitely shows it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helen Hoeflich
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am in my mid 50’s and lost over 100 lbs after a life-long battle with obesity.  My abdomen was left a wreck inside and out and I was covered in drooping, empty skin from my shoulders to my knees.  I walked into my consultation with Dr. Friedman with a mile-long list of things I hated about my body.  After a lengthy discussion and exam, he recommended a staged plan of action to achieve the best results, laid out the possible risks and was honest about the level of improvement I could expect.  I left his office knowing I didn't need to look any further, trusting I would be safe in his hands and private surgical facility.  Dr. Friedman is truly a miracle worker, my transformation over the course of a year has been nothing short of amazing.  He patiently listens as I continue to navigate through a roller coaster of emotions along the way, answering all of my questions and always giving me as much of his time as I need.  There aren't enough words to express how grateful I am to Dr. Friedman and his outstanding professional staff for the exceptional care I have received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liza Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr. Friedman for a breast reduction.  He did a great job of explaining the procedure.  Everyone in the office is so nice and helpful.  He's an awesome doctor and I really liked that he was hands on for the entire surgery.  He will definitely be my go-to doctor for any other work I may have done.  Love my new girls!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy
user_reviews_extended.Description: From start to finish, Dr Friedman always made me feel comfortable. Jin and his other nurses were wonderful! They answered all my questions and made sure I understood everything. I am extremely satisfied with my results and will always turn back to Dr Friedman and his team for future procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Bowman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just went to Dr. Friedman this month for my second breast augmentation job. My first one, I had 550cc but didn't feel my shape was right and wasn't happy. After looking at boob jobs here, and research, I narrowed down to a list of surgeons. I scheduled consultations, and only one Dr. I was going to let touch me. That was Friedman. I am so happy with my results, I have fullness and more volume up top and they are closer together with a different shape implant. He is so knowledge and meticulous and does a great job. You'll miss out if you don't go to him. Not only that, but I would hate for you to pay and not be happy with your results. He is reasonably priced (cheaper then some other quotes I received), and does the best job. I lived in Vegas and this was a lot of the girls money makers - not mine per say- but I am picky with how I want it to look. Do yourself a favor and just schedule the consultation now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Weiguo Zhou
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman: many thanks for taking excellent care of my wife yesterday. You are great plastic surgeon, so dedicated, always going above and beyond and working tirelessly towards best outcome for your patients. Your practice is a world class act, your office staff are super professional. Thanks again for everything!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Being a nurse for 28 years in the DFW area, I absolutely did my research before finding a physician which included speaking to surgical nurses, other physicians, and coworkers. I will admit I have high expectations and want the best. I want someone who will listen to me, not try to oversell me on things I don’t need, mention any flaws I could fix, and make me feel comfortable. More than anything, I needed to see results.
I can’t believe I am saying this but Dr. Friedman not only met my expectations but exceeded them. He is not just a “plastic surgeon”. He is an artist and he is meticulous. People don’t usually impress me but him and his office staff are amazing. Jin, his surgery coordinator is outstanding. If you truly want the best, you need to see him! He’s also very nice and quite humorous once you get to know him but his attention detail is unbelievable. His whole staff is amazing from the moment you walk through the door. You don’t need to bother searching for someone. I’m telling you personally and professionally, I would trust him to do any other surgeries on me again or anything for my family and friends. I had a question over the weekend and I called him and he was as nice as he could be. He did NOT make me feel bad for calling him. He is a brilliant surgeon! Thank you Dr. Friedman for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leon Jinich
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient of Dr. Friedman since 2002 for multiple reasons.. Some visits were for removing moles and  for skin cancer.
Additionally, Dr. Friedman did reconstruction surgery after Moh's surgery for basal cell carcinoma on my nose twice, and cheek.
After so many years I can hardly see the scars.  Also, he has seen me as a hand specialist treating me multiple infections on several fingers.
Finally, most recently, he injected my cheeks and under eyes  with fillers for my daughter's wedding.  I looked awesome! Refreshed!  He is an excellent physician and surgeon, and an artist .  He has always done an excellent job of caring for my family and myself.   LJR

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hand's down the best experience to be had at a plastic surgeon's office. Everyone was so warm and welcoming. They knew me by name and always kept a very professional attitude without feeling like I was just a paycheck. I would love to be able to name particulars in the office but EVERYONE did an outstanding job in making the process efficient and comfortable. I would recommend this office to everyone for any cosmetic surgery. Dr. Friedman has changed my life, and I now feel comfortable in my body.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Isaac
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman is the absolute best. First and foremost, he never rushes through appointments--even the post-ops. He sit downs and patiently answers each and every question you might have. His staff is very friendly and responsive as well.

I had lipo done on my inner knees and outer thighs. It was a minor procedure and I'm happy with the results. Recovery was quick and almost painless.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Holz
user_reviews_extended.Description: SIMPLY THE BEST!!!!! Dr Friedman and every single one of his team are professional, caring, thorough and beyond exceptional. I am a new woman! Thank you Dr Friedman, Jin, Kimmie and your whole staff🤍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sylvia Hamilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to dr Friedman by a friend. Had my implants replaced with smaller set and a lift. Couldn't be happier with the results. Dr Friedman explained all my options thoroughly, he took time to answer all my questions I never felt rushed. The staff was excellent as well, very kind and accommodating. Very little pain during recovery,,,, love love love Dr Friedman and his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bita R. A.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman was recommended to me by a friend few  years ago. I had seen his excellent work and knew if I ever need a plastic surgeon I would go to him. This summer I had mommy makeover done with him. I don’t even live in dallas but I wanted to make sure he will do my procedure. I can’t say enough of how great the staff are and how happy I have been with the results. He is a perfectionist and a true artist. I have been beyond satisfied with the service and the work which was done on me. It has been 3 months since my surgery and they have been so patient and kind to answer all my questions to this day. Thank you!  I will keep on recommending him to all my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaylan Donahou
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Dr. Friedman since 2004 and have gone back several times for minor things as well as after I had a baby as my body drastically changed. I cannot say enough great things about Dr. Friedman and his entire staff. I feel like part of their extended family at this point and always know I’m in the best possible hands. I did my research and wanted the best and that is exactly what I got and then some. After My surgery with Dr. Friedman I went on to win dozens of national pageants, titles, modeling work worldwide, calendars, playing cards, tv shows, and on and on thanks to the confidence that I had and the natural (not fake or plastic looking) improvements he was able to give me. I will never go to anyone else even 16 years later, I have never looked elsewhere. He really listens to your specific wants and needs and what you want in your results. He doesn’t try to talk you into anything you don’t want yourself or need or anything unnecessary. He has great judgement and an even better eye as you can also see reflected in his art work. Anyone considering cosmetic surgery knows what a big decision it is and that being said I’m glad to talk to anyone who has any questions as a former patient of Dr. Friedman’s who would like to contact me. They have my number and email as well for former patient references and recommendations as well as before and after pictures. You are in good hands with Dr. Friedman and his whole team/staff. Jin, Louisa, everyone. The best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Cimbak
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman - and the whole staff - are fun to deal with. And you get top notch communications from them. Want to ask a question?  You can be sure you will get an answer from a Human Being!  I’m not going into my private details but I was awake during my procedure and we all were cracking jokes - which made me really relaxed and comfortable. Such a great team. His humor is dry like a “geek” but he’s also super intelligent and so he’s quite fun to talk to. At least for this engineer!  Smile. Look I don’t write many reviews. But when someone takes care of business so professionally it is awesome in a world where customer service is GONE. All I can say is THANK YOU to that staff. PS - for the record I’d say the spend of dollars was efficient for the work done. In other words a Fair Deal in a world where medical costs are stupid high and unpredictable. Make sure you work with the venerable Ms Jin. She can make the whole process a piece of cake for you. Cheers folks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily Tapp
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter had a breast reduction, and we could not have been more pleased with Dr. Friedman and his staff.  From the beginning, they made us feel comfortable, especially me, the mom.  They answered our many questions, put up with my nervousness, and were genuinely caring about my daughter.  His surgery changed my daughter's life, and she is SO happy.  We highly recommend him as a surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fabio Gemellaro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely Fantastic !!! Kimmie was awesome!! Her personality made me feel comfortable and at ease with the whole operation. Thank you Dr. Friedman for your professionalism and expertise. I highly recommend this place !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Edgman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received a breast augmentation from Dr. Friedman about 4 years ago and was so impressed with his skill and professionalism and the results, that I came back for filler injections. He is the only plastic surgeon I will trust and have referred 2 friends to his office who are also very happy with their results. I really couldn’t recommend him more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff will make you feel comfortable. His wife and him are just lovely and hard working individuals. I have been seeing Dr. Friedman for almost 3 years now. I wish I would have found him sooner. He is pretty honest & will not try to up-sale you. Thank you for helping me keep up with my aging & beauty maintenance. You are a huge blessing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gail Rigler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Ron Friedman is absolutely wonderful.  I cannot say enough good things about him and his staff.  Several friends had told me he was the best but I had to find out for myself. A few years ago I had an accident with our marble floor and had a horrible open gash above my eye.  Looking at me now you cannot even tell which eye he had fixed.  He is honest, ethical and a true artist.  I highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lissette Calixto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely kind and helpful staff. Dr. Friedman was very patient with my procedure. It wasn’t the easiest and I am forever grateful for the results. user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Mayo

user_reviews_extended.Name: AnonN I
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did plenty of research before narrowing down my options and finally deciding on Dr. Friedman. I knew that his credentials were impeccable, and his interest in art was a major draw for me. Thanks to Dr.  Friedman!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsrachelle Arentz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are absolutely amazing.  They make what could be scary a very pleasant, easy experience.  Dr. Friedman's warm personality, pleasant beside manner, and meticulous attention to detail is what makes him a great doctor.  I can't recommend him highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jess Everett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough good things about Dr. Friedman and his whole staff. Not only is he a phenomal surgeon but his staff and nurses are always so welcoming and there for you when you have any questions. I am almost 4 months post op and so happy with my results. user_reviews_extended.Name: megan martin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've seen Dr. Friedman since 2008 and he is exactly the same every time I see him.  I see some of the same staff as well. I recently had a breast implant replaced and I have to say that I was utterly amazed at how compassionate Dr. Friedman and his staff were to my situation.  It was the day before New Years and they saw me and confirmed I needed a breast implant replaced.  The thing most don't know or realize that stands out about Dr. Friedman is that he is AT EVERY SINGLE appointment, EVERY SINGLE consultation and HE DOES THE ENTIRE surgery- unlike MANY other surgeons around who will do the surgery and slip out the back door for a round of golf with friends, leaving his nurse to stitch you up, and finish the surgery.  That's actually really scary, friends!  Jin (his wife and nurse) is amazing.  She is the patient coordinator and she is like a friend!  She is so down to earth!!  I mean- to be able to have Doogie Howser (Dr. Friedman) operate and mold you is pretty amazing and I feel blessed.  Also, at the time of surgery the anesthesiologist asked me if her student could shadow her and my surgery.  I was honored as these students need to see as many cases as possible while in school.  I love that Dr. Friedman has nursing & med students working with him too.  Do your research folks- Dr. Friedman is no joke.  He is smart and ultra talented.

Megan

The loving attention I got as I checked out was heartfelt, and I smile even today as I think of that wonderfully warm atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
