user_reviews_extended.Name: M D P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman is the best!  He took care of teen’s eyebrow laceration and it looks like it never happened. Highly recommended!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a mommy makeover after a 100-pound weight loss and having a baby, and I had a very good experience with this physician and this clinic.  A doctor friend of mine helped me research Dr. Friedman and we determined that his credentials and track record are top tier!  Everything is well-coordinated, and the staff and Dr. Friedman prepare the patients very well for the post-op course of recovery, and also provide everything a patient would need to avoid post-op complications.  All of my questions were answered based on the most current/best practice information, and I felt very comfortable with that as a nurse practitioner, myself. Safety and science first!  My questions were also answered honestly and realistically, and nothing was down-played or over-exaggerated.   I also liked that the office is within a hospital and not some free-standing building.  During my recovery all my calls and emails were addressed same-day.  I was specifically impressed by how knowledgeable ALL the staff are--from the folks at the front desk to the surgery techs to the RNs--everyone gave me good recommendations.  My results surpass what I was hoping for (even just 7 weeks post-op) and I feel more comfortable and confident in my own skin.  Strangers are stopping me in public and telling me how good I look, and I will be wearing nothing but bodycon dresses from here on out!

A word of advice--go ahead and pay extra for extra liposuction.  It is well-worth it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: darra cuno
user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of debating over getting a BA I decided to actually start looking for a surgeon. I talked with a few friends that had it done & looked into their surgeons, but no one really stood out to me and I ultimately decided to look for someone closer to home. Which is how I stumbled upon Dr. Friedman!  After spending hours scrolling through his website & researching him online I emailed his office inquiring about an initial consult. Dana responded. Let me just say, she's amazing! She responded to EVERY email super fast, put my mind at ease & was another huge factor in why I decided to go with Dr. Friedman! At my consult I felt completely comfortable, which if you knew me would shock you. I'm about as modest as it gets, I don't do naked. However I was comfortable. I was told to 'shop' around for surgeons, however I knew that I wouldn't after my consult that day. Before I left the office I got future dates for surgery. That was a Friday, I emailed Dana the following Monday requesting a date. Two weeks later I got boobs. Do yourself a favor & go talk with Dr. Friedman && his amazing staff! You can thank me later. 😉

user_reviews_extended.Name: M'orock Ojong Arrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is the best in DFW. I did a ton of research before choosing him for my surgery. The staff is very compassionate and knowledgeable. Every step of the process is explained in detail and everyone is available to answer questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra McNorton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman, his wife, Jin, and the entire staff were a joy to work with.  They take a real personal interest and really get to know their clients. It's 6 months after my procedure and I'm thrilled with the results. Dr. Friedman is extremely good at what he does and I would and have recommended him to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hong Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely grateful for the experience I had with Dr. Friedman! I got my extended submental liposuction done with him, and the results turned out amazing. He goes into detail about the whole process and made me feel comfortable throughout the procedure. I highly recommend going to him if you have any interest in getting anything done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: H Chang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
There is a huge difference between a good, average, and bad doctor and especially a plastic surgeon.  Not only do you want to minimize any health risks but you want to achieve the best outcome in appearance.   My decision in selecting Dr. Friedman was not made lightly and not without due diligence.  Taking advantage of the fact that I have several doctor friends, I spoke with plastic surgeons and anesthesiologists to obtain detailed insight of not only my procedure but the skill and proficiency of a particular surgeon.  From this was able to get a comprehensive understand of the entire procedure and steps to minimize risks.  My anesthesiologist friends were able to provide a perspective on the skills and proficiency of a plastic surgeon having observed surgeons first hand in the operating room.  Comments on various plastic surgeon included type of incision, use of instruments, attention to detail, and even if the surgeon performed the suture or had a nurse do it.  All the feedback pointed to Dr. Ron Friedman as one of the very best plastic surgeons in the DFW area.
In my interview with Dr. Friedman, I found him to be not only very professional and knowledgeable but genuinely interested in the patient’s well-being and achieving the desired outcome.  As a result, I decided on having my procedure done by Dr. Friedman.
Dr. Friedman and his staff were outstanding.  They made the patient feel relaxed and well taken care of.  You can tell their procedures were refined through years of experience.
I could not be more pleased with my results and the follow up after the procedure was exceptional to ensure the patient does not experience any complications.   By following Dr. Friedman instructions “ to stay ahead of the pain.” I took the prescribed dosages as he prescribed and actually felt very little pain through the entire recovery.
If you are looking for one of the best plastic surgeon in the DFW area to achieve the best outcome possible and minimize any risks, I highly recommend Dr. Ron Friedman.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Dillehay
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his entire staff is absolutely amazing! Dr.Friedman is brilliant!!! Him and his staff go beyond to make sure you are comfortable and very well taken care of. Two surgeries with him so far :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lara Collazo
user_reviews_extended.Description: We went to Dr. Friedman to correct a facial scar our young daughter received that didn't initial heal correct from the ER visit. With the scar running thru her eyebrow and over her eye it was important to us to have a surgeon that could correct the scar and minimize the look of the scar to almost be nonexistent.  Dr. Friedman did an amazing job and you can barely see the scar and it has only been 2 months. This staff were outstanding as performing a procedure on a 4yr old can be difficult when the child is awake and aware of the procedure. But his staff knew what to do to keep her calm and get her thru it while Dr. Friedman focused on the work. I highly recommend Dr. Friedman and his amazing staff to anyone needing corrective plastic surgery or cosmetic surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JadohrA
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff were wonderful, knowledgeable and helpful.  I had two torn ear ring holes on one side and another tear on the other and he was able to reconstruct it where they look great.  I am thankful to him and his friendly and helpful staff.  You will not be disappointed going to him.  I highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Ledet
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman was very professional, straight forward, and knowledgeable about his craft! He gave great advice, but ultimately, my favorite part was how much he wanted my results to be exactly what I wanted...and he made sure of that! He gave me the perfect size and the perfect result. I couldn't be more pleased. His staff was also very friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Baby Matthew
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went for a mommy makeover (tummy tuck/breast lift) and had great results!   Dr. Friedman and his staff made me feel completely comfortable the whole way through.  They went out of their way to help me, and Dr. Friedman was skilled and thorough.  I highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Flock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I think everyone is a little worried about finding a great doctor. Especially one that's going to modify your body. There are so many risks and the last thing you want to do is come out looking like Frankenstein or even die. (a bit drastic).

I researched a lot of doctors before finding Dr. Friedman. First, his office staff is incredible and welcoming and there for you all the time. (Shout out to Dana!) You can tell everyone likes working for Dr. Friedman which in itself is a great indicator you're at the right place.

I went to get consultation and had a million questions. I wanted them to lie to me and tell me I would come out of all of this like a Victoria Secrets model. But unfortunately, no, they told me the TRUTH. They are not a genie in a bottle able to grant you three wishes.

I went through with my procedure anyways and couldn't be happier! I love the outcome. I feel like a new woman and wish I had done this procedure 10 years ago.

I had my operation the day before Thanksgiving and Dr. Friedman actually came to see me on Thanksgiving day to make sure I was okay! Who does that? A fantastic doctor.

I would have recommended Dr. Friedman to my friends. I'm a walking billboard for him and everyone wants to know who did my work and I'm happy to share Dr. Friedman's information.

Note to new patients: Don't be alarmed by Dr. Freidman's straight forward answers. He's not warm and fuzzy. He will not make decisions for you and he will not convince you to do anything. It's not  that he doesn't want to work with you, but he's not going to mislead you. You have to want the procedure and make the decision yourself. If you need assurance or convincing, find it else where. When you are ready and sure this is what you want, you will be a GREAT hands (literally).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirsten Krieg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is fabulous! He and his staff made my first experience much more comfortable than what I had expected. The staff was great and very greeting. I could not be more pleased with his work and would recommend him to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is the best plastic surgeon in the Dallas Ft. Worth area. I refer all my friends and family to him-I wouldn't send them anywhere else! user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are the best! I accidently almost cut my thumb in half with a big serrated bread knife... I had a really deep, jagged cut that was more than 12 hours old and starting to show signs of infection. Dr. Friedman met me at his office on a Sunday at 10:00pm (during non-business hours) to give me stitches to keep me from having any permanent damage to my thumb and stop the infection. I was really nervous about the day I had to get my stitches taken out, a couple weeks later, but they were very gentle and that was easy and painless as well. My thumb looks great... you cant even tell my thumb had ever even been cut, or that I had stitches. Dr. Friedman took really good care of me and I had a great experience. Thanks Dr. Friedman and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Read
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Ronald Friedman is the absolute BEST there is!! He and his entire staff are priceless!!
I had a tummy tuck and a breast reduction/lift in Sept of 2018. We read many reviews and did lots of research. We had consultations with others, but after the consultation with
Dr. Friedman, we knew we had the BEST and we didn’t need to look any further! Dr. Friedman and his entire staff were so kind and helpful throughout the entire process. Every question I had by email and phone were always answered immediately. Dr. Friedman took so much time with me during the consultation. He was honest in what he could do and what he was and wasn’t comfortable with to ensure that my expectations were in check and my health was always his first priority! The morning of the surgery he took so much extra time marking, erasing, remarking, erasing, remarking what he was going to do, just so it would be as close to perfect as possible, and I have to say that his work was perfect!!!!  It exceeded my expectations and definitely made my dreams come true!!!!
I’ll start first with my reduction and lift. I went from big saggy breasts to the perfect perky size C. My nipples are now where they belong again! I enjoy wearing clothes so much more now. I no longer have to live in a bra and try to hide them. I can say that it’s truly changed my life for the better!
Now to discuss my tummy tuck!
I hated my lack of a waist, my stomach, belly button and the overall fatty appearance of it all. I was always self conscious about that area. After my tummy tuck I now have the flattest stomach, such a small waist, and the cutest little belly button! I honestly think he worked magic!!!! My only regret is that I didn’t find Dr. Friedman and his staff sooner!
I have also gone to him now for Botox and injections and he was wonderful at that as well, not that I expected anything less!  I truly consider them family friends and I’m so glad to have each one of them in my life!!!

I did my beast augmentation so happy with the results. ten years later time to replace my implants so I  did not think twice to go again with Dr Friedman I am so so happy with my new implants thank you so much Dr and thank you to all the personal that work there to be always friendly and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Journey Choi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is an amazing board certified plastic surgeon who makes sure every procedure is done with utmost care and precision with unmatached technique. He was also the youngest surgeon in America during early years of his practice who now has the most impressive and extensive medical training and and experience in the industry. Dr. Friedman’s office, which is located inside the Plano Presbyterian Hospital and is staffed with the friendliest and effective team of nurses who are professional and well organized. Nurse Jin, Dr. Friedman’s wife is also an amazing patient coordinator and goes beyond her responsibilities to ensure their patients with whatever needs they have.  I truly recommend Dr. Friedman to anyone looking for a plastic surgeon. He’s also the best at suturing the bottom of my 2yr old’s foot when the pediatric Dr. at an urgent care failed to make it happen and sent us home with a glue tape and 3 ripped sutures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joni Cinnamon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are the best! All that you could hope for and want! Friendly over the phone and in person.  Dr. Friedman is very knowledgeable and articulate. He takes the time to explain things and set expectations. I felt that I was in capable hands through the whole experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Acker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would absolutely recommend Dr.Friedman to anyone searching for the most qualified surgeon. What an amazing team! From beginning to end he and his staff answered all my questions and helped me with every process along the way. My post op care from Dana was amazing. Any question I had, even after hours she was always there with an answer. She even got in touch with another patient who has the same procedure a few weeks before me. All my fears disappeared  and I am so happy with my results. This surgery has changed my life and I feel normal again. Thank you Dr. Friedman and your amazing staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vegas Mars
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Friedman and his staff. I got a breast augmentation done with him. I am someone who does not do anything without overthinking and doing tons of research so trust me when I say this is the place for you! Dr. Freidman is very patient and never makes you feel rushed he will answer literally ALL of your questions. One thing I also love about him is he is very practical no BS, he doesn’t treat you like you’re transactional and he also explains how much a lot of plastic surgery involves marketing techniques that can be misleading. He has definitely done his research. I have really bad anxiety so I called his office a lot to make sure I am doing the correct things pre & post op and they are always there to answer any questions I have. I got to look through his previous work and really get an idea of the sizing I wanted. Everyone down to the anesthesiologist was so knowledgeable and kind. I love all the staff! Sparkle & Jin are so sweet and helpful as well. I am going back here for botox + fillers and other plastic surgery needs 100%. Also Dr. Friedman has the best dry humor which makes for great bedside manner. Overall I’m SO happy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kristy theis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been visiting Dr. Friedman for about 5 years. It's known that he is an outstanding plastic surgeon, but I visit him for nonsurgical skin rejuvenation (injectables). I know you can get BOTOX (and fillers for that matter) anywhere, but I would never trust my face with just anyone. As a seasoned plastic surgeon, Dr. Friedman truly understands the underlying anatomy of the face and where to place the medication so that you get a natural, lasting result. He takes the time to assess your skin, discuss your goals, and ultimately becomes a big part of your "aging gracefully" journey. I LOVE his staff too. They are personable and super accommodating!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim McQueary
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman has done work on 3-4 of my close family members and all have had very great things to say about this man. so Here is my Story, I broke my arm in Jan. of 2020 and have been through 3 surgeries with my original orthopedic Doctor to fix the incision that kept opening up. After the third surgery stitches were removed and the incision began to open up again. By now I was done with all this and at my whits end. So I asked my wife if she thought I could see Dr. Friedman about this. She contacted the office spoke with Jin filled her in on what we where going through.We emailed her the information she got us an appointment. After seeing Dr.Friedman and a culture test I ended up having a mrsa infection this whole time. I had my fourth surgery this time with Dr. Friedman, he fixed my opening did an internal flap and my incision has healed up. I am still fighting a cellulites infection. He continues to be by my side as I fight to get this infection out. For anyone that has any doubt about Dr Friedman i can tell you I would trust my life to this doctor. Dr Friedman and his staff are by far the best I have seen in my life. Thank you Dr. Friedman and Jin for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Stanley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is a miracle worker! he turned my gross torn onion ring ear (gauged to an inch and a quarter and tore) into a beautiful masterpiece and i am forever thankful to him! I have two beautiful petite earlobes now. His staff is so fun as well! They kept me calm, held my hand and told jokes throughout the procedure despite my anxiety regaurding the procedure! It was the best investment because he is literally the best doctor and great at what he does! It is a beautiful office as well with calming artwork and very clean ! Please see him if you need any work he will change your life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Hendrix
user_reviews_extended.Description: I didn’t know places like this exist anymore! Dr. Friedman and his entire staff are not only the best, but they truly care. I changed plans last minute due to a new job and they stayed late to accommodate my needs more than once. They made it work and gave me impeccable results. Amazing place, wonderful staff and anyone would be lucky to have access to such wonderful, caring service. Their team; Kimmy, Luisa and Sparkle are the perfect fit for such an amazing place. It’s not about money to them, it’s about making people happy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RKF Main
user_reviews_extended.Description: For over 10 years I've trusted Dr. Friedman for various cosmetic procedures!! I appreciate Dr. Friedman's expertise as well as the support from his knowledgeable staff. From Botox, tummy tuck, not 1, but 2 breast augmentations, etc.... Dr. Friedman has always far exceeded my expectations!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debra Larson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Friedman for over 10 years. He and his staff took time to address my medical condition and my concerns. My cosmetic surgery was a success. I have continued to use Dr. Friedman for other cosmetic procedures and have been pleased with my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danni Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman and his staff are amazing! I first went to him for a breast augmentation in 2009 after a friend referred me to him. Since then I have referred three friends to him. All of whom were just as amazed with his ability, staff, and professionalism as I was. Recently, I went back to Dr. Friedman for a consult on Botox. Once again, he was honest and professional about what he believed would be best. He genuinely cares about each patient's needs and makes sure that the results of his work correlate accordingly. Not only is he hands down the best plastic surgeon in Dallas, but he only works with the best. He uses an M.D. anesthesiologist and  works side by side with his wife Jin, who is also fantastic! I have never been more impressed with any medical provider. Every employee in his office reflects the same genuine kindness and personal service. Finally, the icing on the cake. Dr. Friedman believes in the importance happy patients and continual referrals. As a result, he has set up a referral program for his patients. I do not know of any other plastic surgeon out there who is kind enough to offer free services to those who send him referrals. Needless to say, I will continue to send everyone I know to him and his team.
-D. Williams

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashlee Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience with Dr. Friedman and his team! I had my breast reduction surgery on Dec 8th and couldn’t be happier. He did an amazing job. I went from about a G to a full D.

Scarring is minimal to non existent and I no longer have back pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Pocasangre
user_reviews_extended.Description: My fiancé and I drove about 13 hours for me to get chin liposuction done. I am almost a week post op and I am LOVING my results!! Dr. Friedman and his staff are incredible and so friendly!! They expressed their concerns and gave me tips for my recovery! Without hesitation, I recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Seven Lounge
user_reviews_extended.Description: 4 months ago, after an injury to my face that I knew would require stitches, I was referred by a friend to see Dr.Friedman. I wanted a Plastic Surgeon to suture instead of someone in an urgent care. It was almost 5pm, I called hoping they could squeeze me in the morning. After I explained the injury and sent them a photo, they said to come in and Dr Friedman would stay late. When I got there, everyone was very friendly. Dr. Friedman was very professional and easy to chat with. He stitched me up and had me follow up. The sutures were so perfect that less than a month later you could barely make them out. Today I cant even find the area. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karyn B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough about how much I love this place! Dr. Friedman is so nice and very professional. He takes his time listening to what you want and then works his magic. I would recommend him to anyone that is wanting, botox, fillers, implants, he does it all and the results are amazing. His entire staff is awesome, so friendly, caring and professional. Definitely a Class A place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Herring
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Friedman is thorough, explains everything in detail, answers all your questions and you never feel rushed. His staff is friendly and personable. I flew in from Hawaii to see Dr. Friedman because he’s worth the trip and he’s that good! Still amazed with the after results.
Thank you Dr. Friedman and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neil S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman did an abdominoplasty for my  better half.. While highly skilled and recognized he is also kind, funny and compassionate. He is also a accomplished artist.This additional talent gave my better half a very aesthetic outcome as well. His amazingly skilled staff led by his awesome wife, Jin, were very kind, warm and helpful throughout the pre Op process, Op and post Op support.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathy Everitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman and his staff are all great!  From the moment you walk in they are welcoming and ready to care for you.  Procedures are worry free here because you can trust and count on this doctor to do the best job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chantay Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have  had an amazing experience with Dr. Ronald Friedman and his staff. The Dr. went over all my options with me for breast augmentation. My results are truly phenomenal. I feel like I new woman!!! The staff was super helpful whenever I called with questions on concerns before and after my surgery. I recommend this place to anyone looking for breast, tummy or botox services. They are the best!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a breast augmentation and lift on March 5, 2013. All I can say is AMAZING!! I read several stories about the pain and what to expect so I wasn't going in totally blind but the walk to the operation room..you can never prepare for. Everyone was so sweet and talked about everything under the sun until I fell asleep. After the procedure, there was some tightness and pain but nothing that wasn't controlled with extra strength Tylenol. This doctor is the ultimate professional, precise, charming and very funny. I was comfortable from the day I walked into this beautiful practice and still feel the same today. I am now 6 weeks post op and the scars look like papercuts and are fading daily. I would recommend this doctor to anyone. I did a lot for research before making this decision and I am grateful to Dr. Friedman and his staff. If you are reading this then you are thinking about some type of procedure so please go and see Dr. Friedman, it will be well worth it and your results will be amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dena Levy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I ripped my leg open during dance practice and my mom rushed me over to Dr. Friedman. This was the second time that he stitched me up, the first was when I ripped my face open as a toddler. Him and his staff were so kind and amazing through this whole process. It was hard and painful but now I am all healed and just had my last checkup from him and I am good to go. Dr. Friedman's practice is amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Louann Lentini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman is the best surgeon around. He is a genius in creating natural beauty. I absolutely love the outcome of his work. The end result was flawless and his staff is the best...caring, friendly, and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Lemley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am 7 weeks post op Mommy Makeover and couldn’t be any more happy with my results!! Great surgeon and great staff! Very helpful and knowledgeable! He came highly recommended to me and I’m so happy I made the call to him! The changes in my body are unbelievable! I highly recommend Dr. Friedman!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Shepard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his staff are such a pleasure! He was realistic with me while still meeting my needs and wants. 4 months post op now and I am super happy with the results. I will be returning again for some unrelated treatment. He is top notch!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Brubaker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started my search in the DFW area for a Plastic Surgeon back in October 2013 for Breast Reduction.  It took me until March 2, 2015 to have the surgery due to correlating with the time of year and with my work schedule.  From the moment I spoke with the staff, I knew he was the perfect MD for this procedure.  I went for consultation in Oct 2014.  I had to wait for insurance approval and a surgery date.  Each step of the process his staff was professional and did not make me feel like I was a bother with my inquiries especially since my insurance had a special department that handles my employers claims which only added to the confusion. Dana is the best. She was easy to reach and informative. Now-for Dr Friedman, I just can not say enough at his talents.  He made me feel comfortable from the moment I met him. He took the time to explain the procedure and expectations.  He spent time answering questions pre-op as well. After I had my first post-op appt I had  a rough day and was concerned about what I saw.  Dana made sure that morning I was able to get in and see Dr Friedman.  He reassured me.  Now that I am 4 weeks post-op, I can not say enough kind words about Dr Friedman and his staff. I have no more neck and back pain.  Even though the recovery is a long one, I definitely would do it over again and would go to no other surgeon to have this done.  His work is nothing but awesome. He is one gifted surgeon and does beautiful work.  I am a healthcare professional and will definitely recommend to others. I went from a 38G to possibly a 38C.  I am still healing and swollen so I am not able to get the exact measurements.  He went through all possible scenarios with me up front.  My only expectation was to be smaller and pain free. So far I am symmetrical and that was not the way I was before surgery. The before and after pictures definitely shows a transformation. I look forward to see my 6 month transformation. Thank you Dr Friedman for your talented hands..

user_reviews_extended.Name: uyen le
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman did not promise anything to me but his job came out more than what I ever expected. I had Breast Revision with him and I am so happy with the result. His staff is so nice and attentive. I especially love Jin for always being patient with me. Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was sitting in the ER while a PA worked on our son's finger.  He had an accident where he nearly lost part of his index finger.  I texted a doc friend who said "Get him to Dr. Friedman".  Two years later and after two surgeries trying to save the tip end of his finger Dr. Friedman had to remove a 1/2" off the end of our son's finger.  I regretted not having left the ER and gone directly to Dr. Friedman.  Friedman reassured me that in this case, it wouldn't have affected the outcome.  Shortly after that incident our daughter broke here nose in a soccer game, and Friedman splinted and straightened her nose.  I returned myself and had a cyst above my right eye removed.  You can't find the blemish or a scar today !!  I returned and had three lipomas removed, again flawless work.  In 2018 I had a carcinoma on my temple, and had Mohs surgery leaving a hole the size of a dime.  Dr. Friedman performed another flawless surgery and today you can't tell where the carcinoma was.  Then last month I was doing yard work and stuck my hand with a thorn from a landscape bush.  The next day my hand was swollen and red, I called that morning and was in Dr. Friedman's office that afternoon.   I had a rapidly advancing infection they gave me IV antibiotics in his clinic and sent home with scripts for oral antibiotics with a follow up in two days.  Dr. Friedman saved my hand.  Dr. Firiedman is the most competent physician / surgeon I have ever been too.  He is attentive, has a laser focus, and has an attention to detail.   I totally  trust his work and enjoy his warmth.  His wife Jin completes the office with here enthusiasm and personal touch.  These guys are the best !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I selected Dr. Friedman to perform an "ear pinning" for my 13 year old daughter. The staff was great. The price was reasonable and most importantly the work was exceptional! I'm so happy that I chose Dr. Friedman.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elisha Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman performed extended submental liposuction (double chin and jawline) on me. The whole experience was great. He was very detailed in the information he provided about my procedure and what I could expect in the weeks/months after. I can't even begin to express my pleasure and satisfaction with the results so far. Totally worth it! Life changing! Really great doctor and staff...I would highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Imed Bouazizi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We went to Dr. Friedman after our daughter suffered from an injury in 2 of her fingers (she had them under a rolling treadmill). Dr. Friedman supported us psychologically and provided us with all information we needed to know throughout the skin graft procedure.
The skin graft was a great success. Thanks to Dr. Friedman, our daughter can now use her fingers again in a normal way. We are really very thankful to Dr. Friedman and can only highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Cohn
user_reviews_extended.Description: When we were told our son needed surgery on his face we knew Dr. Friedman was the only one we trusted fully and we were not disappointed. He’s the best! He took care to make sure his work is as perfect as can be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Azimi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming to Dr. Friedman for Botox for awhile now. Before I go on... I want to say... he does all his injections. He does not use Astheticians. He is a plastic surgeon and it puts me at ease knowing he knows the anatomy of the innervation of my face.
He does the right amount where my face does not look frozen and his touch ups are right on.
The staff are very friendly and accommodating. They make you feel like old friends. The  office is clean and stylish.
I have recommended him to tons of friends and family. They have been happy with their results including their surgical results.
Overall I'm 110% satisfied!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so absolutely elated with the outcome of my procedure!  Dr.Friedman corrected the hollows under my eyes with Juvederm and I could tell an immediate difference.  I have literally been given back the last 10 years!  I am a 35 year old ex-model and my appearance has always been everything to me.  I had lost confidence as the years progressed and searched for answers.  All I can say is Dr. Friedman is my answer!  I am so unbelievably grateful to him and his staff for giving me my confidence back and taking the time to answer all of my questions and make me feel comfortable.  The results are absolutely beautiful and natural and would trust no one else with my beauty concerns.  I couldn't have asked for a better outcome or a better 35th Birthday present!  Dr. Friedman is the best...a natural sculptor and artist.  I will absolutely be back!  Thank you again, Dr. Friedman and Staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Lindsey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been coming to Dr Friedman for a couple years now for lip fillers and most recently Botox. I have been to numerous different doctors for my lips and he is by far the best. I had my lips messed up by an injection, In my past, of a substance that built up inside my lip causing a bump. He has always made my lips look even and natural. I highly recommend him for any injections. :-) Also every single person that works here is soooooo friendly. I have never met a front desk employee or nurse that wasn’t so sweet and very helpful!
Michelle Serrano

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came to Dr. Friedman to get my ear lobes fixed from stretching (gauging) them as a teenager. I had sharpie sized holes in my earlobes for the past 16 years and  had to look past them everytime I saw myself in the mirror.  Dr. Friedman did an amazing job! My ears look like nothing ever happened! He was nice, intelligent,  professional,  and his staff was sweet and welcoming.

Thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Truth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with my breast augmentation surgery,,, I now have 685cc  and they look great and the scars are looking good ... dr Friedman is A+ doctor... he was there for me everytime I called after surgery if I had any concerns,,, the staff is very welcoming and friendly I felt very comfortable. I'm so happy with my results!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: B L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is skilled, attentive (and might I add, always in good humor-I don’t believe I’ve ever come in for injections and not been in stitches). His staff are equally attentive,  accommodating, and warm. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelly Oliver
user_reviews_extended.Description: I travel 3 plus hours to come and see Dr Friedman! It’s well worth it as he is amazing. I just sit down and ask his opinion on how my skin and face look and he gives his thoughts and ideas to me. He and his team are so caring and kind. They also use nitrous if you are nervous. It’s really a nice touch as even Botox can smart a bit. I highly recommend him and his staff. They will take excellent care of you and answer all your questions. I’ve even called back and they walked me through taking care of swelling as I had to attend an event and felt puffy. So caring and personal. Love this place❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Milana Malko
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first ever surgery and I'm so glad I chose Dr. Friedman to perform it. I had expectations but the results went far above and beyond anything I had imagined and hoped for. Both Dr. Friedman and his staff were exceptionally amazing and I could not be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: amazing Bolton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Okay let's get personal! I am a long time patient of Dr. Friedman. I met him almost 20 years ago. He has done 3 surgeries on myself and one microdermabrasion, 2 on the Father of my child, and he is and about to work on a close friend of mine. When our dog went rogue and bit a guest in our home, his nose required almost 40 stiches. I sat right there beside them as  he rebuilt this mans nose right in front of me. If I ever hear any one mention the personal need of a plastic surgeon I am the first to chime in and say there is no way you can do this without at least doing a consult with this man. I  consider him to be the best in his field.  Hands down no question trustworthy and he is a perfectionist. This is definitely something that you want in a plastics surgeon. Also seeing as he is a micro surgeon he is able to save the gnarled hand of a pianist or make your cleavage look its absolute best. I write this review with all of my appreciation and gratitude for the staff that is there supporting him. He is surrounded  incredible women, all of the team work diligently to make you comfortable and help to set the stage so you can be your personal best. Thank you all for what you do. It has not gone without notice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Oh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recommended a friend that was bitten by her dog over Memorial weekend to Dr. Friedman. He was kind enough to immediately take the time out of his busy schedule to see her. My friend Paige was so severely bitten, that she went to an ER doctor and they only gave her surgical glue. With the concern of scarring and after visiting with Dr. Friedman, she was so happy with the results and sympathetic care he provided, we both will recommend Dr. Friedman to anyone in the DFW Metroplex! He is hands down, the BEST Plastic Surgeon anyone can ever ask for!

user_reviews_extended.Name: april raike
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman changed my life! I used to be so self conscience. I hated the way I looked and always wore clothes to hide my body. Now I can wear whatever I like with confidence. The staff is the kindest bunch of ladies. Everyone is very professional and knowledgeable. I'm generally terrified of surgery, but they made me feel so comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Shaw
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a physician, I have seen firsthand many patient's results from surgery by Dr. Friedman, and I have always been impressed.
Over the past few years, I have personally used Dr. Friedman for injectables, and I have been exceedingly happy with the results!   I have used other physicians, aestheticians, and physician assistants for injectables in the past, and I can say with confidence that Dr. Friedman's work is the best.
I have used him for botox, Juvaderm (lips) and Restalyne (nose).   I never realized what a nose can do for one's face until recently when Dr. Friedman filled a superficial scar on my nose- I was stunned, and I felt so beautiful!  It seems that he uses injectables like an artist uses clay:  he knows how to bring out true beauty based on each individual's face.   I highly recommend him, and would not consider using anyone else for injectables!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chow Asian
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very happy with the whole process from consultation, staff, surgery, recovery, size, 6 weeks after.
Dr. Friedman is very detailed, taking time to explain everything and answer the questions, straight forward, set expectations. You can totally trust his judgement and recommendations. The surgery center is within the same facility. Make it very convenience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda
user_reviews_extended.Description: A while back I had a bad experience at a consultation with a surgeon in Southlake and it deterred me for years before I finally decided to try again. After some research I decided to schedule a consult with Dr.  Friedman. Five months post-op and I'm very pleased. Everyone in this office is so helpful and caring. The whole thing was "easy" considering what was being done and the cost wasn't as bad as I had anticipated. There is so much information on the website to prep yourself but, even so, Dr. Friedman will answer any and all questions. I'm pretty anxious by nature and showed up to my consult with a list of questions to which he kept referring to in order to make sure I was comfortable. He will not give you false expectations and you shouldn't want anyone who does. Most definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: One week after surgery and I am very satisfied with my submental lipo results and I can’t wait to continue to see it get even better! Dr. Friedman and his team are all very knowledgeable, caring and fun to be around! 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachelle Wigginton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient of Dr Friedman’s since 2004.  I’ve been very happy with his level of knowledge and expertise in the industry and always very willing to discuss anything I had questions about thoroughly and not rushed.  His staff has always been amazing as well.  I would highly recommend Dr Friedman.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alma Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My chin and side profile always bothered me because thats where most of my weight gain is  noticeable.  I knew I wanted something done but not too invasive and looked into  liposuction. I made calls, reseached and read many reviews and went through many photos before deciding to go with Dr. Ronald M. Friedman. My first consultation was vitrual for chin liposuction. It was convenient and and still very thorough. I was recommended the extended submental liposuction and I am soo happy with the results! I felt comfortable with Dr. Ronald M. Friedman and he answered all the questions I had before and after the procedure. His staff was polite and helpful as well. Overall, good experience and amazing results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: mysti cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman is a true artist! He listens and explains everything in great detail that is easy to understand. His office staff is amazing! I've researched for years and I truly believe he is the best in his field!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristine Tibbetts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Friedman is wonderful.  He explains everything thoroughly and the results show his skill.  You will not find a more friendly office staff!  The nurses are awesome and very caring.  I would never go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Fahrendorf
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have seen Dr. Friedman for Botox and Restylane injections twice now.  I consider myself a pretty tough gal, but when it comes to my face, I'm a whiny baby. Case in point--I couldn't even make it through eyebrow threading without crying.  Dr. Friedman completely put me at ease with his easy-going demeanor and sense of humor (if you enjoy Wildesque puns delivered with dry wit, he won't disappoint!), true artistic talent, and years of experience.  Jin and the office staff are all fantastic as well, and I trust their practice implicitly.
Here's the real proof that I made the right choice:  DH was not in favor, but after seeing a few post-procedure Thanksgiving pics, commented, "Wow honey, you look great in those pictures.  I guess those injections really worked."  I'll take the compliment and take it as his "blessing" to visit Dr. Friedman and co again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal G
user_reviews_extended.Description: He did a wonderful job at removing a suspicious mole on my arm and gave me the pros and cons of each technique of how to go about removing it. Dr. Friedman is great about giving objective advice when deciding what to do. He lets you weigh out the options and decide for yourself. His staff is also very friendly and caring!

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Lanier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Friedman is very personable and and a good listener. The staff  were all very attentive and  made sure I was well informed and had everything I needed pre-surgery and post-surgery. I'm currently 5 weeks post-surgery and very happy with my results. I would definitely recommend anyone wanting a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to Dr. Friedman for a augmentation. I did a fair amount of research and saw how accomplished and well reviewed he was. After the consultation I knew he was the right doctor for me because he was obviously not only a perfectionist with an eye for aesthetics but he was also honest. He was polite and kind but did not beat around the bush about the what my breasts looked like currently and what the procedure could realistically do for me. He told me that just an augmentation would not get me the results I was looking for.  I also needed to also have a lift. I really appreciated his honesty and it made me feel like I could trust him to help me look my best. He also really listened to my concerns and wishes. I was afraid of having them to large and I felt he listened to what I want and balanced that with what would look best on me. The results were incredible.

His staff and facility are well run and very nice. It is a huge plus in my opinion that his operating room is attached to his office and located in a hospital. It was very relaxing to show up the morning of my surgery and come to the same place that I have had all my consultation and pre-op appointments in.

I honestly can say enough good things about the whole experience. I LOVE my new breasts so much. I am pretty sure my family and friends got tired of me repeating over and over and over again how happy I am. He is an amazing doctor with an wonderful staff. His resume speaks for itself and his results are AWESOME.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Ochoa
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time getting any cosmetic procedure done and Dr. Friedman and his team made the whole process so easy & smooth! Everyone was so friendly and funny and made my nerves go away instantly. They are a fantastic team and I will recommend them to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hanna Hailu
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you’re looking at Dr. Friedman’s site, the number one piece of advice I can pass on to you is to trust him and his staff. I wish I could see you face to face, you could hear my voice, and my passion for the work he did for me. He is truly, truly one the best, down to earth, caring, relatable, personable, and intriguing doctors I have ever met. It only took one appointment (my consultation) for him to put me at ease, he takes the time to explain his procedures, he is patient and never makes you feel rushed.  After that appointment I never felt nerves afterward, because I knew I found my doctor. He is gifted; his staff is nothing less than accommodating, beyond competent, and mostly endearing. There is a kindness that reigns within his practice, an energy that is soothing, I remember walking into surgery, feeling happy, excited and READY. You are in the best hands in Dallas, seriously, I wish his career longevity, because his work is life changing! Everyone deserves to feel this way :)

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman and his team are phenomenal! They went above and beyond in the delivery of my care, which exceeded all expectations. Post-op instructions were very clear and follow ups helped me understand what needs to be done to ensure optimal healing. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex V
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone I would call.... I repeatedly heard "Dr. Ronald M. Friedman, Dr. Friedman and also Dr Friedman". So, I my took my already-beautiful fiancé to Dr. Ronald M. Friedman for a little work on some lines that she had been worried about.
The excellent service started as soon as we made the call. Very Professional! Very polite!
The appointment and the explanation of procedures available were delivered with no hard sales, in layman's terms. We felt so comfortable with the decision.
One amazing feature that I appreciate was the extra mile they go with making it virtually painless. They have tools of the trade that the other doctors haven't invested in. The nitrous oxide or laughing gas is a safe and effective sedative agent that is mixed with oxygen and inhaled through a small mask that fits over her cute little nose. This was part of my research. I may not fight off dragons with my sword but I don't want my sweetheart to feel any unnecessary pain. Yep, brownie points big time. ;)
I couldn't be more grateful for Dr. Ronald M. Friedman ,Jin and the staff. Although I'm not the one who had the the procedures, they made me feel comfortable and I had fun too. I cant even explain how amazing she looks!
I do have to mention the detail explanation of recovery was fantastic.

Thanks to Dr. Ronald M. Friedman, The procedure has given My now super-beautiful fiancé ..(not that she wasn't beautiful before :)..has and increased confidence and a bounce in her step that is such joy to be around. I can't recommend  Dr. Ronald M. Friedman enough

First of all, Dr. Friedman and Jin and the team are so professional, but also so personable. Secondly, his knowledge and skillset are beyond comparison. I absolutely highly recommend him to everyone I know without hesitation. He's absolutely brilliant and thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Nichols
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My daughter was born with neuroblastoma, started chemo at 6 weeks along with many surgeries. Throughout the battle to save her life her stomach ended up with a scar causing a large roll on top of it. They used the same location that went across her entire stomach to enter for surgery several times.
After a long battle she was pronounced survivor. Her entire childhood the scar bothered her. Her dad and I promised we would get it fixed if she still wanted to when she turned 18. Well, she turned 19 and still wanted it fixed.
We searched for the best and came across Dr. Friedman. I can not say enough good things about him and all the wonderful ladies that work in his office.
BUT the best part is he went above and beyond to fix My daughters stomach and he Fixed it! We were in tears when we saw it.
Something that has caused many tears in her childhood is now gone. Her stomach looks so pretty now. We can still see the scars of her battle but he made it flat with no bumps or dents.
I would recommend him and personally use him for any plastic surgery needs.
Thank you Dr. Friedman and staff for a wonderful experience!
The Nichols Family

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Choi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Friedman, Nurse Jin, and staff are an amazing group of people.  Their attention to detail, professionalism, and expertise illustrates what it means to go "above and beyond."  Dr. Friedman and Nurse Jin took care (and repaired) my youngest son's foot laceration on short notice when an urgent care was unable to properly close the laceration.  Due to Dr. Friedman and Nurse Jin, my family can rest assured that our son's laceration will heal perfectly.  I would highly recommend Dr. Friedman and his office to any person!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Shipley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a breast augmentation on March 8.  Doctor Friedman was very realistic and clear about what I would be going through, and my results.  I went in for a consultation 3 times - I was only charged for the initial consultation, and he spent quite a bit of his time with me each visit to ensure I was 100% prepared.  Again, he was VERY upfront, realistic and forward with everything.  He didn't leave out details or give me unrealistic expectations just to get my money.

Once you decide to have the procedure, he has you hunt online for pictures of what you want your result to look like.  He doesn't do the "trying on sizers" approach because the size and shape is too different than what the actual result would be.  Instead, he had me pick before/after photos in which the "before" resembled me closely, and the "after" was my desired look.  So far, comparing my results to my pictures, I can say he hit the nail on the head.

I am only 5 weeks post-op, and my results are already AWESOME.  As expected, of course, because his portfolio is the best I've seen in the area.

His assistant, Dana, was awesome too.  I must have emailed a million times with questions, and she was always very prompt and patient with her replies.  I don't remember the names of the rest of his office staff, but I never had an experience that wasn't positive.  Even the anesthesiologist was amazing.

Overall I'd rate Dr. Friedman and his staff as a 10/10.  I will definitely recommend him to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Weber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I did a lot of research online before making an appointment. My case was a little difficult and instead of telling me what I wanted to hear he told me how it really was. He explained why it would be difficult and what we would have to do to get it right. I was so comfortable with that first appt I made my decision fast. I never talked with anyone that wasn't warm and welcoming before or after my surgerys. I will have no hesitation to go to Dr Friedman again if I need anything in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lydia Marsh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found Dr. Friedmans website in a general google search six years ago, before motherhood and breastfeeding and told myself if I ever was going to get them done he was the first person I would travel to go talk to and do a consult with. I've probably shared it with 150 women over the years if they were looking for a surgeon who can give them normal looking augmentations that respect their bodies natural look. Of course after having my son and breastfeeding for two years, one could imagine that my already Tiny 34 A Boobs had now become sadder tinier 36 A Boobs. From my initial phone call and trying to schedule my trip down for the consult, to walking into the office, booking my Breast Augmentation and my Armpit Liposuction, and of course now post 30 days from both I cannot honestly imagine 5 stars is even enough for the true genuine care I received. The entire staff is beyond welcoming, not stuffy or over done themselves. I heard most everything 3-4 good times before my actual surgery happened, the consents were thorough and the post care forms on point. He had called me the next day to check in on me himself as well. I had several general healthy fears before getting it done, all discussed and heard and none of them happened. I woke up to the same size implants I had given him four examples of on different women, and that was honestly one of my big concerns knowing women who had been surprised by much bigger implants than discussed and them having to be fixed later by other surgeons. They healed very well, and are still adjusting into their happy normal spots here. I quit even taking pain meds at the end of day 4 and was back to work following my restricted lifting and post care rules on day 5. Within two weeks the implants felt like a part of me and not a foreign medical object. They feel great and anyone who has seen them in my clothing or without have all been impressed with his work! He is very honest, naturally funny and intelligent and his team is so on point right behind him and what needs to be done and completed. I'd have traveled much longer than 6 hours to get my surgery done with him and happily paid more for it as well. Research your options, when it comes to Cosmetic and Aesthetic items find people who care about discussing risk, discussing realistic outcomes and who promise positive changes and not perfection. If you are considering making changes yourself, definitely give him a call and talk to him! I'll keep sending people his way and hope to get them redone before he retires someday and I have to find somebody else who is as wonderful as him. Thank you guys for helping me feel like myself and for improving but respecting my natural look!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark and Sheila Burkhall
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great experience! I needed my earlobes repaired. From the moment o walked in I was treated with care and respect. Dr Friedman did an excellent job. I am very pleased and highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always hated my double chin. Skinny or fat it’s always remained the same. I couldn’t see anything else in my pictures and it made me so self conscious. I went to Dr. Friedman hoping for some improvement, but did not expect the dramatic difference it made. It wasn’t 100% painless, but his staff was super friendly and he kept us all laughing so it made the process go smoothly. I am so happy with my results! I am no longer hiding from the camera.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recently treated by Dr. Friedman, for what I thought was a simple cut on the hand.  The office modified his schedule, so that I could see him with less than a couple hours of notice.  Unfortunately, the injury had already become infected, and the infection was spreading.  What stands out the most, was not only his assessment and treatment, but also that I received several follow up calls from the office, as well as requests for photos of the injury, to ensure it was healing correctly.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: x Steel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Male - 50yo - Nipple reduction. Best money I've spent in a long time! My nipple-not breast-started to project when I was 13yo.  Needless to say both continued into adulthood.  I tried hiding my long/wide nipples by tape, double pockets on shirts, until I just got tired of trying.  Finding out about this surgery 2 years ago, I also looked in other cities, until I found Dr. Friedman here.  What I liked about him is that he didn't try to find my other flaws---which I like to think I'm perfect, but know better.  He was honest with me about what he could do, since my nipples were not only long but wide.  My nipples looked like I had breast fed! I just wanted a more regular masculine chest.  I decided to have him perform the procedure after looking at the other pics of male nipple reductions (Which he has a lot of pictures in his office--that was important to me.) The procedure took about 40 minutes total, worst part being the needle to deaden, as I was awake for the procedure.  He took approximately 5/8" from EACH side! Yes, I got to see it afterwards---is that a guy thing? Honestly, there was no 'wake up pain' after the numbness went away.  It was like having a large mole removed.  He didn't just lop them off either, which was important too.  I am 3.5 weeks out and  no one would ever know I had it done without my shirt on.  My confidence sky rocketed and feel I now have just a regular looking male chest.  I can also wear anything I want, without thinking about it or feeling self conscious and look forward to the pool this summer.  It's also great now to go without a shirt too!  Dr. Friedman and his staff are terrific.  I also gave them permission to use my pics or myself as a reference. Don't wait, just do it!

user_reviews_extended.Description: After consulting with many surgeons, my search ended with Dr. Freidman. I am thankful I extended my search by one more surgeon. Best decision I've made. Between his gut-busting humor and his staff, there is absolutely no way you could not feel comfortable and at home. Ms. Jin has more care and bedside manor than any nurse I've ever been in contact with. I am 3 weeks post-surgery, to this point and they are still quick to respond to an email or message left for them. I am impressed with every detail of my experience. Dr. Freidman was very direct about what I should expect from the consultation to surgery; at no point was I concerned or confused. The pre-surgery hug is very comforting. The overnight nurse, Ms. Pam, was a delight and thoughtful; maintaining a comfort for me during the first hours post-surgery. Dr. Freidman has provided a confidence I lost during the process of having 2 children. Hands down- best all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horrible breast augmentation experience... Dr Friedman made my pockets way too large and both of my implants would slide into my armpits and sides when I laid on my back. I followed all of my post operative instructions but still had this horrible result. When I voiced my concerns to his office, they became very defensive and basically said "well, you signed a risk waiver and were given options to have larger breasts without surgery - like wearing a padded bra". WHAT?! So, after numerous consultations with other board certified plastic surgeons who agreed that my pockets were made too large, I have spent thousands of dollars since then to have two revisions, first a mastopexy (breast lift) with internal suturing to help hold the implants in place and then a 2nd revision which required mesh to be sewn into my muscle to make my pockets smaller. Finally I have beautiful breasts, no thanks to this guy. Stay away from this doctor!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martina Brehmer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A Life-Changing Surgery
This review is for all of the parents of young men and teenage boys who suffer with gynecomastia. It is very disheartening to see your son whose life should just be starting; slouching around, wearing heavy sweat shirts and numerous layers of clothing, just to hide their bodies. There’s no exercising, swimmming, pool parties, not even to simply be able to wear a t-shirt and jeans. Socializing, especially in high school, is difficult. As a parent, we suffer with our children and search for answers as to how to help them.

Our son is a handsome young man, who had so little self esteem and had been in this situation since the age of fourteen. Having reached puberty, the time to do something about this was now!

During the search for possibilities, surgery was never really considered until visiting Dr. Freidman’s office.
Dr. Friedman and his staff went out of their way to help our son to make his own decision by pairing him with a former patient of a similar age. They spoke with one another privately,  allowing our son to ask sensitive questions. Having also met with Dr. Friedman afterwards, to discuss procedures, the final decision was made to also proceed with the surgery.

Having also suffered from a serious “anesthesia” related allergy,  Dr. Friedman and his team made absolutely sure that our son would be well cared for and the specific and necessary precautions would be taken for success.

Upon removal of the bandages, our son was beaming! Imagine if you will, a teenager dancing in front of a mirror before the doctor walks in....We now have a very happy, confident young man in our midst who will be forever grateful for Dr. Friedman and his staff.

The procedure was virtually painless and 4 days after I can already tell a huge difference. I got my chiseled jawline back and the bulge of fat underneath my chin is totally gone. I am so pleased. I am posting here pix on the day of surgery on the right side and left side is 4 days after. My only regret is that i did not do it sonner. No amount of excercise and dietting helped, but this easy 1h procedure  completely did the trick.

address: 6835 Communications Pkwy Suite 520, Plano, TX 75024, United States

user_reviews.Name: Radwan Ghamrawi
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had upper eyelid surgery, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From the very first consultation, Dr. Kalyam and staff made me feel comfortable, informed, and confident in my decision. The process was smooth, and I felt well cared for every step of the way.

Recovery went better than expected — minimal discomfort and clear instructions that made healing easy. Within a short time, I noticed such a natural yet refreshing difference. My eyes look brighter, more open, and I feel like myself again — just more confident and rejuvenated.

I’m extremely grateful for the professionalism, skill, and attentiveness I received. If anyone is considering eyelid surgery, I highly recommend this clinic. It truly exceeded my expectations!

user_reviews.Name: Beth Taylor
user_reviews.Description: This is the best eye surgeon I found during my research. I now know why she has such high ratings. She is the best, knowledgeable, skillful, kind, and very professional. I had ptosis of both eyes. She knew exactly the fix. The surgery was done at her beautiful clinic’s surgery room. The injections were not pleasant but not too bad. The surgery was painless. She reviewed after care with printed instructions. You won’t be disappointed with Dr Kalyam.

user_reviews.Description: I cannot express enough what a wonderful experience I have had with my eyelid procedure….after years of not seeing my eyelids I now look in the mirror and I’m just in awe at how amazing my eyes look!  Dr. Kalyam is amazing the procedure was simple and the recovery was fast!   I had the eyelid procedure and a “temporal brow lift”…. I’m extremely happy and highly recommend Legacy Eyelids and Cosmetic Surgery!

user_reviews.Description: Dr Priya was awesome! She took the time with me on all of my visit. My journey was great with her and I love my new results. I look so much younger and my bags are gone😃

user_reviews.Name: Josephine
user_reviews.Description: I think a doctor that does not know how to take accountability is dangerous. My eyes looked exactly the same following a ptosis repair she did. She recognized the persistent droop once she walked into the exam room, but somehow tried to convince me minutes later that it had been repaired. Then proceeds to tell me maybe I have myasthenia gravis, which was ruled out before the surgery. She then told me to come back for a blepheroplasty. I’ve seen other occuloplastic surgeons since, who don’t believe I had a ptosis repair because all she did was waste my time, money, put me through the discomfort of surgery to achieve absolutely nothing. She gave me a quote during my consultation, which had increased when the scheduler called a week later to confirm my surgery and increased the next day when I showed up for the surgery!

user_reviews.Name: madison cyiark
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Snider was absolutely amazing throughout my breast reduction and lift experience! From the initial consultation, she made me feel heard, confident, and fully informed. She took the time to explain everything clearly and ensured my goals were understood.

Dr. Snider is extremely adamant about her time, her work, and precision. She is meticulous, detail-oriented, and does not rush the process, which made me feel completely confident in her care. My surgery and recovery went smoothly, and my results are natural, balanced, and better than I ever expected.

This surgery has been life-changing for me, both physically and mentally. I have recommended Dr. Snider to family and many people I know, and several have gone to her and had amazing results as well. I highly recommend her to anyone considering a breast reduction or lift!

user_reviews.Name: Katrice Thompkins
user_reviews.Description:
Dr.Chelsea Snider and team  is truly exceptional. She did my original breast augmentation years ago, and when I was later diagnosed with breast cancer, she stood right beside my oncologist surgeon and performed my reconstructive surgery. That level of continuity, care, and commitment meant everything to me.

Walking through cancer is one of the most vulnerable experiences a woman can face. Dr. Snider was not only skilled and precise, she was compassionate, patient, and reassuring every step of the way. She listened. She explained. She cared. And she restored more than my body, she helped restore my confidence.

Her work is beautiful, but her heart is even more beautiful. If you are looking for a plastic surgeon in Dallas who combines expertise with genuine compassion, I highly recommend Dr. Snider and the team at Vida Bela.

Forever grateful.

user_reviews.Name: Samantha DeMatteo
user_reviews.Description:
I had an incredible experience at Vida Bela Plastic Surgery (Chelsea Snider, MD) in the Plano / Dallas area. From the moment you walk in, the office feels like a luxury spa — it’s high-end, beautiful, and impeccably clean. Truly, it feels more like visiting a Four Seasons than a typical doctor’s office.

Dr. Chelsea Snider is a board-certified plastic surgeon, and she’s exactly who you want when you’re trusting someone with something as precious as your face and body. She has that rare combination of technical skill, impeccable taste, and calm confidence that immediately puts you at ease. She’s a true perfectionist with an amazing aesthetic eye — thoughtful, precise, and incredibly intentional about creating results that look beautiful, natural, and elevated (never overdone). She listened carefully to what I wanted, explained everything in a way that made me feel completely comfortable, and was meticulous throughout. I’m genuinely thrilled with my results — refreshed, natural, and expertly done.

A special shoutout to Paul, who did my multiple laser treatments — he was incredibly knowledgeable, detail-oriented, and made the whole process feel easy and reassuring. The lasers didn’t hurt at all — it was completely painless, and I was relaxed the entire time. Paul is a trove of knowledge, and I’ve honestly never met anyone more passionate about this line of work than him. My results are amazing, and I can’t wait to continue coming back for ongoing laser maintenance.

You can tell this entire team is at the top of their game — which is exactly what you want. What makes Vida Bela stand out is that you get a true trifecta of expertise in one office: each person is genuinely an expert in their lane, and you can elevate your results by thoughtfully combining different modalities with specialists who are all operating at the highest level.

Everyone on staff was so sweet, professional, and welcoming, and their expertise really shows. I would highly recommend Dr. Chelsea Snider to anyone who wants the highest level of care and the best results possible. If you’re looking for a top plastic surgeon in Plano / Dallas and a truly elevated, boutique experience, I can’t recommend Vida Bela Plastic Surgery enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This review reflects my personal and honest experience as a patient of Dr. Chelsea Snider. My intention in sharing is to provide others with information that may help in making informed decisions regarding their care.

I underwent a brachioplasty, torsoplasty, and breast reduction performed by Dr. Snider. The breast reduction was covered by insurance; however, the brachioplasty and torsoplasty were self-pay procedures totaling approximately $14,000.

As a plastic surgeon, I believe that if you offer specific surgeries, you should have full confidence in both your skill and the potential outcomes. Unfortunately, my experience did not reflect this standard.

Three weeks after surgery, despite repeatedly voicing concerns about the level of pain I was experiencing, my symptoms were not taken seriously. I ultimately required emergency care, where I was diagnosed with a rare bacterial infection and hospitalized for five days—resulting in additional expenses and time away from work.

Regarding the brachioplasty, Dr. Snider acknowledged that my results were subpar and agreed to attempt a revision free of charge. However, she expressed uncertainty that it would look normal and stated it might result in a visible “pouch” near my elbow. This was concerning, as in my pre-operative consultation and surgical markings, I was assured that my arm and the “band” of skin would be completely removed.

During our discussion regarding my dissatisfaction, Dr. Snider explained that many surgeons do not offer brachioplasties because patients are often dissatisfied with results—yet she still offers this procedure. She also admitted that she could have removed significantly more skin during my surgery.

Ultimately, I chose to seek correction from another surgeon in the area, which required additional financial investment. Based on my experience, I would strongly advise others to carefully research their surgeons expertise and I personally would not recommend Dr. Chelsea Snider for any surgical procedures.

I was initially nervous, but Paul took the time to talk to me, explained the process in detail, explained the laser technology and what I could expect in the long term. The Vida Bela clinic is immaculate, and the laser technology Paul uses is state-of-the-art. The results are exactly what I hoped for, and this is truly due to the expertise of Paul. user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Snider has been unbelievable throughout the entire process for our 4 year old son Kohen. This past Thursday morning, my MIL went inside to watch my nephew and Kohen while I buckled my niece’s car seat in her car. Just as I was about to finish, I hear my son scream right behind me. He was spinning the wheel on my husband’s bike and decided to stick his finger in. After calling the paramedics and a trip to Medical City Children’s ER, we were given Dr. Snider’s information to follow up with regarding the damage done to his finger.
When I called on Friday, we were told that Dr. Snider wanted to see us on Monday morning. I was concerned about how fast they wanted to see him, but was thankful they were prepared. When we arrived Monday morning, after a quick exam, Dr. Snider confirmed he would need surgery the next day and already had a time reserved at Medical City Children’s. His tendon had been cut and possible nerve damage. I can not describe how much peace I felt with her despite being overwhelmed of the situation. She was so thorough in her explanation of the procedure, answering any questions, informing us of any risks involved and confidence that it should all be fine. I worked with Megan and Lauren to make sure Medical City had all the information they needed. Her team is also very helpful and kind. Tuesday went about as seamless as we could have asked for. Dr. Snider went through the plan again right before Kohen went back and when I met them in recovery, she explained in detail what all she had to do and what recovery and healing would look like. She will definitely be the doctor we call for any future procedures no questions asked!  Considering that this was our first time dealing with a little more traumatic experience, we feel so confident that she was the best choice for our son! Thank you Dr. Snider!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tasha Rose
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Such a great experience working with Londyn as a prospective patient! I'm amazed. I hope this review will do her expertise and 10/10 approach to new patient support some justice.

In cosmetic care, your coordinator is a vital part of the journey, especially in a case like mine.

I survived a brutally abusive cosmetic surgery in Istanbul that left significant damage, pain, scars and rare deformities, some irreparable, and none the ideal to treat!

A few years and some 60+ consultations later, I started to accept the "take it or leave it" vibes that'd come with proposed treatment options, or the refusals to help with questions needed to make informed decisions.

Maybe it was too much for people in bad situations to find a skilled surgeon, AND have their thoughts regarded too?

So, when I called Dr. Snider's office, I decided to make it my last attempt at  connection.

Who knew call no. #61 could be the one!

Not only does Londyn approach case management with humanity, she effectively lifts the burden of uncertainty. In my case, that meant resolving an issue I'd forgotten or maybe didn't realize I had - the need for peace of mind!

Thank you Londyn for creating a safe space for me to be regarded and heard.

Thank you for treating patients like people.

Thank you for being a critical thinker and managing the severity of my case with equal urgency to find solutions.

You helped me release fear to take the next step, which is especially meaningful when that next step is one that has been in progress for years!
