user_reviews_extended.Description:
Atendimento impecável, ambiente acolhedor e resultados incríveis!
Fiquei muito satisfeita com a experiência na clínica, tudo foi feito com muito cuidado, profissionalismo e atenção aos detalhes. Os resultados superaram minhas expectativas, recomendo de olhos fechados para quem busca qualidade e confiança na área da estética!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Excelente atención y servicio!

title: Noble Cosmetic Surgery
address: 6201 K Ave Suite 100, Plano, TX 75074, United States

user_reviews.Name: Sonja James
user_reviews.Description: AMAZING experience from beginning to end!! The staff is AWESOME!! Always courteous, friendly and Dr. Obasi is funny. I was referred to him by my friend because I was miserable, needed relief from the situation I was dealing with and very frustrated after seeing 2 other surgeons. One visit at Noble Cosmetic Surgery changed my life. I’m so grateful and looking forward to my next procedure. I look and feel more beautiful than ever before!! Thank you Dr. Obasi and Noble Cosmetic Surgery!!

user_reviews.Name: Racquel Miller
user_reviews.Description:
I had surgery with Dr. Obasi recently and my experience—from consultation to pre-op to post-op—was good. The facility was organized, clean, and welcoming, and every staff member I encountered was kind, professional, and supportive.

Dr. Obasi has great bedside manners and made me feel completely comfortable throughout the entire process. During recovery I experienced a few challenges, and Dr. O, along with his entire team, made sure I was fully supported every step of the way. He even completed a revision to ensure I was completely satisfied with my results.

I would absolutely recommend Dr. Obasi and his team to anyone considering surgery. Their care, professionalism, and attention to detail truly made my experience great.

user_reviews.Name: Noble Med Clinic
user_reviews.Description: I met with Dr. Obasi for consultation and possible surgery.  He was very  attentive. He explained  to me in basic English,  to my  understanding, not filling my head with medical jargon. He told me what  my options are.  I took a little tour, and the environment is so neat, with friendly and  knowledgeable staff.  I  went ahead and booked my surgery. Thank God they have finance options . I recommend Noble Cosmetic Surgery. I see other reviews here,  some very good,  some not. I'll say this,  the first step to good recovery is being honest with your Doc. Try not to hold anything back. We help them to help us. I'm looking forward to my  journey . 🫂

user_reviews.Name: letisia contreras
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had surgery with Doctor Obasi, and the entire experience was truly amazing.

What started as a simple Groupon visit quickly turned into a full on procedure. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel so welcomed and comfortable—it felt like I was with people who genuinely cared.

Nosha was the biggest reason I moved forward. She is incredibly kind, patient, and genuine. I never once felt pressured. On the day of my procedure, I was very nervous, but she took the time to calm me, reassure me, and stayed by my side the entire time—just like she promised.

The facility is clean, organized, and professional. I’m beyond grateful for the care and support I received. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone considering this journey.

user_reviews.Name: Jonette Cobb
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Obasi took the time to come and meet me, although my appointment was with Anosha. Both were very informative when explaining various treatments and my appointment was not rushed, which I appreciated. Anosha took her time and I am definitely pleased with my results. I traveled from Arkansas for my appointment and will continue to do so. The front office staff is great. They are a ray of sunshine as you enter the doors. I highly recommend Noble Cosmetic Surgery.

user_reviews.Name: MB V
user_reviews.Description: I had the most EXCEPTIONAL experience at Noble Cosmetic Surgery with Dr. Obasi (board certified surgeon) and his staff.   Dr. Obasi was beyond attentive while displaying professionalism towards my needs.  He is very knowledgeable and thorough when explaining the process, especially since I was a little nervous about liposuction.  I absolutely love my results! He did such an amazing job and I was able to bounce back to work in less than a week.  Need I mention his state of art facility!              If I could give this place 10 stars I would. A big thank you as well to Brenda, Mikayla & Andrea (at the front desk) who always answered all my additional questions with a smile. If you are hesitate about surgery in general (like me at first lol) at least go for a consultation and experience it for yourself, it's definitely worth it!

user_reviews.Name: Nuna Coleman
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Obasi is, without a doubt, the doctor you want performing your surgery. His level of patient care and personal attention is unmatched. I’ve had procedures before, but never have I had a surgeon personally check in on me and provide his direct cell number to ensure I was comfortable and healing well. That level of dedication and accessibility is truly rare.

From the moment you walk into Noble Cosmetic Surgery, you can feel the warmth and professionalism. Every member of the staff is friendly, kind, and always smiling. The team works seamlessly together, and the positive energy in the building is infectious. The BOSS LADYY 😃 (she knows who she is!) is absolutely fabulous and keeps everything running beautifully.

After extensive research, I chose Dr. Obasi for my tummy tuck and liposuction — and I could not be happier. He gave me the exact results I had dreamed of for years. The outcome exceeded my expectations, and I am beyond grateful to him and his incredible team for making my dream body a reality.

Thank you, Dr. Obasi and team, for your outstanding care, compassion, and excellence. If I ever decide to have another procedure, there is no question — I’ll be coming right back to Noble Cosmetic Surgery!

user_reviews.Name: Whitney Dreger
user_reviews.Description: I just had my surgery done yesterday with Dr. Obasi! While I won’t know my results completely until swelling goes down, I wanted to leave a review just to comment on how amazing the staff is. I had some pain/discomfort during the surgery (local, some areas may just not have been completely numb yet) and the empathy and support I received from Dr. Obasi and his staff really made the difference. I also have never had the surgeon call me themselves to check on me post-op, usually only nurses. So it was very pleasant that he took the time to reach out. I’d recommend this clinic to anyone. I have friends that plan on making a consultation in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: mrsd2005
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Obasi is a talented and gifted surgeon. His office staff exude professionalism and are always so helpful. user_reviews_extended.Description:

I’m not sure if the lipo I got was technically chin lipo. It was chin and neck lipo - the entire jawline is hit making it even more of a value. This means there were three incisions: both sides of the top of the jaw by the ear and one under the chin.

I’m a baby and handled the local anesthesia. It felt like going to the dentist and getting lidocaine when the tumescent solution was injected. Keep in mind, I was high when this happened as I had PRESCRIPTIONS - all monitored by the doctor. I’m assuming this is the more cost effective form of sedation. In this economy, ya gotta do what ya gotta do.

I’ve had Kybella before (what a waste) at a separate medspa and I think the burning of that was way worse than the few seconds of injection pain required for local anesthesia. Once the procedure was started by Dr. Obasi, the entire procedure took less than five minutes. Again, the bulk of the time required is from waiting for your meds to kick in and then waiting again for your local anesthesia to kick in. I think general anesthesia is a bit riskier given the procedure is only five minutes…

Results: Even with swelling and bruising, my jawline is now certified snatched. No more double chin. The price I paid was in line with the price I would have paid in Turkey, so it was definitely worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mz Mckeiver
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a wonderful experience in November 2023 when I visited Dr. Obasi's office to inquire about an abdominoplasty (tummy tuck). This was not an average procedure for me as I had seven large (quarter-sized) painful keloids on my abdomen from a vertical C-section I had received 10 years earlier. After conducting my own research and consulting with three doctors, none of whom had experience with this type of procedure, I was relieved to find Dr. Obasi. He had the necessary experience to address my unique problem. After examining my stomach, Dr. Obasi explained exactly what needed to be done during and after the procedure. I had my surgery in December 2023, which was successful, and more than I could have imagined.  As a person with prior keloid scarring, during and after my surgery, I received three rounds of corticosteroids, which significantly reduced my incision scarring and left me with a feeling of pure joy.

I am immensely grateful to Drs. Obasi and Olumba for their guidance, expertise, and care. I also want to express my appreciation for their exceptional staff. Dana, NP, deserves special commendation for her knowledge and unwavering patience. She played a crucial role in addressing my questions during my surgery and follow-up appointments. The office team consistently responded to my inquiries promptly, scheduled convenient appointments, and welcomed me with a smile, providing excellent customer service.

I am thankful to have met all these skilled professionals, who not only deliver the desired results but also care about the overall well-being of their patients. If you are looking for the best, I highly recommend NOBLE COSMETICS.

2 months post-op 360 abdominal liposuction, liposuction of inner arms, upper inner thigh, and pubic triangle. Also BBL.

Dr Olumba personally coordinated my post-op care from pain management, fitting me into the correct faja suit, arranging my lymphatic drainage message, plus the continued follow up calls.

The pain is completely gone. I look amazing, goodbye to spanx, hello to leggings. My transformation started at size 12- 14 and I am down to 6-8.

Off course no transformation process is complete without adequate sleep, nutritional support, and exercise. I consider Dr Olumba to be a life coach. She provided the total package to me.

I couldn’t have trusted a better team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashea Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: I trust Dr.Obasi and Dana NP completely. I had been to 3 OBs and 1 other plastic surgeon as I was concerned about my belly not shrinking back down after my second pregnancy. The OBs told me, “oh this is something that just happens sometimes” and the other plastic surgeon I saw said “wow, yes your belly is huge, the before and after pictures are going to be amazing!”. I felt as if I was not really listened to and since I was not in any pain, I didn’t need to be treated/evaluated. I made a consultation appt with Dr. Obasi and within 30 sec of him seeing my abdomen, I could see the concern on his face immediately and he asked me how long I had been walking around/living like I had. It had been over a year since my delivery and he said that I had an umbilical hernia when I was just thinking I needed a tummy tuck. With care and concern, he explained to me the procedure, gave clear and transparent pricing, and recovery process. I finally felt seen and heard and taken care of. I had never had any kind of surgery and trusting Dr. Obasi for a major abdominal surgery was 100% the right path. The day of surgery, I was nervous but everything went really well! He came out afterward to talk to my husband and parents to show them how big my hernia was and reassured them that everything went smoothly. He gave his number to my husband and said to call for any questions or concerns for when I got home. We did end up contacting him a couple times and he got back to us quickly despite it being the weekend. I am now 3 weeks post surgery and LOVE my results. I feel like a new person and have my life back. I can’t thank Dr.Obasi, Dana, and the rest of the staff enough for the quality care that they showed me. If you have any hesitancy or are on the fence, go to Noble Cosmetics with Dr. Obasi!

How could almost symmetrical breasts be so different after what should have been a simple breast augmentation? Its bc a different surgeon worked on each of my breasts. While Dr. Obasi worked on my right breast, Dr. Arumala/ Olumba was working on my left breast. I'm not expecting the details of my surgery to be discussed in a response to my Google review. I have contacted Dr. Obasi directly and expressed my concerns multiple times & he flat out ignored me. user_reviews_extended.Name: robyn duncan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My name is Robyn.  I have had several surgeries with Dr. Obasi.  He has been very good to me.  He’s even picked up the phone personally and answered my questions.  He also texts from his cell phone to check on me and ask if I need anything or have questions.  His staff is very efficient and friendly.  Both Dr. Obasi and staff have a calming demeanor when going into surgery which helps so much when you are afraid of going under and having surgery.

I had Liposuction on my abdomen and lower back and I’m very happy with the results.  My stomach is completely flat after so many years and I can now where wear anything I want and don’t have the embarrassment I had before.

When I went for my follow up appt and after seeing all the weight in my abdomen gone, Dr.Obasi saw an ambilical hernia.  He repaired my hernia.  I went to see a specialist for Lymphatic Massage to help with swelling and possible scar tissue.  I went to a person I know who had been practicing that for 25 years.  She looked at my incision and said Dr. Obasi did an excellent job and was very impressed with his work.  They have never met.  It healed up nicely and my huge outtie naval is now a normal looking innie.  You can barely see the scar - only up close when you are looking for it.

I did have one area of scar tissue build up right above my naval and Dr. Obasi said he would repair that and only charge me the anesthesia.  I looked it up and read many places that it’s not that uncommon for your body to reject surgery.  My surgery was properly done and I am very happy with the results.

When Dr. Obasi opened me up to remove the scar tissue, he found another hernia called a ventral hernia.  He repaired that on a Saturday on the spot which made me very happy.  When I woke up he told me I had another hernia and repaired it.  He didn’t ask for the money.  I looked it up and I saw prices that averaged around $5000.

Overall, Dr. Obasi and his team gets 5 stars easily.  I am so happy with all my surgeries.  I am healing up well with that last surgery and had little to no pain.  It was a pleasure working with him and his staff.  I will be calling him again for my next cosmetic adventure!  :)

Thank you Noble Cosmetics!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let me start off by saying that I went to 3 different plastic surgeons before I came across Dr. Obasi’s website. Each office I went to previously had stuck up office staff, rude bedside manner, I felt rushed when I was asking questions, and no previous plastic surgeon was even slightly reasonable with their pricing.
From the moment I called Dr. Obasi’s office, I just had a gut feeling that this was “the one”. However, when I walked in for my initial consultation.... I knew my feeling was spot on. I was instantly greeted by the kindest medical office staff that I've ever experienced. These ladies are not just “coming to work”, they truly CARE about the patients, never want you to leave without having any and all questions answered, and the warmth & passion they show for helping others just left me speechless. I loved actually seeing a staff of medical ladies laughing, smiling, and they just blew me away with how sweet they were. Keep in mind this was all before I had even MET with Dr. Obasi, and I was already sold just from walking in. During my consult with Dr. Obasi, I just got so emotional because he is so kind, and the way he related to every insecurity I had truly made me feel validated for coming in. The story about how Dr. Obasi got to where he is today was so inspiring, and knowing he truly understood what was upsetting me about my body made the visit 1000% worth it. Four years ago, I had my daughter. I love to workout but cannot get rid of the belly pooch from when I gave birth and it’s such an insecurity of mine. My consultation was for lipo, but Dr. Obasi gave me his recommendation to add flanks as well to the abdomen procedure, and I’m SO thankful I listened to every bit of advice he gave me because I can already see how amazing my results are going to be. I think sometimes we “think” we know what’s best for our bodies, but I’m telling you.. if you just listen to Dr. Obasi you will NOT be disappointed.  This man had me in tears because he was so wonderful, he understood that I was a single mother and could drop 7 grand on a procedure, and he was extremely transparent and upfront which I appreciated. He’s also the only plastic surgeon I’ve ever met with who clearly doesn’t care about just getting your money and never following up with you in the future. Dr. Obasi wants to change the lives of his patients, and truly help each patient to love their body. This man is so kind, he is insanely brilliant, skilled beyond words, and there is NO ONE i would ever trust to touch my body but Dr. Obasi. I also loved that when I left, the staff kept checking up on me and even Dr. Obasi called to make sure I was okay just hours later. He will forever be my  go to for any future procedures. Dr. Obasi’s story is incredible, the way he treats his staff just melted my heart, and I feel like Noble Cosmetic Surgery isn’t just an office... but more of a loving family type atmosphere. Also, a huge shout out to Andrea. She was such a godsend when I would get tearful or explain to her what I hated about my body, and why I was so unhappy and she just listened and reassured me that I was in the right place. I’m only on day two post surgery, but I truly cannot day enough positive things about the character, integrity, and passion that Dr. Obasi and Noble Cosmetic Surgery has for changing patients lives. I love this office so much, and I thank god every single day that I trusted my instincts. Thank you so much Dr. Obasi, Andrea, and to the greatest office staff that I’ve ever met! You truly are a shining example to the medical and cosmetic surgery world of what a procedure experience should be like from beginning to end. Love you guys so much for everything!

Jordan

Needless to say that’s not what happened. He only went in my right breast suctioned a little out and that’s it. My left breast was suctioned out on a surgery day prior. It was a rushed procedure both times. The entire experience from beginning to end has had me on an emotional rollercoaster.

The response from Noble cosmetics is just flat out false and disgusting. I brought up all of my concerns that were very realistic! Dr. Obasi just could not deliver. End of story! It was realistic when I put all that money down to lock in my date. Dr. O was all smiles then. Now that he gave me the worse experience of my life the response is I had unrealistic ideas of what I wanted. Laughs a little. Ladies and gents just please look into all of your options before taking the cheaper route. I most certainly regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could leave ZERO stars I would. Dr. Hillary performed surgery on me three months ago, the procedures involving blepharoplasty, tummy tuck, and liposuction of the underarm and back areas. The results were unsatisfactory, and the doctor proved to be unskilled at suturing and with her incisions. The incision above each of my eyes are large, dark and look like a botched job. At both the beginning and midpoint of the incisions on both the right and left eyes, there is a small lump—resembling a tiny ball—that severely disfigured the appearance of my eyes that was not there before the surgery. I had specifically requested that the doctor lift my right eye higher than my left, as it was more affected by the natural signs of aging, which she did not do. The surgical outcome is poor, and my right eye remains drooping downward even more than before my surgery. As for the left eye, the incision is terrible, and the round, bubble-like protrusion embedded within the incision itself is very noticeable. She stated to wait 3 months to wait for this to disappear but it has not. It’s only gotten worse. The results of this surgery have been deeply distressing for me.

As for the tummy tuck, the incision became severely inflamed after my surgery and it now has a jagged, zigzag appearance. The liposuction performed on my back and underarms did little to nothing and it looks as though no fat was removed from those areas at all, despite the fact that I wore my compression garment continuously. I do not recommend that anyone undergo surgery with Dr Hillary, as she’s overpriced and the results of her procedures are poor for the price you pay. You would simply end up losing both your money and your health.

user_reviews.Name: Melanie Monroe
user_reviews.Description:
I would like to start this review by stating that I have a disfigured result from rhinoplasty revision surgery February 2022 with Dr. Colin Pero. I am just writing my review in 2025 because I was still under his care, post-surgery visits until March 2025 when I stopped because my nose was not improving it was looking worse. Dr. Pero said rhinoplasty revisions take longer to heal so I trusted him. I was getting steroid shots administered; the last steroid shot was in March 2025. In my opinion, I was given steroid shots to appease me. Dr. Pero did not take pictures to track progress during my office visits while administering steroid shots. I was never told that I could have a negative outcome from the rhinoplasty revision during any office visit or before surgery. I have a disfigured, curved nose, and loss of upper lip muscle. The surgery was a revision of his own work, rhinoplasty in 1998. The revision was supposed to only correct the tip area because it did not hold its shape. I was referred to Dr. Pero for deviated nasal septum surgery not rhinoplasty.
I have had consultations with top plastic surgeons in Dallas and Beverly Hills, and they do not want to touch my nose. I appreciate their honesty and transparency during the consultations. I was glad to receive confirmation that my radixx (bridge) area was changed during Dr. Pero's rhinoplasty revision that altered my appearance.
I do not know what my next steps are on this journey; however, I plan to share my journey publicly on my social media platforms where I can say and show more. I'm not alone, I saw a review, posted 10 months ago on Yelp stating "The rhinoplasty was also a complete failure. He made my nose huge, crooked, and deformed."

user_reviews.Name: Christy Mack
user_reviews.Description:
Today I had an amazing experience during my first visit with Dr. Lam. He was genuinely engaged with my concerns, medical history, and overall journey with Bell’s Palsy. Dr. Lam took the time to explain each step of the process in detail and provided a thorough understanding of the procedure, which made me feel confident and well-informed.

His medical assistant, Ruby, was phenomenal, patient, reassuring, and equally informative throughout the visit. Her calm and attentive approach truly enhanced the experience.

I am very satisfied with my first round of injections and feel optimistic moving forward under their care. I highly recommend Dr. Lam and his team for their professionalism, compassion, and exceptional patient care.

user_reviews.Name: A W
user_reviews.Description:
My experience at Dr Lam was mind blowing! I barely was able to walk in due to some unexpected issues regarding my back, which I had never experienced. I was going to have a fusion,  but my friend took me to Dr Lam! Dr Lam gave me my 1st treatment and I walked out of there like I had no issues 30 mins prior to walking in. I am so grateful 🙏🏾 for Dr Lam and God giving he the knowledge to treatment situation like mine.  His staff is amazing.  Thank you Judy for all your help today with my 2nd treatment! Keep up the good work! You guys are making History!

Thank you again Dr Lam for your services!

user_reviews.Name: Camille Gray
user_reviews.Description:
I’m so thankful for this extraordinary human being, savant, academic teacher, and compassionate caregiver. I met Dr. Lam 18 years ago , and found him exquisitely curious, with the desire to improve the lives of his patients, and his brutally honest approach —to find individual solutions tailored to each person  .

Dr. Lam has no equal.

I reached out to seek cosmetic support,  after losing my husband and son. Dr. Lam gently  advised me to fix the grief that stymied my life, and shared his breakthrough treatment for  traumatic loss, rape, kidnapping , anxiety, grief, depression. He’s helped many people all over the country.

I immediately drove 7 hours for his next available appointment.

The treatment consists of multi injections similar to acupuncture—( he cautioned it hurts- for me, it did not).

Immediately, I felt untangled  with a profound sense of relief and peace.

I’m looking forward to a new start, the ability to move forward, with the support of a physician who truly cares about the people he treats.

As a scientist, a psychological researcher, I seek the truth, based on my faith —and an open mind to possibilities unexplored.

One final word, don’t  give up, there is hope with this brilliant physician.

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Lam performed a lip reduction on me and he was quick and efficient. The whole process from start to finish was pleasant and all of the staff was excellent, especially Ruby! I will definitely be returning for any future procedures.

Dr. Lam moves fast, is blunt (which I love, great objective eye), and most importantly he’s an expert. 10/10 will trust with my face’s future.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently visited Dr. Sam Lam's office for a MiraDry procedure. While I'm very happy with the results so far and found Dr. Lam and the nurses to be professional, and reassuring throughout the appointment, my experience with the front desk coordinator was disappointing.
When I first called to schedule, the front desk staff was rude and made me feel unwelcome but I really wanted the procedure so I looked past it. I get to the appointment and they realized I was never sent the necessary patient forms or any pre-procedure instructions, so I walked into my appointment completely unprepared—which was stressful and could have been avoided with better communication.
Thankfully, the medical team made up for the poor administrative experience. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel comfortable. Despite the rocky start, I'm really pleased with the outcome and appreciate the care provided by Dr. Lam and team.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can't say enough great things about my experience with Lam Facial Plastics on my hair regrowth journey. After struggling with hair thinning for years, I finally found the right place—and the right people—to help me get real results.

A huge shoutout to Susane Andrade, the incredible hair technician who guided me through every step of the process. She was knowledgeable, supportive, and truly cared about my progress. Thanks to her expertise and encouragement, I began seeing noticeable improvement within just 3 months—and best of all, there were no side effects.

The entire team at Lam Facial Plastics is professional, welcoming, and committed to excellence. If you’re looking for a trusted clinic to help with hair regrowth, I highly recommend them. This experience has truly boosted my confidence, and I’m so grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C. M.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had been going to Dr. Lam for masseter Botox injections for many years, mainly because he seemed experienced and I didn’t know where else to go. I’ve finally found a better option and won’t be going back. While the staff is always pleasant and friendly, every visit involved sitting through long promotional pitches from Dr. Lam about various other Botox treatments—some of which, like using Botox for depression and PTSD, don’t seem to have strong evidence behind them. It often felt more like a sales presentation than a medical appointment, and I dreaded going back for touch-ups because of it.

Another issue I found strange is that his staff refuses to tell you how many units of Botox you’re getting. Unlike other providers who are transparent and charge per unit, he charges a flat $850—but you have no idea how much product you’re actually receiving. That lack of transparency never sat well with me. On top of that, I often ended up with facial asymmetry after treatment. Even then, the idea of returning for corrections felt like a chore because of the constant upselling. I’ve since found an excellent physician in Fort Worth who charges $500 for the same treatment, is transparent about dosing, and delivers consistently great results—without the sales pressure. I’m much happier now and only wish I had made the switch sooner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucas Yeh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam and his entire team is beyond amazing. Respectful, honest, and clear. Operations go efficiently and smoothly with minimal discomfort. Additionally, the building’s newly furnished feel and Dr. Lam’s own artworks adds to the comfort and hospitality. Don’t miss out on the good snacks and drinks too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Carey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is SO incredibly knowledgeable and trustworthy. I cannot recommend him enough to everyone. He is an AMAZING surgeon!!! I had two moles on my face surgically removed by Dr. Lam, one on my left cheek and on the middle of my nose. I felt very insecure and was bullied for it when I was growing up. I came into his office really nervous and honestly fearful of what he might say, and I left feeling confident and knew I had made the right choice picking him for my procedure. He uses Botox on your scar post-surgery (as it is healing) to minimize scar visibility afterwards. This does hurt because obviously poking scar tissue is going to be painful, but it was SO WORTH IT. When I say you can BARELY TELL that I had surgery on my face, it is INCREDIBLE. I used to always feel like I had to wear tons and tons of makeup to try and cover them up all of the time since I was bullied for it, and now I don't even wear makeup anymore half of the time. He has given me confidence again, self-worth, and he truly takes the time to make sure you look your absolute best post-surgery. I used the silicone cream and the patches on my face while it was healing. Definitely important to follow his post-surgery guidelines. I stayed out of the sun to make sure that my scars did not sun burn and made sure to wear a hat when I was outside. I wore the cream at night, and the silicone patches during the day on my face. I literally wore them to work and all around, because I knew that they helped in the end. I have to say that this man TRULY changed my happiness, and I will forever be in awe of not only the incredible surgeon that he is, but how he truly cares about his patients, he's honest, and he really knows what he is talking about. He is not going to lie to you, and he will tell you exactly how it is. If you are thinking about who would be the best fit for your surgical needs but you aren't sure who to choose, you should definitely pick Dr. Lam, as you will be in great hands.

He gave me his honest opinion and educated me more than I thought I knew. It was like talking to Dr. Rejani. He's 100% top of his field. I will come back only to him for any procedures, no more med spas. BTW, his staff and assistant nurse Ruby are very comforting and super sweet!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I underwent two Follicular Unit Transplantation (FUT) hair transplants with Dr. Lam, one in 2008 and another in 2023.

The technician in 2008 was highly experienced and did an excellent job.

However, the 2023 procedure was handled by a different technician, and the experience was vastly different.

The procedure was INEFFECTIVE, the post-procedure care was POOR, and the overall process was disorganized.

I paid more than $14,000 for the 2023 procedure, but I could have achieved far better results with significantly less discomfort at other centers.

Unfortunately, I can no longer recommend Dr. Lam and would strongly advise others to consider alternative options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tifani Pototschnik
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been seeing Dr. Lam and his staff for a couple of years now for hair loss and wow, what an improvement! Not only am I seeing hair growth, but the health of my hair has greatly improved. Nancy is amazing to deal with and is only an email away with any questions or concerns. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Akuoma Omeoga
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I received a 3,000-graft hair transplant in August 2021. I’ve waited over two years for my results to ensure I give an accurate and fair assessment of my experience.

The surgical procedure was exceptional. From the moment I arrived, the staff made sure I was comfortable and at ease. True to their word, I didn't feel a thing during the surgery. The coordination and nursing staff were incredibly attentive and made sure everything ran smoothly. I couldn't have asked for a better experience in that regard.

While I received some growth, I am not 100% satisfied with the results. When I raised my concerns with the surgeon, I was given unsatisfactory solutions, which was disappointing considering the amount of money spent on the hair transplant.

I was advised to try topical hair growth treatments, which was disheartening because I could have tried that option before opting for surgery, and I wanted a more permanent solution. The facility doesn't offer a satisfaction guarantee to its clients. The only option I was given was a "discounted" rate and hope for a better outcome the second time around.  I was aware of the possibility of a second transplant to attain a denser hair coverage. However, I had hoped that the initial 3000 grafts would suffice and that I wouldn't need additional surgery.

Dr. Lam has a confident and convincing demeanor. He moves very quickly, making interacting with him tough - it was sometimes frustrating. During my consultation, he said, "I go big or go home," and mentioned that I would be absolutely satisfied with the number of grafts I was getting; which, in comparison to other consultations I had, was double the amount. While that could have been a red flag, the number matched what one other very experienced surgeon said. I figured since they were both experienced with Afro hair, it was the right thing. One thing that you should consider is that some people are better salesmen than they are surgeons.
With 3000 grafts, I still have bald patches in my hairline. The technician said they couldn't pack too much hair in one spot, or it wouldn't grow. I feel that should have been explained during the consultation. Perhaps fewer grafts would have been better, or my hair may have required different post-op instructions.

While my results were not everything I wanted, the staff fulfilled their responsibilities. I am grateful for the effort put into helping me achieve some new hair growth. Dr. Lam did an excellent job on my incision; the scar is barely detectable. However, I believe that there is room for improvement; especially in addressing the concerns of dissatisfied customers and taking appropriate actions to resolve them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Scarrell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a FUT hair transplant done by Dr. Lam about 1 year ago. The results were excellent, but I should mention that this was actually my second hair transplant, and that Dr. Lam was touching up the disappointing work done by a different (well-known in the area) hair transplant office.

You should definitely schedule a consultation ASAP because it can take months before he will be able to see you, and then potentially months longer before the actual operation takes place, and then of course there is a lengthy time you need to wait (about a year) before you actually see results.

The procedure itself was entirely painless and felt like it was over in an instant. They didn't use anesthesia or put me under, so I am shocked that I fell asleep so quickly and was out cold for the entire operation. At the other place I had gone to for my first hair transplant, I was awake and highly uncomfortable the entire time, and they had stretched out the surgery to take place over 2 days. So I can say from experience that having this procedure done by Dr. Lam was definitely as easy and painless as it gets. Dr. Lam's price was also slightly lower than the place I had first gone to.

Healing and results can be slow, but that's just how it is. After 1 year, I was really happy with the results. The top of my head does randomly get pretty itchy sometimes, but I couldn't say for sure whether this is simply my natural body being itchy normally, or a side-effect of the transplant.

The staff were very helpful and informative as well.

On a final note, I am a transgender woman and Dr. Lam was entirely sensitive and courteous towards me - not all of his staff always were, but he was quick to correct anyone if they misgendered me, which I thought was very kind of him. I was also impressed that he was thoroughly knowledgeable about working with transgender patients. At the first transplant office I went to, they had never worked with any women before, at all - which should have been a huge red flag for me, but hey I was ignorant and naïve at the time. Dr. Lam is definitely the person you want to go to, whether you're a man or woman.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Simental

user_reviews_extended.Description: What I love about Dr. Lam Facial Plastics starts with how warm and caring the message is on the website when you first visit... that we are all a unique canvas and treated and cared for in exactly that unique way. user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisa Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam and his staff are fantastic! His thorough and caring approach make me feel comfortable with every visit. I had lived for years being self conscious and had insecurities... Dr. Lam’s procedures and recommendations have now given me confidence that I never had before. Dr. Lam is not only brilliant medically, he is an artist aesthetically and you can see this in the before and after pictures of his many patients. I highly recommends Dr. Lam for any and all facial procedures!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Singca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lam is the absolute best! He is conservative but has an eye for beauty and will help you get the results you desire. I have noticed that my treatments like Botox last longer and have better results that I’ve experienced in other clinics. When my daughter had some unexpected tissue form after her rhinoplasty (which was caused by her body, not a results of anything Dr. Lam did) he addressed the situation and had been treating her regularly to try and correct it. I trust him fully and would not hesitate to recommend him. All of the staff is great as well, they are friendly, efficient, and very professional...especially Joy! She is very knowledgeable, always pleasant, and fun to chat with while waiting for any procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Sills
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommend.  What I like most about Dr Lam is his conservative approach. He genuinely wants to make you look your best.  I am a 44 year old women that is receiving Botox treatment. I have very deep lines at the brow and corners of my eyes.  The results have been amazing. The staff is awesome, always kind and friendly. Dr Lam himself exceeds expectations each visit.  I have had Botox treatments previously by other physicians and Dr Lam does the procedure like no other. My previous treatments by other physicians were pretty basic leaving me with odd looking eye brows due to area of injection.  Dr Lam actually discusses his goal before injection then has a two week follow up to make sure that the injections meet his expectations.  What I like most is 1 the procedure is relatively painless performed by Dr Lam, I love the follow up and free correction if he feels it to be necessary with a double bonus that Dr Lam actually listens to your concerns and provides positive constructive feed back to help you achieve your goals.
2024 follow up. 5 years later and I am still using Dr Lam for my Botox Treatment. I am also now receiving fillers and had three moles removed.  Still very happy with my results.  I will be 50 in a few months and am still being guessed at 42-44 years of age.  Many referrals to Dr Lam and he has made my friends look amazing.  You will not be disappointed by his work!

Update: 2025 still a loyal patient. Have had a few moles removed which healed perfectly.  Adding fillers in with my Botox which look nice and natural.  Very happy with the consistency of service provided.  I enjoy the medical assistance but have been helped by Vivian the last few times.  She is awesome.  I recommend Dr Lam to everyone that will listen to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time getting filler around my eyes temples and cheeks. Dr Lam was thorough and explained everything which made me extremely comfortable. He is an expert when it comes to your face! His experience with faces and his artistic skills show in his work. I have worked with many injectors and Dr Lam is by fat the best. Overall he will save you money on not using products where they are not needed. His staff were all very professional and awesome as well. I will definitely be back again and again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Lin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The entire experience from first walking into the clinic to all follow ups are simply amazing! Dr. Lam is both professional, sophisticated, very knowledgeable and easygoing! He makes everything easy to understand. His team is just a reflection of him! They are caring, fun yet very professional. They always make sure you are on their priority list.
The clinic is clean and calming. Very nicely decorated! Makes you peaceful and relaxing!
Thinking about them makes me happy:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Verena
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had an amazing experience (I’m 1 week otoplasty post-op) from the consultation to follow up appointments. The staff here are phenomenal and very sweet and Dr. Lam is an exceptional surgeon. My results are better than I had expected since he really aims for the natural look. Everything was explained pretty clearly and thoroughly and it was overall a smooth process. So happy I chose this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Banana Hat
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a lip reduction a week ago and I am starting to see my results and I'm definitely very pleased! Also, shout out to Sierra, the medical assistant who was there to help Dr. Lam on my procedure. She did an amazing job at calming down my nerves and making me feel at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: E Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Lam who is an excellent physician with a passion for medicine and a caring manner.  Amazing results. One-on-one attention. Efficient, friendly staff.  He was educated at Princeton, Baylor, and Columbia and is board-certified in a number of specialties. Dr. Lam listens to concerns and cares about his patients. I really appreciated written pre-op and post-op instructions, cleanliness, and an attention to details.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lexi Murzea
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have driven from San Antonio to Plano to see Dr. Lam 4 times to treat acne scarring. I am very pleased with my results and will continue to be a patient for a long time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Kritzer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Lam has been my doctor for over 8+ years and every visit has been am amazing experience by both Dr. Lam and his very personable staff. I first went to Dr. Lam in my 50's due to annoying forehead wrinkles. he explained the many options that I had and I chose to stay with the botox injections which I still have done every 6 to 9 months,. He is meticulous in his work and knows exactly where the injection sites need to be.

I am also  a professional and I have seen my patients from other doctors that have done a very poor job of injections especially around the eyes that causes a massive upper lid droop or one eye does not completely close.

I would recommend Dr. Lam and his staff to anyone seeking to feel more confident in their appearance and work environment with the latest technology available.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Property Investment Corp
user_reviews_extended.Description: The worst experience of my life! No exaggeration. This man this man left a medical sponge in my face for 17 years. It was just removed in 2020. I have cognitive issues, cellulitis of the brain over the years, abscesses on my brain, that I'm due for another MRI this Thursday. Please run away if you care about your health for your future health?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maribel Terrazas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for my 1st filler experience with Dr Lam and I am so happy I waited to find the right Dr to touch my face. I did extensive research and had a few consultations prior with other Nurse injectors and doctors and I felt most confident with Dr Lam that he would not overfill me or sell me on more than I needed. I’m so happy with my tear trough results. I feel as if he made me look like myself from my 20’s.  Before , I had the hollowness around my eyes. He and his office staff are kind, professional and all have great personalities. Please do yourself a favor and not save a couple of dollars on an injector that does not have the same quality of work and experience as Dr Lam. Trust a plastic surgeon over nurses that work at spas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Massey
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Dr. Lam's office and I have to say I was incredibly impressed.  Dr. Lam is a true artist not only in his work but literally in the art hanging on the walls all created by Dr. Lam.  His staff was wonderful and friendly from the first phone call and even more personable during my appointment.  I had a consult regarding silicon lip enhancement and Dr. Lam sat with me personally took his time in explaining the procedure and his suggestions. He then took me back and started with my bottom lip. He gave me a dental block and I felt nothing.  He also took care of some issues from a previous silicone injection and when I went to pay he hadn't charged me. I asked his staff to double check this which they did and there was no charge which I was not expecting.  I've had two rounds of silicon injections with another surgeon with minimal results and in my first visit with Dr. Lam I could see an instant result and am very pleased. I highly recommend Dr. Lam!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mila M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love working with Dr. Lam and Nancy. The office staff is also amazing! Dr. Lam is very caring and shows a lot of  passionate towards his work. Nancy, is also great. Her work is fantastic! I am very grateful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phylis Bierman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Before I had the Fat Transfer with Dr. Lam I did research on the procedure and the physicians who specialize in that area. He has a very good manner about him. I just think my face has a softer look now after the procedure, so I really like that.  I would recommend Dr. Lam because of his high level of qualifications and his knowledge in the area of plastic surgery. We had talked about other options and he explained things very well. I am very happy with the outcome and would use him again in the future.  The staff is awesome, very professional, and very highly qualified.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelo “RaL-DeCe” Decena
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing experience from the moment you walk in the door. Staff greet you in a genuinely happy and friendly way, Doctor takes his time to explain the procedures best suited for your needs. I am extremely happy with the results, and I highly recommend Dr. Lam.

One year update: I am still very impressed with the results that I have returned for a separate treatment and have also recommended my family members to visit Dr. Lam. Hands down one of the nicest and friendliest people you will meet.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Trunk Retail, LLC
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam has been my go-to specialist for 6 years!  He's a very talented, meticulous and conservative facial plastics surgeon and expert.  It's important to have a relationship with the practice that you are entrusting your most important features to, and I trust Dr Lam and his staff completely!  I highly recommend him and his practice, they will ensure that you leave looking beautiful in a more natural and realistic approach.  Spend your money on beauty and maintenance wisely on a high quality doctor and products, because you can't hide mistakes or bad procedures when it's your face!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Baltzley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr Lam after visiting another Dermatologist that recommended I get fillers under my eyes for dark circles.  Dr Lam was INCREDIBLE!!   I was extremely nervous that it would hurt and not look good, as I’ve never had any cosmetic treatments before and personally not a fan of altering your face.  However I’ve always been self conscious about my dark circles.  I’m SO grateful for Dr Lam taking the time to explain the procedure and I swear on my life I didn’t feel a thing.  Was shocked!!!  Kudos Dr Lam and Thank You

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Sphar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Lam for many years and have always been thrilled with my results each time. He has such a remarkable ability to give a natural look and not to mention without any pain! His team and him are awesome! I highly recommend Dr Lam!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Dagit
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a lower-lid blepharoplasty with Dr Lam 10/18/16.  The nurse Beth was really sweet and made sure we knew exactly what to do and made me very comfortable.  She suggested hotels (I live in Albuquerque) and the driver was great and on-time.  I met with Dr Lam twice before the surgery and also the morning of.  He also escorted me out so he could tell my partner, Mark, how the surgery went.  Recovery was much easier than I expected.  My eyes felt like they had sand in them for about 2 weeks, but the swelling was almost gone in just a few days.  I wore my glasses for two weeks but otherwise I was up and about right away, no bruising.  I'm very happy with the results and I couldn't have asked for a better experience!  Thank you Dr Lam, Beth and staff!:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lam is amazing at filler and botox!  He will give you quality products/injections with experience of a great plastic surgeon and great artist.  You definitely get what you pay for with Dr Lam and it's worth every penny.  He will get you on a long term plan to get you looking the best you can.  He's super friendly and personable as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JAY CHANZ
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lam is the best! He is professional and an expert at what he does.  Ruby is amazing and took care of me through my process to flawless skin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arnold Wells
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a long time patient of Dr. Lam’s and I have used him for my Botox. A friend originally referred me and I did a lot of research on the web and talked to other doctors before I decided on Dr. Lam. In mid-February I had the CO2 laser done. Dr. Lam is extremely knowledgeable and caring. He called me after my procedure to make sure I was doing well. He is so compassionate and very good at explaining to you exactly what the procedure is. He is also good about setting your expectations not just for the results but for the recovery as well. Dr. Lam exceeded my expectations and the thing I like best about him is how thorough he is in giving you explanations about the procedure. He is always very cognizant and makes sure that you’re comfortable throughout the procedure. Dr. Lam is amazing and I don’t think there’s any other doctor out there that is as talented and compassionate as he is.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kali Ah Yuen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I originally came to get my acne scars corrected. For preface, I’ve been to two other medical spas that promised an improvement in my skin. After spending a year at each, I either saw it get slightly worse or stagnant improvement. I decided to do some more researching and fell upon Dr. Lam. I had seen he had great reviews and the photos on their website/social media showed promising results. I made an appointment the next day and when I came in for my first office visit, the staff was extremely friendly and welcoming. I usually get insecure going places without makeup, but they made me feel great about myself. I did my first procedure and by the two week mark I saw amazing results. I had less cystic acne and my scaring was improving, as well. A month and a half later, my skin was still more clear and had only got acne every now and then and moreso around the chin, due to hormone issues. I then went into my second appointment feeling hopeful and relieved. I know this is where my journey to great skin has peaked. Thank you Dr. Lam for helping me gain confidence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brook Havard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam and his incredible team  are the best. Such a skilled surgeon and such a caring team. They always make me feel like family.  He really is an artist and cares deeply for his clients. The front staff is always welcoming and ready to help me. They answer any and all questions no matter how many I have.  I would recommend them to everyone I know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leeza Libershteyn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient of doctor Lam for the past several years. I get my Botox and fillers done by him twice a year, and I also had a lower lip reduction surgery done recently. Doctor Lam is very talented, gifted individual with great heart and conservative approach. I love the fact that I get my procedures done directly by him. His staff is the most amazing group of people, they’ll make you feel welcomed and taken care of. It is such a pleasure being a patient of dr. Lam’s practice, because I always know that I am in best hands.
Leeza L.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie Suzanne
user_reviews_extended.Description: The wonderful staff of nurses at Dr. Lam’s office made my experience second to none during my experience of reducing my silicone lip implants of upper/lower lips from 15 years ago so pleasant. So great, that I am going back for additional work in the future! Don't hesitate or think twice about changing your lips! I did after YEARS of researching doctors with actual experience and pictures of before and afters AND Dr. Lam was the ONLY doctor that checked off all the boxes! Many doctors will take your money for a consultation and you will not know what or how they anticipate rectifying removal of the silicone from your lips. ONLY with Dr. Lam you can be guaranteed his expertise, pictures of before/after, and lovely bedside manner (along with his lovely staff and nurses) AND know that you will leave his office a better version of your former self. I spent years of agony and pain with the excess silicone in my lips that resulted in upper/lower lips were both too large and asymmetrical. I  never know that my lips were injected with silicone or that is was PERMANENT and changes over time, difficult to remove, and moves into other areas of you mouth. I was the 'pink elephant in the room' that everyone saw, stared at, and made me so insecure for years in my education profession.  I was never sure about what to do or who to go to. I went to a few doctors in Manhattan for consultations since the doctor who performed this surgery is not longer in practice due to obvious ethical reasons (Dr. Brad Jacobs—just Google his name and you will see), but without proof in terms of pictures (multiple) and hearing about ANY their years of experience working on patients with my similar situation, I did not take chance on moving forward with the procedure. Don't waste your time looking, so straight to Dr. Lam. You can have a consult via Skype or just send your photos and book your appointment! I have been dealing with from botched silicone lip injections and now I am back to normal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Mowbray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam and his staff are fantastic. Everyone was very friendly and made me feel comfortable during the whole visit. Dr. Lam has a great eye for detail. He provides honest feedback and recommendations. I really appreciated his expertise!! Highly recommend a consultation with him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eliane Muñoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is honestly one of the most caring and skilled Dr.’s in his field He has an impeccable eye for detail and decades of experience so his opinion is trustworthy and the results are phenomenal. He is a meticulous surgeon and somehow creates a younger, refreshed, and most importantly a natural look. Dr. Lam is the best of the best! His team is welcoming professional and kind. I highly recommend Dr. Lam. Amazing results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LC C
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in to dissolve filler. No one before has had more precision than Dr Lam. He used ultrasound to locate the exact location of my filler. He is very professional and kind. Lizzy was awesome and very caring. Felt so comfortable and will be going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Godbey
user_reviews_extended.Description: When i first started seeing Dr. Lam in 2018, he came highly recommended and his only stipulation was if i did not like something to please give him the opportunity to make it right. I continued to see him for many different types of face injections. At the time they looked good so i continued to receive more. However, now maybe (3-6 months later) i feel my face has absorbed them and would like to talk to Dr. Lam regarding this as i had previously agreed if i didn't like something to give him the chance to make it right. When i called to set up an appointment, the receptionist stated he could not see me until sometime in September. What! That is 4 months out. I have spent thousand of dollars within his office and i will be going elsewhere. However, I will say his staff is excellence and if i was only reviewing them i would give them 5 stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Duran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Lam Facial Plastics for several years and it has made a huge difference in the health and restoration of my skin.  I have referred tons of people to Dr. Lam and have yet to hear anything but stellar reviews and results. AND I must say, the staff is exceptionally amazing! I have never met a more professional and kind medical staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Patton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I flew into Dallas, TX was picked up by Kenny and dropped off at Dr. Lam’s office without incident.  I met Dr Lam, he was wearing pink eyeglasses in honor of his baby daughter’s birth, I thought it was awesome!

I’m excited to see the end result.  I’m grateful to Dr. Lam, Daniella who took great care of me and his wonderful sweet staff!!  Merry Christmas to all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jodi Putter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Lam. I went in for filler and botox, and was extremely pleased with the outcome. I have complete trust in him and will definitely go back. It was painless, and  there was no bruising, which I was concerned about as I'm very fair and thin-skinned. His entire staff was also very professional, helpful and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lena Brennen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used dr. Lam’s services to do lip fillers before my wedding. He did an amazing job making my lips fuller but looking so natural at the same time. He made me feel very comfortable and the procedure was quick and most importantly pain-free. I was very pleased with the results and the services provided by dr. Lam and all of his staff. I highly recommend the practice to anyone who is looking for any type of fillers or facial plastic surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MG
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is extremely knowledgable in his field, and I highly recommend him. From the moment I walked into his practice, I was treated with the highest level of customer service and upmost respect. The appointment was on time, the consultation was thorough, and all of my questions and concerns were addressed. He made me feel comfortable during the procedure, and I was confident and relaxed while he was working. The results came out beautifully, and I will continue to see Dr. Lam for any and all procedures I have in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gwyn Selby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lam is the leader in using new technologies and products to get the best results with the least invasive procedures.  My recovery has been much faster, with little discomfort or bruising.   These new procedures have allowed  me to get the same results as surgery, at a much lower cost. Dr Lam has a tenured staff that keeps thing running smoothly and on time.   Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rachel streur
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently went to Dr Lam for some “refreshing”. I have done very few fillers over the years and wanted natural results vs the “puffy” look I always see. It was quick, comfortable and took 5-7 years off my face while still looking 100% like myself! He is a  master and it shows. It pays to go to someone so experienced and with so much academically under his belt( facial plastic plus head and neck).Thank you Dr Lam!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to the practice for multiple concerns and Dr Lam and his team have exceeded expectations every time.  From thoroughly explaining each procedure and after-care to the welcoming environment, I would highly recommend Dr. Lam. Special shout out to Ruby for being so helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam and his staff are amazing.  During my visit I was made to feel like royalty.  The entire process was pleasant from start to finish .  The experience basically pain free.     I never felt so pampered .  5 thumbs up !  You must make a visit to Dr Lam.  I feel so beautiful already with the Botox and fillers .  Cannot wait when the full results take place   Thanks Dr Lam and Staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Ali
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son whom is African American  had a lip reduction by Dr Lam. The results were better than expected. He only had the bottom lip done because Dr Lam said he didn't need the top lip reduced. He could have sold me on the top lip but his honestly saved me thousands of dollars. Dr Lam and his staff deserves 5 stars for giving the great customer service and 5 stars for producing great results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodey Bell Dortly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I start. I went to this location a couple years ago to get a procedure name Mira dry performed. The Doctor there did a great job. I paid for my procedure over the phone and internet and thought everything was taken care of. Cut to a couple years later I received an email that I was to be issued a refund check. It caught me off guard but hey you’re going to send me a check okay why not. The downhill started here. From multiple emails and now 4 months later it’s been like pulling teeth to get information on the refund. No phone calls or they would state they called when my phone wouldnt ring at all. Just to find out apparently the check was taken and tried to be cashed but couldn’t confirm the address the check was sent to. If I can call and be on hold for 40 mins just to be told that person will call you back, or they left for today or request a phone call back and never receive it. Instead get an email sent back with excuse after excuse the next day. It’s giving if you don’t want to just issue the refund just say that. When we tired to overnight the check it became well the shipping and it having to be signed would have to be deducted from the check. In all my years as a professional. I’ve never seen so many tactics. They apparently don’t do direct deposit, even though we as consumers can pay from our debit cards. The staff might be friendly but they need to learn business 101, money management, better communication with their customers and update there systems. Giving the excuse “ we have consulted with our attorneys and have been advised” but can’t produce a paper train baffles me. So now after 4 months of waiting I finally found out today after finally speaking with a manager for the first time that the check was obtained and tried to be cashed back around October. I have to make arrangements come all the way back to Texas for a cashiers check since they now refuse to send me my refund check. Crazy work I tell you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Craven
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. Lam for years.  He is a true artist with fillers, botox and everything related to facial rejuvenation.  I trust him completely to suggest the best treatment to get the most impact with the amount I'm comfortable spending.  I literally cannot do his work justice in a short review. And his staff is helpful and always kind and willing to explain everything in detail.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laine Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so nervous coming to a plastic surgeon for a facial scar years go. I was so insecure! Dr. Lam and his staff are amazing. Dr. Lam has worked wonders w my facial scar and I’d recommend him w flying colors over any other plastic surgeon. To anyone nervous about enhancing something they feel insecure about, Dr. Lam and his staff graciously meet you where you are at and take great care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Mahlke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr Lam for upper and lower eye lid surgery with fat transfer to the jaw line and I could not be happier with the results. I feel twenty years younger. Dr Lam and his staff are so caring and compassionate. I would definitely recommend Dr Lam if you have been thinking of having this type of surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Javi Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Lam and Lam Institute for Hair Restoration as I have received HairStem treatment and the oral compound, which have helped me greatly. The staff is amazing, Susana in particular has always made my experience wonderful. She always makes me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kathi rice
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Even after my surgery, Dr. LAM continues to tweek things to give me the best outcome. He's so kind. The ladies their are absolutely gems.
Update: He leaves fat chunks under your chin and said I should have seen that in the pictures that were posted. The scar under my chin has big bands coming from it. He tried to fix it but it actually was worse. Dropping 1 star.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Gann
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am in awe of my results and loved every minute of my visit! Dr. Lam takes time to explain every step of the process from consultation to completion. He and the office staff are all very nice and beyond accommodating. I will trust him with my face for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Dougherty
user_reviews_extended.Description: When looking to find doctors with natural results, I really found that in Dr. Lam! His staff is also very professional, kind, and helpful. Bonus: the office is just lovely, and smells so relaxing right when you walk in - ha!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Bajaj

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to share my thoughts about an interaction that I had with the Doctor directly.  Ive had at least 5 consultations in various cities across the US concerning a Deep Plane procedure.   My most recent consult was with a really well regarded and out-of-my league doctor in California who explained to me that the classical deep plane is not so much in favor these days, however there are some elements of the deep plane procedure that are used in conjunction with the High SMAS procedure.  His explanation was sort-of unclear to me, because all previous Doctors only talked about the Deep Plane, and nothing regarding High SMAS.  Dr. Lam went out of his way and produced a YouTube video that clearly explained the differences.  He emphasized that only a very few doctors in the country have this  level of expertise.  I didn't pay Dr. Lam to do this presentation and unfortunately have never met.  I think his willingness to do this for me says a lot about his character.  I feel much more informed now thanks to Dr. Lam's explanation, and its critically important for me to understand as much as I can about what I'm getting myself into.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Y

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean McWalter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give more than 5 stars for Dr. Lam and his staff I would.  He has worked with me greatly over the last 10+ years. All procedures have been tremendously successful and I often get "out of the blue" comments from people I meet that I look much younger than my age.  At this point in my life I actually tell them about the work that I've had done.  Especially the hair.  It looks so natural.... people are amazed when I inform them.  And the hair procedure itself is actually a very pleasant experience.  There is no pain at all.  It literally feels like a day long head massage.

I am an extremely skeptical person so I always have a ton of questions for Dr. Lam and his staff.  He and everybody there are very patient and understanding and have always happily answered all my questions and many concerns.  I've never felt rushed or like I am bothering them.  They have always given me all the time I need to feel comfortable with my procedures both before and after they are completed.  It isn't like they want you to feel like they care about me, it's that they truly do care!!!

I would say that if anybody is nervous about getting a procedure, just listen to Dr. Lam and his team and they will tell you exactly what to expect and they have been correct 100% of the time for me.

They have been a life changer for me and I can't thank Lam Facial Plastics enough for everything that they have done for me over the years!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina N
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fillers, in the hands of an experienced and skilled practitioner, are basically like Photoshop but in real life. You can't tell anything happened except the little injection sites which look like blemishes. For a person who heals poorly and bruises very easily, that is amazing. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to be realistic about improving their appearance. Dr Lam will help you form a game plan and give you guidance along the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randa Bedair
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming to Dr. Lam for treatment of my acne scars on my face and I am so thrilled to find a doctor who doesn’t want to burn my skin off to treat it. His method to use micro-silicone injections has proven to be a much easier and permanent method. Each month, I come in and get a small amount of silicone injected into the deep scars, a little at a time.. and I can see the holes closing up and diminishing each month significantly. The injections surprisingly don’t hurt at all! He uses a vibrating technique, which doesn’t allow you to feel the needle for the most part. I’ve tried co2 fraxel laser, microdermabrasion and chemical peels in the past, but nothing has worked on the deeper scars. I’ve only had 4 treatments but it has made such a huge difference in my face! I still have a few treatments to go and I’m so excited about how much more improvement I’ll see.

As for Dr. Lam, he is a professional, a true artist and makes me feel confident in his abilities. I’m so glad I found him and I trust his judgement wholeheartedly. He absolutely cares about his patients and will not recommend anything more than what you need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corrina Hoffman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I saw Dr Lam for my first time to ever receive a cosmetic procedure. I wanted to address my dark under eye circles and get Botox for my forehead. He was VERY informative, thorough, and transparent on the options I had re: the under eye circles. Option 1: surgical option w/bag removal, fat graft. Pro - best results, longer term solution. Con - requires surgery, more costly.  Option 2: filler. Pro - quick in office procedure, more cost effective. Con - due to the severity of cavity, etc. under my eyes there’s a physical limitation to the efficacy of the results. With it being my first procedure, I opted for the filler.

I am so happy with my results! Did my dark circles completely go away - no. Are they better - absolutely!

As an added bonus I learned from Dr Lam there was an option to address my deformed nose (prior b-ball accident) with filler. Dr Lam fixed that too!!! This was such a surprise to me - the best unexpected surprise!

If you’re hesitant like I was about getting a cosmetic procedure done. My advice is go see Dr Lam and he’ll take care of you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: stephenie drew
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Lam left me feeling that he is a doctor that is passionate about his field, dedicated to the highest quality in all regards of his products and practice, a perfectionist in the details of his work and caring about the satisfaction of his patients.  I was truly impressed with the caring staff and their positive attitudes.  As I am turning 50 next month, I wanted to find a doctor I could trust to help me look my best at my age. As I am entering a new phase of life, I was scared and hesitant to go to a plastic surgeon because I hear of doctors that recommend surgeries or procedures for patients that aren’t actually necessary to achieve the patient’s aesthetic goal.  Dr. Lam has been a blessing!  Not only did he put me at ease; but also, he told me I could achieve a more youthful look WITHOUT any surgery or downtime. Dr. Lam also advised me against the procedure that I thought I had wanted to try.  I had thought about getting “fuller lips“.   Dr. Lam actually advised me against doing that procedure because to enlarge the lips would make my face appear “older”.  (Who knew???).  Dr. Lam explained his point using pictures of me (because it did not make sense to me at the time.). Dr. Lam illustrated how the bigger lips would make my face look older because of the way my face is structured.  Thank goodness for him!  I bet if I had walked into another doctors’s office and asked for lip injections, they would have been all too happy to take my money and fill my lips with some injectable or another. But instead, I found a doctor that is honest and committed to helping me put my best face forward throughout the next 50 years. I will be going back to see him in another six months and we will re-evaluate my situation then. The important thing is that I know I am in good hands with someone who will not do a procedure just for the sake of doing a procedure and billing patients. Seems like a doctor Who truly cares about the individual patient and what is best for him or her— and that means the world to me!!!
