user_reviews_extended.Description:
I believe I subconsciously chose Dr. Lam before even meeting him for the first consultation. He was my first and only interview as I began my search for a far better experience than the past.

In my opinion, Dr. Lam is EXACTLY the kind of Plastic Surgeon that one should aim to find. He is honest, unoffensive, extremely professional and above all else a PERFECTIONIST. At no time did he try and "up-sell" a procedure or offer me unrealistic expectations. I am into my 2nd day post injection(Restylane) and I can honestly say he ACHIEVED the results I was looking for. His skills/demeanor etc. are above and beyond my expectations. This guy is a class act hands down.

I've had a good amount of injections and I can finally say my money was well spent because he knows how to make a face BEAUTIFUL!! I recommend Dr. Lam if you are seeking out the BEST, he may very well be one of the BEST IN THE COUNTRY!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I traveled to Dallas from out of state because I was unable to find anyone in Oklahoma to help treat my synkinesis and bells palsy. Dr. Lam had me in for a consultation and was able to treat me same day. I have now had 2 appointments with Dr. Lam and I am incredibly pleased to say that I am experiencing improvement after suffering with Bells Palsy for over a year now. Super appreciated of his work and excited to try his new skin care line!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Roshanski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is a wonderful doctor and I trust him completely.   He is honest and gentle and he is the only person i know that gives a Botox injection with zero pain.   I live in nyc but have yet to find anyone here that I love as much as Dr. Lam.   You are in great hands!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Vega Lemos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Start of inquiry was great but due to needing to check my agenda (I was flying in for the procedure) and not booking right away the service from
Ashley went form 10 to 0. I have no question Dr.Lam is great, unfortunately his client care team is condescending, rude and unwilling to work with a patient unless you pay right away. Which sadly in the end, when you are trusting someone with your health, choosing a team that cares about the patient just as much as for the money is essential.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Vera
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I first heard about Dr. Lam, I remember him being described as a sculptor of the face. This was right around the time when I first started getting Botox and fillers about 2 years ago. Fast forward to 2020 and I finally made the decision to come to him and I have to say WOW. I am truly amazed by him. My first visit to him was for a consultation and he took the time to answer my questions, told me what he felt would be necessary, was very mindful of explaining cost and procedure and made me feel very comfortable asking questions. His level of professionalism and knowledge is unparalleled to what I’ve experienced before. The level of comfort I felt as he injected my face was something I didn’t know was possible. And looking back at my own before and afters I now know what they meant when they called him a SCULPTOR. He balanced my face beautifully!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destinee DeHart
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lam is a miracle worker! I was suffering with extreme sinus pressure and had a sinus headache for four days that I couldn’t kick with medication. I went in to see Dr. Lam and he was able to relieve all of my sinus pressure and headache instantly with his Botox method. If you are suffering from sinus pain go see him, you will have instant relief!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Than you for the respond Dr. Lam. The last call I had from the office was at 8:45 this morning when I spoke to the office representative. It is possible Courtney has the wrong number I suspect. I will be happy to call first thing Monday.

I'm not at all pleased with my experience at this office. I scheduled a consultation for the Gemini Laser to treat a several angiomas on my face. My consultation was scheduled for 12:30 on 2/7. I received a call at 12:20 to notify me that the appointment would be pushed back to 1pm. Not a big deal at the time. After my consultation, I scheduled an appointment for the treatment on Friday, 2/10, at 12:30. Once I arrived that Friday, I was told the nurse had gone home and would need to reschedule. I was incredibly disappointed that I was not notified of the cancellation beforehand, as I took time out of my work schedule and travelled from Aubrey. I was rescheduled for the following Tuesday, 2/14. Before checking out on 2/14, I requested a credit for the office's mistake that ultimately cost me time and money. Bear in mind this office charges patients a $100 fee for missed appointments. I was told the office manager was not in, but someone would call me back. I never received a call back. Instead, I had to call and leave a voicemail to remind the staff of the issue. Once I received a call back, the receptionist notified me the office manager declined my request. I expressed I took time and spent money traveling to that appointment and reminded her of their office policy on missed appointments. She declined again, and I asked that the office manager call me back directly. I have yet to receive a response.

As far as the treatment goes, I am wholly unimpressed. The angiomas have yet to fade, which would normally start to occur in this stage of the healing process. Additionally, though I paid to have my entire face treated, there were many spots, such as my chin, that the nurse did not go over with the laser. If you are looking for a laser procedure to treat angiomas, I recommend going to a dermatologist to have the VBeam treatment. I had high hopes for this office based on the before/after images on the LFP website. Sadly, I will not be back for additional treatments and will not be recommending LFP to anyone in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helen Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the most terrifying decision I've had to make.  But Dr Lam and his staff were beyond excellent and accommodating.  I flew in from Phoenix for my procedure and they allowed me to rest and nap before my appointment.   Dr Lam talked me thru all my questions and concerns reassuring me of good results.   I am sure my lips look 100% time better.   Thank u to the whole staff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernando Young
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Lam helped me back in 2006 before online reviews were a thing, but I was just speaking to someone about my experience with him and felt the need acknowledge the amazing experience I had. Dr. Lam, please forgive me for taking so long.

I was in a very unfortunate situation where my nose was bitten off by a dog. I remember feeling like I looked like the elephant man. I had this huge fear because of the uncertainty on how I would look. I remember there was one night when I was going through the healing process and it was a Friday or Saturday night and I lost it! I broke down crying and felt overwhelmed.

I called Dr. Lam and he answered. Not a service, him. I could tell he was at an event and he answered! I was a crying bubbling mess and he took the time to calm me down and reassure me that everything would be ok, that everything was fine, and that it was part of the process.

This is just one example of how profound my interaction was with Dr. Lam. 16 years later I still cherish his care for me as a patient.

Dr. Lam, thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just recently saw Dr. Lam. I love this guy. I’m a nurse and picky about who I will see. He didn’t push anything on me and was honest about his opinion. He is very kind and really cares. He actually had to tell ME, “you don’t need to do that. It’s not necessary”.  He wants to do the best job for you and make you happy. Best way to describe him...he’s an artist who is creative and can see the canvas he is about to work on. Thank you Dr. Lam!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Cohrt-Price
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr.Lam at Lam Facial Plastics since around 2010. Dr.Lam has performed jaw reduction with Botox on me. When I first started I wanted jaw reduction because I was happy with how I looked. The results from just one treatment were amazing. The second treatment helped even more. As I have continued to receive treatment I have notice the jaw reduction Botox has also helped with my teeth grinding and TMJ. Dr.Lam is amazing at what he does and always remembers me when I come in even though sometimes I haven’t been in for a year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mona ghasemi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just finished my procedure for a lip reduction. I was afraid to look in the mirror but When I did, I was able to tell that dr lam shaped my lips beautifully even with all the swelling. Can’t wait for the swelling to go down to see final result. There was no pain whatsoever. Staff was super friendly and accommodating. I would recommend him to anyone who is in search of a doctor for a lip reduction !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Krivsky
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is very professional. He spends his time making sure you understand what he is going to do. His knowledge of his work is exceptional and shows in his results. The office staff is also very helpful and always try to make you feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Patterson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an appointment with Dr Lam today! The office staff are so professional, I didn’t have to wait long and my time with Dr.Lam was quick and painless! Of course the best part is, the Botox he placed looks great!
I love my visits to Lam facial plastics!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vinh L. Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daniel and Ruby were excellent. Very hospitable. Fast. Botox is great

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darion
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a consultation for restoration and the experience was rushed. The initial nurse that came in to collect my information was not personable. After pictures, the doc literally looked at my head for 3 seconds and offered a scalp tattoo common to black male hair styles. He didn't have a thorough look at my head at all and I don't think the consultation was worth $100. I waited 6 months for this consultation because I never received word back about the virtual consultation. If you aren't experienced with working with Black hair, Black people, Black culture then it's probably a good idea to articulate that somewhere on your website because my money is still GREEN.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Celeste Pulis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is such an artist!  He has great vision for what would make his clients look and feel their best.  His expertise in the field leaves clients feeling comfortable and confident in his recommendations and procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Turnip
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ruby and Joy were very fun to work with! Dr. Lam does a wonderful job going over the rhinoplasty with you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AllC
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience! The clinic feels like a spa (it isn’t). The staff are welcoming and warm. Dr. Lam has the unique quality of being a genius at what he does while expressing joy at answering all your questions. I don’t work there and this isn’t a paid review. Just always consider honest reviews to be helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Funk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not only is Dr. Lam an extrodinary doctor, he’s a brilliant artist. He has been sculpting my face for almost a year between fillers and Botox. I completely trust him with every visit and he never disappoints! I highly recommend Lam Facial Plastics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a lip reduction procedure done (only on my top lip) in the late afternoon and it was like getting a haircut, you sit there and Dr. Lam and his nurse do all the work.  They are true friendly professionals and really know what they are doing.
Immediately after the procedure, I went to my room at a nearby hotel.
On a scale of 1 to 10, I felt pain at about a 4 for the first couple of hours after the procedure.  I thought it was only going to get worse so I began doing a guided pain meditation, but I fell asleep a few minutes into it.  When I awoke a couple of hours later, my pain was at about a 2.  Then, I listened to some pleasant music and another hour later, the pain was gone by then. I did not need to take the pain medication that Dr. Lam prescribed me.  I was very surprised that the pain had gone away so fast.  I also chose not take the steroids prescribed for the swelling either and it was fine – initially, the swelling was significant.
That evening, I was able to comfortably eat a Salmon and mash potato entrée and some pudding.  For the next two days, I wore a surgical mask b/c I didn’t want people looking at my swollen mouth because on my lips, the stitches were noticeable.  However, if you have dark lips, no one will really notice.
The most annoying part of this experience was the swelling at first and having the stitches in for about 10 days.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith McNutt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found Dr. Lam on realself. They were offering free consults so I made an appointment to learn more about fillers under my eyes. Upon entering the room he began to dissect my face and appearance, telling me his opinion of beauty; which I couldn’t honestly care less. It was ironic that he gives his opinion of beauty out to patients, yet he has a HUGE blackhead on his nose. I mean huge; I couldn’t stop looking at it. It looks like it’s been there for years. Why would a plastic surgeon, who’s job is to make things aesthetically pleasing, take such little time in their own appearance, then consider themselves a judge of beauty? I wasn’t offended, I was trying to hold back laughter. He decided I would need 4 syringes to fulfill his idea of beauty. He showed me pictures of past patients and made fun of the ones of had lip fillers he hadn’t done. I also have had lip fillers and he told me he didn’t like mine either; again, I didn’t care. I was really thinking about doing 4 syringes(god help me) but the doctor said he wouldn’t offer 24 months no interest financing because the rates for him were too high....so he was willing to let a 2900k treatment out the door so he didn’t have to pay $200 in finance charges. If he’s cheap, he’s going to be cheap in his treatment of patients as well. He left to let me think about it. I asked the MA if I could ask him another question and she responded, “he’s eating lunch, do you really want me to interrupt him” WHAT??? Yes, interrupt him! I’m currently in an appointment with him! Needless to say I didn’t get treatment done here and wouldn’t recommend this guy to anyone. The kicker was when I went to leave, they tried to charge me a consult fee. I reminded them I had a free consult with realself and they acquiesced. The doctor had a nice parting message for me as well, he said, “good luck finding someone who can do fillers. It’s very difficult”. Dude, I live in highland park Dallas. Doesn’t seem to be a problem and wasn’t a problem when I got 1 syringe of filler the next day at an office here. My results with 1 syringe are AMAZING. Dr. Lam pushes a hard sell then gets angry when you don’t bite. Don’t fall for it. He claims to be conservative in his treatment but his actions prove him to be quite the opposite.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yoga Jen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is a true artist. He uses filler to rebalance the face and hide signs of aging. The results are always suttle and never happen that overfilled look. He is also very fast and gentle almost painless. Love him and his staff who are always smiling and willing to help.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fanni L
user_reviews_extended.Description: I originally wanted to go to Dr. Lam but I was not allowed a consultation and I was told to pay the money up front ($3500) without discussing with the doctor what the surgery or the after treatment is. I do not understand this type of service. I did not like the attitude of the people I talked to who worked there. They took a long time to reply to my questions without any clear answers. They didn’t make me feel welcomed, or that I was an important patient.  I have never heard of paying the whole procedure without being allowed the doctor before face to face. I think it’s ridiculous and I am very disappointed. I do not recommend it at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam and his staff are exceptional in providing medical services with perfection. Dr. Lam has the eye of a fine artist, a heart of gold, and is extremely ethical in all he does. It is with great pleasure that I recommend Dr. Lam for any of the services he provides.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brynn Isom
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lam gave me Botox and a little bit of filler. I had no bruising and look like I am 10yrs  younger. He is honestly the best Doctor in the world. Thank you also to his empowering staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: lena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is very helpful and knowledgeable. I am very pleased with the results I see so far. He seems to really care about his patients and do what's best for them. My experience throughout has been very pleasant

user_reviews_extended.Name: TAMERA THOMAS
user_reviews_extended.Description: What I thought was going to be a very pleasant experience was actually a nightmare. I had surgery at their surgery center... The nurse did lab tests on me that were not ordered by a physician, she administered narcotic medications via IV and oral to me with no one else in the building to verify, my support garments were put on incorrectly and I still have a mark on my leg from it a year later. Absolutely a nightmare situation and I would recommend not having anything done here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mitch mecum
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Went in to see Dr Lam and had Botox and fillers done. Was actually able to go immediately from my appointment to being onsite with a client and no one could tell. Bruising and swelling was practically nonexistent.

Pleased with the results achieved. It looks like I woke up well rested and refreshed every day whether I am or not but wasn’t so noticeable that there are any chatters about my having work done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Back Yard Wildlife Home Projects
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience with Dr Lam!  This took care of smile lines near the mouth and eyes.  No issues with my smile, it did take a  few extra days for the pin sticks to fade.  Will do this again when the  happy lines come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Hovitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been visiting the skillful Dr. Lam for several years and have enjoyed great service from his staff and excellent skin and facial treatments. I get to look younger and feel great- just look at his crew! A true artist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Renick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really enjoyed seeing  Dr. Lam for my Botox today!  He was so complimentary of my face and skin looking so great.   I love that he doesn’t try and sell me on things if I don’t need it.  What a joy to have him as my doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough how pleased I am with Dr. Lam. I previously had fillers under my eyes that were over done and completely noticeable.  But thanks to Dr. Lam he went above and beyond to make me feel and look the best I can. Thank you for helping me regain my confidence!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toni Rivard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Dr Lam earlier this week for a facelift consult. After discussing with him and estimating the cost, I couldn’t afford the facelift this year. Instead, this awesome doctor suggested a temporary fix - Filler and Botox.  I am 4 days out and look fantastic!  He performs miracles with his magic touch and artistic ability (he is also a fantastic artist).  I am planning to have a facelift by him most likely, around this time next year. He is kind, funny, thoughtful and an ARTIST. I promised myself and him, that I will never let anyone else do Botox, fillers or any surgeries on my face other than him!  Thank you Dr. Lam. You are the BEST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darren M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in a bus accident that left me with an extremely noticeable 8 inch scar in the shape of a horseshoe on the right side of my forehead. About 2 years later and living in California at the time I went to see several plastic surgeons for advice on getting my scar corrected. I knew this would not be an easy task as any scar revision requires a tremendous amount of great technique and skill.  After being disappointed of the responses from 3 different plastic surgeons and feeling that they did not want to touch my scar because of the difficulty it would be for them to repair, I came across a YouTube video from Dr. Lam.  He recommended z-plasty, a plastic surgery technique used to improve the appearance of the scar. After getting it done with Dr. Lam my final results were amazing! My scar is like it disappeared.  I am extremely pleased with the job he did. Dr. Lam is an expert plastic surgeon. He took on a difficult task in fixing my scar and did an unbelievable job. Thank you Dr. Lam and to all his staff at Lam Facial Plastics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelia Reid
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lam is the absolute best. I trust him completely and would recommend him for anything. His staff is lovely - you won’t be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eman Dawood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Lam was very professional, informative , being honest about what I need to be done on my face even when I ask to do  more areas on my face  he didn’t agree , he just advised me with what is needed, he advised me to not waist my money of procedure/ injectable that won’t do or give subtle unnoticeable change for a short time, I really appreciate his honesty .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alessandra Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Dr. Lam for years. What a blessing!!!! My acne scars that had been such a concern since my teenage years are gone and my skin is smooth and beautiful. Now I see Dr. Lam for fillers. He truly is a GENIUS!!!!!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was bitten by a dog three years ago and it split my lip completely in half. When it healed back my lips were uneven, the right side was larger and more puffy than the left side!

I did two treatments with Dr. Lam, each not lasting more than five minutes!
Quick & painless and it was helped my lip so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jia Zheng
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here for jaw reduction botox for the aesthetic reasons. I also happen to suffer from TMJ, though, which was honestly just a side benefit for me. Never in my life did I think it was possible to see the results that I did with only botox! I had even been considering jaw reduction surgery. Now I'm so glad I visited Dr. Lam first. After 6 weeks, my jaw is much more round and smooth than it used to be (was previously very square), and I no longer have as much popping/jaw pain when I eat food. The entire process was quick and painless, and the staff are all so friendly and welcoming. I can't wait to go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Gucciardo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am having injectable fillers done by dr.Lam for about 10 years. Can’t say enough how happy I am for all those years. Every time I come he offers new technologies which always bring increadible results! I am 54 and when I look at my photos at 44 it gives me a feeling my age turned backwards! After every procedure my face looks natural, soft and rested without showing that something was done. Every time I see dr.Lam he always fascinates me with his artistic approach! There is no necessity to explain him what you want - he always knows what you need! It’s 1000% trust!!!
I also would like to mention his increadible stuff and beautiful clinic!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Sakowski
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Lam did fillers for me, I'm very pleased and looking forward to future visits.

Came back for a follow up treatment,  once again very happy with the results.  I highly recommend Dr. Lam. I'll be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Villalba
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had horrible dark under eye circles for as long as I can remember- so bad my father in law asked me if someone punched me when he saw me without makeup. I’ve wanted them corrected so badly for so long. I’m 32 and have always looked several years older because of the circles and after years and years I was finally able to get fillers. I went to the office and Dr. Lam sped through the consult, told me I probably only needed one syringe and then started suggesting other stuff I didn’t go in there for. Needless to say, I walked out of there with Botox(which I didn’t need, he said it was preventative) and one syringe that did NOTHING for my under eyes.  Wasted almost $2,000. Such a huge disappointment. Would not recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Pekurney
user_reviews_extended.Description: The reason I chose to go to Dr. Lam was because he specialized in ENT before going into this practice.  I have grinded my teeth for years and as a result I have broken some teeth. I needed relief and someone told me about Botox in the muscles of my jaws. I went somewhere else and paid much less and they missed my muscles in my jaw’s which caused a lot of pain.  I don’t mind paying more to get exactly what I want by someone who knows exactly what they’re doing.  I would highly recommend him for any procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: susana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to Dr Lam to get Restylane in lower and upper eye to look less tired. He was very patient and informative when describing the procedure and answered all my questions. The procedure was painless and he explained what he was doing and why the entire time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lili López
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the results I got from Dr. Lam. My jaw was always hurting due to my teeth grinding and he may all that a thing of the past. His office is clean and staff is amazing. I love Joy, she’s the BEST!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayden McCoy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been twice for acne scar treatments and have been very satisfied. The service is excellent, the atmosphere is calming, and I have been impressed with Dr. Lam. He has been honest about expectations and very attentive in addition to being price conscious. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiley Wirtz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hello everyone who might be reading this review! It might be a long winded one!!!!! I am a professional model, and have been in this profession for twenty plus years now. I started going to Dr. Lam via suggestion of a makeup artist in Dallas. I was thirty years old at the time, and desperately needed botox for the long lines that were running across my forehead. That being said, I was VERY nervous because my face is how I pay my bills. And reading the horror stories of poorly placed botox (on Google), scared me to death!!! I went in and not only had a WONDERFUL experience with the staff and the location, but Dr. Lam was truly so BEYOND amazing! He took the time to really LOOK at my face, the shape of my face, my brows, my skin etc. Let me tell you his botox is incredible. And when I say that, I mean that on every level. Both in applicaiton (it not hurting at all), to placement, to the amount of time it lasts. I don't know why really, but for me, his botox lasts for eight months. I was fortunate enough to go once a year, for almost ten years. He literally kept me looking at least ten years younger than I really am!!!!! That is, until I had to move across the country!!!! I just had botox done by the very first doctor, other than Dr. Lam. And man, what an incredible difference!!!! Not only was it incredibly painful, but I could hear my skin crunching, and..... it has been one month, and the lines are already back on my forehead. ONE MONTH later! Errrrr.... needless to say, I always knew I was lucky to have found Dr. Lam. But now I REALLY am fully aware of just how lucky I was to be going to him, while living in the same state!!!! Breaks my heart a little knowing I live so far away. But in the end, I would give anything to keep my face young with him, for the next ten years to come!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Longest review ever, but his level of professionalism and kindness is bar none. Not to mention his talent as an artist. I HIGHLY recommend him to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzanne Brasuell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a great experience with Dr. Lam using the Britenow pads! I am 48 yrs old and went without makeup after 30 days of use and everyone says my skin looks great!  I would highly recommend Lam Facial Plastics!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tamara Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy I finally made the decision to have my surgery. Dr. Lam gave me exactly what I wanted. I’m extremely happy with my results and it’s only been a little over a month . Dr.Lam and his staff are very professional and friendly. I made the right choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Abeyta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Procedure: Botox for Teeth Grinding: This procedure has changed the quality of my life. I was unable to get quality sleep and suffered from headaches and radiating pain down my arm. Keep in mind that this is with the use of a night guard. In an instant the stress of it all went away. The pain in my arm went away and I slept through the night without pain. I will do it again and again! Don’t wait, run! He’s a master with a needle. He also does other great work for me that’s more cosmetic. Amazing as always on all counts. I trust him with my face.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Jolley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
C my full detailed review on Yelp (word limited on Google)

Unmatched! Unparalleled! Perfectionist! Highly educated & artistic! ...& he knows it ;) if u want the very best, dr lam is ur go-to guy!
He's brutally honest! He doesn't believe in telling u what u want to hear. He believes results & honesty will keep u coming back. He educates his patients & remembers ur name. Even if u don't care to be educated, he treats u like a work of art. Every patient is a representation of his work! It's akin to Picasso creating a portrait. U get his vision, time, & quality in every unique work of art! U r a canvas & he understands every person is different & requires unique attention. U leave his office a unique work of art that he signs his name against!

I'll be short...because I can write a book on Lam!
Lam is Impressive! He is confident & the VERY BEST in his field. I trust very few ppl & I TRUST LAM! He educates his clients. He spends time with his clients no matter if he's busy or at lunch. Lam places his clients first! He wants to improve everyone in every possible way he touches. He doesn't stop until perfection is achieved. I'm EXCEEDINGLY picky & visual ~Lam is a kindred heart by never being satisfied but always improving & stretching to attain goals! He balances plastic w/realism. He's not addicted to surgery but structures different plans around each client. He will lead u to ur goals but never pressure or drive u in only his direction. This means he believes u can attempt perfection but beauty is in the eye of the beholder. Perfection is relative to each client. He is addicted to quality & u get what u pay for. Past experience w/other DRs gives me in-depth appreciation & realization of cheap treatments vs Lam. Additionally Lams abilities r rivaled by no one. Again, u get what u pay for!
I can go on...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monique Layzell
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zeynep Kaskaloglu
user_reviews_extended.Description: For my upcoming special event, I chose to enhance my lips with temporary dermal filler. Thank God, I chose something temporary, otherwise, if it was permanent like silicone, it was going to be the worst mistake of my life. Mr. Lam injected the temporary filler into my lips. After the injection was made, they never called me to check up on me or set up a post procedure-follow up appointment. The swelling on my lips, especially lower lip, did not go down for almost a week which concerned me. I called them to ask, if this was normal. They asked me to come in and show it to Mr. Lam. Mr. Lam looked at it and said some of the filling material went in to the wrong area inside my lips, and that looked like a swelling, but it was actually the material used was collected below and inside my lower lip. (He injected it to the  wrong area). He punctured inside my lower lip and squeezed the excessive material/filler out. My lips swell for another 4 to 5 days after this. End result, my upper lip is now uneven, one side is thicker/bigger than the other side. It is very visible especially when I smile. I hate looking at my photos that was taken during the event. This was a simple procedure, not even a serious surgery. I am anxiously waiting for the unevenness of my lips to go away, as the filler dissolves over time. I question his talent, skills and dexterity. How can you inject the filler to the wrong area  and  why could you not prevent the uneven look, injecting one side more than the other causing me to have a distorted, skewed upper lip? I got the same procedure done 5 years ago and never had these problems.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was referred to Dr. Lam from another provider and have been blown away with his treatment for my facial paralysis due to Ramsay Hunt Syndrome.
Prior to seeing Dr.Lam I was experiencing complete facial paralysis of the left side of my face that did not resolve after my other Ramsay symptoms went away. I had tried several other treatments and had seen little to no results.
Dr. Lam was able to restore movement to my face after just one treatment and after three treatments I am almost completely back to symmetry. Every part of the experience was exceptional, and Ruby and the rest of Dr Lam’s staff are all exceptional.
My only regret is waiting a couple of months to get in and wish I had started it sooner! I am beyond thrilled with the results and will be seeing Dr. Lam for all of my facial treatments going forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiana Semple
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not satisfied with my surgery personally. I had Dr Lam saved in my bookmarks for years as i was very intentional in saving the $5-$6K which took time and I WISH i didn’t waste it here. Im borderline livid but you live and you learn, all the picture reviews showed a noticeable difference in lip size which made me confident that the job would be done to my standard especially for the price but before starting the surgery, after stating i wanted small lips not smaller but significantly small lips, Dr Lam stated based on his experience he knows what to do and the perfect fit to match my face, etc. Being that this wasn’t money easily saved i wish i would have pushed for my preference a bit more and im writing this post to encourage others to leave that decision of exactly what you want in your own hands. I was so sure I was going to have the lips I wanted a year post op but everyone states I wasted my money because my lips look exactly the same, i am not joking. It’s frustrating but just so you all can do a little more research on choosing the right doctor for YOUR best results what YOU wanted.

user_reviews.Name: Nat W.
user_reviews.Description:
This was hands down the best medical care I have ever received. I have never been to a more efficient, professional, and caring practice in my life. I have a lot of experience in hospitals and doctors offices for myself and family members and they have been nightmarish. This practice is the complete office and I felt so confident in their care.

Dr. Dulin and his team were truly fantastic. They handled my top surgery and I am thrilled with the result and the entire consultation process. I could seriously give a TED talk just about how amazing this practice is and how pleased I am. They are the best!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Jaziel Villarreal
user_reviews.Description: My experience was phenomenal from start to finish. I went in for a double mastectomy and the entire process was made very easily. My nurse Kim was very straight forward, patient, attentive, helpful as well as humorous. My surgeon was Dr. Peter Raphael, my first impression was the one that mattered the most, the way he carried himself and introduced himself to me made me feel safe in his care and was a genuine Dr to patient relationship , he doesn’t just do his job, he loves it. My anesthesiologist was just as kind and humorous, he walked me through it all and sang to me to soothe my nerves. I have never been so welcomed and respected until I walked into their office. Thank you to everyone who had part in this one in a life time experience, everyone truly made it count. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Keri Grant
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Raphael and his staff are absolutely phenomenal! From start to finish, the experience exceeded all of my expectations. The entire team is warm, professional, and truly dedicated to their patients’ care. I couldn’t be happier with my results—honestly, it’s the best decision I’ve ever made! The outcome is even better than I imagined, and I would recommend Dr. Raphael and his staff to anyone I know without hesitation. If you’re considering taking that step, don’t think twice—you’ll be in the best hands possible!

user_reviews.Name: Blaine Morales
user_reviews.Description: I had my original top surgery with another doctor in another state, but needed a revision because my nipple placement was too low. I found Dr. Harris through another one of his patients and decided to book him for the revision. Dr. Harris and his staff were incredibly kind, thoughtful, and patient, taking the time to answer all of my questions and make me feel comfortable. I was able to have the procedure done under local anesthetic, which allowed me to see the revision after he finished. I’m very pleased with the new placement of my nipple—it looks so much better now! I couldn’t be happier and am excited to see the final healed result. I only wish I had known about Dr. Harris for my original surgery, but I’m truly grateful to have found him for my revision.

user_reviews.Name: Emily Gallegos
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Dulin, his nurse Kara, Laura who helped me with my initial consultation and sizing, and the entire surgical staff. From the very beginning, I felt completely comfortable and cared for. Laura made the consultation and sizing process so easy and reassuring. Kara was always so kind, attentive, and quick to answer all of my questions, which made the whole journey smooth. Dr. Dulin is truly an artist—my breast augmentation results exceeded my expectations and look so natural. On the day of surgery, every single member of the surgical staff was professional, compassionate, and made me feel at ease.

If you’re considering surgery, I can’t recommend this team enough. They are skilled, supportive, and genuinely care about their patients. I’m so thankful I chose Dr. Dulin and his team🤍

user_reviews.Name: John Tyler
user_reviews.Description: Dr Raphael and his nurses were very kind and helpful. My only complaint is that there was not a lot of time spent talking over desired results, or potential outcomes. In my case, I had top surgery and liposuction around the torso. I experienced severe stretch marks after the surgery across my chest, as well as stretching and warping on the incisions and my nipples. My results look pretty bad due to this, and it was an outcome that I was not warned about. I was told it was due to “weak skin”, something that is hard to predict, but is a potential nonetheless. I also had body contouring, and there was essentially no time spent discussing desired shape or problem areas. Dr Raphael was in and out. I understand he’s busy, but even a little bit more effort to figure out specific desires, as apposed to such a general approach, would have changed the game. It was a very rushed process. I’m thankful for the care I received and the professionalism of everyone, but I now have many revisions to my results that I will need, as well as outcomes that I unfortunately can’t change, but couldve been avoided with better communication. If you’re receiving care her and spending this kind of money, I’d recommend making sure that the details are mulled over, and you have a list of specifics, as well as questions or concerns. These surgery’s are a big deal.

user_reviews.Description:
I can't speak highly enough about my experience with Dr Raphael and his entire team. From the initial consultation with the amazingly wonderful, Cristal, to my post op care with his talented and attentive nurses (Denise and Kim), everything was handled with utmost care, professionalism, and attention to detail. His entire staff truly listened to my concerns and took the time to understand my goals, ensuring I felt completely confident every step of the way.

Their expertise is remarkable, and the results of my procedure exceeded my expectations! The staff was incredibly kind, supportive, and attentive, creating a warm and welcoming environment that made me feel at ease throughout the process.

If you're considering any cosmetic procedure, I wholeheartedly recommend Dr Raphael and his FABULOUS staff. Their skill, compassion, and dedication to their patients are unmatched. LOVE this team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Hess
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wanted to wait through both procedures I've now had to take the time and write a thoughtful review of Dr. Raphael and his incredible staff. After losing 225+ pounds, I still looked in the mirror and saw the same girl I saw before all that work I had put in (body dysmorphia is a hateful explicative)  so I started searching for a reputable surgeon to help me address my excess skin.

I have now had an extended tummy tuck, breast reduction/lift/augmentation, and arm/thigh lift. Those were broken out into two different procedures and both could not have gone better. From my very first introduction/consultation with Cristal, I felt safe, seen and supported. Dr. Raphael in our consult took his time to listen to everything I had to say, answered an abundant number of questions, and then with the pride of someone that felt like I had known for years, he looked me square in the eyes and told me how immensely proud he was of me and he promised me that he would take care of me. He kept his promise.

Now two weeks post-op of my arm/thigh lifts, I run to the mirror (safely, cautiously) each day to see the girl that I always knew was there. Dr. Raphael and his staff (Cristal, Chelsea, Kim, Lacy - y'all are angels from above) as well as all of the other girls at the front desk, in the office, and in the post-surgical area (Abby and Lexi, hanging with you post-op is my favorite) feel more like family than friends than staff at a doctor's office I happen to go to. I never once experienced shame (commonly associated with excess weight or residual reminders) with this crew - instead I found an immense amount of love and partnership in what felt like the final lap of a 3+ year journey.

Not only can I not recommend Dr. Raphael and his team enough, I will never be able to repay them for the confidence they have given back to me. I am endlessly grateful and hope anyone in need or want of some confidence-inducing work done look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chiyon
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best experience I ever had.  Since we've done lots of homework to finally find the right doctor for the breast procedures, Dr. Raphael was professional yet most trustworthy, made you feel so comfortable and easy.  Also consult ant and nurses were simply amazing!!!! I'm very satisfied with my experience and can't wait for all the girls to have the same.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I highly recommend Dr. Harris as your plastic surgeon! I had mommy make over 3 months ago, When I came in I was super nervous about my procedure. When he came in he explained everything all the pros and cons of the procedure. He is very realistic with you and what to expect. The results are phenomenal and turned out so great. He truly is the BEST at what he does. It went so smooth and he does not leave you questioning the after care he will throughly go over EVERYTHING. Not to mention the staff is amazing, specially Jennifer his Nurse, she always wants to make sure you are okay from start to finish. I would recommended him and his amazing staff to anyone.
Will leave happy and with realistic results!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunshine Clardy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my breast reduction with Dr. Antonetti several years ago on a referral from another patient. To start, my surgery was supposed to begin at 5:30am, and he finally got to me at 3:45pm. I went from a double H cup to one C cup and one D cup. He didn't do my cuts symmetrically. The left is cut and stitched, protruding over the transverse line. I don't know if he was tired or if he got sleepy or what, but I hate my results. I had another choice lined up with a great surgeon that isn't with us anymore but changed at the last minute because the referral seemed great. RIP Dr. Genecov. Although my surgery is several years old, medical professionals are not like wine. They don't get better with age they get sloppy, which is why I got the results I did. Thanks, but I'll definitely go with my first mind next time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Tisdale
user_reviews_extended.Description: Using this facility for my surgery was the best decision I have ever made. Dr. Dulin has absolutely amazing results and my recovery has been smoother than I could have ever imagined. His nurse Hope answered all of my questions and was very encouraging. Kristin, the billing specialist, was a strong advocate to ensure my insurance would cover my surgery and quickly responded to my many questions to ease my mind going into surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Raphael and his team are amazing. From the first time I walked in the door, nervous and unsure, they were welcoming and made me feel comfortable. Even considering plastic surgery was well out of my comfort zone. I didn't feel out of place or awkward.

Dr. Raphael has an incredible bedside manner and is calm and reassuring.  I am 9 days post surgery for an extended tummy tuck, brachioplasty and liposuction.  Although it will still take about another month for all the swelling to go down, I can see a difference everyday.  Because of the multiple procedures, I was required to stay overnight with a private nurse. Lacey was so sweet and caring.

I recommend American Institute for Plastic Surgery with 5 stars. Every step of the way through my journey, I was met with compassion and kindness.  I've had a couple of questions pre and post surgery and I was able to talk to a nurse either immediately or with a prompt return call.

If you are considering any type of plastic surgery, you will not go wrong with Dr. Raphael.  Now, to fix my turkey neck and reduce the size of my nose next year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammi Montgomery
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am 6 weeks out of breast lift with implant revision and could not be happier with my results! Dr. Raphael did my original breast augmentation 30 years ago and when it was time for an upgrade, there was only one doctor I would consider. His staff is great and he is kind, listens to what you want and does an amazing job. Highly recommend him if you are considering any procedure.

I want to give a special shout-out to nurse Kim who is going through a difficult time but showed so much care, concern and support. She’s the BEST. I recommend this surgery center!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Lori, did an amazing job on my lips and my Botox!!! I love my lips. They look amazing. Thank you so much, Lori. I will be coming back to make some appointments with Katie for a facial.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I called this clinic to schedule a breast augmentation consultation with Dr. Dulin. When I mentioned I’m a transgender woman using BCBS insurance, the staff member told me they wouldn’t accept it — not because it wasn’t covered, but because they don’t want to “discriminate against cisgender patients.”

She said, verbatim: “They don’t cover it for cisgender people, so we don’t take it for transgender people, because that’s discrimination against our cisgender patients.” When I replied that it seemed odd, she snapped back, “No it’s not,” in a flat tone.

This clinic advertises gender-affirming care through the International Center for Transgender Care. But if this is how they treat transgender patients — rejecting valid insurance coverage and justifying it with a backwards idea of ‘equality’ — then it’s not affirming, it’s performative.

I’ve since reported the experience to my insurance company. I hope this helps other trans patients avoid the same hurt and disappointment. Respect matters.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Hobbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: The pre-operative staff were very informative and spent the appropriate time to explain the procedures I desired and the potential outcomes. The staff of the surgical clinic were very professional and made me as comfortable as possible before and after the surgery. It was after the surgeries that the behavior of the clinic changed. All of the post-operative appointments were incredibly brief. This was especially distressing during the first post-operative appointment when I was in a lot of pain. The physician examined me for five minutes before having me rushed out of the office. I was left with many concerns and questions that unnecessarily had to be addressed through e-mail. On two occasions I have had to send correspondence to get answers to concerns that could have easily been addressed had the physician given me the time. Every following pre-operative visit has been a similar five-minute visit that has been very disrespectful of the time it takes me to visit the clinic. I recommend having your primary care physician being aware of the procedures you will be getting. Especially if you suffer from any degree of respiratory illness as this plastic surgery clinic is not knowledgeable about how serious these complications can be. The combination of my procedures put me in a position where an aerosolized inhaler was very difficult to use as it was painful to inhale properly. This is information that should be included in the post-operative documentation as obtaining a nebulizer after the fact is not a feat that can be done quickly. Ultimately, I have my reservations about this plastic surgery clinic as their bedside manner went from top-notch in the surgery clinic to disappointingly unprofessional on the administrative side. While still experiencing respiratory distress from the results of the procedure I am left with a lot of doubt as to whether the clinic has the patient's best interest in mind. If you choose to use this clinic please make sure to be informed of the procedures you desire and your own medical history very well as they will proceed with what you pay for regardless of the contraindications.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Salas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Dr. Perry on Dec 1st inquiring about a tummy tuck. After years of battling with the “mommy pouch” I couldn’t deal with it anymore. From the moment Dr. Perry came into the room I knew I wanted him to do the surgery. He made me feel so comfortable and assured me I was not the only one battling this problem. He took his time explaining everything and made me at ease. Surgery was booked for 1/4. I received a phone call the evening prior from Dr. Perry giving me instructions and just calming my nerves. Surgery day came and went amazing! This Doctor by far has the best bed side manner, he does phenomenal work and has the most calming demeanor I have ever experienced in my life! Thank you Dr. Perry for being so incredible! I highly highly recommend him and I can’t forget Colleen and Debbie his staff! Those girls are just as amazing, loving and sweet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 1st time getting plastic surgery Dr. Landon was the best surgeon I could have asked for. I went to Dr. Landon, in 2013 for my consultation, and he quoted me a price during my 2013 consultation, but when I went back a few years later, I was quoted a higher price because the price went up by the time I decided to get my argumentation. I paid the new price I was quoted, which was almost 1k more, and when I woke up after surgery, Dr. Landon gave me some of my money back, and he stated you came to get a consultation back in 2013 (a few years earlier) here is some of your money back, because we have to honor what was agreed upon during your 1st consultation.  I was ecstatic about that. But not only that, he really takes really good care of his patients. If the pain meds he gives you initially not working for you, he will more than likely give you something stronger until he finds what will work for his patient. He also make sure you as the patient stay stock with meds post surgery, and I was in pain almost a month after surgery due to the breast lift, implants and him reshaping my areolas so they wouldn't be so huge. He also gave me a card after surgery that said i have a lifetime warranty on my implants. Now, that was cool and was something i was not expecting to receive after my surgery. And if i ever need to get my implants replaced, the only thing i would have to pay for is the anesthesiologist and for Dr. Landon redoing the implants, but that wouldn't be much. The anesthesiologist would cost more than Dr. Landon would charge to add the new implants. But other than that  Dr.Landon also make sure you still have feeling in your  niples because as he explained it to me he leaves the nipples attached during surgery and you only lose feeling in your nipples if a doctor completely removes the nipples during surgery. He also communicates very well and effectively with you as the patient. I wanted my implants to be bigger, but because I'm only 4'9, he did not want to put his stamp on something that would make his work look not too great. Of course, I, as the patient, followed Dr. Landons advice, and I'm glad i did. I have gotten nothing but compliments since my surgery with people telling me my breasts look natural and feel natural, and it doesn't look like i have implants at all. I am glad i listened to him as the doctor and followed his advice. That was the best thing i could have done for myself and my surgery.  I also did my research before I chose Dr. Landon and i could not have asked for a better surgeon he is the best, and his staff was also very warm, inviting, and sweet ladies.

user_reviews_extended.Description: In January of 2018 I was diagnosed with breast cancer. user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Perry is truly the BEST doctor I have ever seen!! I was extremely nervous before my breast reduction, but from the very beginning, he made me feel completely safe and comfortable. He took his time to explain every single detail with so much patience and calmness.  He even personally called me the day before surgery to go over everything again and make sure I was okay. That level of care and attention is just incredible and meant so much to me.

Anytime I had even the smallest concern, I was able to reach him, and he was always there—either asking me to come in or guiding me step by step on what to do. That level of care is so rare!
I’m still in recovery, but I already feel so grateful and lucky to have found him. His kindness, calm energy, and professionalism are truly unmatched. He deserves more than five stars!!
I also have to mention his amazing office staff—Debbie and Colleen are absolutely wonderful! They are so kind, helpful, and supportive, and they truly make the whole experience even better. You can tell they really care about patients.

I HIGHLY, HIGHLY recommend Dr. Perry to anyone—you will be in the best hands possible 💛

user_reviews.Name: Ali E
user_reviews.Description:
I couldn't be happier with my mommy makeover experience with Dr Angobaldo at Renaissance Plastic Surgery. From my very first consultation through recovery, every step of the process exceeded my expectations. What stood out most was how heard I felt at every single visit. The team took time to understand exactly what I wanted and addressed all my concerns with genuine care and professionalism. The surgery itself was extensive, and the level of care I received throughout was absolutely excellent. Not only did I get the outcome I hoped for, I actually got better results than I even asked for! The attention to detail and Dr A's surgical skill are truly exceptional.
I would recommend this practice without hesitation to any friend or family member considering a mommy makeover. Shout outs to Kaitlyn, Kandice, Jennifer, and Angie for going above and beyond in my care. If you're looking for a team that combines surgical excellence with compassionate, attentive care, this is the place!

user_reviews.Name: Nadia Andrea Gonzalez
user_reviews.Description: Amazing experience from start to finish. I had a breast augmentation on tubular breast. Dr. Plano did such an amazing job. They look very natural with my body shape. Very happy with my results. Thank you doc and team!

user_reviews.Name: MrsB
user_reviews.Description: I am 6 months post operation of a breast implant exchange from this  practice and this was the worst experience.  My complaints are lengthy but to narrow it down.  Doctor Jeff A was unconcerned about my discomfort.  He left a capsule in me and told me he did.  I’ve been experiencing pain for 6 months and asymmetry problems.   I have to wear a bra at all times because the implants are not aligned.  One is up and the other is down.  I look and feel worse than before the exchange. During my follow up he was extremely nonchalant and the visit was less than 5 minutes.  He was Unprofessional,  no concern,  horrible results and a lot of ongoing pain.  Also, the surgery coordinator Kaitlyn needs to work on her communication skills. I DO NOT recommend this establishment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paola Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first surgery with Dr. Jeff Angobaldo was back in July of 2020. I had a procedure that included TT, MR, liposuction to abdomen/flanks and breast lift with augmentation. I had a wound on one of my breast, tummy tuck, and BB which I understand PS has no control over. I went back a couple weeks after for a awake revision of my wound scars on my breast and BB which he explained he could fix, during this follow up I expressed that I was unhappy with the size of implants. I had requested to stay at a size D or DD with cleavage during my consultation and preop appointment although I ended up with a size DDD which was very noticeable since I am a tiny girl 4 feet 9 in. He stated that it could be fixed with a separate procedure! (Sigh). I was very hesitant but I decided to go ahead and get a second procedure for breast reduction. I went to a consultation which I asked about changing my implants (310 cc to a 200 or 250 cc) to bring me down to a full C. I showed him inspiration pics which he explained that changing the size wouldn’t make a difference since I had a lot of breast tissue so he would just remove breast tissue. I didn’t understand this much but I agreed since I was influenced by his surgeon recommendation. During preop I shared this information with his nurses and they advised me to be persistent on what I wanted because he tends to do what he believes would look good instead of listening to his patients desires. With this I made sure to repeat myself when stating I wanted to be a full C after the procedure. I had my second procedure with him on May 2023. During my follow up appointments I expressed that I felt my right breast was larger than my left . His MA kept insisting that it was swelling and to give it time. For the first 2-3 follow up appointment I didn’t see Dr Angobaldo only his MAs. During one of these appointments I let them know that I was having a fluid leak from one of my breast and they applied Manuka honey and gauze on it. At a later appointment I finally saw Dr A and he prescribed me antibiotics for this reason, this is when I finally got to express my concern over my breast size. (At this time I was 3 months PO). He suggested that he could perform a revision on both breast and offered to remove both implants. At this point I was very irritated and annoyed since I got this second procedure to fix the first one. In total the first procedure was $18,500 the, awake revision was $250 and this last procedure was a total of about $5,000 (breast reduction and lipo to axillary area and abdomen). These costs don’t include medications and aftercare needs! In my mind that was what I was thinking, I’ve already spent all this money and now he wants to put me through a third procedure with him. He was able to tell that I was upset and recommended that I think about it and bring it back up at my 6 month follow up. After this follow up, front office scheduled me for a 6 month follow up. Once it got closer to that date they have changed my appointment last minute twice. And they told me that a 3rd revision would be about $1,200. At this point I just took a loss and am not making any attempts to see him again.

P.S. my BB scar was never fixed I had to cover it up with a tattoo.

user_reviews.Name: general X
user_reviews.Description: I was online researching for a qualified oculofacial or ophthalmic plastic surgeon who could address my festoons.  Subsequently, I came across Dr. Priya Kalyam at Legacy Eyelids & Cosmetic Surgery.  I read Dr. Kalyam’s profile and I believed and was confident that she had the expertise, education and specialization to treat festoons as her website suggests.  I made an appointment for a consultation with Dr. Kalyan and paid $200.00.  The day of the consultation I showed Dr. Kalyam my festoons and I wanted to know what were some options for treatment.  To my surprise, disappointment, and frustration Dr. Kalyam told me because I am African American there is nothing she could do to treat my festoons and I have to simply “live with the festoons”.  I was told that traditional treatments for festoons such as laser resurfacing is not recommended for my skin type (IV and above). I have since reached out to a more experienced plastic surgeon who has told me that my festoons must be surgically removed-I do not have to “live with the festoons.” I wasted and just gave away $200.00 so I could be told there’s nothing I can do for you. Moreover, the day I called Legacy Eyelids & Cosmetic Surgery to make consultation appointment I asked if the doctor treated festoons and I was told absolutely “YES”.  However, it should be a disclaimer that Dr. Kalyam does treat festoons but just not on skin types of IV or above. What a waste of money and time!

user_reviews.Name: Josephine
user_reviews.Description: I think a doctor that does not know how to take accountability is dangerous. My eyes looked exactly the same following a ptosis repair she did. She recognized the persistent droop once she walked into the exam room, but somehow tried to convince me minutes later that it had been repaired. Then proceeds to tell me maybe I have myasthenia gravis, which was ruled out before the surgery. She then told me to come back for a blepheroplasty. I’ve seen other occuloplastic surgeons since, who don’t believe I had a ptosis repair because all she did was waste my time, money, put me through the discomfort of surgery to achieve absolutely nothing. She gave me a quote during my consultation, which had increased when the scheduler called a week later to confirm my surgery and increased the next day when I showed up for the surgery!

user_reviews.Name: san m
user_reviews.Description: Due to some very personal circumstances, my already genetically hollow undereyes became worse and turned into my biggest insecurity. I came into the office very nervous and shy since I am a younger patient, but Dr. Kalyam immediately made me feel comfortable and recommended filler for me. She listened to me, answered all my questions, and even did the procedure that same day! She made sure I was comfortable throughout the injection process and just talked to me like normal to ease my mind. The results are AMAZING, and I couldn’t be happier with her work. The office ambience is super nice too, and her staff is very friendly!!

user_reviews.Name: brokerladydfw1
user_reviews.Description: I would give Dr Priya a 0 if it was an option. Was referred to her for a medical eye issue and within 5 mins it was clear she was not interested because it was a medical issue and not some pricey cosmetic procedure needed $$. She was rude and treated us like we were wasting her time.

user_reviews.Name: Jeremy Haltom
user_reviews.Description: Great surgeon. She did both of my upper eyelids in the office. A little pain when injecting the pain killer, but once that done I don’t feel any pain during surgery. In fact, not a single bit of pain during the entire healing process!

user_reviews.Name: Tanicka kirk
user_reviews.Description: I should of went here the first time! chalazion is completely gone .. painful process but efficient. She is very straight to the point I would come back in a heartbeat

user_reviews.Name: David Stout
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Kalyam is the best.  I first met her three years ago when my eye doctor sent me to her for a biopsy of a bump on my right lower eyelid. My doctor told me for eyes she was the best Ophthalmology Plastic Surgeon.  The bump was squamous cell cancer.  When we went through the process of having all the cancer removed, then it was Dr. Kalyam’s turn.  She had to rebuild my lower right eyelid.  Since then, I have had my upper eyelids and eye brows lifted.  I am so happy I did.  I don’t look so  tired and I can see to read.  I wouldn’t trust anyone else.  Plus, her office staff is great too.

user_reviews.Name: Wrynn Wilkins
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing and positive adventure resulting in me feeling better about myself. From the first office visit to the last three month visit, everything was top shelf…easy financial dealing, no pain and no swelling, perfect directions for me to follow at home. She is professional, no scars, and an artist, which is equally important for me. She has the perfect balance of being a wise doctor and compassionate woman…a perfect fit for me!
Thank you, Dr. Priya Kalyam! Wrynn Wilkins
✨💛✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Falcon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Abdominoplasty, Muscle Repair, Liposuction & Large Hernia Repair (Hernia repair done by Dr. Colleen Kennedy)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Stars
As a 1st grade teacher facing urgent medical circumstances, I needed a surgeon who could handle complex procedures quickly and expertly. Dr. Derrick not only met this challenge but exceeded every expectation I had. The combination of abdominoplasty, muscle repair, liposuction, alongside a very large hernia repair was no small feat, yet the results are absolutely incredible.

Due to my circumstances, timing was everything. Dr. Derrick understood the urgency and had me scheduled for surgery within just two weeks of our consultation. This rapid response, without any compromise in thoroughness or preparation, speaks volumes about the efficiency and dedication of this practice. Despite the quick turnaround, I never felt rushed or that any detail was overlooked.

From the initial consultation through recovery, the entire team made me feel comfortable and well-informed. Dr. Derrick took the time to thoroughly explain the procedure, set realistic expectations, and address all my concerns with patience and professionalism. The pre-operative planning was meticulous, and it showed in the final results.

As a 1st grade teacher, I was incredibly concerned about recovery time and getting back to my classroom full of energetic six-year-olds and seven-year-olds. Dr. Derrick’s surgical technique and post-operative care plan were so effective that I was back to work in just three weeks! This recovery timeline seemed impossible given the extent of the procedures, but the combination of expert surgical skill and comprehensive aftercare made it happen. I felt strong enough to handle my teaching duties and even had the energy to keep up with my students.

The transformation has been absolutely incredible. The hernia repair resolved painful symptoms I’d been living with, while the muscle repair restored my core strength completely. The abdominoplasty and liposuction results are stunning – I look and feel better than I have in years. Being able to stand confidently in front of my classroom, move freely without discomfort, and feel strong and healthy again has been life-changing. My students even commented that I seemed happier and more energetic!

From the urgent initial consultation through my remarkably fast recovery, every interaction with Dr. Derrick and the team was professional, compassionate, and thorough. Despite the time pressure, nothing was rushed in terms of explaining procedures, setting expectations, or providing post-operative care. The communication was excellent, and I always felt like a priority patient.

I would recommend Dr. Derrick without hesitation, especially for patients needing multiple procedures or facing time-sensitive situations. The ability to handle such complex surgery with precision while accommodating urgent scheduling needs demonstrates exceptional skill and dedication. For anyone considering similar procedures, particularly those in demanding professions like teaching, you couldn’t be in better hands.

Procedures: Abdominoplasty with Muscle Repair, Liposuction, alongside a Large Hernia Repair (hernia repair done by Dr. Colleen Kennedy)

Recovery Time: Back to teaching in 3 weeks

Scheduling: Surgery completed within 2 weeks of consultation.

Would I do it again?
Absolutely – Dr. Derrick gave me my life back!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Derrick did an amazing job on my procedure. He listened to my concerns and answered each question thoroughly. The staff is exceptional. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. I would highly recommend Dr. Derrick and his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Lerew
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn't be happier with my results and experience at Dr. Derrick’s office. I was treated like a VIP from start to finish, and I don't say that lightly. They knew what to do or have on hand for any situation that may arise. It was incredible to watch and be a part of - this team is as professional as it gets. Dr. Derrick himself was great, clearly knew exactly what needed to be done and how to do it.  I was treated with the utmost respect by all members of the team, and Christi Hernandez, who is the cosmetic coordinator was always reassuring, confident and knowledgeable - and very friendly. Everyone just knew exactly what to do. I wish all my medical procedures had gone this well and this smoothly with a team this strong. My results are amazing. I could not imagine being this satisfied. I highly recommend Dr. D and his team. So professional yet personal.  Thank you again for everything, Dr. Derrick, and the team for a beautiful surgery experience with life changing results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Hilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had the BEST experience with Dr. Chase Derrick. He is hands down one of the nicest, most personable doctors I have ever met. After a significant weight loss, I decided to have a mommy makeover. My results FAR exceeded my expectations…I couldn’t have imagined the life changing results that Dr. Derrick helped me achieve. I cannot recommend him highly enough…everything from the consult to post-op care and his office staff has been wonderful. Thank you Dr. Derrick!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Patterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Derrick provided medical stitching of a large gash on my daughter's forehead after a major car accident.  He had great bedside manners and did great work. user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Galyean
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr Derrick and his staff. Their new office is so beautiful and welcoming. What I appreciate most about Dr Derrick is that you can trust his advice - he won’t try to sell you something you don’t need. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Payne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Derrick is amazing. I’ve had three surgeries that he’s performed: breast lift, augmentation and a tummy tuck and I couldn’t be happier. He explained that he preferred doing the lift and augmentation as separate surgeries to cut down on complications and to give the body time to heal. I interviewed another doctor, before making my decision, and asked about the 2 surgeries and they said ideally 2 surgeries is the way but they can’t talk their patients into doing it that way. That answer made me pause and question whether the doctor was doing what’s best for the patient or what was best to keep that person as a patient.

Dr. Derrick is very honest even if it means talking you out of a procedure that he feels isn’t needed. This is the kind of doctor you want!! You want a doctor that won’t perform unnecessary surgeries because he sees you as a dollar sign instead of a person.

He has a great bedside manner and a caring staff but most importantly he’s an absolute GENUIS in the OR. I’m in love with my results and the scars are undetectable. Highly recommend. 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaye Hannan
