title: Dr. Denton Watumull, M.D.
address: 3201 E President George Bush Hwy, Richardson, TX 75082, United States

user_reviews.Name: Suzanne
user_reviews.Description:
I couldn’t be happier with my experience with Dr. Watumull and his entire team. I spent nearly a year researching surgeons before finding him, and after our first meeting I knew without hesitation that he was the right choice. I’ve had several breast surgeries over the years—most of them attempts to correct a botched lift from more than 20 years ago that left my nipples and breasts misshaped. After recently losing a significant amount of weight, I decided to see if anything could be done to improve their appearance. I wasn’t expecting a miracle; I was simply hoping for a modest improvement.

After meeting with several highly regarded surgeons in different states, I was beginning to accept that my breasts were as good as they were going to get. Then I came across Dr. Watumull’s website and scheduled one more consultation. Unlike others who told me there wasn’t much that could be done, Dr. Watumull took the time to walk me through every option. He was honest about the risks of nipple revision, yet confident in his ability to significantly improve both the shape of my nipples and the overall appearance of my breasts.

I ultimately chose to have a breast lift with implants, an internal mesh-bra, and nipple reshaping. Six months later, my results are beyond anything I ever imagined. My breasts and nipples look amazing, and I feel like a completely new woman. The confidence I’ve gained is truly life-changing.

From my first consultation through every follow-up visit, Dr. Watumull and his staff were exceptional—professional, compassionate, and genuinely invested in my outcome. I am thrilled with my results and will wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Watumull to anyone considering plastic surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Megan Wesseler
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Watumull and his staff were amazing.  He listened to exactly what I wanted and superexceeded my expectations.  Thank you for fixing me up! I highly recommend Dr. Watumull for any of your cosmetic needs.

user_reviews.Name: Karen Lancaster
user_reviews.Description: I am 61 years old and had breast implants for 20+ years. For various reasons it was time to have them removed. I had a consultation with Dr Watumull to let him know what my expectations were. I not only wanted the implants removed, but I also wanted my breasts rebuilt, to look the same way they did before I had implants. Dr Watumull did an excellent job. I could not be happier with the results. I highly recommend him to any woman interested in this procedure!

user_reviews.Name: Kaycie Yates
user_reviews.Description: Dr.  Watumull was amazing from start to finish. I am extremely happy with the outcome. He goes off of research and stays up with new studies and procedures. I cannot recommend him enough.

user_reviews.Name: Alisha Morton
user_reviews.Description: Regional Plastic Surgery Center and Spa is for anyone who is focused on self-care. The center offers a variety of services for those who may need a small treatment up to larger procedures. Dr. Watumull takes his time explaining and answering all questions and he and the staff show care for you well after your procedure. I would highly recommend using the center for any of your self-care needs.

user_reviews.Name: Shirl Page
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Watumull is an excellent surgeon and did an amazing job so much in fact this was my second surgery with him. I highly recommend him and his staff.

user_reviews.Name: Shannon Barron
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Watumull and his staff are fantastic. From my initial consultation to currently being 7 months post op, they have been a great support system. I had a breast lift and the technique he used on me gave me exactly what I wanted. Dr. Watumull prepared me mentally on what to expect which helped as I had never had a procedure like this before.
I’m 57yrs old and wish I had done this years ago. It’s given me confidence in a way I never imagined. I recommend him and his awesome staff, he is an artist!

user_reviews.Name: Kathy Bull
user_reviews.Description: I recently utilized services  by Dr. Watumull to correct scaring and damage from prior surgeries. He and his staff are beyond top notch. You will never go there and feel like a number, they truly care about your process before, during and after. Making the decision to have the procedure I had was NOT an easy one but knowing I was in the right hands made all the difference in the world. Best advice I can give is to ask LOTS of questions over and over, Dr. Watumull is great at understanding none of this is easy and will answer your questions over and over again until you are comfortable with what's happening. Truly thankful to have found everyone in his practice from the front office staff, to billing, to nurses and of course, Dr. W.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Honest & Anonymous Reviews
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had both a primary and a revision rhinoplasty with Dr. Watamull, and overall, I would not recommend him or his clinic.

From the start, the staff and environment felt very sales-driven and pushy, it was clear this was more of a business transaction to them than a focus on patient care. I felt pressured into making decisions quickly, and when I had valid questions or concerns, they were often dismissed or brushed off.

After my first surgery, I was left with underwhelming cosmetic results and significant functional issues, breathing was still a problem, and I didn’t feel truly listened to. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and returned for a revision, hoping for better communication and results. Unfortunately, I walked away from that with the same concerns unresolved.

Every visit felt cold and rushed. There was little empathy or transparency. I was even met with attitude when trying to advocate for myself or ask for clarification on procedures or results. There was no sense of accountability, just a constant push to keep coming back and spending more.

Bottom line: If you’re considering rhinoplasty, especially if it’s your first, do your research and find a surgeon who genuinely prioritizes patient outcomes and care. I wish I had gone with someone who saw me as more than a number and took the time to get things right the first time.

The results exceeded my expectations, and I couldn’t be happier.  If you’re looking for a skilled, compassionate surgeon who truly puts patients first, Dr. Watumull is an excellent choice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Layla Lohmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Watumull and his staff are kind, honest, and very helpful. I had some post op complications with those procedures with the OBGYN.  I have worked hard to get my body/nutrition back over the last 5 years. One of my patients had used him prior and I loved her results and she mentioned great bedside manner.  Let me go on to tell you I wouldn't use anyone else.  Dr. Watumull has been doing this for almost 30 years and he is very knowledgable and listens to his patients.  During my consultation I didn't feel "rushed', I didn't feel "judged".  He listened to what I wanted and gave me his professional opinion on what he thought would look good with my body.   I am two weeks post op with minor post op complications (none where a surprise as they went over the possible normal complications during any surgery).  I was off pain meds after day 3, only Advil and Tylenol.   I had breast reduction/lift and a tuck.  When I had a minor complication even when he was out of town,  he got me in to see his colleague, they fixed me right up and sent home with no other issues.   I have a small area where blood flow isn't providing an area enough to help healthy tissue survive, he is watching it closely and getting it back to healthy.  This is an honest review and I would do this again with Dr. Watumull.  I didn't have any drains, I was back to work post op day 11 (as a dentist, I had to take a few breaks).  It was hard work to get back after a major procedure but I listened to his post op instructions, breathing exercises and walking every hour- it was hard but doable.   He doesn't use compression garments and I felt like I needed a little help to keep the swelling down so I borrowed one for my stomach from a friend that we used during c-section and helped just to reduce lower back pain, but I didn't have to buy $200 worth of garments I didn't need.   This office doesn't nickel and dime, they provide excellent care to their patients and do not push you.  Heidi, his coordinator, was wonderful and kind.  Front desk ladies are personable, and I am now going to see what their spa has to offer.  Thank you Dr. Watumull and staff for giving me back confidence in my body even with the swelling I still have I couldn't be happier! Can't wait for post op when the scars heal.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I just completed my one year follow up with Dr. Watumull and I have waited to go through the entire process before leaving a review. Dr. Watumull did an excellent job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Lambert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m not typically one to write a review, but since it was the reviews that brought me to Dr. Watumull and his amazing staff, I felt inclined. When I first started looking for a surgeon, my plan was to remove my implants, get a breast lift and see about fixing a lump I had over one side of my c section scar.

Being new to the area, I had no one to turn to for a referral. I made 4 consultation appointments in hopes of finding one that would be a good fit. Dr. Watumull was my first and last! I could tell right away that he was an exceptionally brilliant doctor, beyond experienced and very good at what he does. He listened to what I wanted and didn’t try to convince me otherwise. He took his time to give me his professional opinion and thoroughly explain what I was dealing with. I am 41 and have had 3 children. I had to have all three via c-section. Over the years I had been dealing with some issues that I didn’t realize could be related.

Until meeting with Dr. W I was unaware that I had a pretty bad umbilical hernia and my abdomen had been separated nearly 2 inches from bottom to top. I was pretty adamant about not having a tummy tuck. I’ve had a few friends that have had it done and I wasn’t a fan of the results.
Dr. W didn’t try to convince me or pressure me at all! He simply explained what it would do and what my results would be. I trusted him and decided to have the “mommy makeover.” I had my implants replaced with much smaller ones, a breast lift and a hybrid tummy tuck. The recovery was brutal! However, I am 6 months post op and can say with full conviction, that it was so WORTH IT!

I didn’t realize how much the top of my abdomen poked out until now that it doesn’t. I haven’t had a waistline like this since I was 20! I have been self conscious about my breasts for 15 years! I was a 32 DDD and couldn’t wear anything without a bra. I even had to wear a sports bra to bed to be comfortable enough to sleep. Now I don’t even own a bra. It’s amazing! I finally feel like my old self and not just a mom.

I haven’t had self confidence like this in a very long time. My back pain is 100 times better and now that my abdomen is back together, I sleep through the night without waking up to pee 3 to 4 times! Also, I made through the Texas heat of summer without any sweat stains under my boobs!

All my friends who have had the same procedure are jealous! My scars are barely visible at just 6 months post op. They plan to travel from Newport Beach to Dallas to have Dr. Watumull preform scar revisions over the summer.

My husband was pretty hard on me about the expense of it all in the beginning, but now he’ll be the first to say that it was well worth it! I think he’s even happier about the results than I am! I’ve had a couple of concerns along the way that were immediately put to ease by Dr.’s nurses. I was even able to text pictures and get immediate assistance while I was out of town. I am beyond grateful to Dr. Watumull, his nurse Amber and the rest of his incredible staff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aileen Backus
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wanted to share my experience with Dr. Watumull with anyone that is looking for a surgery that will produce the results that you want and has a staff that is always available!
I have had 5 babies through c-section and worked really hard on my fitness journey to lose 60 pounds on my small 5 foot frame. After losing the weight.. As a picky individual I could not be happier with my results! You will not be disappointed!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Marotto
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What can I say about Dr. Watamull that hasn’t already been said? He is the most conscientious and skilled doctor that I have ever had the pleasure of working with. Dr Watamull is highly trained, obsessively prepared, and exceptionally respected by his peers and patients.
I had a previous surgery, with a doctor who was also featured as one of Big D’s best. Nine months’ post op, it was apparent that both the abdominoplasty and breast lift had issues which could only be corrected surgically. I realized that my methodology for choosing a surgeon was flawed. I decided to do more research. After interviewing 4 different and exceptionally qualified plastic surgeons, I was confident that I had found the best doctor for my surgery and after care.
My last appointment was at Regional Plastic Surgery, with Dr Watamull. Dr Watamull did the most comprehensive initial consultation I had experienced. I could tell from his energy and expertise that he was passionate about his practice and specialty and that surgery was his happy space.
I scheduled my neck and full facial rejuvenation, with Heidi Polo, Dr Watamull’s amazing coordinator. I was pressing forward with my initial plan to have the work completed on my face first and the revision abdominoplasty and breast corrections later. However, my husband was very vocal about how unhappy he was that I no longer had the bosom he remembered. So I called Heidi and asked if I could change the surgery from a facial rejuvenation to rthe evision surgery and if I could schedule another consultation with Dr Watamull with my husband in attendance.
Dr Watamull was accommodating and said my husband could pick out my breasts, and that might make him feel more comfortable. Regional Plastic Surgery has imaging equipment and after you take photos they can simulate what you will look like with different sizes. The strategy was a success; my husband really liked Dr Watamull and enjoyed the process.
There was a massive difference between the two surgical experiences. To start with, I realized that at the other office I was a commodity, and at Regional Plastic Surgery, I have value as a person and as a patient. Although, I am not someone that needs to feel warm and welcome to make a decision, I have to say, it sure is nice to have that as part of the package. The front desk is pleasant and professional, the nurses Taylor and Amber are beautiful, talented and amazingly competent and I seriously want to adopt Heidi Polo. All that comes from the top down; it is Dr Watamull’s vision and leadership.
Secondly, Dr Watamull’s workmanship is exquisite.  My abdominal scar had been unsymmetrical, one-half to one-inch-wide in different sections, and the scar had formed a five-inch hump on the right side of my abdomen; sadly, the belly button had closed. Dr Watamull gave me a symmetrical abdominal  incision with almost no noticeable scar, and a fabulous belly button. My breasts  had some wicked scars and were deflated. Dr Watamull fixed all that and gave me the volume that had been removed.  (Husband is happy again.)
At six months’ post op, I recently completed phase two of my plan. I had the face and neck lift. When Dr Watamull was marking my face pre-op, he explained to me that, after studying and reviewing my face, he would proceed with a particular plan and made recommendations even before we went into the operating room. I felt humbled and special and grateful that I had been able to connect with his practice and especially with Dr Watamull.
I just completed my five week follow up appointment and I am dumbfounded over the results. This has been an amazing and positive experience. The only downside is that sometime in the near future, I will be finished with this journey and I will actually miss all the people at Regional Plastic Surgery. I encourage you to move forward with your journey and I confidently recommend Regional Plastic Surgery and Dr Watamull.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Reid
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Magician, Artist, Genius……just a few of the words that come to mind when I think of Dr  Denton Watamull.
Magician, not in terms of sleight of hand or illusions, but because what he does in the operating theater is nothing short of magical. He has the ability to envision the end results before he even picks up a scalpel and he inherently knows exactly what needs to be done to make you look your very best. During my consultation, one of the things he noticed was that my nose was angled slightly to the right; I have to admit that in the almost 50 years I have been looking in the mirror, I have never noticed that, which is a testament to his attention to detail.
Artist because what he does with his surgical instruments is pure artistry. Trust him with your outward facing canvas and he will give you back a masterpiece. I have had more compliments on my beauty from strangers in the past month (I am only 8 weeks post surgery) than I have had since my 20’s.
And Genius because well, his results are irrefutable proof of that. I trusted him completely and his results were well beyond anything I could have hoped for or dreamed of.
Between his extraordinary talents and the incredible staff he employs from the office manager Tara (thank you for always have mints on hand) to the clinic staff, the Ambers and the OR team; I would never trust anyone else to achieve the Hollywood star level results they do.
Thank you doesn’t seem like enough; however, for a lack of another phrase within my textual vocabulary to encompass the totality of my appreciation, I will stick with Thank you! Thank you for patiently answering all of my questions, thank you for the comfort level and experience you and your staff provide, thank you for your consistent follow up post surgery, thank you for making this world a more beautiful place and most of all….thank you for giving me back 20+ years of aging. It has truly been life changing in the greatest ways imaginable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Marlow
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I rate Dr. Watumull and his staff with ten stars  - off the charts fantastic!  Absolutely phenomenal customer service and technical performance!

The results far exceeded my expectations.   He took more years off my appearance than I would have thought possible.

Two decisions are important when planning cosmetic surgery – who’s the best surgeon? And what do I really need done?

Dr. Watumull is clearly the best!   He excels in surgical skill, technical expertise and patient care.  You will not find a more competent, finer professional anywhere! It was evident that Dr. Watumull and everyone on his staff were absolutely committed to helping me achieve my own personal vision of success.

I was initially apprehensive about meeting with a cosmetic surgeon, but everyone treated me like dearest family.   Everyone was compassionate and caring.  They made me feel comfortable with what would happen, and kept me informed and encouraged throughout the recovery process.   There were no surprises.

In my case, I thought I knew what I wanted done but now I recognize the value of getting a top professional like Dr. Watumull to consult on the possibilities.  Dr. Watumull listened to what I wanted to achieve and that was obviously his top priority.  But after my initial consultation it was clear I had overlooked some important options.  He has a “critical eye” and identified specific issues that contributed to my aged look.  He helped me understand what the various procedures could do.  He never made any type of sales pitch but he helped me choose wisely.   Although he would have gladly done just the procedures I initially envisioned, the outstanding results are partly due to Dr. Watumull suggesting some improvements that weren’t obvious to me.   I am absolutely delighted with the outcome.

He spent extra time with me to make sure I was comfortable with and understood the implications of what we were talking about.  He clearly and patiently explained the various procedures and options, the effects, and what to expect from the surgery, the recovery and beyond.

My family doctor, who had been one of his patients, recommended Dr. Watumull and she raved about him.   What better endorsement could there be?   And she was so right.   I would absolutely recommend Dr. Watumull to anyone considering cosmetic surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharee Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Last week, I had an endoscopic bilateral carpal tunnel release surgery performed by Dr. Denton Watumull. It was the best experience I could have had! Not only is his office staff is warm and friendly, but they are competent as well. They answered all my insurance questions and were even able to get my surgery scheduled quickly, so I could get back to work as soon as possible. I've been to his office three times, and each time I waited less than 10 minutes to see the doctor. That is impressive! I never felt rushed or hurried when spending time with Dr. Watumull. He has a great bedside manner and explained everything thoroughly. He did not appear annoyed when I asked even more questions afterwards. I cannot give enough stars for how well I was taken care of by Dr. Watumull and his staff!

As far as the procedure itself, I was impressed with how quickly it was done and how soon I felt relief from the carpal tunnel symptoms. Before this surgery, I had severe numbness and tingling and was woken up multiple times at night with pain.  The first couple of days after surgery were somewhat painful, but within the second week, I am relatively pain-free -- especially compared with how I felt before having surgery. And the best thing of all -- I have no more numbness or tingling. ZERO! The incisions are small and I don't think the scars will be noticeable once they heal. Even right now, typing on my MacBook with my wrists flat on the keyboard, there is no pain on the incisional areas. A lot of people seemed concerned that I was having both wrists done at the same time, but it really has not been a big deal. Honestly, I am just glad to get it all done at once and not have to go through everything a second time.

If you're considering a carpal tunnel surgery, I strongly recommend Dr. Watumull and his office. Don't put it off like I did. I wish I had done this five years ago!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today is 1 week and 1 day since my surgery. I had liposuction done in my abdomen, flanks, bra line(back), and upper arms. I also had renuvion in arms and abdominal. Dr. Watumull and his staff took very good care of me pre op, post op and especially during the procedure. Always answer all my questions and help me understand exactly what I was going to be going through. Heidi is amazing and really helps you feel welcomed! It is a place of NO judgement and you really feel you can tell them anything,  no matter how embarrassing or silly it may seem. From day 1 I felt this is who I wanted my journey with!

He is very knowledgeable and reasonable.  He is direct and a perfectionist which is especially important considering he is contouring my body with such an invasive procedure. Pricing was very excellent for everything that he performed.  He really went the extra mile to ensure I was going to be happy with my results and he perfectly understood what my goal was.

I am bruised and swollen but definitely smaller and fitting into clothing I have not been able to wear in such a long time! AND ITS ONLY BEEN A WEEK!  Recovery is a good 3 - 6 month so its only going to get better and better. I'm so thrilled and excited!!!

Surgery day was excellent, so fast too, staff was amazing in taking care of me and preparing for what's to come. I felt a bit of pain and I was pretty out of it given I was under general anesthesia, but i feel much better as each day passes.

The best part is he does not believe in garments or drains! I was dreading those 2 things the most.

Honestly if you want a professional that will be upfront with you, tell it like it is, and do an amazing job that will leave you in tears of happiness...Dr. Watumull is your surgeon.

EDIT: I needed to return to leave a follow up review, its been 2 years since my procedure and unfortunately I did not get to enjoy my results fully :( Something better happened to me, I got PREGNANT almost 6 months into my recover and its been amazing! However, I am leaving pictures 3-5 months into recovery before I found out I was preggy.  I miss my old body and wish I lived in TX, I would go see Dr. Watumull ASAP.  If you are considering lipo, he is the man to go to. Beyond happy, way better than what I expected, i had a beautiful pregnancy thanks to the procedure too!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Watumull has done two surgeries on me now--one was to remove a benign tumor and complete an elective procedure at the same time when I was about 23 years old. The second was to work with another surgeon to reconstruct the cartilage of my nose after it had been damaged from an unfortunate fungal infection I obtained while undergoing treatments for a rare form of cancer. To be clear, I have experienced both sides of plastic surgery: elective and non-elective. In both procedures, Dr. Watumull not only ensured excellent surgical results which I am consistently complimented on, he showed genuine concern and compassion. He did not have to work with the other surgeon in the way that he did, but he did so as an advocate for me as a patient. I can assure that you WILL NOT find this in most other plastic surgeons.

My mother elected to have an extensive procedure with Dr. Watumull after seeing my results and saying for years that she wouldn't consider plastic surgery. Her results are so natural it's astonishing. I have now referred 4 people to Dr. Watumull and every one of them are not only highly satisfied with their results, some have even shed tears over how much Dr. Watumull has changed their life through his surgical skills.

If you are reading this, I urge you to go get a consultation. Dr. Watumull will have your best interest in mind and he will not recommend something you do not need or will affect you negatively.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ahn-Tee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Given my background, we were pretty much taught against cosmetic changes and to be satisfied with the image you were born with.  That is all good and well, however; my face always looked older because I had dark circles and bags even as a child.  I called them my raccoon eyes and hated to look in the mirror.

I discovered there was a procedure that could be done to alter the image of my eyes and after several years decided to do some research.  I literally drove past the Regional Skin and Laser Center every morning on my way to work and noticed the facility one morning.  When I got to the office, I searched their website and made an appointment for a consult.

During the initial meeting with Dr. Watumull I asked questions regarding all aspects of a blepharoplasty.  He shared with me his credentials, all costs associated, and put my mind at ease.

So, after deliberation and a few months, I made an appointment to have the work done.  Given my upbringing I was even a little apprehensive the morning of the procedure.  What I appreciate most about Dr. Watamull is that no matter how anxious I was feeling before and after the procedure he always put my mind at ease with these words, “I believe you’re going to be pleased with what you see.”

I have held on to those words through the healing process, which is different for everybody and not complete.  I can say with no reservation I believe in divine orchestration and that Dr. Watamull is one of the best doctors in the City of Dallas and that the experience was well worth the investment!!!  He and his staff are exceptional people and excellent care-givers.

I’m encouraged every time I look in the mirror.  I now wear makeup to enhance and not hide my image.  I want to assure anyone that is looking to invest in themselves and may have reservations like I did, to quote a popular slogan, “Just Do It.”  This was one of the best decisions of my life!

Dr. Watamull and you are DEFINITELY WORTH it!!!

user_reviews.Name: Susan Sato
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Morrissey is awesome! Very easy to communicate with. The staff is great as well!
I had a tummy tuck after having 4 children and a hysterectomy, I really needed it. Working out helped but I had loose skin. My stomach looks great! I didn't have much pain afterwards either.
So glad I did it!

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Krueger
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Morrissey. I had a breast lift and some lipo to my hips and am very, very happy with the results. Dr. Morrissey has a great bedside manner. Very friendly. He made me feel very comfortable and fully answered all my questions. His staff is great and very responsive. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: E Ramirez
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Morrissey and his assistant Brenda were so amazing and professional. My husband had liposuction for the abdomen/flank area and the results were amazing (granted he was sore for the first 2 weeks) but 3 months later and he still looks great.
We were in the area for only two weeks and we called on such short notice (4 days beforehand), yet they still were able to see us and schedule a surgery. I highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Brandy Cochrane
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Morrissey did my implant exchange with a breast lift two weeks ago, and I could not have ask for better results. My breast have never looked better. I had implants place by another doctor 3.5 years ago, they were suppose to fill up and lift up my breast after having 3 children, that did not happen I just had bigger drooping breast. I was beyond devastated. I went to see Dr. Morrisey to see what to do to correct them, I just could not deal with the way they looked any longer.

Now 2 weeks later, I am in love with my breast! When I saw them for the first time after surgery I cried happy tears because they were beyond my expectations. I have told my sisters and husband, that they look better then before I had kids. I have seriously never been so happy with my breast in my life. He was the most caring, understanding, and patient doctor, he listened to what I wanted and just went above and beyond. I have referred several family and friends to him since meeting him. He is the best, if you are looking for an amazing surgeon come see him!!

user_reviews.Name: Power Sisters
user_reviews.Description:
I reached out to the office recently, only to be informed of Dr. Morrissey's deeply saddening demise. This news took me by complete surprise. I want to express how eternally appreciative I am for the significant impact this man had on me.

About three years ago, Dr. Morrissey performed an arm lift on me, the results of which have been phenomenal. Despite being acutely body-conscious, he continually boosted my confidence and assured me I did not need the potentially dangerous procedures I had been considering.

Even though I was willing to invest substantially in medical procedures, he remained remarkably ethical and avoided any unnecessary treatments. His integrity in action was, indeed, a precious rarity. His memory will forever be treasured in our hearts. It is regrettably ironic that among all the surgeons, including a fair number of less than satisfactory ones, a man of such excellence like Dr. Morrissey had to be the one to leave us. May he be in God's divine company now.

user_reviews.Name: Brenda Mazzawi
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Morrissey is an amazing doctor and needless to say. A great person Dr Morrissey kept in touch with me throughout my recovery he called me everyday and even gave me his personal cell phone in case We had Any questions. The. Surgery he performed on me was fantastic and just because I know he had made incisions on my body I knew they were there but they were so perfectly made that i could hardly see them. Dr Morrissey is the best

user_reviews_extended.Description: In 2010 i had a breast reduction done by Dr. Morrissey.. It was horrible. I have the worst scars you could imagine. At 1 point i had developed pockets of fluid in 1 breast. He cut opened my breast in his office to pop the the pocket of fluid. I was there alone with my 2 young children. He never closed the opening. The way it healed it looks i was burned. Most of my other scars are 1 inch wide. I now have inverted nipples an hard nodules in both breast. The hard nodules are so bad they cause pain. Please do your research before allowing any dr to operate on you. This was one of worst decision ever made letting him do my surgery. It has changed my life so much an not for the better.

address: 6020 W Plano Pkwy, Plano, TX 75093, United States

user_reviews.Name: Sara Kohan
user_reviews.Description: Crystal was absolutely amazing throughout the consultation process. I made many changes along the way and asked a lot of questions, and she was always incredibly patient, responsive, and flexible. She never made me feel rushed or difficult—only supported and reassured. Her communication was clear, kind, and consistent, which made a big difference for me during such an important decision. I truly appreciate her professionalism and care. I’m moving forward with my surgery with Dr. Raphael and feel very confident in my decision.

user_reviews.Name: David Andrews
user_reviews.Description:
Dr Peter Raphael is the absolute best! I am 2 weeks post-op after a lip lift, neck/face lift and laser and I am thrilled with the results

I did my research - interviewed 5 Doctors and I most definitely made the right choice. I also have half a dozen friends who have been to Dr Raphael

All of the staff at the American Institute for Plastic Surgery are so extremely professional. Catherine and Kim were both wonderful. They have been with AI4PS for many years & you can tell they all work well together like a well oiled machine

I can’t say enough good things about Dr Raphael and his team & I couldn’t be happier with my results. Most definitely recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Denice Cooper
user_reviews.Description: Though I think he is a nice man, I have to give 1 star due to me going in for a osteoma removal on forehead and unfortunately the first time he “ tried to remove it” he didn’t… was left with major swelling, scar tissue, and a hard bone extending on forehead still…. I went back to get it removed again ( with Dr Raphael)  revision…. and once again, 2 procedures later, I saw no improvement and no signs of him being successful. I went to another surgeon and he told me that Dr, Raphael did NOT remove it, not even close to the osteoma area, and now I have to go to Dr who took scan and stated the above) and have him remove it.  I do not recommend him for osteoma removals!!! 2 years of steroid shots, two years of appts , two years and 2 surgeries and he never even removed and removed other healthy bone instead… dent in forehead now… thank god this current doctor  can remove it and polish  down the indention etc. ! Other doctor also stated that Dr Raphael not take a scan prior to both procedures on MY skull was VERY dangerous!!!! Stuck with a ugly large scar for NOTHING and a egg shape tissue, swelling and a hard bumpy bone!!!

user_reviews.Name: Danny Q
user_reviews.Description: I had top surgery with Dr.Raphael and I’m super happy with my results! He made sure I got what I wanted and the staff were also amazing! I highly recommend him if you’re looking to get top surgery!

user_reviews.Name: Logan Wynn
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Raphael did a spectacular job with my procedure. It even appears as though I have chest muscles afterwards! His team was great in every way. I would highly recommend him.

user_reviews.Name: Diane Myers
user_reviews.Description:
Dr Raphael was referred to me by a previous patient.  She expressed she was unhappy with her procedures and had to go back for corrections.  She said he made it right for her.  Well, she was lucky. I went in for a full face lift, cheek implants, upper bleph, lip implants upper and lower, lip lift, and CO 2 full face laser.  This was not my first time to have a face lift, as I had my first in my early 50’s. I can honestly say this was a full botched job!! Only 2 procedures out of how many, 10? Went ok. The laser peel and cheek implants.  To avoid taking up too much space, let’s just say, that when i went back and showed the nurses and I got about 5 minutes with Dr Raphael, they tried convincing me I looked fine.  Well, i sure didn’t!! My lip lift was totally crooked and he had ruined the perfect Cupids bow I’d been born with, he tried doing something with my nose so that my smile is all crooked now too and my nose.  My upper lip implant was totally a true botch job, as was the lower.  He redid the upper to correct his placing lip implant on inside of my lips and crooked sideways, and said he corrected bottom implant as it is at the back instead of front of my lips, but he didn’t do anything with bottom implant.  It is still in there backwards and my Cupids bow is not aligned under my nose anymore.  He had to even redo my bleph and i still have scar tissue left on my upper right lid.  This supposed doctor has left me butchered, mentally and emotionally damaged for life.  When I went back for a 3rd and 4th time, Dr Raphael and his staff again was totally blowing me off saying „ well you sure look SO much better than you did”.  I don’t understand a supposedly „professional plastic surgery clinic”, not once willing to correct this inexcusable damage to a 60’s ish grandmother trying to look prettier for herself and her husband.  It deplorable that i had to have almost everything redone, and it still was
Nowhere close to being corrected.  They talked to me like I was way out of line.  If you want to get this kind of work done, and you’ve been saving your whole life to get it done, don’t go here!  They never once offered to have another partner in this clinic correct Dr R’s numerous mistakes,
Or another surgeon outside their clinic.  They just kept shaming me, the paying patient and retired RN,  into thinking I was all wrong.    I’d like a reputable plastic surgeon correct the mistakes Dr R made and if that’s not an option, refund every penny I paid.    Thanks for reading.

user_reviews.Name: Tiffany Rodriguez
user_reviews.Description: I underwent surgery, and Dr. Peter Raphael was my surgeon. He provided the best results I could have hoped for, and I am incredibly grateful for his expertise and compassionate care. Everyone in his office is equally remarkable and caring.

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Raphael replaced my lip aug implant and performed a lip lift 15 months ago. (I flew in from another state.) It looks as if nothing was altered at all. If anything, my lips have almost disappeared. Before and after pics show no improvement(s) and the lip lift was a complete waste of time and money.

user_reviews.Name: wallace collision center
user_reviews.Description: I brought my 16 year old son to Dr. Brobst to see about removing a mole on his chin that he was very self conscious about. I was very impressed with the staff and Dr. Brobst. They took the time to hear his thoughts and Dr Brobst gave him a couple of options which was great. After the procedure, which was completed in the office, the follow up was incredible. We went back for about a year at different intervals so Dr. Brobst could make sure he was still satisfied with the results which was pretty incredible. From my experience I would highly recommend Dr. Brobst.

user_reviews.Name: James Greenwell
user_reviews.Description:
Our son had severe trauma to the corner of his mouth while playing 7 on 7 spring football. Dr Brobst closed the traumatic wound and provided excellent follow up care. That was several years ago. Today there is no visible scar. He is very talented!
Please don’t forget the decade plus of college, medical school and residency required to become this skillful. Thank you for you dedication:)

user_reviews.Name: Kerrstin Nortonen
user_reviews.Description: I had the best experience with Dr. Brobst and his staff. I had a spot on my nose that I needed removed. It was on the very tip which is a hard spot to deal with. Dr. Brobst did it with ease! Him and his staff are so welcoming and genuinely kind. Dr. Brobst listens with intent and care! He truly wants to help. I will absolutely recommend all of my friends and family to him. I will be going back for anything I need in the future as well. Thank you, Dr. Brobst and staff!

user_reviews.Name: Lucas Shaw
user_reviews.Description: From the moment I walked in, I felt comfortable and well taken care of. The consultation was thorough, all of my questions were answered, and the actual treatment was quick, gentle, and virtually painless. I was so impressed by the doctor’s precision and eye for detail. The results are natural, refreshed, and exactly what I hoped for. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend him to anyone considering aesthetic treatments.

user_reviews.Name: Carolyn Atkerson
user_reviews.Description: Our family has been seeing Dr. Brobst for several years and every procedure he undertakes is done with absolute meticulous care.  His bedside manner is unlike any Dr we have known.  We trust him completely.  Every person in the office just could not be friendlier or more professional.  I love my visits with Amanda, Lauren and Hannah.  These ladies are so knowledgeable and make every visit special.  Thank you, thank you, thank you!!

user_reviews.Name: Michelle Goff
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot speak highly enough about Dr. Brobst and his exceptional expertise as a board-certified plastic surgeon. My journey with him began over nine years ago when he performed two procedures on my face, and prior to that, a deep face and neck procedure recently. From the very first consultation to my most recent experience, I have always felt confident and reassured in his care.

Dr. Brobst is not just an outstanding surgeon, he is a true professional who listens attentively, exercises immense patience, and genuinely cares about his patients. Unlike many medical professionals, he takes the time to thoroughly understand concerns, explain procedures in detail, and ensure that every step of the process is comfortable and clear.

My deep plane facelift required a bit more time than usual, but what stood out to me was the dedication and precision of Dr. Brobst and his team. They never rushed, ensuring that everything was done to perfection. His staff is equally wonderful—warm, professional, and always making patients feel at ease.

Now, with latest procedure,  I am satisfied  and thrilled with my results. The natural-looking transformation he achieved has not only enhanced my appearance but also boosted my confidence. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Brobst to anyone considering plastic surgery. He is truly one of the best in the field, and I am beyond grateful for his skill and care!

user_reviews.Name: Leigh Koritke
user_reviews.Description: Dr Brobst came highly recommended by my dermatologist when I inquired about sagging skin on my face and neck after weight loss.  My eyelids were also becoming heavy and I always looked angry and tired. I had become increasingly bothered by what I saw in photographs and in the mirror.  My goal was to LOOK LIKE ME AGAIN. I've seen the results of procedures that successfully help people look younger, but often they end up looking like an entirely different person... a little freakish even.  I was hoping for more of a restoration versus a new build.  Post-surgery, THE RESULTS ARE AMAZING.  I do look like my younger-self but not overly young.  Instead, I look happier, healthier, and well rested, but STILL ME. I went from haggard to zen.  Dr. Brobst and his team have been phenomenal throughout every step of this process. The after-care has been amazing. Everything about this experience has FAR EXCEEDED MY EXPECTATIONS. If I had to do it over again I would choose Dr. Brobst and team in a heartbeat. 10 out of 10.

user_reviews.Name: Natalie Pence
user_reviews.Description: I had a deviated septum from physical trauma. I ended up only fixing my nose structurally and not aesthetically, which was covered by my insurance. Any surgery to your face will leave you with quite the recovery. I used to snore all night and I know there’s a lot of reasons for snoring but fixing my nose has cleared up AT LEAST 70% of my snoring. Not to mention it’s wonderful to breathe!! It took me a long time to decide to get this surgery and I wish I had done it sooner. Breathing well increases so much in your life, being able to exercise, eat, and sleep better is a life changer. I cannot stress enough how incredible Dr.Brobst and his staff are. They are so kind, and honest about everything. Dr.Brobst did a wonderful job with the surgery, and my nose healed beautifully. They are discreet with the follow up appointments while you’re recovering. Their communication is all around excellent. I 10/10 recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Lauren is truly amazing and has done me right so many times! She is gentle, patient, and genuinely cares about her patients. All the staff here is kind and works around your schedule, always ready to help. Highly suggest coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Description: The care and love we received from this team was unlike any other Dr I have ever dealt with. user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great Doctor and Staff!
Dr. Brobst performed my septoplasty surgery and I can say that he and his team are top notch!  They are very professional, but also caring, patient, and make you feel like family.   His work is impressive, and his impeccable bedside manner is such a nice experience.  I am very pleased with the outcome of my surgery and the post-care follow up by him.  He was very clear in explaining every step of the procedure and recovery, and was very compassionate and calming on the day of surgery.  I highly recommend Dr. Brobst and his entire staff!

Julie C.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not recommend Dr. Brobst and his team more highly! These are the kindest, most intentional, and intellectual doctors I have ever met with. They were able to work around my schedule, being an out of state college student, and provided me with clarity and so much peace on getting a septorhinoplasty. Dr. Brobst was able to answer every one of my questions, no matter what time of day it was at, and explained exactly what my procedure would look like. He takes his time with you at every appointment and his team now feels like family! He did a spectacular job on my procedure and made me 10 times more confident in myself. He continues to follow up with you to see how your recovery is going. Choosing Dr. Brobst and his team to take care of me is one of the best decisions I will have ever made!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely loved my experience here. The staff are amazing and so sweet. Doctor Brobst did amazing work on my nose :D
I finally adore the way my nose looks, most importantly I can finally breathe correctly!
Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst has excellent experience in the plastic surgery field,so that he is an nice plastic surgeon. By the way, his office staff is very friendly and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Lara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had the privilege to accompany my mom to Dr. Brobst's office for a facial surgery procedure, and I simply cannot expressed how happy we are with the results!
His exceptional skills, coupled with the compassion and professionalism of his team, have left my mother looking absolutely amazing.

From the very first consultation, Dr. Brobst impressed us with his knowledge and the way he genuinely listened to what my mom wanted and addressed any concerns we had.
He thoroughly explained the procedure, discussed potential outcomes, and made her feel completely comfortable.

I also want to mention the amazing staff at Dr. Brobst's office who deserve high praise as well. They were not only professional and efficient but also incredibly warm and caring throughout the entire process. They were always there to answer our questions, offer support, and ensure my mom's comfort and well-being. Their kindness and attentiveness truly made the journey more pleasant and less stressful.

Highly recommend ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Moreland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our experience with Brobst Facial and Plastic Surgery was phenomenal. Every one of his staff members were exceptional.  My daughter needed septal surgery secondary to a deviated septum and very large turbinates.  Our initial consultation, was very informative and thorough.  We felt very secure in Dr. Brobst's abilities after this meeting even though we were nervous to have surgery. His reception staff were extremely kind and personable.  His nurse Hannah was top notch. She was very professional, detail oriented, yet friendly, kind and compassionate. The office was impeccable. They were always timely for all of our appointments.  The office's pre and post operative instruction packet was very detailed and thorough. Her surgery was smooth, and the surgical facility was wonderful.  Her recovery was better than expected.  We had zero swelling or bruising which was shocking.  Her repair was aesthetically flawlwss and structurally well-constructed and exactly as he had described it. She can finally breathe! Dr. Brobst is a super friendly guy who made us both feel very welcome .  He was gracious and it always seemed like he had all the time in the world to meet with us.  Dr. Brobst is a remarably skilled, experienced surgeon who perfectly blended art and science. He was patient and gentle and my teenage daughter completely trusted him. He was highly recommended by our ENT provider and I can understand why. He and his staff were truly outstanding and I would recommend him to anyone of my colleagues, friends or family members without hesitation. We drove 35 mins each way to the practice and it was completely worth it!  Thank you Dr. Brobst and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria H.
user_reviews_extended.Description: We are so happy with the results for our child’s earwells. Would happily recommend Dr. Brobst to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor brobst and his stuff are THE BEST!!! I always hated my nose growing up. I had a bump on the bridge of my nose and the tip plunged downwards. I went to a few doctors for  a consultation and did not like the results but doctor brobst made my dreams come true!!!! Dr. Brobst and his staff made it such an easy experience! They do such a great job while making you feel so comfortable! I love the results of my nose now!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Page
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst and staff have been wonderful from start to finish. He takes the time to sit down with you each time you visit his office and address any questions or concerns you have. He was able to repair my deviated septum and now I can breathe better than I have my entire life. Highly recommend Dr. Brobst and his fantastic office staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaleigh F
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Dr. Brobst and all of his staff. When we found out that our precious 10 month old would need surgery on her little bitty face I was an absolute mess. Our first meeting with Dr. Brobst gave me so much peace. He was calm and answered all of my questions without making me feel like the crazy mom. The surgery went perfectly and she is healing just fine. I can’t recommend him enough and every one of the ladies in his office are so incredibly kind and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Barquist
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst and his staff are amazing. He was very informative and explained in depth all aspects of my procedure as well as expectations . He and his staff were there for me before, during and after surgery.  Care is continued as long as needed.  I am more than satisfied with my results and would not hesitate to refer him to anyone who wants to be given all the time, attention and reassurance that is needed when plastic surgery is being considered.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was “seemingly” nice, but I doubt I’d return as they do not appear to respect patients time. I had an appointment at 11:30am and was not serviced until after 1pm. For a non surgical procedure that would take approximately 30 minutes to complete. The office was empty, so it wasn’t as though they were backed up with seeing patients. I later learned that while I waited for over an hour, the staff were ordering and eating lunch. Additionally, I am not happy with my results. I look the exact same way that I did before the service. I’ll just consider this a learning experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ramsey Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst and his team are amazing and so friendly! I came in for a septoplasty after being referred by a local ENT and I’m so glad they sent me to Dr. Brobst. Lauren, Hanna and the whole staff were so helpful before, during, and after the procedure. You can really tell they genuinely care about their patients. A full recovery is typically 6 weeks and I was already noticing a substantial improvement in breathing after the 2nd week. Their facilities are top notch and I would argue Dr. Brobst is the best in his field in North Texas, if not the country. Can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Ferguson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst repaired my ear lobe from a tear that was forced apart due to a poor management of wearing earrings. Dr. Brobst and his staff made me feel comfortable before, during, and after the procedure. I would like to point out that his staff was very humble to me and treated me like family. If I ever need this type of service again, without a doubt, I trust Dr. Brobst commitment for a stellar- professional service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antoinette Gayle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst and his entire team are extremely knowledgeable, friendly and talented. I had wonderful results and the process from scheduling to procedure and post-op was seamless!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional experience! I came in for a melanoma removal and repair. The staff was absolutely Fantastic! They fit me into an appointment with Dr Brobst immediately. The three young ladies that staff the office are the kindest, friendliest, and most dedicated individuals you will meet. It seemed like they worked more around my schedule than theirs. Dr. Brobst is a true professional. Friendly and informed, he takes the time to answer any questions, and explain everything in easy to understand terms. He really cares for his patients, and is in my opinion, a craftsman of his profession. I had to leave the country shortly after my procedure, and they followed up with consistent emails checking on my well being and asking for pictures. I am extremely happy with the service and results provided by him and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently underwent the successful removal of a facial lesion on my forehead by Dr. Brobst. The entire staff at Dr. Brobst's office was exceptionally welcoming and compassionate. I wholeheartedly endorse Dr. Brobst for any plastic surgery requirements.

His treatment has made a remarkable improvement.  I could not be any happier!  I highly recommend Dr. Brobst.  You will love his staff too!!

I asked so many questions before the surgery and then during my recovery and he never once made me feel rushed or like I was a bother. He is truly the very BEST!

Dr. Brobst and his staff are amazing! They were always available, answered all of our questions, and they made the process super easy. Highly recommend Dr. Brobst!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst is a wonderful doctor with an impeccable chair side manner. His staff are super friendly and they go above and beyond for their patient's. His office will make you feel like family and not just another patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Dr Brobst. He and his staff took great care of me throughout the entire process of my reparative nose surgery. user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Richards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brobst is absolutely wonderful! I had a serious injury to my lip in January and Dr. Brobst treated me perfectly. He and his staff are welcoming and sincere. I felt very well taken care every time I visited his office. I now have very little scarring from my accident and it's like it never happened! I couldn't have asked for a better doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ren
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Dr. Brobst a few years ago to see about removing an annoying and unsightly birthmark on my neck. He and all the staff were so supportive and welcoming through the whole process. He explained everything as we went and made sure I had as many options open to me as possible. Friends and family have forgotten that the mark was ever there! This all has been an absolute life-changing joy. If I need anything again I will come back to him regardless of distance. I highly recommend him to anyone seeking work done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Medeles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down a wonderful experience no matter what services you are receiving. Dr. Brobst is top notch and is a master at his craft. He listens, explains what he is going to do, and then works his magic, and painlessly! Amazing! Very important, as I’m scared of needles. I love everything he has done for me, the results speak for themselves!  Also, my daughter suffered a dog bite to the lips when she was younger, and Dr. Brobst took care of her and you would never know of her horrible injury. She also sees Dr. Brobst for services.  Cherry on top: the beautiful ladies in this office make my day, every visit. They are always professional, kind, and happy to help you, which serves as such amazing compliment to Dr. Brobst. He spent considerable time showing me options snd explaining traditional surgery techniques and why he does things differently in some cases to benefit his patients. It was obvious he has a lot of experience, knows his practice well and has found what works best in the OR. I also liked the fact he specializes in faces. ( I am scheduled for a face lift and really don’t care how well a doctor does tummy tucks, implants or anything else.) I also liked the fact that he does pre-op fillers and Botox to prepare for surgery. He does all injections personally and with very little discomfort. The one concern I had before meeting him was a bad google review. One bad review…. And yet somewhat concerning. I found by researching and speaking to other physicians that every physician will have at least one unhappy customer-especially in plastic surgery and cosmetics - unless the reviews are from family, friends and their own clinical staff. Meeting him resolved any concern I had. I will leave a review again after surgery but I’d definitely recommend him to all of my friends for filler and Botox!

UPDATE: 5 weeks out of facelift with resurfacing and I am thrilled with my results! I am obviously still healing but already pleased! (My daughter is a physician and was very impressed as well! Her words, “Oh, Mom! It’s the first time your eyes have been the focal point of your face!” - yes, they had been very droopy like everything else on my face.)

The process to full recovery is lengthen but I’m out and about with makeup covering the resurfacing. I still can’t say enough about Dr. Brobst and his meticulous work. I was surprised that he was so available, working me thru any issue  by phone or even working me into his clinic before hours, during hours, etc. Beside the fact he strives for excellence, (and probably hits the mark each time), he is just NICE… and that goes a long way.  The staff couldn’t be any kinder and supportive. I have had not one single minutely negative encounter which I think is pretty impressive considering how many conversations and appointments I’ve had!

This was a hard surgery- I’m not gonna lie, but I had wrinkled so early and was determined to do this when I found the right surgeon. It was a bucket list thing and I’m really glad I went thru it! Thank you, Dr. Brobst, Mallory and all!

When I had a basal cancer discovered on my face, she walked me through the entire process and took care of the final stages of cosmetic closure and healing. People can't believe I ever HAD a procedure, as there is virtually no discernible scar. I recently had some filler work done before my daughter's wedding, and Dr Kerner and staff helped me feel beautiful for the special day.  Dr Kerner always explains things thoroughly, and there is so much benefit from her years of experience. I love her low-key, friendly demeanor that is the perfect pairing to her surgical skill.

I also love the atmosphere of the office. The team always takes time to make patients feel welcome, and there is an air of peace and calm among the entire staff. I agree with other evaluations stating that Jennifer is a wonderful face for the practice - gracious, friendly, super-knowledgeable, and helpful. Hard to figure out where the two negative reviews are coming from! Belinda and Sally are ideal medical staff - experienced and very knowledgeable, efficient and friendly, while again contributing to an environment that is very peaceful and relaxing.

The entire team is the perfect combo for the types of procedures and services they provide. From the first moment to the last, you're getting the best there is! I would go nowhere else but to Dr Elizabeth Kerner!

user_reviews.Name: Fran Slaughter
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Kerner has been one of my doctors since 1990.  We both have done some moving around in those 28 years but, since she's a terrific doctor and person, I've always stayed with her when I needed her expertise and or guidance.  Her office staff is great too, and have been with Dr. Kerner for a long time.  It's been great to have such continuity - especially with her and her Office Manager, Jennifer.  I look forward to going there whenever it's necessary - Jennifer and the other staff are always so bright and cheerful when you walk in the door.  There's never been an issue (insurance, etc.) that didn't get resolved in an extremely timely manner.  Whenever I've needed a referral, Jennifer has been "johnny-on-the-spot" and gotten back with me timely.  Dr. Kerner is one of my most favorite doctors, and her office atmosphere is excellent - friendly, peaceful, relaxing.  What a great office!

user_reviews.Name: Sharee Mosher
user_reviews.Description: I have debated getting liposuction for years and I finally decided to take the plunge.  I had consults with 2 doctors, Dr Kerner was my second consult and 5 minutes into my consult I knew she was the doctor for me.  She and her staff made me feel comfortable with every aspect of the procedure and outcome.  I absolutely love her, Jennifer, Belinda and Sally!! I now find myself trying to find reasons to go in and visit all of them!  They are my plastic surgery family that make me look my best!  Love my liposuction and my Botox!!  If you are debating any procedure I highly recommend her and her staff!

user_reviews.Name: ccrew99
user_reviews.Description: I recently had a breast reduction with Dr. Kerner and couldn’t be more pleased. I’m symmetric and the perfect size. I would use her again for any other cosmetic surgeries. She and her staff were always available if I needed anything.

I am prayerful about my upcoming surgery.

My scar is already minimal and I cannot wait to see the results come Summer

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kerner is the absolute best in her field. She has been "helping me stay young" for 12 years and I don't know what I would do without her. user_reviews_extended.Description: It's been more than 7 years since I lived in the Dallas area. While I've had doctors in two other states, they simply cannot hold a candle to Dr. Kerner. Whether it's a quick facial or something more complex I know I can trust everyone to be courteous, prompt and offer absolute platinum level products and services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Imari
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The front desk staff is incompetent and Karen (Jennifer) went beyond her job duties which negatively impacted my wife’s time line of receiving documents. They also sent her medical records to the wrong email which is a major HIPAA violation and has since been reported to the HHS privacy division.
The office then responded to my wife’s review as if she lied and made it seem as if her handwriting was not legible when they could have called and asked her to verify instead of violating her privacy.
From my understanding the doctor does great work and was pleasant however Karen should be fired until she’s capable of doing her job and minding her business. Transcarent is an added benefit to our health insurance and has been around for years.
When we called to schedule the consultation, the phone was on speaker, and we were informed that the fee was $50. It was apparent that there was a misunderstanding, as it seemed like they were trying to imply that we couldn't hear properly. Given that there are several surgeons in the DFW area who offer consultations for fees ranging from $0 to $50, this did not strike us as unusual.
The individual who responded to the review exhibited a disrespectful attitude and attempted to explain the rise in consultation fees since the 1980s. However, they failed to verify the accuracy of the information before responding.

user_reviews_extended.Description: 9 weeks post op and I am still amazed how blessed I was to have met this amazing team during this journey!

When I decided to get a breast augmentation, I prayed for a good doctor; God blessed me with one of his best!  I am also truly grateful for the wonderful staff who helped me throughout the process. Top-notch service from beginning to end.

I would use her services again and plan on it. (Rhonda Hamon)

user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough about Dr. Kerner.  She and her staff are amazing.  I was referred to her by another doctor who said she is the best in the area.  I wouldn't want to use anyone else.  If you are thinking about plastic surgery she is the one you want.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alethea Crossman
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son had a large suspicious mole . His pediatrician told us to see a plastic surgeon, not a dermatologist. He said derm would shave of top layer & then probably go back & remove rest of it anyway. Plastic surgeon would take out all the first time. We're SO GRATEFUL he recommended Dr. Kerner. She was so so gentle. When injecting lidocaine, she must've taken 2 full minutes to inject the dose. That meant the tissue fully & slowly absorbed it, for my son's maximum comfort. And later, he had a cyst in his eyebrow; you can't even tell where it was removed. She's so compassionate & skilled. LOVE HER!

Dr. Kerner shows she truly cares during every office visit.

title: Roberts Cosmetic Surgery
address: 5144 Village Creek Dr, Plano, TX 75093, United States

user_reviews.Name: Steve Halter
user_reviews.Description:
I had a lower eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty) a few weeks ago. Like most people I received a few consultations and ultimately decided on Dr. Roberts.

Without question, I'm glad I used Dr. Roberts and the results are amazing.

Dr. Roberts bedside manner and surgical experience are unmatched as far as I'm concerned. I cant emphasize enough, that if you're looking around he is the guy to use.

user_reviews.Name: Muzamil Khan
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Roberts is amazing and a thorough professional.
He is very strict about  pre op medical clearance.
There are no sales pitch or tactics involved. He will give you a clear assessment of what he can achieve and set realistic expectations.
And the support staff from patient coordinator to the operating room nurses are gentle and very detail oriented.
I had a great experience. It took me a year to get my medical clearance, before Dr Roberts did his magic on me.
Post op care instructions were very clear and any questions were immediately answered by Dr. Roberts himself.
Thank you for making me looking great.

user_reviews.Name: Linda Mitchell
user_reviews.Description: Having a face/ neck lift was one of the best decisions I've ever made.  The entire staff was welcoming and courteous.  Deborah especially was helpful with explaining everything about the process.  The results were amazing.  It easily took 15 years off my appearance!! I was surprised that I only felt slight discomfort, which eased in time. My friends complimented me, said I looked amazing, yet never guessed i had plastic surgery!! I would recommend Dr. Roberts to anyone who wants to look younger, but without the stretched out look. My turkey neck and jowls are gone forever!! My husband plans on getting the bags under his eyes fixed. Also I must mention the cost is significantly lower than his competitors.  The total cost was 12,700 dollars, for taking 15 years off!! I feel confident having my picture taken. I love getting dressed up for dates knowing I look amazing.  Thank you Dr. Roberts!!

user_reviews.Name: Mary Lynde-Maas
user_reviews.Description: Excellet outcome. My upper and lower lids look wonderful - no more under eye bags, and upper lids loose skin. My neck & chin look so natural and youthful. The anesthesia experience was perfect. Have 2 before pics & one after with glasses. Very flexible for scheduling surgery & appointments.

user_reviews.Name: Robin Johnson
user_reviews.Description: Dr Roberts performed a brow, face and neck lift and I am so happy with the results. The anesthesiologist and staff were wonderful. I highly recommend Dr. Roberts, he’s very personable - and has the cutest dog!

user_reviews.Name: Briggette Downs
user_reviews.Description: Roberts Cosmetic Surgery is amazing! The staff is very friendly and professional. Dr. Roberts is simply wonderful! He is very knowledgeable and takes time to listen to his patients and give them the best results. The ongoing support you receive from them regarding aftercare is top notch. He performed a lower bleph. The results are stunning! I would recommend them to anyone who is thinking about enhancing their facial or any other features. Thank you Dr. Roberts! You are the absolute best!

user_reviews.Name: Yvonne Byrd
user_reviews.Description:
I got a lower blepharoplasty done here in December, 2024. I was 31 and had very mild under eye bags and I thoroughly regret this procedure.
I naturally had a lot of volume under my eyes and upper cheek areas and it was a beautiful look. Naive to plastic surgery or methods, my hope and expectations were to remove the under eye bags while preserving my natural youthful look.

At my consultation Dr. Robert’s spent very little time in the room with me, he did not ask to see a photo before the natural aging process, and he asked me who I got the under eye bags from since I was kind of young for them. I felt very insecure in that room, but looking back I realize I did not need the surgery and there are far less invasive methods of targeting a little under eye sagging. Of course, this man is running a business and his job is to treat his patients, but my main concern here is that he employs antiquated methods for lower blepharoplasty.

Upon further research (sadly, after the fact) most surgeons reposition the fat, instead of removing it. This preserves the volume and natural contouring.
He just completely took mine and now my whole face looks different, especially my smile. I now hate taking pictures and worry how my face will age with the very generous volume loss that was stripped from the area.

My face isn’t botched by any means, but I wish he had spent more time with me asking me questions and getting to know what my expectations were. The only thing he had mentioned was “it’s not going to get rid of the lines.”
What he failed to mention was that it would greatly exaggerate the line that ARE there, and add NEW lines with the generous volume that was removed. My volume (some women spend tons of money to get) is gone, and I now look 5 years older than before the surgery and it’s devastating.

For reference, these pictures are taken exactly one year apart. 31->32 years old.

If you are considering lower blepharoplasty at this clinic, I would reconsider and choose a surgeon who truly cares.

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Roberts does excellent work! The natural yet younger look is exactly what I wanted. I’m so glad I went to him for a facelift.

I highly recommend Dr. Roberts to anyone considering plastic surgery. Their expertise and dedication to patient satisfaction are truly exceptional. Thanks Doc!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very pleased with the service I received and very pleased with Dr Robert and his entire staff. I had a great experience with my surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Samantha Gallardo
user_reviews.Description: Dr.Tittle and his staff are top notch. He is truly an expert in his craft. I had a breast augmentation done October 2025. They look so natural and beautiful. Cecelia was very sweet as well - I also had lip fillers done here. I am not a fan of needles at ALL. Even vaccines make me nervous! But Dr. Tittle was so gentle. The only thing that shook me a little was when he was all done and I felt a cold wipe on my face, so you know they did such a great job at numbing. If you want to enhance natural beauty he’s the one to go to. He won’t upsell you like other surgeons which I like. I inquired about two other things I was interested in, and he gave me his honest opinion. I truly appreciated that. Most drs are in it for the money and will just do whatever you ask even if it’s not any good for you. I will always come here for anything I need done. - As long he’ll let me! :)

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I first met Dr. Ben around 2017, and it has been a while since then. Over the years, I have visited various professionals for facial care, but I was often dissatisfied with their lack of thorough explanations. That’s why I decided to make a change.

Dr. Ben stands out because he takes the time to explain every procedure before performing it. He doesn’t just do what a patient requests—he carefully considers whether a treatment is suitable based on biological and facial structures. As a middle-aged Asian male, my facial structure differs from other ethnicities, and Dr. Ben made sure to educate me on what would work best for me. I truly valued his expert advice and took it seriously.

Now, visiting his clinic has become an enjoyable experience, and I go about two to three times a year. Dr. Ben is not only highly skilled but also easy to talk to, providing great feedback and genuinely caring about his patients. He listens to what they want while ensuring the best possible outcome.

I am deeply grateful for his professionalism, expertise, and dedication. He is a great doctor and a true gentleman.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Forbes
user_reviews_extended.Description: My surgery was on September 22. 2022 with Dr Tittle. I had liposuction of the chin, upper arms, 360 middle/ flank area. I was a larger patient (250 pounds at that time) and had even been turned away from other facilities.  For me, my image was extremely bruised as I had already lost a ton of weight. The staff was extremely welcoming, and Dr Tittle listened to exactly what I wanted. He gave me realistic expectations and let me know what was going to happen every step of the way. My surgery was extremely easy with no complications. The nurse was very helpful to get me fitted for my compression garments before the surgery. The staff and Dr Tittle followed up with me even after I was completely healed. It has been a little over a year and I can confidently say I am far beyond pleased with my experience. I now have definition in areas that I never thought I would, and I have also continued to lose weight. (Almost 50 pounds now!) I can not thank Dr Tittle and his staff enough!
