user_reviews_extended.Name: savannah farren
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have really debated on sharing my experience given I have been going to and speaking so highly of this salon for some time now.
I booked an appt for highlights with a stylist that had previously given me some amazing results. I do not get my hair dyed often if ever bleached and she was the first person to do this for me. Recently I had (it will not allow me to say ) and was looking to just do something nice for myself. So I booked days out for a Saturday and was called and informed the stylist I originally booked with would not be able to do my hair that day and they gave me the option to rebook another day or go with another stylist. I explained that I was attending an event that Monday and would rather not have to cancel. So they put me with a new stylist Joanne. She was kind and I showed her the inspo I had previously at this salon and even asked if there was a list of what the other stylist had used on me in the past. She said yes and told me she wasn’t sure what toner though.
After the first process I wasn’t happy with it and contacted reception to let them know my concerns to see what I could do to achieve the color I wanted after already spending close to $200! They asked for photos and explained that it would be free of charge and her mentor would also be present to observe her through this next process. (No mentor was present)I come back in and show her more detailed photos of what I would like and ask if it’s achievable after the color my hair is now which felt more orange/yellow. She then asked her manager and explained to me that she could only do a partial of a partial for free and initially only did 25% the top of my scalp which needless to say made it worse and did not blend or even come close to what I showed or was trying to achieve the first time around. What’s funny is she asked to do a before and after of her results but never once asked for the after even though she took the before. Shows me she was unhappy even with her own results. I was so upset and embarrassed I told her I didn’t like it and felt as if I was at a loss I couldn’t afford to fix it so why speak up? After some consideration I called and asked to speak personally with the manger ( no one wants to be that person ) explaining and already feeling intimated that I feel I’ve been wronged in this process not even sure how she got my hair to this color in the first place trying to simply express my concerns while showing her my hair which speaks for itself. She handled the situation well only saying what I could do to fix it but not how bad it was or the uneven spots that were undeniable but unfortunately stated I would still have to pay to have the hair to be fixed on the 3rd time then asked me what could I afford I then told her I didn’t really have the money to go through the process again and how hesitant I was to let someone touch it again.. she then quoted me at $150 for a different stylist and explained how good she was.
I worked hard and got the money up, showed up a few days later and met my saving grace. But there’s always a catch seems like. Get there and the amount of damage that had been done to my hair wasn’t fixable “apparently” now for $150 and that’s all I really had to spend. Ava asked me what was I okay with spending confused I looked at her telling her I had already been quoted 150 for the 3rd fix attempt on my hair. Almost in tears being presented with this while I’m in the chair already been reassured by the manager my hair would be fixed and the price would NOT change for the services or required to make this right, it did. By that point I realized it was no fault to the stylist Ava but management who wasn’t present that day. Ava is hands down the sweetest woman I’ve ever met and still made sure she was able to accommodate me within my means, I still had to pay more than I was quoted (another $200) but at that point I was so embarrassed and wearing a hat all the time I was willing to do anything to just fix my hair. So after about a total of $450 I was able to get what I came in for originally.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blinera Shurreci
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in for their promotion of the NeoGen treatment and did the eyes and lips. I understand that one session is not enough to see results so I cannot say much on that right now.
During the treatment, I expressed concern for the lines on the arch of my eyebrows. She suggested babytox and I took her advice and went ahead with it. The results of the babytox made the problem worse. A problem that was knocking down my confidence, made me feel even more uncomfortable in my own skin.
I tried reaching out and letting the spa know that I was unhappy with the results. I texted them and I was given a dismissive reply. I emailed them but no response. Apparently, it was a ‘no-reply’ email. Lastly, I decided to DM them on instagram, and the owner (I believe) simply asked for my name to check on it, but never replied back anymore after that, even when I wrote her again to check in, but she left me on ‘seen’.
I am very disappointed in how I was treated when I tried to express my dissatisfaction, and I even sent images to show the results. I guess they only want you as a customer as long as you don’t complain. The only reason I gave them 2 stars and not one, is because the technician was actually very sweet, but the company should have tried to correct her mistake, and instead ignored me.

If anyone needs a stylist I recommend her , don’t get me wrong the environment here is amazing and everyone here are extremely nice when I was waiting her they keep asking how I was doing and if I needed anything to drink. Amazing place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Helena has been my stylist from day 1. She's passionate about her work, very good at communicating and loves helping me look and feel my best. Hands down I trust her implicity.

user_reviews_extended.Description: The med spa is great! Kara is the best. She was able to recommend effective solutions. 5 out of 5.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love my hair! Today I had extensions and a dye job done. Went to copper and added depth colors with a copper orange. Scarlet was AMAZING! She was so kind, understanding and very knowledgeable. My extensions turned out phenomenal as did the color. I will definitely be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LeAsia Nation
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10000/10. Erin was great and I loved the experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maricruz R
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time at unicorn and Natalie was amazing from the start! Amazing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Kamath
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I used the NeoGen promo that was advertised on Instagram. The provider that I saw was very nice, professional and most likely did a great job (can't say for sure bc it was only one session).

At the end, however, I was offered the chance to sign up for Affirm for $3800 to continue treatment. Now I will take responsibility and say that I personally should have left then and said "I'm going to look into this... I'll get back to you."

That being said, at the same time I've never been to a provider that shoves an iPad in your face to check to see if you're eligible. Extremely pushy. And now that I think about it, other medspas that I've been to will accept payment plans DIRECTLY and not force you to use Affirm or other loan services.

I have good credit... and am now disgusted because I have notifications from Experian and TransUnion over this.

Additionally, I received no documentation from the spa OUTLINING the treatment. Just an email saying "Thanks for paying $3800," and a follow up appointment date.

Not sure what they do here with hair but they're not running the aesthetic part of their business like legitimate medspas. HUGE REGRET.

I also checked the Affirm site. The purchase has not been made final yet. And guess what. The manager isn't available to speak until TOMORROW. Probably waiting for the purchase to finalize. And they're telling me no refunds.

title: Dr. Ben J. Tittle, M.D.
address: 10743 Preston Rd, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

user_reviews.Name: Christine Villafana
user_reviews.Description: I scheduled my breast reduction/lipo back in July. Each time I made payments and/or came in for my pre-op consultation the staff was incredible. I like that Dr.Tittle is direct when speaking. I had my surgery 1/8/26 and feel so good about the results so far. I definitely recommend Dr.Tittle compared to the other surgeons I saw prior to him for consultations. He was by far the most thorough and didn't shame me for my pre surgery body like some of the other doctors I went to before him.

user_reviews.Name: Michelle Soriano
user_reviews.Description: Dr Tittle is a very talented Dr!  I’m 100% happy with my Aveli treatment on my legs and buttocks.   I plan on working with him too for various procedures for my face.  Nice bedside as well, would recommend him all day long.  The staff is very kind and diligent about their work.  Wonderful experience.

user_reviews.Name: NukSuKow
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t thank Dr Tittle enough. He’s patient with me even though I can be a little ocd. He’s got a great eye for what needs to be done and what should be left alone. He’s very conservative in his approach which I appreciate a lot because so many others over fill for the sake of greed. Every doctor obviously wants to make money for the time they’re putting in but he seems to genuinely care more than some other places I have been in terms of doing the right work rather than extra nonsense.

He basically got rid of what seemed to be a festoon and lingering over amount of filler in my under eye that was messed up from another place overfilling along with some light touch ups in my temple region that were a bit hollow. Happy with my results. Thanks.

user_reviews.Name: Amy Steele
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been going to Plastic Surgery of Texas for years and truly wouldn’t trust anyone else. Dr. Tittle is incredible — he’s done my injectables and he just gets what you’re trying to achieve. His work is always subtle, never overdone, and he has an artist’s eye for detail. Looking forward to a lift/reduction this fall!

Mary has totally transformed my skin. I used to struggle with a lot of hyperpigmentation, and now my skin is clear and actually glowing. She’s also been doing TruFlex treatments on me for a while, and I swear my muscle tone has never looked better. She knows exactly how to target specific areas — it’s like personal training but for your muscles, and way more efficient. You’ll have visible abs in months if you stay consistent and let Mary guide you through the process of increasing tolerance to the procedure.

The best part? It doesn’t feel like a sterile med spa — it feels comfortable, welcoming, and familiar. But at the same time, you know you’re getting care from the best in Dallas.

user_reviews.Name: L Sparks
user_reviews.Description: Being someone with high anxiety and never dreaming of having a procedure done… let me tell you, this is your staff and doctor. From the very beginning Lori went above and beyond to make sure I knew everything and answered all questions I had without hesitation. I felt a calmness over me that is rare (going in and up to the procedure.) I traveled from out of state for Dr. Tittle because of the great things I’ve read and I now know that this is where I would always go. When my anxiety started setting in the amazing anesthesiologist and nurse jumped right in with meds and support. Such a laid back and wonderful experience. The staff now feels like family and it was sad to leave. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

user_reviews.Name: robin elizondo
user_reviews.Description: There aren’t enough good things that can be said.  I was so hesitant to do anything to my face.  I was nervous and scared to have a needle near me.  The entire staff instantly put me at ease. From the minute I walked in there for the first time I knew I made the right choice.  Dr Tittle showed complete professionalism and sensitivity to my fears.  I could not have been more pleased and thankful.  I will never go to anyone else.  Thank you to the entire team.  Y’all are amazing!!!

user_reviews.Name: Kimberly Gorman
user_reviews.Description: Dr.Tittle and his staff are amazing!! This is my second surgery with him and I had great experiences. Dr.Tittle has amazing bedside manner, he is very knowledgeable and assertive to all needs and questions. His staff was the same staff as my last visit about 4 years ago and that was really nice to see the familiar faces. Erica and Lori are so sweet and went above and beyond for my needs and comfort. I really appreciate everyone who helped me and I recommend Dr.Tittle and his staff. I'll see you guys on my next adventure. Thank you.

user_reviews.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Tittle for your plastic surgery needs. I was impressed by the instant comfort I felt with him. The day of my surgery they ensured my comfort and my results are amazing. After researching and consulting 5 other surgeons I am thrilled with my decision! The level of care you will receive here will far exceed your expectations. His work is the best! I love his work is done onsite at his private surgical center. You are not just wanting your turn, you are the star of the day.

user_reviews_extended.Description: If you want to look for the best care and top quality plastic surgery service as well as achieving your aesthetic goals, choosing Dr. Tittle and his staff would be the wonderful choice for you. I'm speaking from my own experiences of spending 2 years looking for a surgeon who is caring and listening to his patients rather than someone who got my money and left me with a botched result from my first surgery. Words cannot say enough how thankful I am for how much work Dr.Tittle had done to not only fix my botched result, but also gave me a new body that I can't help smiling everytime I look into the mirror even when I am not fully recovered yet; I have already seen the wonderful thing happening to my body for choosing Dr. Tittle as my plastic surgeon. The anesthesiologist Doctor who helped me go to sleep and the Nurse who cared for me during the surgery are super nice and caring. All of his staff are friendly, professional and caring. I think I can write a 10 page essay to describe how wonderful it is about my positive experiences of plastic surgery done at Dr. Tittle office and being taken care of so well. I hope writing this honest review can help many people who are looking for a top quality plastic surgeon because I have experienced how terrible it was to have chosen a bad one !! I am so joyful about my decision to choose Dr. Tittle !!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr. Tittle from a good friend, who went to him after another surgeon had botched her procedure.  I actually had a botched breast lift that was 20 years old and and I was very cautious about another surgery and surgeon.  From the front office staff, to the nurses, to Dr. Tittle himself, my experience was more than five stars.  I could not be any happier with the surgery and the results.  For the first time in my life, I am not ashamed of my chest.  Thank you so much to Dr. Tittle and staff for making, what could have been a traumatic experience, an awesome one.  Dr. Tittle was always quick to respond to all of my questions (and I had a lot of them).  I felt 100% confident going into the OR and I absolutely love the results. I will definitely recommend him to anyone I know looking for an amazing surgeon.

Dr. Tittle and his team are by far the BEST in Dallas!
I recently had a breast reduction and it was a very complex surgery after taking out and reducing 20 year old saline implants. Dr. Tittle under promised and over delivered far beyond my expectations as there was extra cavity space, stitches and work he had to perform. I am healing perfectly and every post op has been great. Many Thanks to Dr.Tittle and his wonderful team at the Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas for my new, improved, smaller, lifter and perkier tata’s!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was headed to Austin for a mommy makeover and my niece who had a BBL had the worst experience ever admitted to the hospital for weeks unable to contact the doctor who performed the surgery and everything went down hill from there.
So I canceled my appointment and this happened, the best thing ever. I researched Dr. Tittle through google, and took my chance on the reviews, his credentials and affiliations.
My experience has been nothing below exceptional from the office staff to the hospital crew including the best anesthesiologist ever.
They all assured me I was in great hands. I never expected to have a tummy tuck, breast reduction
/lift and Lipo with no pain.
I’m so thankful for Dr. Ben Tittle he made this body over for me and the results are astounding.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candice Bond
user_reviews_extended.Description: If there were 1000+ rating stars I would give to Dr. Tittle and his staff.  I suffered from a preexisting c-section with horrible painful scar tissue as well as painful post-partum menstrual cycles.  A few years post pregnancy my monthly cycles were disabling.  I needed a hysterectomy.  I am a regular patient of Dr. Tittle for botox, facial care etc – so I discussed with him if he would be able to do a tummy tuck on the same day my hysterectomy was scheduled with my OBGYN. Health and also repair the skin laxity due to my pregnancy and c-section was a win win.  He discussed the procedure with my OBGYN in detail and I was scheduled for my hysterectomy and abdominoplasty on a Thursday morning.  By Friday evening, I was walking around and now 6 days later I am able to move around without pain medicine.  Of course, I am taking it easy but the result is better than I could have ever imagined. I cannot say what an amazing plastic surgery Dr. Tittle is, he handled my very difficult procedure with skill and precision.  His experience and attention to care and detail is the best in the country. I will recommend him to all my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Rosenthal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Tittle is knowledgeable and an extreme professional. He listened to my concerns and made recommendations based on my needs.
I really didn’t need a plastic surgeon for what I needed done (laser for sun damage and injectables), but heard he was the best and that was important to me. And he was extremely kind and friendly. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenda L
user_reviews_extended.Description: After 20 years of excellent service and care,  I can highly recommend Dr. Tittle and his staff.  Dr. Tittle has a very caring demeanor and does the very best for his patients. He is highly skilled not only in plastic surgery but with injectables and the latest in laser procedures.  He listens to his patients and is very truthful in the results you can expect.  Dr. Tittle and his staff have been together for many years.   The office and his surgical suite are proficient in all areas with regard to the patient’s well being.  Dr. Tittle has been the best for me with cosmetic procedures, injectables, and even skin cancer.  Dr. Tittle  is a perfectionist and that’s what you want in a plastic surgeon!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have used Dr Tittle twice for two different surgeries in a span of 15 years and each time he has been amazing, professional and treats every patient as if they are his only patient and doesn’t push ideas that are overly plastic surgery suggestions!!

The staff at his office are great and very friendly and help whenever needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexa Conomos
user_reviews_extended.Description: There is no one like Dr. Tittle! He is one in a million - an incredible doctor and a wonderful human being. Give your trust to Dr. Title, Mary, Lori Erika and the rest of the staff ~ they won't let you down. Dr. Tittle brings incredible energy, creativity, artistry and passion to his practice - he is expertise and professionalism personified. Dr. Tittle is also always investigating the latest techniques and technology, but you'll never experience him trying to "upsell" a product or procedure to you. In fact, he's the kind of doctor who will tell you that you actually "don't need something." He is integrity and kindness is both refreshing and invaluable. When you go to see Dr. Tittle and the crew, you may even feel like you're around family. Mary is a miracle worker if you're looking to perfect your skin in any way. Overall, the office is a happy, warm environment, which runs efficiently and professionally. If you are looking for a doctor and office you can trust, go no further than Dr. Tittle and his people. They are top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough good things about Dr Tittle's office and staff, especially Mary Samuel. My acne scars, fine lines, and wrinkles have vanished. My skin is so soft and smooth now and I can't thank the amazing Mary enough. Even if you're interested in her awesome microderm facial, I can't recommend Mary enough. Thank you Mary!!!

The nurses are genuine and caring, they talk to you like a person and not just a patient. Dr. Tittle openly communicates with me in common terms I can understand as a layperson. I absolutely recommend him for any plastic surgery you might be thinking about!

BEST PLASTIC SURGEN OF DALLAS HANDS DOWN!

Her results have been stunning, I would trust no other MD, MedSpa, or Plastic Surgeon with my wife!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen W
user_reviews_extended.Description:
For years I have been scarred by the cellulite on the back of my legs, and this is not an exaggeration.  It had caused me to cover up and not feel comfortable in my skin.  I have explored a number of options to try to remedy it, which included Cellulaze, endermologie, creams, contraptions to massage it…you name it.  As I was reading the American Academy of Dermatology website to review cellulite treatments and doing research on RealSelf, I came upon Cellfina and Dr. Tittle.  From my initial research, I could tell Dr. Tittle had more experience in treating cellulite than many others, which was an important factor for me.

While I was excited about the potential outcomes, I was certainly trepidatious.  I have been hopeful before.  At my consultation, Dr. Tittle was honest and frank.  He explained things in plain English and gave me a realistic assessment, which I greatly appreciated.

At this initial consultation, I also talked to him about my newly forming “bingo” arms.  My arms were now taking on gravity.  He talked to me about BodyTite, which would require a little lipo but would also tighten my arms over time.

Fast forward to today, which is three weeks post surgery.  I am over the moon with my results and wanted to provide insight as to what I have learned for anyone considering Dr. Tittle and/or these type procedures.  I could not have asked for a better outcome for both my cellulite and my arms in just a short amount of time – all while knowing my results will continue to improve.

Dr. Tittle is a perfectionist, which I can relate to and admire.  On the day of surgery, he drew circles on my legs.  He then turned off the lights and looked with another light to ensure he did not miss anything.  To be triple sure, he also had another person look over my legs once again making sure not one dimple would be missed.  Finally, he printed the pictures to show me exactly what he found and how he was going to execute his meticulous work.

Throughout this process I have learned that the doctor you select will also determine the amount of bruising you will endure post surgery.  At three weeks, I do not have any bruising left.

Finally, I learned so much about Dr. Tittle throughout the process.  Here are a few things I believe are noteworthy when considering important decisions like this one. His anesthesiologist has been with him for 28 years, which speaks volumes to his loyalty and business practices.  Also, Dr. Tittle teaches both internationally and has doctors come from other states to learn from his insights and experience.

Overall, I am grateful for my results and the hand holding throughout the process.  He is one of a kind in an industry where I am mostly skeptical. I would give Dr. Tittle a glowing review and recommend him to all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Infante
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tittle is the ONLY person I trust with any injectables, laser or surgical procedure. He and the entire PST team (Dallas & Frisco) are true professionals that take their job seriously. Ben, Nance, Mary, Bethlehem, and David are incredible! I've even sent my own mother to Dr. T. I've seen him for the last 5 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony vezario
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dear Dr. Tittle,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express some concerns regarding my recent experience at your practice during my wife's breast reduction consultation.

Upon arrival, we encountered several issues that left a lasting negative impression. As a business owner myself, I understand the importance of prioritizing the customer experience and maintaining high standards of professionalism. It is concerning to see these aspects overlooked, particularly in a field where attention to detail and patient comfort are paramount.

I urge you to consider the importance of providing a positive environment for your patients, both in terms of aesthetics and overall experience. Investing in the upkeep and modernization of your practice demonstrates a commitment to patient care and satisfaction.

I appreciate your attention to these matters and trust that you will take them into consideration moving forward. Your patients deserve nothing less than the best possible experience when seeking medical care.

Thank you for your time and attention to this matter.

title: Dr. Raja Mohan Plastic Surgery
address: 7777 Forest Ln c820, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

user_reviews.Name: Maria Klaus
user_reviews.Description:
After having two babies, I had been thinking about replacing my breast implants for a long time. It’s a big decision, and I wanted to be absolutely sure about who I trusted. From my very first consultation with Dr. Raj, I felt comfortable and confident. The consultation was detailed and never rushed, and his staff was consistently responsive and kind.

The day of surgery was incredibly smooth and well organized. Having the procedure done in Dr. Raj’s own OR at his Medical City office—where I had already done my consultation and pre-op—made the entire experience feel familiar and much less intimidating. Everyone was warm, professional, and genuinely focused on keeping me at ease.

The pre-op and post-op care were excellent, my recovery has been exceptional, and the results are exactly what I hoped for. Dr. Raj has a great eye for detail, and I would confidently recommend him to anyone considering a similar procedure.

user_reviews.Name: Jose J Castillo
user_reviews.Description:
Whitney is an incredible injector. Her skill, attention to detail, and professionalism really stand out. She takes the time to listen and carefully studies your anatomy so the results look natural and balanced. If I bring up something she doesn’t think I need, she’s honest and explains why instead of just trying to sell services, which I really appreciate.
As a male client, I’ve felt out of place at other med spas, but here I always feel comfortable and welcomed. The whole team is friendly and accommodating, and they offer flexible payment options which makes treatments easier to manage.
I’ve had Botox and hydrafacials here and have been very happy with my results. I’ll definitely keep coming back and highly recommend, especially Whitney.

user_reviews.Name: Amelia Castillo
user_reviews.Description:
I had my surgery about seven weeks ago with Dr. Raja, and it has been an excellent experience from start to finish. I am extremely pleased with the results of my abdominoplasty. Not only did he successfully repair my muscles, but he also helped restore my confidence and improve how I feel about my body.
I’m truly happy with the way I look. Dr. Raja and his team are friendly, professional, and always ready to answer any questions. I highly recommend them to anyone considering surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Leah S G
user_reviews.Description:
I spent *a lot* of time and effort researching plastic surgeons in Dallas and am 5-stars pleased with my results from Dr. Raja Mohan (aka Dr. Raj), three months post-surgical procedure (since this is a public review, I prefer to not say which one). I chose Dr. Raj for multiple reasons:
1. I saw that he completed the DPSI Fellowship, which is a super prestigious and competitive program nationally – anyone graduating from this is going to be incredibly skilled.
2. He is a board-certified plastic surgeon. Very important!
3. His bedside manner is kind, friendly, informative, and calm. There are a lot of arrogant male plastic surgeons around here (IYKYK) and I’m not into that.
4. His location is convenient and he has his own on-site surgery suite. I felt safe going under the knife.
5. His pricing was more than fair. I’m not looking for bargain basement deals on surgery; I expect to pay a reasonable price for high-quality work. That said, Dr. Raj and his team are competitively priced and certainly exceeded my expectations. Worth every penny.
6. His office staff exemplifies professionalism, expertise, and caring customer service. I had 24/7 access via text to the team and when I had an after-hours concern a week after surgery, they connected me to Dr. Raj at 11 PM on a weekend night. My well-being and peace of mind were his priority.
I highly recommend Dr. Raj and his staff!

user_reviews.Name: Katie Todd
user_reviews.Description:
Whitney at Dr. Raja’s office is extremely talented! I had my lips done for the first time and she made me feel so comfortable and confident and I LOVE the results.

Dr. Raj is a body sculpting artist! I had a mini mommy make over and he did an incredible job. He replaced my implants, did 360 lipo of my abdomen, flanks, back and arms. My body looks better than it did in my 20’s! My recovery was easy, results look fantastic. He truly cares about his work and how you feel. His office staff has been on top of everything and I would recommend him to anyone interested in any sort of plastic surgery. He’s the best of the best.

user_reviews.Name: CHRIS GARCIA
user_reviews.Description: First time seeing Whitney to do my lips. My lips are always so uneven naturally so a lot of injectors don’t want to help me, however, Whitney is such a professional and an artist. She has given me my confidence back. I’ve been getting compliments non stop! Whitney is so sweet and welcoming. She is also very knowledgeable and educated me. I will be back next month for Dysport. Finally an injector in Dallas who I can trust. Thanks Whitney.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Thatcher
user_reviews.Description:
I want to leave a review about Dr. Raj for being the compassionate human he is, not just the surgeon. I did not have surgery by Dr. Raj due to a very unfortunate finding during screening. However, the very day I received the bad news he called me that night after he was in surgery all day. He called to see what I understood about the findings and offered to connect me to resources. He called to check on me. He didnt have to do this as I am not really his patient anymore, but he did. I generally feel in my heart that he is a good man and you don't see these actions by physicians very much these days. So thank you Dr. Raj for simply caring.
If you are looking for a surgeon that sees YOU not just the cash associated with you coming in its Dr. Raj.

She’ll always let me know what may be too much for me and that for me is always a bonus in an injector when they are honest about what will work with my face!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Loves Mommy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I initially chose Dr. Raja for numerous reasons.  The most important being that he is board certified, not all plastic surgeons are. I am a question asker and a researcher. I really do my homework before I let anyone performe any work anywhere on my body. The last thing I want, or need, is to end up on the TV show "Botched." I also believe you have an intuition for a reason and after meeting with Dr. Raja in person it just felt right.  He took his time, was on time (a HUGE pet peeve of mine is respect for my time), and he answered every single question I had. He showed me plenty of photographs and gave his advice on what procedure would work best for my desired result. He is also very meticulous pre-surgery, as well, which some might find "bothersome" or "annoying" but I applaud him for this trait.  He made sure all blood work was complete, he reviewed my medical history in detail and made sure I was healthy enough for the surgery.  He isn't a doctor that will simply "take the job, to make a buck." If you don't qualify he will turn you away. His work will prove his talent but this, in itself, proves his great character. I now not only have found a wonderful plastic surgeon but a friend as well.  I know I can count on him if I ever need him medically for anything in the future.  A good doctor can be found anywhere but a great person is just icing on the top.

I highly recommend anyone considering cosmetic surgery to book a consultation with Dr. Jejurikar.

user_reviews.Description: I cannot say enough about how amazing Dr J is and his entire staff!! My sister and I searched the country for the best Dr to suit our needs and thankfully found Dr Jerjurikar and staff and flew to Texas to get our surgeries. He listened to my needs and wants carefully and patiently while I asked a million questions. He is thorough, thoughtful, kind and has an amazing bedside manner as does every member of his staff and the after care facility. I felt safe (most importantly), heard, confident and very well cared for from start to finish. I was never rushed through any part of the process and always felt like Dr J and his sweet amazing staff cared deeply about me and what I wanted to accomplish. Dr J doesn't have a god like attitude like many plastic surgeons do and was very kind, warm and it was clear that he wanted me to end up with the exact results I wanted. I am beyond happy and so satisfied with my results, I looked way better than I ever thought I could! Thanks Dr J!! Dr J or his staff were with me every step of the way and their follow up, concern and care made the entire process so pleasant, comforting and safe. Their safety protocols are far above any surgeon I've used and I felt so well cared for I was sad to leave them and go home. If you are looking for a top notch expert who will be meticulous, never rushed, thoughtful and caring especially if you have any complications from prior surgeons he is your guy. Every single scar is hidden and nobody has a clue I ever had any surgery (he fixed issues other surgeons left me with) and have gotten so many compliments I can't help but rave about dr J and give him all the credit which is well deserved. His staff will make you feel so cared about and taken care of you won't have a worry in the world and will consider them extended family by the end. Both my sister and I will be traveling back to Texas for all of our needs and will never have to look for another surgeon again. Thank you Dr J and staff!! user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Slate
user_reviews_extended.Description:
By nature , trust isn’t my strong suit . Before meeting Dr. Jejurikar , I’d read his reviews . One never really knows if they scrub the bad ones or incentivize the good ones , so skepticism set in .
I’d met with several other plastic surgeons , before Dr. Jejurikar . Meh . Big egos and nonexistent bedside manners .They also wanted to do extra things to my face that I wasn’t interested in .
Enter,  Dr. Jejurikar ——( cue to imaginary music playing ) Right away , I liked him and his PA Collette. He genuinely listened, let me know what I could expect as far as results, explained the process and really had an extensive conversation about the procedure . By the end of the consultation, I knew there was no reason to look into any other surgeons.

He’s very down to earth , super friendly and kind of down plays how good he is at his craft . In a society where most people are overrated , Dr. J, is underrated and I think it’s because he’s so humble . He makes the surgery and aftercare all about you . There’s no interjection of an ego or feeling like he’s rushing you or pressuring you . He doesn’t have an attitude that he knows best , even though he does.

While you may not think it matters if you “ like your surgeon” , you’ll be having lots of follow ups , and it’s a drag  to be around someone so often in the beginning, when you’re recovering and not feeling like yourself yet .
.
From the anesthesiologist ( I’m sorry , can’t remember her name ) , to Tammy ( the night nurse at surgery ) they were flawless . I had a 6 hour surgery under general and woke up not nauseous which is a first for me . The aftercare from Tammy was outstanding. Really loved her ! She’s the best nurse .

I’m almost 6 weeks out and now the results are beginning to really show and I think “
He didn’t tell me it was going to look this good!” Literally ! My results are beyond my expectations and it’s still early in the process of healing .

Dr. Jejurikar has expertise and integrity . That’s a winning combo for your best results . , Let him do what he knows best , he’s an artist . Trust the process , have a good attitude going into it ,and even if you’re a pain in the butt , he’s going to hold your hand and reassure you . Try not to be a pain in the butt though . . Your results will probably exceed your expectations!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Colemam
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Jejurikar  (Dr. J) and his staff was nothing short of amazing!  I recently had Breast 'Ex-plant' surgery to remove the implants I have had for over 33 years.  I have never written reviews of any kind before, but felt overwhelmingly compelled to share my experience.  I have been suffering for quite some time with an Autoimmune Disease, Causing me severe fatigue, weakness, depression etc... My number one goal was to have my implants removed as soon as possible. I believed that my implants were a major cause of my symptoms, and could be a major contributor to my Autoimmune Disease.  When I began researching  doctors who specialize in the En Bloc procedure to remove implants,  there were several Doctors who performed this type of surgery, and they were all booked out 6 months or longer.... I could not wait 6 months.  When I contacted Dr. J's office and explained my situation, Dr. J got me in for a consultation within a couple days. While meeting and talking with him, he was very understanding and compassionate of my concerns. Although his schedule was extremely full, Dr. J and his staff did their magic, and  arranged for my surgery within 1 week!.  Dr. J explained in detail what he would do for me, in a  straightforward manner and then performed the surgery without any complications in his state of the art facility.   It has now been 2 weeks and I am truly amazed that I have had literally no pain or discomfort at all. Dr.J did an OUTSTANDING job! such perfection, he is an extremely talented / gifted Surgeon! He removed the entire capsules (En-Bloc), with a lift, and I look and feel Great!  Dr. J and his staff are wonderful! I give him 5+ stars, and highly recommend him to anyone considering this type of surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Burroughs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been thinking about writing this review since BEFORE my surgery!
I personally didn’t have a lot of friends or family that openly talked about having “work” done. So I researched as much as I possibly could, read many reviews of Doctors all over the nation, watched every YouTube video I could get my hands on, and studied each doctors work. I wanted to feel safe. I knew myself enough to know this also would be a big Psychological journey. Not just a physical one. Seeing my body that birthed and fed 3 kiddos look different, after 16 years Would I regret it? Was it worth it?
I’ve waited 6 months to write the review, just so I could really give an honest one! With hopes someone might be reading this, that is experiencing the same types of anxiety and worries, as I did before choosing. So let’s get to the good part!
When I met Dr. J the only word I can give you is absolute Peace. His workmanship is done so precisely with a touch of medical artistic beauty. (If that’s not a thing, then Dr. J invented it!)
To top it off, he is one of those rare people that you just know, they are doing what they are put on this earth to do, and he seems joyful, and at ease to fulfill his purpose. To simply help people!
If you decide to go with Dr. J, which I highly recommend, TRUST him on your journey of healing. He knows what he’s doing! I promise! There wasn’t a moment where he hasn’t been fully invested, and on top of my healing. He wants the best for us, and I sincerely thank his family for sharing him with us as I know he puts so much time into his patients! Thank you Dr. J for changing my life, and my confidence! I’m forever grateful to you for your kindness during my healing.
Oh, and a side note once you have “work” done you find out you actually DO have friends,  and even family that have had “work” done, but are ashamed to admit. I’m very inspired to open that conversation more honestly, and give them all Dr.Js name and number. No shame in treating yourself to something that could genuinely change your life from the inside out!
Thank you to everyone in the office as well! Sarah, Collette! Laughter with you, was the best medicine for me thank you for being so on top of everything, and always patient and kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Dr. J. After years of considering if I should move forward, I decided to research for the best doctor. After months of research I kept coming back to Dr. J. Moved forward with my consultation and he made me feel so comfortable. 2 weeks out and I'm amazed with my results. Dr. J is such a humble person and is very knowledgeable. He gave me the best advice that best fit me. I would definitely do it all over again. Dr J is just amazing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chan Carey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted a breast since puberty was supposed to happen. I was always told just wait they would come, and sure enough after two children I was convinced it would never happen without help. I started working in a hospital  about 4 years ago, which put me in touch with several plastic surgeons. Ill admit I went to several consults before choosing Dr. Jejurikar, but none made me feel as important like I wasn't just another dollar. The day I went in for my consult he had just come in from a flight. I'm sure he was tired, but he came in was very friendly, he made me happy I had chosen his office. Not to mention the staff was wonderful they made me feel very comfortable as well. You would think they see patients everyday would just be like whose next, like I experienced before. Instead, they were very warm and welcoming. Dr. J is absolutely awesome. He wanted to make sure I was comfortable with the size I choose and that I still looked natural. Misty (his Nurse) didn't rush me and answered all my questions which meant a lot for a person who was shaking in her boots. I left very happy with my choice and very excited that I had finally scheduled my surgery date. A couple days before the procedure his office called to make sure all my questions were answered and that I was comfortable. They called in my prescriptions and told me what time to come in the night of my surgery. The morning of I walked in very nervous but the staff of the surgery center was so pleasant I was relieved. My anesthesiologist Dr. Stone who was also superb, walked me back got me comfortable. Dr. J came in marked me and I was down for the count. I went back to work 6 days later.  I'm about 67 days out now and I could not be happier! I feel whole! I have some of the prettiest breast ever. They look and feel very natural. They move and I cant even see a scar. If I have to do it again I would! If someone asked who I would recommend for any plastic surgery procedure I would surely recommend Dr. J. He is the best. Not only does he do a phenomenal job he is a great person that cares. I'm 1000% satisfied. Thanks Dr. J,  I look great!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sam Jejurikar truly has a gift. I have had the ring around of doctors for the past 4 years. Everyone telling me nothing is wrong. I instantly felt better, finally some really happiness. No wonder why I felt terrible and moving was a struggle. I had a slow heal but a very healthy healing. Im not 18 anymore  so it took a little more time. I couldn't be more grateful towards Dr. Jejurikar and his staff. He did was no doctor was willing or could do and found the solution.  He is the best doctor in Texas. His staff is top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Guzman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Jejurikar isn’t just a surgeon but he is an amazing, compassionate, and caring person. To me this trumps all the other surgeons in the area. Each one would come in and make sure I was ok, they all talked to me like I was a family member. I wanted for nothing while I was in their care. Then Dr Jejurikar came and checked on me and spent time with me the exact same way. After going home the day before my 1 week check I had ran into some issues with my drains and there he was again on the phone with me with complete reassurance. After seeing my body, and seeing the work my amazing doctor has done… I am overwhelmed with happiness and gratitude. I can’t even put into words how emotional I was about the entire situation and how happy I am with my results. I wish I could spend a whole day thanking you for the amazing work that you have done. I will forever be grateful for you and your staff. Much love to you guys. And for anyone that took the time to read this. Don’t go anywhere else for your cosmetic needs. This is the place!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Review by an extremely satisfied patient!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jejurikar came with high praise and recommendation from several of my colleagues. They had received several services from his office ranging from minor touch ups like Botox and fillers, to breast augmentation. Everyone spoke so highly of him, and they were always gushing about their results! So I made my appointment, and was not disappointed! I would recommend anyone who wants their services. The result is spectacular. I feel confident in who I am. Thank you Dr. Jejurikar and your team

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After losing 50% of my body weight by diet and exercise alone (yes, I’m beaming), I was left with quite a bit of excess skin that caused health issues and was inconvenient and made it painful to move about.

The surgeon that performed my hernia surgery highly recommended Dr. Sam Jejurikar. After checking out reviews and having an initial consultation with Dr. Jejurikar I was very impressed with his bedside manner. I am normally pretty shy about my body, and felt totally comfortable with Dr. Jejurikar. I went ahead and scheduled a body lift procedure in October of 2016. Dr. Jejurikar went over all the risks of the procedure and made it very clear that I would be sore, and that it would take quite a while to heal. As promised, I was sore for a fair amount of time, but Dr. Jejurikar and his office were always very prompt to answer questions and reassure me that recovery was progressing exactly as expected.

After I had recovered completely from my body lift surgery, I went ahead and scheduled the leg lift surgery to address all the excess skin on my legs in August of 2017. user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sam Jejurikar is an amazing surgeon! My brother acquired a pressure ulcer (bedsore) on his tailbone at a hospital in Missouri during a serious illness. As a result, he acquired ICU myopathy.  The bone under the bedsore then became infected. To survive, he needed surgery. This was a life changing event for my brother and his entire family. He can now focus on the remainder of his recovery.  We are very grateful that Dr. Jejurikar was my brother's surgeon. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had Gortex lip implants put in 20 years ago, and 10l years ago they started to retract on my top lip.  Gortex lip implant removal can ruin your natural lips, and most Doctors do not want to take them out, due to possible damage.  In attempt to fix the problem, I’ve had fillers by different people/Doctors, and it never looked normal, and sometimes looked much worse.  Most injectors are not used to injecting fillers in a patient that has Gortex implants (and yes I’ve tried different kinds of fillers, in hopes one would work better.  I researched and found Dr. Jejurikar, and made an appointment to see if he could help me.  I was, and am so impressed with this Doctor, his bedside manner, his staff, and the time he took with me during the consultation.  He actually decided to go ahead and do the procedure after the consultation.  He gave me a dental block, then used a small tool, and went into my lip and separated the scar tissue from the Gortex strands.  This made a small channel in the lip to assist in proper placement of Juvéderm, as well as make the lip less “firm” feeling.  It’s impossible to inject fillers in places where there may be a lot of scar tissue, and expect it to look good!  After he did this procedure, he injected Juvéderm Voluma (2 syringes) and the results were amazing, compared to what I was used too!  It’s now two weeks later, and the difference is unbelievable.  Happy!  So, for the ones out there, that made this same mistake with Gortex implants, you need to go to Dr. Jakar for a consultation.  Thank you Dr. Jejurikar, you’re a miracle worker!!!

user_reviews.Name: Heather Lierman
user_reviews.Description:
My experience with Dr. Meade and his entire team has been 10/10!! As a 40 year old mom, I’ve spent the past several years hating my body. Even with consistent working out and healthy habits, I could not make the changes I so desperately desired and was so self conscious! The struggle to accept my body was difficult.

Once I met with Dr. Meade for a consultation to discuss possible options, my mindset started to shift. He made me feel so comfortable and was extremely thorough in answering any and all my questions. I knew he was an extremely skilled surgeon because I’ve seen his work firsthand, but he is also an incredible person and truly cares about his patients.

We decided I would benefit from a breast lift with implants to restore the volume I had lost while breastfeeding/aging and abdominal liposuction.

Here I am almost 3 weeks out and couldn’t be happier!! My results are FIRE 🔥 and at my suture removal appointment, I looked in the mirror and started crying. Happy tears!! It threw me off guard. I think it came from a place of feeling that as a mom or even as a woman getting older, I had to accept and be ok with the changes in my body even if they happened for good reason (birthing babies). I finally saw a glimpse of the old Heather at that appt. and I am thrilled!

I would recommend Dr. Meade to anyone and everyone. He is worth his weight in gold! If you want skill, results, AND bedside manner- you got it with him.

His staff- Allison, Maria, and Shannon are solid people and an amazing team! They are all so kind, informative, and made sure to walk me through every step of the way. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience!! I knew my results would be good, but they have far exceeded my expectations!!

Thank you Dr. Meade and team for changing my life! I am forever grateful!🤍

user_reviews.Name: Candice Gunn
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Meade and his entire team. Getting a breast reduction is something I had wanted for years, and choosing Dr. Meade was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. The size difference has truly been life-changing, I felt instant relief in my neck and back.

Beyond the physical relief, I absolutely love the way I look now. My proportions feel right, and clothes finally fit my body the way I always hoped they would.

Dr. Meade really listened to my goals and took the time to explain everything in a way that’s easy to understand. I was feeling nervous in the weeks leading up to surgery, but both Dr. Meade and his nurse, Allison, were so reassuring and supportive, they truly put me at ease and helped me feel confident going into surgery.

Maria was incredibly kind and responsive. She made the financial and insurance side of the process clear and stress-free, which made the entire experience even better.

I would highly recommend Dr. Ricardo Meade to anyone. I am beyond grateful for my experience and my results.

user_reviews.Name: Robin Diffee
user_reviews.Description: It is my joy to  recommend Dr. Meade and his outstanding team.  In 2012, I was blessed by Dr. Meade’s expertise and care with my breast reconstruction after mastectomy. To this day, he remains unmatched in skill and professionalism. His warmth makes him approachable as a physician, and he is a kind human being.  My upper eyelids had become increasingly heavy over the last several years, but Dr. Meade and his team recently cared for me to address this issue.  I am grateful and happy to have the twinkle back in my eyes. Recovery from the blepharoplasty was easy, and my entire countenance is refreshed.  If you are on the fence, know that Dr. Meade has earned my trust. I believe he will earn yours, as well.

user_reviews.Name: Leanne Dawson
user_reviews.Description:
6 Weeks out and feeling fabulous! It's hard to put into words how grateful I am for the care I received from Dr. Meade, his RN Allison, and the entire staff at this practice. From my very first consult through surgery and recovery, I felt completely supported, informed, and genuinely cared for.  Dr. Meade combines extraordinary surgical expertise with a calm, thoughtful approach that immediately puts you at ease. He took the time to thoroughly explain the process and answered my questions with patience to ensure I felt confident and comfortable with my decisions. His depth of knowledge and attention to detail are truly exceptional. I knew that I was in capable hands. His RN Allison is equally wonderful. She is incredibly compassionate, responsive, and attentive.  Whether it was answering questions, checking on my progress, or offering reassurance during recovery; she went beyond to make my experience smooth and helpful. The entire staff deserves recognition as well!  Every interaction was warm, professional, and organized.  They create an environment where patients feel welcomed and cared for rather than rushed and impersonal. Six weeks out and I am so pleased with the results!
Surgery and recovery can feel overwhelming, this team made the entire journey feel safe, supportive and positive. I am deeply thankful for their skill, kindness, and dedication to their patients.
If you are considering surgery and want a surgeon who pairs exceptional technical expertise with genuine compassion, go and see Dr. Meade!

user_reviews.Name: Janet Conner
user_reviews.Description:
I am 16 days post-op from a lower, mid facelift with a temporal brow lift, and I couldn't be happier with my experience.
From the very beginning, Dr Meade and his entire team, Shannon, Maria and Allison, made the process feel easy, comfortable, and incredibly supportive every step of the way.  Their pre-op guidance was invaluable, so much so that I was mother of the groom shopping on day 4!   A heartfelt thank you!  Dr Meade listens and delivers natural results - I look like myself, just younger and refreshed which is exactly what I wanted.  The post-op care was outstanding!!!   When it comes to something as sensitive and personal as your face, I highly recommend Dr Meade.

user_reviews.Name: Melanie Grubb
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Meade is absolutely incredible—from his amazing administrative staff to nurse Alison and the entire care team. His attention to detail and commitment to patient comfort are truly unmatched. From the moment we walked in, I felt completely at home.

Dr. Meade is calming, reassuring, and exceptionally skilled—his work is nothing short of amazing. I had a full mommy makeover, and I couldn’t be happier with my results. I’m six weeks post-op and still obsessing over how wonderful this team is!

I also have to give a huge shoutout to my anesthesiologist—he was incredible as well and made the entire experience seamless.
Thank you, Dr. Meade, and to your entire staff for such an outstanding experience. I truly couldn’t recommend you more. See you in six months!

user_reviews.Name: Shelby Jackson
user_reviews.Description: My entire experience with Dr Meade and his fantastic team was nothing less than exceptional. From the consult, to the surgery, through recovery challenges, and the final results..simply outstanding!! My natural looking, beautiful results speak to his superior surgical skills but even more impressive was his friendly bedside manner and unwavering support. Look no further, this is the place for you!

user_reviews.Name: Sharon Brown
user_reviews.Description: I have used Dr Meade several years ago for my initial breast reconstruction after NSM.  Results were great! Fast forward 15 years, I needed to have implant exchange.  Again, results were amazing and Dr Meade is compassionate and caring.  He never rushes through a visit and always takes time to listen and reassure.  Allison and Maria are also compassionate and friendly, couldn't be nicer! I wouldn't go anywhere else, they are the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Lynam
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot thank Dr. Meade and his entire office enough for the incredible care I received. After injuring my face while out of the country, his team got me in immediately, which meant everything during such a stressful situation. Dr. Meade truly went above and beyond—he took the time to carefully assess my injury and expertly restore and improve upon a mediocre job that had been done at an emergency center.

I am so grateful for his compassion, skill, and attention to detail. Just as impressive was his office staff, who handled every part of my care with such care, concern, and precision. From start to finish, I felt supported, listened to, and genuinely cared for. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Meade to anyone looking for exceptional medical care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Tarpley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recently diagnosed with IDC breast cancer, and since this was my second battle with it, a double mastectomy was recommended.  My breast surgeon referred me to Dr. Meade for my reconstruction, and I am now recovering from the first surgery.  I am beyond pleased with the results.  Dr. Meade was honest, reassuring, and forthright in recommending the approach he felt would give me the best outcome-and he was absolutely right.  I cannot say enough about the care, precision, and genuine concern he showed throughout this process.  His skill and compassion made an incredibly difficult experience so much easier, and I am truly grateful for the exceptional results and the support he gave me. Thank you Dr. Meade!! You are the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerry Wilkinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my third procedure with Dr Meade. I can’t stress enough the level of care I have received from Dr Meade and his staff. They go above and beyond for their patients. The office staff is awesome especially Maria. I would highly recommend Dr Meade for anyone looking for exceptional care before, during and after your surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Harder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am beyond grateful to Dr. Meade and his incredible team. For years, I avoided taking photos because I just didn’t feel confident in how I looked. With my child’s upcoming wedding, I wanted to finally feel comfortable in front of the camera—and thanks to Dr. Meade, I truly do. Loving my facelift!
From my very first visit, Dr. Meade was kind, patient, and reassuring. He explained everything clearly and made me feel completely at ease throughout the process. His skill, artistry, and attention to detail are truly remarkable.
The results of my facelift have exceeded all expectations. My eyes look refreshed and beautiful, and the overall effect is so natural—I still look like myself, just brighter and more youthful. For the first time in years, I’m actually looking forward to taking photos and capturing memories at the wedding instead of hiding from the camera.
Dr. Meade is not only a gifted surgeon but also a compassionate doctor who genuinely cares about his patients. I can’t recommend him and his wonderful staff highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Metzger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a reduction done with Dr. Meade and have been so happy with the results. Maria and Allison have been so extremely helpful every step of the way, and made the process as enjoyable as possible. I have felt very respected, listened to, and cared for the whole time. The results are better than I could have imagined or asked for, so I would recommend Dr.Meade and his team to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Swifty Tam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade & his entire team are amazing! They take the time to truly connect with you & genuinely care about you as a person. I can’t imagine going through my breast cancer journey without Dr. Meade & his fabulous team. Whether you are needing reconstruction surgery due to breast cancer or elective plastic surgery, he’s THE BEST! 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddie Hamilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a septo/rhinoplasty with Dr. Meade and everything was phenomenal. I’m thrilled with my result and can’t believe how amazing it looks. Not only that, but Dr. Meade has the most incredible team. You won’t regret coming to see him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Dobson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade and his staff are the most amazing group of people. So kind and understanding of their patients needs. No question is a dumb question. 😊 Made me feel relaxed from the consult appointment through each post op follow up. Very pleased with his work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Garber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meade did an amazing job! He is very detailed and skilled and I am so happy with my results removing 20+ year old implants. (My husband is very happy too!😊) I would definitely recommend him to others considering that procedure. His team is very kind and attentive as well. It was a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: RachelErika Design
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went back and forth for years before deciding to move forward with surgery and was very particular in choosing a surgeon. I am incredibly impressed by Dr Meade’s professionalism and attention to detail. He and his staff went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable with the process from start to finish with extremely clear communication.
I would 1000% recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly DeVaughn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a medical professional of 25+ years. I’ve seen many, many plastic surgeon’s up close and personal. I took my choice of surgeon very seriously. Dr Meade is not only a great technician, but also a down to earth and genuinely good person. I immediately felt comfortable and reassured during my consultation.
Thank you Dr Meade and thanks to his staff who were professional, kind and efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Meade and his staff. I had a brow lift and Upper Blepharoplasty in August of 2024. I’m thrilled with the results. I chose Dr. Meade because he listened to my concerns, the outcome I wanted and he was very professional and kind. His staff is wonderful as well. Also the results of my procedure are natural looking, which I’m happy about. I look refreshed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Sabugo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is amazing! From the very first visit, he made me feel comfortable and really listened to what I wanted. He understood me right away and went above and beyond with my results—I love him so much! His whole team is also incredible, they made the entire process easy and supportive. I felt comfortable every step of the way. Truly grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 16yo had a breast reduction with Dr. Meade in May. She just completed treatment and tells me daily how happy she is with her result. Maria, Allison, and Dr. Meade have been so kind, knowledgeable and reassuring, focusing on her self-esteem and confidence. She is very pleased with her results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Runnels
user_reviews_extended.Description: Seamless and easy experience! Staff is super kind, and Dr. Meade immediately put me at ease where I never even got a second opinion. His bedside manner is fantastic. I’m extremely happy with the results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Areli Venegas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love Dr.Meades office! Dr.Meade is very attentive and always makes very friendly.
Maria is always so kind and nice. Really recommend Dr.Meade if you are wanting the best results for your surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Temple
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to share my appreciation for Dr. Ricardo Meade and his exceptional team. Fourteen years ago, Dr. Meade performed my first BA, and when it was time for a revision, I didn’t hesitate to return to him. He is consistently professional, highly skilled, and genuinely cares about achieving the best outcomes for his patients. His staff is equally outstanding—professional, kind, and always ready to help. I also sought opinions from friends in the plastic surgery field, and everyone spoke highly of Dr. Meade’s expertise and reputation.I’m so grateful for a smooth experience with no issues or problems throughout the process. I highly recommend Dr. Meade to anyone considering plastic surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: H E
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My overall experience was phenomenal! Dr. Meade is a spectacular surgeon and truly takes the time to listen to his patients. His professionalism and dedication shine through with the outcome of surgery. His medical staff is also top notch. I have never met a more caring and dedicated nurse. Allison, did an amazing job of answering all my questions and making sure I felt comfortable with everything before and after surgery. Maria, was always kind and did great at explaining benefits, insurance, financials, etc.
I highly recommend!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Charanza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is one of best in Dallas. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. His staff is amazing, too. They are professional, kind, and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Carpenter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I knew I wanted to have my broken nose fixed from the time I was a girl, (in my 40’s now), and Dr. Meade was so great. He helped me come up with a realistic surgical plan as I wanted to look like myself, only in proportion, and I wanted to breathe better through my nose.
On surgery day the staff made me feel at home, the anesthesiologist and Dr. Meade took considerable time to talk to me and my husband and address any questions and concerns we may have had.
We felt confident in Dr. Meade and his team and we were well taken care of pre and post surgery care.
If you’re looking for a knowledgeable and skilled surgeon who really cares about his patients, I highly recommend Dr. Meade and his team. I am so pleased with the results! Worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Day (PlaneO)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I first met Dr. Meade I had nothing, I was completely flat chested.
I started off my breast cancer journey at 41 yrs old with a different surgeon. I had several complications & infections before I completely had my implants removed. By that time, I had already had 4 surgeries with that surgeon.
Fast forward, 3 1/2 yrs later, I was referred to Dr. Meade. I thought initially that there was no hope in my breast reconstruction. Dr. Meade has been extremely kind, genuine & compassionate to me. I'm so grateful to have met him! He has been honest and upfront with me on everything, letting me know this is a process & to be patient. I'm learning again to trust & I trust Dr. Meade completely! I am also thankful for his staff, Maria & Allison who have been kind & compassionate as well!! They have all been truly a blessing to work with! Thank you all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaylyn Schumpert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently made the decision to have a full breast augmentation (reduction, lift, and implants) and this surgeon right here is AMAZING (and has the best hair)!! This  surgery was very personal and from my consultation all the way through my surgery and after, he and his staff never made me feel anything but absolutely comfortable and confident in each and every step. He talked me through every option, answered all my questions and told me his recommendation as if I were a member of his own family. To say I am happy with my results is a huge understatement... I LOVE my new tatas. If you are considering ANY type of plastic surgery, I highly recommend contacting his office 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daphney Murillo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I stepped into Dr. Meade’s office, I knew I was in exceptional hands. Dr. Meade is not only a truly spectacular surgeon, but also a compassionate and attentive professional who genuinely takes the time to listen and understand his patients. His calm demeanor, thorough explanations, and unwavering dedication were incredibly reassuring throughout the entire process. The results of my surgery far exceeded my expectations—his skill and attention to detail are truly unmatched.

Equally impressive was the outstanding medical staff. Every member of the team was warm, welcoming, and highly professional, but I want to especially recognize both Allison and Maria. Allison is the nurse who guided me every step of the way. She was an absolute gem—so kind, knowledgeable, and patient. She answered all my questions with care, no matter how big or small, and went above and beyond to ensure I felt completely comfortable before and after the procedure.

And then there is Maria Alvarez. I can’t say enough great things about Maria, the Patient Coordinator and Office Lead. From my first interaction with her, she was warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful. Maria took the time to clearly walk me through all the details regarding insurance, financials, and the benefits available to me—something I truly appreciated.

She made what could have been a confusing process feel simple and manageable. Her kindness and professionalism really stood out and made me feel well taken care of every step of the way. If you're considering a procedure here, I highly recommend working with Maria—she’s a true asset to the team!

I can’t recommend Dr. Meade and his amazing team enough. Their expertise, compassion, and commitment to patient care truly set them apart.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Privitera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is world class! Cannot recommend him enough! He is beyond talented, knowledgeable, efficient, honest, kind, and an overall incredible professional. He and his staff made my procedure (breast aug + lift) a walk in the park - even through an unforeseen routine post-op complication (to no fault of his) that could have put me back in the OR. Dr. Meade called me personally the night of my surgery to make sure I was comfortable and stayed responsive through every step of the way. Six months post op and would do it all over again! Will be seeing him for ALL cosmetic procedures from here on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie- Zoomin Groomin Greater Fort Worth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm about 7 weeks post op from a breast reduction, lift, and neck lipo and I'm thrilled with the results so far! Dr. Meade is extremely talented and has awesome bedside manner and his entire team (Maria, Shannon, and Allison) are amazing! Would HIGHLY recommend 🎉🎉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn Cunningham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not only am I a mother of 3, but I began a health journey 10 years ago and lost over 80 lbs and built good strong muscle tone. But I was never able to fully appreciate all of my hard work as my tummy just would not go away. I was referred to Dr Meade by a very good friend and I'm so glad that I listened to her. Dr. Meade took the time to listen & understand what I wanted and guided me through the process of my "Mommy Makeover".  I am so happy with the results and now wearing a bikini for the first time in my 52 year life!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather McNamara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a breast reduction with Dr. Meade, and I would recommend him to anyone looking for an outstanding experience.
From the moment I walked into his office, his staff (Chelsea, Maria, and Allison) were warm, very informative, and helpful in every way!  Upon having my consultation with Dr. Meade, I felt comfortable and absolutely confident that I was making the right decision about the procedure, and that Dr. Meade would be my doctor.  He is very warm and makes you comfortable, while providing excellent information in a professional, easy to understand manner.  Once I confirmed I would be having the procedure done with Dr. Meade, his staff got everything planned out with me, walking me through everything right through the day of my final post-op visit.
On the day of surgery, everything went very smoothly.  Again, everyone involved was phenomenal!  Dr. Meade called me that evening to check in, which was very much appreciated.
My post surgery visits have been very straightforward and helpful.  My healing has been easy.
Most importantly - I feel amazing!  This has been life changing, and I am VERY pleased with my results.  If you are going to have this procedure, I highly recommend Dr. Meade.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Makena Couture
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Dr. Meade! After having a terrible surgery a couple of years back, I was searching for someone to help. He listened thoughtfully and provided a couple of different treatment options. I could not have been happier with the results. He is understanding, thoughtful and intelligent. Highly recommend!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Dawson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chose Dr. Meade to do my tummy tuck and breast lift because he did such an amazing job on my mother’s DIEP flap breast reconstruction. I was not disappointed! I have felt so supported by Dr. Meade and his team throughout this process. Allison and Maria are so sweet and took the time to answer my questions and offer advice. Dr. Meade is so nice and made me feel like I was in good hands, especially on the day of the procedure when I was so nervous! And of course, the results are even better than I ever expected! I feel so much more confident and beautiful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddie Webb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
