My breasts looked and felt terrible and Dr. Meade did a fantastic job taking out my old implants and reconstructing my breasts. They almost looked like I hadn’t done anything at all! I went back to him to put implants in again and he truly has given me beautiful breasts and restored my confidence! He was completely transparent through the whole process and is really an artist in how he does his work. I could not be any happier with the results and really feel like a new woman! His staff is absolutely amazing as well and so kind. Maria is such a delight and easy to work with. I love everything about my experience with Dr. Meade!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Haskell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I chose Dr. Meade to be my plastic surgeon for my double mastectomy reconstruction and I'm SO happy I did! He is phenomenal at what he does. I cannot say enough good things about my results and this office. Dr. Meade listened to my concerns and what I wanted aesthetically and he exceeded all expectations. I was not an easy case by virtue of radiation complications and Dr. Meade has made me feel confident through his balance of aspiration for the best aesthetic results, honesty, and caution.

ALSO his staff is absolutely amazing- Trish, Angela, and Shay made my entire experience so comforting and their hospitality is so wonderful! So quick to respond to phone calls and emails and they always have done their best to accommodate me with scheduling and questions I've had. I never once felt like my concerns were a burden to either Dr. Meade or his staff, which is SO important! They are amazing! My results are amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A Truly Exceptional Experience!

I can't thank Dr. Meade and his incredible staff enough for the exceptional care they provided me during my recent journey. As a 47-year-old who had lost weight over the years, I decided to say goodbye to the saggy skin beneath my chin and opted for a deep plane neck lift. From the get-go, Dr. Meade and his team made me feel comfortable, answering all of my questions (multiple times, I admit! Lol!)  and ensuring I was completely comfortable with the procedure.

Seriously, I cannot emphasize enough how amazing Dr. Meade and his staff are! From the moment I walked into their office, they treated me like a cherished friend. Dr. Meade addressed all of  my concerns and I felt like I was in the hands of a true expert who genuinely cared about my well-being. Shout out to Dr. Meades nurse,  Allison for answering my questions after surgery and putting my mind at ease. Thank you so much!

Fast forward to today, just two months post-op, and I am very pleased with my results!

To sum it all up, I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Ricardo Meade and his entire team for their exceptional care and remarkable results. They made my journey a lighthearted and enjoyable one, and for that, I'm grateful. Thank you, Dr. Meade and your incredible staff, for taking such great care of me!

With heartfelt thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerry Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meade came very highly recommended, after three consultations, I understood why. I wasn’t feeling well and began to be suspicious that my 22-year-old implants may be the cause. With that in mind, my back killing me, and feeling extremely lethargic, Dr Meade helped me to develop a plan of action. I felt totally at ease and trusted fully in Dr Meade’s abilities and experience with my very particular situation. I am so happy with my results and will be recommending Dr Meade and his caring and professional staff. The whole experience from start to finish was utterly amazing! Thank you, Dr Meade, Heather, Maria and Allison… you’re all superstars to me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren E
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended to Dr. Meade and had an incredible experience with him and his team - Dr. Meade, Allison, Heather, Maria, and everyone who assisted with my surgery were all so kind and helpful throughout the entire process. The results of my surgery were even better than I imagined. I can’t praise or thank him and his team enough for their amazing work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaTau Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy that I chose Dr. Meade over the other doctors. At first, I had decided to go to another doctor, but when Dr. Meade's office returned my phone call I was so pleased with the customer service just to schedule my consultation. Dr. Meade stood out over the other doctors because of his knowledge and honesty about what results I should expect. He and his staff made me feel comfortable and the communication with the staff was excellent! I am very pleased with my results and my experience! I highly recommend Dr. Meade!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Dendinger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was diagnosed with breast cancer one year ago after my annual mammogram and I was devastated. The anxiety of the unknowns of this journey was far more terrifying to me than the diagnosis itself. I reached out to women I knew who belong the “pink club “to ask for recommendations for a medical team. Dr. Meade’s name came from two independent recommendations. After my first consultation with him, I did not feel the need to look any further.

Dr. Meade is everything I was looking for in a physician. His calm and caring demeanor immediately put me at ease, and he patiently explained what needed to be done and the sequence of each procedure. He was honest and open about what to expect and assured me that patience with the process would yield the best possible results. He was right.

Dr. Meade genuinely shared my excitement as I looked towards the end of treatment and my final surgery, I could not be happier with my results.   I feel put back together again physically, emotionally, and spiritually. .

Dr. Meade is a highly skilled surgeon. Other doctors (including my oncologist and dermatologist) have complimented his work. His staff also follows his lead. They are kind and caring as is he. I highly recommend Dr. Meade and look forward to returning to him for an elective procedure soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Hosier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade and his team are amazing.  Patient care is the top priority for them.  They explained the procedures to me in detail so that I could make an informed choice.   I had a thigh lift  and upper eye lift.   I am 100% pleased with the results and my after care.   I highly recommend Dr. Meade for any procedure you are considering.😍😍😍

user_reviews_extended.Name: CD
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Meade and his team. I ran into an emergency situation post-op and Dr. Meade made sure I was taken care of 100% of the time. He truly cares for his patients and staff. Please do your research before solely basing your decision on the lowest cost provider - this is a life changing investment & Dr. Meade stands by you 100% of the journey. Love you guys! Thank you for changing my life. ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Arias
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely LOVE Dr Meade and his staff. I’ve been to him twice and each time has been an amazing experience. Ive been in constant communication with Maria and let me tell you… SHE. IS. AWESOME!!!! She’s been there every step of the way! I couldn’t be happier with my results and honestly, i don’t think I’d ever pick another surgeon. 5 star people from top to bottom. thank you all!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Fenn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade and his staff were excellent to work with and help me achieve my goals from start to finish! I researched my options for almost 5 years and am so glad I went with Dr. Meade. I already have friends asking to go see him based on seeing the great work he did on me and knowing how well his staff took care of me. Best decision ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Hosier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade did an amazing job!   I had recently lost a lot of weight and being older, there are a lot of opportunities for improvement. :)   During my consultation, Dr. Meade set realistic expectations for me on what we should do and so I had a tummy tuck and a breast lift.   I am very happy with the outcome.  Dr. Meade's staff is also top notch.  You are in good hands all around with this practice.  I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Sotelo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is the most professional and detailed oriented surgeon I know. I’m extremely happy with my results. Dr. Meade made sure my concerns and question were answered. Recently had my earlobe repair and couldn’t express how a small possibly to others minute surgery made a difference in my life. The staff is extremely friendly and treat me as family. All a professional A team !

user_reviews_extended.Name: BRENDA TORRES
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10 will recommend!!!  Dr. Meade is so attentive and answers all of your questions and concerns. Not to mention his staff, they are all so wonderful. They make you feel at home and give you a sense of security from start to finish.  Best part is I love my results🤩. The only regret I have is not coming to him sooner.  Going to Dr. Meade for my breast augmentation  was the best decision for sure!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosa K. Villegas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade and his staff are amazing! I have never had major surgery but Dr. Meade took his time to answer all my questions, addressed all my concerns and put my nerves at ease. The entire staff was so personable. Dr. Meade was professional, explained every step and made the journey, beginning to end, absolutely incredible. Everything was easy to book, pay and prepare. Never was I rushed or made to feel like I was just another patient. They even helped me with FMLA paperwork. I feel and look great! thank you!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennette Cate
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meade and his staff are wonderful!  I had a breast reduction and couldn't be happier with my results.  I will be back for a tummy tuck by years end! Dr Meade is warm and caring and wants the best results for his patients! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vu Group
user_reviews_extended.Description:
THIS IS THE #1 Plastic Surgeon in Dallas!

Dr. Meade and his team were great to my mom during every visit - from her consultation, surgery, and post surgery. She looks amazing, feels amazing, and her quality of life is where she wished to be again at her age.  We would like to thank Dr. Meade, Maria, Katlin, Holly and Heather for everything.  We would also like to especially thank Holly for making every visit pleasant with her professional and kind energy.  My mom was excited to see Holly for all post op appointments - her bedside manner is top tier and she did not rush which made us feel comfortable that our mom was always in great hands.  Not only do you want to find the right surgeon, you want patients to have the best experience while going through any type of surgery. Dr. Meade is honest, works with integrity, compassion, and not to mention all of his hard earned creditability.  We have visited many doctors and this by far has been the best office as whole.  Dr. Meade truly cares for each patient so it's no wonder why he and his entire team is the best to choose in Dallas. Every detail matters, thats why choosing a surgeon as detailed orientated as he is important. We are so grateful to become one of his lifetime clients + referral to anyone who is leaning towards plastic surgery.  Thank you all for going above and beyond as well as displaying how the medical industry should be! -Vu Family

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Przano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would highly recommend Dr. Meade! He performed my reconstruction after a bi-lateral prophylactic mastectomy and his work is exceptional. He takes great pride in what he does and is meticulous in his attention to detail. I met with another surgeon before deciding to work with Dr. Meade and really appreciated how he outlined the possible options, pro's and con's of each and gave me advice as if I were his family member.

I also cannot say enough good things about Angela! She is truly one of a kind and the level of service she provides is second to none. I have never worked with a more caring and responsive professional in the medical field and she has made my experience truly fantastic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade and his staff is incredible. I love my results and could not have asked for a better result. My scars are very thin and belly button looks so natural. Heather and Allison in his office were so easy to get in touch with and ask questions. J would recommend Dr. Meade to all my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Morton
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5 STARS x A MILLION! For anyone that is considering a procedure I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Meade! I searched for 18 months looking for the perfect surgeon that fit my needs. I had a tummy tuck and lipo and I am so incredibly happy with my results. I knew Dr. Meade was the one for me within a few minutes of meeting. He had a great welcoming demeanor, was very honest w what he thought I did / didn’t need, and most importantly made me feel comfortable and never once made me feel rushed. I am beyond grateful to him and his amazing staff for the time and care they took with me before, during and after. True professionals from beginning to end, they talked thru concerns, & welcomed me into their office to be checked out when I had concerns during the healing process. The BEST part is that Dr. Meade always made himself available to talk post surgery w my husband & I when we had questions. He checked in numerous times post surgery to make sure pain was under control and I was doing ok. Anytime I had a question I texted him directly and he responded and took action immediately every single time! Nurse Allison is an angel! Calm, sweet, & very knowledgeable. All the ladies at the office are truly wonderful. I just love all of them! So helpful and kind!  Dr. Meade, you are an incredible talent, an artist, and I can’t thank you enough for making me look and feel so AMAZING! THANK YOU!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DJ Cawley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I contacted the Dallas Plastic Surgery Institute to schedule an appointment with Dr Meade to discuss Rhinoplasty. From my initial contact, I was impressed with his office. My call was promptly answered by a friendly and professional person who booked an appointment for me.

When I met with Dr. Meade, I was struck by his ability to put me at ease. I have not met a physician, let alone a surgeon, with such a friendly, unassuming countenance. His expertise was quickly apparent. His warmth was as surprising as unquestionable. I believe his kindness is simply innate in his character.

During the consultation, Dr. Meade was fully present, not preoccupied or in a hurry to get on with his next appointment. We discussed my desires & expectations. He was honest about what he could achieve & the challenges. I was not only impressed by & appreciative of his honesty, but this further instilled my confidence in him.

By the end of our time together, I was ready & excited to move forward. Without reservation, I entrusted my nose into the care of Dr. Meade’s expert hands!

During the initial appointment, I also met Allison, Dr. Meade's nurse. She has a cheerful disposition, is a highly skilled, and caring nurse. Allison offered support & was readily available throughout the pre and post operative process.

Before leaving, I met with Maria. She assisted with the financial  arrangements. I can't say enough about my first & continuing impressions of Maria. I instantly liked her & similar to my experience with Dr Meade, I felt very comfortable with her. She has a friendly, professional, straightforward manner. She is bright, self-possesed & kind.

Dr. Meade was painstaking in addressing my greatest concerns. It was obvious he had taken time to consider an approach to the challenge my case presented in order to succeed in giving me my heart's desire. He went above & beyond to achieve a result beyond my expectations! I cannot adequately express my gratitude to Dr. Meade. Suffice it to say I am ecstatic with the results!

Dr. Meade is your surgeon for Rhinoplasty and any of your plastic surgery wishes!

user_reviews_extended.Name: M. Elizabeth
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love Dr. Meade and Allison 🥺😍 - the whole staff is great, but Dr. Meade and Allison have literally the BEST bedside manner. They are thorough, kind, they listen, they have helped me through some post op issues with my body not wanting to take sutures. I couldn’t be more grateful for such a patient surgeon and nurse. I love the way they take time to explain things and make you feel comfortable. I never feel like they are rushing to get through.

So grateful for them 💓💓

I would give 20 ⭐️’s if I could 🩵

I’m in the middle of healing, but I’ll post pictures when I’m a little further out 💟

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Mathison
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING experience from start to finish. Dr. Meade and his nurses were absolutely professional and made me feel 100% comfortable. The results turned out far better than I could've hoped, and I would highly recommend Dr. Meade and his staff for any plastic surgery needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carmen Verdes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I do not typically write reviews because I'm very particular on who I give my trust to but I'm making the exception for Dr. Meade. First thing I want to address is the staff is welcoming and warm, especially Angela, who answers any concerns that I had right away. Dr. Meade is not only a excellent surgeon, he is a skilled artist that exceeded all my expectations. I have done extensive research before choosing Dr. Meade and I am confident to say that he is a terrific doctor who is committed to his work and delivering the best surgical results. I feel heard, cared and comforted by him and his staff with any questions and concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Celines Shipley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meade and all of his staff go above and beyond expectations. My mom is older and he was very careful to make sure her health was safe for surgery. They take their time to make sure you understand everything and never feel rushed. Highly recommend for competency and bedside manner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Hohenstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is a very caring doctor who took the time to listen to all of my wants and needs during my rhinoplasty consultation. He showed me examples with morphing technology on how my nose could potentially look afterwards which I found helpful for visualizing what it will look like. He takes the time to educate you and make you feel comfortable. I can’t wait to get my surgery on the books!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is AMAZING!!!!!! He did my breast aug and I am 5 weeks out from surgery. I was an A cup prior and now I am a full C. He is the best and his staff was incredible.  I am so thankful I chose Dr. Meade. I went to 2 other doctors for consults and he was the most honest, answered all my questions making me feel completely comfortable and excited about the procedure. I would recommend him to EVERYONE!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel White
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade and his staff are phenomenal! I have never had major surgery but Dr. Meade took his time to answer all my questions, addressed all my concerns and put my nerves at ease. Scheduling was easy(Shea knew me by name when I called) and the entire staff was so personable. Dr. Meade was professional, explained every step and made the journey, beginning to end, absolutely incredible. Not once did I feel like just another patient. What a life changing experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lida Karami
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is an incredible surgeon. He is skilled and very knowledgeable as well as friendly and professional.His office staff are starting with Maria and Heather very nice and professional as well.Alison is great too. Hands down the best experience that I have ever had with the best results that I could imagine.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim-Loan McDuffie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade was recommended by a personal friend who is also a surgeon.  My experience with Dr Meade and his practice has been exceptional.  He did a corrective surgery on an issue that was high priority for me, and they handled my concerns with extreme efficiency and in meticulous detail.  They also listened to my concerns with post anesthesia sickness and the anesthesiologist ensured that I was not sick post procedure.  Not all plastic surgeries are shallow and glamorous as portrayed on TV, and when your health is at risk and you need more than just aesthetic results, you will get it all with Dr. Meade.  His eye for detail, the amazing and compassionate staff and their focus on more than just beauty is appreciated beyond words.  I cannot thank them enough, I highly recommend this practice and surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Verenice Carrasquillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: 9 months ago I had a tummy tuck done with Dr Meade. The day of my consultation I commented to him that I had few procedures that I had in mind getting done and he suggested that only one that I really “needed” was taking the extra skin from my abdomen which really made me feel that he truely cares about his patients rather than making an extra buck. The day of my surgery, I was extremely nervous, thankfully there was Maria who is part of Dr Meade’s team, she supported and comforted me when I needed it. She was very sweet and showed a genuine interest in my wellbeing. Every time I go for my check ups, its delightful to see Dr Meade as well as Maria. They truely changed my life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: Gave me what I asked for. That’s why he deserves 1 star. No postop instructions after mommy makeover. The only instructions, don’t stand up straight and measure output from drains. Post op- 1.5cm opening to an incision. No surgicelor Teristeips there. Just never closed. Dressings post op weren’t even covering incisions. Went to office for infected seroma, sat in waiting room for 2 hours in pain after driving an hour. 6 month follow-up- his paramedic assistant dismissed all my concerns only to be confirmed with Dr Meade saying “you have unrealistic expectations”. All I wanted was my boobs that don’t fall out of my bra when I bend over and for them to no longer sag. Biggest waste of 20k. Now I need to spend more since he also jacked my belly button that gets yeast infections like a skin fold every other day. Don’t waste your money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery Barker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish I had words for how much Dr. Meade has done for me. He is both an incredible doctor and person. I went through a traumatic injury that resulted in loads of facial scars. He did a scar revision surgery along with post treatments that have changed my life. He took a really hard situation and has turned the entire look and emotional aspect around for me. Him and his team are beyond incredible. 5/5!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cutemixedchic Bella
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have the displeasure of doing a consultation w/this particular surgeon. After I had been a patient of a surgeon in the same building that apparently he took offense to me, wanting him to do work after that particular surgeon.  And make sure he let me know, basically. "How dare you" when obviously if I wanted to go back to that surgeon, As my surgeon, I would have done that. I needed help. I needed a new surgeon, and if he simply didn't want to do it. Just say that, but instead he berated me and made me feel less of a person , was that really necessary not very nice at all....left his office in tears, I'm a breast cancer survivor & had already been thru A LOT !!

I just needed to feel pretty again & only hoped he could help..
Left me feeling alone 😔 and helpless instead...

user_reviews_extended.Name: jamie robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a breast lift and implants exchanged. This was my 4th implant surgery, but first with Dr.Meade. This was by far the best experience I’ve had with a plastic surgeon. I am beyond happy with the results, downtime was minimal and had an overall great experience with his staff! Dr. Meade is not only an excellent and highly trained surgeon, but has a great bedside manner as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Hamiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meade is performing my wife's reconstruction from double mastectomy due to breast cancer. His work has been flawless to this point. However, it is his staff that really makes his practice shine through. Throughout this process, I have had my share of questions/concerns/etc with every doctors office. The help and support from his staff have been nothing less than phenomenal, far exceeding my expectations at every turn. They are simply in a different league than everyone else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teri Purcell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Meade is an extremely gifted surgeon.  He gave me all the time I needed to understand the procedure, answer questions and calm my fears.  Not only is Dr. Meade a talented physician but compassionate and kind, which puts him at the top of my list.

He is supported by a very caring staff that goes out of their way to put you at ease.

I am so thankful to Dr. Meade.  I highly recommend him to all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clare Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade takes great care of his patients! The staff is also incredible and attentive. I felt comfortable asking as many questions as needed and he took time to talk through the best recommendations for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Singler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is amazing! This was my second procedure I’ve had done with him, and let me tell you, the man is a sculptor. His staff is excellent too. Everyone in his office really seems to care about the patients and their jobs. It was a wonderful experience from start to finish and I couldn’t be more pleased with my results. I highly recommend Dr. Meade’s office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Dollins
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING EXPERIENCE! Truly,  Dr Meade is a one of a kind Dr-best bedside manner ever!  He gave me his undivided attention at every turn and I can’t say enough about his unbelievable staff, so caring and personal! I’m so happy with my new breasts and I’m so thankful for him and to God for leading me to him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christie Lynn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I was diagnosed with breast cancer in
May, it was the most frightening news of my life. After seeing a breast surgeon,Dr. Meade came highly recommended to me, and I’m so glad that I chose him. He spent two hours with me during my consultation to make sure I was going to have the results I wanted. He also reached out to me by phone when I had additional questions and concerns. He’s very meticulous and a true artist in his work. Dr. Meade is an incredibly caring person that will make sure every patient that comes through his doors have the best results from start to finish. I’m forever grateful for Dr. Meade and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Marie Eckstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is a Godly, professional man. At first I was nervous about having a male surgeon do my reconstruction after having a mastectomy, but he was incredibly respectful and SO professional that I never felt uncomfortable with him. He answered all my questions with patience and grace. I never felt rushed in his office and he spent as much time with me as I needed. Not only does he have a fantastic bedside manner, but he does incredible work!!! He, BY FAR, exceeded my expectations. I keep getting compliments about how amazing I look! I am beyond satisfied with my results and would recommend Dr Meade to anyone!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Longenecker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade performed a bilateral mastectomy for me and will be performing the reconstruction with permanent implants next month. The results of the procedure are above and beyond my expectations and I am not even finished. Dr. Meade is professional and is an artist when it comes to the female breast. He asked me what I wanted and what I expected and then he listened and gave me what I asked. At every office visit, Dr Meade took his time. His expertise and compassion definitely helped make a difficult situation much easier. His staff is efficient and helped me easily navigate the entire process. I highly recommend Dr. Meade and will gladly refer friends and family to him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Dunn
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my 2nd experience with Dr. Meade. He is so compassionate and caring. I even tried to get him to do unnecessary work on me, to test him..(he refused). I'm a nurse. I wanted to make sure he was a great dr. And he is. My best friend came for my 2nd surgery, he treated her wonderfully. Just like family. His staff answers all your questions and concerns. You can stay overnight in their clinic if you need extra care. I did that with my 1st surgery (mommy makeover.) I will never go anywhere else for cosmetic care. Thank you Dr. Meade and Dallas Plastic Surgery Institute. P.S. I am 52 this year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Carr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Meade performed my reconstruction after a prophylactic  mastectomy. Not only is he an extremely personable and kind man, he is also an exceptionally gifted surgeon. He carefully listened to all my concerns and explained what the reconstruction process would look like.

Mastectomy/reconstruction can feel really overwhelming. Dr. Meade was able to make me whole and pieced me back together to look just like I did prior to surgery. He made a very challenging chapter of life a whole lot easier and I am so grateful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade is absolutely wonderful!  I’m very happy with my results and his bedside manner is excellent. I would recommend him to anyone who is searching for a plastic surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Kerns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely Amazing. I found Dr. Meade after an oopsie from a previous surgeon. I can say that I am beyond happy with the experience, patient care and quality of work that he has done. Being a patient that needs reconstruction, you always want the best and Dr. Meade is definitely the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Nichols
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Meade worked with my breast surgeon on my bilateral mastectomy and just did the "swap" from expanders to implants.  He, his entire office staff, his nurses and everyone involved have been great throughout this stressful period in my life.  He always took all the time I needed in our appointments and made me feel as if I had his entire attention.  When I had questions or concerns outside of appointment times, they were great at responding to my emails or calls.  They are all great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: After being diagnosed with breast cancer in May 2017.  I was terrified but being in the hands of WONDERFUL doctors helped with my anxiety.  My Breast Surgeon works with Dr. Meade on many cancer cases and highly recommended him.  We were able to do a consultation and coordinate surgeon schedules and proceed quickly.  People told me that the next year would be full of ups and downs and they were correct. I recently completed phase 2 reconstruction.  i am healing slower that I had hoped for but with chemo, radiation and being diabetic i was told healing would be slower.  I have schedule the last phase for this December and can't wait for this ride to be over.  Dr. Meade has always been great, his staff- great.  If I had one complaint it would be that there is always a wait to see him, but with anything of value, it's worth the wait!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Tipotsch
user_reviews_extended.Description: My surgeon recommended Dr. Meade and I'm glad he did. I had abdominal surgery and Dr. Meade performed a tummy tuck at the same time. The results are fabulous! I'm 67 and was concerned about how well I would heal. Dr. Meade and his staff were very reassuring, and I couldn't be happier with the results. I'm planning on further surgery and I wouldn't choose anyone else to do it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa H
user_reviews_extended.Description: This review is long overdue and I'm sorry I haven't shared it sooner!  Dr. Meade is the Best Doctor you could ask for. I had been diagnosed with breast cancer at the age of 40 and had been referred to a DIFFERENT surgeon that would not answer my questions,  spoke down to me and just made my whole experience even worse. He made me feel like he was walking with me through my cancer journey as opposed to feeling like just another patient.  One of the surgeries I had was very unique and he was one of the only surgeons in Dallas who had done it before.  He only did this type of surgery once a year.  That could have made me very anxious but I was completely comfortable in his hands.  My surgery could not have gone any better and my final results were beyond even the best I could hope for! My reconstructed breasts are symmetrical,  full, and the scars all healed nicely. You can tell that being a surgeon, to him, is about helping people. He cares about the work he is doing and getting the best results for his clients. He didn't tell me what he was going to do...he gave me all the information then let me make the choice that was right for me. At no time did I ever hesitate putting my trust in him.  He helped me through the hardest time in my life and I will forever be grateful for all he did for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: We cannot thank Dr. Meade enough, he is a credit to medicine. user_reviews_extended.Name: Carole Eldridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the many things I love about Dr. Meade is that he does what you want done without making you look like a plastic doll. user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Referred here due to getting diagnosed with cancer. I was unsure about seeing a plastic surgeon since this wasn’t a choice of mine. user_reviews_extended.Name: MC Redrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meade and his crew are absolute magicians! I’ve always loved my body, but a few years ago I was thinking about improving it. My confidence is soaring, definitely the best decision I’ve ever made.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TJ J
user_reviews_extended.Description: Upon meeting Dr. Meade the first time, I was immediately comfortable.  Dr. Meade is confident, not arrogant, about his skills which immediately puts you at ease. He listened attentively to what I had to say. Then thoroughly explained, in a manner I could understand, what he could do and what it would entail. His staff are friendly and super responsive to any questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Blair
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a prophylactic mastectomy and Dr. Meade performed my DIEP Flap breast reconstruction.

I simply cannot say enough about not only how wonderful he is, but his entire staff as well. I had pretty specific aesthetic results I wanted from my breast reconstruction, and I came to Dr. Meade after another plastic surgeon told me it wouldn't be possible.  He thought outside the box and laid out a surgical plan to give me the best shot at what I wanted.  He was realistic and let me know that there was no guarantee it would work, but he thought it was definitely worth trying. Thanks to him, I have ended up with the results I wanted and so much more.

When initially choosing which route to go with for my reconstruction, I was nervous about staying in Dallas to have DIEP Flap performed because New Orleans is famous for it. I am so glad I stayed local and went with Dr. Meade. My results are just as good, if not better, than the women who go to NOLA. I belong to several online BRCA / breast cancer groups and every time I post my results photos, everyone raves and wants to know who my doctor is.

Upon my first consult with Dr. Meade and at every appointment thereafter, he spent as much time with me as I needed. I had a lot of questions and never once felt rushed.  He really makes an effort to know and remember his patients. I'm always impressed at every appointment how he remembers things about me, my case, etc. You're not just another surgery to him, you're a person, and you're important. His staff is the same way. They are very responsive to phone calls, helpful with information, and are always very warm and kind. I am going to miss them all once my follow up appointments are done!

Dr. Meade also apparently has an impressive reputation in the medical community as well. Because of weird insurance networks, my surgery took place in a different hospital than he normally works from. The morning of my surgery, the pre-op nurses were all buzzing with excitement that Dr. Meade would be operating there that day. We overheard one nurse tell another to make sure the setup is just right for him. It was so fun to hear them take so much care in wanting to accommodate him. Throughout my week-long stay at the hospital, each time I was transferred to a different department, first the ICU for 24 hour flap monitoring, and then the oncology unit, the nurses would say, "oh you're Dr. Meade's patient!" I somehow even ended up with a 2-room suite at the hospital. The nurses said Dr. Meade likes his patients to be well taken care of. No kidding! Anyway, I thoroughly enjoyed the VIP treatment on Dr. Meade's behalf.

I had a great experience with DIEP Flap breast reconstruction and am happy every day when I look in the mirror. I'm not going to lie, it’s a challenging surgery, but it is worth it. Dr Meade is very talented, skilled, and has performed many while maintaining a very low flap failure rate. He told me once that DIEP is one of his favorite surgeries to do.

Dr. Meade is very honest and will not upsell you to make more money.  He will give you his honest opinion about what is best for you.  He is very confident and proud of his work, and for good reason. That confidence is very reassuring to see from your surgeon. I trust him completely and would highly recommend him for any procedure. He is an artist.  I am so thankful for his work in the breast reconstruction field, making women feel whole and beautiful, in the midst of disease.  Thank you Dr. Meade!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hung Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was diagnosed with breast cancer in August 2015. Dr. Anglin, my breast surgeon, referred me to Dr. Meade. Dr. Meade's office was able to fit me into their busy schedule. The first thing I noticed when walking into the office was how friendly everyone was. The receptionist pointed me to the waiting room in the back. About 5 minutes Dr. Meade's medical assistance, Angela, came out and brought me into the room. After being asked about my medical history, I was asked  to change into a blue top. Dr. Meade came in. He introduced himself. I told him, "I know who you are because I watched your YouTube videos." Initially I was scheduled for a mastectomy on my left breast only not a bilateral mastectomy.

Dr. Meade is very honest and thorough, went over all the options for my reconstruction. With Dr. Meade recommendation, I decided to have a bilateral mastectomy and chose the DIEP flap reconstruction. Looking back with Dr. Meade's advice having the bilateral mastectomy was the best decision I ever made. I'm very thankful to Dr. Meade for helping me making that decision.

What a wonderful experience! I am a large weight loss patient who had excessive skin.. lots of it.. and had a body lift with Dr. Meade. The staff went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and well informed, and there was never a time that anyone was more than an email or phone call away to answer any of my questions. I have had such a long journey since I first lost the weight, that I didn't realize the personal strength and value I would have had to already had to get this far. It is amazing what feeling good about yourself makes you realize. I am not changing myself, I am only allowing myself to have the body I worked so hard for that is hiding under so many layers of excess skin. I can play with my son now with free abandon without worrying about bending over and having skin fall out, or take him swimming and not have to constantly tuck skin back into the sides of my suit. I can just have fun and live life without being distracted by this insecurity any longer. I have told everyone I have come in contact with about my experience with Dr. Meade's staff and expressed my confidence and trust in all of them to anyone looking for services this office handles.

I can never thank Dr. Meade and all of his staff, medical and office, enough. Tomorrow when I wake up and get dressed, I will be thankful for all of them all over again, just as I am every day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Calderon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Meade, MEADE, MEADE!! The BEST Doctor and staff hands down!
From my initial introduction to Dr Meade and Angela, I have found both to be professional in nature with a kind genuine heart. This is a wonderful quality to have when my medical condition was such as it was. At 36, being diagnosed with breast cancer, my entire world fell apart and my life would forever change. I was upset, sad, confused, but more than anything enraged and mad at the world. I remember hearing the word “chemo” ... that was the last thing I wanted to hear. That word just rubbed me the wrong way for some reason. I had convinced myself that i was NOT going to go through with any chemo and almost walking out as I made that clear during my consultation. At that time, I remember Angela looking at me and asking if she could give me a hug, as she hugged me, she held me and said, “Veronica, I understand that you’re upset and don’t want to go through with chemo... but remember, you have a son and whatever decision you make, do what’s best FOR YOUR SON.” That statement right there... I’ll never forget. She was 1000% right. MY SON is MY WORLD. I can’t  give up I thought to myself. I cant be selfish and only think about myself. I had a son to live for. Angelas statement probably saved my life!!  The “NO CHEMO” was engraved in my head for some reason... up until I heard those heartfelt genuine words. Fast forward, here I am 10 months later, Cancer-Free!! Not only did I go through chemo, but also radiation, double mastectomy, reconstruction!! I did the WHOLE THING... no easy way out, but every doctor visit, every chemo, every surgery has paid off!!
Angela and Dr Meade have been very generous with their time and consult when I had questions above and beyond those discussed in the office. They dealt with my anger and were the sweetest!!
Dr. Meade- he has a HUGE HUGE heart!! He was super patient... even when I was upset. He was very thorough, referred me the an awesome oncologist when I didn’t have one. Me being a smoker with Breast Cancer so young, didn’t sit well with Dr. Meade- he’s a tough one... a raw, no filter (but polite) a TOUGH TOUGH cookie with a giant heart, I’ll explain why...he gave tough love when I needed it. He knew exactly where my head was at that exact moment.
“Veronica what I see in front of me is a young lady that’s very upset... upset and she’s fighting with the world.... confused and all over the place. You’re trying to have control over the situation, but this time you can’t be in control. You have to let that control go. I know exactly what you’re thinking and what you want to do, but let me tell you, I’ve seen this and it never ends well. Please do NOT that” says Dr. Meade.
That was such an emotional moment for me... with Angela hugging me, reminding me that my son is MY world... Dr Meade with his big heart and tough love... they were BOTH right!! I couldn’t give up, I had to let that “control” go, I had to fight... for my son and for myself. I’d like to think of them as my two Angels... had I not heard these words, who knows if I’d still be here. They literally saved my life!!
Now, when speaking of the results of my cosmetic surgery, totally have exceeded my expectations. Scarring, minimal. Dr. Meade’s work is like “art”, I’d like to think of it that way.... I mean “the girls” look better than before!! He made sure that the size was just right for my body and wouldn’t tip over! Haha! A friend of mine even said that it looks just like a breast augmentation and not even a mastectomy!! She’s not lying! Dr. Meades work is mind blowing! Every time I go in for a check up, it’s just a lot of fun! Him and Angela make it feel fun and not a cold, boring, doctors appointment. These two are ROCKSTARS!!
When given the chance, I would choose Dr Meade and his professional staff all over again. Bedside manner, exceptional. Overall A+++

PS- Dr. Meade- if you’re reading this, you’ll be proud of me... I went plant based!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: After having a double mastectomy due to breast cancer, Dr. Meade performed the DEIP flap procedure. The procedure took 2 different surgeries in the same week (instead of normal 1) for him to complete it. The tissue failed in one breast a few weeks later and was removed. Therefore, a tissue expander was put in for implant at later date. I received an infection 10 days later from expander and elected to have tissue from other breast removed so I was even on both sides and let my breasts heal for a few months. After reconstructive surgery with small implants (surgery #5) a few months later, I have been left with deformed breasts with nipples pointing down, sagging skin and concave above breasts because implants were too small. I also have nerve damage in right arm that has continuously worsened where I now have daily pain and limited range of motion. I was told by Dr. Meade that he could fix implants but I needed to decide what size implant I wanted so I'm not concave (he's suppose to be the expert; not me)and I would have to pay for the surgery with no compensation from his office for previous botched surgery. I have a $6500 deductible and am not willing to spend that on surgery #6 with no guarantee that he'll get it right. There were no apologies from his office. My breasts look like I could be on the tv show "Botched". Beware if your surgery is not a simple straight forward one!

title: Dr Evan W Beale
address: 8201 Preston Rd #700, Dallas, TX 75225, United States

user_reviews.Name: Toni Harrigan
user_reviews.Description: From the initial consultation through the final post op meeting, Dr. Beale and his team manage everything efficiently, effectively and professionally.  Dr. Beale is very thorough and detail oriented.  His experience and skill is evident in all of his work.  His staff including Peggy, Taylor and Blake are wonderfully supportive addressing all questions and concerns.  Trust that you are in the best and most capable hands from start to finish.  I highly recommend this team to handle your most important asset, YOU!

Dr. Beale has been a great addition to my "cancer team." He and my cancer surgeon performed my lumpectomy + lift/reduction which had fantastic results.

I have to admit, I was a little intimidated when first coming to Dr. Beale. His top-floor office is absolutely gorgeous, well-decorated, and feels luxurious - some things I'm not totally used to! Not only that, but everyone working there is beautiful (inside and out) and at first, I felt out of place. I had never sought out plastic surgery before, and had no intention to had I not been diagnosed with cancer.

BUT, I'm so glad I ended up in the care of Dr. Beale, because he and his staff made me feel at ease at a time when I was literally scared for my life. In particular, I found solace in Brittany, his surgical coordinator. Being a survivor and mom herself, she made me feel right at home. I cried when I met her, because in this gorgeous office with perfect-looking people, she saw ME in my cancer "journey" and could empathize. I wasn't there for fun, or because I wanted to change my appearance. I was there because I had to be and she could relate to my struggles.

I am so grateful I was referred to Dr. Beale. Life has been kind of a whirlwind of chaos since finding out I had cancer, but he and his staff have taken AMAZING care of me. They are quick to answer calls, and always call me back when requested/needed. I'm always seen promptly as soon as I arrive for appointment. And I'm never left in the dark with questions unanswered.

I can't thank Brittany and Dr. Beale enough for being so awesome and caring. Blake and Taylor are incredible, too (understatement of the year). I wish I knew everyone's name in the office because I would love to shout them out for also being phenomenal. Thank you ALL. <3

user_reviews.Name: Paige Kawar
user_reviews.Description: I have completely loved being under the care of Brittany.  She is a cancer survivor and completely knows, understands, and cares about what we are all going through.  Her bedside manner is so loving and patient.  She knows how I feel about my breasts and the procedures I have to go through because she's been there herself.  She has great empathy and she's a cheerleader in my corner!!!!  I'm so thankful for Dr. Beale and Brittany.

user_reviews.Name: Melissa Isaac
user_reviews.Description: Hey, I went in on February of 2025 and had a sliding genoplasty and lipo under my chin. Dr Evan Beale, Taylor and the complete staff at the office were amazing!! They were so attentive to my needs and every time I called they were there with the answers. Dr Beale went above and beyond for me and I can’t thank him enough. I had a vision of what I wanted and Dr Beale and his staff made it happen! I can wear my hair up and not feel self conscious anymore. I have my self confidence back! My only regret is not getting this procedure sooner!! Thank you Dr.Evan Beale, Taylor and the rest of the family! You guys are the BEST!!!🩷

user_reviews.Name: Abby Hickman
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Beale and his entire team (Brittany, Blake, and Taylor) have been nothing but amazing during my entire process for my procedure. Brittany especially went above and beyond to make sure everything was smooth and stress free for me. She answered my MANY questions quickly and so kindly, and made the entire insurance process, scheduling, and preparations SO easy and seamless. This whole team is just the best. And the procedure itself- amazing!! Truly so happy with my results and owe it all to this team.

user_reviews.Description:
My experience with Dr. Beale and his office was wonderful! There are many examples of the excellent service and experience Dr. Beale’s office provided for me:  when I called for the first time I was greeted by Dawn who I felt very comfortable with right away and who answered all of my questions then helped with my financial end of it.
When I visited in office for the first time I was greeted warmly in their beautiful office.  Dr. Beale and Blake were amazing to work with throughout the whole process - I felt very comfortable right away, they answered of all of my questions and offered the best of information. Top-notch professionals and caring. The surgery itself went smoothly I believe because of Dr. Beale. The whole experience of surgery day was a breeze: the surgery center and their nurses were also great. Each time I called and visited the office, Taylor was friendly, helpful and easy to talk to. My breast reduction by Dr. Beale was the best thing I’ve ever done for myself and I’m very thankful for Dr. Beale and his team. Highly recommend their services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chiraz Mansouri
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a huge believer in more than one consultation when choosing a plastic surgeon. I had tummy and leg lipo in 2018 and had a long research before deciding who my surgeon would be. Fast forward to 2022, I started looking for a surgeon for a tummy tuck, muscle repair, breast reduction, and lipo of my thighs. So I went to work again and google recommended a few surgeons in my area. I looked at their websites, their before and after, and everything else! And then decided on 3. I consulted with 2, and Dr. Beale was my third consultation. Let me tell you! Dr. Beale is just the warmest, most empathetic Plastic Surgeon I’ve ever met. He was thorough during my consultation, explaining his “way” of performing this procedure. The consultation was not rushed at all!! user_reviews.Name: Sam “Sam J.” Jack
user_reviews.Description:
I had my breast implants removed by Dr. White and it was the best decision I could have made! Unfortunately, I got a contracture that caused me a lot of pain in my right breast and I decided to move forward with the removal process. He explained how the most important part of this surgery is going to be how compliant I am during my recovery process so I can get the best results possible.
I chose Dr. White because of his experience, bedside manner, and because I knew I'd be meeting with him for all my follow up appointments. I even got to know the staff quite well since I called often to ask questions.
I got this procedure done over a year ago and I love my results! Although the compression is extremely annoying it's also the reason my breasts look amazing and don't need a revision surgery. I'm so glad I trusted Dr. White and his staff to take care of me.

user_reviews.Name: Annie Rose
user_reviews.Description:
I had breast augmentation with Dr. White in Dallas on December 3, 2024, and I honestly could not be happier with the entire experience.

Before the surgery, I was extremely nervous. For years, I held back because I was worried about side effects, pain, and the fear of ending up with results that didn't look natural or suit my body. But after meeting Dr. White and seeing his extensive portfolio of successful cases, I felt like I was in the absolute best hands.

What impressed me most was how Dr. White customized the procedure specifically for me. He didn't just offer a one-size-fits-all approach—he listened to what I wanted and used his expertise to create a plan that would give me a beautiful, natural-looking result that fits my frame perfectly.

After the procedure, I am thrilled to say the results are ideal. I experienced virtually no pain, no uncomfortable side effects, and my recovery has gone exactly as expected—smooth and completely under control. It has been such a positive experience from start to finish.

I also have to mention Dr. White’s team. Every single person in the office was warmhearted, friendly, and incredibly patient with all my questions. They truly made me feel cared for.

If you are considering breast augmentation and want a surgeon who is experienced, meticulous, and genuinely cares about giving you a perfect, personalized result—I absolutely recommend Dr. White. I am so glad I finally went through with it, and I couldn't have asked for a better outcome.

user_reviews.Name: Pamela Graham
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the privilege of having Dr. Steven White at USA Plastic Surgery in Dallas perform my septoplasty, turbinoplasty, and rhinoplasty. I chose Dr. White because he is board-certified in both plastic surgery and otolaryngology, which makes him uniquely qualified to address both the function and appearance of the nose. After speaking with him, it was clear how passionate he is about achieving the right balance between aesthetics and proper breathing function.

As the wife of a North Texas anesthesiologist who has worked with Dr. White in the operating room over the years, I felt especially confident in my decision. My husband has always considered Dr. White one of the very best, and now I can wholeheartedly say the same.

I first consulted with Dr. White nearly 10 years ago, but at the time, fear of post-surgical pain held me back. Over the past year, my breathing issues worsened to the point where I knew it was time to move forward. I am so glad I did. My procedure went smoothly, and my pain level was minimal — far less than I had imagined. Looking back, I only wish I had done it sooner.

Not only has my breathing improved significantly, but the appearance of my nose has also improved thanks to the structural support Dr. White added to ensure proper function. What truly sets him apart from other plastic surgeons is his deep understanding of both the anatomy and the importance of combining function with aesthetics.

My experience with USA Plastic Surgery was exceptional from start to finish. Dr. White has a wonderful bedside manner. He takes time to thoroughly educate his patients and shows genuine care and concern. I never once felt rushed, and he always made sure I fully understood every step of the process.

I also can’t say enough about the incredible office staff. From the very beginning, they went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and supported. They answered questions, returned calls, and responded to emails with patience and kindness. They are knowledgeable, professional, and truly lovely people.

If you are considering this or any procedure, I highly recommend Dr. White and his team. They are simply outstanding.

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Morton
user_reviews.Description:
I had a breast reduction and lift with Dr. White in Dallas, and overall I’m very happy with my experience. Going into surgery, my biggest hesitation was the wise pattern scarring. That was my main concern, and after consulting with six different surgeons in the Dallas area, Dr. White stood out immediately. He took my concerns seriously, explained everything clearly, and I truly felt that scarring prevention and quality healing were a priority for him, not an afterthought.

What I appreciated most was his attention to detail and his willingness to take his time to perfect each side rather than rushing through the procedure. That level of care gave me a lot of confidence in my decision. I’ve also done everything possible on my end to support the best outcome, including hyperbaric therapy and strictly following post-op instructions, which makes me optimistic about how my scars will continue to heal.

My breasts did end up smaller than I initially anticipated or would have preferred, and I’m still emotionally adjusting to their new size. That said, I feel confident that every possible step was taken to achieve the best, safest, and healthiest result overall, and I trust the process as my body continues to heal.

I would 100% recommend Dr. White to anyone considering breast surgery, especially if you value attention to detail, thoughtful planning, and a surgeon who genuinely cares about long-term outcomes and aesthetics.

user_reviews.Name: Stacy Zoeller
user_reviews.Description: I had a modified tummy tuck in Dallas and it’s one of the best things I’ve done for myself as it’s really boosted my confidence. Prior to picking a surgeon I was nervous about what would my results look like and what would the scar look like, after an extensive amount of research and meeting multiple different surgeons I went with Dr. White as he has very strong results and made me feel confident about the procedure. His results also looked the most natural and he had also worked with patients that had massive weight loss and the results were great! It was an important decision on who I wanted to do the surgery as I had worked hard to lose over 100lbs. Dr White and his team are very supportive, professional and great to work with!

user_reviews.Name: Steven Heisen
user_reviews.Description:
The procedure I had is called upper and lower Blepharoplasty. The procedure was performed in Dallas by Dr. Steven J. White from USA Plastic Surgery.

I was initially reluctant to have the surgery due to the unknown of never having a surgery like this before. I didn’t know who to trust as a great surgeon, and I was concerned about how I would look after the procedure was completed and everything healed. After doing research about the best board certified plastic surgeons for this kind of procedure, I chose Dr. White based on reviews, meeting him in person, talking and walking through the process, and his exceptional staff. In the first few minutes of meeting him, it’s easy to see why he is the best at what he does. He’s very thorough, detailed and expects perfection in his work and the outcome. He was very considerate of how I felt, and took the time to answer my questions. His staff of Cosmetic Surgery Consultants, Melanie, Jamie, and Sierra are also a big reason for choosing to go with Dr. White. They helped walk me through the process of pre-surgery preparation and post surgery follow up, photos, and appointments. Melanie was the main coordinator for my procedure. She helped facilitate scheduling pricing, pre-surgery appointments, and help me address some challenges when I needed it most to ensure my procedure was successful.

Today I feel incredible about the outcome. It is everything I hoped it would be and more. All went as described by Dr. White prior to the procedure.

I had this procedure because when I looked in the mirror, I felt and looked old, tired, and was frustrated about encounters with ageism. I knew if I had this type of procedure that it would make me look younger and reduce the age factor. New employment at my age is tough to get as it is, but I am far more confident now about the possibilities in the future.

I would recommend Dr. White to anyone wanting the same type of procedure. It’s life-changing. I plan to have Dr. White perform other procedures I may want in the future. Thank you, Dr White, Melanie, Jamie, and Sierra!

user_reviews.Name: D C
user_reviews.Description:
I couldn’t be happier with my experience. I recently underwent an upper blepharoplasty, lower blepharoplasty, and brow lift (upper face lift) with Dr. Steven White in Dallas, TX, and the results have been truly exceptional. This was actually my second procedure with Dr. White—I had a breast augmentation several years ago—and once again, he exceeded every expectation. The level of trust and confidence I have in him is truly unmatched.
From the very beginning, Dr. White made me feel completely comfortable and confident. He took the time to thoroughly explain each step of the process, answered all of my questions, and ensured the plan aligned perfectly with my goals. His precision and artistic eye are evident in the results—my eyes look brighter, refreshed, and completely natural.

The entire team was warm, professional, and incredibly supportive throughout the experience. My recovery was smoother than I ever anticipated, and I felt guided and reassured every step of the way.  I never experienced pain at all!

I am currently three to four weeks post-surgery and already look refreshed and more youthful. I can’t wait to see how amazing the results continue to be as I heal.

I am extremely grateful for Dr. White’s skill and expertise. I would trust him again without hesitation and highly recommend him to anyone considering cosmetic surgery.

Though I rarely write reviews, it is on my heart to share my story with the life-changing experience that I've received from an amazing person - Dr. White.

I wanted a tummy tuck for many years so that I could be comfortable again in my own skin. After having three boys in my twenties, I'd spent the last thirty years wearing one piece swimsuits and loose clothes that would hide my waist. The reason that I waited so long to have a tummy tuck is due to being terrified. I personally saw my daughter-in-law and sister-in-law get a tummy tuck from "well respected" plastic surgeons and they both had horrible experiences.  Not only did they have big scars and enormous pain, but they both had to go back to get the "rabbit ears" removed. This made me very skeptical to move forward.

As I approached 60, I knew that if I was going to have a tummy tuck, then I should do it before it was too late. I started doing research and came across Dr. White and read the countless reviews of people singing Dr. White's praises. I was very impressed with his reputation and hopeful to move forward.

Though I was fearful to even pick up the phone and schedule an appointment, my nerves were immediately calm when I talked to Jasmine for the first time. I had my first appointment the following week and Dr. White spent two hours answering all of my questions while explaining everything very clearly. After the first visit, my nerves were extinguished and I knew in my heart that everything was going to be fine.

The long awaited day arrived and my husband and I sat in the Pre-Op room as Dr. White drew on my stomach like an artist. My husband and I watched with amazement! I had never viewed a plastic surgeon as an artist, but that is exactly what Dr. White is to me. The surgery went as exactly as Dr. White had described in the first consultation.  Once in recovery, he personally gave specific instructions to the nurses that would be looking after me. The nurses were amazing and knew exactly how to take care of me. Dr. White checked on me a few times a day and would even walk with me down the hospital hallways. After a couple days, I was able to go home without having to take a single pain pill. Simply amazing!

It's been almost a year and my outlook on life has totally changed! For the first time in my life, I love my body and I have confidence in myself! I'm 60 years old, but I feel like I have a new lease on life. I'm able to wear younger looking clothes without feeling insecure or self-conscious.  I love Dr. White! I'm also so thankful for his amazing staff: Jasmine, Penny and Kimberly (just to name a few). There isn't a value that can be put on someone who changes your life, so the only thing I know to do is to share my story so that others can benefit from Dr. White, the artist and the surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Cole
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a nurse practitioner, I approach the idea of surgery from a different standpoint - safety and risk mitigation are my top priorities.  After having two babies and two c-sections in less than 2 years at the age of 39 and being under 5 feet tall - I was left with severe diastasis recti and an excess of skin.  Not only did I lose my self confidence, I was having difficulty with everyday activities I used to enjoy such as working out and even holding my boys.  My husband and I made the decision to proceed with an abdominoplasty with diastasis recti repair, however being new to the area and lacking my usual insider's knowledge of who to go to, we started doing our own research.  I narrowed down my extensive search based upon reviews, techniques and pre and post operative procedures and quickly started weeding out other providers who were not even going to meet me in person before scheduling surgery or who were more concerned about payment vs. patients.  Then I stumbled across Dr. White and after reading his reviews I knew I at least had to meet him.  I can honestly say there are few times when a provider exceeded my expectations - but Dr. White has FAR exceeded every one.  He is thorough,  detailed, artistic and caring - he truly cares about each and every one of his patients!  He definitely goes above and beyond when it comes to preventing complications, which again as a nurse practitioner who knows all too well about negative outcomes meant the world to me.  Not only did I have zero complications, I look AMAZING.  Oh did I mention that he is a perfectionist and his results are second to none.  While some may choose him for those reasons, I chose him because at the end of the day I want it done right with my safety as the priority.  And if after only 6 weeks I am fitting in ALL my pre-baby clothes, buying new bikinis and can see my abs again, I'll take it as a bonus!
His follow-up care is almost unbelievable in that you see him so much, there is never a moment when you feel left on your own.  I have a friend who underwent the same procedure 2 days prior in another state - and let me tell you the difference between our procedures and recovery has been so eye-opening!  I had at least double the amount of appointments she did, yet no complications and she is still having complications including seroma (fluid collection) which led to her wound having to be opened, bleeding around her belly-button and continued swelling.  In addition, she is never given any specific information so she has been following my protocols!
There is a reason Dr. White's surgeries are longer and more expensive - it is because he is cautious, careful, precise and committed to the best results possible.  I believe he is truly one of the best in the nation all around, and he is worth every penny.  You will not find another plastic surgeon who has it all as Dr. White does, and I would recommend him to anyone I know.  I am so thankful I found Dr. White and his team - truly the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dwayne McSwain
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I developed large male breasts at the age of 12, which is probably the last time I was out in public without a shirt. Even with a shirt on, I was always embarrassed and self-conscious about my chest. I had little to no self-confidence and very low self-esteem. So it goes without saying, my breasts had a huge negative effect on all aspects of my life.

For 40 years I dreamed of having a breast reduction. However, I never really looked into it until this year. I was on a flight from Charlotte to Houston when I read an article about Dr. White being one of the top 10 cosmetic/plastic surgeons in the World. So, I called and arranged a consultation visit.

Upon meeting Dr. White, all my apprehension was set aside. I thought it would be too costly, wrong. I thought it would be too painful and the recovery period too long, wrong again. He discussed the pros and cons with me, what my options were, we reviewed his portfolio of before and after pictures for the same procedure, and he described in detail what would happen and what to expect. In all, I spent about two hours at Dr. White’s office and most of that time was with him, which is rather unusual in today’s medical environment. My general physician spends less than five minutes with me on any one visit and delegates most of his tasks to his assistant. Not Dr. White…He is strictly hands-on and very, very, very, very detail oriented, which I find both comforting and refreshing. I cannot say enough good things about Dr. White and his staff. I know you’re probably thinking, “it sounds too good to be true,” but it’s not. He really is the best and it’s something you have to experience for yourself to fully appreciate.

I had the procedure done and everything happened just as Dr. White had described. No surprises; he is truly a grandmaster in his field. I did not have any pain after the surgery and my recovery was a lot faster than I expected. Again, everything happened just like Dr. White said it would.

The results are amazing!! I told Dr. White at my consultation visit that I wanted to be his next success story, and I am. It’s surreal…To dream about something for so long and to have it actually come true is almost unbelievable. I cannot help but stare at myself in the full-length mirror and think about how remarkable the results are. Dr. White is genuinely happy for me and shares in my excitement. You can hear it in his voice and see it on his face.

The only regret that I have is not having this procedure done years ago. My confidence is through the roof and I feel like a new person. My clothes fit better, and, by the way I carry myself, it feels like I’m a foot taller. I am happy, happy, happy!!

Dr. White is absolutely outstanding and I recommend him without reservation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Wiler
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my sincerest review I could possibly write. I had waited nearly 7 years searching for the right doctor for my Breast Augmentation surgery. She witnessed his impeccable attention to detail and care for each patient that she knew she found someone she trusted enough to work on her own body. I had fears and worries about all the unknowns that as I proceeded to book my surgery I was in tears from fear alone. Something I waited and searched long and hard for was finally happening but it terrified me at the same time. This was not naturally in my character to do. I am young, healthy & athletic. I have never had any surgeries (not even wisdom teeth), never even broke a bone. I didn't know if I could do it but I did know that I fully trusted Dr. White and his team to take care of me. Ill never forget Dr. White saying to me " I care about you, but im not worried about you". That resignated in my head all the way to surgery day. Boy was that countdown nerve racking. Finally day of surgery and I was well prepared with everything I needed from my pre-op appointments. I was confident knowing I had followed Dr. Whites instructions to a T, however my fear for absolutely everything ( needles, blood, anesthesia) still lived in my head. Luckily Dr. White is an extremely intelligent man and chooses to surround himself with very qualified and like minded individuals to work with him. Dr. Zipper was my anesthesiologist who is not only a board certified doctor but he is fabulous as well. I told him my fears. I was worried about nausea, worried about complications and even more concerned with if my body would take well to it. I explained to him that I have severe anxiety and that I didnt want to be fully aware of the operating room when they bring me in or else I would lose my mind. He heard everything I had to say and took care of me so well that I can now proudly say I would do that again if I had to. I had zero nausea, zero complication and zero nerves being wheeled into the OR. THANK YOU Dr. Zipper.... I awoke out of surgery to a nice surprise, zero pain. Day 1 and my breasts already looked so good. All the wonderful things I had heard from other people and from Dr. White himself were ALL TRUE. I am only 8 days post op as I write this review and my breasts are already PERFECT! I have no pain, my breasts have already dropped, they are moving and becoming softer each day. I had zero bruising, zero bleeding and just enough meds to get me through the first 24 hours. I am up and about like nothing ever happened to me and people have no clue that I had breast augmentation 8 days ago. My fiancee is obsessed with them and so am I. Dr. White created the perfect size and he spent all the time needed in the OR to make them that way. I couldnt be happier and I am so glad I chose Dr. White. I cant imagine doing this with anyone else. Thank you Dr. White...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Snelling

For the longest time, her desire to have a breast augmentation was outweighed by my reluctance in finding the right doctor. After hearing the reviews from her friends & sitting through the initial consultation however, I started to come around to the idea.
