user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Webb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I chose Dr. White after searching for a surgeon that was board certified in both plastic surgery and otolaryngology. My nose had been broken MANY times over a period of 30 years, including a break very high on the bridge of my nose, and I wanted a nose that would function AND look good. I also was hopeful that I could find a surgeon that didn’t require too much travel. Lucky for me, Dr. White was local to Dallas.

I waited years to find the right surgeon. I wanted a surgeon that would listen to me, make me look like myself, give me actual functioning airflow, and make me confident that I would leave happy. I waited until I could trust the surgeon with my face, because no one wants a face they don’t recognize.

I met Dr. White and knew he was the surgeon for me. He was precise, he was honest, and he was absolutely determined to make me look like ME. Just a less broken and bumpy version of me. He never showed me a magical picture of what I might look like. He showed me real results he got for other patients, talked to me about what my options were and what was likely to work, and made me comfortable.

I am two years out from the surgery, and I couldn’t be happier. I’m thrilled with my nose. First of all, it WORKS! I feel like I’m breathing through a wind tunnel!  Second, literally no one has ever guessed that I had a rhinoplasty. Even other doctors are shocked and impressed when I tell them that I had a very long complex reconstruction of my nose. I love that I look like me still. Just a better version with less breaks. My google profile picture is 2 years post-surgery, if you want to see what I (and my nose!) look like.

If you are considering rhinoplasty and especially if you have trouble breathing, call Dr. White. My quality of life is so much better now. I can breathe. I can hike. I can do yoga. Everything is easier and better now. I cannot recommend him enough for rhinoplasty.

user_reviews_extended.Name: P Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would like to divide this review into 3 sections – the doctor, the office and my surgical journey.

Here is what I’ve learned about Dr. White – he is a very upbeat, positive person, very high energy.  Try to keep up.  He is very caring about all facets of his patients and their health.  I say this because I had been in a car accident and he would not operate on me until my body was ready for the surgery.  He is a perfectionist to the extreme.  As I will talk about later, I had a fairly significant challenge with my implants due to the fact, they were old, had contractures and had calcified significantly.  He meticulously picked out all the pieces of calcium some of which were very small and scattered throughout my chest cavity in order to give me great results and the best chance for the calcification not returning.  He is an incredibly positive person, a trait I found very comforting and encouraging due to my trepidation about the procedure.  Every visit he spends the time I need and answers my plethora of questions.  To sum it up, after my own experience I would consider him an artist.

The office environment is very professional.  From the furnishings to the consultation rooms, it is warm and welcoming, not at all sterile like a typical doctor’s office.  The office staff is exceptional.  I would like pay special compliments to Jennifer and Jazmin.  They are friendly, helpful and caring.  Never once did I feel like an imposition when I called multiple times to ask questions.  They always took the time to fully answer my questions regardless of how trivial or paranoid the questions might have seemed.  Jennifer even gave me advice on bra shopping and sent me to the perfect place to get the exact right fit and I left with 5 wonderfully fitting bras. (I had previously picked out some bras at a popular mall establishment and they were all the wrong size.)

Now for my surgical journey – which began with Dr. White April 2013 with a consultation for removing and replacing my current breast implants.  I had been contemplating a consultation for a couple of years but kept talking myself into postponing it.  Then in March 2013, a car accident prompted my visit to him since I ruptured my original implants.  My case is a unique one in that my original implants were 30 years old, yes, 30 years old – original Dow Corning relics at Dr. White would say.  He had an incredibly tough job of removing the old ruptured implants since both had capsular contractures as well as being hard and calcified.  In a 6 hour operation, he delicately removed the implant capsules and replaced them with new Mentor implants.  Upon removing my 30 year implants, my chest wall was actually concave so he had to use sizers to get the exact right size.  With Dr. White you trust him to put in the correct size, you don’t give him a size.  Had I given Dr. White a specific size of implants that I wanted I would not have been pleased since they would not have been the right size for me.  To say I am pleased is an understatement.  I’m ecstatic with the results – not too big and not too small – absolutely just right.  I trusted his years of experience and it definitely paid dividends.  My husband is over the moon as well.  We have both said many, many times, “Why didn’t we do this 10 years ago?”  My answer was fear of the unknown.  I no longer have any fear of the unknown and my experience with Dr. White has been exceptional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikey Loves Jeanette
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy with my results, I don’t think I could have chosen a better doctor. It wasn’t really pain, more like pressure. I got my breast augmentation 2 weeks ago and I am LOVING my results. I can’t stop staring at them, they looked way better than what I expected. I will be recommending him to everyone! 😊😊😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Russo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. White to anyone seeking Rhinoplasty or Septoplasty.  The experience was just so worth it. user_reviews_extended.Description: I am 59 and thought about a facelift for years before I did anything about it.  I was petrified of having that "artificial" look! user_reviews_extended.Name: lili Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s been 6 months since my surgery and I’m so happy with my result. Dr. White is amazing at his job and I’m so glad I picked him. user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariel Nardi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
**Look no further, Dr. White is the best of the best**

Let me first admit that I am a bit OCD, particularly when it comes to doing my research. I pride myself on finding the best of the best – whether it’s a restaurant, hotel, nail salon, or plastic surgeon. When I decided to get a breast lift, I hit the internet like a fiend. I was on a mission – I wanted to reward myself and my 80 pound weight loss with a breast lift. After putting so much work into my body, I didn’t want just anyone to do my surgery. I wanted the best – a surgeon I could trust, with pedigree and experience, a commitment to excellence, someone who would treat me as if I were their own blood while on the operating table, who wouldn’t stop until they had done everything in their power to give me the best possible result.

After months of pouring through countless websites, before and after pictures, and literally hundreds, if not thousands, of reviews – the choice was clear…Dr. White was my guy. But I wanted to have options, so I found a few other highly recommended and highly qualified surgeons and scheduled consults with 3, including Dr. White. From the first call I made to Dr. White’s office, my experience with him and his staff (Jazmin in particular!) blew the other options completely out of the water. There was no decision to make, my choice had already been made for me just a few minutes into my consult with Dr. White. He’s THAT good. I have never so quickly, implicitly, and fully trusted someone. Not only does he have true skill and experience, but he is personable and passionate and dedicated to achieving the best possible result with each patient. He and his staff go to great lengths to make sure you know and understand every step of the procedure and are comfortable and have had all of your questions answered…without feeling rushed or like just another patient. I remember sitting in his office with him at the end of the consult, reviewing a huge stack of before and after pictures of breast lifts he’d previously done and I was blown away. This man is an artist. But what shocked me the most was that he would point to an after picture, depicting in my mind what I thought to be a perfect set of breasts that I could only dream of having…and he would pick out something he thought he could have done better. My jaw actually hit the floor. He was even more OCD, more of a perfectionist than I am. And who better to operate on you than someone who can look at an A+ performance and say “but I could’ve done A++.”

I will admit that my only hesitation with Dr. White was price – the cost was above and beyond the other two surgeons I met with. But you get what you pay for…and if I had known that my breasts were going to look this good, I would’ve paid double, triple the cost. When you decide to have plastic surgery, you are making an investment in your body and you only get one of those. I wanted it done right. I scheduled my surgery the very next day after the consult and haven’t looked back since. I am now a week and a half post-op, with no bruising, no pain. Nothing but pure euphoria. I wake up and I giggle, I am so freaking happy. Every day feels like Christmas. Like the world is my oyster and I can do anything I want. My breasts are perfect. They are perky and symmetrical and full and youthful – I couldn’t have asked for better. Dr. White perfected the one area of my body that I could not perfect on my own with diet and exercise. He is an artist and a perfectionist, a true miracle worker. I cannot sing my praises loudly enough – there is no other surgeon I would entrust with a breast lift or any other procedure for that matter.

I was shocked by the transformation. Even at my thinnest, I have always felt like my upper arms were larger and unproportionate to my body. After seeing my friends’ results, I was convinced. Having had experience with other surgeons and their techniques, I would highly recommend Dr. White and his knowledgeable staff above anyone else. You owe it to yourself at the very least to schedule a consultation to gain a knowledge and understanding of how the procedure is typically performed, what Dr. White does differently, and why he performs the procedure the way he does. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Bedford

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Swelling gradually starts to diminish each day and now I’m 3.5 weeks out from surgery and can start to slowly get back to my active lifestyle. I would recommend anybody to him

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ravyn Rose
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was really excited to get my breast augmentation done by Dr. White. Upon researching various plastic surgeons in the DFW area, he was the only plastic surgeon I found where there was not a single "before and after" comparison I didn't like. When I had my consultation with him, I felt like he genuinely listened to what I wanted to achieve from the surgery, and helped guide me towards making the best decision on what size I should go implant wise. And all the ladies in the office were super nice and welcoming.

The surgery went well, however after all of the healing- my right breast dropped lower than the other, causing my nipples to face in different directions and the tops of my breasts to be uneven. I had a lot of tension and tightness in my left pectoral tie-in during the healing process, and for months after the surgery. I followed the guidelines with the strap you are supposed to wear and had my husband perform the movement exercises to loosen up the pockets where the implants sit, and after each check up I was told that "everything looked good" and that I was healing nicely. So I'm not really sure as to why my breasts are uneven.

I am a little frustrated with the uneven-ness, as I find my right breast falling out of bras from the underneath, and when I wear low cut shirts- its extremely noticeable. I'm also quite embarrassed as to how my nipples face different directions. :( I don't know what to do to try and fix this, apart from another surgery- which I don't have the money for, and also don't want to have to wait to fix it. :(

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife had a tummy tuck and 2 other elective surgeries from Dr. White over 2 ½ years ago.
I have NEVER written a review – and never intend to write another one.

This review is from the perspective of a husband of a wife who has had several surgeries from Dr. White and who has witnessed his “body of work” literally and figuratively OVER TIME.

Bottom Line First (For those who hate lengthy reviews):
I do not recommend Dr. White if your ONLY consideration is Price.

I strongly recommend Dr. White if your criteria are any or all of the following:
1.	Obsession with Safety
2.	Obsession with No Complications
3.	Obsession with Results
4.	Obsession to detail
5.	World class surgical techniques
6.	Un- paralleled personal attention while healing
7.	Incredibly competent staff
8.	Hospital nurses who say he is the best and would select him for their surgery if they had surgery (yes, I interviewed them while my wife was recovering)
9.	You’re a guy who would like your wife looking smoking hot, but not fake.

If you like lots of words…read on.

If price is your main considerations, you should probably look elsewhere.  Dr. White is however an extreme validation of the rule that you get what you pay for.  With Dr. White, you pay a little more for a HUGE increase in EVERYTHING I believe is important.  With Dr. White, it is like paying $3,000 more for a Yugo and getting a Ferrari.  World class performance and sexy as h… - eck wife.

My wife needed 4 c-sections. She is in impeccable health, works out every day, eats perfectly but always felt discouraged with the literal impossibility of having her midsection look appealing in the mirror.

When she presented the idea of elective surgery, I spent probably 20-30 hours of research on the internet and obtaining referrals…with complete horror I learned of the risks and the high probability of mediocre results.  My conclusion was to either get “the best” whatever that means or do nothing at all.
He is not just passionate and caring…he is unbelievable competent He achieved his world class talent and product by continual learning and stretching himself to improve and be better.  I learned this after hours of conversation with him pre and post op, witnessing his long-term work product first hand, and hearing similar validation from everyone indirectly associated with him. If you select him as your surgeon, you will experience that remarkable and rare combination; A doctor who his capable and confident, but will listen to you, learn, take nothing for granted and is always learning…very, rare!  He really loves what he does and cares about his patients.

The techniques he has refined over time are designed to maximize results, minimize risks and pain, and shorten recovery.  The outcome from the techniques he used (and the time, meticulousness and pride he has in getting it PERFECT) was that my wife had No swelling, no post op complications, and needed NO Painkillers after the first day, and fabulous long-term results.  This was for a surgery that is as or more invasive than a C-Section.
The Saturday after my wife was released from the surgical center, she informed the call center about some concerns (I think with nausea and some weird pain).  Dr. White called her immediately and let her know that everything was ok – but just to be sure and safe, he drove and met her to personally verify – even on a weekend.

He has continued to meet with her long after the procedure is done and paid for to guarantee the best possible long-term result is achieved….his alter ego is really that of an artist and perfectionist.
Finally, ….. no dogears (Google “tummy tuck dog ears”)!  Your wife, partner, or loved one will absolutely NOT have dogears or unsightly scaring if you use Dr. White.  2 years later, her scars (which continues to fade away) are still perfectly flat with the skin and she looks smoking hot and sexy.

My one in a lifetime review – for a once in a lifetime surgeon, person…and artist.
Done writing.
Hope this helps.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let me start by saying the BEST DOCTOR in DALLAS!!!  From start to finish Dr. White was the most professional and well educated Doctor I have ever consulted with.  He made me feel like I was his only client.  The attention to detail and education he provided for such a major procedure helped put my mind at ease.  I recommend this doctor to anyone in and out of Dallas.  If not local, he is worth the travel.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Issac Reese
user_reviews_extended.Description:
“Look at that, you’ve lost 12 pounds since the surgery! Isn’t that wild?!” Dr. White smiled as he gave me the good news. I smiled back and nodded in agreement, it was amazing that the pounds seemed to be coming off without me even trying, but I realized something in that moment. It wasn’t the weight that I lost that meant anything and it wasn’t even the skin that was removed…it was the 12 years of insecurity and embarrassment that I had shed that meant more than the world to me. All the times I would look in the mirror and feel a sense of dread fill me because of what I saw. All the times I would refuse to take my shirt off while swimming (which would confuse everyone because I was “so fit”) because I was too scared of what other people would think. All the times I would panic simply because my shirt got lifted too high which would expose my stomach for just a brief second. I was living my life as a 23 year old with the self-confidence of my 12 year old self. But all that was changed thanks to Dr. White.

I could write a book about how confident and safe I felt in trusting Dr. White with my surgery, but I know most people (including myself) have the attention span of a goldfish so I’ll keep it brief. He’s a compassionate and kind hearted man who truly does care about every single patient that walks through his doors. Changing people’s lives through plastic surgery is his passion, and you can tell that just by listening to him talk. He constantly strives to improve his technique in order to make sure the patients get the best results which is something that’s rare to find in any profession these days. He makes sure you’re prepared for every single potential outcome so that there are no surprises and if there’s something that he didn’t talk about, he has enough experience that he can handle it without missing a beat. Going into this whole process, I had my reservations about the surgery itself and also the cost if we’re being honest. All of those went away pretty much instantly after having my initial consultation with him. I couldn’t be happier with the results even if they threw in a free pony with the surgery, and it was worth every penny.

Speaking of Penny, both of his front desk workers (Penny and Jazmin) are fantastic people. I think it speaks volumes to the quality of a business if the employees are amazing as well. Dr. White has truly created an experience that leaves you feeling whole and happy every time you leave. I’ve recommended his office to every single person I talk to whether it’s my family, my friends, or the random guy that asks me if I want guac in my bowl at Chipotle. I don’t think I’ll ever be able to thank him enough for what he’s done for me, but I figure this is a good start.

P.S. I know that it seems out of place for a guy to get something like a tummy tuck but keep in mind that being confident in yourself and happy with your body isn’t something that’s gender specific…it’s universal. That being said, I do find it strange to say I got a tummy tuck, so I’ve opted in to calling it an “Ab Sculpt”. You can use that too, but I do charge a royalty fee.

If you have a blockage, I definitely recommend getting the procedure done. Your allergies won't bother you nearly as much, and being able to breathe out of both nostrils is pretty amazing.... and no, your nose won't look different, unless you want him to make it look different.

So I highly recommend this procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Cole
user_reviews_extended.Description:
REFERRAL/Dr. Shenaq

I had a double mastectomy, and FLAP reconstruction surgery for breast cancer in 2015. I used another surgeon in the DFW area, and very quickly realized I had made a VERY big mistake. I had numerous complications, and several trips to the ER. This surgeon left my body disfigured to the point I could not wear my normal clothes. When I confronted him, he told me that it was just the way my body was, and that he could not fix it. At this point I was not only frustrated, in pain, but also suffering with depression thinking that I would never look “normal” again. I started looking for another plastic surgeon, to find that the FLAP surgeons in DFW are a very tight knit community, and only had each other’s backs. It was a very discouraging couple of months.

After 2 months of “it can’t be fixed”, I decided to seek out a surgeon outside of the FLAP/reconstruction community. I researched, and researched for over a month. I finally decided to call Dr. Steven White in Dallas. His reviews, and results were like none I had seen for any other plastic surgeon. I called his office, and expected the same run around I had been getting for several months.

To my surprise, I had exactly the opposite experience!!! The receptionist asked what I was looking for, and want I was wanting to have done. After I explained my situation, she said, “Dr. White does not do that procedure, but we have a doctor we recommend, and send people to in Houston. Dr. Jay Shenaq”. My first surprise was that both Dr. White, and his office knew exactly what Dr. White could do and could not do, and were 100% up front about it. They did not try to make me come in for a consultation, only to waste my time and co-pay to tell me that there was nothing Dr. White could do for me. I was AMAZED!! Dr. White, nor his office, had any obligation to help me in this situation, especially because I was not his patient, nor would I become one of his patients. The receptionist was super sweet, and stayed on the phone with me for about 30mins answering my questions, as well as re-assuring me that Dr. Shenaq was the best, and would be able to fix what had happened. She truly cared for me as a person, and not just another dollar sign. It was a refreshing change.

I did in fact take their recommendation, made an appointment, and flew to Houston within the week. Dr. Shenaq took one look at me and said “What happened to you?” I explained, and he told me “Do not worry. I can fix all of this. I don’t want you to worry another second about this mess. Let me do that, and we will get you looking great.” At this point, I cried in relief. Dr. Shenaq did in fact finish out my reconstruction with AMAZING results!!! I can not say enough about Dr. Shenaq, his team, his work, and his results. He was able to make my reconstruction look very natural, along with fixing the mess the first surgeon left. It can be cumbersome to travel 4 hours for a doctors appointment, but it 100% worth every cent to see Dr. Shenaq. He not only restored my body, he restored my mental state as well. He is worth every penny, as well as very second you will spend traveling. What numerous DFW doctors said they could not fix, Dr. Shenaq not only fixed, but made look better than I ever imagined. GO. SEE. HIM.

Dr. White had ZERO reason, and/or obligation to offer me anything other than “we can’t help you”.  Dr. White was compassionate, concerned, and patient to offer me all the advice he did. He was also wise enough to know what procedures he could confidently complete, and which ones he could not. He made no pretenses that he could or would fix me. He also did not have an ego that kept him from recommending what was best for me as a patient. He did not simply line his pockets with my money, and then send me on my way. It was such refreshing approach to patient care that I had not seen before.

THANK YOU. THANK YOU. THANK YOU Dr. White, and team. You have helped me regain my life back after cancer, and a botched reconstruction!!

While I received botox more for prevention than cure since I am still very young, the results have already been so amazing. I look well-rested and bright-eyed and my make-up finally goes on smooth. Thank you, Dr. White!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaux Koenigsberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: “Best in Dallas" is a monumental UNDERSTATEMENT!  Dr. White is a superhero with a scalpel! I am well into my 30s, yet have been able to continue modeling professionally with a little proactive anti-aging "help". I'm so very thankful to have Dr. White and his amazing staff in my corner as I age gracefully, and hopefully remain ahead of the game. Despite his status as one of the most well-decorated plastic surgeons in the country, Dr. White is humble, caring and truly an advocate for ethics, safety and patient health. I was most recently in the office for a bit of Botox, and even this is done with more consideration and design than is the norm. "Better Botox" is what Dr. White calls his Botox protocol. I didn't think it was possible, but he has indeed found a better way to administer Botox! It is true that not all Botox is created equal. He's tweaked every step of the process to result in better results, less complications and an overall easier recovery. My Botox results are natural yet beautifully effective, and I could not be more thrilled with the outcome. I didn't feel a thing during treatment due to the sting-free solution he's devised, nor did I have a single bruise! I have always bruised and dreaded the uncomfortable stinging during Botox injections in the past, so this is quite extraordinary! He uses super tiny needles and replaces them frequently, so I literally felt nothing. I look and feel refreshed, and I'm over the moon to have found such a fabulous doctor in which to entrust my appearance. There are not enough stars in the galaxy to sufficiently rate this amazing team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derek Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife had Dr. White has her surgeon recently and he did a phenomenal job. She chose him based on his credentials and his amazing technique. I would recommend him to anyone out there who is looking for plastic surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: All of my friends have been raving about botox. I thought i was way too young to start getting botox, after all im only 26. After hearing all the good things about how Dr. White does botox I started focusing on the wrinkles in my forehead and my elevens and decided it was worth a try. I AM AMAZED! Dr. White was meticulous with his markings and made a unique "map" just for my face, not just the same pattern for every person. There was zero pain with the super small needles he uses and no bruising because he focuses on avoiding the blood vessels. My forehead looks perfect! No wrinkles. I am so happy with my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcela
user_reviews_extended.Description:
when I first went to Dr. White I was sure if the size and look I was trying to achieve. He advised me to go biggger due to my body type. I wasn’t sure but i trusted Him. I went from 32b to 32 DD.
650cc in each breast. I love the results!! I would have never thought that DD would actually fit my body. But it did. 650ccs seems like a lot but no. It wasn’t a lot for my body because it fits me perfectly and he knew exactly what would look good on me. My body looks natural. I had no bruising and minimal pain.
I’d totally recommend Dr. White to anyone who’s looking to have breast augmentation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is going to be long so bear with me... but you want to read it if you are considering an abdominalplasty. I shopped around for years looking for the right surgeon and finally landed on this guy that was quite expensive, very type A personality and repeats himself over one over until you swear if you hear that comment one more time you may scream... let me tell you though... those three qualities are what you want in a surgeon. He is expensive because he cares about his patients. You aren’t a number to him, he truly cares. And when you are in excruciating pain the day after surgery, you need a type A personality to tell you to cowgirl up and you’re bawling like an emotional mess. And it isn’t until after the surgery that you realize why he repeated himself so many times, because when you are out of it, you’re in line and you aren’t in control on anything around you, you cling on to things you know, and suddenly the only things you know are those things he pounded into your head.
Now they say to eat an elephant you have to take one bite at a time and this surgery is equal to shoving that whole damn elephant down in one fell swoop. It hurts, you’ll regret every second of it for the first 24 hours and at one point you will hate everyone. And then it’s gone. You wake up more, you feel better and then you are so grateful that you made the leap to have this surgery. The first 24 hours are brutal but there is no better doctor than Dr. White

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Bruckshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough about the exceptional care and expertise I received from Dr. Stephen White during my rhinoplasty procedure. From the very beginning, it was clear that he approaches his work with an extraordinary level of precision and professionalism—he is truly a perfectionist in every sense of the word. The results exceeded all of my expectations. Remarkably, I experienced virtually no swelling, no bruising, and absolutely no pain following the surgery, which speaks volumes about his skill and meticulous technique. My recovery was incredibly quick and seamless, allowing me to return to my normal routine far sooner than anticipated. Dr. White’s attention to detail, steady hand, and commitment to excellence place him among the very best surgeons in the country. I would highly recommend him to anyone considering this procedure and feel fortunate to have been under his care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: H H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a breast explant, capsulectomy, and re-implant surgery to address capsular contracture. The procedure was performed by Dr. White in Dallas.

I have a history with Dr. White; he performed my initial implant surgery 10 years ago. I had zero trepidation about choosing him again for this recent procedure due to his extensive experience, deep knowledge of anatomy, and exceptional eye for symmetry and detail. He is a perfectionist, which is exactly who I want performing surgery on me.

In addition to selecting a highly skilled surgeon, excellent results depend on informed and diligent aftercare, both from your doctor and from yourself. This procedure was much more complex than my initial implant surgery 10 years prior, and the recovery process was more restrictive, requiring drains, compression, and careful, limited movement.

That said, I have had no complications from this procedure, which I attribute to Dr. White’s meticulous aftercare and my adherence to his post-operative guidance.

Dr. White has assembled an incredible in-office team of women who are diligent, caring, calming, and understanding. From the moment you walk in, they create a supportive and reassuring environment. They are attentive to detail, responsive to questions, and genuinely invested in your comfort and well-being throughout the entire process.

I would highly recommend Dr. White to anyone seeking results from a surgeon with a perfectionist approach and who is willing to put in the effort required to maintain those results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Bonnet
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a bad experience from the beginning and would not recommend!

title: Farris Plastic Surgery
address: 8345 Walnut Hill Ln Suite 120, Dallas, TX 75231, United States

user_reviews.Name: Sarah Orozco
user_reviews.Description:
I couldn’t be happier with my breast augmentation and the results are truly better than I ever expected. From the very beginning, all of my appointments leading up to surgery were smooth, seamless and reassuring which made the whole experience so much easier.

Janie and Elizabeth were amazing and helped me through every pre-op and post-op visit. They were always kind, patient, and supportive, and made sure I felt comfortable and informed every step of the way.

Dr. Farris is by far the best doctor! He also performed my sister’s surgery, and seeing how great her results were made me confident in choosing him. I’m so grateful I did. My results look incredibly natural, exactly what I wanted, and I feel more confident than ever.

I’m truly thankful for Dr. Farris and his entire team and would highly recommend them to anyone considering surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Reece Cho
user_reviews.Description:
I had an amazing experience with Dr. Zachary Farris and his entire team. I had a more complex medical situation that required extra planning and coordination, and Dr. Farris went above and beyond to make sure I felt safe, informed, and fully taken care of every step of the way. He and his staff were incredibly attentive and accommodating, which made a huge difference in easing my anxiety before surgery.
The assistants and office staff were also extremely friendly, supportive, and welcoming throughout the entire process, from consultations to follow-ups. Everyone made me feel comfortable and genuinely cared for.
I was initially very nervous about getting breast implants because I wanted noticeable volume but was terrified of looking fake or unnatural. I trusted Dr. Farris’s expertise and asked for his honest opinion on what size and profile would best suit my frame. He helped guide me to the perfect choice, and I’m so glad I listened.
My results already looked natural at around 2.5–3 months post-op, and by 4 months they look absolutely amazing. They fit my body beautifully and exceeded my expectations in every way.
I’m extremely happy with my experience and results, and I would absolutely recommend Dr. Farris to any friends or family considering breast augmentation or similar procedures.Thank you so much to Dr. Farris and his team ❤️💚and Merry Christmas

user_reviews.Name: Denise Ibarra
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Zachary Farris and his incredible staff! I had always wanted a breast augmentation but was hesitant. After having two children and breastfeeding both, I lost a lot of volume and developed a tuberous look. I did extensive research, met with other surgeons, then saw Dr. Farris featured in D Magazine. I saw his work, read so many positive reviews, and that sealed the deal for me.

From the very first consultation, I knew I had found the right surgeon. Dr. Farris was patient, kind, incredibly informative, and created such a comfortable environment. I actually had two consults and both exceeded my expectations. He was very transparent and informed me of potential risks. He helped manage my expectations and kept them realistic.

The entire staff is just as amazing. Janie at the front desk always greets me by name and is so sweet and accommodating. Elizabeth is warm and welcoming, and together they create such a friendly, comfortable atmosphere. Leading up to surgery, John, the anesthesiologist, was wonderful, thorough, reassuring, and friendly.

The morning of my procedure,  when it came time to make final decisions, I thought I knew what I wanted, but I trusted Dr. Farris’s recommendation— and I’m SO glad I did.
Liz was right there with me, excited for me and encouraging. Thanks to the whole team, I didn’t feel one ounce of nerves, doubt, or hesitation.

The procedure itself was quick (under two hours), and my recovery was unbelievably smooth. It hardly felt like I had undergone major surgery! Dr. Farris and his team checked in on me frequently. Their care made all the difference.

Immediately post-op, my results looked amazing, I was absolutely ecstatic. Now, two months later, I am still completely obsessed with my results. My breasts look natural, beautiful, and symmetric. My confidence has been restored, and I feel incredible.

I would choose Dr. Farris and his team a million times over and would recommend them without hesitation to anyone considering breast augmentation. They are simply the best!!

user_reviews.Name: phelicia hughes
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Farris was amazing. He did a great job asking about my wants and goals. He was able to explain healthy expectations of my after care and results. The staff was so nice and helpful with any questions I had. I would definitely recommend this place!

user_reviews.Name: Lauren Crowdis
user_reviews.Description: I had such a wonderful experience with Dr. Farris and his team! From my first consultation through surgery and follow-up, the entire office was incredibly communicative, professional, and easy to work with. They made me feel comfortable every step of the way and answered all of my questions thoroughly. I’m so happy with my results and would highly recommend Dr. Farris to anyone considering breast augmentation — he and his staff truly go above and beyond!

user_reviews.Name: Diamond Dixon
user_reviews.Description: After breast feeding for a year and a half I needed a change. I went to Dr.Farris in 2023 and he changed my life. The entire staff and I laughed and had a great time. Thank you for just keeping it natural and giving me the gift of a lifetime. 3 years with beautiful boobies

user_reviews.Description:

Kaylie was the first person I spoke to & she was such a sweetie, so I made an appointment for my consultation. Meeting the rest of the lovely staff from Elizabeth to Janie and of course Dr. Farris was so wonderful & they just made me feel so welcome.  I was very impressed because Dr. Farris sat with me to discuss my medical history & what I was looking to change. This was before examining me, which left a great first impression because honestly, no other Dr. had done that before. I absolutely love my results, it was exactly what I was looking for. So if you're looking for a caring staff and an amazing Dr. then I highly recommend you come in so you can see for yourself, trust me you won't regret your decision.

Yvonne G.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Farris is absolutely incredible!!! His staff and himself go above and beyond to ensure you are comfortable and happy during and after your surgery. I could not be more pleased with my submental liposuction surgery, Dr. Farris has given me new-found confidence! I truly cannot recommend him enough. Kind, thorough and thoughtful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mayra Puente
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Farris and the entire team. From the very first consultation to every follow-up visit, the level of care and attention has been outstanding. One of the things that stood out the most was how accessible Dr. Farris was. He personally responded to online messages, often within minutes, which is almost unheard of.

The staff took the time to walk me through every step of the process. I knew exactly what to expect before, during, and after surgery. Their thorough approach made everything feel seamless and put me at ease.

The level of personalized care was evident throughout. I never felt like just another patient. Even after surgery, I felt genuinely cared for, not just during follow-ups but in every interaction.

This made me question a couple things.

Dr. Farris has an OR right in his office. The surgery took approximately 3 hours from the time I arrived until the time I was leaving.
Dr Farris warned me of swelling and bruising. He told me I might not want to look in the mirror for a few days. I did anyway and I was so excited. Even with the bruising and supporting tape I could see the bags were gone.
As of this writing I am 4 weeks into this.
I had discomfort for 3 weeks. I still have to do the blinking exercises to loosen up a few times a day. Dr Farris told me this will get better with time and could have some residual for up to 12 months. It is a non issue because I like looking in the mirror again. This is the best thing I have done for myself in a long time.
I highly recommend Dr Farris.
I will end with saying it again. I like looking in the mirror again.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a breast augmentation with Dr. Farris this past February, and I can honestly say I’m beyond ecstatic with my results—truly better than my highest hopes. The outcome looks so natural that my friends constantly tell me it’s like I was born with them, which was exactly what I wanted.

From the very beginning, Dr. Farris had an incredible bedside manner. He really listened to my goals and completely understood the assignment. Because of this experience, I’ve been referring all my friends and family to Dr. Farris and his team without hesitation. If you’re considering a procedure and want natural results with a provider who truly cares, I can’t recommend him enough.

title: Azouz Plastic & Cosmetic Surgery
address: 7777 Forest Ln Building C, #802, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

user_reviews.Name: L Walker
user_reviews.Description:
For my 50th birthday, I decided to address a couple of long-standing body image concerns and consulted with Dr. Azouz’s office. After visiting the practice and discussing my options, I chose to undergo gynecomastia surgery along with liposuction. I could not be more pleased with the results.

Dr. David Azouz and Dr. Vitali Azouz performed the surgery and have supported me throughout the entire recovery process, which has gone extremely smoothly—exactly as they predicted. Incredibly, my body looks better than it has at any point in my life. The man-boobs that plagued me for years are gone, there is virtually no scarring, and for the first time ever, I feel confident taking my shirt off in public.

Dr. David, Dr. Vitali, and the entire staff have been exceptional and treated me like a family member every step of the way.

user_reviews.Name: Adam bitton
user_reviews.Description: I’ve known the Azouz family a long time but this is my first time using their medical services and am I glad that chat GPT suggested him over a different doctor I was already seeing in the same building. The original Oncologist wanted to charge me 10x more than what the Azouz practice did for a painless surgery that took no longer then 5 minutes. Me and my bank account are glad that we found you on ChatGPT! Otherwise I would of not thought about contacting such a well reuptable family practice and would have been throwing thousands of dollars down the drain!!

user_reviews.Name: Michaela Bunke
user_reviews.Description: I have been through the medical system and seen my fair share of doctors—truly good ones are not easy to find. Dr. Azouz is absolutely one of the good ones. He listens well, empathizes deeply, and works hard to make sure his patients are taken care of to the highest standard. He fights for and cares about his patients as whole people, considering not just their physical ailments but their emotional well-being as well. In other words, he treats you like a human, not a problem.

user_reviews.Name: Faith Swiney
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Sol Azouz is amazing! I had liposuction for lipedema with him almost 2 months ago. My results were instant, he was (and is) always available for questions, and his bedside manner is unlike any other surgeon I’ve known. His nurse and office staff are both helpful and friendly. I truly cannot say enough about Dr. Azouz and would recommend him to anyone looking for surgery or a consult. He was able to diagnose me as soon as he met me and walked me through the entire process. He even accepts insurance and my surgery was 100% covered. So thankful for Dr. Azouz and his team! 5 stars isn’t enough.

user_reviews.Name: Amy Kara
user_reviews.Description:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Disappointing Physician-to-Physician Interaction — Arrogant and Unprofessional

I scheduled an appointment with Dr. Solomon Azouz after he responded to my inquiry on a physician community messenger regarding treatment for a recurrent right ankle cyst. He indicated that it was within his scope and shared his office information for scheduling. I replied with my contact details in case further coordination was needed, but received no follow-up communication.

When I called to schedule the appointment, I offered my insurance information, which was declined over the phone. I asked again during the appointment reminder call and was told to bring it on the day of the visit. After driving a considerable distance, I faced immediate administrative challenges: I emailed my insurance information twice to registration, but they claimed they couldn’t access either message.

While waiting, I overheard Dr. Azouz remark, “I don’t know who she is—of course she has to pay for the consultation.” I approached him and reminded him of our prior exchange. His response was dismissive and unprofessional: “We don’t accept insurance. You’ll need to pay for the consultation.” This was never disclosed during any of our prior communication.

When he reiterated that payment was required, I prepared to leave. At that point, he said, “Well, since you’ve driven all the way here, let me at least take a look out of courtesy and give you my opinion.” While I appreciated the gesture, it wasn’t necessary—I was already familiar with the diagnosis and the next steps. It felt more like a half-hearted attempt to compensate for his earlier lack of empathy and professionalism than a genuine offer of help.

His demeanor throughout the interaction was arrogant and condescending. At one point, a third staff member had to step in to diffuse the tension after I stated I no longer wished to be examined. When I said I would be leaving a review of my experience, Dr. Azouz responded that I couldn't do that—and insisted he would write one against me.

If this is the way fellow physicians are treated, I truly worry about the experience of everyday patients. Transparency, respect, and professionalism were sorely lacking. Just laying this out in the open—there are plenty of superior plastic surgeons out there.

user_reviews.Name: Brianna Moore
user_reviews.Description: This practice is phenomenal. I have been exceedingly impressed with every detail, every piece of knowledge, professionalism, and care given. It’s difficult to provide that level of everything and still have the patient feel immediately very well cared for- like part of the family. I never felt stupid for any questions because both doctors allowed me to feel very comfortable… and his stories! He has seen everything! My husband feels strongly about doing business with intelligent, but very personable professionals and that’s exactly what the Dr. Azouz’s do. Dr. Azouz also has a special way of boosting your confidence- yes, he enhanced my chest and tummy, but he also spoke with me in a way that helped me enhance my overall well being. He has so much experience that he knew exactly what I needed when I walked in. One of the best parts is that I didn’t need any drains post op!! Apparently he is one of the only surgeons in Dallas to do the surgery in a way that doesn’t require drains. The surgery went exactly as planned, and post surgery was very manageable (I returned to work 2 weeks later, have a husband, a 10 year old, a 5 year old and a dog). My scars are not visible on my chest, and the line on my tummy is not gross. Love this place! Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Jacob Rozenberg
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Solomon Azouz is hands down the best plastic surgeon in Dallas! I couldn’t be more thrilled with my results. I did my gynecomastia, liposuction 360, BBL, and mini neck lifts, and his expertise truly shows.

From the initial consultation to post-op care, Dr. Azouz and his team were professional, kind, and attentive.

He made me feel comfortable and confident throughout the entire process, and the results exceeded my expectations. Whether you’re considering body contouring or facial procedures, I highly recommend Dr. Azouz. If you’re looking for the best in the business, look no further!

user_reviews.Name: Gretchen Kostyniak
user_reviews.Description: I received exceptional care from Dr. Azouz, his nurse Cassandra and his office staff. He made me feel comfortable at each visit, and calls to his office were answered immediately. Both times he was in his office and came to the phone himself to answer my questions. If you are searching for a surgeon to help in your Lipedema journey, look no further.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Hartman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Undoubtedly the best decision I could have made choosing Dr. Azouz. My issue was a hernia that was protruding from my abdominal area. I had seen other doctors that didn’t understated the severity of my hernia. I’m 54, heavy set woman, who eats natural farm to table food (rarely processed food). I have worked out with a personal trainer for 4+ years. So I’m in decent/good shape. I walk 5ks often. I am very active. I say all this to let you know that meeting Dr. Azouz was an experience of instantly knowing that I had found a Doctor that truly understood the concerns I had about my health and this hernia that seemed to be growing! He made sure I understood that he could help me. After getting tests confirming the ‘angry hernia’, Dr Azouz confidently and honestly told me that he could fix it and that that surgery would be very difficult and complicated. He was honest. Told me it needed to happen sooner over later and why.  Answered all my questions directly and never made me feel like I was anything but a wonderful human that needed a tough surgery. When you are faced with this type surgery, you don’t want anyone but the best.  Someone that checks on you as needed. Responds to concerns and walks side by side with you thru the entire process. In my case he felt he needed 2 surgeons in OR for the duration of the surgery. I appreciated that attention to detail and treating me like a human and not a number. And the care since surgery has been just as focused. He has stayed close to my case after surgery because that was what was required in my situation. My body has thrown us some ‘curveballs’ and he is there. He and his partner in surgery have continued to be responsive to me even when what I really needed was reassurance. I highly recommend his office for any surgery you consider. He has given me a new life by helping me take my health to the next level! Only the best! And Dr Azouz is the best!

10/2/19 I am 14 months post surgery, and I am still improving. I look back on the past year + and cant imagine doing the things I can do now that I couldn't do then. Again, Dr. Azouz and Dr Azouz2 gave me the personal care that only dedicated doctors can give. It was tough healing over the first few months but they were there by my side the whole way. Seeing them now is special for they have given me a gift that most doctors would never consider because they don't understand what it's like to be heavy  due to genetics  and not lifestyle!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabby Clarkson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Azouz and his team are so friendly, helpful, and accomodating. Dr Azouz does a great job explaining all available options, and is very thorough in his approach. Definitely recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Perry Hoto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctors David and Vitali Azouz treated my case with respect, dignity, and importantly, discretion. Dr. Vitali Azouz was my primary contact throughout my appointments, including pre and post-operation. He did a fantastic job, and the result of the gynecomastia removal left nothing to be desired. Surgery date was In July, and by October I was up and ready to tackle any challenge, including having my shirt off around family and friends. Beaches and pools are no longer sources of stress and fear. I workout regularly and have full mobility and functionality. It has been a huge confidence boost, and, not to be dramatic, a freeing experience. Totally worth it. Thanks again, doctors Azouz and  Azouz!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Went to Dr. Azouz about a gynecomastia issue that has bothered me for over 10 years. Saw him for the initial visit and knew immediately he was the guy to help address the problem. He was extremely knowledgeable, professional, and friendly to where I was completely comfortable pulling the trigger on the procedure immediately. Fast forward a week and a half after my initial visit with him and we had our follow-up after my surgery from the Friday before, and I could not be happier with the results. His bedside manner and knowledge made me extremely comfortable as he provided his recommendations for next steps while also being sensitive to the issue itself. I have never been as comfortable talking to a Dr. about this issue as I had been with Dr. Azouz.

I am on day (2) of my recovery, and I can say that even in this short a time the surgery has been life changing. He followed up every day to make sure I was 100% comfortable and available for any questions or concerns. Bedside manner is top notch and has made me feel like a priority from day 1.

If you have that thing that has bothered you and have been on the edge of pulling the trigger, no matter what the issue may have been, I highly encourage you to visit Dr. Azouz and his team for a consult.

Best Plastic/Cosmetic Surgeon in Dallas, Ft. Worth, Frisco, Irving, Garland, etc. by far and will be recommending him to anybody that I know may be looking to get something done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antonio Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Extremely Disappointing Experience - Would Not Recommend

I had high hopes for my gyno surgery with this practice, but unfortunately, it has been a complete disappointment from start to finish. Not only was the procedure itself poorly done, but the lack of professionalism and care from the surgeons and staff was shocking.

First of all, the results were nothing like what we had discussed. Despite clear communication beforehand, the outcome was far below expectations. I feel like the surgery didn’t address the issues we spoke about and has left me with additional concerns I didn’t have before. The scars are more noticeable than anticipated, and my recovery has been much harder than I was led to believe.

To make matters worse, I spent $11,000 on this surgery, and it was absolutely not worth it. I expected a level of care and professionalism that matched the high price, but instead, I’m left with poor results and no support.

Additionally, the surgeons themselves were dismissive of my concerns post-op, offering no real guidance on what went wrong or how to fix it. The follow-up care was non-existent, and I felt completely ignored. It’s frustrating to have trusted them with something so important, only to be left feeling worse than before.

I would strongly advise anyone considering this practice to look elsewhere. I regret choosing them and would not recommend them to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Katz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The did such an amazing job, for an extremely fair price.
I really appreciate that they actually care.
I was able to schedule my surgery quickly, only had to take a week off of work (I have a very physical job) and didn't have to take any opiates.
I couldn't be happier with the results.
These are good doctors and good people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura McDonald
user_reviews_extended.Description:
For many years I have thought about getting an arm and thigh lift to remove excess skin from a 70lb weight loss I went through about 12 years ago.  I am only 37 now, but the time felt right, so when I moved to Dallas in May I started researching cosmetic surgeons in the area and found Dr. Azouz.  This was my first experience with any type of surgery, and from the first consultation, both Dr. David Azouz and Dr. Solomon Azouz were just amazing!!  They spent an incredible amount of face to face time with me, patiently going over the procedures and asking me exactly what I wanted.  I felt incredible comfortable with them and their team, and it was clear they had a vast amount of knowledge and experience in this field.
I always felt heard and listened to throughout the process, and I received multiple check-in calls while recovering.  I honestly wasn't sure I was going to end up getting surgery when I first went in for a consultation, but I felt very positive and confident after my visit with the Azouz team.  They were able to get me in quickly and accommodate my schedule.  The surgery itself went seamlessly, and I felt I had been well prepared for the experience and after care.  I also really appreciated both Dr. Azouzs were caring but very honest and frank about what procedures would benefit me the most and what I should realistically expect from surgery.  I ended up doing an arm lift and liposuction on my thighs.  It has now been about 6 weeks since I had the work done, and even though I am still recovering and not seeing the final results yet, I can certainly see a huge difference in my arms and legs!!  I am THRILLED with my decision to move ahead with the surgery, and equally ecstatic that I found Dr. Azouz, who has continued to be amazing during my follow-up visits.
Having just been through this process, I KNOW it is intimidating to chose the right cosmetic surgeon.  I met with a few before going to Dr. Azouz, and he really stood out with his expertise, kindness, and honesty.  I am so thankful to him and his associates for giving me a newfound confidence in my body, and I will certainly recommend him to anyone looking for a wonderful and trustworthy surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luke Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. David Azouz and his staff are highly skilled and professional. I did my research for a few months contemplating having cosmetic ear surgery. From the moment I stepped foot in Dr. Azouz office I was greeted and treated with the utmost kindness. Growing up I had a difficult time with confidence and comments people would make about my appearance. He was very positive and welcoming during every step in the planning, procedure, and followup.  After the surgery I feel like a new person! I am very thankful I had a Dr. with the most knowledge and experience. If you are planning on having cosmetic surgery this Doctor is the very best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renita Beeman Sansom, RDH
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our daughter has now had 3 surgeries with Dr. Solomon Azouz for lipedema treatment. His bedside manner, care for his patients, follow-up after surgery, and the pride he takes in his work is above anything we have experienced in this journey. His nurse, Cassondra is personable, caring, knowledgeable, and will feel like a friend. We highly recommend Dr. Solomon Azouz.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Hotchkiss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Azouz was amazing! My young daughter had a big cut on her forehead. He saw her right away and was able to calm her down when giving stitches. The wound is now healed perfectly with almost no scarring. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Long
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. David Azouz is an exceptional plastic surgeon who has expertly performed a life-changing surgery on me. I had been struggling with gynecomastia, a condition that caused me to have enlarged male breasts, and it was causing me a great deal of insecurity and embarrassment. Dr. Azouz was very honest and thorough in explaining the surgical procedure and what I could expect during the recovery process. He and his staff were very professional, friendly, and accommodating throughout the entire process.

The surgery was very successful, and the results were even better than I had hoped for. Dr. Azouz was able to sculpt my chest area to look masculine and natural while removing all of the excess tissue. The recovery process was smooth, and the post-operative care was top-notch. Dr. Azouz and his staff provided me with excellent guidance and support, ensuring that the entire process was comfortable and seamless.

I am now much more confident and feel infinitely better in my own skin. I am so grateful to Dr. Azouz for his amazing work and highly recommend him to anyone considering gynecomastia surgery. He is a highly skilled and qualified surgeon who truly cares about his patients, and I can confidently say that he has changed my life for the better. Thank you, Dr. Azouz!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle J
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been eight years since I underwent the procedure, and I am still extremely satisfied and grateful. My results look fantastic, and I can’t express enough gratitude to Dr. Azouz. You are truly exceptional, and I wholeheartedly recommend you to millions—I already have. Without a doubt, he is the best breast surgeon I’ve ever encountered.”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Hennessy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sol Azouz does fantastic work and is a very skilled surgeon. He has good bedside manner and is open and honest with you about expectations. His work speaks for itself. The staff are all pleasant and easy to work with. Highly recommend him and his office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talya Rozenberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sol Azouz is a wealth of knowledge! He has been so helpful and supportive in answering all of my questions about my upcoming reconstruction. He is patient and listen to my concerns and has been instrumental in guiding me in my decision making. He explains why he recommends certain techniques over others so I can achieve my desired results. I trust him completely!!! You won't be disappointed. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for a fabulous plastics surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Coleson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got injured at work last August by a cat. I was really worried but the great team at Azouz took amazing care of me. They were easy to schedule appointment and change, if needed.  They were insanely fast as well and had me in/out in no time. But I also felt like I wasn't rushed. I would recommend this team to anyone in the future. Also, there's a pretty nice view in the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Salma Ahmed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My entire experience with Dr David and Dr Solomon was wonderful. From my very first consultation all the way to my post op follow ups, I have never had such a pleasant and positive experience with a doctor before. user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s been a month since I had gynecomastia surgery with both Dr. David Azouz and Dr. Solomon Azouz (they’re a dad/son dynamic duo haha).

Price-wise, expect this to be pricey for several reasons: this procedure is elective, these surgeons are very experienced, and they have generally outstanding feedback from their patients (he gave me a discount for being a healthcare worker). Dr. David Azouz is one of the most in-demand board certified plastic surgeons in Dallas. He also treats patients from all around the world and performs gynecomastia surgery very frequently as its one of his most popular procedures. He conveyed to me during my appointment that sometimes he performs over five of these procedures on different patients on a given day. Therefore, he has likely perfected every tiny surgical detail as well as its typical post-operative management.  My insurance didn’t cover this. However, because of their long-standing experience, I didn’t have a problem with their price tag.  I paid the whole thing out of pocket but I believe they offer installment plans if I’m not mistaken.

As far as the surgery itself, I was given IV sedation with Propofol and Versed; there’s no need for intubation. Of course anesthesia is individualized based on your history and preferences. For myself, Anesthesia was able to manage this procedure without an invasive airway (its kind of like if you’ve ever had a GI scope - similar level of sedation). The CRNA I had was pretty chill and answered all my questions pre-operatively. It takes place at an outpatient surgery center near Medical City Dallas and you can go home the same day with a designated driver after recovering in PACU. The day will go like this: you go to the surgery center, you change into a gown, a nurse inserts an IV, and you walk yourself into the OR. During this time, the CRNA (or whoever is the Anesthesia provider) places EKG stickers on your back and you lie down on the OR table while they restrain both your arms. The last thing I remember is this and Dr. David Azouz starting a pleasant conversation with me (I believe he does this to calm your anxiety and assess your level of consciousness to see if you’re adequately sedated for the procedure; at this time the CRNA is pushing sedating medicines through your IV). I honestly don’t even recall seeing my CRNA pushing meds through my IV. I was asleep during the procedure. The next thing I remember is being in the car at CVS Pharmacy with my family telling me they’re going to go inside and get my pain meds real quick. (Side note, my family said I was trying to jump out of the car on the highway on the way home hahahahahaha).  I don’t even remember waking up in PACU. I got home, they got me dressed in my PJs, and I went to sleep. I don’t really recall much else from that day. To your benefit, the IV meds you’re given intraoperatively produce varying levels of amnesia.

As far as pain, I didn't have any pain at all following the procedure. I think I was given Tylenol #3 with Codeine (I forgot tbh because I didn’t use it much). My only complaint was the skin agitation; I developed blisters and inflammation around my torso which was WAY more uncomfortable than the surgical sites themselves. Dr. Solomon was really nice to me and gave me free Aveeno eczema sample creams and balms as well as a prescription for a corticosteroid called Clobetasol propionate cream (which worked wonderfully).

I’m writing this testimonial to give you an idea of what to expect and to give the praise Dr. David Azouz and Dr. Solomon Azouz deserve. They’re both excellent surgeons and I recommend that they treat your gynecomastia. I chose them specifically after researching their website, reading their biographies, and reading google reviews (most of them are 5-star reviews that attest to their greatness I might add). Therefore, I hope that this review will allow you to comfortably select Dr. David Azouz and Dr. Solomon Azouz as your surgeons of choice. I love these guys and I’m extremely grateful they did my surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Rosson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife's review of Dr. Azouz:

Dr. Azouz is a gifted surgeon who has succeeded where numerous others have failed and enabled me to live my life without constant pain.

I'm a healthy, young marathon runner, so when I started to have significant pain in my upper thigh that kept me from running, I was highly concerned. I visited 2 orthopedic surgeons, both of whom said imaging was clear and that they couldn't find anything wrong with me. They both referred me to physical therapy where I wasted months of my time and thousands of dollars and saw no improvement. Finally, someone suggested that I should see someone in a different surgical specialty, so I reluctantly went to Dr. Azouz, wondering what a plastic surgeon could possibly to help. Within a few minutes of his first examination, he said he felt a mass in my thigh he wanted to remove. We were a bit incredulous that he could find something in 2 minutes that numerous surgeouns hadn't found over the course of a dozen visits, but we agreed to move forward. The following morning he removed from my thigh a fibrotic lymph node which had been pressing on a nerve, and I was running pain-free several weeks later. I was shocked that the other surgeons who specialize in that area of the body could not have figured this out.

About a year later I started having knee pain. I looked for the best knee surgeons I could find and tried everything from cortisone shots to physical therapy. Nothing helped, so eventually one of the orthopedic surgeons concluded I had plica syndrome and performed an arthroscopic surgery. However, even after surgery, the pain continued to increase in severity and became chronic over the course of 10 months; it would keep me up at night and was literally ruining my life. Post-operative imaging looked clean and multiple orthopedic surgeons -- the best I could find in Dallas at multiple top-rated clinics -- agreed that I should just wait it out and it would eventually get better, but it never did. Finally, with nowhere else to turn, I went back to Dr. Azouz hoping for another miracle cure. After a couple visits, he felt reasonably confident that the lump that had developed over the arthroscopic entry points should be removed. In the surgery that followed, he removed a significant amount of scar tissue, and also repaired a hernia he found on the tendon. Once the surgery healed, the chronic pain was gone yet again!

Each time I went to Dr. Azouz was a Hail Mary attempt at fixing something nobody else could fix. He initially just wanted to take a look and hadn't even planned on doing surgeries for either of them, but upon examination correctly concluded that surgeries were necessary. This whole situation brings to mind the old adage that "when you're a hammer, everything looks like a nail." All these other surgeons were so focused on the specific types of issues and surgeries they're used to that they missed what was right under their noses. Dr. Azouz, on the other hand, looked holistically at the person and the problem from all angles before he decided on an approach. His methodical, caring approach is what made all the difference in my outcomes.

I cannot recommend Dr. Azouz highly enough!

title: Bradley Hubbard, MD
address: 9101 N Central Expy #600, Dallas, TX 75225, United States

user_reviews.Name: Dennise Balderson
user_reviews.Description:
I used to think plastic surgery was about perfection, but Dr. Hubbard taught me it's about becoming the absolute best version of myself, respecting the effort I put in before and after. 🤗

Dr. Hubbard performed an entire Mommy Makeover (plus an Upper Blepharoplasty), and I am completely speechless… the results are truly phenomenal. 😍 I came to him with stubborn visceral fat and fat around several areas 😜, and he meticulously sculpted a body I honestly never dreamed possible. It’s a beautiful new me!❤️

What sets Dr. Hubbard apart is how genuinely he cares and listens. He didn't just operate, he gave me the guidance to maintain his incredible work (queue in Russian twists 🥴). I now eat right and exercise, optimizing his hard work because I know my commitment is essential for lasting results. Thank you, Dr. Hubbard, for giving me my confidence back!

His support staff deserves an equal amount of praise! They are outstanding: kind, patient, sweet, responsive, and excellent listeners. They make the entire journey a comfortable and positive experience.
A+++++ rating for Dr. Hubbard and his entire team!

user_reviews.Name: Nicollette Black
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Hubbard did my arm lift as well as a few revisions that were poorly done by another surgeon. I traveled to come to him because he’s an expert and has experience with black patients. He did an amazing job. My incisions look beautiful so far. I honestly didn’t think I could have such good results. He is kind and listens to your concerns. He didn’t come off as arrogant or dismissive. I appreciate that he also sets realistic expectations. His whole team is amazing, the facility is clean and beautiful. I stayed at the post operative recovery center overnight and it was well worth the money. The nurses took amazing care of me and prepared me for recovery after discharge. 10000/10 experience! Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Olivia Paganini
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot recommend Dr. Hubbard and his team enough! Over the years, I’ve trusted him with several procedures—including BA, skin removal surgery, and an upper bleph—and I’ve been absolutely thrilled with the results every time.
What truly sets Dr. Hubbard apart is the natural beauty of his work. My scars have healed beautifully, and I continue to receive compliments on how natural everything looks.
Beyond the surgical skill, the experience with Dr. Hubbard and his staff has always been exceptional! From the moment you walk through the door, you’re made to feel comfortable, heard, and completely cared for. There’s a sense of trust and warmth in his office that is rare to find.
If you’re considering any cosmetic procedure, I can say with full confidence: you are in the best hands with Dr. Hubbard!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elise Donaldson

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wade Vickers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard and his staff are wonderful.  Dr Hubbard made me feel instantly at ease. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard did my breast augmentation a few years ago. Never have I been satisfied with my breast. He did a implant exchange, lift and made my breast areola smaller, as I asked for, however he left half of the areola coming down my scar..I told him I was very unhappy with the work bc it looked like left-over areola, however he claimed at that in time it would go away bc it’s a scar. Well few years later it in fact never went away. Looks so ugly and I’m embarrassed to wear certain bikini tops bc nothing hides the look of them. I can’t even wear certain lingerie tops because you could see the areola tied into the scar in those too! If I could change and do little more research I definitely would have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Sheehan
user_reviews_extended.Description: A year ago today, I said good riddance to my breast cancer with a bilateral mastectomy.  At the end of that surgery, Dr. Hubbard and his Medical Assistant, Kate, reconstructed my breasts.  When you’re diagnosed with cancer, the process moves quickly and blind trust plays a huge part in who you choose for your care.  I chose Dr. Hubbard for this procedure because of the confidence I saw in him at my consultation. I felt seen and heard.  He was personable and kind, but most importantly he made sure I understood that he would consider my wishes during the surgery but would not take risks if my health was in jeopardy. Turns out I had low blood supply in the skin of one breast, so Dr. Hubbard made the call to put in an expander to give that breast more time to heal.  Three months later Dr. Hubbard placed a slightly larger implant in both breasts and added a bit of liposuctioned fat to the upper pole of the breasts to make them look even more natural.  I am over the moon happy with how my breasts look and feel! I was touched that, as a cancer patient, I was treated like the patients who see him for an elective cosmetic procedure.  Dr. Hubbard, thank you again for your artistry, time and kind words. And Kate! Thanks for always being there for me!  You are both angels to the breast cancer community.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Hogan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard is hands down the best plastic surgeon! He's a genius architect in his craft. Not only did he fix my issue, but he made me look amazing; literally better than I could have ever imagined! His staff are also incredibly sweet, kind, and knowledgeable. Everyone at the DPSI were wonderful, I couldn't have had a better experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheri Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard is an amazing doctor and I highly recommend him.  Our 15 yr old daughter was in need of breast reduction.  Her breast size limited her ability to perform in activities and was also a huge self esteem issue for her.  From our first appointment Dr Hubbard was very sympathetic to our daughter and spoke with her about her proposed treatment plan at her level ensuring she had a clear understanding.  I did a lot of research on performing this surgery at her age and Dr Hubbard made us feel confidant that performing it now would open many doors for her as well as give her the confidence she lacked.  He was so right!  She is loving her new size and no longer has to hide herself under large baggy clothes.  She loves Dr Hubbard and his entire staff!!! They are an amazing team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: pppchevy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did a lot of consults for my Breast Aug and lift. by far Dr. Bradley Hubbard and his staff we the best!  I am so glad I chose Dr. Hubbard to do my procedures.

I am so very happy with the results of my breast aug and lift. AMAZING JOB! Thank you Dr. Hubbard and staff you by far are the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tatiana Delaserna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard is the kindest surgeon I have ever consulted with. user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Eckstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm not usually one who takes the time to write a review, but Dr. Hubbard and his staff deserve to be praised! I cannot say enough good things about them all.
