Thank you for the amazing care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had requested a consult with the most sought after surgeon in Houston, where I live. When they called to schedule the consult, (after submitting photos), I was picked apart and not given the time of day since I only wanted breast surgery and not a tummy tuck. I then went back to the drawing board. My friend used Dr. Hubbard and her breasts looked great so I scheduled a virtual consult for my breasts and inquired what could be done to my abdomen without a tummy tuck. Dr. Hubbard was pleasant enough on the virtual call, said only a tummy tuck could address my concerns and I told him it was’t in my means (budget and having small kids) and he never once mentioned it again. (Although I really want one with him one day bc the photos I see are amazing). I went ahead and booked but mostly based off my friend’s results and experience.

When I got to meet him the day before my surgery, he was so nice and so personable… just completely reaffirmed my decision to use him.

The day of my surgery, he was fantastic, his team was great, surgery center was 10/10. Recovery was great. I had a breast lift, aug, inverted nipple repair, areola reductions and some upper back lipo.

Kate called after a day or two and checked on me. She was soooo nice!

I am 5 weeks post op, my scars look amazing and I feel like Dr. Hubbard gave me a part of myself back that was lost after 3 pregnancies and years of breastfeeding my babies. I just had my second post op, and things have a lot of settling to do. However Dr. Hubbard mentioned every little, teeny tiny detail I was eyeballing and hoping just had settling to do. He reassured me that there’s so much settling to do but if anything needs addressed, he will. He could have said everything looks perfect but he is such a perfectionist, he is paying such close attention to the progression of my results.

I am a pretty neurotic patient and his team, Rheanna, Erin and Kate respond to all my inquiries in light speed and even run my questions by Hubbard.

Dr. Hubbard is a perfectionist with the mind of a scientist and eye of an artist.. all with a great bedside manner. Cannot recommend him/his team enough. And I have been coming back and forth from Houston, one trip was the day after Beryl hit and I would do it ALL over again. One day, I’ll get that tummy tuck because his belly buttons are amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard and his team are some of the best in the business! Dr. Hubbard did my BBL/Lipo 360 and I’ve never been happier with the way my butt looks! He and his staff were available for any post-op questions or concerns I had and always got back to me in a timely manner. I 100% recommend Dr. Hubbard, he is definitely worth the wait!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alisha Munden
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonray Childers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t normally leave reviews so quickly but I have had a great experience with Dr Hubbard and his staff from the very beginning. My initial consultation was informative and thorough. Dr Hubbard and his nurse met with me in person and answered all my questions and answered a few I didn’t know I had. user_reviews_extended.Name: Rossy Shaffer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would recommend Dr. Hubbard to anyone, and everyone that is interested.  The results were fantastic, and the bedside manner was top-notch. user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Pjetrovic
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don’t typically write reviews but I really think Dr. Hubbard is excellent. I had a minor procedure but was treated with attentiveness and care. I should end up with great results after I completely heal!  I have found many very skilled doctors typically don't have a great bedside manner but Dr. Hubbard offers both and that is why I will stick with his office in the future.  I can see why there are so many positive reviews!
I am adding to my review because my procedure didn’t turn out like I hoped. The scars are not good but Dr Hubbard actually acknowledged he could have done things differently and has offered to do the procedure again and try to correct the scarring. The negative to this is it’s going to take several months to get back into the office for the appointment. Mine is certainly not urgent so I suppose I understand.
Anyway my experience hasn’t gone as well as I hoped for but I’m happy he is willing to try and correct the original procedure and Im hoping the 2nd time will be what he/I originally hoped for.  Overall I still think this is a professional office that cares about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gamma D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard was highly recommend to me by my breast surgeon who I had picked to do a bilateral mastectomy in Sept of 2018. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenn Amrhein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard and his entire staff are top notch!  I enjoy seeing his entire practice during routine visits and feel so at ease and comfortable.  Dr Hubbard is beyond 5 stars personally and professionally!  You will not find a more likable Doctor and entire practice.  I highly recommend him to everyone I know!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda Flanik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Living life not happy with yourself is never easy, I naturally have small, A-cup breast and recently decided to get Breast Augmentation. It is so hard to find good doctors for any occasion these days, i mean with verbal recommendations, commercials and internet,  I figured I would have to visit several Doctors before finding the right one. Surprisingly the second Ad I came across on Google was Dr. Hubbard and from the moment I started reading about him, I was eager to meet with him. My consultation with Dr. Hubbard was a treat in its own, he has the nicest staff and his office had a very homey vibe. From the moment I met Dr. Hubbard I was at ease, he listened to all my concerns and reasons for deciding to make this change in my life. I have a few medical problems myself and have a lot of allergies to medications which he was already up to speed on all of my info when he walked in the room. After my consultation I immediately scheduled my surgery date, still in wonder if it was going to be as painful as my friends have said. I was in and out of my surgery with just a small amount of nausea but no pain! I was shocked, for in our talks he had mentioned that I didn't have a lot of skin to work with and it might hurt stretching the skin. I was feeling just like my self going home that day and within two days I was out and about feeling great about my new self. I Thank Dr. Hubbard every chance I get and I strongly recommend him to everyone I meet who might want to make themselves feel great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kita M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard and his entire staff are very caring people and it shows in they work together. When the anesthesiologist, Dr. Fontes put the IV in me and said he would be like my guardian angel and would be there every step of the way, It made me feel even more comfortable. Dr Hubbard has impeccable skills and the best bedside manners. I was offered exparal and happily accepted it and did not have any pain whatsoever. It felt like I had done 1000 sit ups LOL so I was sore but it was not painful.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have now had Dr. Hubbard do multiple things for me and have been beyond pleased with anything he has done! user_reviews_extended.Description: I had Rhinoplasty and breast augmentation done in April.  Other than financially, It has been of the greatest, most life-changing experiences of my life! user_reviews_extended.Name: Dayton and Andrea Wheels
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best there is!! It’s a no brainer to let Dr.Hubbard and his team do whatever they see needs to be done. And Rheanna is the best office manager ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Fairweather
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard really takes his time with you (I've never before met a plastic surgeon who didn't seem at least SOMEWHAT in a hurry, so it was almost WEIRD having the doc be fully present during the consultation AND in no hurry whatsoever.). Dr H listens to you, asks plenty of [the right] questions, and I think this means he likely concludes the consultation with a thorough understanding of your needs.  His office manager , Julie, is sharp-as-whip, and also extremely warm and caring.  LOVE those two!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Sayeed
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a total capsulectomy in 2016 because of Breast Implant Illness. I did not feel right after surgery and kept asking Dr. Hubbard if he was sure he got everything out. And he assured me he did. Just had the same surgery redone in August 2023 and the doctor found a whole capsule and a metal clip. I am allergic to metal. I found out that multiple metal clips ( cheaper and faster than stitches) were put in for the DIEP flap, which means I need yet another surgery to take them out. He never mentioned any of this and it is not on the Operation report.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Gascoine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr Hubbard for a couple of years.  I live in south central Florida and travel to Dallas to see Dr. Hubbard.  I have been more than pleased with my results.  Dr Hubbards compassionate, competent and caring manner is surpassed by none.  I would recommend him to anyone seeking treatment and/or advise.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Coffey
user_reviews_extended.Description: At a time when my life seemed to be crashing into the rocks, Dr. Hubbard, Kate and his team were my lighthouse guiding me back to a sense of calm, reassurance and comfort. Finding out that you have been diagnosed with cancer on your first mammogram and undergoing a double mastectomy is quite honestly a nightmare. From the day we met,  Dr. Hubbard's compassion for who I was and what was important to me was his number one priority. He is not only a master of his craft but a complete package. That includes a human and caring side missing from most medical proffessionals. This includes his team, from our first meeting where Kate advised me that she was my concierge and that for any concerns about anything I should reach out to her, I was only a text message or phone call away from an answer.  Dr. Hubbard not only exceeded my (and my husband's) esthetic and physical expectations, he has provided me with a feeling of completeness and wholeness I didn't think was possible. His sincerity, genuining  care drive his unbelievable results that set him apart.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ralpg Scotts
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After a massive weight loss I met Dr. Hubbard at UT Southwestern in Dallas.

I was so impressed with not only his knowledge and skills as a cosmetic surgeon, but with him as a person, that really cares about everyone of his patients.

When he opened his office in Dallas, I followed him for help and will be doing more. I would follow him anywhere he went for his help.
His staff is the BEST and Julie is always there to help you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaniqua Lindsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: About 2 weeks ago I got a breast reduction, and when I say I am so satisfied with the results!! I needed s major reduction I had back pain, shoulder grooves and just was so heavy up top that I hated the shirts that I wore. Dr. Bradley took care of me and satisfied my needs. Overall this was a seamless experience and I would do it all over again. Thank you to Dr. Hubbard and his team that took care of me I am beyond grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard and his entire staff are the absolute best. He answered all my questions and made me feel super comfortable about my procedure. I couldn’t be happier with my results and cannot speak highly enough of him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Ade
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish the doctor educated me more on how keloids affect women with my skin tone. He did nothing about this issue post surgery expect sell me a $85 silicone cream that did nothing. Wish I also did better research on doctors before choosing Dr.Hubbard . I will say though this office was great with getting me approved with insurance quick. They really know what they are doing also he did a great job with my lift and reduction. I had a child 3 years later and they are still sitting up! So if your a lighter complexion I would choose him 100000x.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Grindberg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After working next to different plastic surgeons everyday and seeing many results, Dr. Hubbard is AMAZING! Every time I see his work I am always amazed by his quality, his attention to detail, his knowledge... I have recommended my own family members and anyone I've met who is considering any sort of plastic surgery to go straight to him. His breast augmentations, tummy tucks- it's all just beautiful work every single time. Dr. Hubbard is also very honest and he's quite the perfectionist. He has amazing bedside manner with his patients and everyone walks out happy.

He's done Botox for me before in the past and he's always so careful and never over does it! They just started selling a skin care product called Skin Medica and I LOVE it!

His staff memeber's are so awesome towards me and they work very hard. Rheanna at the front desk is so sweet and she's great at answering all types of questions, helping patients out, and she's extremely knowledgeable! Lisa is such a sweet heart, I just adore her and every moment has been a wonderful experience! Kaylee and Kate are also amazing at what they do! Everyone is always so helpful in that office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda A.
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I travel all the way from Utah just to see Dr. Hubbard. He is an incredible doctor, who we trust. His work is always gorgeous, and you can tell he really enjoys what he does and cares about his patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Friday
user_reviews_extended.Description: Disappointed with my final results. My entire goal was to have lipo, a mini tummy tuck (c-section scar revision) and fat transfer as to improve my confidence in a bathing suit. 4 months post-op and I can’t wear any suits that show my left hip or groan where my hip meets my stomach. I have to wear full coverage suits that don’t show my hips. I also have scars high up on my lower back. I knew the risks going in (no plastic surgery results are perfect) and Dr Hubbard offered a revision to lipo out the strip of fat that was missed and fix the scar/excess skin fold while I was awake. I chickened out after the first few numbing injections. I couldn’t imagine being awake for that much lipo (8-9 inches across my hip) and cutting into my scar. I think they should offer twilight sedation. The assumption that it would be no big deal was a huge oversight on my part because it is a surgery. No laughing gas. No Xanax. Just a Valium did nothing for me. Some people can’t simply sit still and not vomit while being cut into and they should offer other options based on the patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Fowler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but the utmost respect and admiration for Dr. Hubbard!  He took me on and has helped me make headway where no one else has been able to!!  He's an honest, straight shooter and won't give you the "run around"...he tells you how it is and what it's gonna take to take care of your issue, I greatly appreciate that after having dealt with some of the other "doctors"...Dr. Hubbard will get nothing but glowing reports and recommendations from me, and I'm not easily swayed!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carmen Booker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard did my breast reduction in 2017. And as nervous as I was, he did a wonderful job.  And took very good care of me also.  He's kind and very genuine.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawna Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard and his staff are the best! Day of the surgery everyone introduced themselves and what their role was. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming. Best experience. I would highly recommend Dr. Hubbard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Moon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard, Kate, Rheanna, and staff are exceptional. Finding them in a time of need was truly a gift. I had breast reconstruction after cancer. Thank you all for the wonderful care, kindness, education, expertise, and commitment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First of all, my review is not for the surgeon himself or how he practices. This review is specific to his office and their customer service.
In my life, I've worked with many medical facilities and I've NEVER experienced someone as rude as "Rihanna" when she answered the phone. At first, she was polite but when I inquired on whether they accepted insurance or not it went downhill. I was very polite the entire time but she needs to thoroughly explore how to treat customers.
I specifically inquired about utilizing my insurance (BCBS) for gynecomastia surgery. She stated that they do accept insurance for gynecomastia and it's out-of-pocket only. When I asked why, she said two things; 1. The Dr. does not choose to do so and that's his choice. When I inquired a little bit more as to why, we got #2. She stated that insurance does not cover cosmetic changes such as gynecomastia. I had very clearly stated that I have preauthorization from insurance with supporting documentation that classified my gynecomastia as "Medically Necessary" and is 100% covered by insurance. After telling her this, she got very frustrated and rude. She proceeded to say that won't continue those conversation and didn't care about what information I had, bottom line is this office will not ever accept insurance for gynecomastia. There was even more words used here that I won't update in this review but in my opinion, this was a disgusting encounter. I don't care how good the surgeon is, if you support this kind of behavior for customer service, I would never recommend this facility to anyone.

Additionally, I had requested to contact the Dr. via email or any other method to provide information and plead my case but she was very hostile against this request.

She responded to tell me that if I want to discuss anything further with this establishment that I'd be required to setup a consultation appointment and would need to pay out-of-pocket for it.

In summary, I'm sure Dr. Hubbard is a phenomenal surgeon, he came highly recommended from the Texas Breast Specialists - Frisco and I was extremely excited to work with him but due to my encounter, I will reach back out to them with my experience and to warn them about future referrals.
If Dr. Hubbard happens to see this review, I'd love to connect with you to understand why my request can't be serviced at your establishment if you both accept my insurance and I have concrete approval from my insurance.

Best,
Nick

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kel D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Office staff terrible.  I had an appt that the office canceled since I didn't confirm in time and now they are trying to charge me $200 additional to come for a consult with a 4 month wait.

The gal from the office was arguing on the phone with me when I asked for my deposit back since they didn't nor are they willing to provide a service without paying more money.

If they are the gatekeepers, I wouldn't want to deal with this surgeon despite his good reviews.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Montalvo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Patient: Norma I. Montalvo:                                       I just can’t say enough about Dr Bradley Hubbard he’s expertises & compassion. He takes time to listen to your needs. And explains so carefully the procedure that you will be going through. I knew and felt right away, I was in the best hands. But what about he’s office staff and nurses, “Amazing ,“Excellent “ so sweet & caring and the anaesthesiaologist told me if I had any concerns. Mrs.Shanon Cooke  MD loves her profesión you can tell .I was a bit nerves. I felt at ease with her, she become my best friend at that moment. They should be rated 100% Thank you so much for taking care of me.” Age 65, my surgery went great 👍 Keep up the good work! P.S.- It was breast reduction. Going to look like 20! 🙍🏻‍♀️

user_reviews_extended.Name: R J
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I drive from out of state to visit Dr. Hubbard. He is by far the most professional, courteous, and talented plastic surgeon. We appreciate all that he does for our family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jynna Oneal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is super nice and helpful especially the Office Manager. Dr. Hubbard is a skilled artist. I have had two procedures with him so far and both of them turned out better than I had anticipated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Shadden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard is very personable and easy to talk to along with his staff and Julie.   I felt very comfortable and they took alot of time with me and made me feel very comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Richeson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not really happy with the appearance after my surgery. Went back and talk to him regarding it. He said he learned after my surgery how to do the internal stitches without making it look like mine did.  Hey did offer to do a in office procedure and try to fix it but it would have cost me a lot more money.  He did also try going in with an IV needle and cutting the stitches at my post OP  But it did not help. I really like this doctor but for the amount of money that I paid I feel like this should have been corrected at no charge.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Schrader
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Contacted this office for breast reconstruction revision. Had hecard great things about the plastic surgeons
in Dallas, TX. Well, that was early this year. Found out that my insurance approved the surgery in April. It expired in early July. Meanwhile, the office personnel continue to tell me they will call me to schedule the procedure. Im glad to just stay where I'm at. I give this place a huge thumbs DOWN on customer service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Aufill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my experience from start to finish with Dr. Hubbard and the entire staff! Thank you for providing such excellent care and results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allo Maison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m really happy with my breast augmentation and lift results! Dr.Hubbard is the best doctor! Highly recommend him:)))

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Hamilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard has incredible bedside manner but most importantly he does the best work in DFW.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Bodin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hubbard is an AMAZING surgeon and is so kind and caring as well as his staff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chrystal Baeza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hubbard and staff are the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judith Cestero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly Recommended His very Professional.. Love this Dr..

user_reviews_extended.Name: george lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My girlfriend had her surgery here, I would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Pedaggi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff and great experience all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shere Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely wonderful! 🎖

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Sewell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a wonderful experience with Dr Hubbard and his staff Kate,Rheanna, Erin and Toni . He did my breast augmentation a few years ago, and a month ago an upper/lower bleph with fat transfer. I am extremely grateful and happy with my results. I also go to his office to receive my aesthetic services and Erin is amazing! All in all, I have had a wonderful experience and will choose Dr Hubbard for future needs! Thank you!

title: Rod J. Rohrich, M.D.
address: Suite, 9101 N Central Expy #600, Dallas, TX 75225, United States

user_reviews.Name: Kate M
user_reviews.Description:
I had my FOURTH revision rhinoplasty with Dr. Rod Rohrich, (the other 3 were done by other doctors) and I can honestly say he exceeded every expectation I had. After so many previous surgeries, I was nervous, but his experience and confidence immediately put me at ease. He is truly one of the best in his field.

From the consultation to the post-op appointments, Dr. Rohrich was thorough, patient, and incredibly kind. He really listened to what I wanted and gave me realistic expectations. My results are absolutely beautiful natural, balanced, and exactly what I had hoped for. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Keily Hastings
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Rohrich and his staff were over the top when it came to their flexibility and helpfulness on scheduling and rescheduling my appt.   The promptness in which they responded to all my questions and attended to my needs were beyond what I feel the wrd impressive covers.   My surgical results were amazing to my husband and myself.   I am 55 years old and 10 days out from facelift/chin lift surgery.  I can with all honestly say that I look 20 years younger.  I feel more like my old self when I look in the mirror.   My face is not black, blue or yellow.  There is a mild discoloration iaround the eyes that is healing but beyond that and some obvious and expected swelling that still has to go down, my face looks completely healed.   I will have the last of my stitches out in 3 days and in another 11 days after that I’m attending a very prominent black tie event for Mardi Gras and will be riding a float in the parade.   And I can do so knowing that my face is going to look absolutely amazing and no one on that float is going to be able to look at me and say ,”She had a facelift.”All they are gonna know is that I look fantastic!
Thank you Dr. Rohrich and staff.   It was a life changing experience

user_reviews.Name: Emerson Gardner
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Rohrich and his incredible team! After struggling with breathing issues for over 13 years, I finally decided to undergo a 3rd rhinoplasty and it was the best decision I’ve ever made. Dr. Rohrich not only gave me a beautiful, natural-looking result, but he completely corrected my breathing problem. For the first time in over a decade, I can breathe freely and comfortably.

From my very first consultation, Dr. Rohrich’s expertise, precision, and genuine care were evident. He took the time to explain everything thoroughly and made me feel completely confident and comfortable throughout the entire process. His office staff deserves just as much praise. They are kind, professional, and truly go above and beyond to make every step smooth and stress-free.

If you’re considering rhinoplasty or any facial procedure, I can’t recommend Dr. Rohrich highly enough. He’s not only a world-class surgeon but also a compassionate doctor who changes lives for the better. Thank you, Dr. Rohrich and team, for giving me back my confidence and my ability to breathe!

user_reviews.Name: Ali Mattox
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Rohrich is truly the best plastic surgeon ever! I had a severely deviated septum with almost zero airflow before surgery. After my rhinoplasty, I can finally breathe perfectly, and my nose looks absolutely perfect but still so natural. I’m obsessed with my side profile and love the subtle bunny slope!

What makes him even more special is how much he genuinely cares about his patients. I’m a third-generation patient, he’s worked on both my mom and grandma. Dr. Rohrich is the best of the best and the only one we’d ever trust.

user_reviews.Name: Sarah Escobar
user_reviews.Description: I saw Dr. Rohrich for my rhinoplasty, and I love my results! I’ve been wanting to do this surgery since I was 15 years old and I finally got the courage to do it, Dr. Rohrich and his team made me feel so comfortable and I had the best experience! Go see Dr. Rohrich if you want a rhinoplasty he does amazing work!!

user_reviews.Name: Gary Osier
user_reviews.Description: I have had three procedures and a number of injections done with Dr Rohrich and I can't tell you how great they were. I have friends that have used other surgeons and yes there is a wrinkle gone here and some skin gone there but had they seen Rodney, it wouldn't look like they had had stuff done. They would just be better looking which is the goal. He is an artist. He looks at your face and "sees" how to get the results you want to see. It has been totally pain free. He has the best and kindest staff anywhere. They have the right answer to every question. My other doctors that I use for medicine tell me I got the best and it is true.

user_reviews.Name: Julie Ellis
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Rohrich and his staff are wonderful. Having a facelift was a big scary thing in my mind but Dr. Rohrich made me feel comfortable and confident immediately. It’s been three months and I’m very happy with the results. So natural looking and now I think I look the way I feel which is everything I wanted.

user_reviews.Name: Susan Jones
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Rohrich and his staff are there for you the entire journey of your procedure. The care and attention doesn't end upon completion of your surgery. They monitor and guide you through your convalescence all the while making sure you are comfortable and happy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina Sloan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with Dr. Rohrich has been remarkable. After an extensive search lasting over four years, during which I consulted with more than ten doctors, I knew Dr. Rohrich was the right choice for my facial surgery after just a brief conversation. His team is exceptional, managing every aspect of the process seamlessly. Initially, I received essential information and necessary tests, but once I arrived in Dallas from Florida, the entire staff became actively involved, providing first-class care that felt akin to being in a five-star hotel.
It is crucial to trust the process. While there may be some discomfort in the initial days, the experience is not painful. Admittedly, the first month can be daunting, but Dr. Rohrich prioritizes patient safety. He is readily available to answer any questions, often through FaceTime, and his warm demeanor is reassuring. I was particularly impressed by his commitment, as he even returned my calls from home on weekends.
Four months post-surgery, he continues to respond promptly to my texts. My results are stunning, and at 56 years old, I am thrilled with my appearance. I travel to Dallas for follow-up appointments because not only is the environment welcoming, but Dr. Rohrich is also dedicated to making any necessary corrections and offers a complimentary hydrofacial. Although my journey is ongoing, I am thoroughly enjoying my new look.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Krebs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an upper and lower blepharoplasty along with a thigh lift performed by Dr. Rod Rohrich, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the very first consultation, he and his team made me feel comfortable and fully informed about the procedures.

The surgery itself went smoothly, and I was very impressed with the level of care I received afterward. I stayed one night in the overnight facility, which gave me peace of mind knowing that I was being closely monitored by attentive and compassionate staff.

My recovery has been very smooth and the results already look amazing. Dr. Rohrich is not only a highly skilled surgeon but also someone who truly listens to his patients.  I am so grateful I chose him for this journey.

Highly recommend Dr. Rohrich and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Cannon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was dissatisfied with the bags beneath my eyes and wrinkles under my mouth area.  I researched for a cosmetic surgeon and Dr.  Rohrich had outstanding reviews from his previous patients.  I have friends in Dallas who were previous treated by him and were very satisfied with the results.  After interviewing with Dr. Rohrich I felt very comfortable with him and selected him to perform my procedure.  It has now been three weeks since by surgery and I can already see that my jaw line is smoother and the bags beneath my eyes have disappeared.  I am very satisfied with the results of my procedure.  I also wish to mention Joni the scheduler, Letty the medical assistant and Dianne and Tammy the nurses who all provided outstanding service. All of the staff were excellent. Thank you everyone for all of your help and patience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joy Sandmann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Rohrich is truly in a league of his own. From the initial consultation to my post-op care, every step of the rhinoplasty experience has been seamless, thoughtful, and grounded in excellence. His ability to combine artistry with precision is unmatched, and the results speak for themselves. My nose looks completely natural, balanced with my features, and exactly what I had hoped for (and more).

What stood out most to me was the level of expertise and care from Dr. Rohrich and his entire team. I felt informed, supported, and confident throughout the entire process. If you’re considering rhinoplasty and want the best of the best, Dr. Rohrich is the gold standard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L E
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rohrich is the best of the best! Couldn’t be happier with my results. In addition, he went out of his way to meet me at his office at 10 pm the night of my surgery when my nose wouldn’t stop bleeding to help me control it. Supportive and attentive throughout. Thanks doc!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Rohrich did my Botox and it was easy and pain free. Both Dr Rohrich and Leti made me feel at ease and made it a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariana Aribah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my rhinoplasty done by Dr. Rod Rohrich, and I can confidently say the entire process—from the first consultation to my current recovery—has been smooth, supportive, and absolutely worth it.

Before the surgery, Joni Dunismore was my go-to person for everything. She was incredibly responsive to all my emails and made sure I had every piece of information I needed about the procedure, both pre- and post-op. She really helped me feel prepared, informed, and taken care of before I even met the rest of the team.

This was my first time going under anesthesia, and naturally, I was nervous. But the anesthesiologist was amazing—she walked me through everything and made me feel completely safe and comfortable right before surgery. The entire staff, from the nurses to the OR team, made the atmosphere feel calm and professional.

I told Dr. Rohrich that I didn’t want a nose that looked overly done—I wanted something that looked natural and fit my face, while still addressing the parts that bothered me. user_reviews_extended.Description:
Cosmetic surgery is an art, and Dr. Rohrich is at the top of the game. I waited 4 weeks post-op before writing this review because I wanted it to be honest and thoughtful. I had a severely deviated septum and spent years dealing with the aftermath of two separate nose fractures. I'm extremely happy with my results -- my ability to breathe clearly for the first time in 20 years as well as the overall aesthetic.

A few things that set him apart from others:

1. His skill -- After doing months of research, I learned to appreciate how challenging this profession is, and Dr. Rohrich is the best there is right now. He has decades of experience and has thousands of satisfied patients - plus his pricing is reasonable.

2. His understanding of your objectives -- He listens carefully to what you want, and he delivers. We went back and forth on the imaging a few times, and the result turned out even better than the imaging. Don't mistake him being busy with him not listening. While he may be brief during consults, since his schedule is slammed, he listens and doesn't proceed until you're 100% comfortable.

3. His follow-through -- He is extremely professional and accessible. I needed a medication adjustment post-op, and he went out of his way after hours to make it happen. He's available via text, and always prompt in his responses.

I met with Dr. Rohrich the morning of my surgery at 7am to have a final review before the procedure, and he was absolutely locked-in. Once I saw his sharpness and demeanor, all my anxiety was gone. I knew I made the right choice before I even went under.

Advice for patients: You may experience a transition period that messes with your mind a bit for the first week after you get your splint removed. It's unsettling to see yourself differently in the mirror at first, even though it is objectively better, but this goes away.

Thank you, Dr. Rohrich. I'm certain I made the right decision.

user_reviews_extended.Name: V Trowbridge
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Several years ago I lived in a different state and had minimal access to surgeons who specialized in rhinoplasty procedures. I made the mistake of doing very little research and elected to use a random plastic surgeon in the commuting area (with 3 examples of previous work on his website) to undergo my first rhinoplasty surgery. The outcome was beyond terrible (shocking right?). It was a completely botched surgery, I was left with a deviated septum, pollybeak deformity and more.

Fast forward 8 years and I’m living in Texas and finally have access to the best of the best in the plastic surgery business. While there are tons of plastic surgeons for hire in the U.S. and across Texas, I found that there were very few who possess the artistry, precision and technical finesse necessary to consistently perform exceptional work, until I found and used Dr. Rohrich for my revision rhinoplasty.

Dr. Rohrich is not just a great surgeon, he is the Godfather of Plastic Surgery. What made him stand out to me, in addition to his mile long list of accolades and distinguished credentials, is the fact he is also Professor of Plastic Surgery who aspires to train the next generation of great surgeons and has the best interest of all patients in mind, even those he may never meet or operate on.

Additionally, he is transparent and proud to show off his work using his various social media platforms. For me, seeing as how I’m a millennial and like everything virtual and at my fingertips, it was important for me to be able to see real people, real surgeries and real results upfront, before committing to anything. Dr. Rohrich has no secrets, no botched surgeries or reviews he’s hiding from. If a doctor isn’t willing to share pre and post-op photos, videos of surgery, and is hesitant to show off his/her work, it’s a huge red flag for me after my first awful plastic surgery experience.

Dr. Rohrich is an open-book with a charming and genuine disposition. He prides himself on his work and is eager to show off his patients’ before and after photos and videos (that have consented for him to do so). He is also realistic, and will tell you exactly how complex your surgery will be and the likely results. His patients are also from all backgrounds, races, genders and geographic regions of the world. He can literally operate on any ethnicity, any gender, and maintain the uniqueness of that given person while still achieving the functional and cosmetic results desired by the patient.

From the moment you walk in their door you are treated like the most important person in the room and that begins with consults to the post-surgery appointments, everything is seamless. They take all the necessary Covid precautions to keep each patient safe during appointments and surgery. They also call before and after surgery to check-in and are legitimately concerned about your well-being at all times.

I’m so happy with my revision rhinoplasty performed by Dr. Rohrich and his staff and I sincerely believe he and his team are absolutely worth the investment, the drive, the flight, etc. Do not go anywhere else or carelessly choose a surgeon and make the same mistake I did the first time. Use Dr. Rohrich, you will not be disappointed!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Princess Fakunle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hello everyone! As you’re reading through countless reviews seeking an excellent rhinoplasty surgeon, please take a moment to read through mine!

To preface with some background info— I am a 25 year old, African American female, who has spent countless months looking for a surgeon to correct my severe saddle deformity. For the last 16 years, I went through life without a nose bridge, due to a cartilage collapse from my first surgery (reconstructive surgery to correct a birth deformity). As a result, not only has my aesthetic appearance been affected, but my breathing functionality as well.

Fast forward, I finally obtained the financial means and the mental readiness to undergo a second rhinoplasty. I was determined to find someone that not only specialized in complex revisions like mine, but more importantly, ethnic rhinoplasty, as I still wanted to preserve my African American features. I needed the absolute best in the industry to take on my case; therefore, I underwent many hours of research and consultations with doctors in and out-of-state. I’ve been turned away by many doctors because my case was too complex, and had almost lost all hope, until I met Dr. Rohrich.

Y’all, he is so WONDERFUL. During the consultation, he took the time to answer all my questions, and went over the surgical plan in such great detail. He has such a genuine love for what he does, and his bedside manner as well as his impressive experience, made it so easy for me to choose him as my surgeon.

It’s been 7 weeks since he performed my revision rhinoplasty, and as the swelling continues to subside, my nose is looking more and more beautiful. My results are very natural, and I’m so pleased because I still look like myself, but better!! I also want to commend his staff as they have all been so kind and supportive before, during, and after my surgery.

I hope after reading about my experience, you will consider scheduling a consultation for any procedure or surgery you anticipate on getting done. Dr. Rohrich has already changed my life for the better, and I’m confident he can change yours!

user_reviews_extended.Name: minimyzr yah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After much research I contacted Dr. Rohrich’s office for a consultation.  Unless something went terribly awry in the consultation, I had settled on Dr. Rohrich to take care of my “turkey neck” that exacerbated after some serious weight loss.  His credentials, years of experience, and unmistakable dedication to the field made it an obvious choice, though there were 2 others also being considered.  The consultation went fantastic, the office staff were very accommodating and professional and I was on my way to a first-ever plastic surgery.  Turns out I need a full face-lift to make everything look right after removing the loose mass under my chin.
I loved there was a pre-surgery routine with vitamins and natural supplements to get the body ready to minimize the affects of the surgery and help recovery.  I also studied foods to eat in that regard and had a minimum of 80 oz. of water a day for 5 months prior as part of my weight loss regime and post maintenance.  I had lost 35 lbs in 2 months and was healthier than I had been in many years and the pre-surgery routine boosted my confidence.
Surgery went great, recovery was smoothed by the professional and compassionate staff at the lux recovery suites attached to the surgery center.  They took care of everything meticulously.  A compassionate husband also helped, paying close attention to what was being done so he could assure he maintained the care after we left.
One week later, I sent a selfie to a cousin who works at the top surgery center in Houston . She could not believe the lack of bruising and how great everything looked.  Another boost in confidence.
Two weeks later, and after a drastic change in hair style, my daily routine was back to normal.  My eyes were having trouble and vision was not good, but I have a history of eye surgeries and a lifetime of poor vision corrected by either glasses or contacts.  It took about 2 months for my vision to come back to “normal”.
Now the fun part.  I kept getting – “you look GREAT!  What’s different?  Oh, you cut your hair!  It looks really good on you”.  Over and over again.
Dr. Rohrich’s skill took care of my problem, and maintained my natural look.
I feel great. Love the results.  I wasn’t out to look 10 or 20 years younger, but that was an added bonus!
I’m getting so many compliments from people that haven’t seen me in a long time, and close friends are encouraged to “get work done” having seen Dr. Rohrich’s results first hand.
I can’t thank Dr. Rohrich and his staff enough.  The mirror is no longer my enemy.  Sooo Very Happy.
I hope this encourages you to make the leap.  My advice:  Follow the pre-surgery routine to the letter and eat healthily for several months prior to surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a septoplasty and rhinoplasty done with Dr. Rohrich in Dallas,TX. And I am more than thrilled with the results. I have had breathing issues thru my nose for the last 30 yrs, and they have been getting progressively worse. I got to the point where I had to do something about it because I just could not breathe when sleeping. And breathing thru my nose was uncomfortable if not impossible. Dr.Rohrich immediately identified the issues in my consult and explain to me how it could be fixed. Sepo and rhino is not an easy procedure. It is a procedure or millimeters and more of an art form, experience really matters when getting this done. Do your research, Dr. Rohrich is the best out there, and really a leader in the field of plastic surgery. Other Dr's learn from him. He's absolutely incredible. His positive energy and enthusiasm is also comforting. Everything went super smooth from start to finish. From the consult, the procedure and the recovery. Absolutely flawless and pain free. Even after I woke from the surgery, no pain. Just took it easy for a few days. Day 6 got the splint off and the results are incredible, even with the slight swelling I had I could tell right away. It was PERFECT. I have never been able to breathe like I can now, its so amazing and wish I did this YEARS AGO. I sleep better and wake up fully rested now. Had absolutely zero problems through the whole ordeal. I love it.
Also, I want to add, that I have never had any health issues before or even had surgery ever. This was my first experience with all that. Dr.Rohrich and his whole team explain everything to you and make sure you're fully informed and understand everything.

Even Dr. Melanie Kaspar the anesthesiologist was great, no pain during the IV or anything, she is amazing. Like most people, I don't like needles and I felt nothing when getting my IV. This was my biggest worry, and I felt nothing. Dr.Kaspar is an example of the great care standard Dr.Rohrich has, the whole staff is great.
I hope this review brings value to others who might be considering these procedures, don't wait or worry about it, contact Dr.Rohrich and let him help you. I wish I had done this years ago.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valorie Cordes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My decision to have cosmetic surgery was  not an easy one.  In fact, I struggled for months trying to weigh the pros and cons of having this particular procedure. Once I made this monumental decision, it was even more difficult for me to find the right Dr.  I wanted someone who was outstanding in his field: recognized as the best among his peers.  I wanted someone with great credentials and years of experience performing my particular procedure. Plus, I wanted someone who was warm and caring and  would really listen to me: someone who would take the time to hear my hopes, wishes, concerns, and fears. After much research and many personal interviews with multiple Drs., I found that someone--Dr. Rohrich!!!!  Dr. Rohrich performed my surgery, and his warm, caring, bedside manner, coupled with his expertise, made the operation a great success.  The day I left the hospital, Dr. Rohrich made certain that my husband and I had his  personal cell number and he assured us it was ok to call anytime.  I ended up calling him on that number more than once, and usually not at the best time of day or night.  Dr. Rohrich always responded immediately.!!!!  I remember thinking, "Wow, He really does care!!!"  My recuperation was longer than I expected, but Dr. Rohrich and his staff were there to help me at every stage of my healing.  It's been six years since my surgery, and I am still amazed at how caring and attentive Dr. Rohrich and his staff were then and still are today.
Thank you Dr. Rohrich and Thank you to all of your team !!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: India Lu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So, I hate to even post anything negative about Dr. R because he is an amazing human being who treats every single patient as though they were his best friend.  However, I feel obligated to share my experience, especially after speaking with someone who had nearly the same outcome.  And just a side note- this is not my real name.

I have been getting botox for almost 20 years, but the last 5 years from Dr. R.   I loved the results, until a year ago, when I am fairly certain he changed his technique.  It felt much more aggressive and as though he injected deeper.  The cosmetic results were disappointing, and I ended up severely bruised (I have never bruised from botox before- fillers yes, but botox, no).  But, more concerning is that I experienced several frightening physical issues that lasted for nearly 7 months. These included paresthesia, burning sensation under my skin and even in my lips, heart palpitations, numbness, insomnia, muscle twitching throughout my body, dizziness, etc.

Fast forward nearly a year later, and, against my better judgment, I decided to give it another try.    I really wanted to achieve the same look and experience that he had provided in years past.  And I was certain that my one bad experience was just a fluke.

This time, to be on the safe side, I asked Dr. R to only inject half  the amount of botox focusing just on my lower face.   Unfortunately, he misunderstood the directions, and injected the full amount (as the previous appointment), quite aggressively,   all into the lower half of my face.   I didn’t know until they brought me the invoice.  Of course, he was apologetic and offered a refund, but my concern wasn’t so much for the money, but rather the fear of the side effects that I had previously experienced.   I just couldn’t go through that same torture again for 7 months.   Well, here I am 2 weeks out, and from day 2 I started experiencing the side effects, but this time they are worse.   I have the paresthesia, the burning, headaches, insomnia, heart palpitations, light sensitivity, and blurred eyesight in my left eye.  The bruising was horrible and is still visible (and no I am not on medications, aspirin, or supplements), and my face looks worse than before botox. I have these huge golf ball size lumps in my jowls (especially my left one).  In fact, someone just asked me if I had dental surgery!  I will post some pics, and as you can see, the mouth is pulling to one side- the side with the larger golf ball sized knot  (your right side).  Ugh- I think I am just mad at myself for ignoring my gut and going back only to end up with a worse outcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Eyelid Surgery Correction -- Amazing Results!!!
In August 2017 I had eyelid surgery with another surgeon - it was a complete fail.  I ended up with medial canthal webbing on the inner corner of my eyes. I felt and looked  like an alien freak.  I was devastated. I had been to 3 surgeons looking for help.  One (oculoplastic  surgeon) wanted to do a skin graft, the other (facial plastic surgeon) straight up said he didn’t want to touch it and referred me to another oculoplastic surgeon, and that surgeon told me “what you’ve got going on is very complicated, you need to go back to your original surgeon, only he knows what he’s done.”  We're into January 2018 at this point and I felt defeated.  How much more disappointment could I handle?  Then I saw the reviews for Dr. Rohrich, messaged with a former patient, took a leap of faith and made the appointment.  BEST decision of my life!!!  He looked at my eyes and immediately said "OK, here’s what we’re going to do..." He spelled out the plan.  Because of his decisiveness and confidence - immediate trust and relief hit me.   Then when I was out in the hallway leaving, he was on his way to his next patient, he then turned around, came back to me and said “don’t worry, we’ll fix this.”  I wanted to cry.   I had been waiting to hear that for so long.  The plan was 2 kenalog injections spaced apart, and if all else fails, z-plasty surgery.  In the end, we were able to avoid surgery, the injections worked and I am thrilled with the results.  I cannot thank Dr. Rohrich enough for making me look normal again, for giving me my confidence back, and for his kindness.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Hart Training
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rohrich is more than just a cosmetic doctor to me. He's my hero. I was born with a strawberry hemangioma on my nose. It grew until it looked like a clown nose. My mom went from doctor to doctor trying to find someone who could remove it and help me lead a normal life. She didn't want people to treat me different or look at me like I was a freak. And they did. This was back in the early 90's, so obviously times have changed, there are more doctors who would probably be willing to try this surgery now, but back then the only one willing to remove the hemangioma and reconstruct my nose was Dr. Rohrich. If it weren't for this man, I would have had it so much worse. He removed my tumor when I was 5 years old. He rebuilt my nose and refined it as I grew. He pioneered the technique used to do so. He's a true genius, and an artist. When everyone told my mom to accept me as I was, to teach me to love myself despite my tumor, they didn't understand what kind of life that was sentencing me to. No one walks around like Rudolf the Red Nosed Reindeer and turns out normal. Especially kids. Dr. Rohrich healed me. He fixed what was broken. Is my nose perfect now? It's as close as I could've dreamed. He literally built me a nose from the remains that weren't eaten away by my tumor.. and I look NORMAL. Thank you, Dr. Rohrich. I hope you read this and know that I truly couldn't be more grateful to any other human being (other than my parents) than I am to you. Because of you I don't wake up every morning feeling like a freak and avoiding the mirror. If you want any sort of facial reconstructive surgery, you would be a fool to go to anyone else.

title: Advanced Facial Plastic Surgery Center: Dr. Bassichis
address: 14755 Preston Rd #110, Dallas, TX 75254, United States

owner.name: Advanced Facial Plastic Surgery Center: Dr. Bassichis (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Bud
user_reviews.Description:
I recently underwent a lower face and neck lift with Dr. Benjamin Bassichis in Dallas, Texas, and I couldn’t be happier with both my experience and my results. I also know several people who have gone to Dr. B for a variety of procedures — from fillers to rhinoplasty — and the outcomes are consistently excellent.

Dr. Bassichis is truly an exceptional surgeon. His skill, precision, and care were evident every step of the way. The same is true of his entire staff, both in the office and at the surgery center. Everyone was professional, kind, and incredibly supportive throughout the entire process, from my initial consultation to each follow-up visit.

My recovery was remarkably smooth: I had virtually no pain, minimal swelling, and I felt comfortable being seen in public within about a week. The results look natural, refreshed, and exactly what I had hoped for. It may sound strange, but I still look like myself… just a better, more rested version.

If you are considering facial surgery and want the very best, I cannot recommend Dr. Bassichis highly enough. He is an outstanding surgeon, and I am truly grateful I chose him.

user_reviews.Name: Amy Rickman
user_reviews.Description: Do not believe any review that is less than complimentary about Advanced Facial Plastic Surgery.  For over 10 years Dr. Bassichis has surgically treated me, ranging from those you can image to a melanoma close-up right smack on my forehead.  Besides being the best in Dallas, Dr. Bassichis' front office have lovely manners.

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Dare Barnwell Meier
user_reviews.Description: The absolute best. I’ve seen Dr. B for years for aesthetics, and now recently for skin cancer reconstruction on my face. His work is remarkable. So thankful for him and his team taking the time and attention to deliver superior care and amazing results. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Alessandra Higer
user_reviews.Description: I started consulting Dr. Bassichis three years ago after being referred by another remarkable physician. He has carried out three distinct procedures on me, and I also visit him from time to time for Botox and fillers. The quality of care he provides, along with his team's support, is unmatched compared to anything I've encountered before. Not only is he an incredibly talented and exceptional surgeon, but his empathy and concern for his patients are truly remarkable. I strongly endorse his whole practice. You won't be let down!

user_reviews.Name: Karen Hazel
user_reviews.Description: Excellence in every aspect. Dr Bassichis is not only an exceptionally skilled, double-board certified surgeon, he and his team also operate with the highest standards of communication, honesty, patience and compassion. My procedure is life changing, performed with precision and the very best before, during and after care. Not once did I feel like “just a patient,” but rather, a cared-for, valued client whose opinions and concerns matter. Dr Ben is the very best. My results are absolutely amazing and exceeded expectations in every aspect. I only wish I made this decision sooner.

user_reviews.Name: Sarah Park
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve never been more disappointed by a doctor’s office. I made an appointment with Dr. Bassichis for a consultation, and from the moment I walked in, it was a mess. I was told the consultation would last an hour, so I arranged my schedule to ensure I had 1.5 hours to spare. What happened? I spent over an hour sitting in the waiting room with no updates or any acknowledgment of my time being wasted.

Finally, when I was taken back to the consultation room, I was told I’d have to wait even longer for the doctor. This office doesn’t respect your time at all. If they had communicated that the wait would be longer, I would have at least known what to expect. Instead, I sat around with no explanation, just wasting my time.

I walked out without ever seeing the doctor because after that level of disrespect, I have no interest in continuing with them. I’ll take my business elsewhere to a practice that actually values my time and my money. It's clear this office doesn't care about either. HARD PASS!!

I could go on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Local Guide
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Whatever positive, glowing reviews you see here, you can take them with a grain of salt and invert them to get closer to the truth.

In my experience, these are really bad and dangerous people. They lied to me or at least gave a bad impression of cosmetic surgery where the utility of surgery was exaggerated and risks downplayed when I was a mentally ill child, encouraged me to have surgery, even elected a specific surgery for me to have implying that I was ugly and that something was wrong with me, disfigured me, and ruined my life.

Later, they made fake reviews including a review in my mom's name, mocked me, taunted me, bullied me, etc.

At one point, they even tried to have me charged with a crime when I naturally reacted angrily to their provocative behavior. This may be a bit awkward to say but they're a veritable case study in white-collar psychopathy, and successful at preying on vulnerable people and rippin 'em off. Almost anybody who does plastic surgery for a living seems to have a personality disorder.

Everybody makes mistakes but you might hope that the people who are entrusted with performing surgery on your face wouldn't be such dismal and sordid examples of humanity. Compassionate? Ha, not really. More like callous, narcissistic, grandiose, insulting, abusive, sadistic, cruel, dysempathic, ethnocentric, unhelpful. This strategy must work well for them because I think they live in a really expensive mansion now, expensive like you wouldn't believe.

To be fair and generous to them, even though they wouldn't do the same for me, I will say that in hindsight I probably didn't take ideal care of the surgical wound maybe because I was ashamed of what I was doing and poorly informed on post-op care, so this possibly contributed to the terrible scarring, but others have reported bad "results" too so I know I'm not the only one in this predicament.

I call my own scar the bite of Bassichis. It's a mangled, depressed scar even after many years of treatments like retinol and dermaneedling. The surrounding skin doesn't even move and fold like normal skin does because the scar tissue is dense and fibrous so it interferes with that process and gives me a very unnatural and asymmetrical appearance.

It's not attractive and I had no idea this would be my fate, so there never was informed consent in reality. I wonder why all these posts with glowing reviews don't include pictures of their newfound beauty. Aesthetic goals not achieved. Good luck on your plastic surgery journey!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn't be more pleased with my experience with this practice. Dr B. is a true artist, as well as kind and personable. Everyone there was professional and friendly. I felt pampered and happy when I left, and I love my results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Gunningham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience from beginning to end. The office staff, the doctor, nurses, so organized and completely on top of it all. It was seamless and so smooth. I had Mohs surgery and facial plastic surgery afterward. The surgery center was fantastic too. Loved it. Totally felt prepared for it all. I kept thanking them because it was so easy.

Janet Keaveny

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Normal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love both Dr. Bassichis for my nose repair, and Jeanette for my facials. My latest facial was extraordinary! Jeanette made sure my skin was smoother and glowing. I love these appointments and will be back soon. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alena Savera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for TMJ Botox to help with my jaw clenching, and had a very positive experience with Dr.Bassichis and the staff. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Cianciola
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a 78-year-old woman who had terrible bags and dark circles under my eyes.  After  Dr. Bassichis performed under eye surgery to correct this,  the  dark circles and eye bags are gone.

There was no pain in recovery and total recovery within a month.  Eyes were not covered, so regular activities could continue as normal.  Sunglasses covered the post op bruising so no down time in recovery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Wilson [Alexander]
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bassichis and his staff are incredible!! The front desk girls are always so welcoming and helpful, the nurses are skilled and attentive, and Dr. B is the best of the best. 10/10 would recommend him to all of my friends. You will be well taken care of here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lori clifford
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was 5 stars from A to Z.  The clinic employees were professional, warm, and efficient. The surgery center was top-notch. Dr. Bassichis is brilliant and talented. The result from my neck lift far surpassed my expectations.  If you are on the fence, do it! I’m an MD and I’m thrilled with my appearance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: patricia edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a medical esthetician I wouldn't recommend anyone else in the state more than Dr. B. I was licensed decades ago which was around the same time he started his practice and it has been wonderful to watch his practice grow to such success. I also would not send anyone in the world anywhere else to get Botox besides other than to him! He's taking cake and results are very natural! His bedside manner is also very pleasant and professional!

I do however wish the women at the front desk were a bit more personable. They are after all the "face" of the practice.  Also it would be great if they offered a "treatment protocol" for patients needing more than just 1 treatment  done for the patient to bring home so they are able to book their appointments and schedule their visits  more efficiently. As a patient, regardless of whether you discuss it in the office w the technician  or nurse of how many weeks to wait before the next treatment  you find yourself scratching your head on when to  schedule what and what to do next especially if there is an "end goal" the patient is hoping to strive for. We rely on the staff for that guidance. . I have worked in offices that send a treatment plan home (botox this day etc)  which I find also benefits the practice monetarily.  Otherwise it becomes just overwhelming enough to give up. I expressed concern to water the front desk women and her only reply was "well all offices do it differently"  which was  not only dismissive but disgruntling. I'm hoping an office manager reads this review as I love this practice and feel that all business could benefit from constructive "patron" criticism!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Roberts

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bassichis rebuilt part of my nose after MOHS skin cancer removal. He was amazing. I am over 70 and a Medicare patient so I honestly didn’t expect the extra care and concern. I don’t think I could have been treated any better if I was a wealthy movie star. He truly loves what he does and cares about EVERYONE he treats. Thank you Dr. B! Your staff is so professional and helpful. They make these experiences comfortable and stress free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron Hekier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Count me as another happy patient who happens to be a doctor. user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Hollis

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely picky and incredibly vain. Dr Bassichis is the only injector I will allow to touch my face. He has an amazing eye, precise yet gentle touch, and his results are natural. The staff is very friendly. Highly recommend Dr Bassichis and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am so delighted and pleased with my experience with Dr. Bassichis and his entire team that I felt compelled to share my positive experience.

I have been going to Dr. Bassichis for the past few years for Botox injections and sometimes fillers and his work has always been excellent and consistent.  During this time, I have had ongoing conversations with Dr. Bassichis with regards to going down the path of a face lift surgery.  As you could imagine, I was extremely nervous about the possibility of surgery on my face! It was a huge decision and expense for me.

I already knew Dr. Bassichis is a highly regarded and sought out facial surgeon, however, when selecting a surgeon, it was also very important for me to feel well taken care of throughout the entire surgery process and afterwards - that I would be in “good hands”.  Was it possible to find the best facial plastic surgeon who also runs a thriving and growing practice (good sign) and is able to provide caring, personal attention to his/her patients?  Yes, it is possible!  Dr. Bassichis is that and more!

Even though his office is full of patients he always took the extra time to listen to my concerns and patiently answering all of my questions (for the past two years), as I went back and forth wrestling with the idea of “going under the knife”.  During our conversations, he was professional and thorough with his explanations of the various procedure options and extremely patient. He never pushed his opinions on me and made me feel secure, safe and comfortable with my ultimate decision to proceed with surgery.

He was encouraging and supportive with my initial decision for a less invasive procedure and also displayed the same level of encouragement and guidance when I ultimately decided for a more extensive surgery.  I never felt pushed or swayed by Dr. Bassichis, which has not been the case with other surgeons I interviewed.  He has a calm way about him that is confident and reassuring – confident in his abilities, not in any arrogant way (another good sign).  I found he and his entire staff genuinely cared about my comfort and happiness throughout the entire surgical process. They showed a very high-level of professionalism and provided excellent attention to every detail.

Today, I am one week post operation and I feel terrific!  My surgery experience was top-notch at the surgery center (amazing facility and staff).  The results of my surgery are already impressive (even with some residual facial bruising). I can see a refreshed and youthful appearance without looking “overdone” or “pulled” or “unnatural”.   Dr. Bassichis did an amazing job!   I am extremely happy with the results and actually noticed my boost in confidence in my professional life (even as I am working remote this week)!

Needless to say, I highly recommend Dr. Bassichis and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alaena Grable
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bassichis and his staff are amazing. I always feel confident that he will truly consult with me prior to any procedure and will only do what he feels is best for me. His staff are courteous and professional and beautiful! A great representation of his work! ;)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Mabery

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christen Scalfano

Everyone who works in this office has the patients' health & happiness as priority #1. They go above and beyond just being skilled medical professionals, with such kindness and joyfulness. 100% recommend advanced facial plastics to anyone- they will take THE best care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbie Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Benjamin Bassichis is a highly skilled, amazingly artistic and specialized facial plastic surgeon in the prime of his career and at the top of his game.  Aside from his long list of well-deserved accolades, Dr. B establishes a wonderful relationship with his patients by paying special attention to your individual needs and communicating openly to ensure you’re involved in the process.  Dr. B has also surrounded himself with a top notch support team of amazing professionals.  Absolutely first class all the way.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Gianni
user_reviews_extended.Description: After having been seen by Dr. Bassichis for over 9 years, he and his staff have always been very, very professional and up to date on the very latest in skin care techniques. He has never pushed unnecessary services. I frankly was shocked to read the previous review. They obviously have many unmedicated mental health issues. How sad they would choose to malign such an excellent, caring doctor. I seldom write a review so you can trust me when I say this is the Plastic Surgeon I refer everyone to and to no one else! I recently (2 weeks ago) underwent a surgical procedure. I'm thrilled with the results. You will be too! I invite you to go see him. You'll soon understand why Dr. Bassichis has been the recipient throughout the years of many, many prestigious awards from his patients and peers. If possible I'd give he and his staff  5++ stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Getterman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Ben Bassichis and the experienced staff at Advanced Facial Plastic Surgery Center are your ultimate providers of a wide range of facial rejuvenation procedures.
