How fortunate to have Dr. Bassichis and his expert team so readily available in Dallas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Wyatt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. B is the best! The staff and nurses are so friendly and make everyone feel welcome! Kelcey and Rachel are great at what they do and make the experience enjoyable! Advanced Facial Plastic Surgery is in a league of their own!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Delgado
user_reviews_extended.Description: He’s one of the few plastic surgeons who went the distance with injectable’s. He’s black Diamond certified for juvederm. And if you look at his wall, there’s 15+ certifications and awards - he’s extremely smart, like crazy smart. He’s very direct sometimes (I’m 29 and a little too obsessed about my face and its normal asymmetries) and he’s not shy to say “absolutely not”. This, to me, is the sign of a very, very good doctor. Not just any surgeon but one of the very best, I hope and pray dr. B keeps practicing for a very long time because there aren’t many like him. I’ve been seeing him for 9+ years and not once have had an issue healing from minor injectables or Botox. He’s quick and uses good quality needles. It’s your FACE - spend the extra money, it’s worth it. He’s worth it. Don’t go to med spas to get injections (unless by an actual MD with the highest of certifications but most of them will have their own/shared practice if they’re super good). Think about it, anyone with a medical license can buy injectables and use them on people - anyone. Medical licenses do not mean injectable safety. he’s the absolute best, you can trust him with your life (which you are if you trust anyone with a giant needle near your arteries - think filler horror stories). He’s 100% worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Avera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bassachis did my nose job 6 years ago! I was 17 in high school and now I’m 23. I was so happy with the end result. The process was so easy and all my worries and scares were easily put to rest. The staff and Dr were very professional. The best part was Dr. Bassachis likes natural and I didn’t want a nose that wouldn’t fit my profile and he delivered with a nose that fit what I wanted but looks so natural that when people find out I had it completely redone they are shocked at how amazing it looks. When I got out of surgery I had flowers waiting at my house from the Dr and office staff... HOW AWESOME! Recovery was a breeze for me . I highly recommend Dr. Bassachis!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Daniels
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Benjamin Bassichis is not "just" a talented plastic surgeon, he is an artist.
And I am very lucky to be one of his patients for the past 9 years.
He will decline the procedure along with tens of thousands of dollars, if he does not think it is necessary.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional service! I come to Advanced Facial Plastic for everything from facials and laser hair removal to fillers and Botox! The ladies at the front are so sweet, professional, and EFFICIENT. Dr. B answered all my questions and made me feel so at ease. It’s not every day you visit a Dr who is both top of their field as well as kind and personable, and Dr. B checks all boxes!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angel Marks
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visiting Dr B. For some fillers. Great doctor, great results. I did not do much research before because I knew of his expertise and great work. I am so happy I have found him. Thank you Dr. Bassichis.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Hawkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to Dr Bassichis for a consult to determine which non-surgical procedure/ treatment he would advise for elasticity, pore size and overall aging (more sagging- I don't really have wrinkles). I'm 42 years old and follow a daily regimen, receive Botox every 4-6 months in my brow and try to invest in a MD level facial treatment every 12-18 months (such as a laser, microneedling, series of peels, etc) I asked him to advise me as if money isn't a concern and if he were me which treatment would be the best results. He told me two things; filler in my high cheek bone/ under eye and pico-sure laser treatment (package of 3). I got the filler that day and scheduled the 3 pico-sure treatments.
To my shock and surprise, the filler literally lasted 5 days (costing me $1500). This was a huge disappointment! I was hopeful that the $2,000 pick-sure would provide me with better results. The treatments have to be spaced out so it's been 9 months since my first one and I'm so sad that I literally can't see one difference in my skin. My before and after photos look almost identical. The technician, Jennifer (who was super nice and friendly) thought she could see a slight pore reduction but I also started a new Retinol line by Obagi at the same time which I think did more for my skin than the filler and laser (only cost $75). I did tell Jennifer how disappointed I was. She was understanding and offered to take photos a second time, which were the same in my opinion. In the end, there was no resolution offered, no concern over the fact that I spent $3500 with this doctors office and had no results. I'm just so frustrated but feel like this probably happens a lot and clients are just expected to accept that results vary. I think "no results" should warrant a customer service resolution where the client feels they received the services/ results they were sold. I don't usually post reviews but wonder if others experienced the same as me and I'd want to know before spending a large sum of money. I've been to lots of medspas, dermatologist and laser centers in Dallas and over all this was my worst experience. :(

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. B and his entire staff are like extended family. In fact, "the finest medical staff I have interfaced with in my 74 years on the planet". You know they care from the moment you step into their offices. Dr. Bassichis is an artist of his craft. Enough said.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynn Browne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this office. Dr B is awesome and did a great job on my  rhinoplasty. Not only that but he is also one of
The best injectors for fillers in the area. Delisa also does the best prp micro needling. She is such a sweetheart too. They also have the biggest supply of skin products of any doctor I’ve ever been to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda McElreath
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bassichis is the ultimate professional. He takes time to listen and answer every question without appearing rushed or impatient. I trust him completely. He has a great staff who follows his lead in the way they treat patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rebecca mir
user_reviews_extended.Description: Life Changing! I was troubled by facial scars my whole life. Dr Bassichis recommended fractionated co2 laser resurfacing in addition to a facelift. After he patiently and carefully explaining the procedures and why he suggested it, I scheduled. The procedure was only a couple hours, the anesthesia doctor and nurses were so wonderful, and after one-week of healing I have the most gorgeous skin I have ever had. Smooth and even - I no longer have to wear thick base foundation just to leave the house! I have never looked or felt this gorgeous in my own skin. Now I am around a year and half after surgery, and the results are so so great. My skin continues to look so beautiful - I get compliments each and every day. Dr. Bassichis and his professional expertise and abilities changed my life forever. I am forever grateful to this incredible doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: STEVEN SYKE
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a cyst on my nose that left a scar. Dr Bassichis did an amazing job to fix the scar..His support staff is just as great to work with.   I would recommend him hands down

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karly Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Though I had my septo-rhinoplasty surgery a few months back, I feel it is never too late to express my positive experience and thanks. Thank you for your exemplary services. As I traversed through a new frightening unknown course I was truly grateful and immensely appreciative of the calm, reassuring care and surgery of a top rated facial plastic surgeon as Dr. Bassichis. I am truly very pleased with the surgical, recovery and post-op results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kasey Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had rhinoplasty by Dr. B and could not be happier with the results!! I did not hurt even on the 2nd or 3rd day!! I had little bruising for 5 days post-op.  I’ve also had Botox from him and love it. He’s conservative, listened to what I wanted and gave great advice. Don’t waste your time anywhere else! The front girls and nurses are kind, informed and always respond to my questions the same day! Thank y’all again!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient of Dr. Bassichis' for years and have had a great experience every time I visit his office. His bedside manner is unsurpassed. I recommend him to friends & family often.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Key
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This review is a year late, but as I continue with my skin cancer journey I feel like providing positive feedback for those that could be in the same boat looking for the best medical professionals.  Having Dr Bassichis sew up my nose after Moh's surgery was one of the best decisions I have ever made.  It's traumatizing having your nose cut the entire length of it at first, but no one believes me that any cut was made now because I literally have no scar.  It's crazy!  My new dermatologist was in complete shock that I even had Moh's surgery.  There's a reason I opened up the airline magazine on a plane recently to see he is deemed one of THE BEST facial plastic surgeons.

I will say that I didn't love going to his office for check ups mainly because some of the office staff is kind of snooty and there was always a long wait to see him for 1-2 minutes, but HEY....my nose looks amazing and I have no more cancer on my face!  Oh and none of this will be affordable for the average person, just ignore the price tag.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Friel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wish that I had my surgery done 30 years ago.  I can't stop thinking about how much this effected my athletic performance and sleeping over the years.  Looking forward to not being a full blown mouth breather and having constant pressure in my face.  My quality of life is about to be so much better now that I can breathe through my nose.  Thanks!

Attached image is my nose before the surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I am 48, and just recently decided to 'do something' about a few things on my face that were making me unhappy. I am so incredibly happy with all of my results!  I still look just like me - just a wee smoothed out.  Dr. Bassichis and all of his staff have been wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Jackson

From the moment I walked in, the entire experience was incredible. My esthetician, Lauren, is absolutely fantastic. We chatted for over an hour and I easily could have talked with her all day. She made me feel completely comfortable, explained everything she was doing, and delivered the BEST Hydrafacial I’ve had in Dallas (and maybe ever). My skin has never looked or felt better.

They also have an amazing membership program that gives discounts on products, plus great package deals if you buy services in groups of three or six. I immediately bought a package of three more Hydrafacials and I’m already looking forward to doing many more treatments here in 2026 and beyond.

If you are in Dallas and looking for a new skincare home — run, don’t walk. Resurrect Skin MD is everything. 💛✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: christy Gross
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am in my late 40’s and have hated my side profile for years due to my “double chin” and poorly defined  jaw line.  With Zoom and more online media the past years it has really made me want to do something to fix it. I started with research and consultations. Most pointed to either cool sculpting, filler, Botox, or kybela. When i calculated cost and time i was looking at a big investment that still would not be a permanent fix or the results i wanted. Dr. Burns did a procedure on me 20 years ago and i trust him implicitly. I am in the medical field and know many surgeons that respect and send their family to him. I decided to just ask him his thoughts regarding my concerns of my aging lower face. He was straight forward with what I would need and what to expect recovery wise. He was very detailed in addressing my concerns. I was thrilled to know that in one procedure I could have the lower face i always dreamed of! I am currently 2 weeks post operation and I am so glad I did. Cost, time, and getting exactly what i want = Dr. Burns! Don’t waste your time and money on temporary fixes. Social media is nickel and dimming  us women in our 40’s to a temporary fix and it’s not the way to go. Dr. Burns and Kelly are trustworthy, honest, and experts. Forever grateful to Dr. Burns.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Over this past weekend of February 27, 2021, I attended a conference sponsored by the laser company Sciton and directed by Dr. Jay Burns of Resurrect Skin MD. As you might know, Dr. Burns is a Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon active in the Dallas/Fort Worth area for many years. I found his laser therapy preceptorship highly instructive. This surgeon has a superior understanding of the multiple Sciton platforms and the experience to adjust laser/energy therapy to the patient’s skin quality, skin type, and skin problem. He is also an evidence-based practitioner which should matter to the prospective  patient. [Many make specious claims that are just not backed up by any evidence or experience. This surgeon is not one of those.] If you are seeking laser skin treatment or skin quality optimization, you should consider seeing Jay Burns, M.D. and his staff. You will also enjoy the brand-new beautiful clinic.

title: Rachel Walker MD: Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas
address: 6190 Lyndon B Johnson Fwy Suite 500, Dallas, TX 75240, United States

owner.name: Rachel Walker MD: Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Emiliano Galvis
user_reviews.Description: The doctor changed my self-esteem completely. She listens to you very well and makes you feel great. I can say that she is one of the best in breast augmentation or if you want reconstruction with augmentation as was my case. She is the best of all the professionals I have met. The recovery was very fast. The doctor helps you reach your realistic goals.

user_reviews.Name: Mackensi Wickliffe
user_reviews.Description:
I found Dr. Walkers office by a quick Google search and saw the great reviews and decided to schedule a consultation, even though I was worried I was going to be told nothing could be done to correct my previous breast augmentation (done at a different plastic surgeons office). Everyone in this office is warm and friendly and I felt super comfortable at my consultation, and I was so happy to hear that Dr. Walker saw the same issues I did and she was confident in her plan to fix them. I booked the breast revision surgery and I am so grateful that I did. My experience here was night and day compared to my last breast augmentation. My pre procedure anxiety and post procedure pain was taken care of. I received great post op teaching and 4 months later I can tell my results are holding up much better.

I was treated to a complimentary hydrafacial with their amazing esthetician Nyaz and have since signed up for the membership because she has absolutely changed my skin for the better and has really educated me on the use of medical grade skin care products.

Laser scar care was also included in the cost of the revision and while I’m still healing from that I can definitely see improvements in the scar already. She even treated my 5 year old tummy tuck scar and I am so impressed with the results.

Lastly, I received Botox from their nurse injector Katelyn and we did a consultation for some other services and I am excited for the results. Prices were very reasonable for the level of expertise providing the service.

Everyone in the office spoke so highly of Dr. Walker and I can tell she really cares about her staff and patients. I have zero regrets that she was my only consult for this surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Maria Jimena Araoz
user_reviews.Description: The best place to get surgery!! I’m so happy with my results. Dr. Rachel understood exactly what I wanted and helped me pick the perfect size. The whole surgery was super quick, and the anesthesiologist was incredible — she made me feel completely calm. And even after my procedure, they’ve been amazing at answering all my questions so fast. The staff is truly the best. I’d recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews.Name: Anaka Rojas
user_reviews.Description: I am so happy I went with Dr. Walker and her team. I got a breast augmentation and It is everything and more that I wanted. I trusted her to do what she needed to get the results I wanted and i’m so thankful I did. It was such an easy process and I will recommend her and her team to everyone I know. The entire staff is lovely and makes you feel super comfortable and confident. If I could give more than 5 stars I would!!

user_reviews.Name: Krissy Chastain
user_reviews.Description: Excellent care and treatment. Definitely made the right choice coming to Dr. Walker and her team for my mommy makeover. Her nurse Sarah is amazing. Made me feel right at home and took time to answer all of my questions. Had the honor of getting hydrofacial with Nyaz and it was amazing. Left my skin feeling so soft. Had injectable with Kaitlynn who was super sweet. Everyone I have encountered has been so pleasant and helpful. If you need aesthetics or surgery, this is the place and your team!!!

user_reviews.Name: Selina Cazares
user_reviews.Description: I had the best Hydrafacial with Nyaz! I wanted to focus on getting my skin right this year, and she helped customize a plan just for me. I’m already liking the results and the skincare products she recommended that I got in office. She answered my questions thoroughly and made the facial feel very relaxing. I felt well taken care of the whole time. I’m excited to try microneedling next and can’t wait to see the final results!

user_reviews.Name: Sydney Green
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Walker and her team. I had my breast augmentation done here and the entire experience was beyond anything I could’ve hoped for. From my very first consultation to my post-op appointments, every single woman on the team made me feel comfortable, informed, and genuinely cared for. Having a female surgeon was really important to me and the icing on the cake was that the staff is all-female. It made such a difference in how safe and supported I felt throughout the entire process.

I’ve also seen Katelyn for injections and she is absolutely AMAZING — she listens to exactly what you want, and if you’re unsure, you can definitely trust that she is an aesthetics expert and can recommend a treatment plan.

My results are incredible ,and most important, natural looking! My recovery from surgery was smooth and I was pain free next day. Anytime someone asks who my surgeon was, I proudly share their info. Truly a 10/10 experience and I wouldn’t go anywhere else.

Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Cardoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker has magic hands! I consulted with 5 different doctors in DFW in the last 4 years. I had 25-year-old implants that I wanted to switch out, wanted a lift without losing too much upper pole fullness while not going with a larger implant. Dr. Walker was the ONLY doctor that listened carefully to what I wanted, I showed her my inspirational photos, and she took the time to analyze my physique to recommend what she thought would accomplish my goal. All the other male surgeons kept pushing me to go with much bigger implants and said what I wanted was not possible without going larger.  Since my consultation I knew that Dr. Walker would be my doctor, but I was nervous about doing the surgery because of course I went through the TikTok rabbit hole videos of recoveries which said recovery was the worst pain ever. Dr. Walker and all her team assured me that everything would be ok and that I would recover quickly without pain. I am only a week post op and let me tell you….I am beyond happy with my results, the recovery and Dr. Walker & her team’s attentiveness all throughout the entire process. I came out of surgery and took muscle relaxers and pain medication for 2 days only and I never felt any pain at all! I was honestly feeling ready to go back to the gym by my 4th day 😊I also have to say I have never had a doctor call me the evening of the surgery and then again, the following day, to check up on me. If you are considering having surgery with Dr. Walker, just book it! You will not regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Perry
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I found Dr Walker after multiple years of research - I had surger ~17 years ago to correct asymmetry in my breast, and since that surgery I have been unhappy and frankly embarrassed of the results. I did countless consultations with male surgeons, and I always left their office nearly in tears, more self conscious than when I walked in, and scared that the cold, unwelcoming, and imposing attitude (never listening to my concerns and just saying BIGGER!!!) of male doctors was what I was going to have to endure if I wanted a revision.

My first consultation with Dr Walker was like a night and day experience compared to my previous consultation. It’s a staff of all women, the practice is beautiful and the staff is so kind and welcoming. Dr Walker treated me in a way that made me feel safe - she’s realistic/honest, but so warm and friendly. She didn’t once make me feel self conscious, but rather hopeful and confident that I could finally have my breast corrected. At no point did she suggest going bigger, but rather asked what exactly I wanted, and then based of that she gave me detailed steps of how she could achieve that.

I decided she was my surgeon and I booked my surgery. My results exceeded my expectations, the surgery was so easy, she has a surgery suite in her practice which was great cause hospitals freak out. The healing process was quick, easy and relatively painless. And she includes a laser treatment to address any scarring, which there’s hardly any and I’m only 3 weeks out from surgery.

I can not recommend her and her staff enough! I also got my lips done by Katelyn and they look AMAZING! She was so much fun too! Every one in the office is just so nice and down to earth.

This surgery was a huge life event for me and honestly I feel so blessed to have found Dr Walker’s practice.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker and her clinic are everything I could have asked for. Moreover, she takes an individualized approach, considering your unique needs and preferences to determine the most effective treatment options. Every staff member in her clinic is not only kind and intelligent but also really beautiful. The attached laser center has been instrumental in reducing post-surgical scars. After considering several other surgeons, I firmly believe that I made the right choice by coming here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jayla grubbe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Dr. Walker and her team!!! I had a breast lift/breast augmentation with lipo, and it was such a smooth process from start to finish. I feel like Dr. Walker really listened to me and answered all of my questions; you can just tell she really loves her job and is such a genuine person!! If you're anything like me, you probably spent way too much time on the internet researching your surgery and freaked yourself out. Given this, I was anticipating recovery to be a bit of nightmare but, thankfully, that was NOT the case whatsoever. The only time I felt pain was right when I got home after surgery, and even that was mild. I took one pain pill right when I got home after surgery,  Tylenol once the next day, and that was it! I was so surprised by how good I felt for just having what felt like a big surgery. Stick to the stretches Dr. Walker has you doing, take mini walks every now and then, and basically just let your body do it's thing!! I am SO happy with my results already and glad I didn't put off this surgery due to fear. I could not recommend Dr. Walker and her team more!!! They're the best <3

I’ve now completed six sessions over the last 2 months. While I do notice that I have a smaller waist, I’m most excited about the fact that I can actually engage my core. I don’t get low back pain during my workouts anymore! Setting up my sessions with Jasmine at the front office was a breeze! During my sessions McKenna made sure I was comfortable, but also made sure I got a good “workout” in. I’m excited to explore other services at The Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas. The office has such a great vibe and everyone is so kind and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Millwee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where to even begin. I’m hooked for life. I started coming to Dr. Walker’s office after researching lasers to help with skin tightening as fillers and botox do not work for me. I like a very natural look but also want to do what I can to fight this whole aging thing. I found Paul Walker after all the research, came in for a consult and was sold immediately. He is a true GENUIS and pioneer in his field and one of the kindest humans you’ll ever meet. He has transformed my skin. Preferring a natural look, I’ve never been a big makeup person but noticed I wasn’t loving looking in the mirror at home without a tinted moisturizer or something on. He promised I could go back to living my no makeup skin, and boy has he delivered. I love my skin, I feel good about myself again without makeup on. He then encouraged me to visit Dr. Walker to help me with the fat loss in my face. I was VERY hesitant because I do love the natural look and want to look like me. It took quite a few times of encouragement but I finally set up a consult with Dr. Walker and then I fell in love with her, too. In seconds I was confident she could take care of me and keep me looking like me. She is also a GENUIS in her field. And just the most wonderful woman to be around. I signed up for the fat grafting at their first available appointment. She performed it and literally during the procedure she was so excited for how great it looked. Her bedside manner calmed all my fears (which were a lot). A few weeks later I’m so happy to look in the mirror and obsessed with these two beautiful humans. Their work will transform you but their beautiful souls will make you want to be around them and want them to both be the happiest, most successful people ever. They are both so special and have both had to quickly get used to me telling them that I love them. You will, too!

Everyone in this gorgeous office is wonderful!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Lerom-Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had the most wonderful experience at Dr. Walker’s office recently. I had the halo laser performed and the results were more than I could have hoped for, even skin tone, sun spots gone and and overall glow that I haven’t had in years. That day I also purchased Natural Bronze from Dr. Walker’s skin care line. I’m in love! It’s the perfect coverage paired with SPF. I don’t have to buy face sunscreen or foundation anymore cause this product does it all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Gray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Stagnone and his staff are truly amazing. They were very professional and made me feel like I was part of their family! They walked me through everything from my consultation to me getting an infection (caused by a hot tub NOT their faculties) and having to have another surgery. I would recommend him to anyone!! Oh and my breast look AMAZING! He is very thorough and precise in all that he does!! T

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arden B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Life...changing!! Literally the best decision in my life was to put faith into Dr. Walker and her team for my breast reduction. They’re so compassionate and care so much about achieving your vision as natural and beautiful as possible. Even the aftercare is just as attentive. Save yourself the time and highly consider Dr. Walker when you’re looking for someone who actually makes you feel heard and not just another patient walking through the door.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arrowhead Services
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Jordan Weaver here.
Amazing staff. Dr Walker is absolutely amazing. So personable answers and explains every question you have. Never would imagined myself getting a surgery like this but so happy and thankful we did and thankful we had Rachel and her staff doing it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacie Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’d like to give a huge shout-out and thank you to Dr. Rachel Walker and her staff and team today. I wish I had wrote down every name, for individual acknowledgement, but unfortunately I did not. This was a team of ladies who knew the importance of bedside manner, genuine concern, and optimism when dealing with patients who are nervous on their big day. Not a one was in a bad mood, and they promptly and honestly answered every question I had through this process leaving me with no doubt in my decision. Dr. Walker exceeded my expectations from the date of consult, (which she did not rush me through, listened thoroughly, and left no table un turned) to post-op and follow-up. Her whole team. The anesthesiologist was also amazing. She talked me through every step, leaving no room for anxiety. Today was such a good experience. From the front desk, to nurse, and all the way around, impressed, pleased, and thankful are understatements. Thank you to all present today, and know that I 10,000% recommend you ladies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Papik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Katelyn who is the RN injector is so sweet!! Not only is she super personable, nice and helpful, she's amazing at being at injector! she dissolved my lips and is working towards getting me back to the perfect shape as my lip filler had previously migrated from a different location/injector. She also added some chin and jaw filler to give me the perfect shape of my lower face and botox to my masseter muscle. She listened to exactly what I wanted and gave it to me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ella C Cats
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the minute I walked into the office, I felt surrounded with such good vibes from Madison and the entire staff.  The consultation was thorough and professional yet friendly and comfortable.  After visiting with Dr. Walker and Paul Kraft, a second opinion was not even a consideration.
Dr. Walker did a beautiful job with upper and lower eyelid surgery and Paul Kraft worked his magic with lasers doing Trifecta + Profound.  Pre and post-surgical care has been a dream.
These two are the complete package!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Quillin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently, I had the pleasure of visiting and having a procedure done at the office of Dr.Rachel Walker. First I met with Miss Madison Freeman,  the project coordinator and she explained to me in detail what to expect during my procedure. I am a 65 year old woman who was seeking a way to help with my overall complexion,  wrinkles, etc. Then, Jackie, who would be performing my procedure began explaining and preparing my face for the application of a new product of collagen injections, she was very gentle with the injections and I was so impressed with the overall look of my youthful look, I can't wait until I get to visit with them again in the future!  Best Wishes, Kathryn Quillin

user_reviews_extended.Name: KD Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Paul Kraft is amazing. Very knowledgeable about all things laser. His passion is obvious when he is educating on the importance of sunscreen and how skin cancers are a real threat that is under appreciated. He took his time to explain everything and made me feel very comfortable. Laura was great at getting me scheduled with a good time that fit best for me and making sure I had all my information emailed to me prior to my appt.

10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: claudia brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Although only four days post op, I couldn’t be happier for the results so far. As I heal I see every day that passes how much better and better Dr. Walker’s work looks. Not only is she knowledgeable, she’s sweet, caring and just seems to want to have the best interest in you. I highly recommend her for your surgical needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Bryant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a phenomenal experience starting even before appointing a time to meet with Dr. Stagnone and his team. Misty emailed me back ON A SUNDAY after I reached out to let me know what to expect and how to set an appointment with their team. The consultation went very smoothly and both the doctor and his team were efficient and very pleasant. You can tell they are confident with what they do and the quality at which the procedures under their care are performed. Excited for my upcoming appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maureen Dowling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the pleasure of meeting and working with Paul Kraft and his amazing staff. I had a halo fusion laser treatment. Paul’s knowledge and expertise of lasers is incredible. He explains exactly what to expect and the results far exceeded my expectations. He provides his personal cell number for any questions and concerns. I can’t recommend Paul enough for laser treatment. I look forward to working with him again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Faith Alcaraz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for Lip Filler and had the best experience with Katelyn, I wanted a more natural look and less gummy smile and that’s exactly what she delivered! The staff there is amazing and so friendly and gave me the most calming first experience. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Carstens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paul Kraft and the entire team are absolutely amazing!! I have had multiple laser treatments completed here and am so happy with the continued results! Paul is always so thorough and takes the time to answer my many questions. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: charity benson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very pleased with how everything went. Going in I had very low self esteem. They treated me with unbiased compassion and kindness. I definitely recommend Rachel Walker and team for anyone looking for professional work. Easy to work with, even when my husband has a million questions over the phone post surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Fuller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker is amazing!  She listens to what you want,  as well as your concerns and picks an individual plan that works best for you.  My implants look wonderful!  I cannot thank her enough!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin McConnell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot express in words the professionalism and courtesy I have experienced at Dr. Stagnone's office. I had my breasts done there 3 years ago, and to this day I still call with questions. The staff are ALWAYS knowledgeable and patient with me. During my healing process, I was very cranky. The staff   continued to remain patient and kind with me even though I was less than desirable to be around. Most of the staff have had procedures there themselves and make you feel very comfortable. Dr. Stagnone was very professional and catering to my fearfulness before surgery. His portfolio was the best work I saw in all of the online portfolios I researched. If you want it done right, come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacqueline Papik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Rachel C did my chin filler today and I love it! It came out so pretty and balances my face perfectly. Would definitely recommend her if you are looking for injections. She has an attention to detail and is very sweet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Coming from a world where I've constantly had to be on point I made sure to do my research before moving forward with rhinoplasty. After visiting a few clinics all around dallas I felt as if my vision for my nose wasn't being heard. Upon meeting Rachel she was calm, listened to me, spoke of her personal experience and made me comfortable to feel confident in this procedure. I am 3 days out of surgery and she made sure to call and see how I was doing! As a business owner I loved her genuine nature.

Can't wait to see the final results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Huttel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Walker is great! She spends time with you and if very detailed. My pain from my procedure is minimal and am able to walk around. I would recommend Dr.Walker and her team to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Sherman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with Dr Walker! She listened to what I wanted and truly cared.   I was blown away with my results and I felt so well cared for by Dr Walker and her staff.   They went above and beyond to provide excellent service, care and results.  Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Tilley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a tummy tuck and breast lift 8 weeks ago to attempt to regain the body I had before 3 pregnancies, and improve the symmetry of my VERY asymmetrical breasts.  My body looks better at 48 than it did at 28. Let me say that again for those in the back.... MY BODY LOOKS BETTER AT 48 THAN IT DID AT 28!!!!! Dr. Stagnone is an ARTIST.  My results are amazing, the staff is amazing, the facility is wonderful. I am beyond thrilled with my "new body"!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Weir
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker and her staff are FANTASTIC! She listened to what I was wanting, gave amazing advice to make it happen, and they created a plan that helped me fully understand and feel completely in control of what decisions we were making. From pre-op to post-op, I have felt valued and supported. I would highly recommend Dr. Walker without hesitation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jimmy Morrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: It would be hard to find another plastic surgery staff that are more caring than the entire staff at this facility. From start to finish they take care of every detail. The building is easy to find and every room is spotlessly clean. I highly recommend the Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am now 7 months post operation from a breast augmentation and the results are amazing! The office staff and Dr. Stagnone were fantastic. My anesthesiologist was the best. She addressed every point and made me feel completely at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rojin Malek
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nyaz is a phenomenal aesthetician, and I highly recommend getting treatments with her. She makes you feel good, keeps you comfortable, and leaves you feeling confident! The staff is friendly, and super accommodating to any questions and concerns. Overall I had a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Debney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I first visited Dr. Walker after a traumatic ear injury but I turned into a repeat customer after she treated my sun and age damaged skin. My face naturally has redness and I’ve spent many years in the sun fishing. After just two visits and a new personalized skincare regimen, my skin looks 15 years younger. I am going back to visit Dr. Walker in the fall to start my laser treatment plan.  I’ve never felt more confident in my own skin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DIANE ELIZABETH COX
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am SO grateful I was referred to Dr. Rachel Walker and met her and her wonderful staff in Sept. 2020. Immediately, I felt very comfortable  talking with Dr. Walker about having a “facelift” but I wanted to look natural and still look like “me” after the surgery. I was extremely impressed with Dr. Walkers expertise and methods in performing facelifts very different than other plastic surgeons I had consulted with before. I also met with the amazing Paul Kraft, a Medical / Aesthetic Laser Specialist that works with Dr. Walker and he throughly explained the lazer process and what results to expect. I am 60 yrs old, had never had Botox, had severe frown lines, numerous lines around my mouth and chin due to smoking years ago, also lines around my eyes with heavy eye lids and a sagging neck...I cannot express what a miraculous result I have had since my surgery 3 months ago. I look 10 yrs younger and my skin is beautiful. All my lines are completely gone! My eye lift was so remarkable that my vision improved and I had to get new glasses! I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Rachel Walker and Paul Kraft and their amazing knowledgeable staff. Diane C. 12/30/20

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Kramer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Walker was very knowledgeable and I felt she gave me straight forward advice.  She based her responses to  my questions on her medical expertise and did not just try to sell me new services I did not need.
I highly recommend her

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker is great! She spent a great deal of time with me explaining the procedure about which I was inquiring, including benefits, risks and alternative treatments. She set realistic expectations for both the procedure and the outcome. I am looking forward to the procedure! Thank you, Dr. Walker!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jackie Jacinto, RN is amazing! She did my lip filler and Botox and I’ve had beautiful results. I greatly respect Jackie’s expertise and that Jackie consulted Dr. Walker before she performed any treatment on me before and after my face surgery. This is very impressive! Thank you Jackie for always making me look and feel beautiful. Diane C.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mignon Brittain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker was amazing! She truly cares and takes the time to listen to your concerns. If you are looking for a PS I highly recommend her. I wish I would have found her sooner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Von Hoven
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy with the results of my breast augmentation. Dr. Stagnone was so knowledgeable and made me feel so comfortable with everything. I loved the office and the staff and everyone made me feel at home. I would 100% recommend him to all my friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gisele Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Any words seem inadequate when trying to describe my appreciation for Dr. Walker and her team. It can be hard to find a healthcare team that makes you feel safe, and cared for every step of the process, but here it’s a part of every decision. I don’t think I could have asked for better results! A million times thank you to every person at Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas, so happy to have found it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela McQuay
user_reviews_extended.Description: I dreamed of having a tummy tuck for 18 years! I stalked the internet for before and after photos and talked to anyone I knew that had any kind of plastic surgery to find out who their doctor was for years! The biggest problem I found was, I could never find a surgeon who did great tummy tucks and also great  breast augmentations. Choosing the perfect surgeon was a big deal to me, it wasn’t about the cost, it was about choosing a surgeon that was going to give me back a body I could feel comfortable and confident in after so many years of hating my body. Finally,  a coworker suggested Dr. Stagnone, who had done hers and her sister-in-laws breast augmentations. I looked him up and fell in love with his work! Finally, a surgeon that did great breast augmentations and beautiful natural looking tummy tucks! He was the one! I was so impressed with him and his staff that I put my a down payment and scheduled my surgery the day of my consultation. Dr. Stagnone and his staff are top notch! Everyone I’ve dealt with have been amazing! I’m 6 weeks post op now, and so very glad I chose Him as my surgeon! My results are great, and I finally love my body again after 18 years! Best thing I’ve ever done for myself!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Lozano
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just came for my 6 weeks post op appointment for my breast augmentation and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome! I wouldn’t change a thing and everything was exactly what I wanted it to be. Dr. Stagnone and his staff are more than awesome! They make you feel welcome, comfortable, and give you all of the knowledge and tools you need for a successful surgery! I will definitely come back for any future cosmetic needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tia Bomani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Walker is a great “aesthetics” plastic surgeon. But any major issues/deformities I would not recommend. She will seem confident, gladly take your money- then perform a sub par procedure only to want you to reschedule more procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Mansker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I loved my experience at Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas. Dr. Walker and her staff were very kind. I had significant laser treatment with Paul Kraft and my results are truly amazing!

I had significant sun damage on my face, neck and chest concentrated mainly around my scalp and the left side of my face. The discoloration and brown spots that I had are no longer visible after the laser treatment. Paul also treated my melasma, or the dark brown mask that I had around my jaw line and on my neck which was a source of insecurity for myself. It is completely gone! I also had one rather large, unsightly mole on my lower left cheek (also big source of insecurity).   which he completely removed. That was totally unexpected and I was thrilled! The laser treatment seemed to totally resurface the skin on my face and neck. All of that "sun damaged, rough kind of look" is gone. My skin is completely smooth and fresh, and definitely younger looking!  As an added bonus, I also have experienced some lifting in my neck, and some major slowing down of facial hair regrowth.

I am ecstatic with my laser treatment results and also with the impeccable aftercare that I received from Paul, Dr. Walker and her staff.  I look forward to returning to the Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas for my upcoming needs in the near future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Rachel Chetney is the best injector hands down!! She is the sweetest most down to earth person. She made me feel comfortable and never felt pressured by anything. If you are new to injections like I was I highly recommend her!!❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the BEST experience at the Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas. I heard about Dr. Walker from my friend who lives in Dallas and has gone to the Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas several times for Botox treatments. She would constantly talk to me about how pleased she was with both Dr. Walker and her new Botox. It got to the point where she gave such glowing reviews of her experience that I decided I had to travel to Dallas for myself, as I have pigment/sunspots on my face that I have tried EVERYTHING for but have never been able to get rid of.  I was fortunate enough to get in for a consultation while visiting my friend in Dallas and my experience with Dr. Walker was highly informative and it actually felt like talking to a friend! She gave me the perfect combination of skin care products to help get rid of the pigment in my skin and even followed up on my visit/treatment with an over-the-phone check-up. I am pleased to report that after only a couple of weeks of using my new products that my pigment is almost entirely gone and my skin has never looked younger! I am now going to go back to Dr. Walker for some laser treatments on my arms and neck, and am even going to get some Botox (something I thought I would never do) after seeing my friend’s incredible results from her treatments! I highly recommend the Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas for anything from Botox, topical skincare, laser treatments, and surgery (I’m going to eventually get a tummy tuck after having kids) even if you’re from out of town, like me - definitely worth the trip!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Goettsch
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had implants put in 9 years ago from a different doctor.  Last week one of my implants ruptured.  Dr. Walker saw me right away and I was able to get it fixed the next week!  Surgery was yesterday and I am feeling pretty good today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Sherry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lisa is a lovely person, very sweet, knowledgeable, honest, compassionate, and extremely customer service oriented. She is 1000% the reason that I am a loyal customer. They have the latest and greatest equipment and are very reasonably priced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Danielle DeBrooke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love everything about this office! I am a regular client and love my Botox results! One of the best decisions I have ever made. I happily make the 40 minute drive and won’t go anywhere else. If you want a staff that will remember your name, a pristine facility and a doctor you can honestly trust...THIS IS THE PLACE!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T. T.
user_reviews_extended.Description: YASSS!! Finally, a beautiful, clean, and professional clinic for all your rejuvenating needs!!! I had the bbl therapy done by Nyaz and she was incredible!! Nyaz is very knowledgeable and walked me through the entire process AND I saw results as soon as I looked in the mirror! Can’t wait for round two—go see my girl!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience!! From the consultation, to preop, to surgery then post op it was a wonderful experience. Everyone is so kind and caring, they are great at what they do. I am so pleased with my results after surgery and it has changed my life!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paul Kraft is a genius with lasers. I feel so lucky to have stumbled upon such greatness at Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas..Paul exceeded my expectations by 100%! Paul was able to completely remove a scar (that I had for 20+ years) from the middle of my forehead- in one appointment. My skin looks better than it has in 10 years. If you want real results and someone that cares about your skin as much as you do..make an appointment with Paul- he is AMAZING!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Hayes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Katelyn is wonderful! Experienced, knowledgeable, honest, and a master with a syringe! The fact that she is sweet, funny & kind is just a bonus. I tracked her down after she left her previous office because I trust her with my face...nuff said.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandi Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a Registered Nurse and seeing many of Dr. Stagnone's patients through the years, I had no doubt what doctor I wanted to consult with for my Breast Implant surgery.  That time came for me and knowing many of the health care professionals I've worked with over the years had placed their trust in him for their care or their loved ones care, made my decision as easy one.
Being on the patient side of things, gave me a different perspective and the entire experience was one I would recommend to anyone.  I want to extend a big thank you to Dr. Stagnone & all his staff for their exceptional kindness and care.  Never doubted you, only reinforced what I already knew to be true!
Sincerely!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Bartolomei
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have had two procedures with Dr. Stagnone: breast implants & rhinoplasty. Felt very comfortable with him & so did my husband. He is extremely knowledgeable and makes you feel comfortable under his care. Most of all, the work of both procedures look great and I’m very happy with the outcome. Highly recommend him if you’re considering a surgeon in Dallas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Bates
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been lucky enough to be under the care of Paul Kraft for years.  Not only is the one of the kindest people I know, he is absolutely the most knowledgeable and skilled laser specialist.  He recently administered the Profound treatment on my face, neck and décolletage and I have actually had people tell me how "refreshed" I look.  I trust Paul implicitly and he is truly gifted at what he does.  His warm,  joyful personality is infectious and he truly cares about his patients.  Paul has a patient for life with me! - Michelle Bates

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffani Hogan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Stagnone is fantastic!! I was referred to him by a close friend for breast implants and had a great experience from start to finish. He is great at what he does and will give his honest feedback on what he thinks would look good and natural on your body type, which I appreciated. I can't thank him enough for the great job he did on my breasts! The office ladies are all super sweet and helpful too. I would highly suggest anyone who is considering plastic surgery to visit Dr. Stagnone, he is among the BEST in the business!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Spencer H
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walker and Paul Kraft (CLT / LSO) are the consummate professionals. The facility is immaculate and the staff are so friendly and professional as well.  They are extremely attentive and take the time to understand your needs.  I have had several procedures and, every time, have been ecstatic with the results.  They are innovative and have the newest and best equipment.  This is the place to go!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: JoAnn Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Walker and her staff are in tune to “ your” desires and strive to make “your” dreams come true! I highly recommend Dr Walker and her team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKenna Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my consultation with Dr. Walker!! She is knowledgeable and helped me understand my body more. I will definitely be getting my breast reduction with her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leanne Boughton
user_reviews_extended.Description: So warm and friendly. I went for my consolation and was greeted immediately by the staff. While talking with Dr. Stagnone I got the impression that he really does care about what you want your result to be and helps to get you exactly what you want. I went to other consultations and left one of them feeling scared. Not at all here. Would recommend any of my friends to go for a consultation. His wife is the sweetest as well!   I believe you will get amazing results here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rrandi Wright Clawson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Walker and her team have been absolutely wonderful. They have all answered any questions I’ve had regarding my upcoming procedure and even provided me with options I didn’t know were available. Beautiful, facility and an even more beautiful team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sfa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I highly recommend Rachel Walker, MD and Paul Kraft Day who is a member of her team. They both treat you with the greatest respect and care, no matter what the reason for your visit.

Unlike many medical environments you do not feel like they are rushing you through your visit. They take time to carefully explain what is happening and make sure there are no misunderstandings or outstanding concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Rockett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Katelyn at Doctor Rachel Walkers office knocked it out of the park again! This time she gave me a jawline and plumpy beautiful lips with filler!! Amazingly, when she gave me the new jawline it corrected some of the sagginess in my neck! She also took away the lines on my chin. I am so happy with my new look!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Ronquillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently received a  BroadBand Light (BBL) treatment with Nyaz Teymouri and the results were amazing! Nyaz took the time to assess my skin and explain the BBL procedure in detail, addressing any questions I had with patience and expertise. I highly recommend booking with her to anyone seeking professional skincare solutions. You won't be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Calvert Collins-Bratton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Walker and her staff. They make the whole surgical process easy and understandable, with good follow-up care and support. I have already recommended Dr. Walker to other friends, I am very pleased with the outcome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Wall
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a plastic surgeon myself, I know how important it is to choose your surgeon.  Dr. Rachel Walker has an artist's eye for aesthetics and a surgeon's attention to detail.  I have experienced her skilled work in facial fillers and body surgery.  I recommend Dr. Walker without any hesitation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Waggoner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been here twice for breast implants. Once about 15 years ago and the second just a couple of months ago. I was able to replace the old implants, take out some of the stretched skin under my breasts and then have new implants put in to get my lift back.... Dr. Stagnone and staff are great! My 20 year old daughter got implants in June and she also is very pleased with her outcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TeresaR
user_reviews_extended.Description: My consultation with Dr, Stagnone was very relaxed and informative. He struck me as an honest and transparent doctor - not just out for how much money he can get out of you. Love the fact that his wife works with you also, she made me laugh and feel comfortable, as if I was visiting friends. And that was just the consultation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Millard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm writing this review TEN YEARS after my breast augmentation from Dr. Stagnone. My breasts are as beautiful today as the were ten years ago! I too researched and went to a few other doctors and I was/am SO happy I chose Dr. Stagnone because he's truly an artist, as opposed to some of these doctors who decide they'll add plastic surgery to their services simply to increase their income, when they have no natural affinity or 'feel' for it. He took time with me and his staff was so nice, and recovery was easy and smooth. I'm definitely going back to have him do some other procedures for me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bowen Vendig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had such a great experience with Dr. Stagnone and his office staff. Several months ago I got a breast lift (no implant) with another doctor. After waiting a few months, I decided to get an implant and wanted to ask around and see my options and get opinions from others. After meeting with Dr. Stagnone, I immediately made my appointment for implant surgery. I chose a minimal sized implant as I just wanted a natural look and some fullness at the top of the breast. Dr. Stagnone did wonderfully on my procedure and his office staff took exceptional care of me before and after the surgery. My results are better than imagined. I will continue to go to this office if I choose to have other procedures. I already have had friends ask and make appointments to see Dr. Stagnone because they loved my results so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: betsy williamson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Stagnone and his staff. He actually responded to my first email requesting information. user_reviews_extended.Description:

I was truly fortunate to meet Paul after I had a terrible experience of having my face deeply burned from a phenol peel performed by a plastic surgeon. I am not sure what I would look like today if it were not for Paul. And I seriously mean this. Paul has dramatically improved my face texture, tone, skin discolorations, ability to absorb lotions, and taken the redness off my face.  The phenol peel left me with a bright red face, and I could not wear makeup because my skin was unable to absorb.  Paul has corrected this! Because of Paul’s wealth of expertise in a variety of laser procedures, he has been able to transform burned skin to more beautiful skin!  Those that have found Paul are the lucky ones!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Monaghan
user_reviews_extended.Description: My impression is that there are not too many men who are publicly willing to disclose that they have had plastic surgery.  I find that a bit ironic since my objective was twofold: to look better/younger and to feel better personally about the looks of the guy staring at me in the mirror.  I am 69 years old and was referred to Dr. Stagnone by a women friend when I expressed to her that I wished to do something about my substantial "turkey neck".  I found the staff to be first class and was impressed by the fact that Dr. Stagnone's first question was "Why are you here and what are you concerned about?"  Feeling very comfortable after that consultation, I proceeded to have Dr. Stagnone do a lower facelift.  It is now approximately two months post surgery and I am absolutely thrilled with my new look and total lack of turkey neck.  I deliberately did not share my plan in advance with very many people, and I take great delight when people look at me now, trying to figure out what it is about me that looks different (I have always been told that this is the mark of a great plastic surgeon).  I not only look younger, but I also think it goes along with the fact that I have always felt younger than my chronological age.  The post surgical care was top notch, and I would highly recommend Dr. Stagnone without reservation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kaitlyn rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I usually never write lengthy reviews but this one deserves it!
I had such an amazing experience getting my lip filler done with Katelyn, and I genuinely couldn’t be happier with the results. From the moment I walked in, she made me feel so comfortable and welcomed. She has such a calm, kind energy that instantly put me at ease, especially since I was a little nervous going in.

What I appreciated the most was how attentive and detail-oriented she was. Katelyn really took the time to listen to exactly what I wanted—nothing felt rushed or brushed off. I explained that I wanted a natural, subtle look, just a little more volume and definition, and she completely understood my vision. She walked me through everything step-by-step, explaining how she would enhance my lips while still keeping them balanced and proportionate to my face.

During the process, she was incredibly gentle and constantly checked in to make sure I was comfortable. You can tell she truly cares about her clients and their experience, not just the final result. She was also so accommodating, answering all my questions and making adjustments based on my feedback without hesitation.

The results turned out even better than I imagined. My lips look so natural—just like my lips, but enhanced in the best way. There’s no overfilled or obvious look at all, which was really important to me. I’ve gotten so many compliments, and people keep telling me how good and natural they look without even realizing I had anything done.

Overall, I would 100% recommend Katelyn to anyone considering lip filler. She is not only incredibly skilled at what she does, but also so sweet, patient, and genuinely invested in making sure you leave happy and confident. I will definitely be going back to her!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

The first visit all the way until the last that you feel important and comfortable with her office and staff! Everyone she has hired has the same Kind of drive and vision and supports Doctor walkers vision in doing good work, staying true and fair, reasonable with the cost and taking pride in her work, making sure you as her patient receives concierge care! Dr Walker has the hands of an artist and takes pride in her masterpiece. No body anatomy is the same and she had a great teacher who taught her all the ways to love and admire her job, work and making others feel confident without looking botched!

I was so nervous about having a tummy tuck and I would do it again with Dr Rachel Walker and her staff by my side! Her nurse Sarah is so sweet and caring too and really Makes sure each patient is recovering and healing and is so gentle and genuine through the entire thing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Katelyn is hands down an artist. I got alloclae in my hip dips and wanted some projection in my butt. After my weightloss journey I noticed a huge deficit in my glutes. She gave me an amazing silhouette, better than I even imagined. She made me feel so comfortable and relaxed through the whole process. She had spent a lot of time during my consultation answering my questions and showing me what we can accomplish with the Alloclae. My recovery was amazing zero downtime and instant results. Couldn’t recommend enough!!! Love her so much and am so in love with my results. Thank you so much Katelyn!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I got a Hydrafacial with dermaplane by Nyaz and it was easily one of the best facials I’ve ever had. I’m very into skincare and have had many facials, but Nyaz really stood out. I left absolutely glowing—and the glow has lasted for days. Seeing everything the Hydrafacial pulled out of my skin at the end was so satisfying, and the treatment finished with red light therapy which was the perfect touch.

Highly recommend Nyaz to anyone looking to take their skincare to the next level! ✨

user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing from Nyaz’s facials and laser treatments, Katelyn’s attention to detail when injecting and a breast augmentation with Dr Walker- this place is amazing. I couldn’t happier with my results and I’ve only been 2 months post op, and 4 months with the skin treatments I’ve never looked nor felt more confident! I was very apprehensive to get any work done, never had any injections or surgeries, but they listened and didn’t push me to do anything I was uncomfortable with. I wanted a female surgeon when I started my search for my augmentation, and after my consultation I knew I made a good decision. She listened, staff answered all of my questions, and currently they still are available anytime I check to make sure post op is on track. Absolutely recommend this place for any of your esthetic or surgical needs. 10,000 Stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lexi Best
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience with Dr. Walker at Rachel Walker Plastic Surgery Center of Dallas. From the very beginning, she was kind, professional, and made me feel heard and comfortable. Her staff is also incredible and made the entire process—from consultation to surgery to post-op—smooth and supportive.

I consulted with several other surgeons before choosing Dr. Walker, and she was truly worlds better. I knew during my consultation that she was the right surgeon for me. I’m currently two weeks post-op from my breast augmentation and already love my results—even before they’ve fully dropped and fluffed.

Dr. Walker really listened to what I wanted and helped guide me when I was deciding between sizes, which made the process so much easier. I felt taken care of every step of the way. I can’t recommend her enough—she does beautiful work.

title: Dauwe Plastic Surgery
address: 10707 Preston Rd, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

user_reviews.Name: Katee Hennesy
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about my experience at Dauwe Plastic Surgery. From the very first interaction to post-op care, every single person on staff has been incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely a joy to be around. You can truly feel how much they care about their patients.

I had a breast lift and augmentation, and the entire process felt so well explained, thoughtful, and supportive. Emily deserves a special shoutout — she was beyond informative, patient, and reassuring. She went above and beyond to make sure I felt comfortable, confident, and fully informed every step of the way. Her warmth and attention made such a difference, especially during moments that could have felt overwhelming.

The environment is welcoming, the staff is attentive, and the level of care is exceptional. I felt seen, heard, and truly cared for throughout this entire journey. I’m so grateful I chose Dauwe Plastic Surgery and would recommend them wholeheartedly to anyone considering a procedure.

Dauwe did his big one! My boobs look amazing!
Thank you for such an amazing experience! 💕

user_reviews.Name: Kate Corley
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough incredible things about Dr. Philip Dauwe and his team. I had both a breast augmentation and a tummy tuck, from start to finish the experience was exceptional!

I was so nervous- I don’t think he’s had a more anxious patient than me.  Dr. Dauwe and his team took incredible care of me before, during, and after surgery. I actually ended up having two consultations six months apart because life got in the way and I needed more reassurance. Not once did Dr. Dauwe rush me or push me. He never tried to talk me into anything, especially the tummy tuck. He encouraged me to make decisions that were right for me and stay within my comfort zone.

His knowledge extends far beyond plastic surgery. I had concerns about being intubated for the breast augmentation, and he explained the science and safety behind it so clearly that I felt confident moving forward. I truly trusted him with my care.

His entire staff is an absolute dream! Interesting enough it’s all women, including his anesthesiologist  and every single one of them was kind, patient, and attentive. They answered my millions of questions with compassion, sent me home with clear instructions, and supported me every step of the way! Even when I texted them multiple times a day.

And the results… I am blown away. My belly button doesn’t even look like I had a tummy tuck! Dr. Dauwe’s level of skill and detail is beyond anything I could have hoped for! I’m almost three months out now, and it is hands down the best decision I’ve ever made for myself. His work is truly beautiful!

As a bonus, the office is gorgeous and so welcoming which makes appointments even more comfortable.

If you are considering surgery, do not let the light-hearted social media content fool you behind that is a world-renowned surgeon with serious expertise. Choosing Dr. Philip Dauwe was one of the best decisions I have ever made, and I cannot recommend him more! Overall it was the most epic care and results I could have ever hoped for.

Trust me he’s the doctor you want!

user_reviews.Name: Izabella Albertson
user_reviews.Description:
I am just two days post-op, and I truly cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Dauwe and my pre-op/post-op nurse, Kinsey. From the very beginning, they made me feel completely comfortable, supported, and confident in my decision. Their professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail were evident every step of the way.

Recovery has been incredibly smooth so far, and while I’m already excited for my final results, what stands out most is the exceptional care I received. Their expertise and compassion made this entire experience seamless and reassuring, and I am so grateful they were by my side!

user_reviews.Name: Lakisha Dumas
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Phillip Dauwe and his team at Dauwe Plastic Surgery. From the very first moment, he made my daughter & I feel heard, supported, and valued — not just as a patient, but as a person with real concerns, goals, and emotions.

What truly sets Dr. Dauwe apart is his genuine compassion and honesty. He listens. He explains. He guides you based on what is best for your health and your confidence, not what benefits him. In a field where so many providers can feel sales-driven, Dr. Dauwe stands out as a surgeon who cares deeply about doing what is right for the patient first.

He performed my daughter’s breast augmentation, and the experience only reaffirmed everything I already felt about him. The care, patience, and attention to detail he showed her meant the world to us. She felt safe, supported, and beautifully cared for — and her results are stunning and natural. As a mother, knowing she was in the best hands gave me such peace.

Dr. Dauwe’s combination of surgical skill, artistic eye, compassion, and integrity is truly rare. He delivers not only beautiful results, but peace of mind and a genuine sense of trust. If you are looking for a surgeon who listens, cares, and treats you like family — Dr. Dauwe is the one.

We are  beyond grateful for him and his wonderful team. 💗✨

user_reviews.Name: Madi McKenna
user_reviews.Description: I got my breast augmentation done 4 months ago by Dr. dauwe and I could not be happier! The patient care, attention to detail and the entire staff has been a Godsend! So grateful for everyone there who helped with my indecisiveness with sizing and all of my many questions. The safety precautions for getting back to running and working out are so appreciated. They really care about your safety, health and long term results. The pre op and post op care is just top tier! So grateful for everyone there and I LOVE love my results! The entire experience has been 10/10!

user_reviews.Name: Amy Gibson
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience with Audi! She created a personalized treatment plan tailored to my skin concerns and was honest about what would
and wouldn’t work. I’ve had SkinPen, and Halo +BBL laser treatments with her and am so happy with the results. She listens and delivers amazing care — highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Petra Jaslow
user_reviews.Description: Honestly, I wish google reviews allowed you to leave 10 stars because I had a 10/10 experience with Dr. Dauwe and all his staff! I felt so taken care of from my consultation, to my pre op, operation, and post op. I want to thank Emily for getting me scheduled and making sure all my questions were answered pre and post op! She was so helpful and kind and made me feel so at ease! Also, shout out to Dr. Dauwe! Best surgeon in Dallas by far! Forget Miami and Columbia! Everyone should be flying to Dallas to see him and his staff!

user_reviews.Name: K S
user_reviews.Description:
I don’t have enough good things to say about Dr. Dauwe, his entire staff (especially Kinsey, Julie, and Madelyn), and the results of my implant exchange and capsulorrhaphy!

Every touchpoint - from scheduling my consultation to post-op follow-ups - has been a five-star experience that exceeds expectations. Communication is clear, quick, and consistent, and the entire practice runs like a well-oiled machine.

I’m now one month post-op, so my results aren’t even final yet, and I already love them! As others have said, Dr. Dauwe is an artist. His precision and attention to detail really show, and he made me feel completely confident going into surgery by walking me through every step and being honest about recovery and expectations. My only regret is not scheduling the procedure sooner!

Julie was incredibly helpful and patient while I asked every question under the sun before booking, and Kinsey and Madelyn went above and beyond answering late-night post-op emails to clarify recovery instructions and address the inevitable post-surgery questions. Every single person I've interacted with has been warm, professional, and genuinely caring - they even knew my name before meeting me. It truly feels like white-glove service every visit.

I’m so happy with my experience and results, and I can’t recommend Dr. Dauwe and his team highly enough!
