OMG that was not the case and it was the best. My lips head looked the day after and now weeks after. She is amazing! I am so glad I found a new home for my injections!
Thank you, Rachel!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesslyn Stedman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a breast augmentation and lift with Dr. Dauwe and I couldn’t be happier with my results. They look very natural, which is exactly what I wanted. Dr. Dauwe and his team were professional, kind, and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process. I highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Nester
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unbelievably happy with my experience here. Choosing the right  surgeon can be overwhelming and stressful, but once I saw Dr. Dauwe’s reviews and the before and after photos, I knew I needed to book a consultation. I felt comfortable and welcomed by the staff right away and Dr. Dauwe listened to exactly what I was looking for. I felt heard and all questions I had were answered! After going to another consultation with another surgeon, I knew I needed to book with Dr. Dauwe! I couldn’t be happier with my results! Best decision I’ve ever made!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Gateley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about my experience with Dr Dauwe and his office. I was really nervous going into my consultation but his office staff were SO welcoming and kind. It can be kind of intimidating and overwhelming walking into a plastic surgeons office, (I had 3 consults with other doctors before this) but I immediately felt welcomed by Madelyn and was pleasantly surprised with how kind all of the girls in his office were. Emily took me back to my room and took pictures of me and she made me feel so comfortable. My consult with Dr Dauwe was very informative and thorough. I didn’t feel rushed or discarded. Dr Dauwe is kind and warm and his artistic eye is unmatched. I felt like he truly heard my concerns and cared to know exactly what I wanted. Unlike other doctors that I consulted with, he educated me and gave me realistic expectations based off my goals. He suggested a staging process based on my inspiration pictures to meet my goal, something I had never been told about. I felt like other doctors just wanted to get my payment and get me on the table regardless how I would feel about my implants down the road, but Dr Dauwe crafted a personalized plan for me and did a great job at explaining why this was his treatment suggestion based on his experience and my goal. user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Hollo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is my experience with Dr. Dauwe and his Plastic Surgery team after significant weight loss.  As you will see, this was a transformative journey for me.

Weight loss is often celebrated as a monumental achievement, but for many individuals, it can come with unexpected challenges. After shedding 150 pounds, I found myself facing a reality I hadn’t anticipated: an excess of skin in my abdomen and under my arms. As someone in my late 50s, the reality of diminished skin elasticity was daunting, leading me to consider options I had never previously entertained—plastic surgery.
Determined to find the right path for my situation, I began my research into qualified plastic surgeons. After considerable investigation, I chose to consult with Dr. Dauwe and his remarkable team. I entered the consultation room feeling nervous; after all, surgery can be a significant decision. However, I was quickly reassured by discussions with the team and the portfolio of before-and-after photos on Dr. Dauwe’s website. These conversations of the art of the possible and images, triggered a sense of excitement within me, revealing the potential available to me after surgery.
From my very first interaction with Dr. Dauwe’s office, it was clear that I was in capable hands. The commitment to patient care was evident through every stage of the process. My husband accompanied me to the consult, and we were armed with a list of questions and concerns. To my surprise, Dr. Dauwe and his team addressed all my inquiries even before I had a chance to voice them. This level of attentiveness and reassurance can only stem from professionals who genuinely care about their patients’ well-being and outcomes.
Throughout my journey, their exemplary support made all the difference. I felt valued, understood, and encouraged at every step of my journey. Six months post-surgery, the level of enthusiasm and support I received during my follow-up was just as strong as during our initial meeting. It was evident that Dr. Dauwe and his team were in this journey with me—not just as my surgeon and his team but as partners in my transformation.
My experience has been nothing short of life changing. While losing 150 pounds was a tremendous accomplishment, the subsequent surgery to remove excess skin completed the transformation, restoring my energy, body, self-confidence, and overall quality of life. I had not fully realized how the lingering effects of weight loss could affect my self-esteem until I experienced the positive changes post-surgery. Dr. Dauwe and his team not only understood this shift; they embraced and facilitated it, providing unwavering support through my transition.
For anyone considering similar measures, I highly recommend perusing before-and-after galleries, as they played a crucial role in motivating me. I also suggest taking that essential first step: scheduling a free consultation with Dr. Dauwe. This was an opportunity that exceeded all my expectations, and today, I am thoroughly pleased with my results. My gratitude towards Dr. Dauwe and his team cannot be overstated; they have helped me reclaim my life in ways I hadn’t imagined possible. With their expertise, I feel empowered to embrace my new life and look forward to the future with enthusiasm and confidence.

Size 26 to a size 10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenica Sullivan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Dauwe and his staff. A breast augmentation is a procedure I have wanted and researched for years. I set up 2 consults and Dr. Dauwe's office was head and shoulders above the other consult I had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been anxiously waiting to write this review!

(Strap in for a long but well-deserved 10+ star review). - A BA is something that I had been considering for some time and was weighing my options of PS in Dallas to choose from (we all know there are plenty out there). I was highly drawn to Dr. Dauwe because of his work, and I truly had an instinct that I at least needed to go to a consult. - Not only was the process to get that scheduled quick BUT I also mentioned my desire to get in sooner and they made it happen.

My consult process started with Julie who is EXTREMELY knowledgeable. She made me feel right at home in the consult room and discussed what I was looking for in depth. Of course, Dr. Dauwe then later joined the appointment and was able to add context to some questions, set realistic expectations with me, asking intuitive and intentional questions, and quickly squashed any/all anxiety I had around the procedure. - then time to book!

The day of my consult the team made a date/time that worked for me, work for them (another clear example of being so strong at having a "customer first" approach). I was so grateful to have been the first surgery in their beautiful new center out of their office and let me tell you - the morning of, I felt SO at home getting ready. Alyssa was the first sweet face I saw that morning and she was just a light from the start. She did my IV and tended to all questions/nausea I was developing from the nerves. Dr. Dauwe came in cool as a cucumber too the morning of and did the markings/confirmed the sizing I was wanting (communicating VERY clearly and transparently) then before I knew it, the experienced crew was putting me to sleep, and I woke up to zero pain from the procedure.

RECOVERY:
- When I saw I am SHOCKED by how good I felt, I can't tell you enough that the team and Dr. Dauwe clearly knew what they were doing. My recovery was a breeze with no intense discomfort and my incisions were as small as they could be. - Alyssa was even so sweet to book an appointment to take my steri-strips off for me because I was afraid to see my incisions for the first time. She reassured me that all was going according to plan and between a tag team of her, Julie, and the lovely Madelyn on staff - every question/concern I had was addressed ASAP via in person, text message, and shared photos. It truly was white glove/first class service.

I write this review now at 6 weeks PO and my breasts feel 100% apart of my body, I have no pain, and I am so in love with my results (which is wild as they'll only get better with time). I cannot express enough just now grateful I am for Dr. Dauwe and his staff. They were personable, intentional, thorough, supportive, responsive, and are best of class. If you are considering a BA - there is no place like Dr. Dauwe's office, and I guarantee you will be embraced with the same warmth and reassurance from the moment you set foot in the office to begin your journey.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krys
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot praise Dr. Dauwe and his staff enough, from start to finish it has been an amazing experience. I had my consultation back in January where Dr. Dauwe took his time to listen to my lifestyle and goals (I was looking for a breast reduction and tummy tuck after significant weight loss) before making his suggestions. He listened to my concerns and was supportive of any decision I wanted (which is a MUST for any doctor) and encouraged me to take some time with my decision. After about a week I was pretty set on going with his suggestions, and made the call to the office where Julie (the office Wonder Woman) worked with my insurance and answered any additional questions I had.

Flash forward to COVID and finally getting to my date (I had originally scheduled my operation for the summer back in January), Julie and the office team made sure to talk me through any of my concerns about getting a massive procedure like this done during COVID. All of my visits (both pre-op and post) have been during the pandemic and I have always felt safe and comfortable with the standards of safety of the office. The surgery center was equally amazing as was the staff who took care of me during my first night of recovery, which for someone who was super anxious/never had any history of hospital stays is saying something!

My post-op was a breeze. I was given all the information and support needed to be able to set my recovery up for success from Dr. Dauwe and his team, and always had immediate communication for any concerns or questions I had. As for the results, I was IMMEDIATELY happy with everything even bandaged and swollen. I'm two months post-procedure and I cannot tell you how incredibly delighted I am with my results, and the changes keep coming (as expected and told, because it'll take about 6 months for things to settle out). I am a very athletic person and to be able to return to working out without having to wear two bras to hold down the ladies is easily the best feeling ever (and to not even need a bra just doing chores around the house is a whole new world for me). I cannot begin to describe how grateful I am to Dr. Dauwe for taking the time to listen and advise based on my lifestyle, goals, and body frame for what he suggested for me.

Between the knowledge/skillset of Dr. Dauwe and his amazing staff I will always return to them for any future procedures I may need. Everyone in that office is knowledgeable, patient, and incredibly kind. Like I said at the start, I cannot praise or recommend Dr. Dauwe and his staff enough!

Julie (who is extraordinary) and the entire team are 100% competent and professional, endlessly patient and knowledgeable, and always, always warm and friendly.

I’m incredibly thankful to everyone at Dauwe Plastic Surgery for your care and good work. You all are the absolute greatest!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Swift
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at Dr Dauwe’s office.  The staff were extremely caring and professional.  Dr Dauwe spent a long time with me and really listened to my concerns.  Everyone I know who has had a surgery with him has had amazing results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Rodriguez

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mayra Espinoza

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liubov Zinkevych
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I start..my surgery was on July 19, 2023. user_reviews_extended.Name: JMT
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dauwe  is a phenomenal surgeon! He and his team have completely changed my life - words can’t express how grateful I am. I came to Dr. Dauwe from out of state via a mutual friend of mine and his practice manager, Julie. I‘ve had neck/shoulder problems for 10 years (neck fusion, multiple nerve ablations, PT, chiropractic, etc.) with minimal long term relief. Other physicians were out of options. I should have pursued this solution much sooner. Dr. Dauwe is a terrific listener, very attentive, skilled and knowledgeable. A perfectionist in the best way! Dr. Dauwe’s staff is also incredible-they treated me like family, answered all my questions thoroughly and were always there for me. Practice Manager Julie is terrific with communications, what to expect, suggestions, advice, etc. She also worked me in for a few other services while I was there at my request, which was great. She consistently exceeded my expectations! Staff overall fantastic - Drea talented and helpful, Sara and Bre also wonderful. A truly life changing experience! If you are looking for help from the waist up, I highly recommend Dr. Dauwe and his team! Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Moon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t express enough how thankful I am to have found Dr. Dauwe and his staff. From the very beginning of my process with him and his team, I was extremely pleased and confident in my decision of choosing him as my surgeon. Being my first surgery and first time to go under anesthesia, I was extremely nervous. I had many questions about what to expect for a breast augmentation and post op procedures. Being so young I was most concerned with appropriate sizing and the longevity of the surgery. Dr Dauwe helped my pick the perfect sizing and assured I would 100% satisfied with the results, and right he was!!! The office team was so helpful in completing all necessary information and forms, extremely thorough with explaining the process pre-op and post-op. I knew exactly what to expect and that gave me so much relief. The surgery center was incredible as well. They were very detail oriented yet quick with their work. I was in and out of there in no time and on the way to recovery at home. The extent of my recovery was a breeze and I was back to normal within about 5 days!! Dr Dauwe completely restored my confidence and made me feel like a woman. I cannot recommend his work enough. I would do this surgery 5 times over if I had to. I can’t believe how easy the entire process was start to finish and how comfortable I felt with him and his entire staff. I was always greeted with a smile and wished “goodbye, we will see you next time” on my way out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Hanson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Dauwe is Dallas’ Best PS!
I started going to Dr. Dauwe’s office a year ago (November 2021) to see Tessa Thornton for Botox. My daughter is 5 years old. My stomach never returned to its former glory after having her which gave me a sense of body dysmophia I have never experienced. I’m naturally a slender person with a fast metabolism and while I do workout I have never had to work at being thin. No matter what I tried after pregnancy I just couldn’t get rid of my pooch or c-section shelf. While waiting for Tessa, I noticed so many happy patients come and go in the waiting room. This got me thinking more and more about doing something to rectify my stomach woes. During one of my Botox appointments I spoke with Dr. Dauwe’s nurse, Julie. She is amazing and assured me I was a great candidate for a tummy tuck. She answered several of my preliminary questions and encouraged me to schedule a consultation. Enter Dr. Dauwe…I went for my consultation and was blown away by his humility, knowledge, and kindness. Dr. Dauwe has a calming confident demeanor. For me, it’s about a vibe or if I click with someone in addition to their competence. Dr. Dauwe immediately assessed that he could address my needs and achieve my desired results. He suggested abdominoplasty and liposuction to my flanks. He recognized that I had a congenital umbilical hernia which he could resolve during the procedure as well. Let me just tell you his compassionate bedside manner is bar none and he is also efficient!
My consultation was in July 2022 and during that appointment I scheduled my procedure for December 13th 2022. The pre op appointment was valuable and his superb staff helped me prepare for the “what to expect” before during and after surgery. I couldn’t wait for the day to be here.
The day of surgery I arrived at the Baylor surgery center one hour before my procedure. They took me back and the team there was  delightful. I could tell I was in the best hands. His anesthesiologist, Dr. Amy Ripley, from Dallas Anesthesiology Associates was lovely, encouraging, and explained everything she was going to do during the procedure. Dr. Dauwe came in to see me, and once again proved I was entrusting the right physician for the job. He marked me up and we were off to the OR. I can’t put into words his precision and attentiveness. He has a gift. He wants you to have the best results possible and wants you to be happy.
Today I saw Dr. Dauwe 9 days post op. My recovery has gone as expected. My pain was well managed and I’m already standing pretty straight. (This varies from patient to patient) I couldn’t help but tell him “thank you” and will remain grateful to him for giving me my confidence back! I feel like a new better version of myself. He took excellent care of me and I would recommend him to anyone considering plastic surgery.
I am thrilled with my results so far and know they will only get better from here on out! Also, his office is gorgeous! Love all of the David Yarrow art!!!

Thank you, Dr. Dauwe, and to your incredible team! I feel so blessed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Norton

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carin Brunner

user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not possibly be happier with Dr. Dauwe, his beautiful work, his bedside manner and his office staff! user_reviews_extended.Name: Maleah Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my first derma peel with Audi about a few months ago, I feel like I’m seeing the final results and they are amazing. She was so sweet and walked me through the after care process. I’ll definitely be returning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brenden pokorny
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dauwe and his entire staff are incredible! I could not be more pleased with my “mommy makeover” results. They made me feel at ease and took great care of me from my first consultation, to pre-op, surgery and recovery. I met with several surgeons and pored over reviews and before and after photos before I chose him. The before and after photos speak for themselves. I had never had major surgery before, so I was bracing for the worst (and very nervous!), but it really couldn’t have gone smoother. Yes, recovery took time, but I would do it again in a heartbeat. I was able to be off all pain meds in less than 2 weeks. I am just over 7 months post-op and my scars are healing beautifully, my belly button looks natural, and after 4 babies, I have abs again! :) Entrusting your body and life to someone else is scary, especially as a mother, but I felt that I was in the best of hands every step of the way. Thank you, Dr. Dauwe!! Your reputation as the best is well-earned. Forever grateful for my results!!! Xx

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: After having four babies in eight years, my tummy was in desperate need of help. I researched surgeons and procedures and I knew I wanted a plastic surgeon who preformed a drainless tummy tuck and had an overnight facility for the first night post-op. I had consultations with several qualified surgeons and had come to believe that all plastic surgery offices were going to feel like a “take a number, wait your turn, and then send you on your way” operation. I was *this* close to putting money down with another surgeon until my gut told me to just do one more consult. That consult led me to Dr. Dauwe and made all the difference in this process. Dr. Dauwe is not only a competent, meticulous, and well-trained surgeon, he is also a wonderful person! He has patiently answered all of my many, many questions—never making me feel like I was annoying or burdening him. He has cheered me on and celebrated with me in the recovery process. He makes you feel like you are his only and most important patient. I am beyond satisfied with my results and it is not an exaggeration to say that I look better now, at 37 and after four pregnancies, than I did at 21. Dr. Dauwe is a true gem and I can’t recommend him highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Dodge
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been doing botox and fillers for a years at another location (done by an MD at a dermatologists office). But they recently moved to a next generation filler product using a canula and I found the procedure to be very uncomfortable/jerky to the point it made me nauseated.

So after going to Dr. Dauwe for a consult for surgery and seeing they also do injectables, I made an appointment to try out Tess and see if it would be a better experience. I am so glad I did as it was an amazing experience - she was far more gentle using a canula so the procedure wasn't bad at all. She also had more products, and did great job listening to my needs, which were both immediate (heading on vacation with hubby) and long term (wanted to long term results, best bang for my buck).

She was able to get me in last minute before my trip, when I looked in the mirror and felt I just looked old and tired. It was the first adults only (no kids) trip I had been able to take in years and wanted to look my best. She chose a great selection of products, using botox and a filler to give me immediate lift and then also Sculptra for long term results.

Please note that everyone at the office has been great, and I was impressed with Dr. Dauwe as well.  I am only giving 4 stars at this time, instead of 5, because I have limited experience here (one surgery consult visit and one injectable visit). So I can't speak to his procedures or other services. But so far, everything has been great (short wait times, friendly and competent staff, well organized, great service, etc.) and I am looking forward to coming back for injectables and other procedures and can revise as I learn more :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Esparza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dauwe and his staff are absolutely amazing! I loved everything about my experience from start to finish! Him and his staff are very attentive and make sure that you’re comfortable and confident with decisions throughout the entire process and always there to answer all of your questions. You will not regret choosing Dr. Dauwe! I explained my previous experience to my nurse Tessa and she explained what could have potentially happened and recommended I try Botox as an alternative. It was EVERYTHING I wanted!! Didn’t hurt, and was perfectly even! Highly recommend her!! Can’t wait to be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Patti

I had breast reconstruction and a lift and am very pleased with the results.  I would definately recommend Dr. Dauwe at Lemon Avenue Plastic Surgery and Laser Center.

user_reviews_extended.Name: stephanie ragan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Dauwe and his staff! Sara and Julie are so sweet and do a fantastic job preparing patients for their surgery day. Catherine Kinney called me the night before to make sure I was prepared for anesthesia. Her voice was so calming and she really made me feel at ease for my upcoming procedure.

The morning of my surgery, I was greeted with many friendly smiles, including Karen and CRNA Kinney. Before my procedure, Dr. Dauwe came in and measured and marked me up. He once again went over his plan for my procedure and what I could expect after surgery. I had my breast implants removed with a lift. The most surprising thing to me was that HE CALLED THURSDAY EVENING TO CHECK ON ME!! I thought that was so thoughtful of him.

After five days, I can honestly say my results are above and beyond what I ever expected. Dr. Dauwe did a wonderful job! I’ve had minimal pain and my breasts are looking great! He is very knowledgeable in his field, he is professional and kind. I highly recommend him for any plastic surgery needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Speed-Laureano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hard to really put into words the impact my surgery has had on my life, but I will say that Dr. Dauwe and his whole staff has made this experience what I would call life changing. Dr. Dauwe has a calm, humble, demeanor, and I had been following him on IG based on a friend who mentioned he did her breast aug a few years back. When I met with his team in January they were already booked out almost 6 months for a mommy makeover. That’s a good thing! You want to find someone who is booked. Not only did I love his conservative nature and perspective in what I was looking to have done, but he spent way more time with me answering my questions than what you typically find in the healthcare space. I’ve been in healthcare working with physicians for almost 20 years, so it is saying something when a physician has no problem answering all the myriad questions you have when you are going to have a big procedure done. They also made what could be an awkward feeling, feel very normal. He has great eye contact, and his office manager Julie is great at her job and been in the industry a long time. But I have to say, what comforted and confirmed for me the most was his office staff and their friendliness, willingness to help, and their knowledge about my procedure and the process. Sara in particular is a gem of a human. I thought for my pre-op she was just being nice answering all my questions and giving me suggestions, and then when I saw her for my post op I realized: MAN! She’s not just a front desk person, she’s like THE pre and post op professional! I had called on day 3 after my surgery and she was amazing to work with on my meds. She was so patient both before and after my surgery – and it makes you feel like you are their only patient, though it looks to be a busy practice, you don’t feel that way. It’s not a mill, this is not the kind of place that doesn’t care for you and want to answer all your questions. They are truly genuine, I really felt that from Sara, Julie, Bre, and Dr. Dauwe. I haven’t seen Tess but I’m sure I will at some point, I’ve heard great things. This is a rock star team and if you’re on the fence or haven’t scheduled a consult and really walked out feeling very confident in the team – come and get one here – he will tell you his professional opinion. I have another colleague who came here before me and had a consult and he honestly told her to wait until a certain time – so he’s not doing this for volume – he really wants to do the right thing for you. But truly Sara is awesome and I can’t say enough good things about her – you are in good hands with this practice. Thank you, Dr. Dauwe and team.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

If you’re looking for a surgeon in DFW, go see Dr. Dauwe. You won’t be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Brady
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely incredible experience!  My mom had 3rd degree burns on her left leg back in Nov of 2017.  The incident was traumatic and we had to act quickly to get her with a physician.  Unfortunately, the trauma surgeon she was referred to had no people skills, was less than gentle and had little to no interest in my mom's needs.  It was apparent he was focused on getting her to surgery and just sticking to the logistics.  We switched to Dr. Dauwe, and it all changed.  His attention to detail, open communication and warmth displayed to our entire family was overwhelming.  His entire staff was professional and willing to help my mom with very specific needs as she was in a wheel chair during most of the process.  They not only provided incredible care, but the skin graft, after care and follow up exceeded our expectations.  My mom, along with our entire family knew we were in the best hands possible.  Her leg continues to improve and heal, and looks GREAT and she is up and walking again!  I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Phillip Dauwe and the Lemmon Avenue Plastic Surgery and Laser Center team!  The selflessness displayed by all at such a busy time of year was humbling for our family to say the least.  We are forever grateful for each of you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Meyers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would highly recommend Dr. Dauwe! From the moment I walked in the office, everyone was so personable and made me feel right at home. I knew the end result I was seeking but was unsure of my options. Dr. Dauwe took the time to go over the options and ultimately recommended a tummy tuck to achieve my desired outcome. I was apprehensive at first but Dr. Dauwe eased my concerns with a thorough explanation of the procedure and the recovery process. He ensured all my questions were answered and I left feeling confident in my decision. The procedure was seamless and I am thrilled with the results! I could not have asked for a better experience and am thankful for the expertise of Dr. Dauwe as well as his amazing staff!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dauwe went above and beyond to attend to my cosmetically sensitive injury. I HIGHLY recommend Dauwe Plastic surgery for any of your cosmetic/plastic surgery needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fredster Regio
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing!  Wow! Impressive! Exceeded expectations! Those are all words I’ve used to describe the results and the service my wife got from Dr. Dauwe & his staff.

My wife got a tummy tuck, liposuction and a breast reduction/lift from Dr. Dauwe. It was the best decision she could have made. From the moment we first called his office and spoke to Julie to the post op care we received from the nurse and the doctor, everything has been perfect. His front end staff made up of Julie, Sarah & Brie have been PHENOMENAL. Sarah, especially. This woman is simply amazing. She answered all our questions with a patience I had never encountered before in a medical setting. And let me tell you we had many-many questions as anyone going through this would be expected to have. This is no easy process but they made it so seem-less for us by being so kind and helpful. They literally held our hand as we navigated this process.

We visited and considered several surgeons in different states and nobody came close when it came to service and results. Dr. Dauwe’s attention to detail and care for his patients is world class. He’s got a excellent bedside manners and truly cares for his patients. When you come to Dr. Dauwe you can expect a doctor that is meticulous and with high expectations for himself and the results he gives you. My wife and I could not be more grateful and happy to have chosen Dr. Dauwe.

If you are reading this and are considering choosing Dr. Dauwe, do it. You will not be disappointed at the service and results you will receive from him and his staff.

I truly hope that the gratitude I feel for Dr. Dauwe and his staff transcends this review and makes it your way. We are so lucky to have found this Doctor and this office.  I hope you do too.

Edit: The Anesthesiologist(I don’t remember her name) selected for the operation was amazing. She took really good care of my wife. My wife had low blood pressure and that anesthesiologist stayed with my wife from start to finish and didn’t leave until my wife was great. She too, was amazing.

Fred R.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachelle Robison

Can't recommend Dr. Dauwe enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlynn McNutt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr. Dauwe through my insurance while trying to start the process of getting a breast reduction. From the moment I walked in their office, I felt so welcomed and Julie Garcia, one of his patient coordinators treated me like a friend from the get go. I had already had one bad experience with another plastic surgeon while trying to get this procedure done and she immediately put my mind at ease and told me she didn’t think getting my procedure covered would be an issue. I filled out paperwork and was put into a room to wait for Dr. Dauwe. At first I was getting a little impatient with the amount of time I had waited, afraid it was going to be like my first experience, but I heard him talking to a lady in the next room over and could already hear the kindness in his voice before I even met him. When it was my turn to be seen he walked in and introduced himself and was so nice and patient. I told him my story, what I wanted done and why, and what had happened with the first surgeon I tried to use. The appointment did not feel rushed at all, he was genuinely listening to what I had to say and understood what this surgery meant to me. He told me that it was his favorite surgery to perform because it changes his patients lives! He took measurements, pictures, and talked to me a little bit about the process, and he was so warm and friendly the entire time. Three weeks later I heard back from Julie that my procedure was approved and we immediately set a surgery date for October 30th. They constantly stayed in contact with me and kept me up to date on everything I needed throughout the entire process. Dr. Dauwe was already seeing patients again only 2-3 days after his new baby girl was born, including myself for my pre-op appointment, which shows just how much he cares about his patients. The morning of surgery he came and checked in with me after I had been given my IV and drew me up and really took his time and paid attention to every detail. After waking up from surgery I could not help but just immediately start crying after I looked under my gown at my new breasts. He came by to see me before I checked out and held my hand and told me he was glad he was able to do it for me and I could not stop thanking him, still crying. My phone number changed just a week or two prior to surgery and I forgot to update Julie on the change before everything was all said and done. He was so kind to reach out to my mother all the way in Atlanta after he couldn’t get ahold of me to check on how I was doing post op and let her know he was trying to get ahold of me. After getting my new number from her, he called me from his personal number and told me to call or text at any time if I have any issues or questions so he can help me out personally. I just can’t say enough good things about him and his work. user_reviews_extended.Name: Mia Gray
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I even begin? His 5 star status on Google prior to me even leaving this review is ample evidence that his level of quality, professionalism and bedside manner is bar none the best in his industry.

Upon arriving for my consult I met with Julie and Sara, who are incredibly and genuinely sweet, personable and full of great energy. When I met with Dr. Dauwe to discuss the size and look I was going for (Breast Augmentation) he was honest and very transparent about what max CC would compliment my body type and frame. No plastic surgeon I've consulted with prior really went over the anatomy of my personal body while also explaining what going "too big" can do to the appearance, most especially long term. I appreciated the significant amount of time (most especially in comparison to meeting with most doctors) that Dr. Dauwe spent with me. Ensuring I was 100% confident before putting down any money or scheduling my surgery day.

Surgery Day:

I'll begin by saying I've never been put under general anesthesia and for that I was beyond nervous and full of questions.. they were meticulous at answering each and every one of them.. great deal.  I showed up that morning and was set up on IV's and then taken into the surgery room. They had everything down to the temperature cozy and right in there, I laid down on the table, where they had heaters under the blankets. I chatted with his nurses, who were both INCREDIBLE with very nurturing, gentle and playful spirits. They placed the mask over me for sedation and the next thing I know I woke up in a recovery room.. ALL DONE!

Dr. Dauwe personally called me the evening of surgery and the following day to ensure I was comfortable and adjusting into my new girls properly. I was impressed by that because I had my surgery 2 days after Christmas, a few days before the NY. He has a wife, kiddos and a NEWBORN that deserved all of his time, but he made it work and reaching out to me around such a busy, surrounded by family time spoke volume to me in seeing his genuine care for his patients.

THE COOLEST PART? I went out to DINNER and to the park with my son that evening! I was in pain on a scale of 1-10,  5 only for the first hour... then all pain stopped for good and hasn't reoccurred. I'm a week post-op and although my chest still feels really tight, they are significantly dropped and look so beautiful! I can't get over how great I feel and I've got the incredible Lemmon Avenue Plastic Surgery team to thank for that.

I can't express enough through words how strongly I feel you should decide on Dr. Phillip Dauwe for any plastic surgery wants.. best experience and decision ever!

I went on many consults, but he was the only one that asked me sincere questions about my well being, vision for myself, and what would make me feel confident again. He heard me and then offered options that took what I wanted into account while keeping my health in mind. Seeing him and hearing him speak about our action plan made it apparent that he is an artist and is extremely passionate about his work.

I'm thee weeks out from a MAJOR breast lift and tummy tuck that corrected pretty serious diastasis recti (abdominal muscle separation) from my pregnancies. I am over the moon - pie in my eyes excited over the results!

The obvious difference is physical, but I want to talk about the other things I have experienced that have already made an impact. I am a singer, and I stopped performing after my children were born due to lack of breath control/diaphragm control. Almost immediately after surgery I discovered that my strong voice is back! It has been an awesome surprise that I hadn't expected.

In about 2 weeks I have concert tickets and plans for a pretty epic date night with my husband, and I find myself being excited about "THAT" dress. We all have one... It's the one we want to wear but never make it out of the house in because we lose our nerve. I tried it on and darn near cried when I saw that I look like myself again, but even better than I remembered.

All in all, if you want to create a relationship with a surgeon that cares for you as a whole person Dr. Dauwe is your guy. I couldn't have asked for a better experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an absolutely amazing experience with Dr. Dauwe! I recently had a breast augmentation, and from my consultation to recovery, everything exceeded my expectations. Dr. Dauwe made me feel completely comfortable and confident answering all of my questions. On surgery day, I was SO excited rather than nervous, and my recovery was so smooth. I was down for just a few days and healed quickly.

Now, four weeks post-op, I couldn’t be happier with the results. The implants are perfectly proportionate to my body, and I feel beautiful and confident. The entire team, including Kinsey, Gabby, Julie, Alyssa, Tessa, Rachel, and Emily made the experience so wonderful. I am so grateful for such a phenomenal experience🍒

title: Westlake Dermatology & Cosmetic Surgery - University Park
address: 6565 Hillcrest Ave #110, Dallas, TX 75205, United States

owner.name: Westlake Dermatology & Cosmetic Surgery - University Park (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Waggle
user_reviews.Description:
I just moved to Dallas and finding this place has been such a blessing. I came in today for a spot on my leg, and once again, the team reminded me why I love this place so much!

Maya is always so warm and welcoming, and she helped me find the right sunscreen without making me feel rushed. Kathie and Becca made my biopsy quick and painless, listened to every concern, made me feel truly heard. Even Dr. Daniels, who I met briefly, radiated kindness.

As someone who loves aesthetic treatments but also struggles with psoriasis and random skin issues, it means so much to feel genuinely cared for. This team doesn’t just provide treatments, they make me feel safe and valued. I love this entire team!

user_reviews.Name: Arad Attia
user_reviews.Description:
From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and pleasant. Maya, the office manager, greeted me with genuine warmth and care.

My experience with Rebecca and her assistant, Kennedy, was excellent. They took the time to ask thoughtful questions, explained everything clearly, and answered all of my questions patiently. Most importantly, they made me feel that they truly cared and genuinely wanted to help.

Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Tien Nguyen
user_reviews.Description:
I typically don’t write anything less than a great review but I recently went to a new derm office, which in effect - shined a light on some of the pitfalls I was experiencing at Westlake.

Back a couple months ago, I came in for an appointment for my acne scars. I’ve come in for a few appointments in the past as well however my experience was the same every time - minimal explanation from the doctor on my condition and subpar customer service from the receptionists. My most recent visit with them, the doctor told me they discontinued a chemical peel that would potentially help me because it wasn’t profitable enough for them. When I asked about laser, they were very transparent with me and said the laser was not “melanated-skin friendly” so it wasn’t worth spending on. Speaking with other professionals outside this office, they’ve explained to me that while melanated skin have a higher risk with laser, there are still lasers out there that accommodate for the pigmentation and if treated with proper care, it can be highly successful.

This left me with a bad taste in my mouth, esp for a well regarded office in highland park. Kind of told me everything I needed to know and I gave them multiple chances.

While I appreciate their transparency and willingness to semi-work with me, I hope the practice is able to continue to improve on what healthcare they have to offer to better accommodate the diverse DFW area!

user_reviews.Name: Jamie Sarten
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Rebecca Boss, PA-C was amazing! She was so gentle with my Botox, neck Botox, and lip flip. I really appreciated how calm, professional, and intelligent she was throughout the whole appointment. She explained everything clearly and made me feel comfortable. Highly recommend her if you’re looking for someone you can fully trust with injectables!

user_reviews.Name: Karrington Cagle
user_reviews.Description: The staff was incredibly nice and I didn’t have to wait at all. This was my first time getting Botox and I was nervous. Rebecca Boss, PA-C was very gentle and informative during my visit. Kathie was also great and helped keep me comfortable and calm throughout the process. I could not be more impressed with Westlake Dermatology. Thank you guys!

user_reviews.Name: Molly McGetrick
user_reviews.Description:
I had such a great experience at Westlake from start to finish. I saw Becca Boss, who took the time to answer all my skin questions and gave me real peace of mind after the skin check I’d been putting off. She offered excellent guidance on skin cancer prevention and overall skin health, and she introduced me to Altreno—my skin has truly never looked better. I cant wait to come back for aesthetic treatments.

As a bonus, the staff was able to get me in quickly, the office is spotless and relaxing, and parking was a breeze. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Rig Muhsin
user_reviews.Description: I flew in from Houston and got my filler done by Michelle. I can’t express how amazing and patient she was with me. She educated me on the process and took her time to ensure that I got the best results. I can’t recommend her enough!

user_reviews.Name: Sneha Mondal
user_reviews.Description: I had such a great experience at Westlake Dermatology. The clinic is beautiful, modern, and very welcoming the moment you walk in. All the staff were kind, efficient, and made me feel really comfortable throughout the entire visit. I appreciated how thorough they were in answering questions without making me feel rushed. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for dermatology services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Waggle

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenifer Alcantara
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front staff to the back, everyone was so friendly! Office smelled so nice and it’s aesthetically pleasing! Rebecca was so nice and answered every question i had

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had the best experience at Westlake Dermatology and can’t recommend them enough! From start to finish, everything was seamless, professional, and welcoming. Becca Boss was truly outstanding ~ she’s incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and took the time to explain everything in a way that made me feel completely confident and comfortable.

The entire team was warm and attentive, and the level of care I received was beyond anything I’ve experienced at other dermatology offices.

Even though I’ve moved out of state, I’ll still be flying back just to keep my appointments with them. That’s how much I trust and value the care at Westlake Dermatology!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kortni King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had the best experience at Westlake Dermatology. I went in for Microndeeling and the entire process was seamless. The staff was friendly and the providers spent additional time to help educate me on any questions I had before and after. Will be back for more treatments asap!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Cauthern Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I see Dr. Saxon annually and for the occasional cosmetic treatment.  She is professional, on-time, and great to work with. She listens and thoroughly answers questions. She will only make recommendations if you ask specifically for them. The front staff is super efficient and friendly. I particularly like their organization with text, email reminders etc. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Claire Scotto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful ladies who genuinely cared about what they were doing and listened to all my concerns. I felt very heard as a patient which is hard to come by these days in the medical space. Looking forward to continuing my relationship with these fabulous women!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Becca Boss is incredibly kind and a wonderful PA! I took my dad to her as I was concerned about a few spots on his skin. He's a stubborn guy from east Texas so forcing him to the dermatologist is no joke but he did it to make me happy. Anyways, Becca was incredibly patient with my dad and I, ensuring she took the time to educate us about the different spots on his skin and gave assurances that there was nothing of concern or harm to be found. Whew! What a relief. He did have a biopsy done but Becca did this flawlessly and without pain, my dad didn't even notice she was done until he had to ask. Great practice! Everyone was kind and welcoming. Office is so stunning and while there is traffic on Hillcrest, the office is easy to find and parking is free! Such a plus. Kendall, Becca's MA was so professional and kind to my dad as well. Thanks Kendall! Cannot recommend Becca and Westlake enough!! Get your skin checks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Lytle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Becca Boss is the best! She is so welcoming and friendly that you feel  instantly at ease! She listens to all your skin concerns and addresses them in a way that you understand.  The office staff are amazing as well!
I highly recommend seeing Becca for all your skin concerns and/or just a skin check!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Saxton Daniels and her staff are very professional and knowledgeable.  Appointments are timely and friendly.  The location and parking are easy to find.  I recommend Dr. Saxton Daniels for all your dermatological needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Hood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience at this location! The staff were welcoming and professional, and the office was very clean. Michelle took the time to understand my goals, ensuring I receive the best results. Her skill and attention to detail made the entire process comfortable and seamless. I highly recommend her and will definitely be coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa NT
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great visit with Becca Boss and her assistant Kendal. Everybody was friendly and greeted me with a smile. This is a beautiful office space, as well. I will be recommending this office to family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel Burin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is not what I'm complaining here, they are actually very friendly. The thing I was not happy about was the huge scar left in my back after removing a mole. I was expecting a cosmetic surgery that would at least leave a small scar. They used very basic stitches in my back and you can imagine how it is right now. I just thought this could be avoided considering the $$$$ bill that I received after that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Makila Ballard
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time getting a full body skin screening and I will say… immediate thoughts - I was uncomfortable! But Mary Elizabeth and Dr. Ashenbeck definitely made me feel comfortable and heard throughout my entire appointment. Mary Elizabeth helped me plain how things will go before the Doctor arrived as she could see I was nervous. She always had a smile on her face! She was friendly and welcoming. Dr. Ashenbeck was very informative and friendly as well. She was very gentle during the entire appointment. Both were very professional. The staff at the front were also very kind. Immediately, I was welcomed in with smiles and great energy. The wait time was minimal, the check in and out process was efficient & the customer service was top tier! The location was great. Parking was easy and accessible as well! I would recommend anyone to come here! (as I did all of my friends and family minutes after leaving my appointment!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Garrett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient at Westlake Derm for years and they exceed my expectations and address any concerns I have every time. My most recent visit was with Michelle and she walked me through the entire process before treatment and I have been loving the results. The staff is professional and always so kind and helpful. I would recommend visiting here for any Derm/cosmetic treatments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Gianopoulos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient at Westlake for almost 10 years, and while the quality of services has always been excellent, the ongoing billing issues and lack of accountability have left me no choice but to go elsewhere.

Despite having clear documentation showing I had prepaid for a service, the office repeatedly denied it and continued to charge me. I spent months going back and forth with their billing manager, Morgan, who was unable to provide any proof that the funds had been used. When asking about the obvious credit (that matched my cc charge) on their invoices, the response was “that’s just our invoicing system, that doesn’t really mean it’s ’a credit’”.  So, despite invoices and credit card statements showing nearly $1k in remaining credit, my concerns were rudely dismissed over 4–5 times.  Finally, dumbfounded, I requested escalation to someone else, left multiple voicemails, and sent emails, yet no one outside of Morgan who had no interest in settling this ever followed up.

Beyond the blatant billing mistake, the overall customer service experience was shockingly poor. There are far too many reputable dermatology offices in Austin that provide outstanding care, bill accurately, and treat their patients with respect. Unfortunately, after almost a decade as a loyal patient, I will be going elsewhere and can no longer recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Wurst
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Maya, Dr. Daniels, and the entire team have provided exceptional service with a tailored experience. Everyone was friendly, knowledgeable, and flexible to my specific asks and needs.
I appreciate everyone, but especially Maya, for working with me and making me feel valued and heard. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Westlake Dermatology four times over the span of 4 months to treat warts on my hand. Unfortunately, despite no progress from the initial treatment, the same approach was repeated at each visit with no adjustments or alternative solutions offered. After 4 months of seeing no improvement, I decided to stop going. While the staff was professional, I was disappointed by the lack of effective treatment and a more adaptive approach to my condition. I would have appreciated more proactive care and a willingness to explore different options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Selina Soto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Saxton has helped my acne journey. My skin has completely transformed in the past 1-2 years. I can’t thank her enough. Katelynn (MA) is so sweet and kind. She is so helpful and gave me all the recommendations I needed for skincare products.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlin Callirgos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this location! I have tried many different offices for my Botox/ facials and this is by far my favorite. All of the staff is so kind and knowledgeable, my skin has truly never looked better!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katy Jacobs
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t recommend this place enough! I came in for acne treatment feeling very frustrated and down about my skin. My doctor came up with a treatment plan that was perfectly suited for me, and my skin is looking great after just a few months. Front desk staff is the best, Maya was extremely helpful with scheduling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holden Family
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been seeing Dr. Saxton for two years now and so has my husband. She’s very relatable and thorough. The facility is beautiful, like walking into a swanky hotel lobby. All the staff is friendly and beautiful! I enjoy coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this location! Friendly staff and welcoming environment. They’re always attentive and address any concerns. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MB Swatel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Saxton-Daniels had no bedside manner - she looked at my mom's burn injuries with disgust and barely explained her recommendations. She was cold and callous toward her in a very discriminatory way. We had to press over and over again to get a simple response. The nurses and front desk staff were very pleasant, but do not go here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelynn Harvey-campos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this place, both ladies at the front desk are so sweet and are such bright faces to be greeted by. If their faces weren't bright enough, this office is. The waiting room is cozy but the windows make it so welcoming. I never wait to long for them to call be to the back room.
I went in to get a mole checked and ultimately removed. Doctor Kollipara assured me that the procedure was very minor, as I have never had anything removed from my body. She made me feel comfortable and calm as she went through the procedure. I walked out of the office feeling better and brighter than I had when I walked in.  I have never had quite an enjoyable experience at a doctors office until now. Thank you Ladies for being so friendly and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dori Rizzo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nathan is an amazing surgeon! I love my results so far and I have had a great experience through Westlake Dermatology. I was very thorough in picking the surgeon I wanted to go through for my breast augmentation and I felt that Dr.Nathan was the best. Very thorough and he is an artist. I wouldn’t have wanted to go through anyone else. Great bed side manner and I felt comfortable as a younger patient. His nurses, Jess and Aubrey, are also amazing and made me feel very comfortable and were great communicators, pre and post op. The office staff was also great to work with and I especially enjoyed working with Hena and Reid! Overall, 10/10 experience. I would recommend Dr. Nathan and Westlake Dermatology to anyone looking for a trusted and thorough surgeon who produces amazing results! Will definitely continue getting services from them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moses Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff are truly amazing!  I have been seeing Dr. Kollipara which has been a great experience, especially with my stubborn skin conditions. She always has a back up plan and treatment options.

I decided to have a consultation with Dr. Nathan regarding some procedures I’ve been curious about. Wow!  He and the team were amazing!  They were realistic and detailed with the outcome. I look forward to my procedure soon

The location is beautiful in Highland Park!  I highly recommend anyone here for both dermatology, cosmetic and plastic surgery services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asgede stefanos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great spot...Kept things simple, smooth , and respectful... felt uncomfortable making the appt... it was the best decision I could've ever made to go there.  Made me feel like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Veatch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone on the staff is so friendly and welcoming! The PAs and assistants are all so kind, and everyone at the front is very helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: T D
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dermatologist (SAXTON) and staff (KATELYN) were extremely thorough, pleasant and very professional. The process was very quick and I recommend them 100%. I was in & out in 30 minutes. Call in advance to find the office within the big building

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie F
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely love the care I receive from Dr Kollipara - she really listens to what I want and is candid about what to expect - absolutely adore her and her professionalism.

The staff is so youthful and fun and so attentive - it is absolutely refreshing and huge shout out for Reid who is on top of my appointments and attention to detail and is amazing!!!

Love this office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. K is fantastic for all things medical and cosmetic. I have been a patient for about 6 months and happily recommend family and friends to Westlake Dermatology. I always leave satisfied, and we’ll educated. Staff is welcoming and professional. The office is absolutely gorgeous- and my insurance is accepted. I am very happy with WLD.

user_reviews_extended.Name: La B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a consultation with Dr. Stephanie Saxton-Daniels and she truly has no bedside manner. I had bad dandruff issues and she looked at it in a manner that made me never want to go back for any kind of services. She seemed annoyed at my questions. Did she prescribe something that worked? Yes. Will I go back? No, thank you. I’ll give my business to someone that is not awkward and bothered by my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Naomi Daniels
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got a peel done here and am very happy with the results! Staff is awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britt McQuire
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got both my filler and Botox done with Dr.Kollipara and she couldn’t have been more wonderful. Everyone there was knowledgeable about all of the products and procedures and answered all of my questions easily. The entire staff was kind and explained to me at length the procedures to make sure that I was comfortable. My results have been incredible and I am so happy with how my face looks and feels. I cannot recommend them enough, it was just a wonderful experience and I will definitely be returning for follow up appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Burkhart
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Dermatology has been amazing. The staff is so friendly and the services are extremely reasonably priced. I’ve worked with Michelle and she has been amazing for laser hair removal. Highly recommend this office for anyone looking for dermatology and laser hair removal services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alanna Cruciani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Spent 5 minutes with me and told me likely no bill charge as I confirmed before the appointment for an estimate. Got nearly $200 bill in the mail. To change the brand of prescription they said I have to come back in to be charged another $200. They were nice and office was nice but definitely could’ve done their due diligence to provide a more accurate quote. I also feel like they didn’t spend enough time actually reviewing to be able to properly diagnose.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at the office and with Dr Kollipara. She was very thorough in explaining the process, took before photos, and talked me through what fillers and botox I actually needed vs trying to sell me more than what was necessary! She made me feel confident about the things I was self conscious over and assured me that she could help keep things very natural, but could also deliver the results I was looking for! She set up a plan to help achieve my desired results and I'm excited to go back in 2 weeks for the filler portion of our plan! Everything about Dr Kollipara and the office was professional, friendly, and successful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Farhana Enam
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First time Botox or any treatment recipient!
I came here after being referred by a friend. I studied the reviews of a ton of practices in greater Dallas, Austin, and San Fran area before deciding on giving Westlake a chance.

Not only did they take the time to provide great hospitality, they even made sure to address patiently all my concerns and give me great before/after care to soothe my nerves. Dr. Kollipara in particular was so great! She answered all my concerns with patience and ample knowledge to subside and calm me. She walked me through the procedure and during the procedure was gentle and soothing since I do have a low pain tolerance.
I would recommend this place to any new and nervous first timers!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany
user_reviews_extended.Description: I need to warn others about getting Botox here. I got Botox two weeks ago with Kelly Aschenbeck. The botox was injected into my forehead and I think it was placed wrong. I wanted to lift my brows and now instead they’re sagging even worse than before I received the Botox. My eyes feel tiny and look extremely hooded, as well as heavier. I can tell that something was done incorrectly, because I had a slight lazy eye before getting Botox that was barely noticeable; it is now completely noticeable and looks worse. I now have to deal with looking like this until the Botox wears off, which is the complete opposite result of what I was trying to achieve. They did not schedule a follow up appointment with me, which is usually standard with Botox appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Michelle is the best! She is so thorough and makes sure you feel comfortable before proceeding with any procedures. I always leave feeling so much more confident!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Tucker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Dermatology-Dallas is amazing! The entire staff went above and beyond to make me feel welcomed and comforted. Dr. Kollipara even emailed me an article after my appointment that helped further explain questions I had. Nothing is better than feeling truly cared about by your doctors! Excited to keep coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra H
user_reviews_extended.Description: Pretentious rip off! Warning to all - if this is your new patient visit, you are limited to just ONE problem that the doctor is willing to address, with a limit of TEN minutes total. So if you have a total of two issues to address, as simple as they may be, you will need to book an additional appointment and pay an additional $60 (or however much they charge you). She refused to even listen to anything else.  It is absolutely ridiculous and I do not recommend this practice for that reason. This was listed no where on the new patient paperwork.  Shameful method of practicing medicine.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had the most amazing experience with Michelle @ Westlake she’s very knowledgeable and very helpful and was willing to listen to any concerns I may have - Taylor was a joy to check me in and give information about my visit. Both ladies were a pleasure to help me during my visit. I will definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina B.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly both doctors here are great and the team and staff is amazing and they make you feel so comfortable and really listen to your needs. Several times though, while booking through the online portal, I will get rescheduled numerous times. I came for a reschedule appointment and they got the date and time wrong. I know everyone has busy schedules but for this location to continuously reschedule and not keep the original online booked appt and then to mess up the rescheduled date is super frustrating. And when an appointment reschedule is incorrectly scheduled, there is no apology or attempt to squeeze you in even if it was their mistake. I have a busy schedule too. When you call to give feedback or to reschedule, you never get routed to the actual office location either so no one seems to take accountability. Feedback for this location: their online booking tool needs to be better and they need to stop rescheduling patients several times. It is not professional. I may start going elsewhere where I don’t get rescheduled every time. For the prices they charge, this westlake location should uphold professionalism and outstanding service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Stanton
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the most horrible consultation ever! From the introduction, I was made to feel descriminated against! The Dr didn't take me seriously to the point of forgetting to show me before and after pictures. I came into the office w cash in hand to reserve my upcoming appointment for a much needed Mommy make over transformation. From the moment the Dr walked into the room & realized my nationality etc, I guess she felt like I was waisting her Time. She did Everything in her power to discourage me from getting Lipo on more than one area.  I was initially excited & optimistic about the appointment & as soon as  the Dr began giving her consultation, she immediately began to attempt to discourage me about the procedure , going as far as to tell me that after liposuction  I wouldn't begin to notice Any results until after a year.  Not to mention she tried upselling me to a Tummy tuck , even though Im carry small & do not have loose skin.  After the financial coordinator entered the room, she did ABSOLUTELY NOTHING to save the sale. Instead she threw the Drs credentials back in my face & offered to see me to the door if I was no longer interested. In my opinion this office is nothing more than a chop shop itching for a law suit from a very dissatisfied customer in the future if you don't start to treat people like human being & quit prejudging people by what they're wearing or the color of their skin. user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Layne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Heed the bad reviews. This office will lie, and they will rip you off.

Here is what happened: During my first office visit (unrelated to this post) Dr. Kollipara told me she had several ideas regarding treatment of a skin condition around my eyes. It's not a crazy, rare issue. Just something that bothers me.

I took the day off of work and went in excited to hear what was possible. I was also cognizant of the reality of dealing with skin, you'll never have something perfect and my expectations for this appointment were not unrealistic. It was only during our meeting that I found out that Dr. Kollipara must have previously lied about possible treatments in an attempt to make me pay the fee of an office visit. When asked about the treatment plan she had previously mentioned, she SHRUGGED and said there wasn't anything she could do. This less than 1 minute into our conversation.

After being shrugged at by the professional I'd taken a day off to see. I was stressed and upset. This is about 2 minutes in. Seeing no willingness to add anything to the discussion other than a shrug, I told her about several laser treatments I had read about and was confused as to why she was now saying there wasn't anything she could do. Apparently, upon talking to the receptionist post meeting, her notes stated that SHE recommended laser treatments to ME. Ha!

The office charged my insurance and pretended this was a 15-29 minute MEDICAL consultation. I can assure you, it was not. I'm glad to know that my comments were worthy of a medical consultation, who knew you only needed 2 minutes and google to charge for a medical consultation.

Lies continued: The office assured me this was not the way they conducted business, I was told I would not have to pay the office visit fee as what I experienced was not a medical consultation. I have received 3 notifications to pay the bill since and I never heard back from the receptionist even though she assured me I would.

If you want a poor experience and bad results, you've found the right place. Good luck.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Paul Pin is a great doctor. I’m so happy I chose him to do my procedure. I would definitely recommend him to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Klare
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellence and respect for the Hippocratic Oath

In my mid-forties, I felt a need for an eyelid surgery. Until now, I have never had undergone any surgeries; my husband, who was born with cleft pallet and cleft lip, went through 21 reconstructive and plastic surgeries in his first 18 years of life – his experiences were a guide for us in choosing the right surgeon for me. In pre-screening, we relied on the D Magazine’s “Best Docs.”

Dr. Pin’s phenomenal career track record speaks for itself. His patients’ photos of before- and after-surgeries on his website were of great help to us. Also, openly disclosed charges for individual procedures were a straightforward approach we valued.

Our initial consultation reassured us that we didn’t need to look any further – Dr. Pin was to be my surgeon. It was an informative, straightforward meeting with realistic expectations presented. He never sells you on what else he can do for you; you decide what you want to be done and he tells you whether or not this is the right thing to pursue. Just ten days later, I had my surgery performed. Two months have passed since then – I love the results; I know why I look younger and more relaxed, others just notice that I look younger and more relaxed. So much so that my dermatologist (another “D’s Best Doc”) commented: “He (Dr. Pin) did an excellent job! One has to know what to look for (the cuts) and where to look to be able to even notice them (while my eyes are shut closed).”

The free-of-charge follow-up consultations only further demonstrated Dr. Pin’s commitment to excellence.
Having just had my last consultation, my husband and I talked about how much we would miss our conversations with Dr. Pin.

Dr. Pin’s office staff has been, equally, a pleasure to interact with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily R.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Pin performed my breast augmentation last October.  I just went to my last follow-up appointment today and conclusively, I have nothing but positive comments to voice about the entire process.

Dr. Pin was recommended to me by a friend who is a model.  I knew if she trusted him with her livelihood, he had to be one of the best. I consulted with several other surgeons before Dr. Pin.  By the time I left his office, I knew he was the one I was going to have do my operation.

He had exceptional bedside manner, yet was honest and blunt.  He told me what needed to be done, what my limitations were, listened to my concerns, and answered my many "worst-case scenario" questions.  I am a pharmacist and unfortunately, I fall into the obsessive, "over-educated" category of this profession.  That being said, I was incredibly paranoid about complications and being able to work as soon as possible and to full capacity.

The surgery went very well and I only had pain that warranted tears immediately after the procedure and pain requiring pain-killers for 3 to 4 days.   I took 6 days off from work following the surgery, which ended up being adequate.  The follow-ups over the next few months were easy to schedule with his friendly and accommodating staff.

I had no complications, despite all my worrying, and they look and feel incredibly real.  I went up 3 cup sizes and my silhouette now looks balanced, feminine, and  well-proportioned.  It may sound superficial, but this is the best purchase I have ever made.  I have absolutely no complaints and am incredibly grateful to him and his staff.  I would recommend Dr. Pin to any woman wanting a natural looking breast augmentation and/or lift!

Cannot say enough great things about my reconstruction experience performed by Dr. Paul Pin.

Wanted to streamline my appearance by tightening up my face and chin, which over the years had become somewhat “saggy.” Saw it as an investment, as in Corporate America, appearance matters! And, appearing to be old typically does not play to your favor and can impede your career prospects.

My wife, a medical professional, inquired across her network for recommendations for top Plastic Surgeons.  Dr. Pin name was mentioned consistently as one of the best.

Met with Dr. Pin for an initial consultation and found him to be pleasant, approachable and concerned.  Based upon his deep experience, he made a number of recommendations that made perfect sense. The cost too was much less than I had anticipated.

Worked with his office staff, who were incredibly helpful, to schedule the procedure.
After a day and a night in the hospital, the work was done, and I recovered at home for the next week, alert and fully productive. After a week-and-a-half, all had healed with no visible evidence of surgery.

The result is fantastic!  People comment that somehow I look different... more energetic, alert and younger. I’m now being asked to engage in more undertakings with my company.  A friend of my wife, a nurse, said it best when she said, “it took 15 years off!!”

Again, a fantastic experience, great Doctor and incredibly helpful staff.

For those people, men included, who do not plan to retire early, this is a must-do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Boehland
user_reviews_extended.Description:

I’ve had implants for 36 years and was ready to have them removed. I felt good about my decision, but was nervous with the outcome. Dr. Schwartz assured me my breast would look good.

I’m only 4 weeks out of surgery and I couldn’t be more pleased with the outcome. Also Dr. Schwartz doesn’t prescribe narcotics for pain for this surgery. He said they aren’t needed. I highly recommend Dr. Schwartz for your plastic surgery needs and would go back to him if I needed anything else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pati R
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I honestly can’t put into words how life-changing my tummy tuck and breast lift have been. After years of pregnancies and weight fluctuations, I didn’t recognize my body anymore. No matter how much I worked out or ate clean, I couldn’t fix the loose skin on my stomach or the sagging in my breasts. I finally decided to invest in myself — and it was the best decision I’ve ever made.
From the very first consultation, my surgeon Dr. Robert Schwartz made me feel comfortable, informed, and confident. Every question was answered patiently, and I never felt rushed or pressured. The day of surgery went smoothly, and the staff was incredibly supportive and attentive.
Recovery wasn’t effortless, but it was absolutely manageable — and so worth it. Within weeks, I could already see a dramatic difference. My stomach is now flat and tight, and my breasts look lifted, natural, and beautifully proportioned to my body. The scars are healing wonderfully and are much less noticeable than I expected.
But more than the physical transformation, it’s the emotional impact that truly surprised me. I feel confident in clothes again. I stand taller. I’m not constantly adjusting or hiding behind loose tops. Shopping is actually fun now! My self-esteem has improved in ways I didn’t anticipate.
If you’re on the fence about a tummy tuck and breast lift, my advice is to do your research and choose a qualified surgeon you trust — it makes all the difference. For me, this wasn’t about vanity. It was about feeling comfortable and confident in my own skin again.
I would 100% make this decision again

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my breast implants put in by another surgeon 20 years ago.
