After visiting with 3 different surgeons, I found Dr. Schwartz. He made me and my husband feel comfortable about the breast implant removal surgery. He told me that he thought I was going to be happy with my results. While I was still skeptical, because in my mind all I could think about was saggy breast and envision they would look like after surgery, I went ahead and scheduled my surgery 2 days after my consultation. Can I just tell you, Dr. Schwartz was RIGHT! They look so cute and so perfect to me. I don’t feel like I need a lift. They are not saggy like I had envisioned. They are perfect! After 20 years of having implants in, I am so thankful to have my implants out and I highly recommended trusting Dr.Schwartz and his team. He is precise, his nurses are so helpful, and I could not have asked for better results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lacey Jordan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Schwartz and his entire team. From start to finish, the experience has been intimate, supportive, and consistent with familiar, friendly faces at every visit. That kind of continuity speaks volumes about how much this practice values patient care and experience.

I had a breast reduction on one side and a lift on both. Before surgery, I was flooded with warnings from friends and social media horror stories, people saying the recovery would be unbearable and not worth it. I’d be lying if I said that didn’t make me nervous. But Dr. Schwartz and his team were incredibly open and reassuring, taking the time to talk through all of my concerns the day of surgery.

I’m here to say that my experience was the complete opposite of those scary stories. I had zero pain, just some soreness, mainly from the liposuction in my bra line (goodbye stubborn armpit fat!). When asked to rate my pain the day after surgery, I said a 3 but it truly wasn’t pain, more like the soreness you’d feel after an intense chest workout.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Schwartz to anyone considering a procedure to feel more confident in their body. I’m still in recovery and a bit swollen, but I can already tell my results are going to be near perfect. There’s still a slight size difference to maintain the natural shape, but if I ever decide to pursue augmentation, there’s no doubt in my mind Dr. Schwartz is the only one I’d trust to take care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I meant to post a review sooner as it has been a year since my breast reduction but as I’ve healed I am a little disappointed. My stitches had come undone, so staples had to go over my incisions, I went back a week after and we agreed to leave the staples in for another week, but no one called me in for that appointment and the staples just kind of fell out on their own but I didn’t hear from the office for anything after that I feel like they totally forgot about me. I went from a G to a DD, but now my breasts look the same as the did before with additional scarring and I feel my nipples are not evenly aligned. user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Krow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Could not be happier with the results and the entire experience! A friend recommended Dr. Schwartz as she also had amazing results and had nothing but great things to say about her experience. I had a breast augmentation about 12 years ago by a surgeon in Beverly Hills. I was happy with the results for most of the 12 years but recently felt they didn’t go with my body anymore and was more interested in a smaller bust as I’ve gotten older. I was leaning toward removing my implants completely but wasn’t sure if I would need to replace with a smaller implant for better results. I was a bit nervous for my consultation and was worried I would be pressured into going with replacing the implants.   The consultation went better than I thought! Dr. Schwartz completely supported my decision to have them removed and actually recommended against putting in a smaller implant. I felt completely confident in my decision after speaking Dr. Schwartz. He even said patients are often surprised at how good they look after removing the implants completely. He couldn’t have been more right. I thought I was happy with the results day 1 post-op. I recently had my 3 week follow up and I am completely blown away with my results. The surgical scars are healing perfectly and they look even better than when I originally had surgery 12 years ago because Dr. Schwartz used a type of suture technique that used only absorbable sutures internally so no more Frankenstein scars! The best plastic surgeon in my opinion! Also, his nurses were nothing short of amazing, kind and supportive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clare Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so pleased with the results of my breast augmentation performed by Dr. Schwartz. I was extremely nervous trusting the process of getting the results I wanted from choosing example pictures and speaking directly with Dr. Schwartz, but dang it if he didn’t NAIL IT. I would choose Dr. Schwartz over and over again, and I happily recommend him to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: emma calkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience being a patient of Dr. Schwartz has been nothing less than traumatizing. Went for a Breast augmentation and a mini lift. I knew from the beginning something was not right and I brought up my concerns. I was told constantly everything looks great this is normal etc. It was indeed not normal my nipple was completely separating from my breast tissue and sutures causing constant pain, oozing, and bleeding. There solution was me coming in twice a week to check on it, while feeding me multiple pain medications this went on for months. His then brilliant plan was to do another surgery I go in the morning his staff starts inducing me with drugs to begin surgery before he had even looked at my breast. After taking a look he then cancelled the procedure leaving me drugged up and sending me home. Not to mention  I was prescribed antibiotics even though they claimed my incisions had never been infected. After rounds of painkillers and antibiotics they then said that I was allergic to the sutures, this entire mess sent me on a hunt to find my consent forms to see exactly what was signed off on and to review my rights before taking legal action. When looking for them it came to my attention that they were deleted and I had zero access to them. This office has been a living hell to deal with, leading me to receive a second opinion considering my chest was still painful and oozing. The second opinion informed me that not only was the infection healing incorrectly, but my entire augmentation was done wrong with my nipples too high on my chest and uneven. Dr. Schwartz’s entire approach to this surgery has taken all my time, mental/physical energy, and left me in need of revisions to this day.
I wish anyone reading this review to take it and run away from this office. I do not and will never recommend this doctor or this practice to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: immapurplegirl
user_reviews_extended.Description:

The office was easy to find and not being familiar with this side of town that was a huge plus for me. I met both Melinda and Kara the morning of my consultation and was put very much at ease by the girls attitude and welcome spirit. Upon meeting Dr. Schwartz I knew I had found my surgeon. Both he and the girls were friendly enough that I was at ease and professional enough to gain my trust. My consultation was about an hour and a half long and I loved that every minute of that was spent WITH me. I wasn't stuck in a room waiting for him, and actually I haven't waited more than maybe 5 minutes at any of my appointments in this office. The consult was very informative and well explained. Dr. Schwartz took his time answering my questions and explaining not only my options but the procedure as well. Any questions I had were answered honestly and patiently. He never made me feel like I was wasting his time or that he had heard all of these questions before. In fact he made me feel like I was the only thing he was focused on which was very relaxing. I saw Dr. Schwartz for a breast augmentation but I also had questions about getting a lift. The moment he told me NOT to get a lift was the moment I fell in love with him. I felt like I could trust him. It was very reassuring to me that he wasn't just pushing me in the more expensive direction.

My pre-op, surgery and post-op have gone off without a hitch. Even when I've had a million questions Dr. Schwartz and his staff have been supportive and understanding. They have gone on this journey WITH me and not just pushed me on though to get to the next patient. Dr. Schwartz is an amazing surgeon and a good man. He has found a wonderful staff and I am so happy that I have had this experience with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schwartz is amazing! I love my results and couldn’t be happier. I love that he didn’t try to oversell me on anything. He made sure I was comfortable with everything, they are quick to respond to questions and always available. The staff and nurses are great as well! I have already sent several friends here and they are happy as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Keith

They came out even better than expected. The entire process was smooth and everyone in the office were very professional and informative. Thank you Dr. Schwartz and the team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Antle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I considered a few different surgeons for my breast augmentation, but Dr. Schwartz was amazing! user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Tucker

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tabitha S.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Boucher

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittney Hampel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional service! user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Willett
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the very beginning during the initial consultation, I've been nothing but comfortable and pleased with Dr. Schwartz and his team. user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Shepherd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have trusted Dr. Schwartz to care for me twice, after considering the procedure for several years before deciding to proceed. I'm very glad I trusted him to help me achieve what I was hoping for, because I got a great result and I can recommend him to others. user_reviews_extended.Name: Alaina S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schwartz is a very skilled surgeon who always puts your wants and concerns first. He made it happen and my results are amazing. I couldn't have asked for a better surgeon. I highly recommend this doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Missimo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Schwartz is absolutely amazing!! I have been to him 3 times for different procedures, and he has delivered fantastic results every time. If you're considering plastic surgery do not hesitate to make an appointment. Dr. Schwartz will not disappoint! He's a true artist with incredible bedside manner. Thank you Dr. Schwartz and entire staff.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Dr Schwartz yesterday for my very first in person plastics consult for a potential mommy makeover. user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Dr Schwartz a very anxious and shy person and from my first consult to my 6 month post-op check in, I have never felt so comfortable and confident under any other medical professional. I’m short and shaped a little oddly, and expressed concern with having the volume I wanted without looking like a caricature. Dr Schwartz took my “dream boobies” photos and translated them to suit my body better than I could have anticipated. I look so much more balanced and proportional without a bra on, and I have never felt so confident in my own skin and motivated to take care of my body. I feel like my true self and I am still in absolute love with my new breasts. The entire staff is really friendly and easy to talk to, the drive to surgery was more stressful than the actual procedure because they took such excellent care of me. I fit in my clothes so much better, I walk with more confidence at work, and my boyfriend has noticed improvements in my posture and the frequency in which I smile in the mirror. Thank you so much for blessing my life with newfound confidence and pride in my body. I never thought I’d feel this good about my body but I’m so glad I researched, found an incredible board certified surgeon and took the plunge. I wouldn’t change a thing about my experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Marie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't know where to start or how to say thank you to Dr. Schwartz and his amazing staff for all their support and care on my past visit. user_reviews_extended.Description: Robert Schwartz was one of the most knowledgeable doctors I talked to when trying to get consultation for my abdominalplasty, his consultation was so thorough giving every single detail about how he was going to do my surgery. I think he has one of the best practices in the DFW area and just his amount of knowledge and making sure you feel comfortable the entire way is amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nannette Preston
user_reviews_extended.Description: I live in the Dallas area and researched 5 drs. for breast augmentation.  Most were very nice, and had excellent presentations, including pictures of previous work.   Dr. Schwartz and his team are very different.  Not so much a sales presentation, but very professional, kind and friendly....., and a matter of fact demeanor.   So less of a sales pitch, and more of this is what I can do, and how I will do it. I’m so pleased 4 weeks out, and plan for him to do a facelift next.  He’s definitely a great plastic surgeon!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol CH
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended to Dr. Schwartz by a good friend.  She said he is very meticulous with his work and has an very good reputation.  I felt comfortable with Dr. Schwartz and Kara in the office and showed them 10+ photos of exactly what I wanted my breasts to look like.  He was very conscientious and honest with me.  I wanted more natural looking breasts, nothing fake or too obvious or perky, since I have a small framed body.  I wanted a "mommy makeover" after having three kids.  However, he honestly didn't think it was worth it to have a surgery scar for a tummy tuck, since I didn't have a significant amount of belly fat.   (I went to another plastic surgeon who was willing to do a full tummy tuck, without any questioning.)  Everything went smoothly-the office visits, surgery, and recovery.  At first I thought my breasts were large, but after a few days the the swelling went down considerably.  My breasts are now perfect in my eyes, my scars are small and not noticeable at all!  I went from an A to C and got high profile implants.  I actually don't need to wear a supportive underwire bra anymore or worry about what I look like in a low neckline shirt or dress.  I feel so fortunate that I chose Dr. Schwartz.  I think he really did an amazing job on my breasts and liposuction.  I just went to a wedding, and all my friends said I looked better than ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Chandler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've always had an AMAZING experience at Robert Schwartz Plastic Surgery and I would HIGHLY recommend them to anyone and everyone!

Let's start with Cristy which is who introduced me to Robert Schwartz Plastic Surgery. Cristy is a genius and just like Dr. Schwartz her meticulous attention to detail is exactly what you want, in your licensed medical professional. When I first started to see Cristy I immediately saw a difference in how I was treated as a patient. Instead of being rushed in and out like I had been at previous places, Cristy took her time to understand both my concerns, and what look I was going for. I've been seeing Cristy for over two years and each time I go she always ensures I'm happy with the results. Aside from filler Cristy has also taken care of my botox needs. I've had botox injected into my masseter to help my TMJ, my forehead, and I've had a brow lift! I've always had an amazing experience with Cristy and I'm just so impressed with how talented she is!

Now let me tell you about my experience with Dr. Robert Schwartz. Back in November 2019 I had a consultation with Dr. Schwartz and the second I left his office I knew I would pick him to perform my surgery. My consultation lasted over two hours, he went into detail about every step of the procedure, answered every single question I had, and made sure I fully knew what to expect before, during and after surgery. This really stood out to me since other consultations at best lasted 20 minutes. Not only was he wonderful and personable but Laura and Anna were both extremely sweet and helpful throughout the entire process! On January 17th I had my surgery I could not be happier with my results so far!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J C D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s a heavy and strange  thing, going through life with a congenital abnormality resulting in severe asymmetry. There’s a lot of effort one goes to in order to protect oneself. For years I refused to modify my body, dismissed the idea as shallow and inane.
And then it occurred to me how much energy it took to feel okay and that maybe all of that energy would be better spent elsewhere.
I hunted doctors far and wide for consult. Funny thing is, I found myself over and over doing the same thing: I was showing all these people the same pictures from Dr. Schwartz’s gallery as my dream result, but I never thought to meet with him, myself. It took me a while to get my priorities straight.
This is not the most economical plastic surgery clinic, this is a specialty practice with beautiful results done by a surgeon who is ethical, kind, knowledgeable and outrageously skilled.
I met with a lot of “boobsmiths” before I bit the bullet and scheduled my consult.  Dr. Schwartz is a different breed, an artist. You feel that difference in everything he does and says.
I am 5 days post op of a “hopeless” single surgery after 10+ other surgeons doomed me to multiple operations spread over months or years. My body looks beautiful to me for the first time in my life.
This is the real deal, the best Dallas has to offer, this coming from a person, deeply critical of plastic surgery writ large and with a seriously complicated case. I look and feel like a new human. The results are stunning. I cannot recommend this practice highly enough nor say enough about what this fraught experience meant to me. Thank you for changing my life and the way I see myself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorna Thorne
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you want a great surgeon, Dr. Schwartz might be your man, but I wouldn't know because he didn't do my surgery.  If you want a surgeon with INTEGRITY, Dr. Schwartz is NOT your man.  Before even discussing scheduling surgery, I put down a deposit of $3,000.  When I decided not to move forward (again, nothing had been even remotely scheduled), he agreed to return only half of my deposit ($1,500) and refused to return the entire amount.  I ended up taking him to court for the remaining $1,500 and court costs ($142) and the judge ruled in my favor.  ONLY because I took him to COURT did Dr. Schwartz finally return the remaining $1,500 but not the court costs of $142, even thought the judge ruled for the settlement to include court costs!  No bueno in my book.  I dodged a bullet here and will be going elsewhere for all my future cosmetic surgery needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stefani Webster
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love Dr Schwartz!
I’ve been a patient since 2007.  Great bedside manner. He really listens and comes up with a plan to get you to your desired aesthetic.

I recently received lip injections and got to meet Cristy who was so nice and a great lip injector. Every single lady within the practice greeted me with such kindness it definitely got me wanting to go back. A good practice is never the same without the right people. And this place has it all.

NOW When I take a deep breath I have very sharp pain deep in my breast that brings tears to my eyes...
I can not go without a BRA ever, even to sleep without extreme discomfort. I can NOT lie on my stomach or get a massage. I have NO Surface SENSATION IN MY LEFT nipple and BREAST, except for the sharp pains deep within. Both breast are dropping below the scar-line and are visibly deformed !!
I was once a CENTERFOLD with beautiful breast and because of DR SCHWARTZ I have been LIVING IN PAIN  AND HE WILL NOT FIX THE DAMAGES HE Created.

user_reviews.Name: Thomas Hendrick
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Azouz does outstanding revision work, especially for patients requiring upper limb prosthetics. His surgical results consistently support better prosthetic fit and long-term comfort. He is highly effective at identifying and treating neuromas, providing meaningful relief and improved function.

He is also excellent to work with in workers’ compensation cases — communication is clear, documentation is thorough, and the process moves efficiently. Dr. Azouz truly understands functional recovery and delivers results. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Description:

What truly sets him apart is his strong focus on DVT prevention and lymphedema care. His dedication to these areas shows his commitment to improving patient outcomes and preventing serious complications before they occur. It’s refreshing to work with a physician who is not only highly skilled, but also genuinely invested in long-term patient health.

user_reviews.Name: Aleia Mastroianni
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing experience with Dr. Azouz and his treatment of my lipedema condition.  I have completed the first surgery of the three or four that are needed.  My first surgery was liposuction of lipedema from my thighs to ankles.  Dr. Azouz did a great job of preparing me for the surgery and making me comfortable the day of the surgery.  I am very happy with my results and am looking forward to getting my remaining surgeries completed in the next 12 months. Lipedema surgery is no joke!  The surgery is high volume, higher risk than typical liposuction, and requires critical post-op care. The surgery also requires a great deal of expertise and physical stamina from the surgeon. I am so glad I had Dr. Azouz as my doctor and knew that he would see me safely through this process.  I am also grateful to Nurse Cassandra and the whole team who supported me.  I am especially grateful to Dr. Azouz and the office staff for working with me, for nearly a year, to get approval from my insurance company for this surgery.  They continued to fight for me and do all the back-and-forth with my insurance company, even when it seemed like all was lost.  I appreciate the Dr. Azouz continued to advocate for me and that he is still willing to accept insurance, even when many doctors and plastic surgeons have switched over to "private pay only".  Dr. Azouz remains committed to the women who suffer from this condition and believes that medical access should be available to everyone.  Thank you so much Dr. Azouz!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Kara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Disappointing Physician-to-Physician Interaction — Arrogant and Unprofessional

I scheduled an appointment with Dr. Solomon Azouz after he responded to my inquiry on a physician community messenger regarding treatment for a recurrent right ankle cyst. He indicated that it was within his scope and shared his office information for scheduling. I replied with my contact details in case further coordination was needed, but received no follow-up communication.

When I called to schedule the appointment, I offered my insurance information, which was declined over the phone. I asked again during the appointment reminder call and was told to bring it on the day of the visit. After driving a considerable distance, I faced immediate administrative challenges: I emailed my insurance information twice to registration, but they claimed they couldn’t access either message.

While waiting, I overheard Dr. Azouz remark, “I don’t know who she is—of course she has to pay for the consultation.” I approached him and reminded him of our prior exchange. His response was dismissive and unprofessional: “We don’t accept insurance. You’ll need to pay for the consultation.” This was never disclosed during any of our prior communication.

When he reiterated that payment was required, I prepared to leave. At that point, he said, “Well, since you’ve driven all the way here, let me at least take a look out of courtesy and give you my opinion.” While I appreciated the gesture, it wasn’t necessary—I was already familiar with the diagnosis and the next steps. It felt more like a half-hearted attempt to compensate for his earlier lack of empathy and professionalism than a genuine offer of help.

His demeanor throughout the interaction was arrogant and condescending. At one point, a third staff member had to step in to diffuse the tension after I stated I no longer wished to be examined. When I said I would be leaving a review of my experience, Dr. Azouz responded that I couldn't do that—and insisted he would write one against me.

If this is the way fellow physicians are treated, I truly worry about the experience of everyday patients. Transparency, respect, and professionalism were sorely lacking. Just laying this out in the open—there are plenty of superior plastic surgeons out there.

This was no run-of-the-mill puffiness either; it was the kind that gnaws away at your confidence and makes you question every fitted shirt you own.

From the moment I met Dr. Azouz  I could tell this guy was on a different level. He didn’t just nod along and give me some basic plan – he dissected every detail with surgical precision, literally and figuratively. When I mentioned my concern about scar tissue (something that’s plagued others post-op), he cut me off mid-sentence, already ready with a customized game plan. This guy doesn’t just cut out tissue; he crafts his work like an artist, knowing exactly how to avoid every side effect that harsher treatments would have dropped on me like a bad habit.

Dr. Azouz was nothing short of surgical perfection. Not only did he remove every last trace of gyno, but he left me looking like puberty never happened at all. There was no unnecessary pain, no post-op horror show, no Frankenstein-esque scarring. The man left me so smooth I could give a marble statue a run for its money. And that’s saying something for a chest that once looked like it was stuck somewhere between adolescence and sheer betrayal.

If you’re looking for a doctor who’ll not only rid you of gyno but will leave you feeling like you somehow leveled up in life, Dr. Azouz is your guy. This isn’t just surgery; this is a life upgrade with someone who genuinely cares about the long-term results, not just getting you in and out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Rosson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife's review of Dr. Azouz:

Dr. Azouz is a gifted surgeon who has succeeded where numerous others have failed and enabled me to live my life without constant pain.

I'm a healthy, young marathon runner, so when I started to have significant pain in my upper thigh that kept me from running, I was highly concerned. I visited 2 orthopedic surgeons, both of whom said imaging was clear and that they couldn't find anything wrong with me. They both referred me to physical therapy where I wasted months of my time and thousands of dollars and saw no improvement. Finally, someone suggested that I should see someone in a different surgical specialty, so I reluctantly went to Dr. Azouz, wondering what a plastic surgeon could possibly to help. Within a few minutes of his first examination, he said he felt a mass in my thigh he wanted to remove. We were a bit incredulous that he could find something in 2 minutes that numerous surgeouns hadn't found over the course of a dozen visits, but we agreed to move forward. The following morning he removed from my thigh a fibrotic lymph node which had been pressing on a nerve, and I was running pain-free several weeks later. I was shocked that the other surgeons who specialize in that area of the body could not have figured this out.

About a year later I started having knee pain. I looked for the best knee surgeons I could find and tried everything from cortisone shots to physical therapy. Nothing helped, so eventually one of the orthopedic surgeons concluded I had plica syndrome and performed an arthroscopic surgery. However, even after surgery, the pain continued to increase in severity and became chronic over the course of 10 months; it would keep me up at night and was literally ruining my life. Post-operative imaging looked clean and multiple orthopedic surgeons -- the best I could find in Dallas at multiple top-rated clinics -- agreed that I should just wait it out and it would eventually get better, but it never did. Finally, with nowhere else to turn, I went back to Dr. Azouz hoping for another miracle cure. After a couple visits, he felt reasonably confident that the lump that had developed over the arthroscopic entry points should be removed. In the surgery that followed, he removed a significant amount of scar tissue, and also repaired a hernia he found on the tendon. Once the surgery healed, the chronic pain was gone yet again!

Each time I went to Dr. Azouz was a Hail Mary attempt at fixing something nobody else could fix. He initially just wanted to take a look and hadn't even planned on doing surgeries for either of them, but upon examination correctly concluded that surgeries were necessary. This whole situation brings to mind the old adage that "when you're a hammer, everything looks like a nail." All these other surgeons were so focused on the specific types of issues and surgeries they're used to that they missed what was right under their noses. Dr. Azouz, on the other hand, looked holistically at the person and the problem from all angles before he decided on an approach. His methodical, caring approach is what made all the difference in my outcomes.

I cannot recommend Dr. Azouz highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abiyya Munir
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The front desk at the Azouz clinic completely wasted my entire morning and dragged me into a consultation I explicitly tried to avoid. I even mentioned I’m asking for this specific doctor, but was switched in the practice upon entering.

I drove 35 minutes each way, rearranged my day last minute, and showed up within 1.5 hours of calling, which yes, I appreciate they were able to accommodate. But that doesn’t excuse the fact that they couldn’t answer a very simple, very direct question.

I clearly explained over the phone that I needed to know whether it made sense to bring my 5-year-old in 48 hours after stitches for a possible revision. That was the entire point of my call. Instead of answering it, they pushed me into coming in. I even told them we just flew back in the states, I have both my kids with no childcare lined up, and want to avoid an unnecessary visit.

I show up, walk 2 football fields to Building C with two already jet-lagged kids, pay out-of-network for a consult because they don’t take insurance, only for the doctor that we did see at the Azouz clinic to look for about five seconds and say blanket statement: “We don’t do revisions until 6 months to a year.” Not only that - I actually should’ve booked for the FOLLOWING WEEK to actually remove the stitches. So now I need to redo this ALL OVER AGAIN in 7 days.

That is EXACTLY what I was trying to confirm before coming in.

This was not a complex medical judgment call. This was a basic scheduling and expectation question that the front desk should have handled without sending a patient on a completely unnecessary visit.

Instead, I was inconvenienced, overcharged, and put through a chaotic morning with two young children to no benefit.

If your front desk cannot handle simple, practical questions and instead defaults to pulling people in for billable visits, that is not just inefficient, it’s inconsiderate.

title: North Texas Plastic Surgery
address: 8201 Preston Rd #160, Dallas, TX 75225, United States

user_reviews.Name: Morgan Scott
user_reviews.Description:
I went to Sydni for my first facial (ever!) and was honestly a little nervous since I had never had one before. She made the entire experience so comfortable and explained every step of the process, which really helped me relax and feel confident in what she was recommending. Now I absolutely love getting them!

I also have very sensitive skin, so I’m always cautious about trying new products or treatments. She did an amazing job recommending products that work perfectly for my skin, and I absolutely love them! Game changer! This place is a must and I highly recommend Sydni! Feels like visiting a friend :)

user_reviews.Name: Esthetics by Elle
user_reviews.Description:
I had an exceptional experience with Sydni. She is incredibly knowledgeable, attentive, and truly dedicated to her craft. From the moment I walked in, she made me feel comfortable and thoroughly explained each step of my treatment, ensuring I understood what to expect and that my goals were her priority.

Her professionalism and attention to detail are outstanding—she listens carefully, customizes treatments based on your needs, and delivers results that genuinely exceed expectations. You can tell she cares deeply about patient safety, satisfaction, and long-term skin health.

If you’re looking for a medical aesthetician who goes above and beyond, Sydni is absolutely the one. I can’t recommend her enough.

user_reviews.Name: Danielle Nicotra
user_reviews.Description:
Sydni is truly exceptional. From the moment you walk into her room, she creates such a calming, welcoming atmosphere. She explains every treatment thoroughly, answers questions with so much knowledge, and always makes sure you feel comfortable and cared for. Her technique is gentle yet effective, and she personalizes each service to exactly what your skin needs.

My skin has improved so much under her care, and I always leave feeling refreshed, confident, and genuinely looked after. Sydni is the kind of aesthetician who goes above and beyond every single time. Highly, highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Karina
user_reviews.Description: I had such an amazing experience with Sydni! She is incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and made me feel completely comfortable throughout my appointment. She explained everything clearly and made the entire process feel easy and stress-free. You can tell she truly cares about her clients and their results. I couldn’t recommend her enough!!

user_reviews.Name: Victoria Yang
user_reviews.Description:
I absolutely love Brittney for injectables and Sydni for facials and at-home skin maintenance.

Brittney is everything I look for in an injector. She’s encouraging, truly listens to my needs and goals, and never sells me on anything that wouldn’t genuinely benefit me. Best injector in the area!!

Sydni is my go to for all things facials. She’s incredibly knowledgeable about skin maintenance, which is so important when getting injectables, and she has helped me curate the perfect facial and at-home care plan. I struggle with hyperpigmentation, and she always knows exactly what my skin needs.

I can’t thank you ladies enough!

user_reviews.Name: Tara Gant Rosado
user_reviews.Description:
I had an exceptional experience with Dr. Bond and the entire team at NTPS. I underwent a breast lift NO implants along with Lipo 360 and arm liposuction, and I am loving my results. Boobies are perfection! Exactly what I was hoping for. Dr. Bond is personable, attentive, and knowledgeable. I especially appreciated his honesty and the fact that he never came across as a “salesman” which I have felt during consults with other practices. He took the time to answer all questions and made me feel confident and comfortable moving forward with surgery.

The entire office staff was professional and attentive, from the initial consultation through my post-op visits. Response times were super fast - which is so appreciated. Every interaction was positive, and I felt well cared for. On surgery day the pre and post op nurses, as well as the CRNA, were also outstanding, reassuring, and skilled.

Overall, this was one of the best medical experiences I’ve had, and I highly recommend Dr. Bond and NTPS to anyone considering plastic surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Charleigh Stalford
user_reviews.Description: If you're looking for an aesthetician... Sydni is the absolute best in Dallas. My facials are always incredible and I leave feeling refreshed and taken care of. I’m booked for a Halo treatment in a few weeks and can’t wait — I was honestly nervous, but she has made me feel so comfortable and eased all my nerves. She also recommends the perfect products for my skin. I am so thankful to have found her.  Highly highly recommend Sydni and NTPS!!

user_reviews.Name: Tania Palacios
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had a tummy tuck, liposuction, and fat transfer with Dr. Mani, and I could not be happier with my entire experience! From the first consultation to every post-op visit, Dr. Mani was knowledgeable, reassuring, and truly skilled. He explained everything clearly, answered all my questions, and made sure I felt confident and comfortable every step of the way.
The results are amazing, even better than I imagined. I also have to give so much credit to his wonderful staff. Everyone was warm, and professional, and incredibly supportive throughout my journey. And a special shoutout to Jada, who took such good care of me! She was patient, kind, and went the extra mile to make sure I felt comfortable.
If you're considering any cosmetic procedure, I highly recommend Dr. Many and his team. They gave me not only outstanding results but also exceptional care from start to finish!

I never feel rushed or pressured — they’re thoughtful, honest, and never pushy about products or procedures. Every visit feels more like catching up with a friend than an appointment, which makes the entire experience so comfortable and enjoyable. I trust them completely and always leave feeling confident, refreshed, and well cared for.

Highly recommend both of them. 🤍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Townsend
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with NTPS has been amazing. I have used their services for weight loss, a mommy makeover, and med spa. Most recently I have had Botox, Sculptra, and my lips done. Brittany is amazing at knowing where, and how much, to put in. I highly recommend booking an appointment with her. The rest of the staff at the Dallas office are the greatest people and really care about all the patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Sterling
user_reviews_extended.Description: This survey is long overdue. I went to see Dr. Mani for a reconstruction because one of my implants had leaked. I was very pleased with the outcome although I must let you know at first after the surgery I felt like they were not equal in size a year has passed and I must say I am very very pleased with the care I received and also Renata was very understanding about my concerns as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alison Gilcrease
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sydni is not only my skins bestie but also my safe place. I absolutely love getting to see her and she genuinely just makes me feel so dang special!! Me and my skin are so grateful to her:’)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randa Brooke Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brittney does an amazing job with everything I have asked her to do! From tox, to filler and sculptra, she has made me look better than I ever have before. I completely trust all of her recommendations and she has never lead me in the wrong direction. Highly recommended her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Potter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Brittney Anderson at the Dallas location for lip filler, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. I’ve had filler before, but it had been at least five years since my last treatment. I found Brittney through online reviews and TikTok recommendations - and they were absolutely right! She did an incredible job, took the time to understand my goals, and made sure my expectations matched what was realistically achievable. It’s been a couple of weeks now, and I am so thrilled with how my lips look. Thank you, Brittney! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: All four of the staff I encountered were very welcoming, professional and knowledgeable.  I felt right at easy with the, front desk receptionist, nurse, Dr Kelly and Kate, the patient coordinator.  I scheduled right away after already seeing 2 others Doctors in advance, as I was this comfortable with my decision.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience so far.  Being 5-6 hours away from the clinic, I have had all communication either by phone, email, or Zoom.  Every person I have had contact with has been very knowledgeable and patient with my many questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Vest
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brittney Roth is simply the best & I have been going to her for years. I have referred her to multiple people and trust her completely. She has an eye for keeping you looking youthful, healthy and beautiful!! ♥️♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
🌟🌟🌟🌟DR. KELLY IS THE BEST!!!!!!!! I am absolutely amazed. He has exceeded my expectations. I am 6 days post op and his craftsmanship reminds me of what everyone says about Dr. Anderson and Obaid. I feel so humbled and privileged that I got him to be my surgeon. I won’t be surprised that Dr. Kelly gets booked quickly. He was so incredibly kind and attentive and comfortable. I can tell he is a perfectionist. I never expected to be so in love with my body. His incisions are so small. He and his team made sure to make me feel as comfortable as they could. They made sure to let me know to ask any and all questions that I had.

I also so appreciated Dr. Kelly because I was previously scheduled with another doctor and he canceled me 2 weeks prior to surgery with no explanation. It was very heavy on me and very inconvenient and inconsiderate and made me cry.
But Dr. Kelly and his team spent a whole weekend moving things around to accommodate me. I’m beyond thankful
that everything worked out for me to use him. He was going above and beyond and that meant everything to me. He was able to do that before my surgery and he has kept that same standard even after.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paige Trevinmo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kate is my personal “concierge “ and she is amazing! Dr Mani is super knowledgeable and kind. So far so good!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in today for a consultation, and from the front desk to the nurse, surgeon, and accountant, the customer service was outstanding.

Surgery can be confusing, but the nurse and surgeon took the time to clearly explain everything that will happen before, during, and after the procedure. I asked a lot of questions, and they answered each one thoroughly and in a way I could easily understand.

Their patience and clarity really helped me build trust and confidence in moving forward with the surgery. Thank you all and see you soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Payne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Go see Sydni as your Esthetician!!! I’ve been seeing her for years now and my skin has never looked better. I never even know what to do to my skin I just let her do what my skin needs & she always just such a great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rhonda spitzer
user_reviews_extended.Description: From consult to post op , Dr.Bond has been amazing! He takes time to answer all my questions, explained procedures, what I could expect for outcomes , and my results are better than I could have dreamed of, his work is immaculate . His team is responsive and helpful, I am a proud patient and highly recommend !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kelly is so easy to talk to! His nurse was amazing and made me feel so comfortable. Kate is great! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Stepp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Received a few treatments from Brittney (PRP, Botox, and Radiesse). Struggling with the aging process like most middle aged adults. She helped me with hollowing cheeks and those dreaded bags under eyes. Look healthier, more youthful and less skeletal : ). She’s wonderful and very kind. Plus gentle on those of us who hate needles!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benz Benz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my breast Aug with dr. Bosworth he has been amazing throughout the entire process, surgery was great and I got exactly what I wanted. Amazing staff and experience would HIGHLY recommend to anyone looking to do any plastic surgery

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brittney is the best! So sweet and knowledgeable. Amazing results every time. The only person I trust for my Botox 💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gena Metzger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brittney is the BEST!  I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my face other than her. I like a natural look and she delivers every time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Haynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this location! Sydni is so knowledgeable and personable. I look forward to my HydraFacial treatment every month! And Britt does a great job with my Botox

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aubrey Lovelace
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love seeing Sydni for all my skin needs, she’s helped me so much with my treatments and my at home regimen!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lacy Tewksbury
user_reviews_extended.Description: My consultation with Sarah was fantastic and she gave me such great information!  She really listened to my end goals and made excellent suggestions!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilly Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff organization, professionalism, and kindness has been great since I’ve been considering NTPS for my BA. All doctors I have had consults with have been thorough, knowledgeable, and have taken the time to answer all my questions. Now it’s just on me to commit, but I have felt taken care of by NTPS since my first interaction. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Lackey
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel comfortable and welcome. Dr. Obaid was incredibly kind and patient, taking time to answer all of my questions without ever making me feel rushed. His nurse and coordinator were just as helpful, carefully going over pre- and post-op instructions so I knew exactly what to expect. The whole experience was smooth, supportive, and professional from start to finish. I couldn’t be happier with the care I received and highly recommend Dr. Obaid and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary-Grace Nwokonko
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mani did my breast augmentation with a lift, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! He was professional, honest, and made me feel comfortable from the start. He really listened to what I wanted and delivered results that look natural, feminine, and beautifully balanced. His team was also super supportive and responsive throughout the process. I highly recommend Dr. Mani, he’s truly talented at what he does. If you’re ever looking for a nurse to work for you I’m always interested:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Kate
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience at North Texas Plastic Surgery! I recently got Botox here, and the results look absolutely incredible—so natural and refreshed. The staff was welcoming and professional, and they took the time to explain everything and make me feel completely comfortable. The injector was skilled and precise, and I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out.
If you’re considering Botox or any aesthetic treatment, I highly recommend North Texas Plastic Surgery. I’ll definitely be coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariel Causey
user_reviews_extended.Description: From start to finish, I had the best experience with Dr. Mani and his staff! They were kind, funny, and attentive to all of my questions and needs. They were easy to communicate with and quick to respond to any questions or concerns I had. I had an extended tummy tuck, lipo 360 and a breast lift with augmentation. As a mom of 3, I was struggling with self confidence and loving my body. I was in love with my results immediately even through the swelling from the surgery. The staff at the surgical center was kind and took great care of me. Dr. Mani spent ample time with me before surgery telling me what all would be done and made sure I was good to go and had no questions before leaving the surgical center. I have been nothing but pleased with the outcome of this decision. I could not recommend a better surgeon or staff. They were absolutely the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: My consultation experience with Dr Anderson and his team has been amazing. I did a lot of research and read many reviews. He and his staff were very thorough. They all took the time to answer questions and explain the process. I’m an out of town patient so a thorough virtual consultation was key to making the trip for an in person meeting and surgery. I felt extremely comfortable with Dr Anderson. His skill is top notch and I appreciated his recommendations. The 3D visual he shared of my transformation really helped to visualize what the outcome will look like. Overall experience was exceptional! Dr Anderson is the surgeon I am choosing moving forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tamera Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great consultation!! Staff is very knowledgeable and Dr. Kelly took time to answer all my questions. Booked the surgery!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chanin Kelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sydni was so friendly and comforting. She explained everything as she worked and told me what to expect after treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janie Rojas
user_reviews_extended.Description: The wonderful ladies at North Texas Plastic Surgery are always amazing! No matter what procedure you get, they always, and I mean always leave you feeling well cared for. Sydni has been helping me with a Halo laser procedure and as uncomfortable as it can be she provides top notch service so you barely notice any discomfort!  I didn't realize that they also offer Prf injections, which i have been researching as my next procedure. Since I drive in from 2 hours away for my appointment, Sydni quickly accommodated me with a quick consultation with Barbara! Both are very sweet and knowledgeable in their field. They also offer many package deals to help ease any financial concerns. I can't wait to try out more procedures. It feels great to be taken care of!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terri Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in for a consult to have an arm lift done. Everyone was very professional.
Consultation went great!  I scheduled to have the surgery done

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Velasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all the welcoming first conversation set the tone for everything that followed.  I reached out and got top tier treatment from day one.  I got all my questions answered and loved my consultation and even after my concerns were quickly addressed.  Very quick to respond, friendly, affordable, trustworthy and amazing 🤩 10/10 five stars.  I can’t wait to get my second breast implant surgery with them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melisa Franklin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Both Lauren and Dr. Carlson were very polite. Wonderful bedside manner, answered questions I didn’t even think to ask. Both made me feel extremely comfortable and I didn’t feel like I was being judged. I’m usually an EXTREMELY self conscious person so sending pictures of myself gave me a lot of anxiety knowing others were seeing the main thing I am most uncomfortable with about my body. I am so glad the consultation is over, I got to put faces to names and they made me feel the most comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cyndy Allert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love, love, love this office staff and doctor! I felt very welcomed when I walked in. Dr. Obaid made me feel so comfortable when letting me know about my procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came for a consultation on the recommendation of a friend. To start, the suite is lovely and the woman at the front desk was warm and welcoming. I met with Dr. Bosworth about my desired procedure and outcome after chatting with one of the nurses first. Both of them were wonderful. We went over my area of concern with great detail, they made sure I had all the information and answered every question I had. The 3D images gave me the ability to see real expectations of my final results, and honestly, it made it all real and tangible. Anna, who works alongside Dr. Bosworth to answer more questions, go over costs, and scheduling was very kind and helpful as well. I look forward to moving forward with this procedure and the team. I highly recommend coming here, and I would come again for any future procedures I may want or need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danyel Wiley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I met with Dr.Mani and Ashley for a consultation. I couldn’t have had a better experience. The receptionist was so very nice. Dr. Mani and Ashley answered all of my questions and explained the process from beginning to end. The office was very clean and inviting. I would definitely recommend NTPS for any of your cosmetic needs

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing facial with Sydni, she customized every aspect to address all my skin concerns and always makes me feel so pampered and relaxed. Sydni is the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: samantha hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I first heard about North Texas Plastic Surgery Med Spa on instagram and decided to book with Barbara and I could not be happier about my decision! user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Gunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s only been a few days since my breast augmentation at NTPS with Dr. Obaid. The entire process, from initial consult to the days post surgery, have been exceptionally wonderful. Their staff is unparalleled. Each person I’ve come into contact with at NTPS has been kind, professional, encouraging, informative, compassionate.. I could go on and on. At my initial consult I was given all the info I needed, she made sure every single question was answered. I was able to try on different size implants, and even see a 3D image of what the surgery would look like! Because of the time she spent making sure I loved the final size I chose, I was able to go into my surgery with full confidence & having a clear idea of what my breast would look like. I was also a special case because my chest walls/chest sternum were so misshapen. So having breast implants put in, my chest now looks more than just “normal”, it looks AMAZING! The day of surgery, I was made to feel so at ease. They really took care of me as if I was a dear friend or part of their family. Dr. Obaid went over my surgery before I entered the OR, he answered all my questions and got me so excited to “get this party started!”. :) I can’t leave out the anesthesiologist.. wow, what an amazing and friendly man. He could tell I was a bit nervous, and took care of that immediately by giving me medicine in my IV that instantly relaxed me. I was even able to watch my favorite show during the short wait to enter the OR. They just really cater to you 24/7. I have researched many surgeons and I can promise you I will recommend Dr. Obaid anytime and every time. I was treated with upmost respect and kindness. I felt wonderful leaving every appointment. It’s only day 3 and I am IN LOVE with my new breast. The healing process has been practically painless. I was even given Dr. Obaid’s and Melissa’s numbers to ask them any questions at any tine. And they’ve answered them all promptly. I could just go on and on about how wonderful this experience has been. If you’re considering a BA, I strongly encourage going to North Texas Plastic Surgery. I absolutely know any future cosmetic procedures I have, I will be returning to this awesome team of professionals! Thanks so much to NTPS, you truly have changed my life!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Niiyama
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Doctor Obaid is an expert in his own right.  I have had the pleasure of meeting him and his staff over a year ago.  I have continued with various inquiries and procedures - all of which leave me extremely satisfied.  I have met with other plastic surgeon’s over the years and while I have felt comfortable - Doctor Obaid goes over and above with his patients.  He truly cares and wants the best for you.  He also has surrounded himself with a top-notch team.  His staff continues with the caring and delivers every time.  I love them all and trust them implicitly.  North Texas Plastic Surgery is where you need to go if you are considering any procedures.

As for me, I had previously had a tummy tuck after my 2nd child and after 10 years became pregnant with twins.  It was after this that I decided to meet with Doctor Obaid to discuss my options.  I didn’t know if I could do it again or what to do.  Doctor Obaid took the time to walk me through my options.  Of course after breast feeding 4 kids I decided to ask him about improving my sagging breasts.  Doctor Obaid and his staff helped me with providing me very useful information.  They also never tried to “sell” me - it was delivered as information with care for me and my well being.  I decided to proceed with a tummy tuck (update) and breast augmentation.  My procedure was in June 2018 and I am so happy with the results.

I should also share that I decided to ask Doctor Obaid about my nose as it was collapsing and I wanted to know my options.  Again,. Doctor Obaid provided me with information and helped me see that I had a serious situation and had options.  I had been advised by other doctors to have it fixed however it wasn’t until recently that I realized how serious my situation was.  In the end I decided to proceed and at the same time asked if I could increase my breast size (since I was already loving them - why not ).  Doctor Obaid and his staff again delivered on their commitment.  My surgery was in March 2019 and the results are off the chart!  My breathing has improved 80% thanks to  Dorctor Obaid’s expertise and skills. Recovery was exactly as described - not bad at all.  In the end - I LOVE the results.

I continue to visit Doctor Obaid and his phenomenal team for minor items and continued perks to look and feel wonderful every day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hallie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Mani did an horrible job on my friend’s rhinoplasty. The most disgusting thing is he didn’t even take accountability for it and the practice is trying to push down our reviews with “positive ones” just so people won’t see it.

My friend’s nose looks NOTHING like she asked for. Not even a little bit. It looks the exact same as she had it prior to the surgery, it’s just that the nose is way bigger and wider. Like how do you even manage to make a nose look that bad and on top of that, he didn’t even give her a nose she wanted, he gave her a nose that HE thought would look best on her.

Most important! She can’t even breathe properly! She had a deviated septum that he did NOT FIX. She’s been having an hard time breathing.

It looks like he mainly does breast augmentation and I see why. This surgeon should not be allowed to do any rhinoplasties or any surgery in that matter.

Do NOT go to Dr. Mani for any rhinoplasties bc he WILL mess it up tremendously!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rochelle York
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m writing this on behalf of my friend because I’ve been with her through her rhinoplasty journey with Dr. Mani and have seen her experience firsthand.

Before surgery, she had a consultation where she clearly communicated wanting a narrower nose, smaller tip, reduced dorsal hump, and most importantly narrower nostrils.

She is now about 10.5 weeks post-op and, from what I’ve seen, the changes are very minimal. The main visible difference is that her dorsal hump is gone, but overall her nose still looks very similar in width, especially around the bridge and nostrils. Even when comparing before and after photos, the nostril width looks essentially unchanged.

I’ve also noticed that she has been really unhappy with her results since the cast came off. At first it seemed okay due to swelling, but as time passed she felt like her nose didn’t reflect what she expected or what was discussed. The tip also looks more pointed than before, which she doesn’t like.

She also mentioned concerns about follow-up care, including having to bring up taping herself despite having thicker skin, and feeling like guidance after cast removal wasn’t very proactive.

On top of that, there are visible signs of healing like scarring and discoloration that have added to her frustration.

She paid around $11K for the procedure and, from both her perspective and mine as someone close to her, she feels disappointed with the outcome and wishes she had had a different result or more alignment with what was originally discussed.

I’m sharing this because I think people should hear real experiences when considering something as big as a rhinoplasty with Dr. Mani.

title: Dr. Rai: Cosmetic Surgical Center
address: 7777 Forest Ln C612, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

user_reviews.Name: Kristen Berry
user_reviews.Description:
I had my explant surgery with Dr. Rai on January 29, and I truly could not be more pleased with my experience. From my very first appointment through my one-month follow-up today, he has been exceptional in every way.

Dr. Rai is incredibly kind, compassionate, and smart. He took the time to answer every single one of my questions — and then some — in depth. I never once felt rushed or dismissed. He made sure I fully understood the procedure, recovery process, and what to expect at every stage.

What stood out to me the most was how personally invested he is in his patients. He called me himself multiple times to check on me after surgery, which meant so much. On the day of surgery, he even held my hand in the operating room while waiting for the anesthesia to kick in. That level of care and reassurance is something I will never forget.

At my one-month follow-up, I’m healing beautifully and couldn’t be happier with my results. I am so grateful I chose Dr. Rai and would recommend him without hesitation to anyone considering explant surgery.

user_reviews.Name: Tammy Sharp
user_reviews.Description:
I recently underwent surgery with Dr. Rai, and the entire experience exceeded every expectation I had. From the first consultation through post‑operative care, Dr. Rai demonstrated exceptional skill, professionalism, and genuine compassion.

On the day of surgery, I was understandably anxious, but Dr. Rai took the time to speak with me calmly and reassure me before we went into the operating room. What stood out most was the kindness shown in those final moments before anesthesia—Dr. Rai held my hand and stayed with me until I was fully under. That simple gesture meant more than I can express. It showed not only confidence in their work but also a deep understanding of what patients need emotionally during such a vulnerable time.

The surgery itself went smoothly, and my recovery has been exactly as Dr. Rai explained. Their follow‑up care has been thorough, attentive, and patient‑centered. I never felt rushed, and every question I had was answered clearly.

I am incredibly grateful for the level of care I received. Dr. Rai is a rare combination of technical excellence and heartfelt compassion. I would recommend them without hesitation to anyone in need of surgical care

user_reviews.Name: T. E.
user_reviews.Description:
I feel very lucky to have found such an amazing doctor like Dr. Surjit Rai. I had my en bloc surgery with him, and everything was perfect from start to finish.
At first, I was skeptical about all the high reviews, but I was wrong. From the very first consultation, I felt that I was in the best hands.
He is very attentive, caring, and truly a wonderful person. My surgery went smoothly, and my recovery has been just as great.
I am deeply grateful to Dr. Surjit Rai and to the entire team. You are all amazing. Thank you for everything!

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Penney
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Rai is the most exceptional surgeon out there! I’d give him 10 stars if I could! He was comforting and reassuring throughout the entire process, from our initial consultation to the phone calls on the weekend just to check on me post op. I truly cannot say enough good things about him and his staff. They are all incredible human beings dedicated to helping each patient on their healing journey. I’d choose Dr. Rai and his staff a million times over. THANK YOU from the bottom of my heart!

user_reviews.Name: Lisa Lewis
user_reviews.Description:
Where to start? I had implants for 25 years and was having many unwanted symptoms that I feel certain were related to them.

After doing research, I decided it was time to get then out. I was scared to say the least, but after my consult with Dr Rai, I was completely put at ease. He was extremely confident and also honest about the outcome cosmetically. I loved that he didn’t over promise, but did make me feel confident they would be removed safely and he would do his very best to give me the best cosmetic result and he over delivered! My results are phenomenal and I have to say I like my breasts better than with implants and even better, my many symptoms are already improving and I’m feeling like myself again!

His whole staff was incredible from start to finish and the after care follow up by Dr Rai personally is not something you see much anymore! I couldn’t be happier snd would never hesitate to recommend him! He’s a talented surgeon but also kind and compassionate! Hands down, the best experience with a surgery I’ve ever had!

user_reviews.Name: sandy peterson
user_reviews.Description:
I am so incredibly grateful I chose Dr. Surjit Rai for my explant surgery. From the very first consultation, he was patient, honest, and never made me feel rushed. He took the time to explain everything in detail — including the possibility of volume loss or aesthetic changes — and his transparency allowed me to feel fully informed and confident in my decision.

When my MRI led to additional imaging, Dr. Rai personally called to reassure me, encouraged me to move forward without fear, and explained that it would not interfere with my upcoming surgery or worsen my ruptured implant. That level of personal care and compassion during such an emotional time meant more to me than I can express.

Dr. Rai is not only an exceptionally skilled and experienced surgeon, but also a genuinely kind and caring person who is deeply invested in his patients’ healing. His educational content online is incredibly informative and empowering. Choosing him was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. I would recommend Dr. Rai wholeheartedly.

user_reviews.Name: Sharon Johns-Hernandez
user_reviews.Description: From the moment I met Dr. Surgit Rai, there was a peace about him that told me he was here for me. He answered all my questions in a 1-hour meeting. I then had more questions later and emailed him. He responded quickly, not by email, but rather, he called me. His kindness and demeanor are the BEST! His knowledge is top-notch. I asked him about his education, experience, and everything I could think of. He was happy to share it all. I had an implant removal done. I wanted new implants put in. I decided not to replace the implants based on his knowledge and my situation. Other surgeons I interviewed just wanted to replace what I had. He would have done whatever I wanted. I had no implant problems that I knew of. I decided to take them out and get a lift. It turned out that both implants were ruptured. This was the best decision, and I am so glad I was under Dr. Rai's care. While there, I decided to get a lower face and neck lift. Both procedures were done on the same day. What a fantastic job he did. With both procedures in one day, I had no pain. I took Tylenol for one day. I followed his instructions, and everything was perfect. I have had many surgeries in my past. I am 60. Hospital settings make me anxious. Dr. Rai has his own surgical room. I had zero anxiety. If hospitals make you nervous, this is the way to go. I have had many good surgeons in my past.  Dr. Rai is my new favorite. Thank you, Dr. Rai, for taking such good care of me.

user_reviews.Name: Rachel Radimecky
user_reviews.Description: I first consulted with Dr. Surjit Rai back in 2021 about getting an explant.  I would check in about once a year to see how about pricing and how far out scheduling was for the procedure. I finally decided to go through with my explant in November, and my experience has been amazing.  Dr. Rai is incredibly attentive and caring.  He is willing to answer any and all questions you might have, I am sure he has heard them all.  His staff is equally as amazing.  One of the biggest things that made me glad to have chosen him was the day of my surgery, he held my hand and made me feel completely comfortable until I went under.  When I got home, he called to make sure I was doing well and then checked in during the weekend.  He has been open and honest about my results and how my healing should/could continue. I couldn't be happier with how everything turned out.  If you are considering an explant, he is definitely your Dr.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
