So appreciative of Dr Rai and how not only did he do an amazing job but he’s a very comforting doctor as well. It’s super natural at being a compassionate person and getting an explant is not something that is comforting to say the least. His way of explaining what to expect, his way of answering questions and allowing you to speak, the organization of the consults are amazing. I had to do all my consults from afar so having those calls with him not in office I still felt were awesome.
Lastly, some doctors take off a lot of breast tissue, from pictures I’ve seen online. He takes his time to make sure he does not remove a lot so we have more breast tissue left. How slow and steady he is with what he does also is slow important. You truly feel he cares even though it’s not his body. He often says “if this were my wife or sister” and you truly feel he’s caring for you in that way. Hes careful! Very appreciative

user_reviews_extended.Name: andrea marshall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am beyond pleased with my procedures with Dr. Surjuit Rai! I absolutely love him! He saved ME!
I had scars , deformed breast from another doctor from 20 years ago. Then I had both of my old silicone breast rupture. One breast was severely painful. I felt lost when some doctors could not help me.
Then with lots of research and other MANY recommendations I got to Dr Rai. He is an explant specialist! He fixed both breast. He fixed my scars. I am so extremely happy.
I also decided to do a forehead lift, neck lift and eyelid surgery. It has turned out amazing! I don’t look fake or plastic. Just refreshed and like I looked years ago! My family and friends are so full of compliments!
Dr Rai is not only a spectacular surgeon but a great, compassionate person.
I could not be more pleased! I really can’t say enough about my procedures!  Better that I dreamed.  Thank you!
The office and nurse staff is fantastic too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Schneider
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had an explant and lift with Dr. Surjit Rai and could not be happier with my results! I met with other plastic surgeons prior to my consultation with Dr. Rai and I knew he was the right choice for me as soon as I left the appointment. He is unbelievably compassionate and takes the time to answer all of your questions. The icing on the cake is that his team is equally amazing! From scheduling, moving up my surgery date several times, pre-op and post-op care they were all fantastic. My recovery has been surprisingly easy and I am so thankful to Dr. Rai and his team for their continued support.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lari Wise
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Surjit Rai is a Fantastic surgeon & staff. Very kind, knowledgeable, thorough and great bedside manner. I had explant/implant surgery and was very happy with the results. Dr Rai Went above and beyond to follow up on post surgical care. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Gavran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Rai and his entire team! I recently had a breast explant with en bloc capsulectomy and a lift and I am beyond happy that I chose Dr. Rai as my surgeon. I travelled across the country for my surgery and his team made the entire process as seamless and least stressful as possible. He believed me when I told him that I had BII symptoms and genuinely cared about my well being pre, during, and post op. He called me the night of my surgery to check in on me - not all surgeons are like this - he made me feel like family. And to top it all off, I am very pleased with my aesthetic and health results since surgery. I cannot recommend Dr. Rai enough - I would recommend him to my family and friends in a heartbeat.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Burke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rai and his staff are absolutely incredible!! They are so kind and sincerely care about each patient from what I have seen! My surgery went very well! I’m healing very well and so happy with my results. I was also very impressed with the anesthesiologist for my surgery! Overall a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Am now a little over 3 months post op from an explant with Dr. Rai. He did an amazing job not only removing the implants & the capsule but in his masterful approach in making my breast look normal after 14 years of having implants. It was one of the best decisions I ever made and I feel amazing. From the initial consult I felt such a peace and I knew Dr. Rai was the one to do my surgery. My husband & I are both in the medical field and we were so impressed with every interaction with Dr. Rai and his team. His bedside manner is spectacular. If you are looking for a board certified plastic surgeon to do your explant or any other surgery he performs, look no further, Dr. Rai & his team are it. I found him through google reviews so I feel obligated to pay it forward to someone else looking for a surgeon. He checked all the boxes I look for in a surgeon, board certified being the most important. But then his demeanor & amazing staff just made it an experience that sealed the deal. Thank you Dr. Rai, Christan, & entire staff. You guys rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Jeffrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a Tummy Tuck, muscle repair and inner thigh lift done by Dr. Surjit Rai.  The results are life-changing. After 3 c-sections and a large weight loss I had a lot of extra skin and an apron that needed to be removed. My results were excellent and all of that is gone now. My stomach looks like it’s 25 and I’m 57! I had no complications and have only the highest praise for Dr. Rai.  He performed a breast explant and lift on me a few years ago also with excellent results. I would highly recommend him for his skill, professionalism, and bedside manner. I drove two hours to see him and wouldn’t consider anyone else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tonja Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rai and his staff are excellent in every way I could hope. They are kind, professional, and caring. His staff and he communicated with me quickly and consistently even after surgery. He did a beautiful job on my breast explant. I’m relieved and happy with the results. They genuinely care about their patients and treat you like a person not a number. Dr Rai was worth the wait to get booked with him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Mendoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai is by far worth the hype so much so I flew out of state. So glad he did. He's patient, thorough in answering any questions, and explaining the process. His bedside manners are top notch and I needed that in a procedure that can be so vulnerable like explant. To be honest his techniques must be meticulous because my recovery was so much better than I expected. I knew I wanted an expert in this procedure and that's exactly what he is. His staff is great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrington DeLaGarza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came from Manhatten to get a tummy tuck and lipo. First glance it's a beautiful center. The waiting room is very legit and the staff is nice and Profesional. Dr. Rai is a kind accepting Dr. He never made me feel awkward about my skin and surgery choice. He assured me and my mother that everything would be great. The surgery went great I called the office for any questions I had because I was worried. They were kind and gave me info. The doctor even made a house call that night to assure me I would be fine. He's amazing nice and Profesional. Great great doctor and experience. He went out of his way to make the surgery a success and made me feel amazing! Thank you Dr Rai.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilliana Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai is seriously the best doctor ever!  He takes amazing care of his patients and is always willing to listen and answer any questions. Also, his nurse Angie took such fantastic care of me post op. She is a rockstar! Explanting with Dr Rai had been life changing for me. My BII symptoms have already subsided.  Forever grateful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I traveled 5 hours to Dr. Rai for my explant surgery and it was 100% worth it. All of the staff from the nurses to the front desk staff are amazing and make you feel so comfortable. Dr. Rai not only did an incredible job with my surgery but he also is a great man with the best bedside manner I’ve ever seen. He even came to the office on a Sunday to remove my drains and personally called me after surgery. If you’re on the fence about who to use, go here you won’t regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Gibbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so glad I chose to have my explant and lift done by Dr. Surjit Rai. From the moment I first spoke with Christan on the phone about setting up a consult to my 4 week follow up with Dr. Rai, I was taken care of extremely well. Dr. Rai did an excellent job and I am thrilled with my results. Dr. Rai also kept in contact with me in the days after my procedure which was very comforting. He and his staff go above and beyond to support you through the entire process. If you are thinking about setting up a consult with Dr. Rai, do it! He and his staff are the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Reeves
user_reviews_extended.Description: If your looking for someone to trust with a full enbloc breast implant removal your search is over Dr. Rai is the best. He did an amazing job picking his staff and his nurses to help you after your surgery before you go home. Dr. Rai is so smart and passionate about his job and has the best personality to help you along this difficult journey. He has such good energy with his passion for his work that it makes you feel so grateful to have found him. I had my full enbloc implant removal a week ago. He sends all the capsules to the lab to rule out cancer and that was important for me. He calls you after surgery a few times to make sure your doing ok. I am grateful for Dr. Rai.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tanner Clemens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rai and his is whole staff are one of a kind. I felt so comfortable and reassured throughout the whole process. They removed my implants and I haven’t felt this good in years! Dr Rai has completely changed my life for the better. He’s incredibly kind and professional and I highly recommend him and his practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. V. Rai is an absolutely incredible surgeon!!  I cannot say enough good things about how he transformed my upper chest!! His bedside manner is impeccable. He is very, very smart, and knows exactly what he is doing!!  Amazing!  Oh my goodness, I cannot thank him enough!!
His 5 minutes of wisdom here and there will last me a lifetime!!  My almost 95-year-old dad tells me he is exactly right when I tell him his few words of wisdom!  Thank u 🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Troyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I spent a lot of time researching who to have my explant lift surgery with and time after time Dr. Surjit Rai’s results were just amazing. I couldn’t be happier with my results truly. He did an impeccable job and I’ve been telling all my women friends about the dangers of breast implant illness. I love how Dr. Rai cares about his patients and does such an amazing job teaching as well as doing the actual surgery. I would give them 100 stars if I could.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacy Loper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai is the nicest doctor I’ve ever met. He’s so kind, patient and amazing at what he does! I had my implants removed and a lift and I’m so happy with the results. I can’t thank him enough for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Beall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have absolutely loved my experience with Dr. Rai. He was very compassionate and understanding as well as listened to met and answered all of my questions to his best abilities. I am so thankful I had a explant with him. He remembered details about me and my procedure and made sure to follow up on them. He called me personally the night I got home from surgery as well as the next day. He emailed me back within an hour or two when I emailed him with questions. He was so friendly and genuine with his care. I could not have asked for a better doctor and team to get me through this surgery and come out on the other side healthy and "me" again. Dr. Rai has truly been amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sony Heptig
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I could write a dissertation about how amazing Dr. Rai and his staff are....but here’s the cliffs notes version.....I went to Dr. Rai for breast explant surgery. I have had serious health issues for the last 5 years and I knew getting my implants removed was the next best step in my healing journey. Dr. Rai was so knowledgeable about breast implant illness, along with my chronic health conditions and he accommodated all my needs. Dr. Rai is professional, kind, compassionate, generous, incredibly skilled, and sooooooo sooooo caring! I have never in my life met a doctor like him. His staff are beyond kind and professional! They are so prompt and helpful and treat everyone with so much respect! Dr. Rai spends so much time making me feel like his only patient! He called me the night of surgery to check on me and even drove back to the clinic to put my mind at ease bc I had a concern that he could have easily just dismissed! But he drove all the way back just to reassure me! I still cry thinking about how caring he is. He even opened his clinic on a holiday weekend just to remove my drains! And he treats alllllll of his patients like this! As if we are his family! He responds every question with a phone call! His staff always ready to help and kind! I just can’t say enough about this amazing doctor. I have had so many surgeries and I have never had a surgeon talk to me and hold my hand and comfort me while going under. His nurses, wow! Anesthesiologist...wow! Just simply a blessing to have been led to Dr. Rai and his team! I am forever grateful! So if you are thinking about going to dr Rai, don’t wait a second longer and RUN to his office! You will be so blessed! Happy healing!

Also, this surgery recovery has been amazing! I’m only two weeks post op and usually after all my surgeries Ive had complications or issues but not this surgery! I didn’t even need to take any pain meds (and I have zero pain tolerance) He’s amazing....

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kris Kannel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai is one of the best in his field!  Extremely professional yet down to earth.  His work is beautiful and He creates a warm and comfortable environment when you are going through a personal surgery such as a Explant.  Extremely blessed and thankful for his work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsi Mata
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience with Dr. Rai and his team! They truly answer any questions you might have regarding your surgery. From the consultation to the last appointment he was so kind and caring! It was the best experience I have had with a surgeon or doctor. If you are looking for a Surgeon that truly takes his time with every patient, do not hesitate! It was very worth the wait!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harley Doll
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently underwent a breast explant and lift procedure, and I couldn't be happier with the results. From the initial consultation to the post-operative care, the entire experience was exceptional.

Dr. Rai and his team demonstrated the utmost professionalism, expertise, and care throughout the entire process. They listened to my concerns, answered all my questions, and provided me with realistic expectations for the surgery.

The surgery itself went smoothly, and the results exceeded my expectations. The healing process was also managed with precision, and I felt well-supported every step of the way.

I highly recommend Dr. Rai to anyone considering breast surgery. His skill, dedication, and commitment to patient satisfaction are truly commendable.  Dr Rai is  an absolute artist!

I can’t thank him and his team enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R NC
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Rai did my breast reduction surgery. He completely changed my life.. Absolute perfection in his work and he exceeded my expectations. I would recommend anyone to this amazing Dr. Not to mention that his entire office staff is amazing! So warm and welcoming!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Bristow
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr Rai and his staff. From the first phone call to the you can go back to work appt the entire experience was full of compassion with exceptional follow up and all my questions were answered along the way quickly. If you are on the fence about an explant let me tell you I am so much better physically and mentally than I have been in years, the old me is back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: N Baccam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his team were amazing.  Dr. Rai is very knowledgeable and caring.  His nurse Angie and anesthesiologist Dr. Miller also so very caring.  I was very nervous before my surgery but they put me at ease.  I am very happy with my results and very grateful for Dr. Rai and staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacie White
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his entire team are top notch!! I had been researching to have an explant done for quite a while and when I met him and his staff I looked no further. It’s not often you meet a Dr. with compassion, skill and understanding of the patients needs. I booked my surgery immediately  after my consult and cannot be happier with my results. I have already referred friends to Dr. Rai and will continue to do so and speak praises of him and his team. He’s the BEST!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Sexton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today marks my one month post-op explant, and it's my final farewell to Dr. Surjit Rai!

I was incredibly skeptical about choosing a doctor for such a vulnerable process, but I'm extremely grateful that I found Dr. Rai and saw it through.

The process is certainly different, but it's not as daunting as it may seem!

I'll always be thankful for his exceptional bedside manner and aftercare!!

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Rai and the staff for guiding me every step of the way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renea Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his staff are amazing!!  They are caring and supportive as well as very professional.  They all answer any question you might have no matter how small you might think it is.  Everyone, from the office staff to the surgical staff, are wonderful.  Although my experience was very emotional, they understood and made me feel cared for during my time with them.  I don’t live in Dallas, but Dr. Rai checked on me several times via phone and wanted to know how I was doing and if I had any questions or problems.  If I had to do this over, I would gladly drive the 6 hours to have Dr. Rai take care of me.   I will always be thankful for being with Dr. Rai and his staff for my surgery.  He’s the BEST!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Carey

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellie Correll

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terrie Palmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nothing but praise for Dr Rai and his entire team.  My husband and I are so glad we chose to travel to him for my explant. Thank you Dr Rai, Christan, Angie, Ann and all the team!  May God continue to bless your practice and the work you are doing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina Moreland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great care from the beginning and continued throughout my journey! Very professional and caring with exceptional bedside manner. From Dr Rai to all his staff they are all wonderful. Would highly recommend. He is a gifted surgeon and does excellent work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Brockmueller
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an incredible team that surrounds Dr. Rai- from the welcome desk all the way through to the surgical team; I always felt cared for, known and supported. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelera Hensley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his staff were so kind, professional and personable. I was blown away by his bedside manner and he was always responsive to my needs and questions. He is someone I would use again for any future cosmetic procedures and I’ve also recommended him to a friend for her cosmetic treatment. Love Dr. Rai!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nichole King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cannot say enough about the level of care I received from Dr Rai! He was by far the most thorough and attentive Dr I’ve ever seen! Always available for questions before and after surgery….he even called me on a Sunday! 10/10 would always recommend Dr Rai!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Marx
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have so much respect for Dr. Rai and his team that it’s hard to put it into words. user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Anderson

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Hawkins

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irene Lopez

user_reviews_extended.Name: Missy Steinbeck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rai and staff are amazing! He’s a blessing to all of us that we’re dismissed by other doctors. user_reviews_extended.Name: Alison H
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Surjit Rai in Dallas has exceeded my expectations. user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Noel

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Hailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I simply can't find the words to clearly express how wonderful Dr. Surjit Rai AND his staff have been. user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Vasdev Rai. He is very articulate, knowledgeable and quite the artist of his craft. user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Purdom

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: One month post explant surgery and I couldn’t be happier with my results! Dr. Rai and his staff are amazing! user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his entire staff are the absolute best. I was treated with the utmost respect from the first call to the last follow up appointment. user_reviews_extended.Name: Limor Chen
user_reviews_extended.Description: So happy with Dr. Rai and his team! So many women recommended Dr. Rai for my explant and lift, which is why I chose to drive from Austin instead of choosing a surgeon here. From everything pre-op to now 4 weeks post op, they have been extremely caring, transparent and informative. Probably one of the best doctors I have ever experienced in my life. Aside from the care, I am already very impressed with the results of my surgery and feel so much better. Love them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Abts
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Surjit Rai is absolutely AMAZING!  I had an explant with enbloc and lift Aug 24th. Dr. Rai spent an hour with me during my consultation, and made me feel very comfortable. Dr. Rai made sure I knew everything about the procedure and what to expect with the results. I have had 2 cosmetic surgeons tell me "the results would be amazing," sadly I never got those amazing results. Dr. Rai didn't promise me anything other than he would do his best and he did!! They look like they did pre-baby and my baby just turned 16. I'm so happy with the results, I always hated my implants, and now I love everything about my small chest.🤗

The day of my surgery they all knew I was nervous. I thought I was going to pass out on the way to his office. I walked in and instantly felt calm, which has never happened before. Dr. Rai, Sam, and Angela are the absolute best. I've never had so many people comfort me while being put under. Angela is the best anesthesiologist I've ever had. I can't even begin to tell you how amazing Dr. Rai's bedside manner is. He held my hand and assured me I would be fine, and again I felt the sense of calm.

Sam was amazing from the time I walked in to when I left. Having surgery during a pandemic is scary and weird, and she was a very calming presence. She is funny, kind, and very compassionate. Everyone in his office goes above and beyond to let you know you have a whole team behind you.

Dr. Rai called me each day until my 1st post-op visit. When I called to ask a question I was floored when Dr. Rai got on the phone. Most cosmetic surgeons don't talk to you after surgery unless it's a post-op visit, and they don't even remember your name. I wish they were all like Dr. Rai. Which is why he is the most sought after surgeon. His wait list is long, but more than worth the wait.

No matter what you need Dr. Rai is the best cosmetic surgeon in the DFW metroplex. My brests look better than I could have imagined, I thought they were ruined after implants. No matter how many reviews you read about Dr. Rai, they will never be able to do him and his staff justice. I tell everyone its the feeling you get when you walk in the office and talk to Dr. Rai and his staff. He probably won't agree with me, but he did save my life. ❤❤❤

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney Flood
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING EXPERIENCE all the way around. I was so scared to go under anesthesia because I’ve had bad reactions in the past, but I had no issues with Dr Rai and his staff, woke up smoothly in a warm heated blanket so I wasn’t shivering like most places and they gave me plenty of time to get ready before I left. I could go on and on about the entire staff, but I will just say if you are hesitant for any reason, this is your reminder to just book your Explant! I feel 10 years younger thanks to Dr Rai and his staff. You will be so happy with them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ebele Nduka
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with Dr. Surjit Rai and his entire staff was phenomenal. As several women have stated this man goes above and beyond and truly deserves all of the praise.

I researched around and had several consultations with different doctors to perform my explant surgery. I had in 495 cc implants (which put me at a D cup) over the course of 5 years and am naturally a very small A. I was nervous about what the end result would look like and understood that going from such a large cup back to my original size might result in unsightly creasing that couldn't really be fixed other than with putting in another implant. Ultimately, I didn't care and just wanted them out. Dr. Rai doesn't fill your head with false claims & promises. He gives you all the information so that you fully understand where you are, where you'll be going and what might occur at the end--desirable & undesirable. That being said, he assures you that he will put forth his absolute best to ensure the best possible outcome and he holds your hand the whole way through. He is exceptionally skilled & has so much surgical experience (in my case explant) which gave me a lot of confidence in him as a surgeon. He's also tremendously attentive, compassionate & caring. With that, my explant results came out fantastic! I did no extras like fat transfer or lift, literally just had the implants removed and I couldn't have asked for a better result.

The man's knowledge, skill and bedside manner is unparalled. From the jump he makes you feel supremely comfortable, is super patient and he makes sure you get all of your questions answered. After surgery he calls you the following two days to check in and walks you through next steps as well as gives you progress reports. From consultation to surgery to post-op appointments Dr. Rai & his entire team leaves you feeling like they really care. He literally treats you like you're his own family. Additionally, he shows you through his work that he truly knows what he's doing.

His staff is awesome! Everyone I interacted with treats you with respect & care and answers any and all questions you may have. Overall, they're an excellent team and I highly, highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean McLean
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his staff are amazing.  His staff is very welcoming and pleasant to deal with.  No matter how many questions you may have, they will take the time to answer them.   Dr. Rai, he is amazing.  Made me feel very comfortable in my consultation and let me know how the explant surgery would be done.  I made an appointment for my surgery before I left my appointment.  During that time I received several phone calls asking if I wanted to move my surgery up - Yes!! So my surgery got moved from late July to late May.  The day of surgery I was so nervous that I started crying when I got to the surgery suite.  The nurse held my hand til I calmed down.  I was taken to the surgery suite when Dr. Rai was waiting for me.  We talked for a little bit while I was prepped for surgery.  The next thing I knew I was in recovery and waking up.  Dr. Rai told me that he would be calling me to check on me the next morning even though he was going on vacation.  This is a doctor that cares about his patients.  I would highly recommend Dr. Rai

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joni Hoskins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his staff are the kindest, most compassionate team of medical professionals that I have ever met.  Dr. Rai and everyone in his office truly care about their patients.  They are always available for any questions you may have and go above and beyond any doctor’s office that I have ever met.  Dr. Rai has the most amazing bedside manner and is a top notch surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debra Bristow
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Vasdev Rai has completed two surgeries for me.  Back in 2020 he did a partial abdominoplasty, and I was thrilled with the results.  I felt like a teenager again, and I was 53-years-old.  As a Mom who had gone through five births, it was amazing to have a belly button again.  As time passed, I realized that I also wanted Dr. Rai to perform a breast reduction/lift.  I had breastfed all five of my children for their first year of life, and now at 56-years-old, I was wanting the proportion of my chest to match my abdomen.  I had also been faithfully exercising over these past three years, and now it seemed like it was time to complete part two of the process of improving my quality of life.  The sagging skin in both areas, chest and abdomen, was making it difficult to feel clean.  Fast forward to now, and I again feel younger and healthier, after this second surgery.  Furthermore, hygiene is so much easier to maintain.  Dr. Rai and his staff were so kind and patient as I walked through the process of both surgeries.  I am one who asks many questions, as I like to understand and appreciate each phase of the process of surgery.  As time of healing continued on both surgeries, I was only more thankful and pleased with the results.  Again, Dr. Rai and his staff are to be commended on every part of their expertise and kind service to their patients.  Thank you all for being there for me, to walk through these two surgeries over the past three years!  I appreciate you all more than you can know.
Most Sincerely, Debra Bristow

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Ocasio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his staff are truly top notch.  From scheduling, to consult, all the way through to your surgery, they treat you like a person instead of a number.  At about 8 months post op, I am so pleased with my results, but even more than that, I am thankful that I chose a surgeon with such dedication to patient care.  Dr. Rai is with you all the way...even for those questions about your progress you may feel ridiculous or needy for asking 2 months after your surgery.   You can't go wrong with this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marie Boylan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a 23-year patient. I did move away from Dallas but reconnected with Dr. Lai when I required torn ear lobe surgery and a second facelift. I kept his file for 23 years. That should tell you something. This doctor is exceptional and I would never want any other to cosmetically operate on me. When I first went to Dr. Vasdev Rai, I shared that all of my life I had a double chin and no matter how much weight I lost, that double chin remained. This Dr. told me that he would take care of that double chin and I would never be bothered with it again. 23 years later, that double chin is gone. With my second facelift, he does not even need to operate on that area. This is a doctor with a good heart and how rare is that in this day and age. He has superior credentials and he is an extraordinarily kind man that truly cares about his patients. Let's be honest, how we feel about ourselves does matter.  I opine that Dr. Rai is the best. Why look any further.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lacey Childress
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every Single aspect about my procedure exceeded my expectations. I would not choose another doctor for my Breast reduction. He listened and provided what I asked for. All of the nurses and staff were amazing, helpful and sweet to me anytime I came in the office or even called them on the phone. I felt 100% Comfortable every visit and day of surgery. I would Highly recommend Dr. Rai for any surgical procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Bentley, Realtor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and staff are AMAZING. From initial consultation to post op appointments they treat you as family. Thank you for taking such great care of me through this journey.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Most caring Dr. and Staff
From the moment I called to schedule a consult to my aftercare, I have felt so cared for.
My implants were causing me to become ill and he listened and was very honest as to what to expect. He did not try to sale me another set, instead was very interested in hearing what my symptoms were and was excited for me when he heard my symptoms had gotten better after explant, removal of the capsule and a lift.
Dr. Rai is a perfectionist and my outcome is beautiful. I would highly recommend him to family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trahan Amanda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I begin with Dr. Rai and staff...His bedside manner was absolutely amazing! He is so kind, caring and knowledgeable. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I met with several surgeons in the Dallas area, I was given the impression that they only seemed to care about money and having things done "their way", even though it was my body and my choice. But when I met with Dr. Rai, it was such a refreshing experience and not like the other surgeons at all! I knew he was the right surgeon for me. He is kind and compassionate, and treats you as if you are his own family on the operating table. He doesn't look at you like you're crazy when you explain the way you've been feeling and your theories behind it. He genuinely cares and listens to your needs. I took comfort in the fact I knew I was in good hands. As for the procedure itself, it was completely seamless! I had a lot of anxiety leading up and his staff was SO kind and SO good at keeping me calm. The ladies in the office, Kristin and Angie are the best! The anesthesiologist I had, Dr. Kahanek, was so sweet and kind. She really helped me relax before going in and everyone explained everything to me in thorough detail. Dr. Rai was also amazing during the whole experience and has a great bedside manner. They comforted me the whole time as I was prepped to go under. They talked me through it, and rubbed my arm until I quietly went under. I woke up after the procedure and was shocked at how great I felt. I was barely in any pain at all! I had no complications and my results were FANTASTIC. I had explant & lift and could not be more happy with my results!! Dr. Rai met with me a week later to take my drains out (completely painless). And it was smooth sailing from there! I seriously can not say enough great things about him and his office. I will always recommend him with 100% certainty that he will take care of you from start to finish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blyss Benoit

He checks on you after your surgery multiple times and is very quick in answering all of your questions. His staff is great also.  I would choose him again 100 percent! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Satin Pelfrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Surjit Rai is hands down the best doctor I've ever had in my life! My left implant had ruptured so I chose to have a complete explant and after much research chose Dr. Surjit Rai as my surgeon. From the moment I contacted the office via email, scheduled a consultation and met with Dr. Rai I was blown away at the genuine kindness exuding from everyone in the office! Christian is amazing at her job and made me feel so welcomed, and important, as well as putting my mind at ease! Every nurse I worked with (I had three total) was so sweet, gentle and kind. I felt like a rockstar when I walked in for my final post-op appointment. Everyone could tell how AMAZING I felt and expressed their happiness for me. I had been suffering from BII for approximately five years and after just three weeks since my surgery 9/8/2020, I feel 100% better. I am absolutely blown away at how great I feel. The surgery recovery was hard - I won't candy coat that, but Dr. Rai made me feel so comfortable, checked on me daily for the first week and my body did the rest. I can't say enough good about Dr. Rai and his entire team!  Hands down best doctors office I've ever worked with! Wish all doctors were as amazing as Dr. Surjit Rai!

user_reviews_extended.Name: patricia caro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an explant and a lift on December 7, 2017 and am very happy with my results. Dr. Surjit Rai is not only an excellent surgeon but also an amazing human being. His love and care for people and for what he does is very apparent from the first moment you walk into his office and months after your procedure, his whole staff is AMAZING, I highly recommend him!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Von Hatten

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Cobb Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai performed my enbloc explant and did a phenomenal job. I felt so safe and protected before, during, and after the procedure. user_reviews_extended.Name: dena stilwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Could not have asked for a better procedure, outcome, and most importantly, care by a knowledge and sincere Doctor and Staff. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: S Thai

If any one is looking for a surgeon who is realistic and also very skilled, you need to meet Dr. Rai.  nothing is better than a surgeon who makes you feel comfortable before, during & after surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Brod
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai is simply the best. Aside from being an incredible surgeon, he made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process and answered all of my questions with patience, clarity, and professionalism. I am thrilled with my results. I would absolutely recommend Dr. Rai to family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had explant surgery. Dr. Rai and his staff were great!  He explained the procedure thoroughly and what to expect.  His staff was friendly and easy to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sataira Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had no idea my life would forever be changed, the day I met Dr. Surjit Rai. I will never be able to thank him enough, for the absolutely amazing job he did with my surgery. I now have a quality of life, that I never knew I was missing out on. I am writing this review 3 months post surgery, and my results are far beyond what I expected. Dr. Rai is a great guy! I never felt like I was just a patient. He cared about me as a person, my concerns, and it was very evident that he had my best interest at heart- in regards to my procedure and overall outcome. He was very attentive throughout the whole process, and never gave me the opportunity to worry about anything. He called to check on me while I was home recovering, and always kept me informed with what to expect. Amazing doctor! And an absolutely awesome staff! Dr. Rai, Kristin and Lexy, I thank you all!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ebbie Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such an incredible experience with Dr. Rai and his team. Everyone was so nice and helpful through the whole entire process from when I first booked the appointment and especially after surgery. They never seemed at all bothered when I called to ask any questions, and I therefore I was comfortable calling anytime I felt like needed them.

Surgery day was a wonderful experience. I got to meet with Dr. Rai in person before, and he talked  me and my fiancé through the whole process and what to expect. My nurse, Angie, was with me the entire time and took such great care of me.

Dr. Rai preformed a full en bloc capsulectomy with no lift, and I am so pleased with the results! My left implant was badly ruptured, but because he is such a skilled surgeon, he was able to take the full capsule out with the implant. So the silicone from my ruptured implant stayed within the capsule, and did not leak into my body.

After 3 years of feeling sick and experiencing horrible inflammation in my body, I finally have relief! The day after surgery, I felt as though I could see better and my head was clear!

I am so thankful for choosing Dr. Rai, and I would highly recommend him to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Ivey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough about Dr. Surjit Rai and his staff.  They truly care about you, they are so personable and make this whole process that much easier. Thank you again Dr.Rai, for helping all of us,  God has definitely placed you where you need to be. 🩷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelle Bryant
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but wonderful things to say about Dr Rai and his office staff ! Always kind , helpful and professional!  Even though I live in a different state and traveled to TX for my surgery, communication was always great ! I am very pleased with the outcome of my surgery and I highly recommend Dr Rai

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janna M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am so thankful that I chose Dr Rai for my explant surgery. I could have gone with another doctor and Medicare would have paid; however, I wanted the best surgeon when it came down to it.
Dr Rai made me feel completely at ease, considering how nervous I was even thinking about explanting.
The day of my surgery as I'm about to go under the anesthesia. Dr Rai is standing on my right side, rubbing my arm ever so gently, telling me that I'm going to be okay and they (the whole team) are going to take good care of me. Plus, after the surgery, he contacted me numerous times, checking on me.
At my post explant appointment, I told him that I had  cried a few days, grieving the loss of the implants, and he listened so intently, handed me a tissue, and encouraged me the whole time that I really looked good, and would notice a lot of positive changes within the year.
He is the most thoughtful and kind doctor I have ever know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Simpson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rai and his staff are wonderful and made my experience so easy to walk through.  I am so grateful for the care they took of me and my results are nothing short of amazing!!  I had 13 year old, under the muscle, implants removed with a lift.  I feel like my self again after years of not feeling well. Breast Implant Illness is real and thankfully I found Dr. Rai and his office staff who helped me take the most important step towards healing my body!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Additionally, after surgery, Dr Rai personally calls to make sure everything is well.

Great doctor, great staff - Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Surjit Rai performed my breast reduction in June of 2019. Prior to the surgery, I was terrified of what I was getting myself into. I have two small children; what if something went wrong? However, I am 31 and I was living with 34F cups for too long.

After the initial consultation, I knew that Dr. Rai was whom I wanted to perform my surgery. Extremely personable, with a wonderful bedside manner, he made me feel calm and answered every single one of my dozens of questions. He was extremely patient and confident.

His staff is equally kind and patient. The nurses and front desk staff are wonderful. Usually, when the front desk and nurses are nice, the doctor sucks or if the doctor is nice, the nurses or front desk aren’t good, in my experience, anyway. But every. Single. Person. In this office is wonderful.

The day of my surgery went so smoothly and I was in and out in 4 hours. I won’t go into much detail here because everyone’s experience is different but mine was as breezy as a outpatient surgery could go. I’ve had two c sections, so compared to those, this was a cake walk.

The quality of my life post surgery has improved ten fold. I no longer experience horrendous back pain after standing for a mere twenty minutes. I find myself being more active. I have recently taken up gardening, which would have been incomprehensible with my pre reduction body.

Getting a breast reduction with Dr. Rai has been one of the best decisions of my life. If you are thinking about this procedure, I highly, highly recommend Dr. Surjit Rai at Cosmetic Surgical Center.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so very grateful for Dr. Rai, he's such a kind man. user_reviews_extended.Name: sharon pyeatt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was eager to have an explant using the specialized en bloc procedure and found Dr. Rai through a list of approved surgeons in Dallas (I live in OK). In fact, he was "Highly Recommended," so easy call for me. Both of my silicone implants were ruptured.
I couldn't has asked for a better experience. This was probably my 24th surgery, so I know the drill, but he doesn't have people lined up waiting while I waited. Walked in, got ready, laid down on the  table in the adjacent surgery suite, IV in, lights out. Because of my chronic pain history, I have a high tolerance for pain meds; my pain level upon waking up was a 10+.....my nurse, Angie, immediately asked the anesthesiologist for help.  She then began to slowly, but regularly inject more pain meds, monitor for a bit, and continued until I could talk to her.

I am beyond grateful and happy with Dr. Rai and his staff. From Christan, who helped me with paperwork and kept me on track, bumping me up on the list when cancellations occurred, to the surgery staff, to Angie (or Angel, as I thought of her that day!), and of course, Dr. Rai himself, there was nothing but professionalism, kindness, and caring, which was a huge comfort to me. I especially appreciated his honesty. I didn't need a lift, and a fat transfer wouldn't really help me in the areas I that could use some 'filler.'

I highly recommend Dr. Rai for this procedure! I would drive to Dallas to use him for other procedures, if needed or wanted!

user_reviews.Name: Leslie Fetchen
user_reviews.Description:
I am very happy with my results. I had a mid-face lift/neck lift, liposuction of my abdomen, and a mons lift. Following are the positives about the experience:

Excellent results: My face looks natural and the improvement exceeded my expectations. My face looks refreshed, my neck is noticeably tighter, and my abdominal contour is much improved.

Skilled and knowledgeable surgeon: Dr. Harris was highly professional, took time to explain each procedure in detail, and answered all my questions thoroughly.

Clear communication: Expectations, risks, and recovery expectations were explained clearly, which helped me feel confident and prepared.

Supportive staff: The medical and office staff were kind, attentive, and responsive throughout the entire process.  Nurse Jennifer is an absolute angel - even when all goes well, plastic surgery can be an emotional roller coaster sometimes, but Jennifer never got impatient with me and was consistently encouraging and supportive.

Smooth surgical experience: The day of surgery was well-organized, and I felt safe and well cared for.

Manageable recovery: Post-operative instructions were clear, and my recovery progressed as expected with good follow-up care.  That being said, it is a big deal to have plastic surgery.  Be prepared for some ups and downs - and stay in touch with your physician and nurse.  They are the best support!

Improved confidence: The physical changes have had a very positive impact on my self-esteem and overall well-being.

Clean and professional facility: The surgical center was immaculate, modern, and comfortable.

user_reviews.Name: Lawanna Curtis
user_reviews.Description:
After having multiple C-sections and tackling menopause, I desperately wanted my body back! I was nervous about having a tummy tuck and lipo done at 51, but Dr. Harris and his team completely exceeded my expectations. From the first consultation, they were professional, caring, and attentive, making me feel confident and supported every step of the way.

My tummy tuck and liposuction results are absolutely amazing! My stomach is flatter, my shape is more defined, and I finally feel confident in my own skin again. The recovery was smooth, and the care I received from Dr. Harris’s team was outstanding. I’m beyond grateful for their expertise and highly recommend them to anyone considering this procedure.

I had so many questions, and kept going back and forth but Hilary was patient with me and walked me through everything. Jennifer anytime I had questions after surgery was quick to reply and never belittled me no matter how small the question. 10/10 recommend. I have never felt better in my own skin than I do now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa PG
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Harris and the entire staff at AI4PS are welcoming and professional. Each case is unique to include mine and what we expect to come from the procedure. This helped me so much in planning mentally and emotionally for this. Now I am just over 3 months post surgery and the team has still kept open communication regarding after surgery care and left an open invite for me to contact them with any issues (if I have them) going forward. user_reviews_extended.Description: There is nobody else I would let touch my face but Jen. She has changed my life and elevated my confidence to the next level. She is so knowledgeable, kind, accommodating, and really listens to her patients wants while providing her opinion as to the best treatment route. She is always further educating herself which I really admire. I would recommend her to ANYONE and everyone. 10/10. Thank you Jen!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: claire
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Jen last week and could not be more satisfied. She is honest, patient, professional, knowledgable, personable, and extremely talented. I was a little nervous before my appointment, but once I arrived I felt immediately at ease. Jen seriously made the entire process enjoyable and I could not be happier with her or the results. Would give her more than 5 stars if I could and will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Owens
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have always been very insecure w/ my lips.. they were very thin & just not cute!
Sivan helped me feel like the young woman I’ve always wanted to be. I absolutely love my lips! Sivan calmed my nerves & made me feel extremely comfortable. I would highly recommend her to inject anyone I know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Cunha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had microneedling done with Payton and have loved the results.  She is so knowledgeable and truly has perfected her craft.  Can’t wait to go for my next session.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: For the best Hydrafacial  & WonderTouch services & results to pamper yourself with, be sure to ask for Trish!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monse Bustos
user_reviews_extended.Description: My mom and I booked our lip injections appointment with Jen Pilotte and we are already looking forward to our next visits! She made our first time so accomodating and she is incredibly knowledgeable in her specialty. Any questions we had she had the answers to! She was funny and gentle! Hands down the best, I recommend her to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Prescott
user_reviews_extended.Description: I guess I'm a bit premature in my rating as my Botox hasn't had enough time to settle in.  That said, my 5 rating so far is based on the facility being nice, Jen being thorough and addressing all my questions including long term facial balancing to skincare. I really appreciated her being honest about what would improve my appearance and what wouldn't, as well as providing the associated costs to the treatment recommendations so I can budget for them. I've already ordered the skincare she recommended, and I'm excited to see how that and the Botox works over the next 6 weeks. Jen also provided ice when I was about to faint (a common thing for me). I will mention that I did wait for 30+ minutes, but that is not something I would base a rating on knowing that excellent professionals are busy and pulled in a lot of directions. What's important to me is the quality of treatment. Lastly, I appreciated the receptionist that I spoke to today adding my Botox points to the alle rewards program as I didn't think to sign up until after my appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Jen because of all the positive reviews. I was very excited to see her. She does a lot of training and I felt like she knew what she was doing…BUT when I went in for my procedure she seemed to be very short with me and it just wasn’t the experience I had imagined I would have. I went ahead and had the procedure with her but it’s hard to go back and spend that kind of money on someone who isn’t interested in seeing you in the first place. Maybe if I were prettier or skinner or if I were as “beautiful” as the clients she always post about she would be interested in me as a client….but she just made me feel ugly and not worth her time. The procedure was fine no bruising. I can’t say I was happy with the outcome of the visit because there will be no second visit to address any concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hillary Philbrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was originally flying out of state for my procedures until I finally bit the bullet and decided to come to Lemmon avenue. This clinic is amazing. From the moment I walked in, everyone was so sweet and accommodating. I have a cleft so my lip injection process probably differed from others with “normal” lips to start off with but Jen never treated me any different. In fact, she went above and beyond to not only make sure I was satisfied but made sure she explained everything and talked me through every step- even asked my feedback. I’m in a ton of cleft groups and I try to mention her to everyone “of age” looking to obtain some normalcy to their lips. Jen literally gave me a smile I’ve always wanted and I will forever recommend her to people as well as continue to see her myself!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Roca
user_reviews_extended.Description: If your looking for a talented injector , I highly recommend NP Jen Pillotte , I found her on IG and fell in love with her work! I have been going to her for my Botox and lip fillers now for almost a year,  she is EXTREMELY accommodating and values your time !! She went above and beyond to make me feel beautiful and appreciated ❤️❤️ She took her time with me and explained what she was doing.  I love her heart and how honest and caring she is! I will continue to see her and tell everyone to go to her! ❤️❤️ Thanks Jen !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Misty Roe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen did amazing work with fillers and Botox for me. I had absolutely no bruising with her, which was a first for me. After her recommendations, I looked refreshed and totally not over done. Very happy with my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been getting microneedling with PRF with Stephanie for over a year and she is the best!! She is so amazing, super sweet and extremely talented and I always look forward to my appointments with her. Stephanie has transformed my skin over the last year and it has really improved my confidence! I love not having to wear makeup and still look fabulous 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Savage
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Worth the trip to Dallas if you’re out of market.

I started seeing Jen at Lemmon Ave last fall and have never felt more comfortable with an injector. She’s all about a natural look and will truly help you combat the aging process.  She books up months in advance so plan ahead. She’s so worth the wait.

I also highly recommend Taylor for your skincare needs. I recently had a facial with him that left my skin radiant and refreshed; something much needed.

Dr. Deuber did my husband’s blepharoplasty and received the best care. He could not be happier with the results.

For me, Lemmon Ave is super convenient and I am never kept waiting. My appointments are always on time and the staff is super friendly and helpful.

I’ve been injected before in other cities. You can’t go wrong with anyone on staff at Lemmon Ave.  They’re truly experts in what they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mar EE
user_reviews_extended.Description: I followed Jen’s Instagram page for a while. After seeing all the amazing results and how professional she seemed, I decided it was my turn. I have gotten lip fillers twice already and botox. I loved the whole experience and what made me come to her was how knowledgeable she is about everything she does. Jen will be the only person I will get lip fillers and Botox from! <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Moyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have seen Jen for all of my injections and she has transformed my face. I had lip injections elsewhere and went to Jen for nose filler. She did such a beautiful job I allowed her to dissolve my lips and start over. I didn’t realize my lips could look so good! Since then she has done full facial balancing with filler. I cannot say enough good things about her skill set and discerning eye. I’ve also been to Stephanie for skinpen with PRF injections and after a year of consistent treatments my skin looks better than it ever has. I can compare to other microneedling treatments I have had elsewhere  and stephanie is truly in a league of her own.  She curates a package with various add-ons specific to your skin needs an anti-aging desires. I had never received the results I have with Stephanie anywhere else.  Do not waste your time and money anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Karen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Look no further , Jen is amazing !
I’ve been to plenty injectors in the last 10 years and let me tell you , jen is the most professional injector I’ve came across , her services are on point , she makes you feel totally comfortable and will make you feel important . I can tell she treats all her patients equally which is very important! Overall a very nice , friendly individual . Highly recommend her 10000% .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan Carr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Originally I had been following one of Sivan's fellow co-workers, at Renew when I came across Sivan's work. Both are equally amazing at what they do. However, Sivan caught my eye with her Tear Through/Cheek correction back in 2017 on Candice. That is when I knew I had to have work done by Sivan one day.

At the time it wasn't achievable for me financially, but I saved up some money here and there and kept following her. She kept growing, and her techniques became even more advanced. Fast forward three years later, and I was ready to take the plunge. Although I was mostly interested in my under eyes, I went ahead and scheduled my lips as well, because of some symmetry issues.

March 7th, 2019 was my appointment date. When I arrived at Lemon Avenue, I was in awe of the building. The architecture was phenomenal, the décor was crisp and clean. Their receptionist was very friendly, attentive, and helpful (very important as I am not a local Dallas resident). My initial meeting with Jen and Sivan was really easy. They were both super chill, and down to earth people. For me it was nerve racking, because of my fear of needles. However, they both reassured me it was going to be okay, as their numbing cream was top notch (my lips were number for 4 hours afterwards). It was good stuff. She worked her magic, we chatted about different things, and booked my next visit four months later. The entire staff were friendly, and smiled a lot. It genuinely felt like they were all a family. Sivan and Jen are one of the best teams in this industry.

It has been three weeks since I had my under eyes and lips done. The results, have far exceeded my expectations. I feel more confident, and have been able to wear red lipstick again without it bleeding/smearing. She did such a beautiful job, and has such an amazing eye for detail. I would follow her all over the United States if she ever moved. Sivan is AMAZING!!! Hands down, an amazing injector with a beautiful soul. She is a perfectionist and is worth it!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Lumbreras
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Jen!!! I went to her for my first time getting a mini lip and went back in January for a full lip and she kills it every time! Definitely recommend her to anyone looking into getting lip fuller. You can’t go wrong with Jen! 🤍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cherisse Galloway
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with Payton! She explained the whole process thoroughly and made me feel so comfortable. She did amazing work and I feel so beautiful!! 10/10 recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Cournoyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to Jen at Lemmon Avenue twice already and have a third apt booked! I was extremely happy with the service there and will continue to go! She’s super informative and caring. She stays booked out for months because she is that good! Her social media is also why I chose to go there because you can see a lot of her clients results and have some information on hand before you go to your apt!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Marquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I freaking loved Sivan!!!!! It was my first time and I had been doing my research. And of course since she’s the best, when I booked my appointment I had to wait like 3 months!  But during that wait, and after watching her stories and seeing her educate the importance of her work, MAN! It made it worth the wait and now that I got my lips done, I’m so pleased with everything, my only complaint is that now I want more! Haha! She’s truly the best!!!!!! 💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Tetchie and she did an amazing job! This was first time ever getting lip injections and I was very impressed with how everything went. The office is very warm and welcoming! I'm so happy with how my lips look!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Sosa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first experience was with Taylor.  I got some laser work done.   He was extremely sweet and didn't try to give me a treatment that I didn't need.  He kept in contact with me to make sure my needs were met.  He gave me a little free touch up during my follow up.  He truly cares that you are happy with your service.  He's someone I want to be friends with in real life.  He's that awesome!!!

Jen is a true professional who takes her skills seriously.  One thing to know about her is she is constantly continuing her education and learning the latest and greatest.  I went in thinking I wanted all these treatments done and she quickly shut that down.  She is honest and will never recommend anything just to recommend it.  Her goal is to make you look your natural self while at the same time meeting your beauty needs!!!  She is a true artist.  I am genuinely impressed with her skills and her attitude towards her craft.  I highly recommend you go to all of their Instagram pages!!!  Their pictures speak for themselves.  You will be amazed!  @theplasticnp @lasertechtaylor @thestephanieglow @theresadoeslasers @carydeuber @lipsbykyra I never write reviews unless I truly mean it.  I take reviews seriously.  I rely heavily on reviews so I hope you take my review into consideration as you make your decision to book an appointment with this amazing team.  I wish I could work here!!!!  lol...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marci Woodruff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy with my skin treatments at Lemmon Avenue! Bryer has transformed my very sun damaged skin on face, chest and arms using both HALO and BBL laser. I'm absolutely blown away with the results and with his professionalism.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been getting injections for about 5 years now and have been a “botched” victim on multiple occasions (well, it was totally my fault for being cheap, you DO get what you pay for).. so believe me when I say I am VERY picky now when it comes to my face and who I let near it with a needle!!! I just recently visited Jen to get my lips done and the minute I walked out to my car afterward I immediately booked my next appointment I was SOO HAPPY with her work! She is an artist when it comes to lips and made me feel so calm and confident by asking me questions and GENUINELY caring about how I wanted my lips to look because I’m very particular about the shape, size and symmetry of them! Injectors like Jen are RARE and I am sooooo thankful for her!! Can’t wait to go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brittni taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this place ! Jen is my injector and she is beyond talented . I moved to Texas a few years ago and I was so nervous I wouldn’t be able to find an injector that cares about not just making money and being ethical about what they do to my face, but I found Jen and I couldn’t be happier about the progress of my face. I was a bit disappointed when I learned I needed to get some of my filler dissolved due to migration but I just trusted Jen & I’m so thankful I did . My face looks better than it ever has and I’ve been getting injections for almost 10 years now. Thank you !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Tache
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can not recommend this staff enough! Sivan has done two Kybella treatments for me, plus Botox and chin and cheek augmentation and I LOVE LOVE LOVE my results! She has been amazing to work with and I’ve never felt more confident than I do now.  The whole office staff has been so kind and helpful and I can’t wait to go back for more services in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nubia De Leon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I followed Jen’s work for years and this year, I finally booked a lip filler appointment. I’m just upset I didn’t do it sooner 😂 The staff at Lemmon Avenue is very welcoming and nice. There’s a reason why Jen is always booked up! Despite her talent and popularity, she is very down to earth. I’m obsessed with my lips and just booked a touch up 💋 you will not regret getting work done here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simply Styled
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would leave five stars for everyone else at this offie who was so kind. Jen, however has by far the worst bedside manner of any provider I have ever had in my life. I came in for a consultation for a procedure, which  was $100 and was available to be scheduled on her website, so I figured it wouldn't be a problem. However, it soon appeared to be a big problem. I came into the room and sat down while she stared at me. I felt so uncomfortable, so I just started asking questions. She was very irritated with me for asking questions about the procedure. I have never had any work done, so I felt that asking what I needed, how much I needed, what types, pain level, cost, do I need time off work, etc. were all valid, but she acted very annoyed. I asked questions for maybe one minute before she interrupted me and said "so do you want to do it today yes or no?" I felt panicked and honestly taken aback by how blatantly disrespectful, cold, and short her attitude was. I honestly did not feel comfortable at all with her anymore as a result of her manner and I didn’t even know it was an option to get it that day. Not to mention the cost would be about $600 more than I thought it would be based on my research, which is fine, everyone should charge their worth…but I was just surprised and needed time to consider that. I truly don't know if there was a misunderstanding or what I did wrong to make her act so angry at me, but I felt that I was not to be obligated to get the procedure day of so I could think it through, digest what she told me (even though she didn't want to answer my questions), and come back when I was ready. After all, I did schedule a consultation, not a procedure. However when I told her I would come back to get it done, she made a comment to the effect of her not having time for low paying appointments like me. Right after that, my mind was made. No thank you miss mama. I will not be having someone who has such an issue with me putting needles in my face. I really hope she values my hard-earned $100 she will be keeping for my 3 minute appointment since I will not be able to go back due to the lack of professionalism on her part. I personally think that $100 for 3 minutes isn't a very low paying appointment, and if she feels that way, my suggestion would to be kinder and more respectful of your patients who want to learn about their procedures, want to hear your advice and expertise, and PLEASE just show a little compassion. If this were the case, I would have come back and paid the other $680! I am sure she is very good and very skilled at what she does, but I have since gone to someone else who has so much respect for me as their patient and has a bedside manner. I have no idea what I did to make her so furious but I wish her and especially her patients the absolute best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofia Darvischi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I seriously do not know where to start with my review, because I have so many amazing things to say about this place! The space is absolutely beautiful, and the kind greetings from the staff reflect that. I have been seeing Stephanie for a couple of months now for Microneedling and most recently lip filler and I sincerely enjoy my appointments with her. She is sooo sweet, knowledgeable, and always addresses my concerns with the utmost professionalism. Not only that, the results from my treatments with her have boosted my confidence more than she knows and I am genuinely grateful she is my nurse. I am so happy she is at Lemmon Ave full time now!! Also, I recently took my mom for a consult with Dr. Deuber and he was great about explaining my moms options thoroughly to her. She decided to get some botox, prf, and a lip flip during her visit so she was squeezed in with Cary who was an absolute doll. I knew my mom was enjoying herself. Haha! I will definitely be back many more times.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maleigh Barrington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an appointment with Payton a few months back, and she exceeded all of my expectations. This was my first time, but she made me feel extremely comfortable, and calmed my nerves. Payton is sweet, patient, and knowledgeable. I definitely recommend booking with Payton for all your needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Bass
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Sivan RN is not just what meets the eye...

She is gorgeous for sure, but within three seconds of meeting her you feel at ease, not judged, and you can relax a little knowing she is going to give you what you need most; the right service and product for your face!! She makes me feel welcome, and never like another name and appointment she has to "get through" that day. Thank you for my beautiful "me" that I didn't know I had!! I have been seeing her a year now, and I’ll never look back!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lacy Kelley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was injected here a few years back by an injector that has since lost their license for injecting expired products. user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Leonard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve visited twice now for a Hydraclear facial. Not only did I have a phenomenal experience when visiting the office (so clean, comfortable, and such a convenient location), my skin has NEVER LOOKED BETTER. Not to brag (okay, maybe a little), but I’ve gotten multiple compliments on how bright, fresh, and clear my skin looks. If you haven’t had the chance to visit, I highly recommend Lemmon Ave. Also, Taylor is amazing, informative, and overall fun to talk to. Do yourself a favor and go!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in, a newbie from another state, and with some major lip migration (I didn’t even know that was a thing! 😭) They were extremely honest (which I appreciate beyond measure), and reworked my lips. I couldn’t be more grateful! I had a plastic surgeon before who was extremely heavy handed as well. Lip filler appointments were not only extremely painful, but I bruised so much. I would dread them.

After dissolving at Lemmon Avenue with Cary (ouch but worth it), Jen was who I scheduled to see for my filler follow up. I fell in LOVE. With Jen. With my lips. All. Of. It. 👏🏼🥰 She is so educational and gentle. I went in expecting so much pain, and I was in shock my whole visit that I wasn’t laying in a chair ready to pass out. Completely changed my injection experience and I will continue to see her. I’ve also recently gotten some Botox, cheek filler and under eye filler with PRF. I’m very happy with how it looks! I can’t say enough about Jen and how skilled and talented she is, not to mention she’s just a straight forward, down to earth person. I’ve recommended her to anyone who asks or is considering filler or Botox! Thank you for all that you do to keep us feeling beautiful! 💛

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Marie Smidt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Kyra,  is an absolute gem in the world of cosmetic nursing. From the moment I stepped into her office, I knew I was in good hands. Kyra's professionalism, expertise, and genuine care for her patients shine through in everything she does.

Her meticulous attention to detail and commitment to understanding her patients' needs are truly commendable. Kyra took the time to listen to my concerns and goals, providing me with personalized recommendations tailored to achieve the results I desired.

Not only is Kyra exceptionally skilled at what she does, but she also creates a warm and welcoming environment that immediately puts you at ease. Her passion for her work is evident, and she goes above and beyond to ensure her patients feel comfortable and confident throughout the entire process.

If you're considering any cosmetic treatments, look no further than Kyra . She is truly a master of her craft, and I cannot recommend her highly enough. Thank you, Kyra, for your exceptional care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christi Trammell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Theresa is very kind and knowledgeable with skincare and treatment. First time I could look in a mirror and feel confident in my skin. I couldn’t say enough kind words about Theresa. Jen did the best job I’ve ever had with injectables, her experience and knowledge shows. She gave me different options to approach my insecurities and balancing my face. You get what you pay for, and here you are paying for a staff who knows what they are doing. I wouldn’t go anywhere else for facial and injectable treatments. I hope one day they will offer B-12 shots.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time getting lip filler after searching thru so many injectors went with Jen and had 0 regrets. Was super nervous but Jen definitely made me feel comfortable and at ease and loved the results. Will definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Woods
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always enjoy my experience at Lemmon Ave. Payton corrected my lips and made them so much better. I trust her with anything when it comes to my face. She is so kind, welcoming, and knowledgeable. Thankful to have her as my injector.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Rachel

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Untch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen has done my Botox for 3 years now and I refuse to go anywhere else. Thank you for continuing to increase my confidence and making me feel comfortable and beautiful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen made me feel so welcomed and comfortable throughout the entire process of getting lip, cheek and nose filler. She completely calmed my nerves and made me feel at ease. I will definitely be going back to her and referring family and friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Horner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to Jen twice and I love her! Gotten lips done and Botox twice! I had to cancel my last touch up appointment due to me getting pregnant,  but I will definitely be going back to her as soon as I’m able!

user_reviews_extended.Name: morgan sanders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Jen to have botox in my jaw for TMJ and also had a full lip augmentation and baby botox. I cannot thank Jen enough for making me feel like my self again. I was apprehensive to book an appointment because I felt "out of place" but so glad I did. Jen was extremely welcoming and caring; not once during my appointment did I feel rushed or pressured. She took her time and was very meticulous with her injections. I would reccomend jen to any of my family or friends. We all deserve to feel confident in our own skin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Malo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The care and service here will make you question why you ever went anywhere else. No joke. I can’t say enough amazing things or rave enough about the staff and the level of care I have received with Dr. Dauwe and his staff. I am a “newish patient” 35 years old, and I’ve been only a few times for fillers and Botox. The moment I walk in the office, Julie is just the sweetest, kindest and most down to earth person. She is so friendly and welcoming. Not just a hi, how are you? She genuinely engages in conversations with me,  and I remember I was having some “ouch moments” while getting my lip filler and she came in and comforted me.  Just amazing.
