I love coming for my visits and I leave so happy with my results and service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandi Valenzuela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cary is amazing! She's conservative, caring, empathetic and highly educated. Her technique is efficient, precise and I feel little to no pain with most procedures. I trust her 100 percent! She's so fun and a joy to work with which definitely helps to relieve any nervousness, and I leave feeling happy and excited about my results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ursula
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is extremely friendly.  Carey is so knowledgeable.  HONESTY is their policy and that'swhat I love!  It truly is an awesome place! Definitely coming back. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Malzac
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen was extremely polite in the short time I met her. I received dysport during my first visit and it was quick and easy. We talked about possible treatment for my aging. She made quick suggestions and I have a follow up appt set for next week! I’m excited to finally get some lips and see about the other treatments that were suggested the last time we met. I was hoping for a more in depth consultation (since that’s what I was there for) with more information regarding the suggested treatments. I think we met for 5 minutes and botox is quick. I’m pleased with my results and she’s always been kind and responsive on Instagram which shows a level of customer service you don’t see anywhere else. Thank you, Jen! I look forward to my follow up appt and future treatments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Lovely
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lemmon Ave. is the best! I travel for my appointments from Houston because I absolutely love my results! Sivan is thoroughly dedicated and committed to excellence in enhancing what you desire about yourself! She is honest, straight forward and definitely a knowledgeable expert! During my 1st visit she asked me "What bothers you or what do you want to improve today?" She addressed this and even allowed me to meet with Dr. Deuber immediately so that I could get a quick consult on my submental fat. I appreciate Sivan and her team and I'm so glad she is the RN that administers my injections!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hagen Sparks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen is the best around. user_reviews_extended.Name: Daria Panahy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Jen! She is so accommodating and listens to my concerns and goals. She is for sure the best injector around. I wouldn’t go anywhere other than Lemon Avenue for my injections!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hustler Nails
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I got a full lip done by Jen this past weekend. It was my first time ever getting injections of any kind, normally I’m nervous before doing anything of this kind of nature (Eyelashes, microblading, facials etc) but I had a peace of mind because I knew I was going to be in good hands. She’s naturally a pro and she post her work on Instagram so I knew beforehand she was going to take good care of me.
Jen met me in the room, even though she was wearing a mask I could tell she had a big smile on her face and her positivity / happy mood gravitated to me and any remaining worries immediately went away. I immediately felt comfortable as if I was with a friend! She took some photos and told me that the injection I initially wanted wasn’t going to be a good fit and suggested the full lip. Although that wasn’t what I asked for on the schedule, she took me back and did my full lip with no complaints. She gave me two things to distract me from the pain along with numbing cream. My lips look absolutely beautiful, my confidence is through the roof. I cried when I got back in the car because I haven’t felt that confident in a really really long time. I explained to her that I wanted my cheeks done and she said whenever I’m ready to call and I can get on her schedule. My lips do not hurt and it’s been two days, they look so good and I’m getting non stop compliments on Instagram.

-@haileynicholl // @hustlernailz

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Farnham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Lemmon Avenue Plastic Surgery. Not only is their office beautiful, but their office staff are welcoming and friendly! Sivan has been doing my lips for a while now and I am ABSOLUTELY obsessed with them! She is truly the best! Knowledgeable in her work and it shows! 💋

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trista Herrmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: When it comes to skincare and treatments Trish is the best! She has done microneedling, chemical peels, and microneedling on me, and each time she goes above, and beyond my expectations. She is attentive, focused, and very knowledgeable about skin care! I am a client for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cannot recommend this place enough!! Everyone is so friendly and helpful here. I saw Tetchie today for full facial balancing and she is a magician! I will be a forever customer here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eternity Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came to see Paige. She does an amazing job on educating you as well as giving you a great game plan for what you need. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my lips beside her. She really knows how to shape my lips and give me the dream lips I want! Would recommend her to all my friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ash
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve visited multiple times to see Jen and Taylor and they’re always super personable! Jen makes sure to ask questions during injections so that she knows how to please you and make sure you leave happy, she even gave me and sample of sunscreen when she saw that I was sun burnt 😂. Even when I have questions out of the office Taylor is very quick to reply back which I appreciate!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sivan & Jen are absolutely amazing & truly passionate about what they do. After an incident left my face unrecognizable for a month, it was really difficult for me to look in a mirror & see myself the same way. My girlfriend Kortni referred me to Sivan & I was so nervous that I watched her Instagram for weeks before making my appt. She really took her time to get to know me, listened to my concerns & formulated an injection plan to get me to where I wanted to be in a safe & realistic way. Since my initial consultation, Sivan has done my lips twice & each time the shape was PERFECT. She created the perfect cupids bow and symmetry (I had no upper-lip at all y'all, paper-thin). She has also done my tear troughs, baby botox & jawline which helped my TMJ. My 3rd appt was with Jen, she injected my lips & did my cheek pop. The shape was identical to what Sivan had created, she just leveled me up. Then last week Jen did my 4th full-lip & my chin. I could not be happier. My lips are finally the perfect size & shape & everything I have always wanted and my side profile is so much more feminine (no more face-slimming Snapchat filters or tilting my head to hide my profile in photos). The final result is totally worth it 100%, trust the process. Thank you @lipsbysivan & @lipsbyjen for giving me my confidence back & for being such amazing boss babe women. I would never trust anyone with my face else, because, it's my face. It's worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Sapien
user_reviews_extended.Description: Taylor Cooley’s professionalism is remarkable. I’ve had several laser techs who fell short from being as knowledgeable as he is. He listens well and explains the treatments in depth. It’s exceptional how comfortable you will feel in his presence. You can rest assure that his equipment is the latest and greatest, 1 appointment in, and I’ve had extraordinary results!! I’m super excited for the end results. Thanks Taylor!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marleigh Essler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had the most wonderful experience with Paige! She is very knowledgeable and personable. I have been going to her for years and always leave very happy with my service. Cannot recommend her enough, she is fantastic!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Payton with a 10/10 for injector realness! She listens and gave me exactly what I was wanting! Such a pleasant visit from the moment I was welcomed to the moment I had to escort myself out so I didn’t spend more money. Will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Alvira

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy M

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Hunt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cary was amazing! She made me feel so comfortable, and she was extremely knowledgeable about anatomy and the correct procedures and what gave the best results. user_reviews_extended.Name: Nellie Swindall
user_reviews_extended.Description: So I was seen by Jen back in March and I can’t say enough how outstanding Jen and basically every staff member I encountered were! user_reviews_extended.Name: Shellie Van Druten

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Galeazzi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first lip injection appointment with SIVAN & I am absolutely in love with my lips! I can't wait for my next appointment! Sivan is truly the best I wouldn't trust anyone else with my lips. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Mendoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen is the best!! Bottom line, I TRUST her! She is the best at recommending exactly what you need without ever feeling pressured to do so. Her services have made me feel so confident and beautiful. Truly a master at what she does!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chayce Dowdey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing staff, pristine facility and luxury services from the best providers in the country. The atmosphere here is so welcoming, and it really feels like a day spa rather than a surgery center. I ONLY go to Lemmon Avenue Plastic Surgery Center, and will only give my business to the best of the best. Sivan and Dr. Dauwe, you have a patient for life in me!

Sivan- Personable, knowledgeable, honest and pays CLOSE attention to detail. When you’re working on someone’s face, that’s obviously the most important thing. Too many times I have gone the cheaper route only to end up upset and searching for another provider to fix what the previous one did. I am so glad those days are over! YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR. Sivan is the definition of a professional. She doesn’t take her job lightly and she is dedicated to customizing a treatment plan that fits every one of her patients personal needs. I’m so thankful to have her as my injector, and I’m even more thankful that a practice was opened and only the most quality providers were considered here.

Dr. Dauwe- He’s on fire for his work. He’s excited to help you and excited to watch you transform. I love that!!! Nothing puts you more at ease than knowing your surgeon is PASSIONATE. He is proud of his work and eager to do it. I love my new girls, 1 year post op and looking better than ever.

This place I call home!  Thank you thank you thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LINDSEY SHERIDAN
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paige is AMAZING! She puts her patients first and is receptive to their goals. She is knowledgeable in all areas and gives her professional opinion. She makes you feel like a princess! 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: bobbiejo schneck
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time with Jen for Botox, and she was AMAZING! I normally have trouble with Botox placement. user_reviews_extended.Description: I have seen Sivan, RN for facial services and she is hands down a master at what she does, lips, botox, literally working magic with non surgical procedures!! user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlynn McNutt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first experience with this amazing team back in October for a breast reduction. I was super intimidated at first, although the surgery was something I’d longed for 4+ years, the idea of permanently altering my body was still quite scary. Those fears and the anxiety didn’t last long after getting to meet Dr. Phillip Dauwe and his coordinators, Julie and Sarah. I truly felt like they were rooting for me the whole time while waiting for my insurance approval, and that meant so much to me. They were so warm and welcoming, but also very serious about their work and so informative every step of the way. They weren’t many times I would come to a visit and have questions about the procedure or recovery because they were all so amazing about providing me with all the info I needed! Now 5 months post op and so happy with my results and proud to say a good friend of mine has also been seen by them! I can not recommend this practice enough to anyone thinking about cosmetic work. The quality of not only the work, but the people as well, is unbeatable ♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Bolding
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had my first visit with Sivan in February. I came in for a full cheek augmentation and masseter Botox to help reduce my terrible clenching and facial pain. During my consult, i inquired about other treatments and she was thankfully very honest about what i did or didn’t need. A few days after treatment i had a minor freakout moment when my Botox kicked in, and i began to panic due to my anxiety issues. I was so embarrassed, but I reached out to Sivan at 9:30pm just to make sure i was ok. I was not expecting her to respond to me considering it being after business hours. She was prompt in her response and helped to calm my nerves which i very much appreciated. I will be coming back and am so glad to have found Sivan!

user_reviews_extended.Name: yesenia velazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jens work is amazing! She did my non sergical nose job and lip fillers and I can definitely say She’s very professional at what she does 10/10 loved my experience so I had to book again ❤️🤷‍♀️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Giraudo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Taylor is a GENIUS! I had a consultation a few months back and he truly listened to my concerns, answered all my questions and gave his advice. He really took his time in examining my skin, pointing out that what I really had was melasma. He suggested I go with the Ultra Glo laser opposed to the BBL which is what many other laser technicians recommended.  He let me know that the BBL treatment would actually darken my melasma. I am so glad that I listened to him and trusted him because he absolutely knew what he was doing. The entire Ultra Glo took a few minutes and he walked me through the entire process. A few days of dry skin but then I could see the dark spots and melasma disappearing. I am completely satisfied with my results, and a little more!

title: Dr. Nicholas Haddock
address: 1801 Inwood Rd, Dallas, TX 75390, United States

user_reviews.Name: Nataliya
user_reviews.Description: I extend my sincere gratitude to Dr. Haddock for his exceptional professionalism and extensive knowledge. His remarkable breast reconstruction saved my life, and I am deeply appreciative of his expertise and dedication. Dr. Haddock stands out as the most knowledgeable and compassionate doctor I have encountered. Thank you for your exceptional surgical skills and unwavering commitment to patient care.

user_reviews.Name: Isabel Gaeta
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Haddock and his team are amazing.  I was deciding between Dr. Haddock and another doctor at MD Anderson in Houston, and I chose Dr. Haddock because I was impressed in our first meeting with his knowledge and proposed game plan for me. I had a bilateral prophylactic mastectomy that included both DIEP and LAT flaps.  Throughout the entire process Dr. Haddock and his team were professional and explained the pros and cons and were patient answering all my questions.  They had to adapt a couple times and I trusted them completely throughout the process.  I am happy and grateful with the results but even more thankful for Dr. Haddock’s support throughout the entire process because it’s a scary and emotional journey.  I highly recommend him and his team…you will be in the best care.

user_reviews.Name: Janice Reidhar
user_reviews.Description: I was referred to Dr. Haddock by my oncologist in Arkansas. I was very worried that this 6 hour trip down here would be a waste of my time and I would end up disappointed. But what did happen was I left feeling so relieved and excited about what he can do to help me. Not only was Dr. Haddock great to talk to but his reassurance of how he could fix my issues was even better than I could have imagined.  His staff were super nice and very welcoming.  I can’t wait till I have my surgery!

user_reviews.Name: Sheri Maples
user_reviews.Description: Great staff and doctor. He explains everything that he is doing and all my options.  Wonderful doctor.  I will definitely be getting my procedure done with Dr. Haddock.

user_reviews.Description: Amazing consultation with Dr. Haddock and his wonderful staff.  Looking very forward to my next steps of my breast cancer journey.  He's one that sees and listens.

user_reviews.Description: As soon as I met Dr. Haddock I  knew my choice was right. He is very informative, answered all of my questions and made me feel at ease with the journey that I was about to go through. His staff was very kind and showed concern.

I have recommended them to several friends who a both survivors like myself and those who are not and they have all had the same experience.  I cannot imagine going through this journey without this team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maleeha Aziz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have the BRCA1 gene mutation and a very strong family history of breast cancer and have been hyper-aware of my risk since I was a child. At 25, I was seriously looking into prophylactic surgery options. After consulting with several surgeons, I chose Dr. Haddock for my DIEP flap reconstruction at 29, following a robotic nipple-sparing mastectomy.

From very the beginning, Dr. Haddock impressed me with his extensive knowledge and passion for breast reconstruction. His high volume of procedures and remarkable efficiency were key factors in my decision. My DIEP flap procedure, which took just five hours, was notably quicker than what other surgeons had anticipated!

He has a very direct communication style, which for me took some getting used to as it was a bit of a departure from the warmer, more nuanced approach I was accustomed to—he’s all business, very academic, and straight to the point (no fluff). But I appreciated how he always took the time to answer my many questions with patience and thoroughness.

His calm, straightforward manner may come off as stoic at times, and I’ll admit that in the beginning, I struggled to express my concerns because of it. It was intimidating, to say the least, especially when you’re interacting with a surgeon who is so well-respected in the field and who is also significantly older than you are. Often younger patients have their concerns invalidated and dismissed but I was so grateful that was not the case here.

If you ever feel like something’s unclear or you have lingering concerns, don’t hesitate to talk to him. While he can’t know what’s on your mind unless you share it, I understand that it can feel daunting. I was nervous too, but once I worked up the courage to speak with him, I was amazed at how approachable and understanding he was. He listened with immense grace, never interrupting or making me feel like my worries were unwelcome. His kindness and thoughtfulness during our conversation left me feeling truly heard, and I walked away feeling relieved, empowered, and genuinely happy. It made all the difference.

What also stood out to me was his humility. When I brought up another female surgeon I had considered, he had nothing but glowing praise for her. I felt this was a rare and admirable trait among surgeons I’ve consulted with. He was also receptive to feedback about how hard it can be for patients to express their needs, acknowledging the power dynamics that can make those conversations challenging. The fact that he took this feedback to heart really shows how deeply he cares about his patients’ experiences.

And let’s not forget his nurse, Molly—she’s an absolute gem! Molly was a ray of sunshine throughout the entire process. Her warmth and empathy made every step of this journey so much easier. Together, Dr. Haddock and Molly make a fantastic team, and their personalities really complement each other.

As far as results go, my breast reconstruction exceeded all my expectations. It’s extraordinary what Dr. Haddock was able to achieve, especially given that he started with nothing after the mastectomy. The aesthetic outcome is pretty impressive. Sometimes I am still amazed at how natural it all looks. For my fellow millennial HP fans, the best way I can describe it is that he is the Albus Dumbledore of the surgical world in skill and temperament. He has magic in his hands and I hope people get to experience it for years to come.

While this journey has been emotionally and physically intense, I am deeply grateful for the exceptional care from Dr. Haddock, Molly and his team. Although I still may not agree with everything, I appreciate his perspective and now understand why things happened the way they did. I am truly thankful for the positive outcome despite the struggles along the way.

I highly recommend Dr. Haddock for anyone considering breast reconstruction. His surgical expertise is pretty extraordinary. I went into this journey with uncertainty, but I came away with incredible results and gratitude and respect for Dr. Haddock as both a surgeon and a person.

needed to be with some issues. So far we are impressed with the quickness and serve we are receiving, unlike our trip here two years ago with a doctor in another area of expertise, drop the ball which resulted in life changing and devastating events in my life, change forever and can't be fix now because a doctor was to afraid to speak up . user_reviews_extended.Description: To make a long story short, I woke up on the morning following my breast implant surgery with almost no pain (and this was without pain medication). user_reviews_extended.Description: I met with Dr. Haddock to discuss a reduction as a result of some tissue that needed to be removed. I also had questions around the various options that might be available to me to accomplish the optimal result for me.  I explained that my goal was to feel as good as I could about it.  He was so patient and real as he explained in layman's terms why some options would not work or would not be advised.  He also explained other aspects of the surgery and potential post surgery process that may make a difference as I made my decision.  I never felt pressured or as though my questions were not important.  He was kind, compassionate and real.  I will keep you posted but it was an easy decision to select him as my surgeon!

title: DR. MICHAEL LEE
address: 4311 Oak Lawn Ave #365, Dallas, TX 75219, United States

user_reviews.Name: Nancy H
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had a facelift, chemical peel, and eye blepharoplasty with Dr. Michael Lee, and I could not be happier with the results or the experience. Dr. Lee is exceptionally talented, highly skilled, and truly gifted at what he does. Beyond his surgical expertise, he is warm, friendly, which made me feel completely at ease throughout the entire process.

What also sets Dr. Lee apart is his Concierge Physician approach. The
private, one-on-one care and the 24-hour access to his incredible team, who were always available, attentive, and supportive. The level of personalized care and attention I received was far beyond my expectations.

I would absolutely rate Dr. Lee 11 out of 10 — he is the best of the best!
Nancy Hansen

user_reviews.Name: Erika Reaven
user_reviews.Description: Dr.Lee is truly amazing and very talented. I saw him in 2017 for my first surgical procedure and have been very happy with my results. Casey, Emily and his staff are also very sweet and welcoming. I recently saw him again for my mommy makeover consultation. I really appreciated the kindness and honesty provided during the appointment. Pricing is reasonable for what you receive in return - a staff who truly cares about you throughout the entire process and responds to any questions you may have in a timely manner. I am excited to have Dr. Lee again as my surgeon for my next procedure in a few months! Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Bernice Das
user_reviews.Description: From the initial consultation to the surgery, the entire process with Dr. Lee was seamless. I visited him for a lip lift, and I couldn't be more pleased with the results. Dr. Lee not only demonstrated exceptional skill, but he also went above and beyond to ensure that my husband and I fully understood the risks and benefits of the procedure. He emphasized the importance of a conservative approach, reminding us that less is often more with these types of surgeries. I highly recommend Dr. Lee.

user_reviews.Name: S F
user_reviews.Description: I set out to find the best surgeon in the DFW area and I truly believe I found him in Dr. Lee. He is an absolute perfectionist and artist. The entire process was easy and painless and he and his staff were wonderful every step of the way. Dr. Lee listened to my concerns, answered my questions, and made me feel comfortable from start to finish. The post-op follow up has been excellent as well. And the results are better than I expected!  Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Randalyn Houser
user_reviews.Description: After 4 pregnancies, the last of which I carried twins to 2 days shy of full term, my body had been stretched to its limits and beyond. I've always been proud of my body and the amazing things it has done but I missed looking on the outside like I felt on the inside- strong and confident. My ab muscles were very separated and caused my body to compensate in ways that created pain in other areas especially my back. I had a ton of extra skin in my belly and after nursing for a combination of  6 years my breasts were drooping in ways I didn't know an A cup could droop. After my initial consultation with Dr. Lee I knew he was the right doctor to put my trust in for the procedures I wanted. Everything about him and his practice is professional, caring and trustworthy. You can tell that he is a perfectionist and takes a lot of pride in practicing with excellence- in both the artistry of surgery as well as relationally with his patients. My actual procedure went very smoothly and recovery, although not easy, was very manageable and I could not be more pleased with my results! When I went in for my two week follow up I passed out in the chair during my appointment (I don't do well with medical stuff and apparently even snipping the ends of my stitches was enough to do me in). I woke up hearing Dr. Lee say "you take care of people all the time, just relax and let us take care of you." I share this slightly embarrassing story because I really did feel incredibly well cared for every moment of this "mommy makeover" journey and I am so grateful for Dr. Lee and his amazing staff!

user_reviews.Name: Suzanne Gould
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Michael Lee is a highly skilled and meticulous surgeon. I had a neck and lower face lift,  and I am beyond satisfied. I look 10-15 years younger! He has a calming presence and superb pre op and post op communication skill set that makes you feel at ease. I highly recommend Dr. Lee for all your aesthetic needs.

user_reviews.Name: B Hedrick
user_reviews.Description: My experience with Dr. Lee and his team was professional and extraordinary on all levels. Dr. Lee is a meticulously talented surgeon and he is a perfectionist. His work is impeccable, he and his team so professional, but also so personable. I trust him completely, he is simply the best! I highly recommend him.

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Michael Lee is awesome. He fixed my nose a few years ago and I went back for a facelift. I had great results and no pain with quick recovery. He's the best in my opinion and he truly cares about his patients. His staff are all great also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: E J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I feel robbed

I feel totally robbed. While Dr.Lee’s staff focused only on scheduling a date as early as possible, they conveniently failed to mention some small details like: your 8,000 deposit is non-refundable, and you will be charged over 20,000 usd in penalty fees if you change (NOT CANCEL, JUST CHANGE!) your surgery date within 6 weeks of your original date. The penalty fees alone could get you another surgery with an incredibly competent doctor.
All in all, the experience left an extremely bad taste in my mouth. The team, specifically the patient coordinator Emily, was pushy, rude, and completely apathetic.
Before commiting to a date, Emily also implied I could have a lower bleph with my face and neckift if I desired, while after the deposit his staff told me the lower bleph was an absolute non negotiable, forcibly bringing my price up to 50k. (Without the possible added 20k for a date change!)
While Dr. Lee’s team fumbled the ball big time, another doctor’s team in the area did an excellent job. This other doctor includes revisions in his fee, allows you to move your date in case of an emergency, and overall puts YOU first. I am now two months out from my face and necklift and look incredible! I suggest you skip Dr Lee and check out other Board Certified Plastic Surgeons in the Dallas area. A doctor who puts money first will NEVER treat you like you deserve, as Dr. Lee and his team have shamelessly proven. They may have stolen my 8,000 dlls but they don’t have to steal yours.

title: Dr. Liland - Park Cities Plastic Surgery
address: 3500 Oak Lawn Ave Ste 160, Dallas, TX 75219, United States

owner.name: Dr. Liland - Park Cities Plastic Surgery (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Darbey Jimenez
user_reviews.Description:
I had an amazing experience with my breast lift and augmentation. Dr. Liland was my surgeon, Allison was my CRNA, and Angela was my nurse—and I truly can’t say enough good things about all of them. From the moment I came in for my consultation, the front desk team was sweet and inviting. Dr. Liland took his time answering all of my questions, let me try on different sizes, and made thoughtful recommendations that made me feel confident in my decision. I was able to schedule surgery just two weeks out.

On surgery day, my nurse Angela was absolutely amazing—so kind, incredibly knowledgeable, and walked me through everything step by step. Allison came in to ask final questions, and I was honestly shocked at how comfortable and at ease I felt with both of them. You can truly feel their level of experience and professionalism in every interaction.

At my one-week follow-up, Angela thoroughly checked all of my incisions and patiently answered every question I had. There was absolutely no pressure or upselling—just genuine care, honesty, and expertise. I love my results so far and can’t wait for my friends and family to see them. I am so grateful to this entire team and would recommend them without hesitation.

user_reviews.Name: Nancy Dziekowicz
user_reviews.Description: Dr Liland is an exceptional plastic surgeon whose skill, professionalism, and attention to detail truly stand out. From the initial consultation through follow-up care, I felt listened to, respected, and completely confident in the process. Dr. Liland is thorough, honest, and takes the time to explain options clearly, which made every decision feel well-informed and comfortable. The results exceeded my expectations and look natural and refined.

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Weber
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Liland and his team. I felt safe and comfortable throughout my journey with the surgery and recovery. I had a mommy makeover and the results were amazing! “Life Changing” Dr. Liland is an artist in his field. His before and after pictures are what drew me in but he’s is an amazing caring person, down to earth guy and makes you feel comfortable and confident in his ability. His team is the best. They are very easy to talk to and were available to me throughout my recovery. I am so glad I chose Dr.Liland and I highly recommend him to anyone that is looking for the best!

user_reviews.Name: Willie
user_reviews.Description:
I originally shared my full experience on RealSelf and have also submitted a formal complaint to the Texas Medical Board, because what happened to me under Dr. David Liland’s care should never happen to anyone — especially a massive weight loss patient. After losing over 200 pounds, I was finally ready to remove my excess skin and close this chapter of my journey. I went into surgery feeling hopeful and was told I’d be receiving an extended thigh lift — one that would properly address the severity of my loose skin down to my knees. Unfortunately, that is not what I received.

My results were uneven, incomplete, and left me with deformities and no definition in my thighs. The emotional and physical toll has been devastating, made worse when I was told I’d need to pay again for a revision to fix work that should have been done correctly the first time.

Since then, I’ve consulted with five other board-certified plastic surgeons in the Dallas–Fort Worth area, including Dr. Al Aly, who literally wrote the textbook chapters on massive weight loss body contouring. Every single one confirmed my results are not consistent with a properly executed MWL thigh lift and identified major technical errors.

In my opinion, Dr. Liland is not qualified to operate on massive weight loss patients, despite advertising these procedures. Patients like me — who’ve worked hard to lose hundreds of pounds — deserve surgeons with true MWL expertise, not someone using them to gain experience.

I wish someone had been this transparent before my surgery. If you’ve gone through massive weight loss, please research your surgeon carefully and don’t be swayed by social media photos or marketing claims. I’m sharing this so others don’t endure the same pain, expense, and regret I have.

user_reviews.Name: Senah Taylor
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Liland and his entire staff are seeing to none. Dr Liland has performed 3 breast surgeries on me, I have been a returning client for many years due to his exceptional work. Starting with the consultation process and ending with the follow up aftercare, I couldn’t be more pleased with the exceptional care I have received over the years. I have sent numerous friends and referrals to Dr Liland and they have all been more than pleased with his work. Angela, Dr. Lilands RN goes above and beyond to answer any questions and to address any concerns. I will forever be a client, furthermore, I will be forever thankful for the confidence he has helped restore. I will always send my friends and family to Dr. Liland and his staff.

user_reviews.Name: Victoria Smith
user_reviews.Description:
I had my breast augmentation with Dr. Liland at Park City Plastic Surgery in December 2023, and I truly couldn’t be happier! I had wanted to come here for a long time, especially after seeing how amazing his work was on my cousins—he’s done three, maybe even four of their augmentations, and several friends and family friends too. His reputation is top-notch, and now I understand why everyone raves about him.

Dr. Liland is incredibly skilled, but just as importantly, he’s kind, patient, and makes you feel confident and cared for throughout the entire process. His staff is just as wonderful—Maria and Betty greet you the second you walk in with big smiles and genuine warmth. During my orientation and surgery prep, Olivia (who was there temporarily) and Angela were the nurses helping me, and they were phenomenal. I seriously can’t thank them enough! Angela, in particular, has continued to be a go-to for me anytime I have questions—even months/years later, she always makes time to help.

I didn’t post before-and-after photos since it’s a breast augmentation, but I did include 2 regular photos from before and after my surgery so you can see the difference. I’m so happy with my results—they look natural (at least I think so), fit my body perfectly (per Doc rec), and have given me such a boost in confidence.

If you’re considering anything, I highly recommend Dr. Liland and his team. He’s truly in his prime and can do it all—and do it all exceptionally well.

user_reviews.Name: Lisa Napoli
user_reviews.Description: Dr Liland was recommended to me by my Dermatologist. Whoever heard of a Plastic Surgeon doing consultations on a Saturday? Well Dr Liland does, and it was so convenient. In my initial consultation the procedure was explained thoroughly by not only Dr Liland but any further questions I had in the days after his knowledgeable staff were able to answer. Post procedure his team were amazing with following up on my progress. I am thrilled with my results, they've exceeded my expectations. I would have no hesitation in going back in the future.

Dr. Liland's energy is amazing, his experience and expertise are second to none. I cannot thank him and his staff enough. If you’re searching for a surgeon with precision, knowledge, and an artistic ability to make a patient look their absolute best, he is the one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After extensive research, I scheduled a complimentary consultation with Dr. Liland. During the consultation he was very thorough, a great listener and paid attention to my concerns. The front desk staff were great with costumer service, answering questions and scheduling. We booked my surgery and received all of the information needed to prepare and answer any questions that we had. Dr. Liland’s nurse, Angela, was FANTASTIC! The entire team was kind, thoughtful and very professional! Dr. Liland is a master at his craft with extensive experience.
My recovery has been on target 3 months post. The silicone treatment did irritate my skin but healed quickly and I resumed treatments. My scars are fading fast and I have olive complexion.

Overall, my am VERY pleased with my results and I am so happy I took the steps to go forward with the procedures. After having 3 C sections and finally feel confident, beautiful and comfortable in my own skin.
Thank you Dr. Liland and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DETRA FISHER
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Liland is the man. Him and his staff are amazing made this mommy makeover a breeze for me. Will definitely be going back for my other updates. If your looking for a trusted plastic surgeon that’s been in business for years and is very accurate please don’t hesitate to contact Dr Lilands office to get that body snatched and ready for the summer. I can finally fit in all my clothes and wear that two piece I’ve been holding on too for years. Thank you Dr Liland for making me feel so comfortable and caring about my well-being. YOU ROCK

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Hendrickson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot recommend Dr. Liland and his staff highly enough! He’s performed several procedures for me, including very tricky revisions of a facelift, necklift, and lower eyelid correction. I don’t look “done;” I just look, by another doctor’s opinion, about 20 years younger. In fact, the doctor I’m referencing was seeing me for the first time and he thought he’d gone in the wrong consultation room because my face didn’t indicate what his records showed, which was that I’m 72.

Besides that, Dr. Liland is a joy to work with. Despite his many distinguished years as a cosmetic surgeon, he’s funny, approachable, and so down-to-earth. His staff is equally wonderful. His nurse, Angela, genuinely cares about their patients and responds to concerns with lightening speed.

I interviewed several surgeons prior to engaging Dr. Liland, and none of them could have done for me what he did. Be sure to consult with him; you’ll be immediately comfortable and confident with him, as I was.

He is amazing I recommend him to all my family members and friends in Dallas and if you are outside of Dallas he is def worth the experience of knowledge and trust and such an amazing process his staff is incredible and I trusted them so much

His staff is both friendly and professional. I cannot express how highly I recommend Dr. Liland and Park Cities Plastic Surgery.

Tattoo model here from Dallas Texas . Liland has done multiple surgeries for me 2 breast augmentations and a mini face lift. He also does my Botox every 6 months . user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Perry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Liland is amazing! From his thorough consultation, advice and recommendations to his incredible work. His staff is courteous and professional. I continue to benefit from his excellent care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Watkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I even start?

You want to talk about White Glove Treatment!

From day one, on my first consultation, I could tell that not only is Liland an artist, but he and his team really enjoy what they do.

Dr. Liland has done breast revisions on several people I know, including my mother in law, and the recovery and results are always stellar.  So after losing a LOT of weight, I knew I wanted him to remove all the leftovers.  He may be known for his work on breasts, but honestly anything torso I think he can more than handle and do so beautifully.

I love that the surgical suite is on site, you don't have to deal with a hospital at all.

His Med Surg Nurse Angela is not only an angel and so good at her job, but she's a hoot and so real.  I never felt like I was being treated clinically.  I felt like I was talking to a friend that just happened to be an expert in cosmetic surgery.

I went in thinking I was just going to get a 360 lift and call it good.  No no no.  Dr. Liland took a look, and made a plan.  As I said, he's an artist and I fully believe that, unlike a lot of other surgeons, he's not just going to take your money and do whatever.  He wants to make sure the results are up to his high standards and that you're going to be happy.  He is also very up front with what your expectations should be.  He goes through the whole list.  Sometimes things aren't totally smooth, sometimes they're not totally symmetrical, here are the challenges you will go through with recovery, etc.  I had other consultations where the doctors assured me things would be perfect.  But I've done enough research to know who was telling the truth.  I never felt like I was being "sold" on the procedure.  Very low pressure, very low stress.

Pricing is up front and direct.  No hidden fees, no surprise expenses.

Like an idiot, I decided I would go back to work too soon and I decided I would wear my binder extra tight to speed up the process.  To be clear, I WAS TOLD THAT WAS A BAD IDEA.  But I did it anyway.  Because of this, I had some complications and pain.

Dr. Liland and Angela took it in stride.  They gave me their cell numbers and told me to call or text them at any time if anything wasn't working.  He called in meds for me at like 11:30PM and had me in to see him first thing in the morning the next day.

I had to do IV antibiotics because he wanted to be sure I was covered.  It's not the first time I have had to do that after a surgery, but every other time, I had to go to a hospital, park, wait, go to a room, wait some more, get the IV, check out, then go home.  Nope.  I waltzed in, they put me on a comfy couch in a lovely room with a blanket and a space heater (IVs are COLD) and I got my meds and went on with my day.

The pain management was taken very seriously.  Surgery hurts y'all.  Please don't think you're going to get sawn in half like an assistant to a bad magician and limbo your way out the door.  And I was warned that this was one of the more painful procedures.  To be fair, I have a VERY high pain tolerance, but even with that taken into account, I feel like my pain was managed really well.  At no point was I miserable, just uncomfortable.

After care for the wound itself was great.  I got all the tips and tricks and pointers on how best to heal, and not even a year out, the scar is already just kind of a light rose pink.  I have no doubt that if I continue to follow their instructions it will be almost invisible some day.

Next on the list is to get the thighs and glutes souped up, and I already know who I'm going to.  I don't even need to shop around.  This man and his team have my business, and my referrals, for life.  It's a good thing he doesn't age because I don't know what I'll do when he retires.

user_reviews.Description: I am 1 month post op from a rhinoplasty with Dr. Yash. I can confidently say that everything about my experience was incredible! The staff was so so kind and helpful. user_reviews.Name: Michael Kunen
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had an upper blepharoplasty and browpexy with Dr. Yash, and I couldn’t be happier with my results. From start to finish, he was incredibly professional, attentive, and easy to talk to. user_reviews.Name: Abdullah Khakwani
user_reviews.Description:
I had an abdominoplasty and gynecomastia surgery with Dr. Yash, and I couldn’t be happier with both the experience and the results. The level of hospitality and professionalism from the entire staff was incredible. Dr. Yash, Taylor, Tara, and the rest of the staff made me feel comfortable and genuinely cared for throughout the entire process.
The communication was outstanding. Every question I had both before and after surgery was answered clearly and patiently. Dr. Yash took the time to explain each step, set the right expectations, and make sure I understood all my options.
I really appreciated how accommodating the team was. Scheduling, follow-ups, and all the other small matters were handled quickly and kindly. They checked in on me regularly after the procedure, and I was always aware that I was in capable and compassionate hands.
The results also exceeded my expectations. The work is natural and exactly what I hoped for. I’m very grateful for Dr. Yash and his entire team. If you are looking for a surgeon and a top tier staff that have both great expertise and also can give genuine care and top-tier hospitality, I can not recommend them enough.

user_reviews.Name: Dayanara Torres
user_reviews.Description:
I don’t even know where to start because Dr. Yash truly exceeded every expectation I had. Going into this my expectations were already high and I was so confident in his ability, but somehow he still blew me away. From the beginning his bedside manner made me feel so comfortable and safe he’s such a genuine, kind person and that made the entire experience so much easier.
When my cast came off I almost cried because my nose was exactly what I had pictured for myself. Exactly. I remember being scared that I might feel like I looked like a different person after surgery, and I honestly haven’t felt that at all. I still feel like me just the best version of myself. It’s such a weird but amazing feeling seeing yourself the way you’ve always pictured yourself.
I’m only about a week and a half post op and I’m already so happy with my results. Healing has been smooth, swelling has been minimal, and my nose already looks better than I ever imagined it would at this stage. I genuinely feel happier, more confident, and lighter, and that’s something I didn’t even expect from this. Dr. Yash is not only an incredibly talented surgeon, but an amazing human. I feel so grateful I trusted him with something so personal and I truly owe him the world. I can’t recommend him enough.

The experience was smooth from start to finish, and I can finally feel confident in my own skin. Couldn’t have chosen a better surgeon. Thank you for making this such a positive journey 💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Chilcott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Life changing experience ! when I started my journey of deciding to get a tummy tuck I research out of state surgeons all over and I landed on Dr.Yash based off of his belly button, scar shape and area and how I emotionally felt talking with him and his staff. I had consultations over video chat and then again the day before my surgery. I was pretty nervous for that in the beginning but I had contact with Dr.Yash as well as his staff frequently helping me with questions and concerns and truly built a trusting relationships with everyone involved before I even stepped foot in his office. Dr.Yash went into full detail of my concerns and how exactly he could fix it not just the typical response of don’t worry it will be handled. The day of surgery I was nervous as to be expected, but everyone and I mean everyone from front desk to nursing staff and the anesthesiologist were welcoming, calm, knowledgeable and funny! Waking up I was greeted with warm smiles and laughs and a bone deep sense of being safe and cared for. I opted to stay the first night in their post op care and I would recommend that to everyone. The room resembled a nice hotel stay and not a hospital setting which was important to me and helped with my comfort. My husband had his own bed not just a cot in my room as well, so when we left we were both rested which is important for the amount of care I needed from him afterwards.  The nursery checked up with me, fed me, taught me how to walk and use my body during post op and taught me how to manage my pain and drains. Being out of state I stayed for a week at a nearby hotel and had multiple check ups. I could already see the how amazing my final shape would be. Each time i was in office I would sit and just chat like family with Tara, never had the feeling of being rushed or pushed. she is a gem I truly treasure. My healing journey was remarkably quick and easy, my scar is beautiful with clean lines, my belly button looks exactly the same as it did pre-babies and  I had next to no swelling,very minimal bruising and could walk normal within 4 days. And as a bonus I have a very large tattoo on my lower hip that Dr.Yash was able to stitch together to make it look cohesive, like that was how it was always suppose to look! I truly believe my easy recovery is due to Dr.Yash’s gentle hands during OR. I am now 12 weeks post op and it was the best decision I have made for myself and I wouldn’t change a single thing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Brewer
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best plastic surgeon I’ve ever experienced!! After a botched explant/lift, I couldn’t stand to even look at my breasts, I found Dr Yash and was immediately taken by his attentiveness and his kindness. However he won me over by paying careful attention and thoroughly explaining to me the route we would need to take to achieve my desired results. He used an internal mesh, that I was really nervous about, he took the time to listen to my concerns, answer my questions and ultimately I decided to trust his expertise. Boy am I glad I did! I’m more happy with my results than I could have imagined. He checked on me personally the evening after surgery and throughout the week and I’ve never seen another plastic surgeon dedicate so much time to his patients after surgery. He was incredibly kind, which again, I haven’t experienced before and so for all the reasons above, Dr. Yash will be my one stop shop for any of my future needs! He is, simply put, the very best!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a revision rhinoplasty with Dr.Yash a little over a month ago. I can honestly say, Dr.Yash and his team made me feel very comfortable with my decision going through with the procedure. Dr. Yash personally called me to answer any additional questions that I might have had before the procedure. I LOVE my new look. I could see the deference immediately. I enjoy taking pictures again and going out in public. I highly recommend Dr.Yash.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gawron
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve wanted a rhinoplasty since I was a teenager, and thanks to Dr. Yash, that lifelong dream has finally come true. I couldn’t be happier with both the results and the entire experience. From my first interactions with Taylor, to meeting Dr. Yash, to the warm hug I received from Tara right before surgery, I felt genuinely cared for every step of the way.

I asked for natural results that would still leave me looking and feeling like myself, and that’s exactly what I got. The piezo technology is truly remarkable; I had no bruising, no black eyes, and only minimal swelling. The entire healing process has been incredible.

I feel like a new, more confident version of myself, and I’ll be forever grateful to Dr. Yash and his amazing team for making this experience so positive and transformative.

user_reviews_extended.Name: leland
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am beyond grateful for Dr. Yash and his incredible team! After undergoing a revision rhinoplasty, I was initially very nervous. I had concerns because revision surgeries are far more complicated than primary rhinoplasties, and I wasn’t sure what to expect. From the very first consultation, Dr. Yash put all my fears to rest. He made me feel completely comfortable and confident in his expertise, which was so important to me.
Dr. Yash and his team were extremely thorough in answering all of my questions, not only before the surgery but also afterward. Every time I reached out, whether it was for advice or just reassurance, they responded quickly and made sure I was taken care of. They checked in on me regularly, which really made a difference in my overall experience.
One thing I really appreciated was Dr. Yash’s approach with photo renderings. We discussed my goals, which included opening my airways, fixing my septum, and removing a dorsal bump left by a previous surgeon. Instead of promising perfection, he gave me a realistic idea of what my nose would look like, and he was honest about the process. To my surprise, my results ended up even better than the renderings. My nose looks fantastic, very natural, and my breathing has never been better!
The surgery itself was so smooth and painless. My recovery was far easier than I expected, and I can honestly say this experience has been so much better than my first surgery. The care I received from Dr. Yash and his team made all the difference. I couldn’t be happier with the results, and I’m so thankful for their dedication and professionalism throughout the entire process.
If you're considering rhinoplasty, I highly recommend Dr. Yash and his team. They exceeded all of my expectations and made what could have been a stressful experience incredibly easy and stress-free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Lapp
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Yash was amazing from start to finish! Everyone that works in his office is so kind, helpful and makes you feel comfortable through the whole process. He has great bedside manner which is so important!  I'm so happy with my results and would recommend Dr. Yash to anyone looking for a Breast Augmentation or any other procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such a wonderful experience with Dr. Yash and his team. From the very beginning, Taylor was amazing—so professional, kind, and truly made me feel like a friend rather than just a patient.
I originally scheduled my neck lift in June, but on the day of surgery my blood pressure was extremely elevated. Dr. Yash made the difficult but very important decision not to proceed with the planned surgery that day. At the time I was upset, but looking back I am so thankful that I chose a doctor who put my health and safety above everything else. That decision spoke volumes about the kind of physician he is.
Once I was able to get my blood pressure under control, Dr. Yash’s team got me rescheduled quickly and made the entire process seamless. The surgery itself went beautifully, and I am so grateful for the results and for the care I received throughout the journey.
Finding a doctor who truly puts their patients’ well-being first is rare, and I cannot recommend Dr. Yash and his team enough.

He is very professional while being personable. I really appreciate his time and effort to get me back to feeling confident and comfortable in my body. title: Khan Plastic Surgery
address: 3811 Turtle Creek Blvd #200, Dallas, TX 75219, United States

user_reviews.Name: Jana Velgrube
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Khan and her team Brandy and Matt were exceptional from start to finish. From the initial scheduling of my consultation to the procedure itself, every step of the process was handled with care, professionalism, and attention to detail. The consultation was thorough and informative, and the breast augmentation surgery exceeded my expectations. It was truly 24hr breast augmentation recovery. Same day after surgery I went to enjoy dinner with my family.
Dr. Khan is amazing surgeon, but what I really loved is her warm, caring personality. I felt like I knew her all my life and felt super comfortable her doing my surgery.
Please trust her expertise and experience when choosing size of implants. I was worried it will be too big, but end up just perfect size and absolutely beautiful.
Also on a day of a surgery I was scared and anxious, but looking back now nothing to be worried and afraid of. Trust me, you are in a great hands of an amazing surgeon and wonderful woman.

user_reviews.Name: Rosamond Hsaw
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Khan is amazing at what she does. I had my surgery with her a few weeks ago and everything went very smooth. She is so easy to talk to, which makes the consultation and surgery that much better.

Surgery was super quick, about 1.5-2 hours in and out. Instructions were straightforward, but can always call office to clarify. Prescribed a ton of tylenol, but only took it for a few days after surgery for discomfort. I didn't feel any pain, just tight and soreness.

Shout out to Matt, who patiently answered every single question I had (and I had a ton lol) and Brandy, for always calling and checking up on me post surgery. I can't thank you enough, I'm so happy with my results! Definitely recommend Dr. Khan, you will not be disappointed!

user_reviews.Name: Luighsighe Hennigan
user_reviews.Description:
I had the absolute best experience with Dr. Khan and her entire staff. From the very first point of contact, their warmth, professionalism, and thorough communication set the tone for what became a seamless, confident, and empowering surgical journey.

Every question I had big or small was answered quickly and clearly. The staff is incredibly friendly and responsive, always making me feel supported and cared for. Surgery scheduling was a breeze, and they made sure I felt fully prepared every step of the way. They truly think of everything, down to the smallest detail, and the level of coordination between their medical and administrative teams was next level.

Dr. Khan herself is not only highly skilled but also compassionate, calming, and transparent. I felt completely at ease in her care, and I’m genuinely thrilled with my results so far. I could not have chosen a better team,  they are simply phenomenal.

Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Mary Rossi
user_reviews.Description: I’m so happy with my experience with Dr. Khan and her team! My 24hr breast augmentation looks amazing and is SO natural. I actually can’t believe it. It was hard for me to imagine a breast aug looking natural on me, especially with my muscular/athletic frame, but it looks and feels perfect. My body looks more proportional and feminine. As far as the day of surgery, I was VERY nervous about going under anesthesia, but the team was really kind and patient with me & joked around with me to help lighten my mood. Everyone here is a professional and an expertise. I’m so grateful for my experience & I highly recommend anyone who wants this done!

user_reviews.Name: Kris Curtis
user_reviews.Description: Fantastic Experience to get my implants out.. I walked in to do research and the next thing I found myself signing up on the whole surgery !! Dr Khan and staff are so down to earth, our conversations were healthy, educating and not rushed.  She has her own hospital which again was an added plus..  I can't recommend this office enough !

user_reviews.Name: Kasey Stover
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Farrah Kahn at Kahn Plastic Surgery. She did a fabulous job with my implant replacement and correction, which was previously done by another doctor. I am truly impressed with her expertise and care. The office operations were also outstanding — everything was so organized, easy, and clear. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Carolina Balderas
user_reviews.Description:
I carried so much shame about what my body had become. For four long years, I fought to lose the weight and keep it off, but every time I looked in the mirror, all I could see was what used to be there: every reminder of my past still staring back at me. My confidence wasn’t just low… it was completely gone.

Then I met Dr. Khan.

She listened. Really listened to my fears, my goals, and every insecurity I had tried so hard to hide. She never rushed me, never dismissed a single question, and talked me through every hesitation. She walked me through the entire journey, from the surgical plan to the recovery timeline, making sure I felt informed and supported every step of the way.

And the care didn’t end in the operating room. My healing took much longer than the six weeks I had hoped for, and during those moments when frustration crept in, Dr. Khan and her team were there, reminding me that healing isn’t linear and that my body *would* get there. They monitored every detail of my recovery, and adjusted treatments whenever necessary. The post-op support was honestly extraordinary. Brandy and Matt answered what felt like a thousand frantic emails and questions, always with kindness and patience.

And now… my results are beyond anything I dared to imagine. Dr. Khan didn’t just transform my body, she gave me back my confidence, my sense of self, and the feeling of finally being at home in my own skin again.

If you’re considering a mommy makeover or any cosmetic procedure, I cannot recommend Dr. Khan and her team enough. They are compassionate, skilled, and truly life-changing. I will be a patient of hers forever

Dr. Khan is amazing at what she does. With the lift alone, it looks like I have a mini implant due to how well she was able to shape and construct the tissue and breasts. Her and her staff have been wonderful from the beginning. Having some nervousness before surgery, the staff at the surgery center were very comforting and supportive. Matt has also been wonderful with always helping to communicate with Dr. Khan any concerns or questions that I had during the healing process. Dr. Khan also makes sure you are supported with everything through your entire healing process and post-op visits. I am now 7 weeks post-op and am very happy with my results and how things are settling in. I would recommend her to anyone who is interested in plastic surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

During my consult she was extremely professional and kind. She explained the steps I should take in order to achieve the look I wanted and ultimately we decided together that I would simply explant with a lift.
Oh my gosh. I am so happy with my results!!

The process was incredibly emotional for me, and Dr Khan and her Assistant Brandy were there pre-op and post- op with so much patience, reassurance and care. Truly you will feel like you’ve won the body lottery if you go with her. Incredibly smart doctor and amazing staff.
Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofia Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I knew before even stepping into my consultation that I wanted to have my surgery with Dr. Khan, and my experience only confirmed that I made the right choice. From the very beginning, she made me feel comfortable and understood. She’s warm, approachable, and truly listens. Her entire team is just as wonderful—easy to talk to, responsive, and patient with every question I had along the way.

As someone who is scared of needles, I was especially nervous about anesthesia, but her anesthesiologist was incredibly kind and calming, which made a huge difference for me.

Post-surgery, I had so many questions and concerns, and Dr. Khan always made time to follow up—sometimes even calling me from home during her personal time. That kind of care is rare and meant so much to me.

Now at 6 weeks post-op, I’m absolutely in love with my results. She gave me exactly what I was hoping for!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn A Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I traveled from Montana to see Dr. Khan for a breast lift, and I couldn’t be happier with my results! She made the entire process seamless, constantly answering any questions I had about pre/post op. From the initial consultation, I knew I was in good hands. The office staff is very kind and welcoming. Dr. Khan is also very knowledgeable and works with you to get your desired goal without any pressure for additional procedures. Dr. Khan’s recommendation for hyperbaric oxygen therapy was the key to a smooth recovery for me. I would recommend Dr. Khan to all of my family and friends. She’s the best! I am 11 weeks out and I’ve resumed normal activity while feeling more confident than ever! Best decision of my life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edie Hernandez Putt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Khan and her staff at Khan Plastic Surgery are a group of friendly and highly skilled individuals. During my initial consultation, I immediately decided to entrust Dr. Khan and her colleagues with my care. I was completely impressed by her professionalism and her genuine interest in meeting my needs. She is one of those professionals who actually follow through with after-hours support. Sorry to have interrupted your Saturday evening, Dr. K but I am grateful you did. While health care professionals provide standard care, Dr. Khan’s care and after care treatment was pivotal in helping to get me back to my normal routine. As extensive as my procedure was, I am thankful for her expertise and her considerable knowledge of the recovery process. I have been in behavioral healthcare for over thirty years and know when care is remarkable. Dr. Khan and her team at Khan Plastic Surgery are exceptional professionals and highly recommend their cosmetic care. Thank you, Dr. Khan; I am so pleased with the outcome of my surgery. You guys are super.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sammi DeJohn
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Khan was seamless start to finish. I had my initial consultation and immediately knew I was in good hands with Dr. Khan and her team. She is honest and compassionate, and did an excellent job making sure I felt comfortable with the whole process. I had my breast augmentation in September 2023 and truly couldn’t be more pleased with the result at 6 months. One of the most impressive aspects of this was the recovery, the day after surgery I was up walking around and doing light errands. At the exact 6 month mark I ran in a 10 K race (with plenty of support but still ran it nonetheless)! I feel that it’s common to be nervous about any kind of surgery, but I have never felt more comfortable or in better hands than with Dr. Khan. If you’re looking for a breast augmentation with fabulous results and quick recovery, this is the office to visit. I could not be more grateful for the experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Ford

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Hoelscher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had scheduled a 24 hour-recovery breast augmentation.

I have a blood clotting disorder and always held off getting this surgery performed due to my personal higher risk of complications.  The experience and technique used by Dr Khan is a major reason why I traveled to Dallas, TX from San Antonio, TX to meet her and to go forward with the surgery.  Her skills as a surgeon are remarkable. The whole experience was really seamless.  During my initial consultation with Dr Khan, I learned details about the rapid recovery technique,  I believe your surgeon has the expertise to know what will look best, therefore you need to trust and listen to what they recommend.  I felt very comfortable doing so after I met Dr. Khan and learned more about her accomplishments and training. I love her approach where she selects the proper size of implant tailored to the specific size of my breast pocket to create the best and most natural outcome.
The surgical experience was seamless.  I arrived for my preop evaluation on a Thursday.  I was measured and reviewed the details of the surgical process and recovery.  She even gave me handouts that addressed emotional concerns that some patients may experience after surgery, like a temporary post-surgical depression.  She thought of everything you would need to know in her handouts to alleviate fears, so they were very helpful. Surgery followed the next day (Friday).  The outpatient surgical suite was very clean and kept safe during COVID (not even your hubby can go in).  They gave me time to speak with the anesthesiologist who had called me the night before as well.  Liz (the anesthesiologist) was awesome. She explained what steps would be taken to prevent the risk of potentially dangerous blood clots due to my unique blood disorder.  Once my preop meds were given to me, I was taken back to the operating room.  She did not rush through the surgery — after the procedure, when I was finished with post-anesthesia recovery and could be escorted to the car where my husband was waiting to pick me up, she explained to my husband that she had taken extra time to assure everything was just right with the placement of the implants and the closure of the wounds.  I really appreciated that! She cares about your safety and a good outcome for you.  My husband drove me to where we would be staying in Dallas and the recovery period began.  Dr. Khan had already armed both of us with the knowledge about the recovery procedure to follow over the next couple of days, and everything you need to do is written down and given to you in detailed handouts as well, so we both felt very confident knowing exactly what I was supposed to do.  And really, the recovery protocol was very easy to follow.  The first item on the list was to sleep for 2 hours — NO PROBLEM!  Then I did my arm exercises exactly as directed, walked around, ate dinner and honestly felt great that night. UPDATE: It's been 4 1/2 years since I had my procedure. I edit to add that I had another baby less than 2 years ago and breast fed for a year. They're still perfect and look even more natural! :)

---------

I chose Dr. Khan for a few different reasons. (1) She will not compromise your natural anatomy (2) Other doctors perform 12 hours of surgery in any given day; Dr. Khan spends at most half that amount. (I don’t want anyone operating on me at the 11th hour!) (3) Her dedication to her craft is genuine and she cares about you and your health.

The 24-hour recovery breast augmentation is not a gimmick! My surgery was at 7:30am. I followed all post op instructions exactly as outlined. By 4pm the anesthesia had worn off. Had some mild discomfort, but the exercises I was instructed to do helped tremendously and loosened the tightness. I opted not to go out for dinner although I’m confident I was well enough to do so. Get a travel neck pillow! That was my best friend throughout the night. The next morning I was up at 6:30am, bathed my 3 & 4 year olds, cooked breakfast, went grocery shopping, and then drove myself to my post op appointment at 10:30am!

You cannot put a price tag on this! My family has been amazed to see me up and back to life 24 hours after my surgery!

Thank you Dr. Khan & staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Adelaide
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In September 2013 I had a breast reduction and lift from Dr. Khan and I can't say enough good things. She was the second surgeon I saw and unlike the first surgeon she never tried to up-sell me. She clearly and concisely explained exactly what the procedure would entail and answered all my questions both at my appointment and by email or phone before and after the fact. I also had excess skin removed from my abdomen after an 85lb weight loss last year. Due to the fact that I had major surgery to remove a tumor in my abdomen last year it was more complicated than normal. She did outside research to see what my options were, presented them to me and then told me what she would advise if she were talking to a family member.

On the day of surgery Dr. Khan was so positive and confident and excited to help me that it completely assuaged any lingering nervousness I had. She was so meticulous when she marked me up before the surgery, often going back and redoing lines until they were perfect, the whole time telling why she was placing certain lines in certain places. (This could be because not only did she go to Duke medical school but also Parsons art school in NY…she's literally an artist and my results are a true testament to that!!)

I stayed in the hospital overnight and when she checked on me the next morning she brought in a camera to show me a picture from the operating table so I could get an idea of what the results looked like (you're all bandaged up so you can't really see.) When I started to cry she thought I was nervous about the scars but in reality I was so so happy with the end results that I couldn't help but tear up.

I expected her to be more out of touch after the procedure but she and her nurses called to check up on me and were so accommodating in scheduling the removal of the drains the following week (She even agreed to come in before going out of town just so I could have a few extra days to shop for a dress for a wedding reception I was hosting!)

I really can't say enough about her bedside manner. She made me feel comfortable every step of the way and answered any questions I had…she even gave me her personal cell number. And it sounds crazy but she's just the type of person you want to be friends with…and that makes a difference! She was so genuinely happy to help me change my life like this.

As for her technical skill, well I can't imagine anyone achieving better results. I have a close friend who had a reduction almost a year ago and my scars already look almost as good as hers and it's only been 3 weeks! My breasts are not only perfectly shaped but they are 100% perfectly proportioned for my body. When I was in my consultation and I asked her what size she thought I would be afterwards she said that she didn't like to use letters and numbers and I was a tad nervous not knowing what to expect in the end. But she clearly knows the human body because was able to give me breasts that might be more beautiful than any ever created naturally. The removal of my excess skin also went amazingly. It looks natural and not at all "over worked" or "plastic" (I was never looking for sculpted 6pack abs but now I actually have a waist and you can see the hard work I put in over the last year.)

Everyone who has seen my results is stunned at the natural look and incredibly fast healing. I can not begin to tell you how much it changed my life, and after seeing a few other examples of breast reductions on friends of mine I can assuredly say that my results are by far the best. I don't know how she did it, or what she does differently but whatever it is it's 100% worth it. And 100% amazing! I would  recommend her to anyone who is looking for cosmetic or reparative plastic surgery. From her attitude to her skill to her involvement with patients she is by far the best doctor I have ever worked with. So glad I found her, and you will be too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LYA MELENDEZ
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm sad to have had such a disappointing experience given my excitement after booking a consultation with this office. My fiance and I went in for the consultation and were received by the receptionist with a level of arrogance and pomposity. We were initially asked to wear masks which I did without hesitating. The receptionist then told my fiance he had to wait downstairs in the lobby due to COVID restrictions. We tried requesting an exception to this given the fact that we live together and the decision of moving forward (or not) with the procedure is one we wanted to make together. We consider ourselves a team. He immediately gave us an attitude and stated the rules had been emailed to me after the initial booking.

Despite the tone, my fiance was more than understanding and left the office with complete composure. I asked one more time if we could ask the doctor and reiterated we live together if that made a difference and that's when he really blew up and said "It makes a difference because COVID!" It was at that juncture I decided to phone my fiance since I no longer felt it was a good idea to go through with the consultation given the attitude I had received. The receptionist offered to refund the "non-refundable" deposit to which I said yes but when I told my fiance I wasn't comfortable with the way we had been treated the receptionist interrupted my call to defend himself.

Upon leaving, I contacted the office via Instagram in an attempt to reach the doctor herself before leaving a bad review (I'm a business owner and understand how detrimental these can be). Shortly after messaging them explaining the above situation I noticed they had blocked me. Suffice to say this is not a business I can presently support or recommend to anyone.

____
Just like your other 1 star review from less than 3 months ago stating the same behavioral issues with the staff said: Your response speaks volumes.

There were multiple lies + gross exaggerations in their response but there's one I was able to prove with with just a couple screenshots with time stamps: (see below)

4:12pm - I took a screenshot of their IG page before sending a message
4:39pm - sent IG direct message
4:49pm - their profile shows "User not found"
11:07am - (after they replied to my google review and stated they didn't block me nor did they received my message) all the sudden I can see their profile again.
