title: Kelling Plastic Surgery - Joseph A. Kelling, M.D.
address: 411 N Washington Ave Suite 4200, Dallas, TX 75246, United States

owner.name: Kelling Plastic Surgery - Joseph A. Kelling, M.D. (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Sherry Davidovich
user_reviews.Description: There are lots of options when it comes to a plastic surgeon for a breast augmentation, especially in the Dallas area. After meeting with several other doctors, I chose to go with Dr. Kelling for several reasons. I felt he really listened to my concerns and answered all my questions with attentiveness.  He made sure I understood the process and all the things to expect so there were no surprises. His staff is so friendly and professional. You are always greeted with a smile. My surgery went well and although I am still in recovery, I am beyond happy with my results. This being such a big decision, I am very happy that I chose to go with Dr. Kelling.

user_reviews.Name: LACEY BOONE
user_reviews.Description: I absolutely love Dr. Kelling and the entire office staff. Everyone is friendly, professional, and incredibly accommodating from start to finish. I had a breast augmentation with a small lift and couldn’t be happier with my results or overall experience. I felt well cared for and confident every step of the way. Highly recommend — you won’t be disappointed!

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie M
user_reviews.Description: I was referred to Dr. Kelling for lipoma removal, and I couldn’t be more thankful for the experience. From the initial consultation, he was truly patient centered and took the time to listen, especially since this was my very first surgery and I was super nervous about anesthesia. Despite performing many major procedures, he treated my small case with the same level of care and importance. On the day of surgery, he made sure to check in with me, and he even called later that evening, which meant so much. I am incredibly grateful to have been referred to him. The outcome exceeded my expectations. I can’t even see the incision! I’m thankful not only for Dr. Kelling, but also for his entire staff.

user_reviews.Name: M. Carrizales
user_reviews.Description:
From the moment I walked into Dr. Kelling’s office each person was so professional, kind and friendly. Dr. Kelling listens and hears out your concerns, he is interested in you as the patient and makes time to understand your needs. He’s very professional, thorough, and makes absolute sure you have an understanding of what your procedure entails.
Now, I had a breast reduction and lift after years of back pain, arthritis in my neck and prolonged discomfort. My life has drastically changed within moments. My healing is looking beautiful, it’s incredible to see the drastic changes. I feel so confident, relieved and so grateful. Mind you I’m still in my recovery process. Yet so very happy I chose Dr. Kelling and trusted in his ability and professionalism. If you have been conflicted on making a big decision like this, schedule a consult. You will feel heard and confident that you are in good hands!
Thank you Dr. Kelling and your amazing staff for EVERYTHING!

user_reviews.Name: Tom Williams
user_reviews.Description: I had a two inch diameter hole in my face to close after skin cancer surgery. Dr. Kelling did an outstanding job, and quite simply gave me my face back. Naturally I was concerned before he operated as to how skilled he was. He proved to be an expert. I had no idea cosmetic surgery could be this good. I highly recommend Dr. Kelling.  Tom Williams

user_reviews.Name: Tonia Ashworth
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Kelling is the ultimate professional with an abundance of compassion, care and concern.   My life and outlook have so greatly improved. He worked wonders!

user_reviews.Name: Cynthia Salas
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot thank Dr. Kelling and his amazing staff enough for the incredible experience I had with my liposuction and fat transfer to my glutes! As a proud mom over 40, I was looking to enhance my confidence, and Dr. Kelling did just that. From the initial consultation to the post-op care, everything was professional, friendly, and supportive.
Dr. Kelling is not only highly skilled but also very attentive and understanding of my needs. The results are fantastic, I feel fabulous and rejuvenated! The staff made me feel comfortable and cared for every step of the way. If you’re considering a procedure, I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Kelling and his wonderful team.

user_reviews.Name: Mary Ackert
user_reviews.Description: This is Mary Ackert. I became a patient of Dr. Kelling in June 2025. I was referred by my Dermatologist to see Dr. Kelling about the removal of a large lipoma on the back of my left shoulder. Dr. Kelling and his team treated me with respect and kindness. I knew that they really cared for me as a patient and as a person. I was scheduled for surgery quickly and within a couple of weeks my bothersome lipoma was no longer a part of my life. I am forever thankful for Dr. Kelling,his skills as a surgeon and his bedside manner. He freed me from a lipoma that was causing shoulder pain. I did not realize how much pain I had until the lipoma was removed. It has been 4 weeks post op and I feel great. I highly recommend Dr. Kelling, his office staff, surgery scheduling personnel and the surgical team. His medical assistants are also very kind. You are treated with kindness and as if you were their only patient.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kelling listens and pays great attention to detail and made sure I got the results I wanted. Office staff welcoming and very efficient. Extremely satisfied with the whole experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dallas Wolford
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a surgeon myself who is specializing in cosmetic surgery, Dr. Kelling is the ONLY surgeon I would trust to do plastic surgery on me. As part of my own training, I have had the opportunity to spend time observing him in the operating room and he is without a doubt one of the most technically gifted and talented surgeons I have ever seen. He’s got an eye for detail and is perfectionist operatively, which is exactly what you want in your plastic surgeon…. he truly cares. He is kind, patient, funny, compassionate, and his bedside manner reflects that. Dr. Kelling’s results are flawless.

Additionally, his wife Lauren, is an NP at the practice and she has performed Botox and BBL / Halo lasers on me — she is absolutely darling and does incredible work. I would trust her to do anything and everything that she wanted or felt I needed. She’s an expert at all things lasers and injections AND is so fun that at the end of the appointment, you just want to be her friend.

Talk about the absolute BEST duo. Take my professional advice and book all your aesthetic needs with Kelling Plastic Surgery. You simply will not have better results or a better experience anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bonnibrook Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr. Kelling for a revision augmentation. I needed my inframammary fold repaired after a car accident and I also have a pectus deformity in my chest wall that was causing the implants to sit closer together than I wanted. In addition, the surgeon I saw previously didn’t allow me to go as big as I wanted, and I still wanted to increase my size. Dr. Kelling really listened to what I wanted. He went above and beyond to ensure that everything was repaired beautifully and that it was all the right shape, size, and in the right place. Having been to another surgeon before, I was extremely impressed with the outcome and my experience as a whole. I’m so glad that he did my revision and that I FINALLY have the look I wanted!! I’m very grateful to Dr. Kelling and highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason C Hopcus
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an absolutely fantastic experience with Dr. Joseph Kelling, and can't recommend him enough! I recently underwent a lower blepharoplasty, neck liposuction, and fat transfer procedure under his care, and the results exceeded my expectations.

From the beginning, Dr. Kelling demonstrated an exceptional level of expertise and professionalism. His warm and welcoming demeanor immediately put me at ease, and he took the time to thoroughly explain each step of the process, addressing any concerns or questions I had. His patience in listening to my needs and desires truly stood out to me.

The surgery itself went incredibly smoothly, thanks to Dr. Kelling's skillful hands, supportive team, and attention to detail. The lower blepharoplasty has revitalized my eyes, the neck liposuction has given me a more defined profile, and the fat transfer has enhanced my natural features.

Dr. Kelling's commitment to his patients' wellbeing is evident in every aspect of his practice. He goes above and beyond to ensure comfort and satisfaction, and his post-operative care was exceptional. He's been there every step of the way during my recovery journey, making sure I'm healing properly and answering any post-surgery questions.

What truly sets Dr. Kelling apart is not only his surgical expertise, but also his genuine care for his patients. He understands the emotional aspect of undergoing cosmetic procedures and approaches his work with both sensitivity and empathy. This combination of medical skill and personal touch is truly rare and greatly appreciated.

My experience with Dr. Joseph Kelling has been nothing short of outstanding. His kindness, thoroughness, patience, and dedication to meeting his patients' needs make him an exceptional plastic surgeon. If you're looking for remarkable results coupled with a positive and supportive experience, look no further – Dr. Kelling is the best choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Reeves
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had extensive cosmetic surgery with Dr. Kelling. I cannot say enough about his professionalism and excellent bedside manner. He was available, listened and was compassionate. He helped me reach my goals and my results are amazing. I cannot recommend him enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Draper
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Joe Kelling and Lauren are a wonderful team!  My wife Deborah and I have been coming to their clinic for several years now to experience their wonderful aesthetic treatments.  She and I have become quite fond or their affable staff as, Racheal, Blanca, Kim, and Lisa will greet you as though you are a lifelong friend.  They work well together getting their jobs completed successfully providing the best overall results for your visit be it a Botox treatment, consultation, or preparations for and upcoming surgical appointment.  Very thorough!!

I will be quite honest with you...I am 67 years old and have been bringing my wife Deborah to this practice for several years.  Last year, Deborah finally convinced me to try Botox treatments. I have been in awe of the results!  We laughingly refer it as BROTOX, and I Love It!

Lauren Kelling, DNP, FPN-C is their Aesthetic Nurse Practitioner and a wonderful clinician with a skillful and very soft touch.  Her injectables and topical treatments are delivered skillfully with no discomfort providing ultimate beauty!  We love the Kellings!

Saving the best for last...Dr. Joe Kelling is an awesome Aesthetic Surgeon.  In May 2025 my wife had her neck, lip, and face lift performed by Dr. Kelling.  Without going into the minutiae, the results are absolutely the most beautiful work I have ever witnessed!  Deborah now looks younger than her years and is feeling great about herself.

Beyond the results, Dr Kelling and his staff go above and beyond and as such we will be loyal customers!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tee Ete
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a TT in February and I LOVE DR. KELLING!  He did a wonderful job, listened to all my questions, weird ones included, made me so comfortable I wish I had 2 stomachs just so I could go see him again! LOL
The results are amazing and his staff in the office is wonderful. Also, it definitely doesn't  hurt that he's so good looking! I mean, if you gotta have a doctor, why not a hot one?! Call him if you need anything done and you won't regret it!

user_reviews.Name: Jermaine Mackey
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Kevin R. Hanz and his entire team are truly exceptional. From my very first consultation to post-op follow-ups, I felt informed, respected, and genuinely cared for every step of the way.

I had a Male Chest Skin Excision and Abdominoplasty, and I couldn’t be happier with my results. Dr. Hanz took the time to explain the procedures thoroughly, set realistic expectations, and answer all of my questions. His expertise, precision, and attention to detail are outstanding. The results look natural and have already made a huge difference in my confidence.

The office staff and surgical team were just as amazing—professional, kind, and supportive. They made what could have been a stressful experience feel smooth and reassuring. Recovery instructions were clear, and any time I had a question, they were quick to respond.

If you’re considering cosmetic or reconstructive surgery, I highly recommend Dr. Hanz. You’ll be in excellent hands.

user_reviews.Name: Janna Davis
user_reviews.Description: I would highly recommend Dr. Hanz to anyone considering a plastic surgery procedure. I love my results as they have been life changing for me by giving me more confidence about my appearance and have also really inspired me to continue with my weight loss journey. I am very grateful and thankful to Dr. Hanz, the nurses, and staff! Dr. Hanz is truly a miracle worker as my results have been exceptionally beautiful and very natural looking as well!

user_reviews.Name: Krystalyn Geissler
user_reviews.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Hanz's office for your aesthetic needs. Jackie is incredibly sweet and helpful. The office is clean and comfortable. I had the pleasure of working with Amy for my first appointment where she kindly reviewed my options for Botox. She was so kind and informative. We ended up deciding to use Dysport for my aesthetic goals and I couldn’t be more pleased with the results! Amy made sure I was comfortable and walked me through all of my concerns. I strongly feel that I can trust Dr. Hanz and his team wholeheartedly. I am so impressed with the staff, and even more impressed with how good I feel after my appointment. I will definitely be returning!

user_reviews.Name: Unicorn Carrie
user_reviews.Description:
Selecting a plastic surgeon can feel daunting. I read countless reviews and had consultations with several surgeons before finding Dr. Hanz—and I’m so glad I did.

From the very beginning, the staff and facility were outstanding. Communication is seamless; it’s always easy to reach someone with a question or concern, which made a huge difference throughout the process.

I had an arm lift and a mini thigh lift, and I am completely in love with my results. For the arms, Dr. Hanz placed the incisions perfectly—well hidden from most angles and primarily on the inner arm. I was mentally prepared for a harsh scar, but my healing has been amazing. At just 8 weeks post-op, my scar is already a thin pencil line. The pre- and post-op do’s and don’ts they provide are true game changers and clearly make a difference in healing.

My mini thigh lift has also been incredible. There were a few minor bumps along the way, which is expected given how much that area moves, but Dr. Hanz provided consistent reassurance and very direct, practical guidance (yes—use the blow dryer after every shower; air drying is not an option!).

I also can’t say enough about the anesthesiologist—she was so incredible. She immediately put me at ease by chatting with me about my bikes (I’m a cyclist), which completely calmed my nerves.

Overall, my experience was excellent. I felt comfortable, supported, and well cared for at every step—from booking the consultation and discussing costs, to surgery, follow-ups, and navigating any moments of concern. I highly recommend Dr. Hanz and his team.

user_reviews.Name: Molly Green
user_reviews.Description: I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Hanz and his staff. They are truly the best! I had a mommy makeover and every step of the way they are there to help in any way with outstanding results! They are now like family to me. That’s how much they truly care about each patient. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Louise Cottel Crain
user_reviews.Description: I have had multiple plastic surgeries with Dr. Hanz over the years, and he consistently goes above and beyond my expectations with my results! While he is beyond a doubt on of the most talented plastic surgeons in Dallas, his bedside manner and easy nature also really stand out as special and unique. Dr. Hanz truly cares about his patients; I never feel rushed when I see him for follow ups, or feel silly for asking too many questions. I trust him empirically. He is an exceptional surgeon AND an exceptional human being which is such a powerful combination. I plan to see him for many years to come, and already have another procedure scheduled for the spring.

I couldn’t be happier with my experience and highly recommend Dr. Hanz and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Haar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Have you seen any episodes of the television show "Botched"? How about the show "American Greed"? If so, please continue reading.

I'd like to communicate a series of incredibly unfortunate experiences I recently had with Dr. Hanz and his staff. In early 2024, I met with Dr. Hanz and his clinician to discuss having Bellafill inserted into my jawline. During the consultation, Dr. Hanz expressed confidence that Bellafill would provide me with a positive and long-lasting result. Importantly, we also discussed that Bellafill is designed to bond or adhere to the bone. This fact was crucial in my situation, as I was having Bellafill placed onto my mandible (jawline), which is a part of the face that is in constant motion. I then scheduled an appointment with Dr. Hanz's clinician and had Bellafill inserted into both the left and right sides of my jaw. Very soon after that, I moved away from Dallas, and I now reside overseas.

To make a very long story short, Dr. Hanz's clinician did not correctly insert the Bellafill into my jawline. Instead of adhering to the bone as was promised, the two Bellafill injections immediately became free-floating and unsightly blobs of disfiguring filler. One blob looks like a frisbee of floating filler, while the other looks like a misshapen football of floating filler. Try to imagine: Whenever I open my mouth, my jaw moves but the Bellafill blobs do not.

Over many months, I expressed my frustrations with Dr. Hanz's clinician via email, I shared photos and a video documenting my horrible outcome, I requested a refund, and (because of my residency overseas) I requested a telehealth appointment with Dr. Hanz to discuss options.

As I've meticulously documented, on five occasions Dr. Hanz's staff rebuffed my requests for a telehealth appointment. Instead, they continuously indicated that I would need to return to the clinic for an in-person appointment. If Covid lockdowns taught us anything, it's that telehealth appointments are an effective option in the patient/caregiver toolbox. I can only presume that my five rebuffed telehealth requests were at Dr. Hanz's direction. After my fifth request for a telehealth appointment, I was granted a call (but not a video call) with Dr. Hanz.

During our call and through subsequent emails, Dr. Hanz expressed the following: 1) Yes, a review of the photographic evidence indicates that his office did not place the Bellafill properly, 2) Because I am unable to return to Dr. Hanz's office, I should consult with a different physician (at my expense I presume), and 3) No, Dr. Hanz would not be refunding to me any portion of the cost of the disfiguring procedure because he had (and I quote) "already paid the makers of Bellafill for their product." I couldn't believe it. Additionally, Dr. Hanz would not commit to discussing or acting upon, at no expense to me, surgical or other therapeutic removal options related to the misplaced Bellafill at the hands of his clinician.

Before you schedule a procedure with Dr. Hanz or his staff, please ask yourself the following: Do you want to put your appearance at risk with this doctor? How would you feel if Dr. Hanz's clinicians improperly injected a semi-permanent filler into your face, causing a disfiguring aesthetic outcome? Do you believe it was ethical for Dr. Hanz to put his profit motive above his patient’s wellbeing? How alarmed would you be if your requests for a telehealth appointment were stonewalled on five occasions?

I have come to accept that I must live with two discs of floating Bellafill suspended in the proximity of my jawline -- Bellafill that will likely last for 3-5 years. I've also accepted that Dr. Hanz's financial self-interest prevents him from refunding to his patient the cost of his office's botched procedure. I've also learned that customer service is a mirage with this office. You, however, do not need to meet the same fate that I did. Please do not seek aesthetic treatment from Dr. Hanz or his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Several years ago, I worked as Director for a medical missions organization. This non-profit sent surgical teams to underdeveloped countries to perform highly specialized procedures. Since the cases were particularly complicated, only the most proficient of surgeons were allowed to operate.
I was surprised that a doctor with as little experience as Dr. Hanz (at the time), was selected. The group of plastic surgeons appointed to choose the doctors for each trip, recognized Kevin's exceptional skills at an early stage of his career.
Fast forward to now, Dr. Hanz is still way ahead of his peers. He has done all the basics for me and my husband, like skin cancer removal, botox and filler. I am now ready to have him do his magic on my 60 year old face!  He is trustworthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lydia Inboden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had gained a lot of weight during covid and with a full time job and kids I found it hard to manage healthy eating and frequent exercise. I went to Dr. Kevin Hanz and met with his amazing staff. They recommended a weight loss drug called ozempic or semiglutide. I have been taking one dose a week at home and have lost 20 pounds in 19 weeks! Nothing else has changed in my daily routine. All of my cravings for wine and snacks has completely gone away. When I do have a meal I find I only eat about half. I have had no side effects other than a little exhaustion the day after I take it. Kevin's office staff has been amazing and I would recommend this 10/10! I had tried lipo and cool sculpting in the past and lost no where near as much weight as I have on ozempic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chad F
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for almost 2 years and Amy and the staff always do a great job of taking care of any of my concerns from labs, to supplement support to weight loss. They have been great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hunter Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had lipo 360 with Dr. Hanz. I didn't experience any pain during thanks to the medications. After the procedure I was very sore, but I was back at work at 830a the next day. The soreness has lasted since, but has gotten better & hasn't restricted me from my day to day routine. I was able to shower 48 hours after my procedure so I was able to take the garment off. I knew I was going to be swollen, but even with the swelling I could see visible results. I cried happy tears because I couldn't believe it. The nurses & doctor have been more than amazing throughout this process by checking in & making sure I am doing well. I cannot wait to see my results week after week!

**Update**
It's been about 10 months since my first procedure. I had my 2nd procedure 2 weeks ago on a totally different area! Much easier recovery since it was just arms and not my entire midsection. Soreness, but nothing keeping me from my everyday routine. I was back at work the next day with this procedure as well. Fabulous procedure, amazing staff, & life-long results that have made me so much more confident.

I asked for my implants to sit slightly higher than natural without them looking like I had them super pushed up. They sit low.

I asked for my implants to be close together since my breast naturally sit far apart. They are still far apart and even slide COMPLETELY into my armpits when I lay down. It looks horrible.

I asked if my implants would look “tight” since I had little breast tissue to begin with, Dr said no… a lie considering my implant is very visible.

Not only that, but my entire breasts are numb. Not just the incision, the whole breast. It is extremely uncomfortable everyday all day.

They look worse than what I started with and I was told I could “always come back for a revision”.
So I should pay for a whole new surgery when I should have gotten what I paid for the first time? How upsetting and disappointing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jandy M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I really wish I was Writing a five star review and not a one star one, but This has kind of exaggerated an insecurity I had in the first place. It has been a few years since I got a breast augmentation from Dr. John Burns but It seems like I might have to get a revision or for them to be redone way earlier than I thought.

First and foremost, I actually really liked his bedside manners, and that’s what made me go with him in the first place he made me feel really confident about the procedure. When I pointed out that One of my breasts is smaller than the other and asked him if he could put a bigger one in it, (I had consulted with a different surgeon in Dallas and when he did the scan that’s when he showed me that difference and recommended I get a bigger implant in my smaller breast and it just confirmed how I already felt. ) he said that it’s not that big of a difference so he refused to put a bigger size in my smaller breast. I’m not sure if he refused me because it was More costly on his end, but I really wish that he listened to me because it is pretty apParent now that my boobs are bigger especially in skin tight clothing and unlined bras. I also asked him if he could do a mini donut lift in order to reposition my nipple or even cut a little bit of my areola just so that it’s closer to the position and size of my other breast and he said that I shouldn’t do it because once the implants are in, it wouldn’t look that different, but I’m really wishing that he had done it. I listened to him because of all the positive reviews he has on google and real self and because he is so well rated as a surgeon, he’s been in the industry for so long, so I thought I should be able to trust his judgment but I wish I listened to how I felt and spoke up some more. I feel like because of the bigger size of my boobs, Now my nipple sits even lower than what it used to And it’s more noticeable, especially with it looking smaller than my other breast.

I really hate that I had to write this. I wish I was just fully satisfied with my results, but I’m not. I do hope that this helps with the decision that somebody makes with their body.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns, RN Mallory, and his staff went above and beyond to help my breast augmentation dreams come true. Professional team, welcoming staff, clean and modern space. Payment plans are also an option as well! Overall, I’m really loving my results and experience. 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meg Gorman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns did an excellent job on my surgery. It’s amazing how such a small tweak gave me so much more confidence—I truly feel like a new person. Dr. Burns and his entire staff were kind, professional, and wonderful to me every step of the way. I’m so grateful. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Lloyd
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I ultimately had to back out of scheduling surgery due to anxiety and needing more time to think through such a major decision. I had paid a $1,000 deposit, and when I called to explain my situation, I was told that even if I rescheduled surgery with their office in a few months, the deposit would not transfer or be credited.

While I understand offices have policies, this lack of flexibility added unnecessary stress during an already difficult time. If you experience anxiety around surgery or may need additional time, I  recommend finding a more accommodating office. They are out there!

Save yourself the stress and clarify policies CAREFULLY before committing. I am now out 1 thousand dollars for a surgery I still plan to have, but just needed a little additional time to prepare.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sholeh Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a mini face and neck lift in June 2024, and I just received my 9-month post-op photos! Wow, what a difference! Dr. Burns took 20 years off my face—I truly look like I did 20 years ago. I can't thank him enough! I am beyond grateful for both the care and the incredible results I've received. He’s also done a tummy tuck for me, and each experience has been amazing. Dr. Burns and his staff are truly wonderful. He is not only highly knowledgeable, but also kind and compassionate, making you feel like you're his only patient. I am so thankful for the fantastic job he did for me!
Sholeh Cooper

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Steen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Burns and his staff. They are all so welcoming and accommodating! My surgery went just as expected and zero complaints about my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison McKinney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns helped me find the perfect procedure and coached me through the entire process. I am extremely impressed with the quality and results of my procedure and highly recommend Dr.Burns to anyone that is interested in his skills and services. I was treated so well and the team prepared my husband very well to assist in my recovery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenley Frazier
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got a breast augmentation with Dr John Burns and I cannot say enough good things about him and his staff. Elizabeth the nurse is also amazing! They made me feel so comfortable and made this process so seamless. They listened to me and my goals and made it come true. I am extremely happy with my results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kameko Zayas-Bazan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I feel compelled to express my deepest gratitude and admiration for the exceptional care I received from Dr. John Burns. As an African American patient, I was apprehensive about finding a surgeon who truly understood the unique needs of my beautiful but sometimes complex brown skin. But Dr. Burns exceeded my expectations in every way.

After months of meticulous research, I finally found a surgeon who checked every box. Dr. Burns' passion for his craft is evident in the outstanding results he delivers. His expertise in tailoring his techniques to accommodate diverse skin types is truly remarkable.

What's more, I was pleasantly surprised to find that Dr. Burns' prices are very reasonable, making his exceptional care accessible to a wider range of patients. This rare combination of expertise, compassion, and affordability is a true testament to Dr. Burns' commitment to his patients.

Throughout my journey, Dr. Burns' staff were a constant source of comfort and reassurance. They addressed my countless questions with patience, kindness, and professionalism. Every encounter, from consultation to follow-up care, was a testament to their exceptional dedication.

My experience with Dr. Burns was nothing short of transformative. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking top-notch care, regardless of skin type. Dr. Burns is a true master of his craft, and I feel fortunate to have had the privilege of being his patient.

Thank you, Dr. Burns and staff, for an unforgettable experience!

Sincerely,
Kay

user_reviews_extended.Name: elizabeth lloyd
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a breast augmentation with Dr. Burns, and I can't express how thrilled I am with my experience. One week post-surgery, I feel fantastic and am already loving the results.

Dr. Burns and his staff were exceptional throughout the entire process. From the initial consultation to post-operative care, I felt completely supported. They took the time to create 3D images to help me choose the right size for me and answered all of my questions.

The surgical team and Anesthesiologist made sure I felt comfortable and informed, which eased my nerves before surgery and made the day very enjoyable.

If you’re considering breast augmentation, I highly recommend Dr. Burns and his team. They truly prioritize patient care, and I couldn't have asked for a better experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole
user_reviews_extended.Description: Six years post-operation & I still have issues with my left breast. Went to him a few weeks after, only for him to gaslight me like I had body dysmorphia after taking a measuring tape to measure the dimensions. My left doesn’t feel like my body, because of the numbness & nerve damage as well as the sizing & the way it sits, depending on how I lay. Cramps & muscle spasms happen often, especially during my workouts on just that one side. Sometimes, I have to wear a sports bra to alleviate the discomfort. It’s higher than the other, and it’s more than a cup size smaller than the perfectly fine one, too. Pretty obvious every time I wear sports bras at the gym, so I have to pad it a little more on that side to not make me so lopsided. Plus, my underwire marks are not aligning, as one is right under my good one, but a space on the other. Almost got a revision with him, but ended up canceling after putting down a partial payment & loss some of it, but it’s okay, because I couldn’t trust him enough to go through with it. A small loss, beats an even worse surgical experience with him. Also, refunding for anesthesia took months. Just a bad experience overall. Issue is still evident till this very day, & can’t stand to even touch my left breast, or even look myself in mirror most days. Complications happen, but gaslighting me is insane, especially when the discomfort is there, & not the aesthetics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lexee Purdy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn’t have been more overwhelmed choosing a doctor for my breast augmentation. I found Dr. Burns on Realself and then followed him on instagram/ socials for a while before committing. My favorite thing he does, that I didn’t notice from the others, is posting instagram stories directly from the operating room! I was able to see first hand how genuinely consistent his work is. Meeting him and his team in person was exactly as everyone says! So nice, so informative, everyone went above and beyond every step of the way to help make the experience everything I hoped for and more! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Naomi Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After considering a breast augmentation for several years I finally decided to finally set up a few consultations. I saw one other local surgeon and then was recommended Dr. Burns by a few girlfriends that had the same procedure. During my initial consultation I asked several questions and explained the look I was wanting. Both Dr. Burns and his nurse Elizabeth did an amazing job at making me feel comfortable, easing all of my concerns, and most importantly helping me decide on a size that fit my body. After the appointment, I was confident that Dr. Burns was the right choice, and I scheduled surgery for just two weeks later!

I was significantly late the day of surgery and yet the staff graciously accommodated me. All of the staff was extremely friendly and accommodated my needs. I am now 1 week post procedure, and have been healing great. I can't say more great things about Dr. Burns, his nurse Elizabeth, and all of their team. If you're still on the fence about your surgeon, trust me, they might not be the one. Give this crew a shout for a consultation, and mark my words, you'll be so glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Miles
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I even begin to describe the incredibly kind, thorough, and discerning care and work of Dr. Burns and his staff?! Dr. Burns’ is hands down the most phenomenal plastic surgeon. Whereas so many cosmetic surgeons recreate impractical and toxic standards of beauty in a cookie-cutter, one size fits all manner, Dr. Burns takes a holistic and bird’s-eye approach to enhance and celebrate each of his patient’s unique features. He and his staff will do a full review of your goals, lifestyle, and any other details to ensure that your end result is not only beautiful but sustainable for a full and vibrant life. After my procedure, I can truly say I finally can “see” and love my body for the first time.

His nursing, administrative staff are also top notch! They all came to greet me and chat for a little bit the day of surgery, making me feel not only comfortable and relaxed, but really excited for my procedure. I have felt heard, seen, and cared for every step in this transformation. Elizabeth, the clinic nurse, is such a bubbly and kind spirit who is the beating heart of the practice! She is personable and a phenomenal patient-centered and brilliant nurse.

Don’t even think twice, go see Dr. Burns!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leinadiz Soto Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t even describe how incredible my experience was and has been. I had my surgery 5 months ago and I’m healing perfectly. The staff and doctor Burns were so caring and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in for my first appointment. They took the time to listen and address all my concerns and went into details about what would happen before, during, and after my surgery. I’m so happy with the results, the “girls” look exactly how I wanted them to and I’d go as fare to say even better. Thank you Doctor Burns and your staff for making this experience the best of the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Narducci
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns and his team are absolutely kind, amazing, and talented.  I had a very poor surgical outcome from another doctor that I wanted fixed.   This is the place for all of your revision needs.   Dr. Burns is an excellent surgeon, artist, and knows how to get the results you want.  I found his website and social media photos , and his results are the real deal.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Laine-Carr
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a breast explant, a capsule removal with a fat transfer and a bit of extra liposuction done on 2/27/24. The surgery went perfectly and I am so happy! Dr. Burns is an amazing surgeon who was recommended to me by a friend who feels the same way. Elizabeth, his nurse, is very gentle, kind and extremely efficient.  His receptionist is so kind and very helpful. I would 100% recommended Dr. John Burns!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr Burns and the whole staff!  I had a tummy tuck revision and it is just perfect. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Autumn Martin

His nurse, Elizabeth has been so extremely helpful through the healing process! I highly recommend Dr. Burns and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: claire cheatham
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Dr. Burns' expertise in breast augmentation is truly remarkable, and I felt completely confident in his abilities throughout the entire process.

Nurse Elizabeth played a crucial role in my journey, providing exceptional care and support from start to finish. Her warm and compassionate nature immediately put me at ease, and she was always available to answer any questions or concerns I had, both before and after the surgery. Nurse Elizabeth's extensive knowledge and experience in post-operative care has ensured me a smooth recovery process, and her genuine concern for my well-being made me feel like I was in the best hands possible.

The entire staff at Dr. Burns' office was friendly, professional, and accommodating. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm smile and made to feel comfortable and valued as a patient. The office itself is clean, modern, and well-equipped, creating a welcoming and calming environment.

I am beyond thrilled with the results of my breast augmentation, and I owe it all to the exceptional skills and care provided by Dr. Burns and Nurse Elizabeth. They truly went above and beyond to ensure my satisfaction and well-being throughout the entire process. I would highly recommend them to anyone considering a breast augmentation or any other cosmetic procedure. Their expertise, professionalism, and genuine care for their patients make them an outstanding team that I am grateful to have had the opportunity to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey McKay
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Burns and his staff are amazing! It will be the best decision you make. Everyone is accommodating, flexible, and Dr Burns listens to what you want and also knows how to execute the best results.  Dr. Burns has the talent of the best surgeon around and his artistic eye will give you the confidence to know you are getting the best results possible.  The aftercare team is amazing and I recommend asking for the night stay if you can with a private nurse. From the consult, to bedside manner, to scheduling to aftercare - the entire operation was positive and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Yoss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! I am beyond impressed and pleased with my experience at Dr. Burns' office. From moment you walk in, you are greeted with smiles and positive energy all around. Dr. Burns is incredibly kind and patient, and a genius at his craft. You can tell he loves what he does and gives his patients 110% every time. I am SO glad I went with Dr. Burns for my liposuction procedure. If you are on the hunt for a surgeon, stop here! You will not be disappointed :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: joules
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a medical emergency with a breast implant extrusion. (A highly qualified surgeon had done that problematic augmentation.) There are only (roughly) 630 cases worldwide like mine. Dr. Burns is an incredibly compassionate surgeon. He said he would move heaven and earth to get me into surgery that week - and he did! Plus, his surgical skills, expertise & artisry are fantastic. He cares about the outcome. Dr. Burns office staff are exceptional. Warm, caring, considerate. Truly wonderful people!  Who helped a patient in a true emergency situation. I look forward to working further with Dr. Burns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Spann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns and his staff were wonderful to work with.  They we always quick to respond with any questions or concerns both before and after surgery.  I felt confident and comfortable with proceeding to book my surgery after an online consultation with him.  There are plenty of plastic surgeons in the Houston area (where I live) but I chose to go with him and make the 3 hour drive for surgery and my post op visit because he is highly recommended for one of the procedures I was having done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Fallen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Burns and his staff has been absolute perfection!  Recovery has been exactly as described, and I am already in love with my results.  I can’t say enough about Dr. Burns and his staff.  Everyone has been incredibly kind and communicative.  I am so grateful for the care and expertise.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Magan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Feared I had breast implant illness so I had my breast implants removed, I also had liposuction in my thighs, and abdomen, and had fat transfer to my breasts. 8 days post op and I can already tell Dr Burns is magical. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah S

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the care and attention I received from Dr. Burns and his staff. Lanie and Laura were so wonderful and made me feel so comfortable. The office environment was so cheerful and welcoming, they were able to answer all of my questions and took their time with me. Dr. Burns is very professional and knows what would look good for your body type. So glad I trusted him and his years of experience. They are so prompt replying back to me even post op and being out of state they worked wonderfully with me and my schedule. They were worth my time and money!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Felecia Nichole
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I couldn't be happier with my decision to use Dr. John Burns. He made me feel so comfortable and was so very honest with me along the whole process. I am only 1 week post op, still swollen, but I am beyond impressed already.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie McMacken

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Pickle

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanna Ojeda
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Burns and his staff was definitely outstanding I am 3 months post op I had liposuction and breast fat transfer done and let me tell you Dr. Burns is an expertise in his field I am in love with my results I love the fact that he managed to give me an hourglass figure and a natural breast augmentation I am so much more confident! he’s so attentive, caring and knowledgeable I am from out of town and still managed to get a hold of him when needed answered all my questions and concerns in a timely manner. Dr. Burns you definitely went above and beyond thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Jenson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns is amazing. Him and his staff made me feel comfortable and safe. Dr. Burns was easy for me to talk to and completely calmed my nervousness with my explant surgery. He informed me of things I did not understand and he was honest about the possible outcomes I will face. I am so grateful for my experience.  Dr. Burns and staff, if you read this, a million times, thank you for making my experience wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rena Cochran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Burns and his team, Tracie, Lanie, and so many others were absolutely beyond fantastic. They were all very attentive and professional with all the MANY questions and concerns I had about my breast augmentation surgery. I was so nervous about not only meeting them but also about the surgery it self. When I arrived at the Dallas Plastic Surgery Institute for my pre-op, my anxiety was through the roof. However, when I finally met everyone, it was almost like meeting family, they were so nice and warm hearted. They made me feel like I didn't have a care in the world. Dr. Burns kept eye contact with me the entire time he was explaining the procedure, he went over sizes, concerns, the surgery itself, and asked me several times if I was comfortable, he was absolutely amazing. His confidence in what he does was a breath of fresh air and I could not have been more thankful that I chose Dr. Burns and his team for this procedure. During my surgery, my nurse could see that I was a little overwhelmed by all the lights and equipment in the operating room so she squeezed my hand to let me know, everything was good and she was there. When Dr. Burns arrived he explained  everything again and made sure I was totally comfortable. The day after surgery, Dr. Burns and Lanie made sure all questions and concerns were answered before I traveled back home and said do not hesitate to call them with any questions, no matter how small I thought they might be, they wanted to be absolutely sure I was comfortable and happy with my results, which I couldn't be happier. They were truly amazing, professional, and treated me with the upmost respect as if I were a part of their family. Truly a Blessing...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizzy L.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns and his team were everything I could have wanted in a surgeon team! From our first appointment Dr. Burns and his staff were very transparent about the process and what would look best for me and my goals, patient while I asked 100 questions and very comforting on the day of the procedure. The team even answered a question late Sunday evening that I had. I would recommend Dr. Burns and his team to anyone looking for cosmetic work in the DFW area and I’ve even recommended him to my out of town friends as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krissa Blundell
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Dr. John Burns were amazing! From the first call loaded with all of my questions, to the consult, Pre surgery appointment, the surgery day, and first post op appointment, it all went beautifully!! I went with exactly what Dr. John Burns suggested even with being a little nervous about my breasts being too big. I’m so glad I did because I love the outcome, they are exactly what I wanted! This was the first surgery I’ve ever had and the whole staff on surgery day were so sweet and accommodating. When it was time to go into the surgery room I felt so calm and confident. I also can’t thank Lanie Sutton enough for her kindness and patience! Talk about a sweet sweet women, she definitely makes the atmosphere in that office! She walked me through every step and ensured me that I would never be a bother if I had concerns of questions at any time of the day. She was just so kind and I think that makes a huge difference when deciding to alter your body! I’m overall just so happy with the outcome and very happy I chose Dr. John Burns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandee Seelig
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can not say enough about Dr. Burns and his staff. Deciding to have breast augmentation at 57, I knew I was late to the party,  worried about getting the results I was seeking and almost embarrassed for even considering it.
From the first consult, Dr. Burns and his staff made me feel comfortable and more confident with my decision.
5 weeks post surgery and I am loving my results!
A huge thank you to Dr. Burns for giving me  what  I thought would never be attainable (without a lift).
I am beyond pleased....he truly is a miracle worker!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Torye Seidler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Walk don’t run to this office if you are thinking about a breast lift and or augmentation. This whole experience was absolutely amazing from day one. I can honestly say I could never have dreamed to be so happy with the lift and implant replacement. I cannot recommend this team enough!

I am from out of town and did a virtual consult with Dr. Burns where he took the time to answer all of my questions and give his feedback on what procedures/ size would give the best result. Dr. Burns shocked me with his quick responses to email and constant communication through the whole process from beginning to end.

I flew to Texas and met the team for the surgery. My nurse, Amarrah, was a saint and was patient and kind as she answered every question under the sun. After the surgery she continued to answer any and all questions I had while recovering. While I did have a rare complication with post op, through no fault of Dr. Burns, she made sure I was well informed of ANY risks possible which allowed for quick action! She took the time to reassure me that everything was right on track and looking over photos of anything I had questions about.

I always say you can tell a lot about a doctor based upon how they react when things don’t go according to plan. I know I was in the best hands with this team! While I live out of state, I will be coming back to Dr. Burns for any further surgeries I may need in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: pamela harper

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandy Green
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at the Dallas Plastic Surgery Center, and I cannot emphasize enough how unsatisfied I am with the outcome of my cosmetic surgeries. My first procedure, the fat graft to my breast, took place on January 14th, 2022. From the very beginning, the healing process was severe, and my concerns were far from resolved.

When I noticed painful, hard masses forming under the skin due to clumped fat tissue inside my breast, I immediately reached out to Dr. Burns on May 11th, 2022. In response, he recommended another surgery, promising that he could remove the cyst and prevent any future issues with additional fat or a breast augmentation surgery. Despite my weariness from the physical toll of the first surgery, I decided to go ahead with the breast augmentation on June 23rd, 2022, as my main concern remained.

Unfortunately, to my dismay, the cyst reappeared after the second surgery, and the pain persisted. For nearly five months, I had to endure this burden, letting my body recover from two surgeries, only to find no improvement. On October 26th, 2022, I met with Dr. Burns again and expressed my extreme dissatisfaction with the results. Rather than addressing my concerns properly, Dr. Burns suggested a third surgery, requiring an exorbitant cost of $8,000. This felt like nothing more than a trial-and-error approach.

Frustrated and desperate for answers, I sought second opinions from reputable surgeons who confirmed my worst fears. They unanimously agreed that my procedures had been subpar and fixing the issues would cost a staggering $30,000. The gap between the quality of work done by Dr. Burns and these other professionals was alarming.

To add insult to injury, when I received my file from Dr. Burns' office, I was shocked to find progress notes that falsely stated I was "pleased" with my results on March 2nd, May 11th, and October 26th. This misrepresentation only fueled my frustration and lack of confidence in the clinic.

The negative impact on my self-confidence and emotional well-being has been profound. I feel like a completely different person, and there are days when I can't bear to look at myself in the mirror or let others see me. This has taken a toll on my personal and professional relationships, leading to strains and emotional distress. The psychological burden I carry is immense, and I have even broken down in tears over the ordeal.

Moreover, the financial repercussions of this experience cannot be ignored. I had to take several weeks off work for each surgery, significantly affecting my wages. I never anticipated having to go through multiple surgeries just to correct the initial issues. Even now, I still miss workdays occasionally due to the ongoing discomfort caused by the cyst.

Given the dire situation, I firmly believe that I cannot continue working with Dr. Burns or the Dallas Plastic Surgery Center. I desperately need to correct the issues with my breast tissue, overall breast appearance, and scarring. In order to resolve this matter amicably, I expect Dr. Burns and/or Dallas Plastic Surgery Center to take responsibility and cover the cost of correcting these problems a.

In conclusion, my experience at the Dallas Plastic Surgery Center has been nothing short of disappointing and distressing. I sincerely hope that this letter will prompt the necessary attention and action to address my concerns and rectify the situation.

I am happy to share pictures but will not post as my results are traumatizing enough without the whole word, having to see them.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Burns, and his entire team, are the most warm and welcoming individuals you’ll ever meet. user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Tracie the office manager has been awful since day one it took her 3 days to return my call to schedule a date after my consultation for explant/fat transfer. Four days leading up to surgery I unfortunately had to cancel due to a death in the family. When I called her crying to inform her to my surprise she had no sympathy and replied your the girl that calls everyday with questions. To my defense, what girl wouldn’t call to ask questions leading up to surgery. The day I canceled she refunded me my money. A few weeks later my caretaker was able request time off from work and I wanted to reschedule the surgery. She told she would have to get with the dr and see and she will call me back. She never called me back and I did not receive a response for a week. I had to email the doctor and he said he looked forward to taking care of me and will get with Tracy. When I called her back a week later she said Dr Burns could not perform my surgery and she does not recall me saying I had a death in the family, otherwise she would have rescheduled me. When I asked her why it took her this long to respond she informed me that she does not do well with confrontation. I never heard from Tracie or Dr Burns after that call. This is very discouraging, because if there was an additional cost to reschedule I would have gladly paid it. I think they should include this in their policy instead of burning bridges with  their patients for needing to reschedule one time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Crab Trap Dallas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Things just work out just like they should. I was orginially scheduled with another center but things did not go through so I was referred to Dr. Burns. Everyone that works there is so kind and welcoming. I did my consult online and then went for my pre-op around 2 weeks before my augementation. Dr.Burns explained everthing to prepare for surgery and also did an AMAZING job my implants look so natural. I am on day 5 and feel absolutely fine. On a scale of 1-10 I would say a 1.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirsten
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Burns did my explant surgery, full enbloc capsulectomy, and he is absolutely amazing. user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an outstanding experience with Dr. Burns, from consult to follow-up. His nurse, Elizabeth, answered all of my questions and calmed my anxiety. I am still recovering but so far very happy with the results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dani Dee
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in for a consult, I didn't receive a warm greeting. My consult with Dr. Burns was for Bellafill to help with acne scaring. He didn't assess my skin at all nor came 2 feet in front of  me to know if I was a good candidate for this procedure. I didn't receive a skin test for it and was pretty upset I wasted time to come see him. All he did was play a 2 minute video and told me how much the procedure would cost. I felt insulted. The consult lasted for 3 minutes maximum and all he could ask me is if I wanted to do bellafill today. It's not always about money. People are living with acne scars that eats at there confidence. We come to doctors/surgeons to help us feel better and not depressed. And for this consult alone I will never go to this office again.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns & his staff are EXCEPTIONAL!! From the moment I walked in, they have done nothing but take care of me. Any question I may have is answered and taken seriously. I am truly grateful for every single person in that office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Dionet
user_reviews_extended.Description: En febrero del 2020 comence a buscar un cirujano plástico para cambiarme mis implantes ya que tenia más de 15 años con ellos,consulte con 3 diferentes cirujanos y ninguno me inspiro confianza como él, desde el momento que llame a la oficina del Dr.John Burns para hacer una cita marilu silva fue muy amable el día mi cita desde mi llegada al edificio todo muy bonito limpio el recibimiento de todo el personal muy amables y sobre todo muy profesionales el Dr.Burns fue muy paciente con mis preguntas durante la consulta, a causa del covi19 tuvieron que cambiar mis citas varias veces,en fin hoy tuve mi cirugía todo increíble la atención de las enfermeras anesteIologa y por supuesto del doctor me siento feliz, solo espero el resultado final y si tuviera que hacer algún otro procedimiento quirúrgico lo haría con el Dr.Burns 😍                                                            In February 2020 I started to look for a plastic surgeon to change my implants since I had more than 15 years with them, I consulted with 3 different surgeons and none inspired me with confidence like him, from the moment I called the office of Dr. John Burns  To make an appointment, Marilu Silva was very kind on the day of my appointment from my arrival at the building, everything was very nice, clean, the reception of all the staff, very friendly and above all, very professional, Dr. Burns was very patient with my questions during the consultation.  Because of the covi19 they had to change my appointments several times, anyway today I had my surgery all incredible the attention of the anesthesiologist nurses and of course the doctor I feel happy, I just wait for the final result and if I had to do some other surgical procedure I would do it  with Dr Burns 😍

title: Laurence A. Weider, MD
address: 7777 Forest Ln Building B, Suite B-145, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

complete_address.street: 7777 Forest Ln Building B, Suite B-145

user_reviews.Name: kennedy haden
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough good things about my experience with Dr. Weider! I had a breast augmentation and one of my biggest concerns going in was asymmetry. I’m only 21, so it was really important for me to find a surgeon I completely trusted and felt confident in. From the very first consultation, Dr. Weider made me feel comfortable and took the time to explain everything clearly.

One thing I really appreciated is that he lets you bring inspiration photos and actually listens to what you’re wanting. He doesn’t just go off a size you ask for, he really looks at your inspo and works with your body to achieve the look you want while still keeping everything natural.

My results are honestly amazing. What used to be noticeably uneven now looks perfectly balanced, they literally look like twins! The best part is how natural they look. You truly cannot tell I’ve had any work done, which was exactly what I wanted.

The entire team was so kind, professional, and supportive throughout the whole process, from consultation to recovery. I felt completely taken care of every step of the way. If you’re considering a breast augmentation, I would 100% recommend Dr. Weider. I’m beyond happy with my results!

user_reviews.Name: Bee P
user_reviews.Description: I cant begin to express how grateful I am to Dr Weider, Kimber and the entire staff! I knew immediately after my consult that this was the dr/practice that I would entrust with my explant and lift. Dr Weider, Kimber and staff handled all my questions / concerns and eased my mind before and after my procedure. I was given real expectations and they delivered better than I ever imagined! Dr Weider is a highly talented, skilled and very meticulous surgeon! My experience has been above perfection and I highly recommend Dr Weider and staff for any surgical needs.

user_reviews.Name: Ruth Okoye
user_reviews.Description:
I had my breast reduction surgery in March, and I truly couldn’t be happier with my experience or my results. Dr Weider did an amazing job, scaring in some places are virtually invisible!! He was super patient with me and all my questions as well! The entire team made me feel supported, informed, and cared for every step of the way.

The staff was incredibly kind and professional, but I especially want to shout out Kim and Kimber! They were absolute favorites, always available, patient, and thorough in answering every question I had. Their reassurance and attentiveness made such a difference throughout the entire process.

I’m beyond grateful for this team and would highly recommend them to anyone considering!

user_reviews.Name: Mikki McDougall
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Weider, Kimber, and the entire staff were so friendly right from the beginning - kind, informative, and patient.  I have had other procedures at different places, and this was a completely different experience.  I truly felt cared for.  I am so happy with my results and am feeling so much more confident about my health.  I highly recommend Dr. Weider and his office.

user_reviews.Name: Cynthia Burdick
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing experience with my Explant surgery. The whole staff is friendly, caring, attentive, and professional. Dr. Weider is meticulous as a surgeon & I knew I would love my results!

user_reviews.Name: CA
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Weider did an amazing job on my 2 recent surgeries.  Last fall he removed a large silicone mass in my right breast that was left during explantation done by a DIFFERENT doctor.  Dr. Weider then did a reduction on my left breast (with bilateral lifts) to give me asymmetry.  It is PERFECTION.  His office staff, Kim and Kimber, are absolutely the best and extremely professional.

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Zerzeck
user_reviews.Description:
There seriously are not enough words to say how incredible my experience has been with Dr Weider and his office from the very first call I made to them!  I initially got implants placed back in 2008 and for majority of that time I have dealt with capsular contracture on both sides. Needless to say the contractures just kept getting worse and worse as time went on leaving me with very misshapen breasts.  I searched around off and on for years for a surgeon but nobody I spoke to really made me feel comfortable or confident.

Then I came across Dr Weider!  From the very first call I made to his office I immediately felt I was in good hands!  All of my questions were answered and I didn’t feel rushed or pressured to schedule a consultation at all!  Then my actual consultation date came and all that appointment did was make me feel even more confident in my decision!  The office was very clean and the staff were INCREDIBLE!!!!  Kimber, his surgical nurse, is amazing and you can tell she’s a wealth of knowledge in this field and took all the time I needed to answer all of my questions. Dr Weider was also so friendly and made me feel very comfortable and confident that I was making the right choice regarding my surgical plan!  I ended up having a full explant and capsulectomy with a lift and implant replacement and I couldn’t be happier with my results!  For the first time in over 10 years, I finally feel confident looking at myself in the mirror!!  Trust me, you will not go wrong choosing Dr Weider as your surgeon!!!  I couldn’t recommend him or his office and staff more!

title: Dallas Surgical Arts
address: 12740 Hillcrest Suite 100 & 170, Dallas, TX 75230, United States

user_reviews.Name: Katie LaBean
user_reviews.Description:
I struggled with TMJ for years and tried countless doctors and treatments, none of which truly helped. I even saw another surgeon who quickly signed me up for surgery without much explanation, which didn’t sit right with me.

Getting a second opinion from Dr. Sanovich was one of the best decisions I’ve made. He took the time to thoroughly examine my jaw, explain my options, and make sure I was getting the right surgery, not just a surgery.

From start to finish, Dr. Sanovich and his entire team made me feel genuinely cared for and supported. My recovery was closely monitored, which was so comforting.

Since surgery, my jaw no longer locks, clicks, pops out of place, or causes the sharp pain I dealt with for so long. The difference has been life-changing. I am incredibly grateful for the care I received and would recommend Dr. Sanovich without hesitation.

user_reviews.Name: Dani Davis
user_reviews.Description:
Having been insecure about my underbite since childhood, I have explored corrective jaw surgery several times as an adult. However, the timing was never right due to financial, insurance, or family obligations. In 2024, at the age of 56, I finally decided to prioritize researching my options.

After several consultations, I knew I was in good hands when I met Dr. Sanovich. He is highly knowledgeable and showed great patience in answering all of my questions and concerns. Furthermore, because of his previous collaborations with my orthodontist, I felt confident that I would achieve the best possible results.

Dr. Sanovich and his team have been truly incredible throughout every stage of the process—from the initial consultation and FMLA paperwork to the pre-op appointments, the surgery itself, and recovery follow-ups. I cannot recommend Dr. Sanovich highly enough to anyone considering this life changing procedure.

user_reviews.Name: Ec Huebner
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Sanovich and his staff give superior customer service and a personalized overall experience, that provided us with a life impacting outcome we could have never imagined for our young, barely adult son. Every other specialist in the metroplex had told us there was nothing more that they could do. Everything they had tried was failing, from crowns to dental implants.  We never dreamed he could have a full set of teeth, aside from removable denture appliances and then we found Dr. Sanovich!
In addition, the personal and caring service that we received from Dr. Sanovich was unparalleled! Our son has seen dozens of specialists in his short life, but none has given us the kind and personalized level of care we’ve received from Dr. Sanovich- from pre-surgical, during, as well as post-surgical, and every step through recovery, to collaboration with his dentist and prosthodontist. He has truly changed our son’s daily life with his innovative surgical dental solutions!! We are beyond grateful for the daily impact his creative solutions and impeccable abilities have had on our son, and without even one scar- amazing!! We would 1000% recommend Dr. Sanovich and are forever thankful. ♥️

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Bruno
user_reviews.Description: Dr Sanovich is the most compassionate and skilled surgeon I’ve met. I’ve unfortunately had many surgeries, but I think most of them could have been skipped had I gone straight to Dr Sanovich from the start. I came to Dr Sanovich because I was unhappy with the aesthetic outcome of jaw surgery that was done elsewhere. Instead of doing a revision, Dr Sanovich was able to restore my smile and feminine facial portions by doing a lip lift and genioplasty. The original jaw surgery done elsewhere resulted in an infection, and it was actually Dr Sanovich that caught the infection and pushed for further testing. Had it not been for him, who knows how long the infection would have gone undiagnosed! He even worked while he was on vacation to help me with the issue. I’m so thankful for his compassion during that time, working on an issue that he had no responsibility for. He is also so meticulous with his own work. I’ve had multiple jaw surgeries and genios, and Dr Sanovich was the only surgeon who showed me his surgical plans and kept me involved in the planning process and took my aesthetic preferences into account while planning. So many surgeons are dismissive and protective of their work, but Dr Sanovich is so down to earth and approachable, that I’m able to come to him with even the tiniest of issues, and he acknowledges them and works to make things perfect. I flew in from California to see him, and I’ve once gone back multiple times for other procedures because there is no one else I trust with my face. Also his office staff are sooo on top of things, which makes coordination easy and removes a lot of stress! I just can’t say enough good things about this surgeon and his practice! I’m so thankful for him.

user_reviews.Name: Barbara Skora
user_reviews.Description: My experience with Dr. Randy Sanovich and the team at Dallas Surgical Arts was beyond 5 stars. From my consultation through my follow ups, I was met with extreme professionalism and care. Dr. Sanovich has the surgical precision and expertise that in combination with his artistic skill results in a beautiful and functional outcome. I came to Dr. Sanovich after more than 30 years of TMJ issues, poor occlusion and relapsed orthognathic (jaw)surgery. He performed bilateral total joint replacement of my TMJ’s,  Leforte, and some cosmetic tweaking.  I am 3.5 months post surgery and am healing really well. The office is extremely organized and well run. Communication is excellent. Emily, Martin and everyone that I had the pleasure of interacting with were top notch. I consulted with 5 surgeons before deciding on Dr. Randy. I also traveled from out of state for this procedure. I am very happy that I chose Dr. Sanovich and Dallas Surgical Arts.

user_reviews.Name: Alexandra Smith
user_reviews.Description:
ANGELA. IS. MY. GIRL. Cares so much for her patients. She is so understanding and attentive to my wants and gave such good advice/feedback. So easy to talk to and work out a plan on what is best for you. When I had some post-injection bruising after my first time and was *internally panicking*, she did everything she could to help the recovery process and make me feel better.

I had Jenn for my micro needling appointment and she was SO SWEET! Will definitely be back for future treatments!

The technician/reception staff are so sweet and helpful as well!

I love this place overall and won’t be going anywhere else!

user_reviews.Name: Trent Jardine
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Sanovich truly changed my life.

I can’t put into words how grateful I am for Dr. Sanovich and his team. After living with TMJ issues for years, I had bilateral TMJ joint replacement surgery with him — and it was the best decision I’ve ever made. I feel absolutely amazing. It completely changed my quality of life, and my bite and smile are perfect.

Dr. Sanovich is an incredible surgeon and a genuinely kind, compassionate person. He made me feel understood and cared for every step of the way. His skill and attention to detail are unmatched — but what stands out even more is how much he truly cares about his patients’ well-being.

Emily and the rest of the team were amazing, too. They made the process so much easier and were always there when I needed reassurance or had questions.

I honestly don’t know what I would have done without Dr. Sanovich. I’m beyond thankful for the care, expertise, and support he and his team gave me — they didn’t just fix my jaw, they gave me my life back.

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Anderson
user_reviews.Description: I’ve had three Sculptra sessions and one microneedling with PRP session and all of the above has been fantastic. The office staff and setting were warm and inviting, and I’ve loved the treatments I’ve received. Hannah was great about discussing my skin concerns with me and fine-tuning a treatment plan, then executing it well. Angela has been doing my Sculptra, and she took time to analyze my individual needs, was gentle, and was easy to chat with while getting injected. Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brandy Huls
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Randy and his entire team are phenomenal.
From my very first consult through post-operative care, the experience has been unlike anything I’ve had before.

My jaw journey began in 2019, long before I knew about Dr. Randy. Unfortunately, that meant three failed surgeries—a bilateral arthroplasty (twice), and then a botched total joint replacement with a LeFort I. Eventually, a fellow patient told me about Dallas Surgical Arts, and by that point I knew something was seriously wrong. I’d been living in debilitating pain that no medication, injection, or PT could touch. My third surgery had left one side of my face lower than the other, my eyebrow paralyzed, and my quality of life completely devastated. I lost my joy, my confidence, and even had to close my very successful business. The pain had simply become too much to bear.

By the time I met Dr. Randy, I was desperate but determined. Going in for a fourth operation was terrifying, but the possibility of relief and a whole lot of faith pushed us forward. Just shy of a year after that TJR and LeFort I, my husband and I made the trip from Northeast Florida to Texas.

From the very first appointment, I knew we were in the right place. The consultation was smooth, compassionate, and thorough. Within minutes, Dr. Randy suspected a non-union and potential additional complications, though we wouldn’t know the full extent until surgery.

Fast-forward to October 2, 2025: the plan was a total revision, upper blepharoplasty, and a brow lift. When I woke up, my husband told me the news… we had been right. A complete non-union… and more. The weight that lifted off my chest in that moment is something I’ll never forget. To know the pain I’d endured for years was REAL, and not something “in my head,” was indescribable.

But here’s where everything turns around.

I came out of that surgery with more hope than I’ve had in years. My joints were stable. My plates were no longer loose. I could taste again. And by some miracle (one no one can explain), the paralysis in my eyebrow resolved. Praise God.

One thing I deeply appreciate is that Dr. Randy understands aesthetics are just as important as the mechanics. I’m now eight weeks post-op, no longer reliant on prescription pain meds or Goody powders around the clock, and I finally have my self-esteem back. I’m already putting things in motion to return to work this spring.

Looking at me now, you would never know the hell I’ve been through, the scars are barely visible. Week by week, the progress amazes me.

If you’ve made it this far into my review, I hope you feel a glimmer of hope because there is hope for those of us dealing with these jaw issues. But I also hope my story encourages you to choose a surgeon who is not only skilled, but truly invested in your quality of life.

At my 6-week appointment, I sobbed with regret that I hadn’t him sooner. Randy just shrugged and said with a smile, “Ehh, I may not have been this good back then.” 😅

There is hope. I am proof.
— A wife, mama, and business owner
