user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Key
user_reviews_extended.Description: Angela with Dallas Surgical Arts is fantastic. She listens to my concerns and is extremely meticulous in her approach to address each of my needs making adjustments as appropriate. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly Sonner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so grateful for having found Dr. Sanovich and his team. Choosing Dr. Sanovich for my TJR is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for myself. I can’t say enough good things about his staff Emily (admin), Hailey (nurse), and Dr. McCullum (fellow). If you are looking for a surgeon who is patient, attentive, thorough, and incredibly skilled, Dr. Sanovich is the best choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sanovich and the entire Dallas surgical arts team are phenomenal. I needed to have total joint replacement of my jaw and also chin surgery. I was super nervous especially about how my face could look after surgery. I was happy to find out Dr Sanovich uses a virtual surgery planning tool so I could see the changes before I even did the surgery. He is an expert jaw surgeon and I’m so glad I picked him. My jaw and chin look and feel perfect, and my teeth line up exactly how they should. I’ve also received Botox and other injections at his office and the results have been great. I couldn’t be happier with my experience at DSA. All of the people in the office are so sweet, they remember your name when you walk in and are just very caring. Jaw surgery is scary to face but DSA made it so, so much easier. I’ve had no issues and have recommended them to people and will continue to do so! I no longer have chronic pain and dysfunction, and I can’t say thank you enough for changing my life! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Salwa Abukar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jennifer is incredibly knowledgeable and professional, yet she always takes the time to make sure you feel comfortable. Thank you Jennifer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so happy with the results of my nose job! Dr. Sanovich is an amazing plastic surgeon. While healing looks different for everyone, revisions and corrections sometimes have to be made. Without any hesitation he helped get my desired  results!  Not to mention his staff are amazing. They are extremely attentive , sweet, and amazing at what they do. I totally recommend coming here !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosa Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am absolutely terrified of any dental work but had to get my back molar removed. Dr. Daniel and his assistant Laura were amazing. Ms. Laura really made me feel at ease and listened to all my concerns and worries. It was not painful at all. I am definitely glad I had a positive experience and would recommend them to anyone who has anxiety with dental extractions. The only thing may be one of the front desk ladies seemed irritated but was helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathie Old
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really cannot say enough about Dr Sanovich and his wonderful staff. Each person there always provide me with the best care at each of my visits. I recently had a cosmetic procedure completed by Dr Sanovich and was impressed by his calls and texts to make sure I was well and  comfortable. When I enter the door I am always greeted with a warm smile and seen in a timely manner. After each and every appointment I have with at his office, I leave being amazed at their professional attitude and caring manner, that it has left me feeling like family. They are truly an awesome bunch and I HIGHLY recommend him to everyone!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Horadam
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was referred to Dr. Sanovich by my dentist after my TMJ Disorder deteriorated to a point of extreme pain and discomfort. Not only was it causing physical pain that radiated down my body, but it also caused sleep apnea, back and neck mobility problems, and numbing of my face.

Dr. Sanovich and his team patiently walked me through my options and potential treatment plans, landing on Arthrocentesis for my left jaw joint and Arthroplasty for my more severe right jaw joint. He and his team did a great job explaining the potential outcomes of the surgeries and how the recovery would likely look. The surgery itself was pretty easy, as was the immediate recovery (I didn't even need my jaw wired shut).

It has now been about two years since my jaw surgery, and Dallas Surgical Arts have been wonderful about checking in and making sure my recovery has been as smooth as possible. I'll never have a normal jaw, and they never promised that, but my TMD is MUCH less painful and my sleep apnea is no longer medically significant (goodbye CPAP!). I also can feel the right side of my face again, which is nice. Thank you to Dr. Sanovich and his team! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elija Seim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Sanovich and his staff are amazing! They explained everything to me and made me feel at ease throughout the entire process. I am happy with my results and would definitely recommend them!

I had my second procedure with Dallas Surgical Arts and yet again had a wonderful experience. The entire staff was so great to work with and I could not recommend them more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Hawley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Both my husband and I have been going to this office for years; everything from tooth extractions, to dental implants, to facials.  I’ve never had anything other than a wonderful experience.  The office itself is so beautiful and spa-like, and the folks working there are friendly and very professional. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to Dr Sanovich for Wisdom Teeth removal. Great doctor!! Helped when I had questions after surgery. Would recommend to my friends and family! Thank you Dr Sanovich!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noelle Zavala
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I elected to see Dr. Sanovich as a patient last year and underwent surgery in January 2024. I am absolutely thrilled with my experience.

Dr. Sanovich is one of the most caring, intelligent, and talented clinician/surgeons I have ever met. He is a master of his craft and balances form with function to achieve optimal results.

His support staff compliment his practice well and I always felt cared for. It was nice to see the same people each clinic visit and in the OR, holding my hand every step of the way.

I look forward to visiting DSA for future needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evelyn Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sanovich and his team are one of a kind! They are extremely attentive, caring, and skilled. I struggled with TMJ/TMD that caused daily headaches, migraines and chronic pain that became so physically limiting that I could not continue college. After years of unsuccessful non-invasive treatments, surgery became the final option and the work of the team at Dallas Surgical Arts brought me relief that I thought was impossible!

I had double jaw surgery in February with DSA, and each week post-op I saw more improvement in my condition. Dr. Sanovich and his team were extremely attentive and helpful during the process from start to finish, and were very responsive to any questions or concerns.

Now six months later I’ve had an 85-90% improvement in my overall symptoms! For 2-3 years before surgery I had to take OTC and prescription pain medicines multiple times daily, but I’ve now been med-free for months.

In addition to surgery, I also received Botox treatments from DSA for relentless tension headaches that eliminated them entirely.

Every experience with Dr. Sanovich and his team has been overwhelmingly positive! Both the surgery and Botox treatments were life-savers, and I couldn’t recommend Dallas Surgical Arts more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Patterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Dr Sanovich and his friendly staff. I always feel heard and taken care of. Dr Sanovich listens closely to really understand what I am needing while I am in his office. He makes me feel like I’m  his only patient, never rushing out of the room until my needs have been addressed. He has helped me heal and to look better. I highly recommend Dr Sanovich.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Kraft
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sanovich and his staff are simply amazing. I’m having a tooth implant done, but the hard parts are finished. I’ve had 4-5 visits to the office and have been treated as if I were a celebrity each time.

Dr. Sanovich has a busy practice, but he makes you feel that he will stay and visit with you as long as you want. There’s no hurry-up at his office. He has been very patient with my many questions, and he calls me at night after procedures just to be sure I’m OK.

His staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. I think by now I’ve met everyone in the office and without exception they are each top-flight.

I have absolutely no complaints, and I would refer any of my friends or family to Dr. Sanovich.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kellie Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Elsa, Is so knowledgeable & helpful. She is pleasant & informative. If you are wanting to do research before making a decision she's your person.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryle Filek
user_reviews_extended.Description: So thankful for Dr. Daniel Sanovich! He is a wonderful doctor and is so patient. I was paranoid of removing my last two wisdom teeth that were starting to cause some problems for me. His staff are just as amazing. I wouldn’t choose to go anywhere else. I recommend him to all my family, friends, and whoever else is in need of an awesome surgeon to remove those pesky wisdom teeth! Thank you so so much for taking such great care of me!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tori Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I was able to give more than 5 stars for this review, I would! Dr. Randy Sanovich and his entire staff are not only kind and helpful but also very knowledgeable as well! I am extremely happy with my Botox treatments and will be returning for continued treatments for the foreseeable future!! Could not recommend Dallas Surgical Arts more, I send all my friends their way because I know they are in great hands here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: abbie higgins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had the absolute best experience while having two procedures done with Dr. Sanovich and his team. Last year, I had my wisdom teeth removed and it was such an easy procedure and recovery. Three weeks ago, I had jaw surgery and am SO happy with the way everything turned out. Dr. Sanovich and his team have been very helpful in every aspect of the process. I currently live and work in Austin and they have been amazing with working around my schedule and communicating with my mom and I every step of the way. Loved being around such a personable and professional team. They really go above and beyond. I would 100% recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Schexnayder
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the initial consultation to the post operation; every single interaction I have had with Dr. Sanovich and his staff has been outstanding. In fact my experiences at the office have all exceeded my expectations, which is a very difficult achievement. Dr. Sanovich has proved to be highly accessible to his patients. They were willing to work with me on scheduling, the package, and topical products. There is a reason why the reviews are all so complimentary; the services and products are of incomparable quality. I will continue to recommend this doctor and office without reservation as I already have. I will also without hesitation continue to visit the office as needed. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zaina Kholaki
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sanovich and his staff are the absolute best ever! They were all so sweet and took really good care of me. I visited a couple of doctors before him and I never felt comfortable or confident after leaving their offices except for today. I am so thankful for Dr. Sanovich and his staff!
I was a little nervous before the surgery but Dr. Sanovich was very comforting and very honest with what was going to happen. My first impression of the office was just WOW, gorgeous decor and extremely clean. The operating room was pristine, with what is obviously new technology that made me feel safe. The process was so streamline, from small lockers to keep my belongings during the procedure all the way to a nice heater to keep my cozy when recovering. A+ experience, would absolutely recommend Dallas Surgical Arts to any friend of family member!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Murphee Stepanek
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received better care with this practice than I do with my routine physician! They superseded my expectations and provide next-level surgical skills! Probably the best kept secret in Dallas. I will definitely be going there for all my future cosmetic procedures!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elaine Velazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sanovich and his entire team were so amazing throughout the pre and post op process. They listen to you , answer any questions, and make you feel valued as a patient . Dr Sanovich is a fantastic physician and I am so glad I chose Dallas Surgical Arts !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosario Charo Welle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Oh my goodness, what can I say? My family and I first came to Dallas Surgical Arts in 2009 referred by our amazing orthodontist. Our then 10-year-old son needed oral surgery to correct an overbite and Dr. McBride and Dr. Sanovich were highly recommended. The procedure was done with extreme care, we remember the warmth and concern, and the time doctor McBride spent with us, as the procedure was explained to us and we were assured that our son will be in the best hands. It was a comforting experience for our son and for us. Recently, it was my turn to seek the help of Dr. Sanovich to correct a procedure and a severe infection due to an impacted wisdom tooth. Again, Dr. Sanovich and their staff were fantastic in spending time with me and my husband to listen to our concerns and to assure us of the best course of treatment to follow. The procedure was successful and my recovery time speedy and comfortable. If you are looking for a fantastic oral surgeon, look no more: Dallas Surgical Arts is your best choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Boyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: We came from out of state to have Dr. Sanovich perform TJR surgery for my daughter. We appreciate the way Dr. Sanovich and his staff accommodated us. They were quick to respond, spent plenty of time addressing our questions, were very attentive, and supported us in every way. Dr. Sanovich is a skilled surgeon and we felt much better knowing our daughter was in good hands. We couldn't be more pleased with the results from the surgery. Not trying to sound dramatic but I would say they were life changing for her. She healed quickly without any complications. The surgery took care of many medical and aesthetic issues and we are so pleased. She has a new confidence. Despite this being a very difficult surgery and recovery I would still highly recommend TJR surgery with Dr. Sanovich. Thank you Dallas Surgical Arts! We really are so grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Buchanan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to Dr. Sanovich to get my wisdom teeth removed and I had the best experience. The friendliest staff and very professional. He even played music before I went under so I wasn’t nervous which I thought was really cool. He always checks up on his patients to ensure you are happy with his staff, experience and his service.

Would highly recommend using him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Adelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got a rhinoplasty from Dr Randy Sanovich! I am now two years post op and my nose is so cute!  My breathing is so much better, and it looks very natural on my face. He did so well balancing the proportions of my face. He is such an amazing surgeon, you can tell how much he cares for his patients well being. If I could give 10 stars I would. Thank you Dr. Sanovich for the confidence I’ve gained, you’re the only surgeon I trust with my face.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yingzhi Liang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place has very unreasonable cancellation policy. I called to reschedule because I was sick but they said they will confiscate my $100 deposit even if I was sick and even if I just wanted to reschedule. I will not come back to this place again.

Update: They did call and explained to me that the money will be applied to my treatment which I was fine with. They refunded my deposit and refused to reschedule or book any new appointments for me. I just wanted to reschedule because of my sickness. Their manager was very hostile to me on the phone because of my review. I was treated meanly both times I had conversations with them. I would not recommend this place.

The review is all they care about, not their customers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Hairston
user_reviews_extended.Description:
One of the BEST Medical Spa/Doctors offices, I’ve ever been too. Dr. Sanovich is very professional, knowledgeable and really can transform and enhance his patients facial features.
Hailey is so gentle, professional, knowledgeable, and really can do a work of art on the products she uses on your face.
She has a very talented technique in lip injecting and it’s PAIN FREE. Her sculptra method is unlike any other procedure I’ve ever done. It’s quick and once again PAINLESS!
Jennifer is the queen of skin! She is your go too- for keeping that glowing radiant youthful skin we all wish to keep! She really listens and recommends certain skin formulas tailored for her patients and she really educates on the purpose of each procedure the patient gets. She is honest and I always walk out of her appointments learning something new about my skin, and how to keep it healthier!
The medical grade skin lines Dallas surgical arts carries is very impressive. They are not pushy at all. I will forever be a client of theirs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haylee Crow
user_reviews_extended.Description: If your thinking about getting anything cosmetic done, I would highly recommend Dr. Sanovich. I had 1.2 ml of lip filler done with him after having a bad experience with another injector. I am beyond happy with the results after just 2 days. I didn’t experience any bruising post injections and the swelling was down in just a few hours. His team was very attentive in efforts to make me feel comfortable and relaxed. Dr. Sanovich and his wife are truly great people and they do great work. 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Franks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing care for my child from a talented surgeon and caring staff.  She had a very major 7 hour surgery (upper and lower jaw reconstruction plus TMJ replacement) and we always felt like we were in the best hands throughout the process from initial consult, through the multi day hospital stay to extended and thorough follow up care.  Dr Sanovich has a great bedside manner, very approachable, easy to talk to, and put us at ease.  Highly recommend Dr Randy Sanovich and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Soukup
user_reviews_extended.Description: The 5 star reviews are true. This is easily the most genuine doctors office I have EVER been to. The ladies up front.. so so sweet. I live out of town and the communication was so effortless. Any question, concern, or paperwork I needed filled out was done/answered with no hesitation or issues. Dr. Sanovich himself, he knows what he’s doing and knows his stuff! Going into a face alternating surgery isn’t easy but he makes you feel comfortable and confident in the process. I am almost 2 months post-op and couldn’t be happier with my results and they aren’t even at peak yet! I would recommend Dr. Sanovich and his team 100x over. Thank you for such an amazing experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stasiuanna Washington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had double jaw surgery with Dr Sanovich in 2020 and the experience was amazing and I’m so happy with my results. All the office staff are friendly and professional, always feel at home when I come in. Haley is amazing, always there to answer all my questions. I have done botox, lip filler, IPL facial, skin pin and other things. Always leave happy and always my only choice for skin care of any kind .

user_reviews_extended.Name: A B (AAABEEE)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sanovich and his team continue to impress me! Each one of his staff members have been great for the two years I’ve been seeing them. I’m getting double jaw surgery in 2 weeks to correct a Crossbite and I fully trust this doctor and his team for a successful surgery. I interviewed 3 surgeons total over the last two years (who were in network) and Dr. Sanovich has impressed me by far over the other two.  Would recommend!

UPDATE: I had the surgery a few weeks back and everything went smoothly. My new smile is greatly improved. Dr. Sanovich and his ENTIRE team have been very supportive, communicative, and amazing throughout this journey. Jaw surgery comes with a lot of unknowns and variables, but I can’t think of a better place to go than to Dallas Surgical Arts.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gaudy Deleon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an Excellent experience, great service. I had 3 teeth extracted including a wisdom tooth. These guys made me comfortable, reasonable and clean.  It has been the best experience I have had at a dentist. From the front desk staff , to the assistants and Dr. Sanovich. Everyone was personable and treated me like they truly care. The office is immaculate and they made sure I was as comfortable as possible. I’m pleased and impressed.  They do it all, if your looking for high quality and a pleasant experience while doing things that are not necessarily enjoyable this is the place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Mattox
user_reviews_extended.Description: We can’t say enough about this gifted surgeon!  My son had double jaw surgery 12/16.  Dr. Randy Sanovich literally changed my sons life, giving him the most perfect face, profile, and teeth alignment.  Flawless results.   The care he provided both before and after the surgery has been incredible.  The entire staff is absolutely amazing.  Dr. Sanovich and his team of incredible individuals truly set the standard for others to be measured.  Absolutely recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alayna Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sanovich is a great person. He is down to earth, compassionate, and honest.

I had genioplasty + neck lipo. I was a little indecisive about what I wanted to have done and obviously extremely nervous. Dr. Sanovich and his team were so patient and understanding with me. They really take their time and make sure everything is healing properly post-op. I’m currently 3 months post-op, and my results get better and better everyday. My case was not an easy one, but I am so happy with my results and I feel so much more confident.

My experience with Dr. Sanovich has been such a journey, I’m actually sad that it’s over. I’ve truly enjoyed my time with Dr. Sanovich and all of the nurses that have assisted me at his office. I am beyond thankful for Dr. Sanovich and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith Yates
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Sanovich and his staff. When my young  daughter had a lip and mouth injury he went out of his way to treat her and give her the best care possible. He has amazing bedside manner and made my child feel safe and in great hands. His follow up has been so thorough and attentive and he truly connects with his patients. His staff is friendly, professional, and proactive- from phone calls, to front desk, to his nurses- every component is exceptional. My daughter says “Dr. Sanovich is Awesome!”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron May
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sanovich is amazing! He has a spectacular bedside manner combined with exceptional skill. I felt extremely confident putting the life of my mother in his competent and caring hands. Truly an excellent surgeon, he explained everything keeping all factors in my mother's care in a clear and defined priority. I cannot recommend him enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Dougan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our family had a wonderful experience here for my daughter’s jaw surgery! Dr. Sanovich is a skilled surgeon, and we are so grateful that he was able to diagnose a complex bite problem and co-ordinate a multi-step treatment that began and ended with orthodontics and had surgical treatment in the middle. His office team are also exceptional. Like Dr Sanovich, they are very kind and responsive and they  were so respectful of our concerns as parents. They took time to answer all of our questions and to make sure we were all comfortable every step of the way. I would choose Dr Sanovich and his team again in a heartbeat and am so grateful to our orthodontist for recommending him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dallas Surgical Arts is awesome and I recommend everyone I know! Dr Sanovich is amazing but, Haley has been a blessing from day 1! She assisted in my daughter’s very lengthy and difficult surgery which is how we originally met. More recently she has been amazing with my Botox as well as correcting the lip injections I had elsewhere.  She corrected my bumpy, ugly lips and has given me the natural, smooth, but much more plump lips I’ve been looking for!!! I’ve recommended her to multiple friends of mine!!! ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Kelsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had multiple visits to this office and the atmosphere has always been the same: kind compassionate people who are friendly, caring, and happy. Dr. Sandovich is probably the most down to earth doctor I’ve come across in my 60 years. He is humble and interested in your life outside of your mouth!  And I have to say - it doesn’t hurt that he is so easy on the eyes too!  I highly recommend him and his staff. I am in good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Calabrese
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the most professional service I’ve received in a long time. From the front office staff to the doctors, you are treated like a VIP the minute you walk in. I never had to wait and was given all information needed along the way. I cannot recommend them enough! Thank you for taking such good care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Palmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dallas Surgical Arts is everything I’ve been looking for! We moved here a little over a year ago and I’ve been searching for a new injector. After trying a few places and being let down, I finally found Hailey at DSA. Not only is she patient, kind, and thorough- she did a WONDERFUL job on my Botox. The entire staff at the practice is friendly and professional. I am excited to return!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy P
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about our experience with Dr. Sanovich and his team! From beginning to end they were professional and kind with outstanding customer service. Dr. Sanovich is very knowledgeable and took the time to answer and address all of our questions. We are also very happy with the results of our daughter’s surgery. We highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Doyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Words can’t express our appreciation for Dr. Sanovich, Hailey Ware and all the staff. We are new to Dallas and our daughter needed jaw and nose surgery and wisdom removal. Dr. Randy and his team made it happen. The results are amazing and she looks beautiful. Every aspect of the practice is superior from insurance to scheduling. Their clinical abilities are exceptional and as a mom I really appreciate the strong communication. Our family always feels special when we go for check-ups.  I will be the next patience in our family to visit Dallas Surgical Arts!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacqueline Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The reason I chose Dr. Sanovich is because he and the staff at DSA are so knowledgeable. I had two procedures done with Dr. Sanovich and felt at ease knowing I had a doctor that knew what he was doing. He definitely respects and puts into consideration the outcome you want. If you have any questions he and/or the staff will get on it asap. Now the one thing is, Dr.Sanovich is SUPER popular/busy so make sure to be patient when booking with him.
One thing that stood out to me was how clean the office was, and their in office surgical room.
I went for a consult without knowing much about his work, and later found out he is a well known doctor in the DFW. I honestly thank God I landed in such good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Bannavong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Choosing Dr. Sanovich as my surgeon for orthognathic surgery was the right decision. He and his team made every step as smooth as it could have been. They were very accommodating with me being from outside the Dallas area and did their best with keeping me well informed the entire time. Dr. S definitely shows he is highly knowledgeable, skilled, and humble at what he does and his work speaks for itself. There’s not enough stars on this review I can give to express how satisfied I am of my results from surgery, with Dr. S, and with his team. You shouldn’t think twice about finding another doctor; Dr. Sanovich will exceed your expectations in every way possible. Plus he and his staff are all such cool people. They make you feel comfortable and right at home in his office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent first appointment! The office is beautiful and clean. They were perfectly on time with basically zero wait time.  The staff are incredibly kind, attentive to needs and knowledgeable about what they do. Dr Randy is great! Obviously an expert at what he does. Took plenty of time to explain the procedure and manages any discomfort very well. I look forward to future appointments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linh Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Danny did a great wisdom removal for my daughter, Jennifer today. The process was extremely efficient and even my daughter’s recovery was quick as well. His team provided everything for us for after the surgery and made sure we were prepared to go home with all the precautions during the recovery phase. Dr even called throughout the day to check up on my daughter to make sure she was okay! He’s a very friendly person and a fantastic doctor as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Betsy Rosen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been more impressed with a doctor in my life! Dr Sanovich really took care of me and checked in with me regularly ( especially on his personal time) to make sure I was recovering from my surgery. I would HIGHLY recommend him to anyone and even wish he could also be my general practitioner. He’s attentive, knowledgeable, sincere and genuinely cares about his work and his patients. I’m not typically a review writer but he  deserves the acknowledgment without any doubt!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noli
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sanovich has all of the qualities a person hopes for when seeking excellence from their medical professional. He has a perfect balance of expertise, personality and honesty that creates a synergy that is comforting and reassuring. His results are impeccably delivered with skill and confidence. His staff members are pleasant, welcoming and accommodating. I would wholeheartedly recommend them without reservation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Cummings
user_reviews_extended.Description: After I was attacked by a dog, I needed reconstructive surgery and Dr. Sanovich came to my rescue. Everyone at Dallas Surgical Arts has been so kind, professional, and accommodating. The new office on the ground floor is easy to find, beautful, and inviting. Parking in the open lot is easy with ample space. We couldn’t have chosen a better place. Dr. Sanovich really cares about his patients. His confidence is reassuring. In one month I’ve had three surgeries & he has given me hope. Who knows, maybe I’ll look better than before the attack when all is said & done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Del Rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Dallas Surgical Arts for my facial procedure and injections for a couple of years now. Every experience is top notch from the moment you walk in the door. I had a procedure with Dr. Randy that went wonderful and have been getting injections with Hailey for my youthful appearance. I also received a facial from Jen and felt like my skin was brighten instantly.  I highly recommend the office for any facial goals that you may have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Addkison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I look forward to every appointment! I first went in not knowing exactly what was going to be best for me but I knew I didn’t love my lips. That is when I met Jayne! She talked me through filler and lip flips and I ended up with a lip flip. I absolutely love the way it makes my lips look. user_reviews_extended.Name: Barb Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Outstanding Practice!

Having just moved to the area I was pretty panic stricken when a broken tooth quickly escalated to a dental cyst and extraction of three teeth, including one very impacted wisdom tooth.  After hours of googling and review reading I picked up the phone and called Dallas Surgical Arts.  Dr. Sanovich is a double-board-certified surgeon in oral and maxillofacial as well as facial cosmetic surgery...  I really needed a warm fuzzy and his credentials were impressive.  From that very first contact this practice raised my bar when it comes to expectations from a medical services provider.  Every single member of their staff, from the front desk to the surgical team to Dr. Sanovich himself was friendly, smart, caring and went out of their way to help me feel not only informed and comfortable... but important!  Like they genuinely valued and appreciated my trust in their practice.  How often do you get this from a doctor’s office???

Big picture, my entire experience was exceptional.  Called them on a Monday, got in for a consultation on Thursday and had my surgery on Friday (all in same week).  He removed the cyst, extracted one very impacted wisdom tooth and two others next to it AND started two implants on the other side of my mouth.  By Monday I was back to work... albeit a bit sore but with very little pain and definitely on the mend!  Considering all the potential complications (severe pain, dry socket, nerve damage, infection, etc.) I couldn’t have asked for a better outcome.

Aside from the great outcome here are a few other things that really impressed me:

-- When I called to make an appointment they were fully booked but immediately offered to “re-arrange” a few things to get me in quickly
-- Being able to set an appointment via text message, and personal texts to remind me about it
-- Entire operation seems really well run, very professional and organized with attention to all the little (but really important) details
-- Having the latest & greatest technology on-site (like 3D imaging)
-- Prescriptions given the day before surgery... so no having to deal with the pharmacy afterwards
-- Cozy blankets and my choice of music during surgery, plenty of time in recovery area afterwards & no rushing me out the door
-- Option to use Exparel for pain control really minimized need for strong painkillers
-- Great follow-up care – personal calls from Dr. Sanovich to check in on me

Needless to say, I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annette Matteson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist referred me to Dr. Sanovich for ongoing TMJ-related jaw problems. After more than 10 years of pain and discomfort, 5 dental devices that didn't help and sometimes worsened the condition, I had given up hope. I could only open my mouth slightly and was in nearly constant pain. I scheduled a consultation with Dr. Sanovich, and was able to get in quickly. Dr. Sanovich immediately restored hope that I could feel better. He explained what the issue was in language that I could understand, listened to my description of symptoms, answered my many questions and was very empathetic. He gave me real-patient examples of successful surgeries, but never made false promises. The consultation included a CT of the jaw, but an MRI was needed to determine exactly what the problem was. The MRI showed that the disc that cushions the jaw had slipped out of place, which is what he predicted at the consultation. But, the disc was also perforated. So instead of having a surgery that would put the disc back in place, I needed an abdominal fat graft to replace the disc. I wanted to do the surgery as soon as possible so that I would recover in time for a trip, so had the surgery within two and a half weeks of my initial consultation. I am now 9 weeks from the surgery, and am almost entirely pain-free and am now able to open my mouth almost normally. Throughout the consultation, surgery and follow-up, his staff was extremely helpful. The Dr called me after hours several times and was available to me by phone any time. I had an exceptional experience with Dr. Sanovich and his office. I highly recommend Dallas Surgical Arts.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Randy Sanovich and Laura helped me learn a lot during my jaw surgery consultation! I am grateful for doctors and medical staff like them. I've experienced a lot with my health and just validation and kindness from a doctor saying he knows it's been a lot really helps mentally. The Othognathic treatment coordinator didn't seem very friendly/helpful in my experience but still overall a good office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg coward
user_reviews_extended.Description: Having Jaw surgery over a year ago, with moving the upper and lower jaw forward to help me breathe is not a surgery anyone wants but one i needed to have. Unfortunately this was the 2nd time In my life. Things change after 30 years. The surgery was not easy nor was it a fast recovery. However, the team from the office to the hospital surgery team always took time to care. As for  Dr Sanovich, I may start to Cry on how well he helped me. I had a few complication with surgery and recovery. Dr Sanovich never stopped helping  me recover.  He even spent time talking  to my wife, make sure she was ok and understood he would do everything it took to get me through the process. The whole team never stopped trying. Even a year later they still call and check on me. Surgery is just that, surgery. Everyone responds different but the response from the group taking care of you is what matters. I would suggest anyone take the time to let Dallas Surgical Arts be a part of your health solution if you are in need.  Thank you for always making me feel loved and cared for. Greg

user_reviews.Name: Scott Flanagan
user_reviews.Description:
Lone Star Plastic Surgery is absolutely amazing! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and well cared for.

Candance and Alexandra are incredible so friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. They took the time to answer all my questions and made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. You can tell they truly care about their patients.

Dr. Hill is exceptional. He is attentive, honest, and extremely skilled. He listened to my goals, explained everything clearly, and delivered results that exceeded my expectations. I felt completely confident and comfortable in his care.

The entire team is top-notch, and the office atmosphere is warm and professional. I highly recommend Lone Star Plastic Surgery to anyone considering cosmetic or plastic surgery. Truly a 5-star experience

user_reviews.Name: Bob Baumann
user_reviews.Description:
I was involved in a severe car accident that resulted in significant facial injuries. The hospital initially planned to close my wounds without a plastic surgeon, but my wife insisted on bringing one in. I ultimately required 60 stitches to my face and 24 staples to the back of my head.

Dr. Hill and his team were exceptional. Their skill, precision, and professionalism were evident from the beginning, and the results speak for themselves. I am truly amazed at how well Dr. Hill was able to put me back together. His entire team is top-notch—highly capable, compassionate, and attentive throughout the entire process. I cannot say enough positive things about the care I received.

user_reviews.Name: Gee
user_reviews.Description:
I came for the laughing gas, stayed for the surgery! :)

Dr. Hill and his team were AMAZING. I had my Upper Bleph done within a week of my consult, and the entire process was smooth, professional, and surprisingly Stress Free.

BIG SHOUTOUT to Alex, Traci, Candace, and Amber for taking such great care of me. Laughing gas deserves its own shoutout... I couldn't have done without her! Haha

Great price, great vibes, and by week 3 I was already loving my results. 10/10 would do again!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a TT, MR, and lipo with Dr. Sean Hill and absolutely love my results. His staff are some of the sweetest I have met and the office setting is beautiful and comfortable. He's on point with every question, even after surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I couldn’t be happier with my experience! Dr. Sean Hill is absolutely amazing—professional, compassionate, and incredibly skilled. From the initial consultation to the post-op follow-ups, he made the entire process smooth and stress-free. Dr. Hill took the time to understand my goals, answer all my questions, and ensure I felt confident and comfortable every step of the way.

The results are beyond what I imagined—beautiful, natural-looking, and perfectly tailored to my body. His staff was also incredibly friendly and supportive throughout the journey. I would 100% recommend Dr. Sean Hill to anyone considering breast augmentation. He’s the best!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hill is a terrible listener. His bedside manner is poor. I was so disappointed in his approach to understanding my medical history in order to help me. Would never go back, walked out of my consultation. Please don't waste your time, emotional health or $ like I did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Michel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hill and his staff are incredible.  They showed the utmost professionalism through the entire process from my very first office visit until the final post-surgery checkup.  They made me feel at ease during the consultations, and always kept me informed about the expected results from the procedure I wanted.  The outcome was far better than what I had initially imagined, and I am still very pleased 6 months later.  I highly recommend Dr. Hill and Lone Star Plastic Surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Beatty
user_reviews_extended.Description: I go to Dr. Hill for my injections and am always very pleased with my results! Dr. Hill and Candace, the nurse injector, are a great team to go to for your cosmetic goals! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cara Fraser
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first impression of Dr. Hills office was Amber;  she was so kind & helpful when explained I had lost 55 lbs over the past 3 years and had kept at the same weight for about 6 months. I had fat on my belly that no matter what I did it wouldn’t  go away.

In my  consultation with Dr Hill he was very upfront about the expectations that I had about just having a panniculectomy vs what could be achieved by just having the panniculectomy; it would remove the fat but it would not alleviate my back pain, next he discussed adding liposuction & abdominal plasticity to get the results that I did need.  I had a lot to think about, research & pray. I decided to take this leap of faith because this issue had been my struggle my whole life.

It was a big surgery but it all went well.  Again everyone I came in contact with were amazing, the nurses, techs & even dietitians in the hospital helped make this a positive experience.

My recovery had some issues with my incisions which turned into my recovery taking a little longer but with the knowledge of Candace, her constant support, answering all my questions & keeping me calm while healing, I am all good.

At 3 months post opp I am going good, back to exercising and living my best life. And please at where I am right now.

I took a leap of faith and couldn’t be happier and pleased with my results.  I could not have asked for better support, knowledge and genuine care of everyone at Dr. Hills office.

I would highly recommend Dr. Hill to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shanda Lynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very please with my whole experience. All of my questions were answered and the process was explained fully to me. Dr.Hill and his staff have been wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: A++ The facility & staff are TOP NOTCH. I had my Fall BROTOX done by Candace this day. Professional, witty, SKILLED, concerned & passionate. HIGHly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diego Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got a facial done here with Alexandra and she did and amazing job. She explained everything throughly and left my face feeling amazing !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandi Soto
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office and team are great! It’s been a little over 2 years since my breast reduction, and I am not happy with my results. No blood work done before procedure in case of an emergency. I asked and they said they’d do it while at the hospital which didn’t happen while I was awake so not sure if it ever got taken. My areolas aren’t the same! One is circle shaped with like a cut almost mid area as if it were sliced in 2 different parts. While the other is an oval shape with some bumps around it, and an ugly scar. They were perfect before my procedure. They still hurt with any touch as if they are going to be ripped off! I did mention to Dr.Hill at one of my last visits he said he could refer me to a cosmetic tattoo artist to fix them for me, but I refused because I couldn’t afford it. Medicaid paid for my procedure as it was a medical necessity due to back pain, but regardless it was still paid for. If it were done correctly I wouldn’t need to have it fixed. If my self esteem was low now it’s even lower. I’m afraid to even show my breast. Other people’s pictures looked great and awesome reviews which is why I chose Dr.Hill, but from my personal experience I regret doing it. Do your research really good!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corinne Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hill and all of his staff are absolutely amazing! I was bit in the face by a St. Bernard while on vacation & had to undergo emergency reconstructive surgery. I went to Dr. Hill the day I got back to TX. From my first visit, Dr. Hill along with his Medical Assistant Alex (HIGHLY recommend Alex if you need sutures removed -she  has hands steadier than a mannequin). Every staff member has gone above expectation to ensure that I’m not only healing great, but also that I’m comfortable, know/understand all of their recommendations and treatment plan and expectations. There’s no doubt I’ve been in the best hands with Lone Star and it’s evident in how well my face looks today compared to just 6 short weeks ago when I felt horrified and unrecognizable. Thanks y’all for everything you’ve done for me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shouting from the rooftops - “IF YOU NEED BOTOX OR FILLERS, GET YOURSELF AN APPT WITH CANDACE!” I’ve had Dr. Hill administer my Botox for years, but I attended the monthly Botox party and was injected by Candace last week.  When I tell you my kids can’t see “mean mommy” face and my forehead looks smooth as butter, it’s the truth! I am SO impressed! She was gentle, conservative with her treatment, and ahhmazing. Dr. Hill is amazing at his craft, and now Candace is an added bonus ! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Amerault

Dr. Hill did my lip filler and did such an incredible job! Let me tell you I was SO nervous. They staff eased my worries, they're an incredible group of individuals. My lip filler looks natural yet still plump! I love it!

Thank you to all at LSPS!

I highly recommend going to see Alexandra @ Lone Star Plastic Surgery. You will NOT be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monique J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s been about a year and a half since I had my breast reduction, and honestly, I’ve been holding off on writing this because I wanted to give it time. In the beginning, everything seemed fine. I had some pain and swelling, but I was told that was part of the healing process.

As the months passed, I started to notice that my breasts never actually got smaller. The areolas didn’t look right either, like they weren’t shaped or cut correctly. The pain in my nipples never fully went away, and I still have soreness under my breasts where the incisions were made.

I couldn’t go back for a follow-up because my insurance got cancelled. I’ll say this, Dr. Sean seems like a nice guy and cool on the surface, but it felt like he was more focused on the money than the outcome.

On a positive note, the office staff were amazing. Very friendly, professional, and helpful anytime I spoke to them.

I usually don’t leave reviews like this, but I’m not happy with how things turned out. I was hoping to feel relief and confidence after the surgery, and instead I’m still dealing with discomfort and results that just don’t look or feel right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Stepanenko
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had my lips done by Candace. She is the sweetest person ever and so gentle while doing the injections. My lips look incredible! I did the mini pout which is a half syringe instead of a full syringe of filler. If you’re nervous about doing a full syringe, definitely get this to start! My lips look natural but still have some volume to them. I can’t recommend Candace enough!

It was a better result than I even expected! My appointments, surgery and recovery were all easy! If you want a surgeon that is truly a surgeon and not a salesperson, than this is the right place. I honestly could not have trusted him more.

I’d definitely recommend Dr Hill and Lone Star Plastic Surgery…if there was an option for 7 stars, I’d have selected it, but I’ll stick with the 5 stars for now :)

user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a SkinPen micro-needling treatment done and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Alex was super knowledgeable and made me feel extremely comfortable throughout the whole process. My skin was noticeably better within a few days of healing. Looking forward to all of my future sessions with Alex!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Makenzie McCormick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a facial with Alex and she did AMAZING! The products were great but there were 2 major things that stood out to me:
1. She asked me before we started if I wanted to yap or if I wanted to relax. I thought this was so nice because I've had facials where the aesthetician doesn't stop talking the entire time, and I usually like to zone out during my facials lol!
2. The lighting in the room was PERFECT and I mean PERFECT. It was perfectly diffused so it wasn't harsh but I also wasn't in there complete blind.
I HIGHLY recommend Alex and this Medspa and cannot wait to go back!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annemarie Caraway
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a skin analysis done with Alex Romo and it was a great experience. We discussed my current skincare routine and she asked about my skin goals. Then she looked at my face under a special light to look for sun spots, dry or oily spots, redness, congestion, etc. I then got to test some products she recommended to help with my redness and dry spots. She even wrote down the order I should be using my products to optimize my skincare routine! She was so friendly and helpful. I’ll definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Romo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Candace did amazing on my botox treatment, she walked me through everything she was doing and made me feel comfortable during my treatment. Dr.Hill and his staff are super friendly and welcoming, will definitely be back and recommend my friends to this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenan Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Hill was truly wonderful. I am so happy with the results of my surgery. He did beautiful work, he was always informative and kind. user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethany Dornbusch
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Hill and his staff are all SUPER incredibly nice! I have received a breast reduction and a hydrafacial from Lone Star Plastic Surgery. You will receive EXCELLENT service starting from as soon as you walk in the doors and see Jamie, the receptionist, who is as sweet as can be, to getting your consultation and all your questions answered by Dr. Hill, Dawn, and Alex, to walking out the door with you yourself feeling satisfied and completely taken care of. user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucy Vo

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Walking into the serene ambiance of the spa, I was both nervous and excited about my first HydraFacial and dermaplaning experience. The soft lighting, calming music, and gentle aroma of essential oils immediately put me at ease. Alex, the esthetician, greeted me with a warm smile, and I knew I was in good hands.
As we began, Alex explained each step of the process, ensuring I felt comfortable and informed. We started with dermaplaning, where Alex used a delicate blade to gently exfoliate my skin, removing dead cells and peach fuzz. The sensation was surprisingly relaxing, and I felt my skin becoming smoother with every stroke.
Next came the HydraFacial. Alex expertly applied a series of serums and used a specialized device to cleanse, extract, and hydrate my skin. The gentle suction and cooling serums felt invigorating, and I could feel my skin absorbing the nourishing ingredients.
When the session ended, I looked in the mirror and was amazed at the transformation. My skin was glowing, smooth, and rejuvenated.  Alex's skill and attentive care made my first HydraFacial and dermaplaning experience a success.

I’ve never felt like my appointment was rushed like at other offices & have always had great results from my injections!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend getting a skin scope done with Alex Romo. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a HydraFacial a couple weeks ago--my skin looked so much better right after and has continued to improve.

I had a couple fine lines, some lower-face drooping, and a LOT of congested pores on my nose. It was so weird to see all the skin debris Joy had extracted and exfoliated. My skin was so smooth and taut right after.

I also bought the Skinceuticals CE Ferulic oil and the Skinceuticals Retinol 0.3. I was concerned about how they'd fit in with the anti-aging skin care routine I already had, so Joy googled the products and went over the ingredients for me to make sure. I appreciated that so much!

So--I have smoother skin and finer pores than I've had for years, maybe decades. I also think my skin looks more toned and taut. I recommend this facial and Joy very highly. She really went the extra mile to make sure I understood everything that was happening. My skin looks even better than I anticipated--I'll definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such an amazing experience with Dr. Hill from start to finish. He was incredibly kind, professional, and made me feel comfortable every step of the way. I’m almost 5 months post-op now, and I absolutely love my results! they turned out even better than I imagined.

My recovery was surprisingly smooth. I had little to no pain after surgery and was able to get back to my normal routine pretty quickly, including doing regular chores. Within just two weeks, I was already back at work and even going to the gym.

I truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience. If you’re looking for a skilled, caring surgeon who delivers beautiful results, I highly recommend Dr. Hill!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Salma Nadifi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Honestly, I don’t even know where to start. I had rhinoplasty on March 22 (or possibly April, I don’t remember the exact date), and it has been over two years. My nose still looks terrible. From the very beginning it was uneven.
When I brought this up to the doctor, he kept telling me it was just swelling and that it would improve with time. I trusted that explanation and waited, but nothing improved. One side of my nose looks completely different from the other. The asymmetry is obvious and very disappointing.
While my breathing may be slightly better, the appearance of my nose is far worse than before. The shape is uneven and looks unnatural. I honestly feel embarrassed and uncomfortable looking at myself in the mirror. This experience has been extremely frustrating and emotionally draining.
Now I’m faced with the possibility of needing revision surgery, which is another expensive and stressful process. After this experience, it is very hard for me to trust another surgeon.
This has been the worst medical and cosmetic experience I’ve ever had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edith Lowry
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was so incredibly easy to make the appointment and the lady at the front desk was so welcoming and kind when I got there. I expected to have to have surgery on my nose for a scar revision for MOHS procedure. Dr. Hill immediately made a decision that that was unnecessary, and instead suggested a steroid shot. I expected to have to wait weeks for the results, but by the time I woke up the very next morning, there was no bruising or pain in my nose and the lump that was on the top of my nose that concerned me was completely dissolved. I could not be more pleased with the results or the care I received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Sauceda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I come to Lone Star Med Spa to see Alex, and she’s truly amazing at what she does. She’s helped improve my skin texture so much and has been very intentional with treating my rosacea. I love that every treatment is customized to exactly what my skin needs. You can tell she genuinely cares about her clients and their results. Highly recommend her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peyton Meroney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t recommend Lonestar Plastic Surgery enough. Candace did an amazing job on my Botox. She has a gentle touch and did a fantastic job. Amber at the front desk was so welcoming and Traci, the patient care coordinator, made me feel very comfortable and cared for. I will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mayra Romo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you've been thinking about starting your skincare journey or stepping up your routine, I can't recommend this experience enough. Alex is incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely such a great time to be around. She took the time to thoroughly explain every step from start to finish and makes the whole process feel easy, empowering, and even fun.
Can't wait for session two!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Mayfield
user_reviews_extended.Description: The aesthetician, Alex, is fabulous! So friendly, professional, and very knowledgeable. My skin has truly never looked better - it’s younger looking, smoother, and more glowy. Highly recommend Alex and the whole staff at Lone Star Med Spa!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing customer service. Very detail oriented. Amber at the front desk is always very kind and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don’t usually rush to leave reviews, but in this case I felt compelled to share my experience for anyone considering revision surgery.

Dr. Hill performed my breast revision using Strattice mesh, and even though my recovery has been a bit longer than expected, I am truly beyond amazed at the results. His work speaks for itself … the outcome is natural, beautifully done, and exceeded my expectations.

What sets Dr. Hill apart is not just his surgical skill, but who he is as a person. He is incredibly kind, attentive, and takes the time to ensure you feel informed and comfortable every step of the way. You can tell he genuinely cares about his patients and the quality of his work.

If you are contemplating a revision or looking for a top-notch surgeon, I cannot recommend Dr. Hill enough. Choosing him was one of the best decisions I’ve made, and I’m so grateful for the results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hill and his staff are amazing.  They go out of their way to get you in and also make you comfortable.  Every part of their process has a special touch!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Callier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Second time in for a facial with Alex and both times I’ve came out skin feeling fresh and clean. Alex is also very informative educating you throughout the service and also giving tips for the skin goals you are trying to achieve! I highly recommend booking!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Owens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience!  Dr. Hill and the entire Lone Star team are professional and treat you like family.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peace Love and Tennis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Unfortunately, a very disappointing experience. Scheduled a January consult for blepharoplasty due to severe hindrance to my peripheral, upper field, and night vision--I specifically noted medical insurance coverage upfront. Dr. Hill's 5-10-minute consultation felt rushed and condescending, with no clinical evaluation.

At no time did the office request photos from my younger years to ensure a natural-looking outcome and did not utilize AI technology--which is pretty commonplace now--to share what I might look like post-surgery.

Fast-forward: 8 weeks later, office staff advised their surgery facility is out-of-network--only after the pre-auth denial. Due diligence upfront would have avoided wasting my time and their resources if their chosen facility is out of network. My insurance patient advocate confirmed the request was missing clinical measurements, which standard practice dictates MRD measurements and SVF with both open and taped eyelids, but the practice requested only SVF open from the optometrist and never took MRD.

Unprofessional delays and transactional service--more focused on their injection/cash-pay business than using medical expertise to help with health. Looking for turn-key profits over patient care. Wasted my time. Would not recommend.

address: 6898 Lebanon Rd STE 102, Frisco, TX 75034, United States

user_reviews.Name: Summer Bridges
user_reviews.Description: I have had the best experience with Dr. Smart and his staff. Everyone has been very nice, professional and willing to answer any and all questions that I may have. I had a mommy makeover and I absolutely love my results!! Dr Smart is an amazing doctor!

user_reviews.Name: Frances Ware
user_reviews.Description: I would recommend Dr Smart and his team to anyone! They were professional and kind. They didn’t hesitate to bring me in after surgery when I had a question or concern with my healing. They had me come in to make sure all was healing properly. Brook is absolutely incredible and makes you so comfortable. Jennifer at the front is incredibly warm and welcoming. The nurses were fantastic. Dr Smart is honest and let me know exactly what he could and couldn’t do based on my skin and body condition prior to surgery. He did an amazing job! Would 100% recommend this office!!!

user_reviews.Name: Xuan Nguyen
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve always wanted a tummy tuck but was scared of the recovery. I’m so glad I went with Dr. Ken Smart! The recovery wasn’t bad at all, just follow his instructions. I’m so happy with my results, especially my belly button, it looks so natural. Dr. Smart is amazing, and his staff are all so sweet and caring. I’d give him 5+ stars and recommend him to anyone who’s been thinking about getting a tummy tuck.

Would I go to him for any other work? Absolutely. Dr. Smart has an artist’s eye and knows exactly what will make you look and feel your best without you even having to explain much. He truly knows what he’s doing.

user_reviews.Name: Fashion 4 Elle
user_reviews.Description:
Can’t say enough about my experience with Dr. Ken Smart. From the very first consultation, I felt completely comfortable, informed, and knew he was the one. I had a tummy tuck with muscle repair and liposuction, and the results have truly been life-changing.

The staff was professional, kind, and attentive every step of the way. They made sure I understood the process, recovery expectations, and answered every single question with patience. This was important to me. Surgery day was smooth and stress-free!

The results speak for themselves. My stomach is flatter and more toned than I could have ever imagined, and the muscle repair played a huge role in that. The liposuction was the perfect finishing touch, giving me natural curves and balance to my figure.

I am beyond grateful for the skill, care, and artistry of Dr. Ken Smart. This has been one of the best decisions I’ve ever made, and I have recommended him to everyone considering this type of procedure. Truly five stars all around!

user_reviews.Name: Andrea
user_reviews.Description:
I had a breast lift in June with Dr. Smart and it was one of the best decisions I have ever made! I met with several surgeons but Dr. Smart was kind, honest and very detailed. He did not try to sway me into getting implants. I was apprehensive about what my results would look like because, quite honestly, I haven’t seen any good before and afters.
When I went in for my pre-surgery visit, I was nervous and starting to consider getting implants because I was afraid I wouldn’t get the results I wanted. His assistant took the time to talk to me about it and assured me Dr. Smart would be able to give me the results I wanted. She was right, I LOVE the way they look! Dr. Smart did an amazing job! My scars are minimal, hardly noticeable and they are perky! If you are considering breast surgery, make time to meet him, it might be the best decision YOU make too!

user_reviews.Name: Shanber Laymance
user_reviews.Description:
I tried to keep it short…Absolutely incredible experience with the entire team from scheduling to post-op, the care, professionalism, and prompt communication were outstanding! Everything was seamless and all were genuinely kind.

I came on the referral of a trusted family member and couldn't be more grateful for the referral. Every person I interacted with took pride in what they do. I felt like I left as a friend, not just a patient.

The card from the team was unexpected and appreciated. I highly recommend Dr. Ken Smart, Dr. Lovoi (anesthesiologist), Rachel, Brook, and everyone else who played a part in my time there - THANK YOU!!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently underwent a deep plane face & neck lift and lower bleph with Dr. Smart, and the entire experience exceeded every expectation. After having a Mommy Makeover six months ago, I felt incredible about my body, but my face no longer reflected the way I felt on the inside. This procedure was the perfect finishing touch — now everything feels beautifully aligned, natural, and authentically me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Lunghi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot express enough how amazing Dr. Smart and his team are. I lost over 100lbs and needed my loose skin removed. user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Smart did my Lower Body Lift and what I call “re-installing the girls” after I lost 115 lbs. I feel SO MUCH better, and am so much more physically comfortable. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sadie Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr smart and everyone who works at his office are so kind and make you feel so welcome! user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Dudek

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After consult after consult and a TON of careful consideration I decided to go with Dr. Smart and his team for my mommy makeover. To start with, his team is fantastic! They practically held my hand through out my entire process. If I had a question pre - post op I never had to wait for an answer they were ON IT. I would email them and get a response within minutes. To the point he said it made him feel so much better knowing I was in good hands! Secondly, Dr Smart he was hands down amazing. His bedside manner was spot on. I didn’t feel like “just another patient.” After seeing my results, I understand why he is known as the “Boob Whisper”. He listened to what I wanted and made sure my expectations were matching what my results would be. He flat out told me some of my “wants” were not possible. Other doctors were telling me “Oh yea, I can do that” and my husband would even say that doesn’t seem realistic. Bottom line.... Dr Smart was honest he wasn’t just trying to “sell” me a job! He isn’t just another doctor trying to be social media famous. His patients come first and he post when he can but he isn’t in the operating room just making videos. In my case, he was working his magic!!!

I would recommend Dr Smart and his team to anyone I know for any procedure small or big. ( I am getting my fillers done there now too.) As a business owner myself, I know the importance of good customer service and Dr. Smart has an amazing and talented team behind him. I am so thankful I chose Frisco Plastic Surgery!!!

Thank you to the entire team at Frisco Plastic Surgery. You have changed my life and I am sooo happy! I can’t thank y’all enough!

If I could give 6+ stars I would. Dr. Smart and his entire staff are amazing to say the least. As of today, I am 4 weeks post op and feel amazing (which is really an understatement). I knew when I finally did this I would say to myself “Why didn’t you do this sooner?” And, I said exactly that.

If you are looking to make a small or big change this new year…
If you want a doctor and staff that are caring, kind and genuinely want the best results for you…
If you are hesitating like I was…DON’T…

Dr. Ken Smart and his entire Staff are the practice for you!!!

I explained to him what I went through and what I was wanting. He assured me that I was not a lost cause, and that my condition could be corrected. In the same breath, he reminded me that how I would look afterward and my ideal version of perfection may not be the same. I had done my research this time so I was confident he was the surgeon for me. I was also so impressed with his staff they were so amazing! I decided to cancel the second doctors consultation and go with Dr. Ken. From my first appointment to my last they made me feel so comfortable! I left my last appointment, crying tears of JOY because I now feel so comfortable in my own skin. Something, I thought would never be possible.

I would highly recommend Dr. Smart and his very capable staff for any of your plastic surgery needs.

They answered all my questions and took such good care of me. If and when I decide to get another procedure I know where I will be going. Doc, thank you and your wonderful staff!!

I would have never agreed to 1500.00 for the treatments if that had been told originally. The nurse also said I might think of consulting with doctor about face lift if cost of continued treatments was a problem. I am 59 & definitely DO NOT need a face lift. I felt so bad about myself & conflicted & stuck about spending more money.
I did the second treatment & while it looks better (definitely not 1500.00 worth) it’s still not great. It left my face in pain and bruised which had never happened before. The nurse was a nice person but I definitely did not get the caliber treatments that Dr. Smart gave nor do I feel it was worth the money I spent. I’m sure my small business will not be missed, but  I will not be going back. Hope this helps next person ask the right questions & avoid the same disappointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Ingram
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient of Dr. Smart for over 10 years, and there is truly no one else I would trust with my care.

From the very beginning, he has consistently demonstrated a level of patience that is rare to find. He never rushes appointments, takes the time to thoroughly listen, and genuinely cares about understanding your goals—not just medically, but personally. You never feel like just another patient.

What sets Dr. Smart apart even further is his attention to detail and commitment to excellence. He is an absolute perfectionist in the best possible way. Every decision, every recommendation, and every step of the process reflects a deep level of thought, precision, and artistry. It’s clear that he holds himself to an incredibly high standard—and it shows in his results.

Equally important is his integrity. In an industry where that can sometimes be overlooked, Dr. Smart stands in a class of his own. He is honest, ethical, and always prioritizes what is truly best for you, even if that means advising against something. That level of trust is invaluable.

After more than a decade as his patient, I can confidently say that his consistency, skill, and character are unmatched. If you’re looking for a surgeon who combines technical expertise with genuine care and unwavering integrity, Dr. Smart is it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Hydro
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m very happy with the results of my surgery and would still give this practice five stars for the outcome. That said, my overall experience during recovery was more mixed.
There were several times I felt my concerns weren’t fully heard. Early on, I mentioned that my compression garment was cutting into my inguinal area and causing significant discomfort, but no alternative options were offered. Later, it was acknowledged that it could be affecting my lymph node area and I was told at five weeks I could take it off. It made me wonder if earlier adjustments could have helped minimize my swelling ( mentioned later)
I also had ongoing concerns about one of my drains, which was causing sharp pain and had very low output early on. Despite bringing this up multiple times, it remained in place and I eventually developed a minor infection. It left me questioning whether earlier intervention might have helped.
Lastly, while I understand swelling is part of the process, I experienced significant ( I estimate 14 pounds since that’s what was removed and my weight remains the same nine weeks later)fluid retention, particularly in my upper thighs and felt this was  dismissed telling me I looked the same as my before pictures and then passed off by telling me to go to my primary care doctor  ( who couldn’t see me until June when this was March)when I tried to express how uncomfortable it was.
Overall, I’m grateful for my surgical results, but I hope future patients feel more heard and supported.

I should say I was an out of state patient and flew to Texas for two weeks for this surgery.
I had hoped to go back for further surgeries since my outcome aesthetically was very good and my pain from actual surgery minimal.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Choosing to have a tummy tuck with muscle repair was a deeply personal decision for me. After two C-sections and years of significant weight changes, I was left with extra skin that no amount of discipline or effort could change. Moving forward with surgery felt like finally honoring the work I had already put into my body, and restoring a sense of alignment that I couldn’t achieve on my own.

From the beginning, I felt confident in choosing Dr. Smart. I had heard consistently great things—not only from patients, but from other physicians who hold him in high regard. That gave me real peace of mind, and now at 6 weeks post-op, I can say without hesitation that I made the right choice.

My recovery has gone smoothly, and even at this stage, my results are already incredible. I still have healing ahead, but I’m starting to feel that sense of alignment I had been hoping for.

His entire team has been amazing. Brooke, in particular, has been so supportive—always patient, responsive, and thoughtful, even with my long lists of questions.

I’m truly grateful for the care and expertise I received. I highly recommend Dr. Smart and his team to anyone considering this journey.
