user_reviews.Description:
Just over two weeks ago (1-9-26) I had a revision performed that has meant so much to me and has uplifted my self-confidence tremendously. I am still recovering but can say with absolute clarity that I am so happy! I previously had a mommy makeover in October 2024 and later a standard brachioplasty in July 2025, both of which were beautifully done. The brachioplasty itself was flawless—it simply needed to be extended for better balance. When my original surgeon had an opportunity come up to take his craft out of state shortly after my procedure was done I was genuinely happy for him and wished him nothing but success. And still do!! At the same time, I felt understandably nervous about transitioning my follow-up care to this freshly done brachioplasty and after having built such deep trust over time.
That uncertainty quickly faded when Dr. Bond took over my follow-up care at North Texas Plastic Surgery in the late summer. From our very first appointment, I felt completely at ease, comfortable, and truly understood. Dr. Bond listened carefully, respected the work that had already been done, and approached my case with compassion, honesty, and thoughtfulness.
By November, we had a clear plan moving forward, and the revision to extend my brachioplasty was scheduled to be performed in January after the hustle and bustle of the holidays.
The results of this revision have been incredibly meaningful to me—not just physically, but emotionally. Everything now looks balanced and so natural, and my confidence has been uplifted in ways I didn't expect. Throughout this entire journey, the care I received from Dr. Bond in a short time has been top notch. And the entire surgical team, nurses and staff at North Texas Plastic Surgery was truly exceptional as always and continues to be as I am still recovering.
Everyone at NTPS goes above and beyond to make me feel supported, safe, and genuinely cared for through every step.
I am deeply grateful for the trust, continuity of care, and emotional healing this experience provided and continues to provide. I would wholeheartedly 100% recommend Dr. Bond and North Texas Plastic Surgery to anyone seeking not only outstanding surgical results, but a team that truly cares about their patients as human beings.
Will post photos when fully recovered at a later time 😊

user_reviews.Name: Christi Kendrick
user_reviews.Description: I had a hydrating facial and light peel done with Tammy, and my skin looks and feels so very nice. I’ve had IPL and other treatments done elsewhere, and NTPS services are on a whole nother level. This was a clinical strength facial. For real results with real professionals, I highly recommend Tammy and the NTPS team. #customerforlife

user_reviews.Name: Shannon Rubin
user_reviews.Description:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
It’s difficult to put into words what the North Texas Plastic Surgery Fellowship Program — and especially Dr. Kelly and Dr. Obaid have meant to me. This practice didn’t just change my body; it helped heal something much deeper. If I could give them a million stars I would!

After living with the physical effects of a 200-pound weight loss for 27 years, I carried not only excess skin but decades of self-consciousness and discomfort. Choosing surgery was not a small decision — having a procurement background I researched and interviewed multiple surgeons in DFW and Houston area.

I ultimately underwent two surgeries with Dr. Kelly.  My first was a 360 lower body lift, arm lift, and breast lift. The second was a thigh lift, implants, and a fix to my stomach (not his work). I can say without hesitation that placing my trust in him was one of the best decisions of my life. From the very first consultation, he approached me with kindness, patience, and respect. He listened carefully, educated thoroughly, and never made me feel rushed or pressured. His skill is extraordinary, but it’s his compassion and steady presence that truly set him apart. I felt human and not like someone being used to gain Instagram status - I literally had one practice shame me because I didn’t want to spend 78k on all the same procedures and while over 100k followers is impressive, I wasn’t going to be on Only Fans anytime soon so had no issue using a Fellowship program (trust me I shopped the others as well) 😂

Going through one surgery requires trust. Going through two requires complete confidence — and Dr. Kelly earned that every step of the way. Even during a more challenging recovery with my thighs (my first surgery was a literal breeze), I never doubted that I was in exceptional hands. The care, professionalism, and responsiveness of the entire team remained consistent and reassuring.

My only regret is that I because this surgery was slightly harder, I delayed feeling ready to schedule a third procedure. By the time I was prepared, Dr. Kelly was fully booked. That speaks volumes about the trust and demand surrounding his work. I was so confident in him that I specifically hoped he would address the loose skin on my face and neck — because after two surgeries, there was no one else I would have wanted or trusted.

Dr. Obaid’s fellowship program is something truly special. It provides access to an incredible level of surgical expertise while preserving a culture of integrity, humility, and genuine patient care. The fellowship program is not merely a training pathway. It is a bridge — one that connects patients like me to opportunities that might otherwise remain forever out of reach. This program changes lives, and I am profoundly grateful to have benefited from it.

The results of my surgeries have impacted far more than my appearance. They’ve changed my physical comfort, my confidence, and the way I feel in my own skin after nearly three decades of waiting. This wasn’t cosmetic. This was life-altering, and I am endlessly grateful.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’d have to say that Dr. Obaid and his staff are the most amazing people. They go above and beyond they answer any and all questions no matter how silly you’re stupid you may think they are to you. They never make you feel bad. They actually listen to you and try to help you the best way they can. They give you lots of information and go over it with you very thoroughly. They give you all your options and help you in every way possible even after the surgery they were amazing. I ended up having to go to the hospital for an allergic reaction at about 2 AM in the morning and my husband use the app that the doctor has to talk to them and they responded within 30 minutes. They checked on me just about every day while I was recovering from the allergic reaction and worked with me and my doctors here in my hometown to make sure I got everything that I needed. Thanks to Doctor Obaid i’ve got my confidence back and I absolutely love my body and my results.

I had two friends that had him as a doctor for their BA and both said wonderful things about him. I knew he would be the one I would go to once I was ready. He listened to the size and worked with me in achieving the look I wanted. I am still 9 days post op and I feel great.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
First off, I would like to say that I am a huge supporter of women supporting women. I believe it’s important to do what makes you feel good about yourself.  After a lot of thought and consideration, I decided to have a mommy makeover in 2020. It was the best decision I had ever made. After having four children and being at the age of 57  I just couldn’t  fight the midsection  any longer. It was time to do something about it. I had  consultations with two other surgeons before consulting with Dr. Obaid. Interestingly enough, I met him the morning of my surgery with my husband beside me for the first time face to face. We both felt very at ease and confident that I would be in great care.
Dr. Obaid’s  staff put me at such ease before the surgery that I felt comfortable to go with him. They were very knowledgeable and helpful and very  supportive. I just have to say that everybody that took care of me from beginning to end was kind, considerate and very understanding of any question I  had for them. And trust me I had a lot of questions because I had never done anything like this before. I am now 62 and feeling more confident with myself than I have in many years. Thank you Dr. Obaid and your amazing team for all of your talent and support.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
After diligent research and a thorough consultation, I knew I wanted Dr. Anderson to perform my procedures. As a 35-year-old woman who lost 125 lbs, I dealt with significant loose skin. I ultimately opted for a 360 tummy tuck along with a breast lift and augmentation.

During my consultation, Dr. Anderson addressed all of my concerns. He kindly explained which of my expectations were achievable and which were not, proving himself to be honest, non-judgmental, and highly skilled.

I was also incredibly impressed with the communication at NTPS. I live about three hours away from the closest clinic, but the staff and Dr. Anderson were remarkably responsive via the digital portal. Recovery was no "walk in the park," and I even faced some complications (unrelated to Dr. Anderson’s work), which made that communication invaluable. I could send a photo or video, and a nurse or Dr. Anderson would respond within 24 hours—usually within four. This brought me tremendous comfort during an extensive recovery.

The surgical staff is knowledgeable and calming, and the office team is supportive and friendly. I am incredibly pleased with my results and highly recommend Dr. Anderson and NTPS to anyone considering cosmetic surgery.

Lastly, and oddly enough the question I get most "Does your bellybutton look normal" and yes it's better than "normal" it's beautiful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yra O’Dell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I left a 5 star review last year before my breast augmentation surgery but I took it down because I am so unhappy with how I’ve been treated 1 year post op. Just because someone has a great following on social media, doesn’t mean their work is quality. The only great experience I had was with the patient coordinator, Polly. She was so kind and helpful. Dr. Najera did my breast augmentation last year - May 31, 2024. I had my 1 year post on May 22, 2025 - just shy of one year. Dr. Najera diagnosed me with capsular contracture on both breasts and was quick to tell me that I had to go under the knife as soon as possible or else it’ll get worse. A little back story - during my initial consultation I kindly requested and wanted to do the inframammary fold incision (underneath the breasts). I wanted this because it was common practice and also from doing research, it was the best incision site. Dr. Najera was very persistent and borderline pushy about going through my nipples because “I’m Asian” and that it’s ideal for women of this ethnicity to go through that incision site. My thought process was, I probably shouldn’t question him since he’s the expert. Even though I was severely uncomfortable with his decision, I went ahead and trusted him and the process. 6 month post op - he said I just needed to massage. My breasts we’re already very hard and he never even warned me about capsular. 1 year post op he says I need to do surgery immediately and that will be another $6,000 to fix the issue then immediately left the room. Chandler Little, the patient coordinator assigned to me this time, is absolutely horrendous and non responsive. I said I wanted to schedule surgery when I got home from an emergency family trip to Arizona. I got home, reached out and Chandler gave me the silent treatment. In one of my emails to Chandler I requested a message to be relayed to Dr. Najera that the second time around, I want to do the inframammary incision. Chandler never responded nor did I get a call back from their office. I did my due diligence and took the initiative to get a second opinion from another reputable and board certified plastic surgeon. I went to that appointment and he educated me on how the periareolar incision is not ideal because the milk ducts are not sterile and has a significant higher bacterial concentration which is linked to capsular contracture. Dr. Najera never talked about these risks. He just talked about how it’ll “look better” but to be honest, I’d much rather have a small visible scar underneath my breast than have the risk of infection and capsular contracture. I will be doing my revision surgery and capsulectomy with the surgeon that gave me the second opinion to fix what should’ve been done right the first time. I felt so unheard by Dr. Najera and his staff. It’s so unfortunate that I felt I didn’t have a say on what to do with my body. People come here to trust you with their body and their life essentially and to be treated this way and to be given the silent treatment is unacceptable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Langston Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Upon doing research and having my initial consultation with Dr Dallas I was sure I had chose the right place for my gluteal implant procedure. Unfortunately now I know better. I had looked at clinics in different countries that where cheaper and had stellar reviews but I decided it was worth spending the extra money to feel safe and more at ease. My overall experience made me feel very unsafe in the care of this clinic. I was given a 24/7 care # and there were times my questions went unanswered for hrs or until their business day started at 9am. I was made to feel like just another #. After establishing a connection via text I was questioned several days later, who was I, Yet once a turn for the worst happen and I reached out I was quickly referred to by my first name.
All of my concerns were met with “the drs not concerned, just keep taking your antibiotic/keep area clean”. Unfortunately for me the first time the Dr took concern he was  forced to rip out of me the very thing he placed in me 15days prior now full of infection. I was told that unfortunately infections do happen but I believe it could have been treated earlier if someone had just listened when I said I had a fever, when I said I had blood in my urine, when my drainage changed color, consistency, smell and volume. When I said my drains started leaking at the incision area to the point I was cleaning myself up a few times a day because it seemed I had more leakage on the outside of my body than I did inside the drain. I believe that had standard care been  practiced 4 days prior when I went in complaining of fever and drainage change (I.e tested a sample of discharged, took blood or urine sample to identify type of infection) there would have been a different outcome because I would have been treated more effectively. The day I went in drenched in yellow infectious discharge that drained from my body uncontrollably and shaking with fever I was asked for a urine sample as “standard procedure” before operation to see if I had smoked cigarettes. The wonder of what could have been avoided had these standard procedures been applied days prior. This office has many 5star reviews… which made me choose them. Unfortunately I didn’t receive 5star care. If you choose this company I pray you have a better outcome.

I was seriously doubtful about anyone being able to correct this fiasco.

My 1st visit with Dr. Najera was such a wonderful experience.  He could tell that I was at the end of my endurance and he put me at ease and said with confidence "When things get this bad, they send them to me.  My job is to make sure that this is corrected and that you won't have to deal with this again."

His staff are just as compassionate as he is!  They were very professional, yet sensitive to my needs.  You won't find a group of people better than them!!

Throughout the entire time with the surgery and recuperation (April 2012), he was such a sweet and compassionate doctor and he made my abdomen look as if nothing had ever been wrong to begin with!!  I now have a flat stomach and can wear my clothes that I haven't been able to for over a year.  I can walk again, eat again, and enjoy life that had been elusive for so long.  Many people have come up to me since my return to work in May so totally shocked at the difference and I have been told I look great!!

I would recomend Dr. Najera to anyone and know with confidence that they are in good hands with their health and body.

Thank you, Dr. Najera, for being such a compassionate doctor and an expert in your medical  field that you could take everything that was out of place in my abdomen and still make me look this good!

Barbara Brian

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mrs. C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My surgery was 05/17/2017 and my revision surgery will be next week. My new surgeon and family doctor have prescribed pain management aids, muscle relaxers and holistic remedies to get me through until my current implants are removed. Apparently my surgery with Najera went over by half an hour and I indirectly received a petty $300 bill from the hospital because they were instructed to “bill the patient” which is nothing short of a SLAP in the face!!!

Let’s talk about why this is SO utterly disgusting and disturbing. This is my second set of implants. In 2009 I had my first surgery in Newport Beach, CA. I gave birth to two children (2010/2013) so it was time to have them replaced. The implants Dr. Najera used are the same brand as my original ones and only 110cc larger; unfortunately for me they encapsulated shortly after surgery during the recovery period. Thus far the speculation is that my right breast is an excruciating grade 4 and the left is a 3.

Regarding this $300 operation overage. I had three follow up visits with Najera and his Nurse no one EVER said...
A. Surgery went over the allotted time
B. What caused it to take additional time
C. DUE to that, I would owe the hospital facility more money.
If I decided to get the revision done it would be another $4,500 on top of the money I handed over six months ago! And I have to eat the $300 that I still have zero explanation or understanding of how or why the surgery went over to begin?

Clearly the social media persona, hype and status is a higher priority than patient care and retention! From the beginning I was annoyed with the constant phone, email and communication issues they defaulted too. They called me to reschedule my initial consultation. Then my pre-op due to relocating the practice to the new location. On June 16th a clear example of priorities was demonstrated. As I’m waiting in the exam room, I could hear Najera and his staff screaming and hollering for someone’s 30th Birthday. After several dry runs or rehearsals; I finally had enough sense to press record at 9:27am so I could share the nonsense with my husband. I’m all for the workplace camaraderie - it’s very cute and thoughtful of them to make others feel special, however he’s half an hour behind schedule having a mini-party right outside the exam rooms, it just unacceptable! There’s a time and place for all that... it’s called a lunch break or after business hours. What would have happened if I strolled in 30 minutes late? Without a doubt I’d be turned away or charged a no-show fee. Let’s not forget THEY are charging me the $300 for him taking longer than anticipated during surgery.
just beware. . .
That is THE REAL DR. DALLAS!!!

My final follow up visit at his office was also my Birthday. I was told in short “the hardness will not subside with time, the only way to fix the issue is to remove the implants and scar tissue.” Najera did mention using cadaver tissue (or skin) which ‘may help to reduce’ the capsular contracture from happening again but no in-depth conversation aside from that.
As I digested that information, I thought to myself  {I already have something foreign in my body that’s being rejected or causing a reaction} as routine as it may be to a medical professional, I’m worried about things like genetics, DNA, the short and long term risk of life with breast implants if I’m having an issue so early on. Needless to say I didn’t feel comfortable going forward despite the implant warranty and discounted surgeons fee.

It took three emails and two weeks to receive my quote for the revision and Amber started the conversation with “I apologize you didn’t receive my previous email”. To this day, I have not received ONE follow up call or email to see if I had any questions, how I’m feeling, what I’m thinking about doing or when. I guess if I’m flagged in their computer I may get lucky to  receive a six month follow up call this Friday 11/17/2017!

user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Solomon and his staff are very professional and friendly!  I was impressed as soon as I walked in the door.

user_reviews.Description: Dr Solomon and his team are the best!! His staff is so caring and supportive and answered all of my questions and concerns before and after the surgery. Highly recommend this office and will definitely be back when considering another procedure.

I highly recommend his office to anyone interested in plastic surgery..

When I left the consult with Dr. Solomon, I felt peace (no nagging gut feeling) and knew that I wanted him to do my surgery! Thank you for the result I desired.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Redding
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I walked into Dr. Solomon’s office, I felt welcomed and at ease. Melanie, the front desk staff , greeted me with warmth and kindness, setting the tone for a truly exceptional experience. I was then brought to a room by a medical assistant, Diana, who was not only kind but also incredibly knowledgeable, making me feel comfortable every step of the way.

When I met Dr. Solomon, I was immediately impressed by his patience and thoroughness. He took his time explaining the facelift procedure in great detail, ensuring I understood every aspect. He answered all of my questions with such kindness and expertise, never making me feel rushed. His calm and caring demeanor reassured me that I was in the best hands.

His surgical consultant , Ella, was also a pleasure to speak with, and then I had the opportunity to meet Dina, the PCC and office manager. She walked me through the surgical plan with such care and professionalism, making the entire process feel seamless.

I left my consultation feeling completely at home, confident, and excited for what’s to come. Dr. Solomon and his team truly go above and beyond for their patients, and I can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Merritt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Having had breast cancer and a mastectomy with reconstruction over 20 years ago, I was recommended to Dr. Solomon to have some corrective surgery done.  I must say that contacting Dr. Solomon was one of the best decisions I ever made! The degree of professionalism and expertise, as well as the fact that he is very personable, informative and patient, makes Dr. Solomon and my multiple visits to his offices some of the best medical experiences I've ever had!  No only was Dr. Solomon the best doctor I'd ever worked with, but his entire staff was wonderful, responsive, professional and personable as well! The atmosphere in the offices was always positive and welcoming! I had one surgery with Dr. Solomon and the procedure was so well explained, I knew exactly what to expect from beginning to end, as well as recovery and post-recovery!
The confidence level I had and continue to have in Dr. Solomon has made me trust in his medical decisions completely!  I would recommend anyone with a need for plastic or reconstructive surgery to The care and expertise of Dr. Solomon!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a couple of friends I know who went to a different surgeon in Houston (more social media forward) with great results. luckily I had a friend go to Dr. Solomon who had amazing natural results, you couldn’t tell she had a mommy makeover at all!! I can say that I am SO happy I went with dr Solomon, he took time listening to every concern, explained every detail, and was thoughtful in his approach to my body. My results are exactly what I wanted and the price was not some insane number like my friends. My belly button was a huge concern and it’s perfect! I’m 4 weeks post op and I can’t believe this is my body, my waist is snatched my chest looks 22 and natural to my
Body. If you were hesitating like me, this is your sign to book. I wasn’t going to go through with it and I’m so glad I did, I’m excited for summer for the first time since I had three kids!

From the moment I met Dr. Solomon and staff I knew I was at the right place!  He explained everything relative to my procedure, set realistic expectations and was a very easy process!  I am currently 4 weeks post op and the results are amazing with still some swelling!  Day of the surgery his staff was amazing and took all my anxiety away and made me so comfortable!  Pain was at a minimum especially if you follow all their pre and post op instructions!  Follow up visits were just as meaningful!  Make Dr Solomon your first and last stop!

He’s a perfectionist and perfection is what I received!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not have asked for a better experience. It only got better when I was walked back to the room and met with Dina and Dr. Solomon. Dr. Solomon was patient, informative, and really wanted to make sure I knew the ins and outs of my procedure (bread augmentation). Dina was so easy to work with scheduling wise and it was almost like I was being helped by family. I was so nervous day of surgery, but I met Hailey, the OR nurse who put me at ease. I cannot believe how perfect my results are- Dr. Solomon saw my vision and NAILED it. Even my husband can’t believe how good they look when I look at the “inspo” pics I had shown prior to surgery. This is the best place for plastic surgery in North Texas and beyond. I cannot recommend this practice enough. Thank you Dr. Solomon and team for helping me be the best version of myself!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Guy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
*Late post Review*

In early 2024, I had the male Lipo 360, chin Lipo and buccal fat removal with Dr. Cox.
Right after the surgery, I was very disoriented and had someone picked me up. I ordered the protein-hulk from smoothie king and drank it on my car ride home. I was very nauseous and threw up a little before drinking water and going to sleep.
Afterwards, the recovery process was difficult but you will need to follow his instructions and do the massage appointments with Juanita. DO NOT SKIP OR MISS any lymphatic massage appointments with Juanita! She is crucial to your recovery!
I say the first month was the most difficult because I needed to get rid of the excess fluids and had to change my diet. I swapped compression garments twice, the first was right after the surgery (XXL or XL), to L, and then M. Taking the medications as instructed is very crucial. Since I worked from home, it wasn't too bad for me. I was always next to the bathroom.
Before the procedures, I bought washable puppy pads, disposable puppy pads, gauze, skin tape, adult diaper, and stuff to clean the wound. I washed my hands frequently and used lysol spray before and after using the restroom. You will need to keep yourself clean as much as possible to prevent infection.
One of the other difficult phase was washing the garments. I had to mainly wash it during the weekends. I would used the previous garment as support while waiting but you need to at least wash them once a week. Please keep in mind my body was very sensitive and the garment compression felt like it was holding my body together.
Overall, the recovery from the buccal fat removal was the easiest, you just need good oral hygiene with non-alcohol mouthwash. I brush and use mouthwash after each meal. The lipo 360 and the chin lipo had the most difficult recovery. My right side of my neck was more swollen but after the 3 month mark, things got better. I was still too sensitive to start working out and it wasn't until the 6 month mark when I felt I made significant recovery. The 8th-9th month mark felt closer to being normal.
Post 1 year, I feel great! Some of the surgical scars from the lipo 360 is still fading.

Dr. Cox and his team were awesome! They are great with communications and really care for you and your recovery.
I definitely recommend him but you'll need to be a fighter because the recovery journey isn't easy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deedra Seekatz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After almost 4 consecutive years of breastfeeding two kids, my boobs needed to be brought back to my chin. My body needed to feel like mine again. I already had implants before I started having kids, and wasn’t even entirely satisfied with that surgeons work. I knew I wasn’t going back post kids. I went through three different consultations in Las Vegas and California and never felt satisfied with what I was hearing from any of the doctors. I have the mentality ‘go big or go home’. I knew I wanted bigger than suggest implants and wanted them brought back up to my chin. I know gravity will do it’s rude work overtime. Other surgeons kept suggesting smaller tear drop implants. No thanks! Dr. Cox not only listened, but he educated me. He told me more about the procedure and the difference in all the styles of implants and down to what kind of stitching he would do. I was worried about scars. But I looked at his work over and over and felt more and more comfortable with choosing him. I am only 3 weeks post op and I can say my areola scar shouldn’t even be called a scar. It is looking so good. I am loving my 750 SCX implants. The fullness, the size, and that they’re back up and ready to say hey to the world. Topless boat rides and resorts and pools, in a couple summers will be done with more confidence. I already know my scars will be gone in a couple summers. I super promise not to let the sun see the scars until after a year.
He is a perfectionist and takes so much pride in his work. And rightfully so! He does amazing! I accidentally got a bruise on my left side which caused bruising and in turn swelling and a popped stitch. Y’all it’s hard to do nothing with two little little and three dogs. Rather than telling me to go to my local ER he wanted to see up close and personal what was going on. I flew back from Washington state to Dallas. He was willing to come in on his day off to see what I had done to myself. He fixed me right up and gave me confidence all was going to be alright. He is worth the travel, worth your time, and money.
I am already considering more work to be done by him.
He and his staff are so kind and easy to talk to (and they’re all really good looking). They respond at all hours, sometimes even after hours.
His nurse Leannza is seriously the sweetest soul and coolest person to be around. She took my Botox virginity and I am beyond satisfied. I am not frozen and can still be my overly expressive self, but without wrinkles! I already told my husband I am going back specifically for her. We can just double the trip to see a Cowboys game.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely WONDERFUL experience with my breast augmentation surgery. I traveled 5 hours after a friend recommended Dr. Cox to me, and he exceeded my expectations! From my first consultation through recovery, he and his team handled everything with professionalism, care, and attention to detail.
HIGHLY recommend this practice to anyone considering a similar procedure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nelly Vazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an exceptional experience with Dr. Cox for my XL breast augmentation surgery, and I cannot recommend him highly enough.

From the very first consultation, Dr. Cox stood out for his professionalism, attentiveness, and ability to clearly address every single one of my questions. He took the time to understand my goals and made me feel completely comfortable and confident in my decision. His expertise and honesty were evident from the beginning, which made a huge difference in my overall experience.

Throughout the entire process, before and after surgery, Dr. Cox remained consistently attentive and accessible. His communication through the app was outstanding; he was always responsive, reassuring, and present whenever I had a concern or needed guidance. That level of care made me feel truly supported every step of the way.

On the day of the surgery, everything was seamless. Dr. Cox was extremely punctual and well-organized, which immediately gave me peace of mind. His calm and confident demeanor helped ease any nerves I had, and I felt I was in the best possible hands. He created an environment of trust that is invaluable in a procedure like this.

The results have exceeded my expectations. His attention to detail, aesthetic sense, and surgical skill are truly remarkable. I am incredibly happy with my outcome, and it reflects the level of excellence and dedication he brings to his work.

If you are considering breast augmentation, especially an XL breast augmentation, Dr. Cox is absolutely the surgeon you want. His expertise, professionalism, and genuine care for his patients make him stand out in every way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Marvel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had Lipo 360, auxiliary lipo, back lipo, arm lipo, and chin lipo done by Dr. Cox, and I couldn’t be happier. He’s incredibly skilled with a true artistic eye, explaining everything thoroughly. He contoured my lower back & auxiliary area so well that it made my butt and bustline look naturally perkier!  The entire team at Cox Cosmetics, especially Dr Cox & Christina (his head nurse) were absolutely fantastic.

Post-Op, Dr Cox recommended that I get massages regularly, so I went to Valeria at BodyFour TX for my lymphatic and fascia massages and she did an amazing job as well. Dr. Cox, coupled with Valeria’s massages, was truly the dream team for outstanding results!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Owens
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a breast augmentation at Cox Cosmetic Surgery and couldn’t be happier with my experience. The team was professional, supportive, and made me feel comfortable every step of the way. My results look amazing! I definitely recommend Dr. Cox and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From start to finish the whole process with Dr.Cox & his team have been AMAZING!! I absolutely love my results & the confidence I’ve gained.

Christina his nurse has been so helpful & sweet, Stefanie from the front desk has been really nice & personable and Dr.Cox has put my anxieties at ease every time we’ve talked. He’s explained everything in detail and has really been hands on.

I would 10/10 recommend him and his team!!

title: Rana Facial Plastic Surgery
address: 5140 Legendary Dr Suite 110, Frisco, TX 75034, United States

user_reviews.Name: Karen Klane
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Rana and his entire team. I had a deep plane facelift and neck lift along with upper and lower blepharoplasty, and the results are beyond anything I hoped for. Dr. Rana was my sixth consultation, and after meeting with surgeons across the country, he was by far the best.

From the first appointment, I knew I was in the right hands. The entire staff is professional, kind, and incredibly supportive. My results look natural and refreshed, and I absolutely LOVE them. The entire experience and recovery journey have been wonderful because of this team.

If you’re considering facial surgery, I highly recommend Dr. Rana.

user_reviews.Name: AMY MILLER (Staff)
user_reviews.Description: I researched plastic surgeons for two years and scheduled multiple consultations. As soon as I met Dr. Rana, I knew he would be my surgeon! He and his office staff were so welcoming and down to earth. Dr. Rana was honest and immediately put me at ease. He solely works on faces and is double board certified, which gave me even more confidence in my decision. I had an R2 facelift, R2 extended neck lift, upper blepharoplasty, and CO₂ laser skin resurfacing- 55 years old. My results are so natural — I could not be more pleased!

user_reviews.Name: Janice Holson
user_reviews.Description: This experience has been life affirming!  It ranks in my life among the most empowering decisions I ever made. Last summer I began self care, and found that depression slipped away. The more I finally cared for myself, the better I could help others.  During this time, I decided to do the deep plane facelift/necklift with CO2 laser.  Photos are self explanatory.   If considering it...DO IT!  Dr. Rana and his staff are amazing.  You are not getting any younger..Just unveil the person within!

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Kahooilihala
user_reviews.Description: I can’t share enough great things about my experience with Dr Rana and the entire staff. From my first consultation to every follow up visit the staff is professional, thorough, and incredibly supportive. Dr Rana is truly skilled and detail oriented.  I Highly recommend Dr Rana and team for anyone considering any type of aesthetic treatment or procedure- you are in great hands!

user_reviews.Name: JB
user_reviews.Description: I can’t say enough excellent things about Dr. Rana and the entire team! From my first consultation appointment to my 3 months post surgery appointment they have all been there for me. They answer any calls or texts quickly. I’ve had other plastic surgeons with terrible bedside manner after surgery so Dr. Rana has been such a breath of fresh air! My results are better than I’d hoped for! I wished I’d done it sooner. You won’t regret choosing Dr. Rana!

user_reviews.Name: Kisha Pannell
user_reviews.Description: I had an excellent experience with Dr. Rana. From my first consultation, they were professional, attentive, and took the time to understand my goals. Everything was explained clearly, which made me feel comfortable and confident moving forward.

user_reviews.Description: The team here is so amazing! They’re so caring and knowledgeable. The office is gorgeous and they are truly dedicated to making their clients happy. They’re honest, never pushy, and so kind — whether you’re interested in injectables, natural treatments like lasers and micro-needling, or something more advanced, you’re in the best hands here! Dr. Rana runs this place right -  his vision is reflected in this warm environment.

He was very clear in my consultation with him on what he could and could not do. My results are even better than I expected! Erica Vega in my opinion is irreplaceable to his team. She helped me through every step from booking my surgery to being there in the consultation to being there consistently after my surgery. I cannot tell you how many times she helped me understand the process. And I can’t forget Devon , She  was the first impression I got of his office when I called, and it was a good one!!! If you are considering plastic surgery,  book the appointment! The only regret you’ll have is not doing it sooner.

Daina Jenkins

Overall, my experience was deserving of five stars, and I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Rana and his team to anyone seeking top-notch care and exceptional results.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Where to start?  Dr. Rana is a gem... a genuinely kind, approachable guy who also happens to be an excellent surgeon. They are also responsive to questions and concerns both before and after surgery- which is so appreciated.  I had 4 consultations and am so happy I went with Dr. Rana.  My results are very natural and while I'm still healing, I am so happy thus far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Shapiro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have gone for five consultations and Dr Rana was by far the kindest and most Understanding. He did not face shame me he went over all my issues with me. I have to say it was the first time I had ever had surgery, was treated so well by the anesthesiologist, the nurse and of course him . The follow up on my upper and lower eyes were just incredible. They pay attention to what you're saying they don't just brush it off. My eyes look amazing and they were so good that I had a friend come up from New York who had a complete facelift with him and she is over the moon. I wouldn't go any place else to have Cosmetic surgery nor would I go any place else to have Phil is done by Ashton. Love the place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Whaley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rana’s staff is amazing. They are very attentive and caring. Dr. Rana has a wonderful manner and is very personable. He cares for his patients and demonstrates attention to detail. I would recommend his office to anyone for a variety of services!

user_reviews_extended.Description: After searching for the right surgeon and literally, years of research, I chose Dr. Rana to do my procedures. I am absolutely thrilled with my results. Dr. Rana is an absolute magician! He and his entire staff are amazing and wonderful people to work with. In what could be a difficult journey, they have made it as easy and comfortable a process as possible and much more so than I had expected. I highly recommend Dr. Rana and his team of expert professionals for any of your facial plastic surgery needs. Forever grateful and entirely pleased with my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ella Santiago
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rana is truly a gem! I’ve met with multiple plastic surgeons over the years and not one has come close or been as impressionable as Dr. Rana. I met with him over a year ago before deciding to book my surgery. I needed time to think about what I really wanted and no one ever pushed me. When I finally decided that I wanted to go through with the surgery I picked Dr. Rana because I remembered how kind he was! You truly feel like you’re his only patient. I’m so happy with my results already and I’ve been telling everyone  to come see him! Him and his entire team deserve way more than 5 stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clancy Denton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy with the results of my deep neck lift, lower face lift and chin augmentation. Dr. Rana and his staff made me feel so comfortable at my consultation, procedure and all follow up appointments. Everyone who I’ve come into contact with at his office is so friendly and always excited to see the results. I would highly recommend Dr. Rana and have already recommended him to several people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathie W
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful  with Rana Plastic surgery. they performed and represented the procedure accurately. I had a wedding to attend two weeks after the surgery and I think I looked marvelous. They took excellent care of me, answered all my questions and I felt that my concerns were addressed and answered. It’s now three weeks out and it’s amazing how much better this procedure makes me feel about myself, I know people that have worried about this for years and never done anything about it . I am grateful Rana! I feel like a better version of myself, and I appreciate all their attention to making my experience so positive!

I felt Dr Rana listened, was kind, caring and most importantly an exceptional surgeon I could trust. He gave me the natural results I wanted and I couldn't be happier. His brand new facility is luxurious and you felt like a VIP when you walk in their door. I would 100% recommend him to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Rice
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rana and all his staff are incredible! I had the best facial plastic surgery journey I could have hoped for and more. Dr. Rana is meticulous, kind, and has a great sense of humor. I have been well taken care of within my post op appointments, any questions or concerns I have had are addressed immediately. I am so happy that I chose Dr. Rana to help me with my facial plastic surgery goals. He is truly one of the best and my friends who have gone elsewhere for their faces.....they always say, I have had the best outcome. Thank you Dr. Rana to you and all your amazing staff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
The most amazing experience from start to finish. Bed side manner of Dr Rana and staff is an A+. Results of my surgery are an A+. Everyone including my other doctors have noticed how refreshed and younger I look but had no clue I  had plastic surgery.
Dr. Rana is so caring, professional and skilled. Will definitely use this office for all my cosmetic procedures!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Coffey
user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of consultations, I finally decided to move forward with my procedure (deep neck, face, eyes, and lip lift). To say I was nervous is an understatement. But all I can say now is WOW! Dr. Rana is truly the best. His team is incredible and was available 24/7 to answer all my questions, both before and after the surgery. When they say "trust the process," they mean it. There was no pain—just rest, allowing my body to heal, and trusting the journey!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hillary Blumberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Big Thanks to Dr Rana and his fantastic staff for helping me look as young as I feel! Dr Rana is an artist, very skilled and has a great bedside manner. His staff is also very upbeat, welcoming and positive. The vibe of his office is definitely the best of any MD I have seen! No doubt that I will be his patient for years to come.

Dr . Rana and his staff are truly amazing. He really listens to what you want to accomplish a natural more refreshed outcome. He and his staff are professional , friendly and so helpful. In the world of cosmetics he is a rare and delightful find!

Exceptional Neck Lift Surgery – A Truly Transformative Experience

If you are reading this, you are probably researching a doctor for plastic surgery.

YOU ARE IN GOOD HANDS W/DR. RANA!

As I approach 50 yrs, sagging neck skin began to show, aging me 10 yrs...

After a couple hr surgery, I felt great!
I did not take pain pills (just the antibiotics) and had minimal bruising. In fact, I went to work the very next day (I work from home) and was pleasantly surprised how easy it was to keep up with {gentle} daily routines.

I was concerned about not being able to workout for a month post-op, but the month flew by--definitely not a showstopper!

The results exceeded expectations! My neck looks youthful, toned, and natural—no one can tell I've had surgery.

What impressed me most about Dr. Rana was how he took the time to understand my concerns. He did not upsell, instead, he suggested a way to have the least amount of surgery with fantastic results.  The care received during recovery was also outstanding--the team was in constant communication.

The surgery results have made a positive impact on my confidence and appearance. I went from saggy/sluggish to  youthful/glowy--I couldn't be happier with the outcome!

I am 6 weeks post-op and the 1 inch scar under my chin is cleverly placed and practically disappeared; it is flat and blends in with my skin tone.

Dr. Rana's creds, artistry, and attention to detail are superb!  He has a kind, approachable spirit and I wholeheartedly recommend him for a cosmetic procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessie Cole
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank God I went to Dr. Rana! I’m 36 and had a deep neck lift and buccal removal on July 26th and just had my one month follow up. I am already elated by the results even though full effects won’t be seen until October. In August 2021 I had under chin lipo suction and skin tightening done by a board-certified facial plastic surgeon located in Plano. The results were VERY disappointing and the procedure wasn’t cheap and I was as awake for the entire thing. There was zero difference after all that money and recovery. Two years later, I wanted to re-address the issue but  didn’t know where to go. I had a consultation with another board-certified facial plastic surgeon who recommended the same thing I had done last time and told me that I was too young for a neck lift. I told him that lipo suction / skin tightening didn’t work, but he was adamant that it would work this time cause he was doing it and he’s the best. I felt very frustrated and unheard;  I knew there had to be more options than lipo/skin tightening. My boyfriend found Dr. Rana on Instagram and I decided to go see him. Completely different experience than any other surgeon. He touched and felt my entire face carefully. Other surgeons had touched my face but Dr. Rana was feeling for the intricacies of my muscles and fat. After he was done he gave me a tour of my face and explained to me in detail why my previous procedure didn’t work. He then recommended a deep neck lift. I was surprised that even though I had surgery, the pain was minimum. I thought my cheeks would hurt really bad because of the buccal removal, but had zero pain in my cheeks/mouth. I had watched buccal recovery videos where people’s cheeks swelled up like balloons. Mine got puffy but no where near the swelling people online had.  I am one month post surgery and my results are already outstanding.  I feel like myself again and for any and all procedures in the future it’s only Dr. Rana for me. My recovery has been faster than a traditional neck lift.  I learned that Dr. Rana is double board certified for facial surgery, so he only does surgery from the neck up, which is one of the reasons he is so talented and the best. (Video on IG for full explanation by him). The other reason is that he and all of his staff are genuinely kind and very attentive. I felt cared for through my whole experience.  I referred him to one of my friends who is about to have work done with him and he loved Dr. Rana. Another friend of mine just booked a consultation for a chin implant. I had to write a public review so anyone frustrated by lack of results from other surgeons can find Dr. Rana and feel like themselves again. Thank you Dr. Rana for gifting me back my confidence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
1000% if you are looking for an over achieving, brilliant, empathic, and talented facial plastic surgeon, you need call  and book your consultation with Dr. Nik Rana today!  I feel incredibly lucky that I found him all on my own to do my face and neck lift. I don’t know anyone where I live so I had to go off my own research. Finally after over a year of looking, I got to where I could narrow it down to my top two for a consult. Neither one was local for me but obviously you should never just settle or limit yourself to a local surgeon.

My first consult was with a female surgeon in Louisiana. Obviously since she was my top two, she was highly accredited and qualified so I was extremely excited. Well after waiting 45 mins in a room by myself, she walked in and didn’t even properly greet me. I felt like I was at a walk in clinic at this point.  After a quick evaluation of my face using a small hand held mirror and brief time going over some before and afters on her computer, she put me in another empty room to wait for a printout of everything SHE WANTED and REQUIRED for me to do on top of a facelift and neck lift. Lastly, she didn’t have her own accredited surgical center so hospital fees were another additional cost to all her added “requirements”. I walked out feeling like I wasn’t taken seriously and that I was cheated out of a proper consultation that I paid for.

Finally I got to have my consult with  Dr. Rana ( he was more booked up, which is a good thing). From the minute I walked in, I was taken care of. First I went over medical stuff and pictures with Beth and then got to meet with Kristina, my contact and rock throughout this whole process. Her and I went over everything we discussed over the phone. Within minutes, Dr. Rana came in and introduced himself. He’s energy was so warm and positive and I felt at ease right away. He took soo much time with me and allowed me to go over all my concerns in front of a large wall mirror and answered all the questions I felt I couldn’t get out with the first surgeon. There was no “up selling” or hesitation with him. I was a perfect candidate for his signature face and neck lift that covered everything that I wanted done. To top it off, he has his own accredited surgery center!!!! I was so impressed and excited, I didn’t hesitate to book my surgical date and payment right then and there.

I am currently one month post face and neck lift and I am here to tell you, it’s the best decision I’ve ever made. My husband who went into this thinking I was “too young” and didn’t think it would make a difference is blown away. He honestly is just as excited as I am about my progress as my face heals and changes daily.

Dr. Rana and his staff deserve 10 stars in my book! Go and see him and you won’t regret it.

user_reviews.Name: Mayra Hernandez
user_reviews.Description:
I had my tummy tuck with muscle repair and liposuction and I truly couldn’t be happier with my experience so far.
From the very first consultation, Dr. Mauricio Giraldo made me feel completely comfortable and confident. He took his time explaining every detail of the procedure, answered all my questions, and made sure I understood what to expect before and after surgery. His professionalism and skill really put me at ease. Even just one week post-op, I can already see beautiful results.
A huge thank you to the incredible nurses, especially Mailin and Claudia. They have been absolutely amazing throughout this entire journey. They are kind, attentive, and always quick to respond to any concerns.
The clinic itself is clean, organized, and welcoming. You can tell they truly care about their patients and their results.
If you’re considering a tummy tuck or any cosmetic procedure, I highly recommend Dr. Giraldo and his team. I’m only one week into recovery, and I already feel more confident and grateful that I chose them.

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Giraldo and staff are the best! I couldn't be happier with the results of my procedure. From the first consultation, I felt completely at ease. The office is spotless. Every visit is smooth and professional, I never feel rushed. Dr Giraldo and staff are amazing-So friendly and genuinely caring. The nurses are so knowledgeable, and cheer you on every step of the way. I highly recommend Medilaser, you'll be in excellent hands!

user_reviews.Name: Martha Brensike
user_reviews.Description:
My experiences at Medilaser has always been top level of excellence and professionalism. Dr. Giraldo and Mariah are absolutely wonderful, friendly, and are so knowledgeable of their work of expertise. Dr. Giraldo has taken care of me and my husband’s varicose veins in the past, and we are absolutely pleased with the results.

Today I had my first of six treatments for IPL/BBL for sunspots on my back, and Mariah made me completely comfortable and talked me through everything. I am excited and looking forward to the end results. I know I’m in good hands with Mariah.

user_reviews.Name: Lila H
user_reviews.Description:
Choosing Dr Giraldo as my surgeon was one of the best decisions I’ve made. From my very first visit, I felt heard, respected, and completely comfortable. The doctor took the time to truly understand my goals and explained everything in a way that put me at ease. The care didn’t stop after the procedure—the follow-up and attention were just as thoughtful. I’m beyond happy with my results and grateful for such an amazing experience. I highly recommend this doctor to anyone looking for natural, beautiful results.
Gracias Dr. Giraldo por todas sus atenciones y cuidado.

Dr. Giraldo is always informing you on what he is doing and what you can expect on the procedure in terms of any minor temporary needle injection in some cases.

I would highly recommend Dr. Maurcio Giraldo MD to anyone requiring the services that he provides.  He and his staff is courteous and knowledgeable.

user_reviews.Name: James Mullen
user_reviews.Description:
I am giving a 4-star review for now, pending my final results, but overall my experience with Dr. Beck, Rosa, and the staff has been positive.

Dr. Beck performed my surgery when another doctor would not due to my medical condition, even though I had been medically cleared. The surgery went well, and I am currently still in recovery. Even now, I can say I am very happy I had the procedure. It has already changed my lifestyle, and I can now wear shirts comfortably that I avoided in the past.

My main concerns were related to aftercare. One of my drainage pumps was not maintaining suction and was not draining properly. I reported it multiple times and shared photos, but I was told not to worry. This caused me significant stress, and I believe a quick in-office visit to evaluate or replace the pump would have helped and provided peace of mind.

I was also only provided one pair of lipo foam pads, which became dirty quickly, so I purchased my own sterile gauze and wore clean cotton shirts to maintain proper hygiene. In addition, the medical glue used after surgery caused significant skin irritation and discomfort for me. I am not a medical professional, but it would be helpful for patients to be informed about this possibility.

I strongly recommend that the office create an official aftercare video specifically for their patients. There are many videos online, but they all provide different guidance. It would be much more reassuring to receive clear instructions directly from the doctor’s office covering topics such as drain care, glue irritation, showering, compression, massage guidance, and what to expect during recovery.

That said, Dr. Beck, Rosa, and the staff were professional, and the surgery itself was a success. I am grateful that Dr. Beck was willing to perform the procedure, and it has already made a meaningful difference for me. I look forward to seeing my final results and may update this review at that time. I would recommend Dr. Beck to others considering this surgery.

I am giving a 4-star review for now, pending my final results, but overall my experience with Dr. Beck, Rosa, and the staff has been positive.

Dr. Beck performed my surgery when another doctor would not due to my medical condition, even though I had been medically cleared. The surgery went well, and I am currently still in recovery. Even now, I can say I am very happy I had the procedure. It has already changed my lifestyle, and I can now wear shirts comfortably that I avoided in the past.

My main concerns were related to aftercare. One of my drainage pumps was not maintaining suction and was not draining properly. I reported it multiple times and shared photos, but I was told not to worry. This caused me significant stress, and I believe a quick in-office visit to evaluate or replace the pump would have helped and provided peace of mind.

I was also only provided one pair of lipo foam pads, which became dirty quickly, so I purchased my own sterile gauze and wore clean cotton shirts to maintain proper hygiene. In addition, the medical glue used after surgery caused significant skin irritation and discomfort for me. I am not a medical professional, but it would be helpful for patients to be informed about this possibility.

I strongly recommend that the office create an official aftercare video specifically for their patients. There are many videos online, but they all provide different guidance. It would be much more reassuring to receive clear instructions directly from the doctor’s office covering topics such as drain care, glue irritation, showering, compression, massage guidance, and what to expect during recovery.

That said, Dr. Beck, Rosa, and the staff were professional, and the surgery itself was a success. I am grateful that Dr. Beck was willing to perform the procedure, and it has already made a meaningful difference for me. I look forward to seeing my final results and may update this review at that time. I would recommend Dr. Beck to others considering this surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: June Forshay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a physician practicing in the western US. Dr. Beck is located over 1200 miles away. I found him after an exhaustive search for the right doctor for my project . . . a daddy makeover?! LOL!!

I had lifted weights, (HEAVILY), and did a lot of protein supplements for 6 years, (2000 - 2006), and couldn't get my chest anywhere near where I wanted it. I concluded that this challenge was genetic. Everywhere else seemed to develop fine. So, I decided to get pectoral implants.

I found the company I wanted to create the custom implants, Implantech. They take your CT scan of the chest and customize the implants to your anatomy . . . no two are ever the same. Looking fake wasn't an option for me. Now, the main thing was to find the right surgeon for the procedure.Through Google searches, I found and later spoke to plastic surgeons in Long Beach, CA, Beverly Hills, CA and Dr. Beck in Plano, TX. I took a pass on a surgeon in Manhattan . . . probably because of my assumption that the procedure would carry with it the Manhattan tax . . . (always 20% + over the rate anywhere else). That was probably unfair but I am wanting to be completely transparent here. Dr. Beck expressed the most confidence that he could accomplish all that I wanted all in one visit.

I also needed some liposuction but didn't want to waste the fat. I wanted it injected into my backside so that I could better fill out my jeans.

I am over 60 years old and felt some pressure to "go or get off the pot" with regard to this project. Could I actually approach any plastic surgeon as a 70-something and have him/her keep a straight face through a consultation?

Dr. Beck and his team were perfect. I had a virtual consultation where we talked about my goals. I am a large individual and didn't want my implants undersized. Realizing that I definitely didn't want to do this twice, I trusted his judgement while making it clear that I did want to go sort of large. I was comfortable that in his collaboration with the Implantech team, he would get them sufficiently large to be what I call "worth my while", without making me look artificial or worse, ridiculous.

I was sent images of my proposed implants superimposed on my CT scan showing how they would rest against my chest wall. They sought my approval before moving forward with fabrication. I appreciated them involving me in this way and with this level of detail.

I flew in on a red-eye, got to my hotel where I was able to rest for 4 hours and then went to the surgical center at 6:15 a.m. The procedure took 7 hours. I asked the nurse who started my IV if she would please take some of the blood from the IV placement to check my glucose . . . something that they normally do by pricking the finger. She accommodate this special request

Dr. Beck was meticulous, performing liposuction throughout the torso down to the pubic bone, (look it up), and including the back so that the ultimate result is seamless. I felt actually sculpted. The experience made me think of Michelangelo, (in full Michelangelo di Lodovico Buonarroti Simoni, (born March 6, 1475, Caprese, Republic of Florence [Italy]—died February 18, 1564, Rome, Papal States), Italian Renaissance sculptor, painter, architect, and poet who exerted an unparalleled influence on the development of Western art). This iconic sculptor and artist felt that his creations were already contained within the block of marble and that his job was to remove the excess stone revealing the character inside.

My recovery was impressively easy considering the length and extent of my procedure and the length of time under anesthesia. I couldn't be happier. I am back in size 34 pants for the first time in nearly 2 decades. More importantly, just one week later, being bruised up, in a sweater or shirt, I looked great! That isn't only my opinion but also the opinion of others. Never having been burdened with Hollywood good looks, I've always done my best to look good. Dr. Beck made me look great.

My transformation was remarkable. Thank you and Bravo to Dr. Beck and the whole team.

I’ve worked with Dr. Beck across multiple procedures over time—hair transplants, Botox, liposuction of the chest and abdomen, and most recently upper and lower eyelid surgery with fat transfer. What stands out most is his specialization in treating men. He understands both the aesthetic goals and the psychology behind them in a way that feels tailored, not generic.

Dr. Beck consistently prioritizes a natural look and exercises real restraint—he doesn’t push “overdone” results, which I’ve come to appreciate more with each procedure. He takes the time to walk through expectations, explains trade-offs honestly, and focuses on outcomes that are both realistic and proportionate.

Having gone through a range of procedures with him, I can say his approach is thoughtful, measured, and highly attuned to achieving results that look like you—just better. I would recommend him to anyone looking for a surgeon who understands male aesthetics and values precision over excess.

title: Texas Facial Aesthetics
address: 6371 Preston Rd #100, Frisco, TX 75034, United States

user_reviews.Name: Francesca Hashem
user_reviews.Description:
I can honestly not say enough great things about Dr. Richardson and the whole team at Texas facial aesthetics.  I had a facelift,  neck lift and endoscopic brow lift and I am so glad I chose Dr. Richardson. The experience was exceptional  from the very beginning.  When calling to schedule the consultation; the front desk coordinator was so kind and when I showed up for the consultation; I was so impressed with the whole teams’ kindness and care.  During my consultation with Dr. Richardson;  I immediately felt calm talking to him about the procedures, and I knew he would be my plastic surgeon. He is so professional, honest, caring and so humble. He took time to  explain what procedures we could do and it was totally up to me how little or how much I wanted to do. It was truly a very informative consultation without any pressure to commit to the surgery. Once I decided to proceed with the surgery; Dr. Lee, the anesthesiologist called me the night before to talk to me and go over things which I appreciated so much. It instantly calmed my anxiety. On the day of surgery, both Dr. Lee and Dr. Richardson came to talk to me prior to the surgery and the sweetest medical assistant Sam was helping me prepare for the surgery!  When the surgery was over;  I was sent home with clear follow up  instructions and the reassurance  that I could call the office with any questions at any time. Whenever I did have a question; one of the nurses promptly called me back.  Dr. Richardson also does multiple follow up appointments to make sure everything is going well. I am 6 weeks post op and  I could not have asked for better results and I truly believe Dr. Richardson is an exceptional plastic surgeon and artist. I am so impressed with the whole office that this is going to be my place for all my self care needs from now on! Thank you, Dr. Richardson and your fantastic team!

Also; a special shoutout to Bria, one of the medical aestheticians who gave me a fantastic hydraFacial today.  She is professional, sweet and so personable and guided me in the right direction as far as skincare and treatments go! I am hooked and look forward to many more visits with her!

user_reviews.Name: David Knight
user_reviews.Description: I don't trust my face to just anyone. I've been a patient at TX Faces since they opened, and the consistency is what keeps me coming back. Whether it's my regular filler appointment or trying a new laser treatment, the standard is always top-tier. The team remembers me, asks about my life, and tailors treatments to my changing goals. They're honest about what will work and what don't even talking me out of procedures that arent right for me. That integrity is rare. Their onlien booking (via their site) is seamless, and they send clear pre- and post-care instructions. A class act all around.

user_reviews.Name: S Bobina
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been a patient of Dr. Cain for over four years and truly appreciate both him and this facility. However, today I want to highlight Renaida, their Aesthetic Technician. Over the past few years, I noticed spots appearing on my face and always wanted to address them—but I hesitated after reading horror stories about laser treatments on brown skin.

From my very first consultation, Renaida made me feel completely comfortable. She never pressured me to buy products or services, unlike many other places. Recently, I decided to try a Halo Laser peel. The recovery was challenging, and I questioned my decision more than once, but now—seven days later—my skin looks like I’m in my twenties again.

Texas Facial Aesthetics has never pushed unnecessary procedures. Every visit has left me feeling cared for and at ease. I’m grateful for their professionalism and the genuine sense of trust they provide.

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Walker (Jess)
user_reviews.Description: We have loved our results and experience! I can’t speak highly enough! I am referring family and friends. Impeccable communication from the ladies in the front to the coordinators and the nurses in the back. Dr. Cain, well… he is an amazing facial artist/sculptor/surgeon;) We are very thankful to have found Texas Facial Aesthetics!

user_reviews.Name: Joel Beek
user_reviews.Description:
Solved my "marionette lines" when nothing else worked.
I was starting to get those downward lines around my mouth that made me look perpetually sad. Creams weren't cutting it. I did a ton of research and scheduled a consultation at TX Faces. They didn't just offer filler; they presented a full plan involving a tiny bit of laser skin tightening and a very strategic hyaluronic acid filler. The results are unbelievable. It's not that I look "done"—I just look like me, but 8-10 years ago. The technique was masterful, with zero bruising. It’s been 6 months and the results are holding perfectly. Worth every penny for the expertise.

user_reviews.Name: jara brailsford
user_reviews.Description:
I had keloids removed from both ears, and Dr. Cain did an absolutely amazing job. I am so grateful I found Texas Facial Aesthetics. After visiting multiple facilities prior to this one, many of them told me there was nothing they could do without cutting off part of my ear. Dr. Cain took the time to really listen, and he gave me hope when I felt like I was out of options.

The entire team was so kind, welcoming, and professional. They always make me feel comfortable and explain the process with  transparency. The results exceeded my expectations, and I finally feel confident again.

So glad I found you guys!!!

user_reviews.Name: Michielle Orsini
user_reviews.Description: I love my experience with Bria! I can’t say enough good things about my visit. She is incredibly caring, took the time to understand my concerns, and made the entire experience relaxing and comfortable. The results exceeded my expectations—my skin has never looked better. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for both genuine care and exceptional results.

user_reviews.Name: Jason Lopez
user_reviews.Description: Candi works wonders and is a complete professional at her job! She explains the simplest of procedures and carries them out flawlessly! I will be returning for all my dermatology needs! Thanks Candi!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a mole shaved off right above my upper lip and was very pleased and impressed with how easy the process was with Dr. Cain. The appointment to remove it only took a few minutes, and the nurse was very friendly and informative about the aftercare process. I had no problems during the healing and have great results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julianne Pierce
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Richardson and his staff are wonderful! Very professional and yet down to earth and knowledgeable. I feel fantastic and am enjoying my results. Thank you for making me look the way I feel 🩷🩷🩷

user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with Dr. Richardson and his staff was nothing short of excellent.

I was fortunate enough to have a referral after I had done what research I could. I had two consults and neither came close to matching the professional office and staff interaction.

I am thrilled with the results of my upper and lower bleph. He recommended laser resurfacing as well and I am so happy I had it done. Dr. Richardson has extensive knowledge and explained everything in detail. Furthermore, he and his lovely staff put me at ease.

If you have any reservations about these procedures, look no further than Texas Facial Aesthetics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaycee
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING surgeon, AMAZING staff. I came for a procedure for my face and his work is THE BEST! I don’t know if it’s just him or the way they are in Texas, but I felt welcomed, cared for, and just really at ease. They are all very professional, ensuring that I understood what to expect and what was needed on my part- but at the same time, I felt like I was visiting friends. I have never felt so comfortable at a doctor’s office- especially one thousands of mile from my home in a place I’ve never been. I don’t think anything could’ve gone more perfectly. My concerns were addressed before I needed to even ask- almost like they knew. I’ve visited surgeons before and I always felt like they pointed out things where I felt more self conscious. Dr. Richardson focus was on my concern. He is extremely easy to talk to and he really takes his time with you. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Drewy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was very pleased with Dr. Cain and the rest of the staff at TFA! Everyone was extremely knowledgeable, informative, professional and caring.
