Chris

user_reviews_extended.Name: TexasVaporBabe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is just amazing!!!! I love everything about coming here. Everyone is so nice and accodating. I feel great after everything I get done here.
Renaida is the nicest faciaist I’ve ever been to. She walks you thru everything. They don’t try to upsell you or add things you don’t need. Best place to go hands down!

user_reviews_extended.Name: jacie ivy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Richardson is amazing! I had chin lipo and buccle fat removal done. He educated me every step of the way, helped me understand my options, and always made me feel heard. He did an amazing job and I love my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: G Perrier
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Doctor Cain – is kind and humble.  He was very thorough in explaining my procedure plan, recovery, and results. He is very easy to talk to and very down to earth which I found endearing.

Staff – I’ve engaged with most or all his staff.  They are very professional, nice, and responsive.  They reflect Dr. Cain demeanor.  They are a great team.

Office – Is pristine, modern, and comfortable.  For all my visits it was always streamline.  I never waited long for anything.  I was in and out and really appreciated that the staff was considerate of my time.

Procedure – I had a facelift in April 2024.  I cannot even tell where my scars are, and he just lifted my sliding face back up.  I look like myself but BETTER and this is exactly what I wanted.

Healing – Healing time and pain were minimal for me.  I had no issues or complications.

Results - I cannot be happier with my results.  He did such a fantastic job!  I had zero complications, concerns or any expectations that were not met.

Experience – this was positive!  This is because of the choice I made to work with Dr. Cain and his staff.  I did vet a few other prominent Dallas area doctors and was disappointed with those experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience consulting with Dr. Richardson! He made me feel very comfortable throughout the appointment. Dr. Richardson took his time to explain everything in detail and I never felt rushed at all. It's obvious that he is highly knowledgeable and skilled at what he does. His professionalism and expertise gave me the confidence to move forward with him for my procedure. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Falyn Lott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience and the best nurses ever! So sweet and caring. Felt comfortable and safe during the whole thing, and Dr.Cain was the best! I am so happy with my results and I have him to thank!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl P
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a disappointing outcome from a rhinoplasty performed by a surgeon at a different practice. Revision rhinoplasty was not an option due to health concerns. I sought out Dr. Cain’s expertise in non-surgical (liquid) rhinoplasty. His thorough explanation and kind demeanor put me at ease. I'm overjoyed with the natural-looking results!  I highly recommend Dr. Cain!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendra Elaine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr. Richardson at Texas Facial Aesthetics for a forehead reduction (hairline lowering), and the whole experience was fantastic! This was my first time getting any kind of plastic surgery, so I was nervous. But Dr. Richardson and his team were so amazing to work with. What stood out to me about Dr. Richardson was his concern and care for my overall health. He was thorough with all my questions and ensured that I timed the procedure in the best way with my other health needs. His team was patient with me when coordinating my procedure date. He was clear on what I should expect and we aligned on the results I wanted. And 3 weeks post-op, I am so happy with the results! He and his team made me (and my mother, who served as my post-op nurse) very comfortable. I'm still healing but my confidence is already higher and I can't thank Dr. Richardson enough. Highly recommend him and the whole TFA team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Sam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a scar revision done with Dr. Cain and I could not be happier with my results, I am just about one year post op. I have a more complicated case than most and Dr. Cain and the entire staff took such great care of me during post op follow ups. I still get my Botox done here as well and am always pleased. I will always recommend Texas facial aesthetics and Dr. Cain for any cosmetic procedures to all of my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devonna McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am 3 weeks post op from a hairline lowering procedure done by Dr. Richardson and I absolutely love my results. Dr. Richardson is very kind, professional and will give you realistic expectations. I had no pain after surgery and my stitches were almost unnoticeable. I was able to return to work within two weeks. My scar is healing beautifully and my hair is already starting to grow through it so I know it will look even better with time. I’m so happy and grateful. It was worth every penny. Thank you so much Dr. Richardson and team 🤍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoe Li
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Cain and staffs are amazing! I had my piercing keloid removal surgery 1 years ago. I left this review now, because I know keloid regrow really often happens, and I would like to share my positive experience (after 1 year, yay!!).
Dr. Cain is really professional, knowledgeable and friendly! The doctor and staffs were all highly respect my time and opinions. They explained everything about the surgery to me and being so helpful during the surgery!
It has been more than 1 years. I was so afraid the keloid will regrow at beginning!  But so far, I can tell, my scar has been smaller and smaller (much better than 1 year ago!).
Really recommended this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kari Lemmon Wolfe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love getting my monthly HydraFacial with Bria! She’s amazing—super knowledgeable and makes the whole experience so relaxing. The space is peaceful, and my skin always looks fresh and glowing after. It really keeps my skin looking great all month. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great results. Took about 10-12 months for the last tiniest signs of swelling to go down but still looked better and better starting about 3 weeks after when I faced the outside world again. 45 when I did it so almost no bruising. Definitely would do it again. Dr Richardson and his team are incredible. Other people I saw for consults made me feel like I was just a dollar sign. Dr Richardson tailored my neck, face and brow lift/forehead reduction plus laser to my anatomy and desires. His staff are very friendly. I immediately felt at ease with them. Some think plastic surgery is just for the rich “keeping up with the Jones’” but not here. They made me feel at ease. Price was competitive and I think I got more value for my money here. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Wardwell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
June 1, 2024

I am 67 and looked high and low for the right doctor to perform a forehead lowering procedure. I found Dr. Richardson and his wonderful staff! I felt comfortable with Dr. Richardson from day one. Everyone was very friendly, helpful and professional. The procedures Dr. Richardson decided would work best for me were the forehead lowering, brow lift, lower bleph and face-lift.
I was confident in my choice going into surgery...excited and proud as I recovered from surgery.  Everything Dr. Richardson said I should expect was true and spot on.
It's been 8 months since my surgery and I have no regrets!  I know one thing---I do Not look 67 years old!!
I highly recommend Texas Facial Aesthetics and I think you will agree.  Thank you Dr. Richardson and staff members! ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Elliott
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My decision to go for a facelift was followed by extensive research on plastic surgeons in the area. Dr. Matthew Richardson’s name at Texas Facial Aesthetics, Frisco was recommended by another great surgeon of mine, and I found him true to the stellar reviews he has earned.
It is daunting to realize that facelift is something that would alter your visage. That said, I was nervous and had many questions for him! My nervousness and stress were short lived after meeting with Dr. Richardson. He completely put my mind to rest and at that very instance I knew I had found the right surgeon for my facelift!
Dr. Richardson and his staff are exceptional! I felt at home the moment I stepped into their clinic. He has extremely fine hands. It is hard to see any sutures/scarring. The whole process was painless. I am almost a month out now and I have to say, I couldn’t be happier with the results that are unfolding. He deleted at least 10 years, if not more, off my face!
The post-op instructions were very easy to follow, and I followed everything religiously. The ease of getting answers to my questions was great. I could just email, text or call his office if I had a question, and they were addressed and answered promptly by Dr. Richardson or his nurses.
His team consists of excellent anesthetists (mine was Dr. Lee), nurses and medical assistants. I would like to mention Sam, Jessica and Beth; they were outstanding. The front desk and staff are very personable, polite and caring. Everything about Dr. Richardson’s clinic is phenomenal. I would recommend him to anyone who is looking to get a facelift, neck lift or any other cosmetic procedure. He is the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Proctor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Richardson did an excellent job on my forehead reduction. I love my results! Dr. Richardson and the staff at Texas Facial Aesthetics took the time to answer any and all questions and went over as many details as needed during my consultation, the day of surgery, and my post op consultation. They make sure to check in on your after surgery when you go home and make sure you have everything you need throughout the whole process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Donaldson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience with Dr. Cain and his team. Everyone was very welcoming and super informative. I went in for a mole removal on my face and the process was very smooth, with no pain at all. Doctor went over all options and never made me feel pressured to make a decision. Overall great experience, lovely practice and kind staff! Thank you Dr. Cain and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kathleen duperval
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Richardson is hands down the best surgeon when it comes to forehead reductions. The day after my surgery I could barely notice the incision!! So clean and thin!! I felt like he really cared about making sure I was happy while also prioritizing my safety/health. I appreciated how honest he was through out the the process and how thoroughly he answered all my questions. Furthermore, his entire team was AMAZING!!! All the nurses were super helpful, kind, organized, and provided lots of important information. I really appreciated the Anesthesia doctor’s calming and kind energy as well. I get super nervous about going under, so the fact that I felt reassured and comforted during that process really meant a lot to me. The anesthesia and the surgery itself went perfectly smooth!! This whole experience has been amazing!! I felt safe, cared for, and came out with such a beautiful forehead!!!! Dr. Richardson and his team are truly a blessing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn Lawrence
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Richardson Was highly recommended from a friend. From my very first meeting to my last follow up today, it was a five star experience all the way.  . after less than three months, I barely have any scars and My results are amazing. I would 100% recommend Dr. Richardson.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barah Gardner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Texas Facial has completely changed my life! Dr. Richardson is absolutely the best in his field! He is so caring, takes the time to truly understand your needs, and provides the best guidance to accomplish your goals! The entire staff team is equally amazing and caring! Every time I visit, I leave feeling amazing! Everything I’ve had done including facials, multiple  treatments, and even surgery has exceeded my expectations! If I moved to the other side of the world, I would travel back here just for them! I will never go anywhere else! Truly outstanding!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cvlagnv
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Richardson is very professional and kind. Him and his staff are very welcoming and make you feel very comfortable. I came as an out of town patient and they are very responsive wether through email or the phone so I appreciate their quick response time. They made planning the trip and procedure a breeze. I got a hairline lowering procedure and Dr.Richardson work is very seamless scar wise and in general does great work and makes sure you are happy with the results. Him and his staff made sure during the procedure and in recovery that I was fine and answered all questions I had. In all him and his staff made the whole trip and procedure as comfortable as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phyllis Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a lift and laser resurfacing performed by Dr. Richardson. I am overjoyed with the results. He is incredibly talented. I would give him more than 5 stars if the option was available. All of the problems areas on my neck and jaw line are gone but with a very natural appearing result. The laser resurfacing took care of all brown spots as well as many fine lines and bumps.
I highly recommend Dr. Richardson and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Ivey
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I met him, I felt very comfortable with Dr Richardson.  His staff was very responsive and caring.  I’d recommend Texas Facial Aesthetics to anyone researching elective surgery.   I am very happy with my results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Jobe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to Texas Facial Aesthetics a few times for a couple of different procedures. The most recent procedure was with Dr. Richardson, who was amazing as usual. Before the procedure, we discussed what I wanted to accomplish. He was very thorough, answered all my questions, and addressed all my concerns. In the end, he was able to do exactly what I wanted, and I am thrilled with the results! Dr. Richardson’s bedside manner is incredibly professional and caring, and his staff is so sweet. The competence of Dr. Richardson and his nurses will bring me back to this practice time and time again!! I always recommend Dr. Richardson to anyone looking for a facial plastic surgeon because I know they’ll be in good hands with him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chef Sam
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I contacted Texas Facial Aesthetics, I was extremely pleased with how fast they responded to my inquiry. When I walked into their office, I knew that I made the right choice. The staff made me feel comfortable and welcome. Dr. Richardson and his staff were all very attentive and listened to all of my concerns in a detailed matter. The whole process was effectively organized. They explained everything that I needed to know and the procedure was extremely professional and efficient. Dr. Richardson also personally called me and checked up on me several times after the procedure to make sure that I was properly healing. That just shows how passionate he is about his profession. I would definitely recommend Texas Facial Aesthetics.

I am the type of person who will avoid doctors, clinics, hospitals, etc., by all means necessary. This was an extremely tough decision for me and I was very pleased with Dr. Richardson. user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Moyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a significant weight loss through diet and exercise, I was left with unattractive loose skin on my neck and an aged face. Rather than feeling good about my work in progress, I was depressed and extremely self conscious about my neck. Texas is not the place for year-round turtlenecks and scarves! I began searching in earnest for a cosmetic surgeon, specifically neck and face lifts. That is when I discovered a very talented LOCAL surgeon, Dr. Matthew Richardson! I was very struck by his patients’ before and after photos because the after photos were more refreshed, attractive  and youthful versions of the before - not the stereotypical Hollywood stretched, filled look! So natural! I scheduled  a consultation with Dr. Richardson to discuss my concerns with my appearance, as well as my health status - rheumatoid arthritis and Sjogrens Syndrome, both autoimmune conditions that can increase risks of surgery and recovery. At the initial consultation, we discussed surgery options as we looked through the online photo portfolio that I had studied intensely.  Dr. Richardson compared my features to other patients that could achieve similar results. He made me feel very comfortable and I immediately felt I could trust his advice and professional services. I left with a recommendation for several procedures consistent with our discussions. As a busy professional, I was very open to combining multiple procedures into one surgery and recovery period. Given my very dry eyes, a complication of Sjogrens Syndrome, he did not recommend an upper eye lift for my hooded eyes, but instead recommended some lasering on the upper lids and a lower eye repair with fat injections under the lower lids. I appreciated his full consideration of my complications. I had worried that I might not be an eligible candidate. My surgery occurred on my 56th birthday! I can honestly say that I didn’t have significant pain or discomfort after and my recovery was quite easy at home. There was swelling and numbness, day 3, whoa!, along with bruising, but at no point did I suffer or regret anything.  I can easily and adamantly recommend cosmetic surgery with Dr. Richardson! He is the BEST and a genuinely kind person too!  The five stars above just aren’t enough to signify how life changing my results have been and how much I appreciate his expert care and attention to detail!! He is so attentive,  caring and perfectionistic! I was solely focused on my turkey neck, but had noticed his other patients’ treated with a lip lift, so we included that procedure. Yes, my neck is better now than I had even dared to dream, but my upper lip is SO great too! Now I have a plumper, bowed upper lip and I smile all of the time! I am so grateful that I found Dr. Matthew Richardson and made this investment in myself! I have renewed enthusiasm for reaching my goal weight with a more youthful and attractive neck and face! I cannot conclude without also extending my admiration and appreciation to the full Texas Facial Aesthetics team!! Everyone there is a caring professional, so pleasant and attentive!! Best doctor, best team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marieme Diallo
user_reviews_extended.Description: HORRIBLE HAIR TRANSPLANT EXPERIENCE. Dr  Richardson did a hairline lowering on me 01/2019. He told me I needed hairline lowering and hair transplant to get the result I wanted and he was going to help me. I believed him . After the hairline lowering, he told me he lowered 3cm, then the number changed to 2 cm. He has few pictures of hair transplants in his website so I assumed he can do it and he is genuine. I went for my hair transplant 08/08/19 for 1000-1500 grafts which he charged me 4800. I moved from Texas to California Feb 2019. I flew back to Texas, paid money for hotels etc..(the cost added up to over 6000. The day of the hair transplant, he walked in, drew a hairline on me and in that particular moment, I knew I chose the wrong doctor for my procedure. I told him the corners were sharp and I didn't like it. He said we have to add hair here and there and that is how it is supposed to be. He was very cold and unfriendly. In that particular moment, I couldn't stop the surgery because I would lose my money. They gave me something to sleep with an IV.  I woke up after he did the holes on my head but the transplant didn't start yet. During the transplant he was complaining about not usually doing more than 400 grafts. It made me feel uncomfortable and like I was a nuisance even though I am the patient and paid my money. What made me super depressed is he was cutting grafts, decided to stop all of a sudden and threw the piece of grafts that had at least 300 hair follicles in a biohazard bin and he said he always take more than he needs umh?. If you are doing a hair transplant, already you don't have enough hair, why would someone deliberately take more than he needs. At that moment, I knew he was lying and just didn't feel like doing it anymore. I wonder who did those 1700 hair grafts pic he has on his website. The next day, I called and he called me back. I told him how bad my face was swollen and how I hated the hairline and I was depressed. He said oh you will like it once the hair grow. I went to hair transplant specialists and they both said he clearly transplanted no more than 500 grafts and the hairline is horrible. I went for the stitches to be taken off 11 days later, since I had a FUT; he was so fake and phony being nice because he knows he did me wrong. He offered me some hair vitamins for free and said he is willing to fix my head. Now I booked an appointment with a  hair transplant doctor in Los Gatos, CA for September 30, 2019, because now I cannot take a chance with someone inexperienced like  Dr Richardson and my donor area is extremely limited.I will never get the look I want in this life because I trusted someone I shouldn't and everyday I am depressed over this.  How can you treat a patient like that?

user_reviews.Description:
In the beginning of this year, I underwent a BBL procedure. Shortly after, I was diagnosed with a PULMONARY EMBOLISM- a life threatening condition that required immediate medical intervention. My boyfriend previously shared a brief review of what followed after I noticed the symptoms began to surface, but now that I’ve completed all required testings and bloodwork, and have met with both my PCP and hematologist for answers, as Dr. Walker advised, I feel it’s important to finally speak for myself.

After my surgery, before my boyfriend wrote a review, I sometimes wasn’t getting responses to my emails and had to call quite a few times. I still have those unanswered emails in my mail. After the review was posted, I no longer had problems with getting my emails answered. At one point, I experienced an issue after hours and called the after hours line. I’m not sure whether the lady I spoke with called Dr. Walker, (I don’t know the exact process they use to get in touch with him), but she tried reaching out to him three times, and he did not respond. She followed up with me each attempt as she mentioned before ending the call that I should expect a call from him within approximately 20 minutes. I’m very understanding, so by the third attempt, I told her it was okay, that I understand he may have been occupied or addressing other urgent matters at that time and ended up handling it myself.

Prior to the pulmonary embolism, I developed swelling and mild bruising below my right knee. Nearly 6 months after surgery, the swelling persists, and, sometimes, only subsides with the use of compression socks. It becomes particularly evident when my leg is exposed, serving as a constant reminder of everything I went through. Notably, there was no prior history of swelling in this region, it was one of the earliest indicators of the pulmonary embolism that followed.

A moment that still stands out to me was when I consulted Dr. Walker about firm, painful bumps, forming under my skin by my abdomen. Despite my concern and specific questions about fibrosis, he assured me it wasn’t the case. That brought me a great sense of relief. However, upon bringing the issue to my PCP, since the affected area showed no signs of improvement, a later evaluation confirmed it was fibrosis. Something that made me question the accuracy of his assessment and overall care.

Beyond that, I was deeply disappointed with my surgical results.

I was genuinely excited to get this BBL, but unfortunately, what I experienced was FAR from what I hoped. I waited to write this review until I completed all necessary testing and blood-work because I wanted to share the honest truth. There is SO much more I could share, but it’s too much to put into words. Ultimately, everyone is human and errors are inevitable. I hope that anyone considering a procedure like this will not make the mistake I did. Make sure to ask thorough questions, not just surface level ones. Research your surgeon carefully, and make sure you choose someone who truly cares, not just someone who says they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My girlfriend recently had a BBL with Dr. Walker. We noticed some concerning symptoms, including, swelling in both feet, mild bruising with additional swelling on the lower right part of her leg, just below the knee, and shortness of breath/chest pain. Upon evaluation at the ER, she was diagnosed with a PULMONARY EMBOLISM—a LIFE-THREATENING CONDITION.

Before taking her to the ER, concerned, she immediately called the office after noticing her symptoms. She explained the swelling in her feet and the bruising with swelling below her knees to the woman she spoke with on the phone, I believe it was the receptionist. She was then placed on hold while the lady informed Dr. Walker about the situation. Afterward, my girlfriend was asked to send pictures, which she promptly did. The lady then said that Dr. Walker wanted her to elevate her feet and wear compression socks. If my girlfriend hadn’t spoken up about her chest pain and shortness of breath, I honestly don’t know if she would still be here with us today. It was only after she reported shortness of breath/chest pain that she was finally advised to go to the ER. Throughout the entire process, she constantly asked questions and sought clear instructions on how to proceed. Despite the seriousness of her symptoms, she was repeatedly placed on hold by the lady she was speaking with on the phone.

Upon receiving instructions to go to the ER, I immediately rushed her there. Blood work results indicated the PRESENCE OF BLOOD CLOTS, and a CT scan confirmed what we FEARED—she had a PULMONARY EMBOLISM a LIFE-THREATENING CONDITION , but by the grace of God, she is still here with us.

I sincerely urge you to do your research before selecting a surgeon. During your consultation, don’t hesitate to ask comprehensive questions to ensure you fully understand your options and the care being provided.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JoAnna Marez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I paid 21k for a MMO. Everything dr recommended I got done. I didn't haggle or anything. Let him know my concerns he told me what to do I said ok. Do it. I just want results.

This was my 2nd surgery different dr and he delivered results.

Not comepletly unhappy but I expected better with what I paid.

I got Tummy Tuck, breast lift , implants, lipo, fat transfer, also charged for processing fat, morpheus skin tightening in back and paid xtra for back lipo thats why it was so much.

I asked for fat transfer to hips for fear of getting elephant ears. Guess what now im sqaured and have elephant ears. My TT scare faces down not up. One breast is bigger then the other and they are far apart. I'd love some cleavage!!! Your the plastic surgeon make it happen.

But I scheduled revision because I was not happy I was quoted 7200 (total shock)  but ok whatever just fix me. Why when I go in for pre op we went over finances again and I was quoted 9200 for a revision. Uh excuse me for mistakes you made.

Was not happy with this at all especially after I spent 21k and 11k just the yr before for mini TT, lipo 360 and bbl with another dr. I expected to look super amazing after especially because it was suppose to be my last surgery and I'm a size 0/2 woman. But revision for not doing enough lipo is not my fault, in dr putting the same CCs in each breast when we all know we arnt comepletly symmetrical is not my fault, that morpheus skin tightening did nothing to my back total waste of money, in the TT scar and dog ears is not my fault I specifically asked dont do that to me please because now I look like a box. I went in with concerns I wanted fixed but it just created other things I dont like.

Then he overcharges for everything. So beware he's expensive and doenst give you exactly what you want and you have to pay alot more to try to fix. In guess what they kept my 1000 deposit which sux because I agreed on paying 7200 not 9200 when i went to pre op. So because I cancel on you for trying to charge me xtra is my fault. Wow ok looks like that's all you care about is money.

Like geesh I just paid 21k without flinching and you didn't give me what I asked for.

Sux so bad because this is my body and I made a investment on it and I wish I got what I paid for.

So gonna cry be angry and get over it and I guess find another dr that will deliver so I can fix these things I dislike about myself.
:(

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meagan Kile
user_reviews_extended.Description: Having a breast lift with augmentation was one of the toughest decisions I have ever made. But the moment I met Dr Walker my mind was made up to not live in fear and just do it. I always jump to worst case scenarios in all things but Dr Walker was so kind and patient and explained all aspects of the procedure, even what the material of the tools used in the operating room and the process to help me make an educated decision. His team is outstanding and super responsive. The surgery center that he uses was top notch and the anesthesia specialist was very attentive and made me feel comfortable. The amount of research I did on google prior to speaking with Nurse Dewina (who is fantastic) on Dr Walkers team and Dr Walker himself was intense and the both of them sat down and went through each and every question/concern that I had and made sure I fully understood everything. Even the wild internet misinformation they addressed for me so that I felt comfortable with my final decision. I am 34 yrs old and I lost a ton of weight and was extremely self conscious with my breasts. Dr Walker completely lifted and reshaped them and made them perky and full again and I couldn’t be happier! The pricing was quite competitive and they made it so easy with the care credit I signed up for. I am 6 weeks post surgery and feel fantastic. My scarring is minimal and healing and I haven’t had any complications thanks to Dr Walker being such a perfectionist in his craft. If you are considering any type of reconstruction or cosmetic procedure I urge you to talk to Dr Walker. He will be honest with you, have no judgement and provide you with realistic expectations and amazing results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Hardy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Would definitely recommend Dr Walker.  Not only does he get 5 stars for the quality of his work... but he gets 5 stars for patience and being so personable. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s far overdue that I give a 5 star review to Walker Plastic Surgery.  Dr. Walker is kind and listens to your concerns. You can tell his interest is genuine and he took plenty of time with me to explain the procedures I was interested in.  As important as the doctor, is the staff. Dr. Walker has registered nurses and licensed estheticians working with him…something you should ask because in past experience at another office, this was not the case.  Dewina his RN is an awesome nurse that calmed my fears before surgery. Her thoroughness and sweet temperament made me feel confident on surgery day. Afy scheduled me and was a gem helping me add on a few things.
Last October I had a browlift, CO2 laser full face/neck and mini tummy tuck. My recovery was a piece of cake. My skin looks so even and smooth! My post op checks ran on time and so did the doctor. So refreshing! I couldn’t be happier with my results and my overall experience. I visit for Botox, fillers and the med spa for laser hair removal and hydrofacial. Walker Plastic Surgery is my one stop shop :) Now in less than 2 weeks I am having another surgery with Dr. Walker. Reverse tummy tuck, CO2 laser chest/neck, Face/Neck/Body Tite, Fat injection to the face, upper eyelids and rhinoplasty (nose).
A good initial meeting with doctor and staff, an office that runs on time and respects my time as well, detailed follow up appointments, licensed and experienced team and my AMAZING results have made me a patient for life.  There is no other doctor in Frisco worth visiting. Go right to the top with Dr. Walker!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Callie Whittington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Walker and his team. They have been amazing from consultation to post op. I have full faith in Dr Walker to help me through this nightmare.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jana Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I met Dr. Walker I knew he was the surgeon for ME! He took his time and explained everything to me. His office was able to get me scheduled when I wanted and everything was a smooth process even with my personal medical hiccups. I decided to get breast augmentation with a lift and tummy tuck! (Mommy Makeover) The surgery went Great and he followed up with me after a couple of times after surgery. I just left my 1 week post op appointment and I have Amazing Results! I honestly believe he did everything he could to give me the best possible results. I had a dramatic moment in office and he was very polite and patient with me. user_reviews_extended.Name: Miyesha Osei
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a woman of color we are often concerned about scars, appearing natural, perception and shame. For years I lived with excruciating pain in my back, neck, shoulders and hips often leaving me in the bed, unable to walk upright or play with my children. My quality of life was diminished and I didn’t even realize. I felt shame with entering bra stores thinking the entire time the staff was wondering why I was there. I always purchased expensive bras and I was always spilling out of the cups no matter how big the cup…even up to an I cup (which still didn’t fit) I couldn’t wear button up shirts, turtlenecks or empire waist shirts. I met Dr. Walker on a referral and from the moment I entered his office the staff never made me feel ashamed. Even with a small scheduling issue that made me want to jump ship they were beyond patient. They let me breathe and call them back. They fit me in and Dr. Walker literally took care of me the day before Thanksgiving even with the staff at the facility almost all gone home early. He took his time and literally transformed my life. I don’t have anymore back pain, hip, neck pain or shoulder pain. He called me the day after surgery and was funny and personable. I don’t know about his other patients but I feel like he is my friend. He doesn’t chat in medical terminology and he is a total virtual hand holder. I can’t say enough about Dr. Walker, Dewina or Alex. Even the receptionist is glowing and happy to see me when I come in. I’m looking forward to my 6 week post op appointment. I’ve been assured that they will do everything possible to minimize any scars. I feel beautiful again and no worries about the untamed dough that kept rising out of my shirts with a mind of its own. He took off over 10 lbs in my breast reduction and I am singing from the hills to everyone that will listen as a shining example of what a life change something like breast reduction can bring. More changes to come as I am just shy of 2 weeks out but I’m amazed! I’m hoping Dr. Walker is so amazed by the transformation that he allows me to be volunteered if he has cases as extreme as mine was. I’ll say this…I should have done it sooner BUT it was meant to be when it was so that I got to be Dr. Walkers’ patient. 🩺⚕️❤️‍🩹🥼👨‍⚕️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From my very first consultation with Dr. Nick Walker, I knew I had found my surgeon. I had multiple consults scheduled, and canceled every single one after meeting him. There was no comparison.

What sets Dr. Walker apart is how deeply he listens. He didn’t push procedures or upsell, he took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and thoughtfully explained how to achieve it. He even walked me through my anatomy on an iPad, breaking down why certain approaches (like over vs. under the muscle) would deliver the best result for my body. That level of personalization is rare.

His entire team operates at the same standard of excellence. I felt fully prepared going into surgery - from detailed guidance on how to care for myself beforehand (including nutrition for healing) to a personal call from the anesthesiologist the day before. The day of surgery? Seamless, calm, and genuinely supportive in every way.

Post-op care has been just as exceptional. Dr. Walker personally checked on me twice in the first week — not rushed, not routine checking off a box — just making sure I was okay and had everything I needed.

And the results? Truly perfect. Natural, balanced, and exactly what I asked for, because he actually listened.

If you’re considering surgery, this is the team you want.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Walker’s work was great. I had some unsightly loose skin and hard to lose volume from excessive weight loss in the past. I also needed a breast lift with implant exchange. Everything was taken care of with satisfaction and without any real issue. One incision re-opened, but it was right in a crease that was disturbed whenever I sat or stood. It was addressed immediately and there was no further attention needed.

Also, I want to note the friendliness, flexibility and helpfulness of the staff. I currently have mobility difficulties. Everyone was more than accommodating and interested in my safety and comfort. Often times I feel very ‘othered’ due to my current condition, but I never once felt that way. In honesty, that’s what stood out right behind the results itself.

There is one final set of procedures, that if everything works out, I intend to return to Dr. Walker to perform.

user_reviews.Name: Aileen
user_reviews.Description:
In the beginning of this year, I underwent a BBL procedure. Shortly after, I was diagnosed with a PULMONARY EMBOLISM- a life threatening condition that required immediate medical intervention. My boyfriend previously shared a brief review of what followed after I noticed the symptoms began to surface, but now that I’ve completed all required testings and bloodwork, and have met with both my PCP and hematologist for answers, as Dr. Walker advised, I feel it’s important to finally speak for myself.

After my surgery, before my boyfriend wrote a review, I sometimes wasn’t getting responses to my emails and had to call quite a few times. I still have those unanswered emails in my mail. After the review was posted, I no longer had problems with getting my emails answered. At one point, I experienced an issue after hours and called the after hours line. I’m not sure whether the lady I spoke with called Dr. Walker, (I don’t know the exact process they use to get in touch with him), but she tried reaching out to him three times, and he did not respond. She followed up with me each attempt as she mentioned before ending the call that I should expect a call from him within approximately 20 minutes. I’m very understanding, so by the third attempt, I told her it was okay, that I understand he may have been occupied or addressing other urgent matters at that time and ended up handling it myself.

Prior to the pulmonary embolism, I developed swelling and mild bruising below my right knee. Nearly 6 months after surgery, the swelling persists, and, sometimes, only subsides with the use of compression socks. It becomes particularly evident when my leg is exposed, serving as a constant reminder of everything I went through. Notably, there was no prior history of swelling in this region, it was one of the earliest indicators of the pulmonary embolism that followed.

A moment that still stands out to me was when I consulted Dr. Walker about firm, painful bumps, forming under my skin by my abdomen. Despite my concern and specific questions about fibrosis, he assured me it wasn’t the case. That brought me a great sense of relief. However, upon bringing the issue to my PCP, since the affected area showed no signs of improvement, a later evaluation confirmed it was fibrosis. Something that made me question the accuracy of his assessment and overall care.

Beyond that, I was deeply disappointed with my surgical results.

I was genuinely excited to get this BBL, but unfortunately, what I experienced was FAR from what I hoped. I waited to write this review until I completed all necessary testing and blood-work because I wanted to share the honest truth. There is SO much more I could share, but it’s too much to put into words. Ultimately, everyone is human and errors are inevitable. I hope that anyone considering a procedure like this will not make the mistake I did. Make sure to ask thorough questions, not just surface level ones. Research your surgeon carefully, and make sure you choose someone who truly cares, not just someone who says they do.

My girlfriend recently had a BBL with Dr. Walker. We noticed some concerning symptoms, including, swelling in both feet, mild bruising with additional swelling on the lower right part of her leg, just below the knee, and shortness of breath/chest pain. Upon evaluation at the ER, she was diagnosed with a PULMONARY EMBOLISM—a LIFE-THREATENING CONDITION.

Before taking her to the ER, concerned, she immediately called the office after noticing her symptoms. She explained the swelling in her feet and the bruising with swelling below her knees to the woman she spoke with on the phone, I believe it was the receptionist. She was then placed on hold while the lady informed Dr. Walker about the situation. Afterward, my girlfriend was asked to send pictures, which she promptly did. The lady then said that Dr. Walker wanted her to elevate her feet and wear compression socks. If my girlfriend hadn’t spoken up about her chest pain and shortness of breath, I honestly don’t know if she would still be here with us today. It was only after she reported shortness of breath/chest pain that she was finally advised to go to the ER. Throughout the entire process, she constantly asked questions and sought clear instructions on how to proceed. Despite the seriousness of her symptoms, she was repeatedly placed on hold by the lady she was speaking with on the phone.

Upon receiving instructions to go to the ER, I immediately rushed her there. Blood work results indicated the PRESENCE OF BLOOD CLOTS, and a CT scan confirmed what we FEARED—she had a PULMONARY EMBOLISM a LIFE-THREATENING CONDITION , but by the grace of God, she is still here with us.

I sincerely urge you to do your research before selecting a surgeon. During your consultation, don’t hesitate to ask comprehensive questions to ensure you fully understand your options and the care being provided.

I’ve been assured that they will do everything possible to minimize any scars. I feel beautiful again and no worries about the untamed dough that kept rising out of my shirts with a mind of its own. He took off over 10 lbs in my breast reduction and I am singing from the hills to everyone that will listen as a shining example of what a life change something like breast reduction can bring. More changes to come as I am just shy of 2 weeks out but I’m amazed! user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From my very first consultation with Dr. Nick Walker, I knew I had found my surgeon. I had multiple consults scheduled, and canceled every single one after meeting him. There was no comparison.

What sets Dr. Walker apart is how deeply he listens. He didn’t push procedures or upsell, he took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and thoughtfully explained how to achieve it. He even walked me through my anatomy on an iPad, breaking down why certain approaches (like over vs. under the muscle) would deliver the best result for my body. That level of personalization is rare.

His entire team operates at the same standard of excellence. I felt fully prepared going into surgery - from detailed guidance on how to care for myself beforehand (including nutrition for healing) to a personal call from the anesthesiologist the day before. The day of surgery? Seamless, calm, and genuinely supportive in every way.

Post-op care has been just as exceptional. Dr. Walker personally checked on me twice in the first week — not rushed, not routine checking off a box — just making sure I was okay and had everything I needed.

And the results? Truly perfect. Natural, balanced, and exactly what I asked for, because he actually listened.

If you’re considering surgery, this is the team you want.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Walker does amazing work and he truly understood my goals and the look that I envisioned for myself. I am so excited for the final results! His staff makes the experience seamless. I highly recommend anyone thinking of making changes to visit with Dr Walker.

user_reviews_extended.Name: s generette
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Walker’s work was great. I had some unsightly loose skin and hard to lose volume from excessive weight loss in the past. I also needed a breast lift with implant exchange. Everything was taken care of with satisfaction and without any real issue. One incision re-opened, but it was right in a crease that was disturbed whenever I sat or stood. It was addressed immediately and there was no further attention needed.

Also, I want to note the friendliness, flexibility and helpfulness of the staff. I currently have mobility difficulties. Everyone was more than accommodating and interested in my safety and comfort. Often times I feel very ‘othered’ due to my current condition, but I never once felt that way. In honesty, that’s what stood out right behind the results itself.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Experiencing Exceptional Care: A Patient's Journey with Dr. Hopkins

In the world of medicine, where technical skill meets human compassion, finding a healthcare provider who embodies both qualities is a true gem. Dr. Hopkins is that gem—a triple board-certified surgeon whose expertise is rivaled only by his remarkable bedside manner. My recent experience with him during my Panniculectomy with Abdominoplasty was nothing short of exceptional.

From the moment I walked into Dr. Hopkins' upscale, meticulously clean office, I felt a sense of calm wash over me. The welcoming atmosphere was not only visually appealing but also reflected the clinic’s commitment to patient care. This positive first impression set the tone for what would be a transformative medical journey.

Dr. Hopkins took the time to sit down with me and address all my questions, no matter how small. His knowledge is profound, yet he communicates in a way that is both approachable and reassuring. It was clear that he is not only a skilled professional but also someone who genuinely cares about his patients' well-being.

The surgical procedure itself, a combination of Panniculectomy and Abdominoplasty, was executed flawlessly. Dr. Hopkins' attention to detail was evident in the meticulous manner in which he approached my surgery. I left the operating room feeling confident and hopeful, but it was his compassion that truly made the difference in my recovery process. Throughout my visit, I felt genuinely cared for, which greatly alleviated any anxiety I had about the procedure.

I am grateful to have chosen Dr. Hopkins for my surgery. I have no regrets, and I cannot express enough how thankful I am for the positive impact he has had on my confidence and overall well-being. His skill and compassion truly brought my confidence level back up to where it belongs.

Beyond Dr. Hopkins, the care I received from his entire team was noteworthy. Aletha, Samantha, and Nurse Katie are all pillars of support within the clinic. Their dedication, sweetness, and respect for patients made my experience comfortable and enjoyable. They were always ready to lend a helping hand or offer a kind word, making a world of difference throughout my visit.

The efficiency and friendliness of the entire staff contributed to a smooth and easy process, which is often an overlooked aspect of patient care. In an era where rushed service can be common, it was refreshing to experience prompt attention combined with genuine warmth.

As I reflect on my journey, I realize just how important it is to have a healthcare provider who values the details of patient care. Dr. Hopkins and his team exemplify the standard we need here in Texas. Their unwavering dedication, professional expertise, and heartfelt compassion resonate deeply with the values that should guide healthcare.

I highly recommend Dr. Hopkins to anyone seeking not just a skilled surgeon but a compassionate partner in their healthcare journey. Thank you once again, Dr. Hopkins, for everything—you have made a profound impact on my life, and I look forward to seeing you and the team soon!

user_reviews.Name: Will
user_reviews.Description: I believe the medical term for what I had done was Blepharoplasty. This is the procedure to remove the bags under my eyes. Dr. Toledo had been highly recommended to me and I am glad he was. The initial consult was very easy and enjoyable. Dr. Toledo checked me over, described what he saw, and how he could fix it. Photos were taken and I immediately scheduled the surgery and was given excellent literature to help me prepare. The night before the surgery the anesthesiologist called to introduce himself and describe what was going to happen and ask if I had any questions. I thought this was amazing to get that kind of pre-op call. The surgery went very well. I came out of the anesthetic with no issues. I had filled a prescription for pain meds but never needed them. There was no pain. The only discomfort I felt was having to put antibiotic eye drops in my eyes. I was so pleased there was no pain. I had no bruising or racoon eyes. I was out in public a few days later and had to tell people that I had just had surgery. They were amazed and impressed with the results. After care was the best. Dr. Toledo and his staff are great and caring. I can't say enough nice things about them. The stitches came out and even that did not hurt. I have attached before and after pics his staff took. I am so thankful I had the surgery and that Dr. Toledo did it. At the final check up I thanked the Doc for making such a big change in my life possible.

user_reviews.Name: Creeanna Nutter
user_reviews.Description: I have been wanting a nose job for so long and never thought it would happen. Dr. Toledo is reasonably priced and made everything go so smooth. Made sure my results were natural looking to fit my face and functional. I have the nose I dreamed of and I can breathe better! I couldn't be more happy with my outcome and I would highly highly recommend going to him!

user_reviews.Name: Sophia
user_reviews.Description: I’m beyond thrilled about my rhinoplasty result. I’m 4 weeks post op (photos taken at 3 weeks) and it’s truly corrected something that has been at the forefront of my mind for all my life. Even at this early stage, where swelling is still prominent, I love my result. I really appreciate Dr Toledo’s commitment to achieving natural looking results that complement each patient’s unique features. Not to mention, functionally he repaired a severe left septal deviation I didn’t even know I had; his ENT background is so valuable in this regard. I could not have asked for a better result.

user_reviews.Name: Gracie Giddens
user_reviews.Description:
I am a 19-year-old girl and I came in with a severely broken nose that required a rhinoplasty/septoplasty. Choosing a surgeon for such a complex procedure felt incredibly overwhelming.  I did so much research and ended up being referred by another plastic surgeon to Dr. Toledo. The day I met him, I knew he was the best one to do the surgery. I genuinely couldn't be happier with that decision. My nose went from incredibly crooked to such a perfect, cute nose.

If you are reading this and feeling the same level of anxiety I felt, the biggest piece of advice I can give you is to just trust him. He knows what he's talking about. Just go in, listen to his expert advice, and know you're in the hands of the best.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Toledo to absolutely everyone. Thank you, Dr. Toledo, for giving me the nose I have always wanted and making this whole process so worthwhile!

user_reviews.Name: Shahid Alfridawi
user_reviews.Description: I went to Dr. Toledo for my primary rhinoplasty, and both he and the anesthesiologist made me feel very comfortable before the procedure. My results look exactly like the mock-up he showed me, which exceeded my expectations. I recommend going in with a clear idea of what you want. Dr. Toledo is very direct and honest, and he provides professional input that’s truly helpful.

user_reviews.Name: Komal Kaur
user_reviews.Description:
***Update***

I’m updating this review after reading Dr. Toledo’s reply, which is completely inaccurate and misleading. To set the record straight: not once did he ask any mental health questions, perform any kind of evaluation, or have the right to make such a reckless claim about me.

My appointment lasted less than 10 minutes total - not “almost an hour” as he claims. The imaging portion took under a minute, and the moment I asked to see a few small adjustments, he became visibly impatient and dismissive. He walked out and returned saying he “can’t fix my brain” and that I’d be “nitpicking every angle.” That comment was degrading, completely uncalled for, and crossed every line of professionalism.

Declining a surgery is one thing. Lying publicly about a patient’s mental health to justify disrespectful behavior is another. His response is not only dishonest but manipulative, and it shows exactly the type of arrogance I experienced in that room. I stand by every single word of my review..no patient deserves to be spoken to or treated this way.

------------------------------------

I am deeply hurt and disappointed by my recent consultation with Dr. Toledo. I previously had a minor surgery with him back in June that went very well, so I was excited to come back for a rhinoplasty consultation. Sadly, this experience left me in tears and I’ve never looked at myself this way the way I’ve been insulted by someone I trusted so much.

At first, he was direct, which I appreciated because not a lot of doctors are..I’ll give him that. But once we got to the imaging, things went downhill. He spent about 10 secs creating one potential outcome on the computer and expected me to accept it without further discussion. When I asked questions and requested a few tweaks so I could see every angle, he became dismissive. The entire “consult” was 5 mins including the time I walked in the door and he came in the room, to me sitting down for imaging.

Dr. Toledo left the room, then came back sighing and told his nurse he “can’t perform on me” because I “have body dysmorphia.” He then said he “can’t fix my brain” and grabbed a mirror saying I’d be “nitpicking every angle of my nose”. This was all because I wanted a consultation longer than a few mins to make sure I understood the results before investing my hard-earned money for something I’ve wanted for my birthday/grad/Christmas gift to myself. He said “he doesn’t perform on people like that” implying there’s something wrong with me. I was so shocked and hurt.

I took off work early for this appointment and was genuinely excited, but instead I was insulted and left in tears. I never expected this from anyone especially a doctor I trusted. No patient deserves to be treated this way. I will also be reporting this experience to the medical board.

user_reviews_extended.Name: conanjay28
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have used these facilities twice now, in 2014 and 2026. Surgeon Dr. Toledo, his staff such as Esther and Sylvia, and anesthesiologist Dr. Jackson provided the utmost care to me - high quality people, high quality care, and theyre big on discretion. This all applies to before surgery, during surgery, and after surgery. They answered all questions I had, especially Sylvia, who had to answer via phone a few times for after-hours care. I have a profound love for all these professionals and this facility. If I should desire more cosmetic surgery in the future, I know exactly where to turn.

If you or someone you know is considering plastic surgery in the DFW region, please highly consider the Highland Park Plastic Surgery Center.

(They even expressed deep care about mental health conditions I have that did not apply to the surgery, going so far as to offer outside help and referrals in those areas!)

With Love, Monica.

user_reviews_extended.Description: My rhinoplasty surgery with Dr. Toledo went very well. I am extremely happy with my results, it looks very natural, he fixed all the issues I had with my nose. Everyone in the office was very nice & helpful. 10/10 recommend getting procedures done with Dr Toledo.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Yaklin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was extremely pleased with my results.  My breast augmentation results exceeded my expectations. Dr. Toledo and his staff are so friendly and have been an amazing guide through out the entire process. Look no further for the best team for a procedure that requires both art and science.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Riddhi Joshi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr. George A. Toledo, MD thinking I only had a deviated septum and asked about rhinoplasty/septoplasty. He was very honest and explained that I actually had a nasal perforation. Many doctors might have gone ahead with surgery without mentioning the real issue, but Dr. Toledo took the time to be transparent and make sure I understood my condition. I’m very thankful for his honesty and professionalism.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo is very honest and direct. I found his approach refreshing after going to 2 other Dallas plastic surgeons who seemed to be unsure about what is best for me. I'm a registered nurse working at BUMC for 10 years, so I know doctors. Anyway, I had a revision rhinoplasty last month and my results are incredible. I had my first rhinoplasty in LA about 15 years ago and waited a long time to get a revision because the first time was so hard. Dr. Toledo really listened to me and now my nose is perfect. He has able to straighten it and take care of my tip which was too wide. The recovery was very easy, I went back to work in a couple of days. I'm so happy and encourage others to see Dr. Toledo. He and his staff are the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy McCullough
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo and his staff are amazing!  From the initial consultation, they made me feel comfortable and answered all of my questions.  I am extremely pleased with my results and would highly recommend Dr. Toledo to my friends and family.  His office staff are First Class!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dominique Brignac
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr. Toledo a month ago and truly loved working with him and his team. They did a great job and made me feel informed, comfortable, and cared for each step of the way, can't recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: maddie wagner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo and his staff are the best! I am just over a month out from my rhinoplasty surgery and am SO happy with the results. It looks so natural and perfectly fits my face. Throughout the whole process, Dr. Toledo and his staff were very helpful, answering all my questions pre and post-surgery, so I had a clear understanding of what to expect. Overall, I am so so happy with my result and the entire experience, and couldn't recommend Dr. Toledo enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bonnie Nolan
user_reviews_extended.Description: My entire experience with Dr. Toledo and his team was very positive. Dr. Toledo is very honest about the results he can achieve and his team is very transparent about pricing and recovery time. My rhinoplasty surgery day was very easy since the surgery occurred at Dr. Toledo's office building. I believe the whole experience took only two hours. Moreover, I have had no issues with recovery and Dr. Toledo and his team has always been available for questions and checkups. Overall, my results exceeded my expectation, and I have full confidence in recommending Dr. Toledo to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience and beautiful results! I highly recommend Dr Toledo. He is an excellent plastic surgeon and the staff is amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Mcconnell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a nose job performed by Dr. Toledo and I am beyond thrilled with the results!

From the very first consultation, I felt confident in Dr. Toledo's abilities and knew I was in good hands. Throughout the entire process, Dr. Toledo was professional, attentive, and made sure I was comfortable and informed every step of the way.

The surgery itself went smoothly and the recovery process was manageable. I was amazed at how quickly I was able to see the final results, and they were exactly what I had hoped for. My nose looks natural and fits my face perfectly. I have received so many compliments and feel so much more confident in my appearance.

I would highly recommend Dr. Toledo to anyone considering plastic surgery. He is an exceptional surgeon with a wealth of knowledge and experience. He truly cares about his patients and goes above and beyond to ensure they are satisfied with their results. I am so grateful for the work he has done for me and will forever be a loyal patient. Thank you, Dr. Toledo!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Toledo is the BEST!! I’m about 2 months post-op (primary rhinoplasty) and couldn’t be happier with my new nose. I went to a few different initial consultations, but knew Toledo was the right choice for me after spending just a few minutes in his office. He is realistic, honest, and extremely straightforward about what he can/cannot do for you. He will not operate if he doesn’t think he can get a 80-90% improvement, which I found extremely comforting. As for my post-op recovery, my initial bruising and swelling was actually much less than anticipated. The most amazing part is how natural my nose looks post rhino. People can tell that I look better but sometimes can’t pinpoint what exactly I changed because my new nose fits my face so well. I love that I still look like myself, just a softer/ more feminine version, which was my exact goal.

His nurses and staff (Esther, Tracy, Emily) were so wonderful and I can’t thank them enough for the time they took helping me feel at ease throughout the process. His anesthesiologist, Dr. David Jackson, was incredible as well. He even called me the night before surgery to check in and see if I had any questions or concerns. As this was my first surgery ever, I had never been under general anesthesia before and was really nervous about that part. Dr. Jackson made me feel extremely comfortable and calm.

Dr. Toledo is a skilled, confident, and experienced surgeon with an incredible team behind him. You can’t go wrong with choosing him, and his years and years of experience should put your mind at ease. He did not disappoint! Thank you again, Toledo and team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savanna Gale
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo is AMAZING!!!!! He exceeded far beyond my expectations for my rhinoplasty. He is extremely knowledgeable and honest. During my consultation Dr. Toledo told me what he thinks could be changed about my nose, then he took the time to listen to my feedback and what I wanted to change about my nose, and showed me on the computer what the result might look like. No one can achieve the results that a computer gives, but he got really really close to that kind of perfection. I honestly don't even have the words to explain how thankful and blessed I am to have found such an amazing surgeon. When I tell people that I got a rhinoplasty they always say they would’ve never noticed if I didn’t say anything because it fits my face so well and looks so natural. Also, the office staff and the nurses are all so amazing, kind, and helpful. The whole experience and process was fantastic from start to finish. I immediately felt more confident the moment my cast came off. I am now almost one year post op and I genuinely couldn’t be happier with my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelina Radney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo and his team are top notch.  The begin to the end my experience at Highland Park Plastic Surgery Center was excellent.  I am in the medical field, specifically the OR, and it was after much research and consideration that I chose Dr. Toledo for my full facial rejuvenation.  I flew in from out of state and received top care and attention from Dr. Toledo, Dr. Jackson and his entire staff.   Dr. Toledo’s attention to detail, his commitment, combined with his years of experience resulted in an outcome that exceeded my expectations.   Dr. Toledo addressed all my questions and concerns to my satisfaction as well as listened to my personal thoughts and expectations of my end results.  The surgery center exemplifies the type of quality professionalism that one would expect.  I was addressed with comfort and competence that put me at ease during every phase of this journey.  I definitely made a great decision and will not hesitate to return to his office for future care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ally Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was incredibly professional, knowledgeable and helpful. Questions I had were answered quickly and easily. Dr. Toledo did a wonderful job on my surgeries and I’m grateful that he has clearly mastered his craft. Exceptional surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description: First and foremost, I want to thank Dr. Toledo, Esther, Tracy, Silvia, Emily and Dr. Jackson for taking such excellent care of me and my concerns. Their expertise and professional manner put me at ease and helped me gain confidence in my decision to have rhinoplasty and brow lift surgery at Highland Park Plastic Surgery Center. I was treated with compassion, care, respect and kindness from the initial consultation though the post-surgical follow-up. After we discussed my desired outcome for the revisions, Dr. Toledo advised me of reasonable expectations and the probable length of time it would take to achieve the final results. We decided on a surgery date and it was promptly scheduled. My results exceeded my expectations. I had 3 very deep brow lines in between my brows which was a major concern for me. The results are spectacular, the creases are barely visible. Dr. Toledo did a phenomenal job on my nose and believe me, it was a “honker”. It now has a lovely, natural appearance and I have received so many compliments on it from my friends and family. I’m just ecstatic with the results!  Dr. Toledo has performed over 3,000 rhinoplasties so it is my opinion he is the best rhinoplasty surgeon in North Texas. Another aspect I was pleased with was having my surgery performed at Dr. Toledo’s office as opposed to the tedious surgical procedures experienced at hospitals. The ease of appointments and office wait times were excellent. I don’t think I ever spent more than 5 minutes in the waiting area before I was escorted back to the exam room where Dr. Toledo promptly arrived within a few minutes. This exhibits an exceptional scheduling strategy to me. I have waited over 2 hours after my appointment times in other Dr’s offices and the ease of appointments at Dr. Toledo’s office was refreshing. I am so happy with the results Dr. Toledo and his staff have achieved with my surgery and I greatly appreciate everything they have done for me. I highly recommend this remarkable practice for anyone considering plastic surgery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos De Diego
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Toledo did an amazing job on my rhinoplasty, Staff are very friendly and welcoming

user_reviews_extended.Name: edna Reese
user_reviews_extended.Description: After many years of researching Plastic Surgeons, I finally decided on Dr. Toledo of Highland Park Plastic Surgery Center for a facelift. After our first consultation, I knew I had made the right choice. He was honest and professional on what he can and cannot do to achieve the results I was looking for. After 3 weeks post-op, I am extremely happy with my results. Thank you Dr. Toledo for your expertise and compassion. You truly are an expert at facelifts. Thank you to my anesthesiologist, Dr. Jackson for relieving my anxiety prior to surgery. Dr. Toledo’s staff was very inviting and professional at each visit. Many thanks to Esther, Sylvia, Emily, Betty, and Tracy. If you’re looking for a plastic surgeon, I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Toledo of Highland Park!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Herfurth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Dr. Toledo for a revision rhinoplasty 3 1/2 months ago and I couldn’t be happier with the results! Naturally one will be skeptical about getting a revision rhinoplasty for many reasons, but Dr. Toledo was very candid in the initial consult and I found comfort in the fact that he would not operate if he did not think he was able to improve my previous concerns. Dr. Toledo and his team have been very thorough and extremely helpful throughout the entire process and have taken great care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Only 3 weeks post septoplasty and the results are already amazing. It’s as if my nose has an instagram filter on it. Dr Toledo was the first surgeon I went to and I booked with him straight away. This no-nonsense type of surgeon really understands angles and proportions whilst being able to achieve beautiful natural results. I like how calm he is to be around and not sale’sy or pushy at all. This was my first cosmetic surgery and I felt great care by Dr Toledo and the entire team made the whole process extremely easy. I love the side profile of my nose but my new front profile is even better than I could have hoped for. Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: BellaVic
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo is hands down AMAZING!! He performed my initial procedure in 2001, a second procedure in 2003, and my most recent procedure this year.  Nothing but great experience’s every time with him and his staff throughout the entire process. I recently had explant surgery and am extremely happy with my results. Dr. Toledo and his staff guided me through the entire process, listened to all my concerns, answered all my questions, and let me know what to expect from the surgery and my results. At my most recent follow up Dr. Toledo made sure that I knew to call or come back in if I have any questions or concerns before my next follow up in three months. Dr. Toledo really cares about his patients, and I am so thankful for him and his staff; they truly are caring and compassionate people who treat you with kindness. Thank you so much Dr. Toledo and staff!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eloisa Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hi. If you’re looking for someone that is honest and a staff that is amazing this is wear you should be. Also if you haven’t found someone that is awesome at working with Hispanic, African, Indian, and asian skin then look no more Dr. Toledo is the best Doctor for you. All the questions you have about any surgical procedure can be answered at his office and via phone by schedule. I had my rhinoplasty surgery a year ago and everything went smoothly and I healed fast and completely within 2 two weeks. If you don’t have transportation in the Dallas location or someone that can take you home and nurse you, a travel nurse can be hired. You will have to pay that separately. But when it comes to paying for the procedure they will give you that information during consultation. When you arrive at Dr. Toledo’s office it matches the Good energy of the staff very beautiful. The office is also peaceful, clean, and informative i.  Dr. Toledo is very experienced, if you want natural results he and his team will most definitely achieve it and take good care of you. user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo has no bedside manner, he spoke to me as if he was bothered to speak with me. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonya Anders

From consolation to every follow up visit he and staff have been the very best. I highly recommend them with a 5 star.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Price
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Toledo is INCREDIBLE. I seriously could not recommend him enough. I had my rhinoplasty 6 weeks ago and it was the BEST experience.

First and foremost, when my mom and I went to my initial visit, Dr. Toledo could tell I was nervous  as I’m getting married in September, but he assured me my nose would look amazing after 6months.. he then said it would look great by 6 weeks. Dr Toledo is truly an expert and I’m already so happy with my results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Traci Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Toledo has my absolute trust. He is a phenomenal plastic surgeon. He is very blunt and honest with what he promises and I really appreciate that about him. His staff are ALL incredibly nice and cool people that make you enjoy going to an appointment. I would recommend him and his staff without any hesitation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pearl Downing
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo achieved exactly what I wanted with my rhinoplasty. He sets realistic expectations and will be honest with you on what he can improve. All the girls at the front desk are especially friendly and sweet as well which is an added bonus when visiting the office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Pearce
user_reviews_extended.Description:
***Update***

Please see the bottom part of the review for the most recent update.

About 3 weeks ago, I decided it was time for me to take the plunge and have nose surgery. I had a crooked nose and a deviated septum, so I underwent septoplasty and rhinoplasty together. I am very pleased with the results I've achieved so far. My nose is still a little swollen, but the appearance is what I am happy about. Dr. Toledo is great! The front office ladies are all awesome. The blonde nurse, who I met for the first time yesterday, was very nice (and pretty) but that's beside the point. The anesthesiologist was great. He called me the night before surgery and answered a few questions I had. I don't see how people post negative comments about doctor Toledo, though. It's not like you're going to be friends with him outside of the office. He is like a typical doctor in terms of personality and communication. All I cared about was getting good results, and that's exactly what I got. 5 stars overall. I'm glad I went with Dr. Toledo.

Edit (Feb 8, 2026) -
It took me a while to write this follow up review, but I’m not happy with my results. Not only is my nose not straight, but part of it wasn’t even looked at by Dr Toledo. I remember being in his office and him spending a total of about 15-20 seconds actually looking at my nose and telling me what I needed done. The upper part of my nose is crooked, along with the lower part. He only tried to fix the lower part, which it still isn’t straight. The upper part was never re-broken by him as if he didn’t even try to fix it. Only good thing is that I can breathe out of my left nostril now, which I couldn’t before. Overall, not happy with the results. Waste of $12k. I’m going to have to go to another doctor to see what can be done to rebrake the top part and actually have a straight nose.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Bartlett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Toledo and staff are amazing! I have been a patient of Dr. Toledo's for almost 20 years. He did my initial surgery in 2002, a repair in 2005 and another update 11/2021; and every time I felt like they were family. Every one is kind, compassionate and truly do treat you like family! As a medical professional myself (RN), creating an atmosphere of care, concern and compassion is not as common as you would think. Thank you Dr. Toledo and staff for taking great care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robyn Schwerdt

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne

user_reviews_extended.Name: Penelope Archer

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arshila Sojdie

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Manning

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Wagner

user_reviews_extended.Name: R L

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Maltese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Toledo is top notch, hands down the very best plastic surgeon you will find! He is the ONLY plastic surgeon I would ever even consider using. user_reviews_extended.Name: alli mckibbin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been happy with the appearance of my nose. I finally had the opportunity to fix it. user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are looking for an incredible plastic surgeon and a staff that creates a warm and welcoming environment, then look no further!  As expressed by almost all of these reviews, I can also attest that Dr. Toledo is a very talented plastic surgeon.  He is a true artist. He goes above and beyond to make sure that his patients are completely satisfied and happy with their results.
