user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Berges
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Real review from an Oklahoma doctor: As a physician myself I spent a lot of time researching who I was going to use when I finally decided to do rhinoplasty/septoplasty. I’ve always wanted this done and finally made the leap.  My biggest fear was not liking the results and being stuck with them.
I did 7 consults with different ENT and Cosmetic Surgery specialists. After my consult with Dr Toledo I was very confident in His skill and experience. He listened to my concerns and what I was looking for and was able to deliver.

I am extremely happy with my results and am so very glad that I found Dr Toledo. Do not hesitate in using him for your Rhinoplasty. He is fully capable and you will not be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renae Lohmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I read Dr. Toledo's reviews before going in for a consultation and noticed some say he is too direct. I must say that my experience was great. He is very, to the point, and I think that's great. He showed me what I could expect from the rhinoplasty using computer imaging, I also asked him if I should consider other procedures like lipo and fillers and he said it wasn't necessary and I was beautiful without those and it wasn't something I should be concerned about, especially at my age 24 (which he was right!! so grateful for him). I like his very natural approach; not doing too much or trying to make me a fake Instagram influencer. I’m extremely pleased with my results. It's been 2 weeks and I love my nose. No bruising or pain.  My fiancé and family love it too. This is a Doctor with integrity and is not money hungry to pressure me into unnecessary surgeries. Would go back if needed 10/10!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bohemianca
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hired Dr Toledo for 2 different procedures within the last 15 years. I saw Dr Toledo last year for a second completely different procedure than the first.  I didn’t review right away, because I was too upset. I thought waiting a year would be fair. I returned to him because he did a good job. His bedside manner wasn’t the best, but it wasn’t awful. However, It was awful on the second procedure. Without going into what the surgeries were, I just want to say this. After waking from the last  procedure, I was hurried out of the door in pain. At one point, he leaned over to tell me that it”shouldn’t hurt that much”.  I watched as he motioned for the nurse to “hurry up” with me. I complained a week later to staff during my follow-up visit, telling them about how bad that experience was.  I never returned for my post op photos. The treatment I received after waking still haunts me today. We all don’t have the same pain tolerances. His comment was insensitive and off putting. He speaks to you as though you’re LUCKY to even speak with him at all. Don’t ask a question, unless you want him to shut it down as though you are a child asking for dessert before dinner. His staff seems to try to overcompensate  for his lack of empathy, but it  wasn’t enough. I hope he can gain better perspective of how to return to treating patients with compassion and exemplify ethical behavior to clients that are arriving already feeling eager for support.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Thorp
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so grateful for Dr. Toledo, he saved my life. I have been a patient for years. He did my nose 15 years ago. Over the years I have sent countless friends to Dr. Toledo.  For all types of procedures including Rhinoplasty, face lifts and tummy tucks.  All have had the same experience as I. user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary A Dunne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Toledo is truly the G.O.A.T in his field!! His staff is amazing and totally dedicated to their craft and Dr Toledo!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Genevieve Simpson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough great things about Dr. Toledo, I have recommended him to all of my friends and family in search of a plastic surgeon and will continue to do so.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Sakowski
user_reviews_extended.Description: I agree with just about every 5 star review already written. My experience was better than expected and the results are even better than I'd hoped. I am so thankful he was recommended to me. No doubt, I'll be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bruce Wayne

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Pastorelle

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Burris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm very happy with the results from my rhinoplasty and septoplasty.  I not only feel more confident in my appearance, but I can breathe better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Meireles

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chandler Nichols
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolute best experience!! Dr. Toledo and his staff are excellent. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Doctor, the Job he performed on me was Great, highly recommended!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in today for a consult very excited to speak with Dr. Toledo and his staff and left feeling like I paid $150 to annoy someone for 10 minutes. He came in looking very irritated, aggressively grabbing my chin and nose to look at it. When I told him I previously had nose filler he started squeezing at my nose to “try and move it” OUCH. He spent maybe 1-2 minutes editing the pictures and that was that, I was never asked for my opinion on the things HE wanted to change. The pictures he edited looked terrible as he barely spent time on it so I couldn’t even make a decision on if I wanted to proceed or not. The other staff clearly try to overcompensate for his egotistical attitude and it was a very uncomfortable experience. Read the bad reviews and save your $150 bucks 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely happy with the results of my rhinoplasty! I had such a good experience with Dr. Toledo & his staff. The office people were very friendly & helpful. Just got the cast removed 3 days ago & already love how my nose is looking. He gave me exactly what I want & made it look “natural”. Have already got so many compliments on how my nose looks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim C.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I couldn’t be happier with my results! My facelift, breast lift, and tummy tuck turned out beautifully—natural, balanced, and exactly what I hoped for. From the first consultation to post-op care, the entire staff (Esther, Silvia, Anesthesiologist Dr. Jackson, and of course Dr. Toledo) was warm, professional, and incredibly attentive. They made me feel comfortable and supported every step of the way. I especially appreciated Dr. Toledo's candor and what expectations were possible and ones that were not. His years of experience, expertise, and being a double board certified were very important to me. Highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional results and a truly caring team! Thank you!
Kim. C.

title: Dr. William P. Adams Jr.
address: 6901 Snider Plaza #120, Dallas, TX 75205, United States

user_reviews.Name: Jamie Darnell
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Adams and his entire team are phenomenal. I am only 10 days post-op, and my experience from consultation through recovery has been nothing short of exceptional.

I underwent a breast revision with pocket repair — this being my second pocket repair after a prior surgery with another surgeon. From the very beginning, Dr. Adams was honest, transparent, and realistic about my options and potential outcomes. During my consult, he clearly explained that a lift would be necessary and was upfront about not being able to maintain my prior size long-term if the pocket repair was going to be successful. I appreciated his integrity and trusted his expertise completely.

Even at just 10 days post-op, I can already tell my results are going to develop beautifully. I also have the option to size up in about 12 months once everything has fully healed, which gave me peace of mind knowing this was a long-term, thoughtful plan — not a rushed decision.

The recovery has truly exceeded my expectations. I’ve had five cosmetic procedures, and this has been by far the easiest and least painful recovery I’ve ever experienced. I was up, mobile, and comfortable very quickly and didn’t even need all of my prescribed pain medication. Dr. Adams’ 24-hour recovery method is absolutely real and incredibly effective.

The staff deserves just as much praise. I felt safe, supported, and cared for from start to finish. A special thank-you to Ellery, who was amazing — compassionate, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough in making sure I understood every step of the process. Her support made a huge difference.

I cannot express enough how wonderful Dr. Adams and his team are. If you are looking for an exceptional surgeon who prioritizes patient education, safety, and beautiful long-term results, I highly recommend Dr. Adams.

user_reviews.Name: Jo Whitley
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Shikhar Tomur performed a skin graft on my nose after having a Basel cell carcinoma removed. Prior to the surgery, he informed me of all options and what to expect using different procedures and answered all questions so I felt very comfortable knowing what to expect. I can’t begin to explain how grateful I am to have been put in his most capable hands to perform this surgery. He went above and beyond all expectations before and after the procedure. My recovery has been remarkable because of his expertise and care. He treats you with the highest respect and puts you at ease. Truly, he is a most caring physician! I highly recommend him for any procedure you require! And, the surgery was a total success with absolutely no complications!

Three months since the surgery and you can hardly see that any procedure was done. I am so thankful for him. If you want the very best, look no further than Dr. Tomur!

user_reviews.Name: Tara Williams
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Tomur and his team are wonderful, caring, experienced professionals! From my initial consultation to my post-procedure appointments with Dr. Tomur and the team, I have been incredibly well cared for, heard and supported. This team has tremendous technical and medical knowledge and capability. They are at the same time remarkably kind and genuine individuals. A pretty special combination!

user_reviews.Name: Gabriella Solis
user_reviews.Description:
Truly a 24-Hour Recovery – I’d Do It Again in a Heartbeat!

I’m just one week post-op from my augmentation and lift with Dr. Adams, and I can confidently say: it was 100% worth it and I’d do it all over again.

Even at my consultation, the entire team made me feel welcome and cared for. Every person on Dr. Adams’ staff greeted me by name, and that personal touch continued all the way through surgery and recovery.

I was most nervous about pain and downtime, but surgery day was smooth and seamless. I spent about 6 hours total at the surgical center, then returned to my hotel, took a nap, showered, went out for a late lunch, did some shopping at NorthPark, had dinner, and was in bed by 9 PM! I had hardly any discomfort the first few days and didn’t need any prescription pain medication until day 4, when I took a single dose after a full work day. That was it — and even then, it was more precautionary than necessary. I had surgery on Thursday and returned to work on Monday.

I knew I had chosen the surgeon to give me beautiful and optimal results — but I didn’t realize I was also choosing the surgeon who would give me the easiest, fastest recovery imaginable.

It’s not magic. It’s not an exaggeration. Dr. Adams and his team prepare you from the very beginning to manifest a smooth recovery and encourage your body to heal quickly. I followed their guidance and trusted the process; I’m beyond grateful that I did and even more so that I chose Dr. Adams.

user_reviews.Name: Dorys Aracena
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had a breast lift (mastopexy) with augmentation performed by Dr. William Adams, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience and results. From start to finish, Dr. Adams was incredibly professional, making me feel comfortable and well-informed at every step. He and his team were exceptionally supportive, answering all my questions before I even had to ask. It was clear they truly care about their patients’ well-being and satisfaction.

After 2 years of research and visiting all type of doctors in Miami and the FL area in general, I traveled all the way from Miami to Dallas to undergo this procedure with Dr. Adams, and it was by far the best decision I’ve made.
The offices are impressively clean, comfortable, and welcoming, which made each visit an absolute pleasure. Dr. Adams even has amazing technology on-site, allowing me to see a 3D demo of how I would look post-surgery. This gave me so much confidence and reassurance going into the procedure.

The staff at the surgery center were phenomenal, helping me feel completely relaxed and confident on the day of surgery. Kirby and the entire team were a dream to work with; their kindness, commitment, and warm, friendly attitudes made me feel like I was among family.

Now, just 8 days post-op, my results are already better than I could have imagined—the look is so natural, and Dr. Adams accomplished exactly what I was looking for to perfection. My recovery has been smooth with absolutely zero pain, and, aside from some expected limitations, I’ve been able to resume most of my daily activities.

I can’t thank Dr. Adams and his team enough for their incredible professionalism and dedication. Choosing Dr. Adams was the best decision ever, and I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone considering this journey.

user_reviews.Name: Brianne Dengler
user_reviews.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Adams! I recently had a breast augmentation revision and the whole experience was flawless. They are so organized, took amazing care of me and gave me the prettiest results! Ellery felt like sunshine and made the whole process so seamless. When my procedure required a bit more than anticipated, she pivoted so fast. She had new meds waiting at the pharmacy across the street and a new customized, post-op booklet waiting for me in recovery! (Like how?? I think she’s magic.) She truly gave the highest level of patient care! Dr. Adams, of course, did a phenomenal job and I felt so comfortable with his expertise. The surgical team was also top-notch. I had a lot of nerves about the surgery day/process itself. It was way better than I could’ve imagined. The staff from pre-op to recovery, had me feeling so comfortable. I’m more than happy with the results and will happily stay their patient as long as possible (and tell all my friends and family as well)!

user_reviews.Name: Kymbre Kupatt
user_reviews.Description: I am so grateful for the opportunity to be under the care of Dr. Adams & his girls. They made this process painless in all aspects & my results are even more than I hoped for. I felt so confident in his work that I had zero worry on what my result was going to look like & that my recovery would go smoothly. Truly a blessing to feel like you are getting the best care possible.If you want an anxiety free process,  I cannot recommend Dr. Adams enough.

user_reviews.Name: Jill Livesay
user_reviews.Description: When I walked into this clinic I felt hopeless. I had been operated on several times and it was worse every time. When I started the process I felt valued by his team, and when I met Dr Adams I felt hope. The end result exceeded all my expectations. I am so grateful for the time and effort put into my transformation. It has made me whole mind, body and spirit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kylie Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adams & his team are nothing short of AMAZING! Breast augmentation is something I considered for over a decade and I finally decided to do it. I did an extensive amount of research and found Dr. Adams. I traveled to Dallas from South Carolina for his skill and reputation for 24 hour recovery and excellent results. There is nothing that I would change about my experience! His team was in contact with me multiple times prior to my arrival so I felt very prepared and comfortable. We flew into to Dallas and met with Dr. Adams the following day. He explained his tissue-based planning methods and presented me with my options. We made a decision and I felt so excited and comfortable when leaving. Any nerves I had were gone! Surgery was the next morning and the staff at the surgery center was awesome! I was in and out in just a couple of hours. I followed his step-by-step instructions and felt good enough to go to dinner and an NBA game that night! No pain - just a little tight or sore… almost like after a good workout! I had my postop appt the next day and then flew home that afternoon! I’m about 2 months out and could not be happier with my experience and results! Thank you SO much, Dr. Adams! To Ellery, Kirby, Christy, and Caroline - you ladies are phenomenal and truly care for your patients and it shows! Dr. Adams is so blessed to have you all on his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aurora Sanders
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adams is INCREDIBLE. I went to Dr. Adams last August for a breast augmentation, and it’s now coming close to being a year since the procedure; the results are incredible. He’s known for his 24 hour recovery technique, and it’s exactly as described. The surgery itself was a breeze, very quick! I went back to the hotel for a 1 hour nap (part of his protocol) and was out shopping and getting dinner the same afternoon! The pain was extremely minimal, no narcotic pain medication required; and I was back to working and living my normal life within a day of surgery. The results are fantastic and natural, and I’m so glad I chose to trust Dr. Adams with my surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adams and his staff are amazing. They took great care of me before, during, and after my procedure. I’m 100% satisfied with my decision to have my breast augmentation done by him. I hated that part of my body before surgery, to the point where I didn’t even want to look in the mirror. Now I feel confident and proud.

user_reviews_extended.Name: wendi case
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have friends who also had an augmentation and talk about the pain and how they can’t sleep on their side and have issues with push ups etc. I kept thinking they must have had a different surgery than me, I had absolutely NO pain!! I don’t have any issues sleeping and I am able to do upper body workout without any problem!  I chose Dr. Adams because he writes several of the chapter in the books used by plastic surgeon in their residency training. Also, the staff are amazing! They always make you feel important, because the are passionate about what they do. I have been recommended them to anyone who will listen!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I originally had my first breast augmentation procedure 10 years ago with Dr. Adams. I recently went back in for a breast implant exchange and lift. Both experiences have been absolutely amazing, and I am loving my results! I was back to work the following week and only needed Tylenol when I felt uncomfortable.
All of the postoperative instructions were completely thorough prior to surgery which put me at ease. Dr. Adams and his staff are truly the best. Thank you so much for the life changing results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Lapino
user_reviews_extended.Description: I first saw Dr Adams in 2006, and returned as I want a different type of implant now. I could easily have stayed with my original set because they are gorgeous. I cannot recommend him enough. His work is flawless, he’s the best at what he does - and I’ve worked in the aesthetic industry for 14 years and have seen a lot of other doctors greatest work. As a patient I can say that your recovery is next to nothing. You may feel a little tired for 12-24 hours, but your excitement at your now perfect breasts overrides that. I had nearly invisible scars, I cannot wait to see what I have after this next surgery. Dr Adams explains what he wants to do and why, he explains your options, and he’s friendly and positive the entire time. You don’t feel pressured or as if you have to do a thing. If you’re thinking of getting breast ANYTHING, go to Dr Adams. I’m traveling from Europe to see him, because he’s incredibly talented.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery Mileger
user_reviews_extended.Description: For as long as I can remember I wanted a breast augmentation. I am so glad I found Dr. Adams. I can't believe I waited this long! From the first minute of my consultation, I couldn't wait to get the surgery. The 3D imaging was amazing, Dr. Adams was very informative and his entire staff was so helpful. The recovery was amazing. Not only were my results better than I could have dreamed but I had zero pain and was back to work the next day. Just two weeks later, I was off to a lake vacation with my friends. I am blown away by his fast-track recovery process. It has been a fun and pleasing experience from start to finish and a year later, I am still so in love with my new breasts and the confidence they have restored. Best decision to see Dr. Adams in the summer since I didn't even have to put my plans on hold, too, and they could accommodate my schedule with ease. I cannot say enough great things about him and his incredible staff. Thank you so much for changing my summer and my life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Malone (Wellness Inspired Gal)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adams and his team are the absolute BEST!!  I went to Dr. Adams for a "re-do" after problems with my first augmentation. It was much easier than I expected and so much smoother than my first surgery; no pain, no bandages, no drains.  I love my cohesive gel implants. The outcome was fabulous and the staff is amazing!  I too, am an out of town patient. I was in for surgery that morning and home in my own bed that evening. I still go to Dallas 2-3 times a year to see Dr Adams and his staff for my botox.  Extremely satisfied and would recommend anyone to Dr. Adams.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucie Love
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Dr. Adam's plastic surgery center. The staff was absolutely incredible. They helped me pick out my new breast size and made me feel very comfortable and not nervous at all. Everything I was worried about I didnt feel worried about anymore once I arrived at his office. Sydney is such a fabulous nurse and helped me so much with my recovery. We still text and she helps me with any questions I have regarding my recovery. They have been so incredibly fabulous. I had liposuction and a breast augmentation and I have never been more happy with how my breasts and arms look now!! It is such a difference and helped me to feel WAY more confident. My breasts look AMAZING all my friends are in awe of how great they look and how quickly my recovery went. I am thrilled that I booked with Dr. Adam's. And look forward to returning for more procedures in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Priscilla Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for beast augmentation in 2023 & I am beyond happy with my results they look natural and he made sure it fits my body frame perfectly. I wanted to go bigger but I’m glad I didn’t! Dr.Adam’s and his staff were very professional as well ! They answered all my questions before and after surgery with no issues. Money well spent🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nena Do
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Adams was awesome! I'm so glad I decided to go with him, he is an excellent plastic surgeon. His staff was super friendly and very accommodating. I had my surgery on Friday and was back at work on Tuesday, no post op pain or complications. I would highly recommend Dr. Adams.

user_reviews_extended.Name: May Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am extremely and beyond impressed with Dr. Adams, Christy, Geena and his surgical team.
They made the entire process, which can be nerve wrecking, very comfortable for me from start to finish. After my consultation, I was confident I had picked the right surgeon to have my breast augmentation. Dr. Adams is an expert in this field and in my opinion the only way to go. He and his staff were so thorough and answered all my questions and concerns before I even had a chance to ask them! I was educated through my consultation and guided on the best and safest size for my body. I couldn't be happier with the results. The 24hr recovery is not a myth! user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaydance Hope

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would definitely recommend Dr. Adams for any breast augmentation surgery (i.e. boob job, lift or reconstructive surgery)! I was referred to him by a friend of mine who had hers done & explained to me she had a 24 hour recovery period, no pain, no discomfort, no complications & the work he did was beautiful & natural looking.

After not being from Dallas, I did extensive research & found there was no better plastic surgeon than Dr. Adams who specializes on breast augmentations. If you follow his post surgery instructions, you will heal in no time. I was walking around & eating that same day & felt normal. You could easily be back to work 2-3 days later. I was even back in the gym working out 6 weeks post surgery. Now, it's been 3 months since my surgery & i'm fully healed & my "boobs" have completely settled. Most surgeons say 4-6 months until they look natural on your body; however Dr. Adams procedure only took 2.5 months.

I am the biggest baby about pain and I promise, there wasn't one hour I ever felt any pain. Several friends of mine have had their surgery's conducted by other "really well known" doctors in Dallas and yet they complain of nights waking up screaming in so much pain taking weeks off work. NOT with Dr. Adams - his medical research, innovation, & procedure he uses is THE BEST.

Everyone involved from his staff to clinic technicians are all so amazing to have worked with & I would refer him to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Adams has been my go to doctor for all of my cosmetic surgeries and I wouldn’t go to any other surgeon. The office staff is really nice and welcoming! I recommend him extremely highly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karie DeLynn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am so disappointed to be writing this negative feedback. I hope I am able to help others not make the same mistake I did by choosing a surgeon that is not willing to do what’s best for his patients. Even if he wasn’t willing to take the blame, then he could have at least acknowledged that the results from my surgery were not right.

I had a breast augmentation and liposuction in September 2018 by Dr. Adams
*3 months after surgery I started to notice that I might be “bottoming out.”
{Bottoming out can be caused by the following reasons: Large implants and weak breast tissue. Surgeon error of lowering the breast crease too low.}
I then brought my concerns to Sydney’s (Dr. Adams’ assistant) attention immediately so that she could then share my concerns with Dr. Adams. She told me it was too early and I was still healing and I was definitely not bottoming out. I was concerned maybe my implants were too large but I was reassured they were not. Dr. Adams is actually more on the conservative side when choosing which size of implant for his patients. If I had weak breast tissue, that is fine, but he still should  have addressed the issue rather dismissing it as a nonissue.

*6 months after surgery the issues got worse. Again,  I brought it to Sydney’s attention and she reassured me I was not bottoming out and I was still healing. Same song and dance. I trusted her observation and felt as though she had my best interest at hand. I was very wrong!

While meeting with Dr. Adams (8 months after surgery), Sydney sits there with a horrible look on her face as though it’s my fault and I was in the wrong. She was extremely unprofessional. In my opinion she is not qualified to do her job. I am beyond disappointed that Dr. Adams felt that suggesting a fat transfer to fill in the ripples was the answer. Basically trying to put a band aid on the problem. What about the fact that my implants had sunk so low they were sitting on my rib cage? No suggestions made for that.

Here I am 9 months after surgery and have met with 2 other surgeons and after consulting  with them their immediate response was, “without a doubt you are bottoming out.” I knew all along but naively convinced myself for 8 months that Dr. Adams and Sydney were right. I was wrong again!

Again, I would rather him to have taken the easy way out and blamed it on my body and how my body accepted the implants rather than acting as though there was no issue at all. I’m now left with a bigger issues than I started with, I am out $13k,  and still have to pay to have a revision done. I haven’t gone into the fact that the liposuction was a complete waste of money because he didn’t address all the areas I asked him too. Fortunately I don’t have issues from that part of my procedure.

While I am aware plastic surgery is an elective surgery you would think a surgeon wouldn’t want his name attached to poor work. I would not recommend Dr. Adams to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Adams and his fabulous staff have been great!  He is a skilled cosmetic surgeon, having fine-tuned my particular procedure, and has had many articles published in respected medical journals.  His staff is professional, warm and friendly, and they have been more than patient with my questions, phone calls and emails.  I highly recommend Dr. Adams and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: debbie fontenot
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had implant exchange surgery (leaking saline implant) and a neck tightening procedure done with Dr Adams in Jan 2018. Both ending with very poor results! Even with leaking implant my breast look way better in before pics than they do after surgery! My chin has a huge scar with flaps of skin running down neck. Looks deformed! I expressed my concerns from the very beginning and it was very obvious that Dr Adams had no intention of taking responsibility for the poor outcome. He and his staff were very indifferent and showed no interest in patient satisfaction!! In one of the visits I was actually told my one of his staff that she would be more than happy to refer me to another surgeon. In final visit he said he would refer me to another surgeon to fix my neck and that the only thing he would do for breast is a lift (which I didn't need before). All at my expense. I already spent 14k with Dr Adams. I am having 2 other surgeons fix this bad outcome, making Dr Adams a very disappointing, costly, and all-around bad choice in plastic surgeons!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: April S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are considering any type of cosmetic procedure do your homework! There are so many surgeons from which to choose, all with varying degrees of skill, cost, and personal style. After giving birth to my four amazing children and breast feeding them I needed help! I did my research and had two consultations with other doctors before I found "my surgeon", Dr. Adams! Upon meeting Dr. Adams and his amazing staff I knew that he would be the doctor for me. Dr. Adams performed a breast lift and augmentation along with a tummy tuck on me in 2009, and here I am nearly five years later, and my body looks incredible. My breasts look and feel natural, sexy, and better than BEFORE having children. I said it five years ago, and I've read where others have stated the same since me, Dr. Adams is the Da Vinci of plastic surgery. There is a reason patients say it - It's the truth. Remember, you have only one body. Entrusting it to lesser skilled hands could lead to a lifetime of regret. You owe it to yourself to select the best - Dr. Adams!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Michell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had breast reduction surgery done by Dr. Adams in June 2017. I went in with the initial consultation stating that yes I wanted to be smaller than the H/I cup that I was, but still wanted to have large breasts approximately a DD/DDD. He tells me he can't guarantee cup size, but will go with what he feels is appropriate for my frame. I question the need for small implants in addition to the reduction as I've seen others that end up looking pancakey and lack upper fullness after reductions. He assures me that I have plenty of natural breast tissue and will not need implants to maintain shape and upper fullness.

I proceed with surgery and at my first post OP appointment question the large amount of lateral tissue remaining under my arms when supposedly he had liposuctioned the area. I'm told it is swelling and will go down. I go in for several follow ups over the following months, rarely ever seeing the Dr only his assistant. Lateral tissue remains unchanged and I'm also now questioning the "dog ears" at the ends of my incisions. I'm told by the assistant that he intentionally closes that way so the scars don't over correct and pucker in and they should flatten over time with their "scar therapy". I used Bio Corneum and Mepiform strips both recommend by them that made no difference at all.

Fast forward to my one year follow up...dog ears still present and large amount of lateral tissue present. Zero upper fullness in my breasts you could literally feel bone, no breast tissue whatsoever and I'm a C/D cup now at best mainly due to width not projection which is way smaller than I said I wanted, and they basically just look like sad pancakes. Not at all the results I had hoped and spent over $12,000 on. So we talk about revision of the scars and putting in some small implants he NOW agrees I need for upper fullness. Then I get the quote of $8500 for this, and $4500 of that is for "scar revision"! I understand paying for the implants, but excuse me, the horrible purple keloids with dog ears on a fair skinned person like myself are your fault, not mine!

Therefore, I had my revision done by another surgeon with excellent results. He couldn't believe how horrible the incisions were and said the "dog ears" were just pure laziness on Dr. Adams part. World of difference with the other surgeon and my breasts are beautiful now. It's only been a short time since that surgery and you can already barely see the scars. Any idiot can slap in a pair of implants and call themselves an authority on breast augmentation, but it takes true skill to do reductions, reconstructions, or revisions. Choose wisely ladies or learn the hard expensive way like I did!
